        let (tenant, mut tx, _) = authorized(
            &state,
            &headers,
            &identity,
            READ_PERMISSION,
            PERMISSION,
            false,
        )
        .await?;
        let data = sqlx::query_as::<_, OutgoingNfeSnapshot>(
            "SELECT id,access_key,issuer_document,issuer_name,recipient_document,number,series,issued_at,total_cents,item_count,environment,xml_sha256,created_at FROM fiscal_outgoing_imports WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2",
        ).bind(tenant).bind(id).fetch_optional(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?.ok_or(DomainError::NotFound)?;
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(
            StatusCode::OK,
            None,
            OutgoingDetail {
                tenant_id: tenant,
                data,
            },
        ))
    }
    fn filter_date(value: Option<&str>) -> Result<Option<time::Date>, DomainError> {
        let format = time::format_description::parse_borrowed::<2>("[year]-[month]-[day]")
            .expect("static date format");
        value
            .map(|raw| {
                time::Date::parse(raw, &format)
                    .map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("Data inválida; use AAAA-MM-DD"))
            })
            .transpose()
    }
    #[utoipa::path(get, path="/api/v1/fiscal/outgoing-imports", tag="Fiscal",
        security(("bearerAuth"=[])), params(OutgoingQuery,("X-Tenant-Id"=Uuid,Header)), responses(
        (status=200,body=OutgoingPage),(status=403,description="Sem permissão fiscal"),
        (status=422,description="Filtros inválidos")))]
    pub async fn list(
        State(state): State<AppState>,
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
        query: Result<Query<OutgoingQuery>, QueryRejection>,
    ) -> Result<Response, FiscalError> {
        let query = query
            .map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("Filtros inválidos"))?
            .0;
        let q = query.q.unwrap_or_default().trim().to_lowercase();
        let offset = query.offset.unwrap_or(0);
        let limit = query.limit.unwrap_or(25);
        let from = filter_date(query.from.as_deref())?;
        let to = filter_date(query.to.as_deref())?;
        if q.chars().count() > 200
            || !(1..=100).contains(&limit)
            || from.zip(to).is_some_and(|(a, b)| a > b)
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Confira o período e os filtros da consulta").into());
        }
        let (tenant, mut tx, can_import) = authorized(
            &state,
            &headers,
            &identity,
            READ_PERMISSION,
            PERMISSION,
            false,
        )
        .await?;
        let data = sqlx::query_as::<_, OutgoingNfeSnapshot>(
            "SELECT id,access_key,issuer_document,issuer_name,recipient_document,number,series,issued_at,total_cents,item_count,environment,xml_sha256,created_at FROM fiscal_outgoing_imports WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND strpos(lower(issuer_name || ' ' || issuer_document || ' ' || access_key || ' ' || number::text),$2)>0 AND ($3::date IS NULL OR (issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date >= $3) AND ($4::date IS NULL OR (issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date <= $4) ORDER BY issued_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6"
        ).bind(tenant).bind(&q).bind(from).bind(to).bind(i64::from(limit)).bind(i64::from(offset)).fetch_all(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        let total = sqlx::query_scalar(
            "SELECT count(*) FROM fiscal_outgoing_imports WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND strpos(lower(issuer_name || ' ' || issuer_document || ' ' || access_key || ' ' || number::text),$2)>0 AND ($3::date IS NULL OR (issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date >= $3) AND ($4::date IS NULL OR (issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date <= $4)"
        ).bind(tenant).bind(&q).bind(from).bind(to).fetch_one(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(
            StatusCode::OK,
            None,
            OutgoingPage {
                tenant_id: tenant,
                can_import,
                data,
                total,
            },
        ))
    }

    const BODY_LIMIT: usize = 1024 * 1024;
    
    pub fn routes() -> Router<AppState> {
        Router::new()
            .route(
                "/api/v1/fiscal/ibpt/quote",
                axum::routing::post(ibpt::quote),
            )
            .merge(emission::routes())
            .route(
                "/api/v1/fiscal/settings/{section}",
                get(preferences::get).put(preferences::put),
            )
            .route("/api/v1/fiscal/nfe-events", get(preferences::events))
            .merge(incoming::routes())
            .merge(cte_distribution::routes())
            .merge(cte_inspection::routes())
            .merge(cte_links::routes())
            .route("/api/v1/fiscal/monitor", get(monitor::status))
            .route(
                "/api/v1/fiscal/monitor/sync",
                axum::routing::post(monitor::sync),
            )
            .route(
                "/api/v1/fiscal/monitor/documents/{id}/xml",
                get(monitor::download_xml),
            )
            .route(
                "/api/v1/fiscal/monitor/documents/{id}/manifest",
                axum::routing::post(monitor::manifest),
            )
            .route("/api/v1/fiscal/danfe", axum::routing::post(danfe::generate))
            .route("/api/v1/fiscal/config", get(get_profile).put(put_profile))
            .route(
                "/api/v1/fiscal/certificate",
                get(certificates::get)
                    .put(certificates::put)
                    .delete(certificates::remove),
            )
            .route("/api/v1/fiscal/readiness", get(readiness))
            .route("/api/v1/fiscal/nfe", get(list).post(create))
            .route(
                "/api/v1/fiscal/order-preparations/{id}",
                get(order_source::get),
            )
            .route("/api/v1/fiscal/nfe/{id}", get(get_draft).put(update))
            .route("/api/v1/fiscal/nfe/{id}/issue", axum::routing::post(issue))
            .route("/api/v1/fiscal/received-nfes", get(received::list))
            .route(
                "/api/v1/fiscal/received-nfes/{id}",
                get(received::get_document),
            )
            .route(
                "/api/v1/fiscal/received-nfes/{id}/xml",
                get(received::download_xml),
            )
            .route(
                "/api/v1/fiscal/received-nfes/{id}/danfe",
                get(received::download_danfe),
            )
            .route(
                "/api/v1/fiscal/received-nfes/import",
                axum::routing::post(received::import),
            )
            .layer(DefaultBodyLimit::max(BODY_LIMIT))
            .merge(received_nfse::routes())
    }
    
    pub fn service_routes() -> Router<AppState> {
        lojas::routes()
    }

          const body = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(body.title || "Não foi possível consultar o fiscal")
          return body
        }
        async function pages<T>(path: string, tenant: string): Promise<T[]> {
          const result: T[] = []
          const seen = new Set<string>()
          let cursor: string | null = null
          do {
            const page = await json(`${path}?limit=100${cursor ? `&cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}` : ""}`)
            if (page.tenantId !== tenant || !Array.isArray(page.data)) throw new Error("A empresa da sessão mudou. Atualize a página.")
            result.push(...page.data)
            cursor = page.nextCursor || null
            if (cursor && seen.has(cursor)) throw new Error("A paginação fiscal não avançou. Atualize a lista.")
            if (cursor) seen.add(cursor)
          } while (cursor)
          return result
        }

    function material(input: ObjectValue, expected: string) {
      const certificate = object(input.certificate);
      const encoded = text(certificate.pkcs12Base64, "Certificado", 90_000);
      if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/.test(encoded) || typeof certificate.password !== "string" || certificate.password.length > 1024) refuse("Certificado inválido");
      const pfx = Buffer.from(encoded, "base64"), info = readCertificate(pfx, certificate.password);
      if (info.holderCnpj !== expected || info.validFrom.valueOf() > Date.now() || info.validUntil.valueOf() <= Date.now()) refuse("Certificado vencido ou incompatível com o CNPJ", "certificate_invalid");
      return { pfx, passphrase: certificate.password };
    }
    
    /** Only fixed authority endpoints exist here. No URL from a request is used. */
    export async function dispatch(operation: string, value: unknown, send: Send = sendToSefaz): Promise<ObjectValue> {
      const input = object(value);
      if (operation === "inspect-cte") {
        try { return { ...await inspectReceivedCte(input as { xml: string; companyTaxId: string; environment: "homologation" }) }; }
        catch (error) {
          if (error instanceof CteInspectionError) refuse(error.message, error.reason === "invalid" ? "invalid_cte_xml" : error.reason === "unsupported" ? "cte_profile_unsupported" : "cte_layout_unavailable");
          throw error;
        }
      }
      if (operation === "inspect-nfse") {
        try { return { ...await inspectReceivedNationalNfse(input as { xml: string; recipientTaxId: string }) }; }
        catch (error) {
          if (error instanceof NationalNfseXmlError) refuse(error.message, error.code === "invalid" ? "invalid_nfse_xml" : "nfse_layout_unavailable");
          throw error;
        }
      }
      const environment = fiscalEnvironment(input);
      if (!["prepare", "authorize", "consult", "event", "void"].includes(operation)) homologation(input);
      if (operation === "prepare") {
        const mapped = mapDraft(input), credentials = material(input, mapped.issuer.cnpj);
        const generated = buildNfeXml(mapped), signedXml = signNfeXml(generated.xml, signingKeyOf(credentials.pfx, credentials.passphrase));
        await assertFiscalXml(signedXml, "nfe");
        if (mapped.model === 65) {
          const qr = await createNfceQrPayload({ signedXml, profile: input.nfce as Parameters<typeof createNfceQrPayload>[0]["profile"] });
          return { accessKey: generated.key, signedXml, qrCode: qr.payload, qrMode: qr.mode, qrVersion: qr.version, qrSourceSha256: qr.sourceSha256 };
        }
        return { accessKey: generated.key, signedXml };
      }
      if (operation === "authorize" || operation === "consult") {
        const key = validKey(input.accessKey), credentials = material(input, key.slice(6, 20));
        if (key.slice(0, 2) !== "35") refuse("Autorizador ainda restrito a São Paulo");
        let signed: string | undefined;
        if (operation === "authorize" || input.signedXml != null) {
          signed = text(input.signedXml, "XML assinado", 1_048_576);
          if (!signed.includes(`Id="NFe${key}"`) || !signed.includes(`<tpAmb>${environment === "producao" ? "1" : "2"}</tpAmb>`)) refuse("XML diverge da chave ou do ambiente");
          await assertFiscalXml(signed, "nfe");
          // A consultation authenticates using the current A1. The historical XML
          // may have been signed with an older certificate and is never retransmitted.
          if (operation === "authorize") {
            const signature = /<Signature xmlns="http:\/\/www\.w3\.org\/2000\/09\/xmldsig#">[\s\S]*<\/Signature>/.exec(signed)?.[0];
            const ownKey = signingKeyOf(credentials.pfx, credentials.passphrase);

        Client, Url,
        header::{AUTHORIZATION, HeaderMap, HeaderValue},
    };
    use serde_json::Value;
    use std::time::Duration;
    
    #[derive(Debug, PartialEq)]
    pub enum EngineError {
        Unavailable,
        InvalidResponse,
    }
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct FiscalEngine {
        client: Client,
        endpoint: Url,
    }
    impl std::fmt::Debug for FiscalEngine {
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
            f.write_str("FiscalEngine { credentials: [REDACTED] }")
        }
    }
    
    impl FiscalEngine {
        pub fn from_env() -> anyhow::Result<Option<Self>> {
            let endpoint = std::env::var("ERP_FISCAL_ENGINE_URL")
                .ok()
                .filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty());
            let token = std::env::var("ERP_FISCAL_ENGINE_TOKEN")
                .ok()
                .filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty());
            match (endpoint, token) {
                (None, None) => Ok(None),
                (Some(endpoint), Some(token)) => Self::new(&endpoint, &token).map(Some),
                _ => anyhow::bail!(
                    "ERP_FISCAL_ENGINE_URL and ERP_FISCAL_ENGINE_TOKEN must be configured together"
                ),
            }
        }
        pub fn new(endpoint: &str, token: &str) -> anyhow::Result<Self> {
            let endpoint =
                Url::parse(endpoint).map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("Invalid fiscal engine URL"))?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                endpoint.scheme() == "https"
                    || endpoint.scheme() == "http"
                        && matches!(endpoint.host_str(), Some("127.0.0.1" | "[::1]")),
                "Fiscal engine requires HTTPS or literal loopback HTTP"
            );
            anyhow::ensure!(
                endpoint.username().is_empty()
                    && endpoint.password().is_none()
                    && endpoint.query().is_none()
                    && endpoint.fragment().is_none()
                    && matches!(endpoint.path(), "" | "/"),
                "Fiscal engine URL must be an origin without credentials"
            );
            anyhow::ensure!(!token.trim().is_empty(), "Fiscal engine token required");
            let mut authorization = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {token}"))
                .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("Invalid fiscal engine token"))?;
            authorization.set_sensitive(true);
            let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
            headers.insert(AUTHORIZATION, authorization);
            let client = Client::builder()
                .default_headers(headers)
                .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
                .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))
                .timeout(Duration::from_secs(45))
                .build()?;
            Ok(Self { client, endpoint })
        }
        pub async fn call(&self, operation: &str, payload: Value) -> Result<Value, EngineError> {
            if ![
                "prepare",
                "authorize",
                "consult",
                "event",
                "void",
                "distribute",
                "distribute-cte",
                "inspect-cte",
                "inspect-nfse",
                "manifest",
            ]
            .contains(&operation)
            {
                return Err(EngineError::InvalidResponse);
            }
            let url = self
                .endpoint
                .join(&format!("/v1/{operation}"))
                .map_err(|_| EngineError::InvalidResponse)?;
            let mut response = self
                .client
                .post(url)
                .json(&payload)
                .send()
                .await
                .map_err(|_| EngineError::Unavailable)?;
            if !response.status().is_success() {
                return Err(EngineError::Unavailable);

    Add: C:\Users\nicol\source\erp-next-main\scripts\fiscal\download-official-schemas.ps1
    param([string]$Destination = 'artifacts/fiscal-reference-downloads')
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Destination | Out-Null
    $folder = (Resolve-Path $Destination).Path
    $cookies = Join-Path $folder 'portal-cookies.txt'
    $page = Join-Path $folder 'portal-esquemas.html'
    $source = 'https://www.nfe.fazenda.gov.br/portal/listaConteudo.aspx?tipoConteudo=BMPFMBoln3w%3D'
    & curl.exe -sS -L --fail --max-time 45 --max-redirs 6 -c $cookies -b $cookies $source -o $page
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Não foi possível baixar a página oficial' }
    $html = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($page)
    $start = $html.IndexOf('VERSÕES OFICIAIS (em uso)')
    $end = $html.IndexOf('VERSÕES ANTERIORES (em desuso)', $start)
    if ($start -lt 0 -or $end -le $start) { throw 'Estrutura do catálogo mudou; revise antes de baixar' }
    $active = $html.Substring($start, $end - $start)
    $matches = [regex]::Matches($active, '<a[^>]+href="(?<href>exibirArquivo\.aspx\?conteudo=[^"]+)"[^>]*>(?<title>.*?)</a>', [Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::Singleline)
    $records = @()
    $index = 0
    foreach ($match in $matches) {
      $index++
      $title = [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlDecode([regex]::Replace($match.Groups['title'].Value, '<[^>]*>', '')).Trim()
      $code = [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlDecode($match.Groups['href'].Value).Split('=', 2)[1].Replace(' ', '+')
      $url = 'https://www.nfe.fazenda.gov.br/portal/exibirArquivo.aspx?conteudo=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($code)
      $slug = [regex]::Replace($title.Normalize([Text.NormalizationForm]::FormD), '\p{Mn}', '')
      $slug = [regex]::Replace($slug.ToLowerInvariant(), '[^a-z0-9]+', '-').Trim('-')
      if ($slug.Length -gt 115) { $slug = $slug.Substring(0, 115) }
      $filename = '{0:D2}-{1}.zip' -f $index, $slug
      $target = Join-Path $folder $filename
      & curl.exe -sS -L --fail --max-time 45 --max-redirs 6 -c $cookies -b $cookies $url -o $target
      $ok = $LASTEXITCODE -eq 0
      $entries = 0
      if ($ok) {
        try { $zip = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($target); $entries = $zip.Entries.Count; $zip.Dispose() }
        catch { $ok = $false }
      }
      $record = [ordered]@{ title = $title; url = $url; filename = $filename; validZip = $ok; entryCount = $entries }
      if ($ok) {
        $record.sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $target -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
        $record.bytes = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $target).Length
      }
      $records += $record
      [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $folder 'downloads.json'), (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $records -Depth 8))
      Write-Output ('{0}/{1}: {2} [{3}]' -f $index, $matches.Count, $title, $(if ($ok) {'ZIP válido'} else {'falhou'}))
    }

    function ibptSubmission(selection: IbptDraftSelection, count: number): Schema<"IbptSelection"> {
      if (!selection.uf || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(selection.asOf) || selection.items.length !== count) throw new Error("Informe UF, data e uma escolha IBPT para cada item")
      return {
        uf: selection.uf,
        asOf: selection.asOf,
        items: selection.items.map((item, index) => {
          if (!/^\d{1,3}$/.test(item.ex) || item.origin !== "national" && item.origin !== "imported") throw new Error(`Informe EX e origem IBPT no item ${index + 1}`)
          const version = item.version?.trim() || null
          if (version && !/^\d{2}\.\d\.[A-Z]$/.test(version)) throw new Error(`Informe a versão IBPT no formato 26.2.A no item ${index + 1}`)
          return { ex: item.ex, origin: item.origin, version }
        }),
      }
    }

    import { DOMParser, XMLSerializer } from "@xmldom/xmldom";
    import { createFiscalQrPayload } from "./nfce-qr.ts";
    import type { SigningKey } from "./sign.ts";
    import { assertFiscalXml } from "./local-layout.ts";
    
    /** Explicit UF configuration: no NFC-e URL is silently reused for model 55. */
    export type SimplifiedNfeEndpoints = { qrCodeUrl: string; accessKeyUrl: string };
    
    function endpoint(value: string): string {
      const url = new URL(value);
      if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password || url.hash || url.search ||
          !/(^|\.)gov\.br$/.test(url.hostname)) throw new Error("Configure uma URL HTTPS oficial da SEFAZ para NF-e simplificada.");
      return url.href;
    }
    
    /** NT 2026.003 v1.00. Signature is checked against the embedded certificate.
     * The supplement is outside infNFe and therefore preserves its XML signature.
     * Offline callers must supply the same key that signed the invoice.
     */
    export async function supplementSimplifiedNfe(input: {
      signedXml: string; endpoints: SimplifiedNfeEndpoints; signingKey?: SigningKey;
    }): Promise<{ xml: string; qrCodeUrl: string; accessKeyUrl: string; payload: string; accessKey: string }> {
      const qrEndpoint = endpoint(input.endpoints.qrCodeUrl), accessKeyUrl = endpoint(input.endpoints.accessKeyUrl);
      const qr = await createFiscalQrPayload({ signedXml: input.signedXml,
        profile: { version: "3", ...(input.signingKey ? { signingKey: input.signingKey } : {}) } }, "55");
      // The national XSD requires literal separators and literal Base64 in the XML.
      const qrCodeUrl = `${qrEndpoint}?p=${qr.payload}`;
      const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(input.signedXml, "application/xml");
      const root = doc.documentElement!;
      const ns = "http://www.portalfiscal.inf.br/nfe";
      for (const old of Array.from(root.getElementsByTagNameNS(ns, "infNFeSupl"))) old.parentNode!.removeChild(old);
      const supplement = doc.createElementNS(ns, "infNFeSupl");
      for (const [name, value] of [["qrCode", qrCodeUrl], ["urlChave", accessKeyUrl]]) {
        const node = doc.createElementNS(ns, name); node.appendChild(doc.createTextNode(value)); supplement.appendChild(node);
      }
      const signature = root.getElementsByTagNameNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#", "Signature")[0];
      root.insertBefore(supplement, signature);
      const xml = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(doc);
      await assertFiscalXml(xml, "nfe");
      return { xml, qrCodeUrl, accessKeyUrl, payload: qr.payload, accessKey: qr.accessKey };
    }

    impl DanfeClient {
        pub fn new(endpoint: &str, token: &str, ca_bundle: Option<String>) -> anyhow::Result<Self> {
            let endpoint = Url::parse(endpoint)?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                endpoint.scheme() == "https"
                    || (endpoint.scheme() == "http"
                        && [Some("127.0.0.1"), Some("[::1]")].contains(&endpoint.host_str())),
                "DANFE_MCP_URL requires HTTPS or literal loopback HTTP"
            );
            anyhow::ensure!(
                endpoint.username().is_empty()
                    && endpoint.password().is_none()
                    && endpoint.query().is_none()
                    && endpoint.fragment().is_none(),
                "DANFE_MCP_URL must not include credentials or query parameters"
            );
            anyhow::ensure!(!token.trim().is_empty(), "DANFE_MCP_TOKEN is required");
            let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
            let mut authorization = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {token}"))?;
            authorization.set_sensitive(true);
            headers.insert(AUTHORIZATION, authorization);
            headers.insert(
                ACCEPT,
                HeaderValue::from_static("application/json, text/event-stream"),
            );
            let client = Client::builder()
                .default_headers(headers)
                .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
                .timeout(Duration::from_secs(15))
                .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))
                .build()?;
            Ok(Self {
                client,
                endpoint,
                ca_bundle: ca_bundle.map(Arc::from),
            })
        }

                        result["isError"] == true
                    })

                None => operation.await,

    //! Domestic retail eligibility for DANFE Simplificado Tipo 2 (NT 2026.002 v1.11).
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use utoipa::ToSchema;
    
    use crate::domains::DomainError;
    use super::model::{DraftInput, ProfileInput, exact_decimal};
    
    #[derive(Clone, Deserialize, Serialize, ToSchema)]
    #[serde(deny_unknown_fields, rename_all = "camelCase")]
    pub struct SimplifiedDanfe {
        pub qr_code_url: String,
        pub access_key_url: String,
    }
    
    fn official_url(value: &str) -> bool {
        if value.is_empty() || value.chars().count() > 300 || value.chars().any(char::is_control) || value.trim() != value {
            return false;
        }
        let Ok(url) = reqwest::Url::parse(value) else { return false; };
        url.scheme() == "https" && url.username().is_empty() && url.password().is_none()
            && url.query().is_none() && url.fragment().is_none()
            && url.host_str().is_some_and(|host| host == "gov.br" || host.ends_with(".gov.br"))
    }
    
    /// Additional checks only; the draft's ordinary arithmetic/tax checks remain required.
    pub fn validate(draft: &DraftInput, profile: &ProfileInput) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        if draft.print_type != Some(6) {
            return if draft.simplified_danfe.is_some() {
                Err(DomainError::Invalid("Endereços do DANFE Simplificado Tipo 2 exigem tipo de impressão 6"))
            } else { Ok(()) };
        }
        let endpoints = draft.simplified_danfe.as_ref().ok_or(DomainError::Invalid(
            "Informe as URLs oficiais da UF para consulta por QR Code e chave do DANFE Simplificado Tipo 2",
        ))?;
        if !official_url(&endpoints.qr_code_url) || !official_url(&endpoints.access_key_url) {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid("URLs do DANFE Simplificado Tipo 2 exigem HTTPS, domínio gov.br e até 300 caracteres, sem credenciais, consulta ou fragmento"));
        }
        let final_consumer = draft.final_consumer.or_else(|| draft.tax_declaration.as_ref().map(|taxes| taxes.final_consumer));
        if draft.model != 55 || draft.purpose != 1 || final_consumer != Some(true)
            || !draft.presence_indicator.is_some_and(|presence| [1, 4, 5].contains(&presence))
            || draft.recipient.state != profile.state || draft.exportation.is_some()
            || draft.departure_at.is_some() || !draft.referenced_access_keys.is_empty()
            || draft.return_direction.is_some() || draft.source_return_id.is_some() || draft.source_return_kind.is_some()
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid("DANFE Simplificado Tipo 2 exige NF-e 55 de venda interna normal a consumidor final, presença 1, 4 ou 5, sem exportação, devolução, data de saída ou referência fiscal"));
        }
        if !draft.installments.is_empty() {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid("DANFE Simplificado Tipo 2 não permite fatura ou duplicatas"));
        }
        if draft.freight_mode.as_deref().unwrap_or("9") != "9" && draft.presence_indicator != Some(4)
            || draft.transport.as_ref().is_some_and(|transport| transport.plate.is_some() || transport.vehicle_state.is_some() || transport.rntc.is_some())
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid("DANFE Simplificado Tipo 2 admite frete somente na entrega a domicílio e não permite dados de veículo de transporte"));
        }
        if let Some(taxes) = &draft.tax_declaration {
            if !taxes.final_consumer || taxes.ipi_cst.is_some()
                || taxes.ipi_rate.as_deref().map(|rate| exact_decimal(rate, 2, 4)).transpose()?.is_some_and(|rate| rate != 0)
                || taxes.destination_icms_rate.is_some() || taxes.destination_fcp_rate.is_some()
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid("DANFE Simplificado Tipo 2 não permite grupo de IPI ou ICMS da UF de destino e exige consumidor final"));
            }
        }
        let allowed = ["5101", "5102", "5103", "5104", "5115", "5405", "5656", "5667", "5910", "5933"];
        let mut invoice_total = 0_i128;
        for item in &draft.items {
            let sp_exception = profile.state == "SP" && item.cfop == "5949" && item.icms_cst.as_deref() == Some("40");
            if !allowed.contains(&item.cfop.as_str()) && !sp_exception {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid("CFOP não permitido no DANFE Simplificado Tipo 2; em SP, 5949 exige CST ICMS 40"));
            }
            invoice_total = invoice_total.checked_add(item.commercial_total()?).ok_or(DomainError::Invalid("Total do DANFE Simplificado Tipo 2 excede o limite"))?;

    fn danfe_configuration() -> anyhow::Result<Option<crate::domains::fiscal::danfe_client::DanfeClient>>
    {
        let endpoint = env::var("DANFE_MCP_URL")
            .ok()
            .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty());
        let token = env::var("DANFE_MCP_TOKEN")
            .ok()
            .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty());
        let ca_path = env::var("DANFE_CA_BUNDLE_FILE")
            .ok()
            .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty());
        if endpoint.is_none() && token.is_none() && ca_path.is_none() {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let endpoint = endpoint.context("DANFE_MCP_URL is required when enabling DANFE")?;

        let bundle = ca_path
            .map(|path| std::fs::read_to_string(path).context("Failed to read DANFE_CA_BUNDLE_FILE"))
            .transpose()?;
        crate::domains::fiscal::danfe_client::DanfeClient::new(&endpoint, &token, bundle).map(Some)
    }

        payload: Result<Json<ImportOutgoingNfeInput>, JsonRejection>,
    ) -> Result<Response, FiscalError> {
        let payload = input(payload)?;
        let note = match danfe::inspect(&payload.xml) {
            Ok(value) => value,
            Err(title) => {
                return Ok(problem(
                    StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    "invalid_authorized_xml",
                    title,
                    serde_json::json!({}),
                ));
            }
        };
        if let Err(title) = validate_outgoing(&payload.xml, &note) {
            return Ok(problem(
                StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                "invalid_outgoing_xml",
                title,
                serde_json::json!({}),
            ));
        }
        let recipient_name = match recipient_name(&payload.xml) {
            Ok(name) => name,
            Err(title) => {
                return Ok(problem(
                    StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    "invalid_outgoing_xml",
                    title,
                    serde_json::json!({}),
                ));
            }
        };
        let recipient = note.recipient.as_deref();
        let (tenant, mut tx, _) =
            authorized(&state, &headers, &identity, PERMISSION, PERMISSION, true).await?;
        let tax_id: String = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT tax_id FROM tenants WHERE id=$1")
            .bind(tenant)
            .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
            .await
            .map_err(db)?;
        if note.issuer != tax_id {
            return Ok(problem(
                StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,
                "document_company_mismatch",
                "A empresa ativa não é destinatária desta NF-e",
                serde_json::json!({}),
            ));
        }
        // An XML archive must not create a second representation of an issuance record.
        let exists: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
            "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fiscal_nfe_documents WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND access_key=$2)",
        )

    # Avaliação e instalação local das bibliotecas Siscomex
    
    Avaliação em 08/11/2026. As duas bibliotecas foram preparadas em diretórios separados do ERP. A biblioteca Python serve como referência para consulta do cadastro público de NCM; o projeto Java fornece interfaces e modelos de integração com o Portal Único. Nenhum deles determina automaticamente a classificação fiscal de um produto ou substitui a emissão de NF-e.
    
    ## Instalações locais
    
    | Projeto | Local | Versão e licença | Verificação |
    | --- | --- | --- | --- |
    | [siscomex-ncm](https://github.com/leogregianin/siscomex-ncm) | `C:\Users\nicol\source\siscomex-ncm` | 1.0.2, MIT; revisão `cacd1cda19acf22e34a82e30c9b31cc508ee73e9` | Instalado em `.venv` com Python 3.11.15; 15 testes passaram sem rede, 1 teste de download foi excluído. |
    | [portalunico.siscomex.gov.br](https://github.com/samuelfac/portalunico.siscomex.gov.br) | `C:\Users\nicol\source\portalunico.siscomex.gov.br` | `r77-azuis-RELEASE`, MIT; revisão `34388c10ff2f5ac69c72063614cea25faaefdb4f` | 1.038 fontes compiladas; `mvn install` concluído com `BUILD SUCCESS`; JAR instalado em `.m2-local`. |
    
    O Python foi instalado em modo editável, com `urllib3 1.26.20` e `pytest 7.4.4`. O backend original `poetry.masonry.api` falhou por não implementar `build_editable`. Apenas o clone local recebeu a troca para `poetry.core.masonry.api`, com `poetry-core>=2.0`. A configuração original está em `pyproject.toml.original`.
    
    O Java usa ferramentas portáveis dentro de `.tools`: Maven 3.9.11 e Temurin JDK 17.0.21+9. Os downloads tiveram SHA-512 e SHA-256 conferidos, respectivamente. O projeto declara compatibilidade Java 8. A compilação limita o heap a 512 MB e usa `.m2-local`, sem alterar o Java global ou publicar pacotes.
    
    ## Utilidade e limites do Python
    
    `FetchNcm` consulta código, descrição, início e fim de vigência e ato normativo no [endpoint público de nomenclatura do Siscomex](https://portalunico.siscomex.gov.br/classif/api/publico/nomenclatura/download/json?perfil=PUBLICO). O cliente faz GET com timeout de dez segundos e retentativas; não contém operações de escrita aduaneira.
    
    O cache `ncm.json` fica no diretório corrente e vence pela data de modificação do arquivo, em sete dias. Copiar um JSON antigo pode fazê-lo parecer recente. O construtor pode acessar a rede implicitamente; código inexistente retorna um objeto com código e descrição vazios. A consulta não escolhe a vigência pela data da nota, e `refresh_data` captura qualquer exceção e retorna `False`.
    
    A biblioteca não fornece unidade tributável de exportação, CFOP, ICMS, IBS/CBS ou classificação automática a partir da descrição comercial. Para exportação, a tabela oficial NCM/uTrib baixada em `artifacts/fiscal-reference-downloads` continua sendo uma fonte separada. A dependência restrita à série urllib3 1.x deve ser revisada antes de uso operacional; esta avaliação funcional não equivale a uma auditoria completa de dependências.
    
    ## Utilidade e limites do Java
    
    O clone contém 1.038 fontes Java, principalmente modelos e interfaces JAX-RS/Swagger. Inclui módulos de DU-E, classificação fiscal, cargas, anexação e plataforma, com operações GET, POST e PUT declaradas. É uma biblioteca de contratos, não um aplicativo pronto ou um serviço MCP.
    
    A interface pública de download de NCM declara retorno `void`, exigindo adaptação para consumo tipado. Os modelos e rotas precisam ser confrontados com a [documentação oficial atual do Portal Único](https://docs.portalunico.siscomex.gov.br/) antes de qualquer integração. Não há diretório de testes Java no clone. Autenticação, certificados e operações aduaneiras não fizeram parte da execução local.

    const TENANT: &str = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
    const OTHER_TENANT: &str = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222";
    async fn request(
        router: &Router,
        method: &str,
        uri: &str,
        bearer: Option<&str>,
        tenant: Option<&str>,
        body: Option<Value>,
    ) -> (StatusCode, HeaderMap, Vec<u8>) {
        let mut builder = Request::builder().method(method).uri(uri);
        if let Some(token) = bearer {
            builder = builder.header("authorization", format!("Bearer {token}"));
        }
        if let Some(tenant) = tenant {
            builder = builder.header("x-tenant-id", tenant);
        }
        let payload = match body {
            Some(value) => {
                builder = builder.header("content-type", "application/json");
                Body::from(value.to_string())
            }
            None => Body::empty(),
        };
        let response = router
            .clone()
            .oneshot(builder.body(payload).unwrap())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let (parts, body) = response.into_parts();
        (
            parts.status,
            parts.headers,
            to_bytes(body, 9 * 1024 * 1024).await.unwrap().to_vec(),
        )
    }
    
    fn json_body(body: &[u8]) -> Value {
        serde_json::from_slice(body).unwrap()
    }

    }

    /** Local development can run the fiscal API without changing the other ERP services. */
    export function fiscalApiOrigin(resource: string, defaultOrigin: string, override: string | undefined, environment: string | undefined): string {
      if (environment !== "development" || !override || !/^\/fiscal\/(?:nfe(?:\/|$)|issued-nfes$|outgoing-imports(?:\/|$)|readiness$|config$|certificate$|order-preparations\/|ibpt(?:\/|$))/.test(resource)) return defaultOrigin
      const url = new URL(override)
      if (!["http:", "https:"].includes(url.protocol) || !["127.0.0.1", "[::1]"].includes(url.hostname) || url.username || url.password || url.pathname !== "/" || url.search || url.hash) throw new Error("Destino fiscal local inválido")

    export function object(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
      if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error("Resposta fiscal inválida")
      return value as Record<string, unknown>
    }
    export function parseOutgoingXmlNote(value: unknown): OutgoingXmlNote {
      const note = object(value)
      const text = (key: string) => typeof note[key] === "string" && (note[key] as string).length > 0
      const integer = (key: string, min: number, max: number) => Number.isSafeInteger(note[key]) && Number(note[key]) >= min && Number(note[key]) <= max
      if (!integer("id", 1, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) || !text("accessKey") || !/^\d{44}$/.test(String(note.accessKey))
        || String(note.accessKey).slice(20, 22) !== "55" || !/^\d{11}(\d{3})?$/.test(String(note.issuerDocument))
        || !text("issuerName") || !text("recipientName") || (note.recipientDocument !== null && !/^\d{11}(\d{3})?$/.test(String(note.recipientDocument)))
        || !integer("number", 1, 999999999) || !integer("series", 0, 999) || !integer("totalCents", 0, 99999999999999)
        || !integer("itemCount", 1, 990) || ![1, 2].includes(Number(note.environment)) || typeof note.environment !== "number"
        || !text("issuedAt") || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(String(note.issuedAt))) || !text("createdAt") || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(String(note.createdAt)))
        || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(String(note.xmlSha256))) throw new Error("Resposta fiscal inválida")
      return note as unknown as OutgoingXmlNote
    }
    export async function readJson(path: string, signal: AbortSignal, tenant?: string) {
      const response = await erpFetch(path, { signal, headers: tenant ? { "X-Tenant-Id": tenant } : undefined })
      const value: unknown = await response.json()
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(typeof object(value).title === "string" ? String(object(value).title) : "Consulta fiscal indisponível")
      if (!response.headers.get("content-type")?.includes("application/json")) throw new Error("Resposta fiscal inválida")
      return object(value)
    }
    export async function activeCompany(signal: AbortSignal, expected?: string) {
      const me = await readJson("/api/erp/me", signal, expected)
      const tenant = object(me.tenant).id
      if (typeof tenant !== "string" || !/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/i.test(tenant) || expected && tenant !== expected) throw new Error(companyChanged)
      return tenant
    }
    export async function fetchOutgoingXmlDocument(note: OutgoingXmlNote, tenantId: string, format: "xml" | "danfe", signal: AbortSignal) {
      await activeCompany(signal, tenantId)
      const response = await erpFetch(`/api/erp/fiscal/outgoing-imports/${note.id}/${format}`, {
        headers: { "X-Tenant-Id": tenantId }, signal: AbortSignal.any([signal, AbortSignal.timeout(60_000)]),
      })
      if (!response.ok) { const problem = await response.json().catch(() => null); throw new Error(problem?.title || "Documento indisponível") }
      const mime = format === "xml" ? "application/xml" : "application/pdf"
      if (!response.headers.get("content-type")?.startsWith(mime)) throw new Error("Documento inválido")
      const reader = response.body?.getReader()
      if (!reader) throw new Error("Documento vazio")
      const chunks: Uint8Array[] = []; let size = 0
      for (;;) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read()
        if (done) break
        size += value.byteLength
        if (size > 8 * 1024 * 1024) { await reader.cancel(); throw new Error("Documento excede 8 MiB") }
        chunks.push(value)
      }
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(size); let offset = 0
      for (const chunk of chunks) { bytes.set(chunk, offset); offset += chunk.byteLength }
      const expected = format === "xml" ? note.xmlSha256 : response.headers.get("x-pdf-sha256")
      if (!expected || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(expected) || response.headers.get("x-xml-sha256") !== note.xmlSha256
        || response.headers.get("x-nfe-environment") !== String(note.environment) || await documentHash(bytes.buffer) !== expected
        || format === "danfe" && new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.subarray(0, 5)) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("O download não corresponde ao documento armazenado")
      await activeCompany(signal, tenantId)
      signal.throwIfAborted()
      return { bytes, mime, filename: `${format === "xml" ? "NFE" : "DANFE"}-${note.accessKey}.${format === "xml" ? "xml" : "pdf"}` }
    }

      ["01", "Multa e juros", true],
      ["02", "Crédito presumido de IBS sobre saldo devedor na ZFM", false],
      ["03", "Retorno por recusa total ou destinatário não localizado", true],
      ["04", "Redução de valores", true],
      ["05", "Transferência de crédito na sucessão", false],
      ["06", "Retorno por recusa parcial na entrega", true],
    ] as const
    const debitTypes = [
      ["01", "Transferência de créditos para cooperativas", false],
      ["02", "Anulação de crédito por saídas imunes ou isentas", false],
      ["03", "Débitos de notas não processadas na apuração", true],
      ["04", "Multa e juros", true],
      ["05", "Transferência de crédito na sucessão", false],
      ["06", "Pagamento antecipado", true],
      ["07", "Perda em estoque", false],
      ["08", "Desenquadramento do Simples Nacional", false],
    ] as const
    
    export function hasItemFiscalReference(draft: DraftInput) {
      return draft.purpose === 5 && draft.creditType === "06" || draft.purpose === 6 && ["03", "04"].includes(draft.debitType || "")
    }
    export function hasHeaderFiscalReference(draft: DraftInput) {
      return [2, 3].includes(draft.purpose || 1) || draft.purpose === 5 && ["01", "03", "04"].includes(draft.creditType || "")
    }
    
    export function NfeFinancialFields({ draft, change }: { draft: DraftInput; change: (patch: Partial<DraftInput>) => void }) {
      if (![5, 6].includes(draft.purpose || 1)) return null
      const credit = draft.purpose === 5
      const key = credit ? "creditType" : "debitType"
      const options = credit ? creditTypes : debitTypes
      const label = credit ? "Tipo de nota de crédito" : "Tipo de nota de débito"
      return <section className="form-section space-y-3" aria-label="Finalidade financeira da NF-e">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{credit ? "Nota de crédito" : "Nota de débito"}</h2>
        <label className="grid gap-2 text-sm">{label}<select aria-label={label} required className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm" value={draft[key] || ""} onChange={event => change({ [key]: event.target.value || null, referencedAccessKeys: [], items: draft.items.map(item => ({ ...item, referencedDfe: null })) })}>
          <option value="">Selecione conforme a instrução fiscal</option>
          {options.map(([code, name, supported]) => <option key={code} value={code} disabled={!supported}>{code}: {name}{supported ? "" : " (não implementado)"}</option>)}
        </select></label>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Disponível no regime normal (CRT 3), para operações nacionais. Informe códigos, alíquotas e documentos de origem conforme a orientação fiscal. Salvar não gera lançamento financeiro.</p>
        {hasItemFiscalReference(draft) && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Informe o documento fiscal de origem de cada item na etapa Tributação.</p>}
        {draft.purpose === 6 && draft.debitType === "06" && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Pagamento antecipado está disponível sem IPI neste pacote de schemas.</p>}
      </section>
    }
    
    export function NfeItemFiscalReference({ draft, item, index, change }: { draft: DraftInput; item: DraftItem; index: number; change: (patch: Partial<DraftItem>) => void }) {
      if (!hasItemFiscalReference(draft)) return null
      const value = item.referencedDfe
      const noItemNumber = draft.purpose === 6 && draft.debitType === "03"
      return <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 border-t pt-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <label className="grid gap-2 text-sm">Chave do documento de origem do item {index + 1}<Input required maxLength={44} inputMode="numeric" value={value?.accessKey || ""} onChange={event => change({ referencedDfe: { ...value, accessKey: event.target.value } })} /></label>

        pub fn new_with_prefix(endpoint: &str, token: &str, ca_bundle: Option<String>, prefix: &str) -> anyhow::Result<Self> {

    ---
    name: requesting-code-review
    description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
    ---
    
    # Requesting Code Review
    
    Dispatch a code reviewer subagent to catch issues before they cascade. The reviewer gets precisely crafted context for evaluation — never your session's history.
    
    **Core principle:** Review early, review often.
    
    ## When to Request Review
    
    **Mandatory:**
    - After each task in subagent-driven development
    - After completing major feature
    - Before merge to main
    
    **Optional but valuable:**
    - When stuck (fresh perspective)
    - Before refactoring (baseline check)
    - After fixing complex bug
    
    ## How to Request
    
    **1. Get git SHAs:**
    ```bash
    BASE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)  # or: git merge-base origin/main HEAD
    HEAD_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
    ```
    
    **2. Dispatch code reviewer subagent:**
    
    Dispatch a `general-purpose` subagent, filling the template at [code-reviewer.md](code-reviewer.md)
    
    **Placeholders:**
    - `{DESCRIPTION}` - Brief summary of what you built
    - `{PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS}` - What it should do
    - `{BASE_SHA}` - Starting commit
    - `{HEAD_SHA}` - Ending commit
    
    **3. Act on feedback:**
    - Fix Critical issues immediately
    - Fix Important issues before proceeding
    - Note Minor issues for later
    - Push back if reviewer is wrong (with reasoning)
    
    ## Example
    
    ```
    [Just completed Task 2: Add verification function]
    
    You: Let me request code review before proceeding.
    
    BASE_SHA=$(git log --oneline | grep "Task 1" | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f1)
    HEAD_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
    
    [Dispatch code reviewer subagent]
      DESCRIPTION: Added verifyIndex() and repairIndex() with 4 issue types
      PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: Task 2 from docs/superpowers/plans/deployment-plan.md
      BASE_SHA: a7981ec
      HEAD_SHA: 3df7661
    
    [Subagent returns]:
      Strengths: Clean architecture, real tests
      Issues:
        Important: Missing progress indicators
        Minor: Magic number (100) for reporting interval
      Assessment: Ready to proceed
    
    You: [Fix progress indicators]
    [Continue to Task 3]
    ```
    
    ## Common Rationalizations
    
    | Excuse | Reality |
    |--------|---------|
    | "I'll just review the diff myself instead of dispatching a reviewer" | You're the coordinator — reviewing the diff inline burns the context window you need to keep driving the work. Dispatch a reviewer subagent: the diff and the evaluation live in its context, and only the findings come back to you. |
    | "The reviewer needs my whole session history to understand the change" | Hand it precisely crafted context, never your session's history. That keeps the reviewer on the work product, not your thought process. |
    
    ## Red Flags
    
    **Never:**
    - Skip review because "it's simple"
    - Ignore Critical issues
    - Proceed with unfixed Important issues
    - Argue with valid technical feedback
    
    **If reviewer wrong:**
    - Push back with technical reasoning
    - Show code/tests that prove it works
    - Request clarification
    
    See template at: [code-reviewer.md](code-reviewer.md)

        platform::langfuse::shutdown().await;
        result
    }
    
    async fn run() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        let config = Config::from_env()?;
        let pool = PgPoolOptions::new()
            .max_connections(config.database_max_connections)
            .connect(&config.database_url)
            .await
            .context("failed to connect to PostgreSQL")?;
    
        match std::env::args().nth(1).as_deref() {
            Some("migrate") => {
                sqlx::migrate!("../../migrations")
                    .run(&pool)
                    .await
                    .context("failed to apply database migrations")?;
                info!("database migrations applied");
                return Ok(());
            }
            Some(_) => anyhow::bail!("usage: erp-next-api [migrate]"),
            None => {}
        }
    
        let listener = TcpListener::bind(config.bind_address)
            .await
            .context("failed to bind HTTP listener")?;
        let local_address = listener.local_addr()?;
        let auth = AuthClient::new(config.auth_userinfo_url);
        let mut state = AppState::new(pool, auth)
            .with_ibpt(domains::fiscal::ibpt::IbptCatalog::from_env()?)
            .with_registry(domains::registry_lookup::RegistryClient::new(
                std::env::var("ERP_CNPJ_WS_ENABLED").as_deref() == Ok("true"),
            )?)
            .with_subscriptions(platform::subscriptions::provider::MercadoPago::from_env()?)
            .with_fiscal_engine(domains::fiscal::engine_client::FiscalEngine::from_env()?)
            .with_nfe_production_enabled(config.nfe_production_enabled)
            .with_nfe_production_tenant_id(config.nfe_production_tenant_id)
            .with_monitor(domains::fiscal::sefaz_client::Sefaz::from_env()?)
            .with_certificates(domains::fiscal::certificate_crypto::CertificateVault::from_env()?)
            .with_assistant(domains::assistant::InferenceClient::from_env()?)
    })

    pub async fn get_draft(
        State(state): State<AppState>,
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
        Path(id): Path<Uuid>,
    ) -> Result<Response, FiscalError> {
        let (tenant, mut tx, can_edit) = authorized(
            &state,
            &headers,
            &identity,
            "fiscal.nfe.read",
            "fiscal.nfe.manage",
            false,
        )
        .await?;
        let data = load_draft(&mut tx, tenant, id).await?;
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(
            StatusCode::OK,
            Some(data.revision),
            DraftSnapshot {
                tenant_id: tenant,
                can_edit,
                data,
            },
        ))
    }
    
    async fn prepare(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,

    ) -> Result<(IssuerSnapshot, i64), DomainError> {
        let row = load_profile(tx, tenant)
            .await?
            .ok_or(DomainError::Conflict(
                "Configure a preparação fiscal antes de criar o rascunho",
            ))?;
        let profile = profile_data(&row)?;
        let total = value.validate(&profile)?;
        if let Some(category) = value.financial_category_id {
            let valid: bool = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM financial_categories WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND status='active' AND direction='income')")
                .bind(tenant).bind(category).fetch_one(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
            if !valid { return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Categoria financeira deve estar ativa e ser de receita da empresa")); }
        }
    
        let (company_revision, company) = issuer(tx, tenant, &profile).await?;
        Ok((
            IssuerSnapshot {
                tax_id: company.tax_id.clone(),
                legal_name: company.legal_name.clone(),
                company_revision,
                company,
                profile_revision: row.revision,
                profile,
        1

            let credit = self.credit_type.as_deref(); let debit = self.debit_type.as_deref();
            if (self.purpose == 5 && (!credit.is_some_and(|v| ["01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "06"].contains(&v)) || debit.is_some()))
                || (self.purpose != 5 && credit.is_some())
                || (self.purpose == 6 && (!debit.is_some_and(|v| ["01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "06", "07", "08"].contains(&v)) || credit.is_some()))
                || (self.purpose != 6 && debit.is_some()) { return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Declare o tipo de crédito para finalidade 5 ou de débito para finalidade 6, exclusivamente")); }
            let item_refs: Vec<_> = self.items.iter().filter_map(|item| item.referenced_dfe.as_ref()).collect();
            if ![5, 6].contains(&self.purpose) {
                return if item_refs.is_empty() { Ok(()) } else { Err(DomainError::Invalid("Referência DF-e por item está habilitada somente nas notas de crédito e débito")) };
            }
            if self.model != 55 || profile.crt != 3 || self.recipient.state == "EX" || self.exportation.is_some() || self.return_direction.is_some() || self.tax_declaration.is_none() { return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Crédito e débito exigem NF-e doméstica CRT 3 com declaração tributária explícita")); }
            if self.purpose == 5 && !credit.is_some_and(|v| ["01", "03", "04", "06"].contains(&v)) { return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Crédito 02 exige grupo ZFM e emissão a partir de 2029; crédito 05 exige transferência de crédito; grupos ainda não suportados")); }
            if self.purpose == 6 && !debit.is_some_and(|v| ["03", "04", "06"].contains(&v)) { return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Subtipo de débito exige grupo de transferência, estorno ou ajuste de competência ainda não suportado")); }
            if credit.is_some_and(|v| ["01", "03", "04"].contains(&v)) && self.referenced_access_keys.len() != 1 { return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Crédito 01, 03 e 04 exige exatamente uma referência no cabeçalho")); }
            if credit.is_some_and(|v| v != "06") && !item_refs.is_empty() { return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Somente crédito 06 permite referência DF-e por item")); }
            let required = credit == Some("06") || debit.is_some_and(|v| ["03", "04"].contains(&v));
            if required && item_refs.len() != self.items.len() || !item_refs.is_empty() && !self.referenced_access_keys.is_empty() { return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Declare a origem de cada item sem combinar referências no cabeçalho")); }
            if credit.is_some_and(|v| ["03", "04"].contains(&v)) && self.referenced_access_keys.iter().any(|key| key.get(..2) != state_code(&profile.state)) { return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Crédito 03 e 04 exige referência da mesma UF do emitente")); }
            let mut header = std::collections::HashSet::new();
            if self.referenced_access_keys.len() > 99 || self.referenced_access_keys.iter().any(|key| !valid_financial_key(key) || !header.insert(key) || self.purpose == 5 && credit != Some("03") && &key[20..22] != "55") { return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Chaves de origem inválidas, repetidas ou com modelo incompatível")); }
            let mut bindings = std::collections::HashSet::new(); let mut keys = std::collections::HashSet::new();
            for reference in item_refs {
                if !valid_financial_key(&reference.access_key) || &reference.access_key[20..22] != "55" || (if debit == Some("03") { reference.item_number.is_some() } else { !reference.item_number.is_some_and(|v| (1..=990).contains(&v)) }) || !bindings.insert((&reference.access_key, reference.item_number)) { return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Referência DF-e por item inválida; débito 03 proíbe nItem, os demais exigem item de 1 a 990 sem repetição")); }
                keys.insert(&reference.access_key);

    param(
      [string]$EnvironmentFile = (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'AvilaOps/erp-next-local/api-effective.env'),
      [string]$DatabaseSshHost = 'applications',
      [int]$DatabasePort = 55441,
      [int]$ApiPort = 8081,
      [int]$EnginePort = 8082,
      [int]$McpPort = 8093,
      [switch]$UpdateWebEnvironment
    )
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
    $workspace = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..'))
    $runtime = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'AvilaOps/erp-next-local'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $runtime | Out-Null
    $statePath = Join-Path $runtime 'processes.json'
    $previous = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $statePath) { Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $statePath | ConvertFrom-Json } else { $null }
    $allowed = @('DATABASE_URL','AUTH_ISSUER','AUTH_USERINFO_URL','FISCAL_A1_KEYRING','NFE_PRODUCTION_ENABLED','NFE_PRODUCTION_TENANT_ID')
    foreach ($line in [IO.File]::ReadAllLines($EnvironmentFile)) {
      if ($line.StartsWith('#') -or !$line.Contains('=')) { continue }
      $pair = $line.Split('=', 2)
      if ($allowed -contains $pair[0]) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($pair[0], $pair[1], 'Process') }
    }
    if (!$env:DATABASE_URL) { throw 'Informe DATABASE_URL no arquivo privado de configuração' }
    $database = [uri]::new($env:DATABASE_URL)
    if ($database.Scheme -notin @('postgres','postgresql') -or !$database.UserInfo) { throw 'Configuração PostgreSQL inválida' }
    $env:DATABASE_URL = $database.Scheme + '://' + $database.UserInfo + '@127.0.0.1:' + $DatabasePort + $database.PathAndQuery
    $env:DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS = '2'
    $env:API_BIND_ADDRESS = '127.0.0.1:' + $ApiPort
    $env:ERP_BACKGROUND_WORKERS_ENABLED = 'false'
    $env:RUST_LOG = 'warn'
    $env:ERP_FISCAL_ENGINE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:' + $EnginePort
    $tokenPath = Join-Path $runtime 'engine-token'
    if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $tokenPath)) { [IO.File]::WriteAllText($tokenPath, [Convert]::ToHexString([Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::GetBytes(32))) }
    $env:ERP_FISCAL_ENGINE_TOKEN = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($tokenPath).Trim()
    $env:FISCAL_ENGINE_PORT = [string]$EnginePort
    $env:FISCAL_ENGINE_BIND = '127.0.0.1'
    $env:DANFE_MCP_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:' + $McpPort + '/mcp'
    $env:DANFE_MCP_TOKEN = $env:ERP_FISCAL_ENGINE_TOKEN
    $env:DANFE_MCP_TOOL_PREFIX = ''
    $env:DANFE_CA_BUNDLE_FILE = Join-Path $workspace 'deploy/fiscal/icp-brasil-roots.pem'
    foreach ($port in @($ApiPort, $EnginePort)) {
      if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw "Porta local $port ocupada; encerre somente o processo de desenvolvimento correspondente antes de iniciar" }
    }
    $null = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:' + $McpPort + '/health') -TimeoutSec 5
    $tunnel = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort $DatabasePort -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($tunnel) {
      $owner = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId=' + $tunnel.OwningProcess)
      if (!$previous -or $previous.databaseTunnel -ne $owner.ProcessId -or !$owner.CommandLine.Contains([string]$DatabasePort) -or $owner.ExecutablePath -notlike '*OpenSSH\ssh.exe') { throw 'A porta do túnel pertence a outro processo' }
      $tunnelPid = $owner.ProcessId
    } else {
      $ssh = Start-Process -FilePath 'ssh.exe' -ArgumentList @('-N','-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ExitOnForwardFailure=yes','-o','ServerAliveInterval=30','-o','ServerAliveCountMax=3','-L',('127.0.0.1:'+$DatabasePort+':127.0.0.1:5432'),$DatabaseSshHost) -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput (Join-Path $runtime 'db-tunnel.log') -RedirectStandardError (Join-Path $runtime 'db-tunnel.err.log') -PassThru
      $tunnelPid = $ssh.Id
    }
    $engine = Start-Process -FilePath 'node.exe' -ArgumentList @('--import','./scripts/register.mjs','src/server.ts') -WorkingDirectory (Join-Path $workspace 'apps/fiscal-engine') -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput (Join-Path $runtime 'engine.log') -RedirectStandardError (Join-Path $runtime 'engine.err.log') -PassThru
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    $api = Start-Process -FilePath (Join-Path $workspace 'target/debug/erp-next-api.exe') -WorkingDirectory $workspace -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput (Join-Path $runtime 'api.log') -RedirectStandardError (Join-Path $runtime 'api.err.log') -PassThru
    $state = @{ databaseTunnel=$tunnelPid; databasePort=$DatabasePort; backgroundWorkers=$false; apiPort=$ApiPort; enginePort=$EnginePort; engine=$engine.Id; api=$api.Id; mcpPort=$McpPort }
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($statePath, ($state | ConvertTo-Json))
    if ($UpdateWebEnvironment) {
      $webEnv = Join-Path $workspace 'apps/web/.env.local'
      $text = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $webEnv) { [IO.File]::ReadAllText($webEnv) } else { '' }
      if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $webEnv) { [IO.File]::Copy($webEnv, (Join-Path $runtime ('web-env-before-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')))) }
      $entry = 'ERP_FISCAL_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:' + $ApiPort
      $text = if ($text -match '(?m)^ERP_FISCAL_API_URL=') { [regex]::Replace($text, '(?m)^ERP_FISCAL_API_URL=[^\r\n]*', $entry) } else { $text.TrimEnd() + "`n" + $entry + "`n" }
      [IO.File]::WriteAllText($webEnv, $text)
    }
    $state | ConvertTo-Json

    use std::{env, net::SocketAddr};
    
    use anyhow::{Context, ensure};
    use uuid::Uuid;
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    pub struct Config {
        pub bind_address: SocketAddr,
        pub auth_userinfo_url: String,
        pub database_url: String,
        pub database_max_connections: u32,
        pub nfe_production_enabled: bool,
        pub nfe_production_tenant_id: Option<Uuid>,
        pub invitations: Option<crate::platform::invitations::ProvisioningClient>,
        pub mail: Option<crate::platform::mail::SmtpMailer>,
        pub danfe: Option<crate::domains::fiscal::danfe_client::DanfeClient>,
        pub contracts: Option<crate::domains::contracts::provider::Docuseal>,
    }
    
    impl Config {
        pub fn from_env() -> anyhow::Result<Self> {
            let nfe_production_enabled = parse_legacy_fiscal_flag(
                &env::var("NFE_PRODUCTION_ENABLED").unwrap_or_else(|_| "false".to_owned()),
            )?;
            let nfe_production_tenant_id = env::var("NFE_PRODUCTION_TENANT_ID")
                .ok()
                .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
                .map(|value| {
                    Uuid::parse_str(value.trim()).context("NFE_PRODUCTION_TENANT_ID must be a UUID")
                })
                .transpose()?;
            ensure!(
                !nfe_production_enabled || nfe_production_tenant_id.is_some(),
                "NFE_PRODUCTION_TENANT_ID is required when NFE_PRODUCTION_ENABLED=true"
            );
            let bind_address = env::var("API_BIND_ADDRESS")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "0.0.0.0:8080".to_owned())
                .parse()
                .context("API_BIND_ADDRESS must be a valid socket address")?;
            let auth_issuer = env::var("AUTH_ISSUER")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "https://auth.avilaops.com".to_owned())
                .trim_end_matches('/')
                .to_owned();
            let auth_userinfo_url = env::var("AUTH_USERINFO_URL")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| format!("{auth_issuer}/oauth/userinfo"));
            reqwest::Url::parse(&auth_userinfo_url)
                .context("AUTH_USERINFO_URL must be a valid absolute URL")?;
            let database_url = env::var("DATABASE_URL").context("DATABASE_URL is required")?;
            let database_max_connections = env::var("DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "10".to_owned())
                .parse()
                .context("DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS must be an integer")?;
    
            ensure!(
                database_max_connections > 0,
                "DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS must be greater than zero"
            );
    
            Ok(Self {
                bind_address,
                auth_userinfo_url,
                database_url,
                database_max_connections,
                nfe_production_enabled,
                nfe_production_tenant_id,
                invitations: crate::platform::invitations::ProvisioningClient::from_env(&auth_issuer)?,
                mail: crate::platform::mail::SmtpMailer::from_env()?,
                danfe: danfe_configuration()?,
                contracts: crate::domains::contracts::provider::Docuseal::from_env()?,
            })
        }
    }
    -- Authorized outbound XML archive only; does not issue or book fiscal operations.
    CREATE TABLE fiscal_outgoing_imports (
        id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
        tenant_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
        access_key char(44) NOT NULL CHECK (access_key ~ '^[0-9]{44}$'),
        issuer_document text NOT NULL CHECK (issuer_document ~ '^[0-9]{11}([0-9]{3})?$'),
        issuer_name text NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(btrim(issuer_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
        recipient_document text CHECK (recipient_document ~ '^[0-9]{11}([0-9]{3})?$'),
        recipient_name text NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(btrim(recipient_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
        number bigint NOT NULL CHECK (number BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999),
        series integer NOT NULL CHECK (series BETWEEN 0 AND 999),
        issued_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
        total_cents bigint NOT NULL CHECK (total_cents BETWEEN 0 AND 99999999999999),
        item_count integer NOT NULL CHECK (item_count BETWEEN 1 AND 990),
        environment smallint NOT NULL CHECK (environment IN (1, 2)),
        xml text NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(xml) BETWEEN 1 AND 921600),
        xml_sha256 char(64) NOT NULL CHECK (xml_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
        imported_by_identity_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id),
        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
        UNIQUE (tenant_id, access_key),
        UNIQUE (tenant_id, id)
    );
    CREATE INDEX fiscal_outgoing_imports_tenant_issued_idx
        ON fiscal_outgoing_imports(tenant_id, issued_at DESC, id DESC);
    CREATE TRIGGER fiscal_outgoing_imports_append_only
        BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON fiscal_outgoing_imports
        FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_audit_log_changes();
    
    ALTER TABLE fiscal_outgoing_imports ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
    ALTER TABLE fiscal_outgoing_imports FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
    CREATE POLICY fiscal_outgoing_imports_isolation ON fiscal_outgoing_imports
        USING (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid)
        WITH CHECK (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid);

    import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
    import { readOpenApi } from "./gate.mjs";
    
    const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../", import.meta.url));
    const require = createRequire(new URL("./consumer/package.json", import.meta.url));
    
    export async function generateWeb(input, output = resolve(root, "apps/web/src/lib/api/generated.d.ts")) {
      if (!input) throw new Error("OPENAPI_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED");
      const { document } = await readOpenApi(resolve(input));
      const { default: openapiTS, astToString } = require("openapi-typescript");
      const source = astToString(await openapiTS(document));
      await mkdir(dirname(output), { recursive: true });
      await writeFile(output, source);
      return source;
    }
    
    if (process.argv[1] && pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href === import.meta.url) {
      await generateWeb(process.argv[2] || resolve(root, "artifacts/contracts/candidate.json"));
    }

    ## The Rule
    
    **Invoke relevant or requested skills BEFORE any response or action** — including clarifying questions, exploring the codebase, or checking files. If it turns out wrong for the situation, you don't have to use it.

    ## Skill Priority
    
    When multiple skills apply, process skills come first — they set the approach, then implementation skills (frontend-design, etc.) carry it out. Brainstorming and systematic-debugging are Superpowers' most common process skills, but the rule holds for any of them.
    
    - "Let's build X" → superpowers:brainstorming first, then implementation skills.
    - "Fix this bug" → superpowers:systematic-debugging first, then domain skills.
    
    ## Red Flags
    
    These thoughts mean STOP—you're rationalizing:
    
    | Thought | Reality |
    |---------|---------|
    | "This is just a simple question" | Questions are tasks. Check for skills. |
    | "I need more context first" | Skill check comes BEFORE clarifying questions. |
    | "Let me explore the codebase first" | Skills tell you HOW to explore. Check first. |
    | "I can check git/files quickly" | Files lack conversation context. Check for skills. |
    | "Let me gather information first" | Skills tell you HOW to gather information. |

    | "The skill is overkill" | Simple things become complex. Use it. |
    | "I'll just do this one thing first" | Check BEFORE doing anything. |
    | "This feels productive" | Undisciplined action wastes time. Skills prevent this. |
    | "I know what that means" | Knowing the concept ≠ using the skill. Invoke it. |

    export const blankIbptItem = (): IbptDraftItem => ({ ex: "", origin: "", version: null })
    
    export function fixed(value: string, scale: number, wholeDigits: number): string {
      const match = /^(\d+)(?:[.,](\d+))?$/.exec(value.trim())
      if (!match || (match[2]?.length ?? 0) > scale) throw new Error(`Informe um decimal positivo com até ${scale} casas`)
      const whole = BigInt(match[1]).toString()
      if (whole.length > wholeDigits) throw new Error("Valor acima do limite fiscal")
      return `${whole}.${(match[2] || "").padEnd(scale, "0")}`
    }
    const scaled = (value: string) => BigInt(value.replace(".", ""))
    const cents = (value: bigint) => `${value / BigInt(100)}.${(value % BigInt(100)).toString().padStart(2, "0")}`
    
    export function itemTotal(quantity: string, price: string): string {
      return cents((scaled(fixed(quantity, 4, 11)) * scaled(fixed(price, 10, 11)) + BigInt(500_000_000_000)) / BigInt(1_000_000_000_000))
    }
    
    export function productsTotal(items: DraftItem[]): string {
      return cents(items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + scaled(itemTotal(item.quantity, item.unitPrice)), BigInt(0)))
    }
    
    function percent(value: string): string {
      const result = fixed(value, 4, 2)
      if (scaled(result) >= BigInt(1_000_000)) throw new Error("A alíquota percentual deve ser menor que 100")
      return result
    }
    
    export function invoiceTotal(draft: DraftInput): string {
      const ipiRate = draft.taxDeclaration?.ipiRate
      const rate = ipiRate ? scaled(percent(ipiRate)) : BigInt(0)
      return cents(draft.items.reduce((sum, item) => {
        const product = commercialItemCents(item)
        return sum + product + (product * rate + BigInt(500_000)) / BigInt(1_000_000)
      }, BigInt(0)))
    }
    
    function commercialItemCents(item: DraftItem): bigint {
      const gross = scaled(itemTotal(item.quantity, item.unitPrice))
      const freight = scaled(fixed(item.freightAmount || "0", 2, 13))
      const discount = scaled(fixed(item.discountAmount || "0", 2, 13))
      const insurance = scaled(fixed(item.insuranceAmount || "0", 2, 13))
      const other = scaled(fixed(item.otherAmount || "0", 2, 13))
      const net = gross + freight + insurance + other - discount
      if (discount > gross || net <= BigInt(0)) throw new Error("Confira o desconto e o total do item com frete")
      return net
    }
    
    function declaredTaxes(declaration: TaxDeclaration): Schema<"TaxDeclaration"> {
      for (const field of ["recipientTaxpayer", "finalConsumer", "ipiInIcmsBase", "icmsOutOfContributions"] as const) {
        if (typeof declaration[field] !== "boolean") throw new Error("Declare contribuinte, consumidor final e composição das bases conforme a instrução fiscal")

    # Brainstorming
    
    You are very good at building. You build what you believe your human
    partner wants, and that belief is usually thinner than it feels. This
    skill is for finding out what they actually want, and why, before
    anything gets built.
    
    People often haven't finished working out what they want. Good questions
    help them think it through. When you understand the why, you make the
    hundred decisions they never mention the way they would have made them.
    
    ## First: What Do You Actually Know?
    
    Before you reply, ask yourself: what do I know about what they want, and
    why?
    
    - **Everything that matters is in the request** ("make the icon cornflower
      blue"). This is a quick, clear task. Do it, and say what you did.
    - **Something non-trivial is missing.** Start the conversation.
    
    Before you start implementing, you must, in order:
    
    1. Lay out the approaches in a message of their own, and have your
       human partner pick one (see Lay out the approaches).
    2. Write the design doc, short or full (see Size the Work).
    3. Get their approval of that doc.
    4. Invoke the superpowers:writing-plans skill.
    
    Two things aren't implementing: a spike they said yes to (see Spike to
    feel things out), and doing what they asked once they've opted out of
    the questions.
    
    ## Look Before You Ask
    
    In an existing project, or when they've given you context (a spec, a plan,
    a handoff, files they pointed at, earlier conversation), dig in before your
    first message. Read what they referred to and the code or material it
    connects to, and keep reading until you can explain how the relevant
    parts work today and what this change would touch. Never ask what the
    project or their context already answers.
    
    ## Your First Message
    
    Move the work forward, with one of these:
    
    - **They've already said what they want** (a spec, a plan, a detailed
      request): aim for about 200 words for the whole message. Echo their
      request back in your own words, so they can see whether you've got its
      shape: what they want, who it's for, and why, as far as they've said.
      Add what you found that bears on it: how the relevant parts work today
      and what the change would touch. If you found something they may not
      have considered that would change what they're asking for or how it
      has to be built, like a constraint, a conflict, or a cheaper path, say
      so plainly. How to build it comes later, once you understand what they
      want (see Lay out the approaches). End with one line inviting
      corrections, then one question about what they want: the thing their
      request leaves open whose answer would most change what gets built.

    # Systematic Debugging
    
    ## Overview
    
    **Core principle:** ALWAYS find root cause before attempting fixes. Symptom fixes are failure.
    
    **Violating the letter of this process is violating the spirit of debugging.**
    
    ## The Iron Law
    
    ```
    NO FIXES WITHOUT ROOT CAUSE INVESTIGATION FIRST
    ```
    
    If you haven't completed Phase 1, you cannot propose fixes.
    
    ## When to Use
    
    Use for ANY technical issue:
    - Test failures
    - Bugs in production
    - Unexpected behavior
    - Performance problems
    - Build failures
    - Integration issues
    
    **Use this ESPECIALLY when:**
    - Under time pressure (emergencies make guessing tempting)
    - "Just one quick fix" seems obvious
    - You've already tried multiple fixes
    - Previous fix didn't work
    - You don't fully understand the issue
    
    **Don't skip when:**
    - Issue seems simple (simple bugs have root causes too)
    - You're in a hurry (rushing guarantees rework)
    - Manager wants it fixed NOW (systematic is faster than thrashing)
    
    ## The Four Phases
    
    You MUST complete each phase before proceeding to the next.

        }

    async fn prepare(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        value: &DraftInput,
    ) -> Result<(IssuerSnapshot, i64), DomainError> {
        let row = load_profile(tx, tenant)
            .await?
            .ok_or(DomainError::Conflict(
                "Configure a preparação fiscal antes de criar o rascunho",
            ))?;
        let profile = profile_data(&row)?;
        let total = value.validate(&profile)?;
        if let Some(category) = value.financial_category_id {
            let valid: bool = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM financial_categories WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND status='active' AND direction='income')")
                .bind(tenant).bind(category).fetch_one(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
            if !valid { return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Categoria financeira deve estar ativa e ser de receita da empresa")); }
        }
    
        let (company_revision, company) = issuer(tx, tenant, &profile).await?;
        value.validate_reference_issuer(&company.tax_id)?;
        Ok((
            IssuerSnapshot {
                tax_id: company.tax_id.clone(),
                legal_name: company.legal_name.clone(),
                company_revision,
                company,
                profile_revision: row.revision,
                profile,
            },
            total,
        ))
    }
