    name: test-driven-development
    description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
    ---
    
    # Test-Driven Development (TDD)
    
    ## Overview
    
    Write the test first. Watch it fail. Write minimal code to pass.
    
    **Core principle:** If you didn't watch the test fail, you don't know if it tests the right thing.
    
    **Violating the letter of the rules is violating the spirit of the rules.**
    
    ## When to Use
    
    **Always:**
    - New features
    - Bug fixes
    - Refactoring
    - Behavior changes
    
    **Exceptions (ask your human partner):**
    - Throwaway prototypes
    - Generated code
    - Configuration files
    
    Thinking "skip TDD just this once"? Stop. That's rationalization.
    
    ## The Iron Law
    
    ```
    NO PRODUCTION CODE WITHOUT A FAILING TEST FIRST
    ```
    
    Write code before the test? Delete it. Start over.
    
    **No exceptions:**
    - Don't keep it as "reference"
    - Don't "adapt" it while writing tests
    - Don't look at it
    - Delete means delete
    
    Implement fresh from tests. Period.
    
    ## Red-Green-Refactor
    
    ```dot
    digraph tdd_cycle {
        rankdir=LR;
        red [label="RED\nWrite failing test", shape=box, style=filled, fillcolor="#ffcccc"];
        verify_red [label="Verify fails\ncorrectly", shape=diamond];
        green [label="GREEN\nMinimal code", shape=box, style=filled, fillcolor="#ccffcc"];
        verify_green [label="Verify passes\nAll green", shape=diamond];
        refactor [label="REFACTOR\nClean up", shape=box, style=filled, fillcolor="#ccccff"];
        next [label="Next", shape=ellipse];
    
        red -> verify_red;
        verify_red -> green [label="yes"];
        verify_red -> red [label="wrong\nfailure"];
        green -> verify_green;
        verify_green -> refactor [label="yes"];
        verify_green -> green [label="no"];
        refactor -> verify_green [label="stay\ngreen"];
        verify_green -> next;
        next -> red;
    }
    ```
    
    ### RED - Write Failing Test
    
    Write one minimal test showing what should happen.
    
    <Good>
    ```typescript
    test('retries failed operations 3 times', async () => {
      let attempts = 0;
      const operation = () => {
        attempts++;
        if (attempts < 3) throw new Error('fail');
        return 'success';
      };
    
      const result = await retryOperation(operation);
    
      expect(result).toBe('success');
      expect(attempts).toBe(3);
    });
    ```

    title: use client
    description: Learn how to use the use client directive to render a component on the client.
    ---
    
    The `'use client'` directive declares an entry point for the components to be rendered on the **client side** and should be used when creating interactive user interfaces (UI) that require client-side JavaScript capabilities, such as state management, event handling, and access to browser APIs. This is a React feature.
    
    > **Good to know:**
    >
    > You do not need to add the `'use client'` directive to every file that contains Client Components. You only need to add it to the files whose components you want to render directly within Server Components. The `'use client'` directive defines the [server and client boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary), and the components exported from such a file serve as entry points to the client.
    
    ## Usage
    
    To declare an entry point for the Client Components, add the `'use client'` directive **at the top of the file**, before any imports. The directive applies to the entire module and cannot be placed inside a component or function:
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```

    fn prepare(value: &str) -> Result<Vec<Asset>, DomainError> {
        let invalid =
            || DomainError::Invalid("Use uma foto JPG, PNG ou WebP de até 10 MB e 16 megapixels");
        let (prefix, encoded) = value.split_once(',').ok_or_else(invalid)?;
        let (format, filename, media_type) = match prefix {
            "data:image/jpeg;base64" => (ImageFormat::Jpeg, "source.jpg", "image/jpeg"),
            "data:image/png;base64" => (ImageFormat::Png, "source.png", "image/png"),
            "data:image/webp;base64" => (ImageFormat::WebP, "source.webp", "image/webp"),
            _ => return Err(invalid()),
        };
        if encoded.len() > 14_000_000 {
            return Err(invalid());
        }
        let original = STANDARD.decode(encoded).map_err(|_| invalid())?;
        if original.len() > 10_000_000 || image::guess_format(&original).ok() != Some(format) {
            return Err(invalid());
        }
        let mut reader = ImageReader::with_format(Cursor::new(&original), format);
        let mut limits = image::Limits::default();
        limits.max_image_width = Some(6000);
        limits.max_image_height = Some(6000);
        limits.max_alloc = Some(128_000_000);
        reader.limits(limits);
        let mut decoder = reader.into_decoder().map_err(|_| invalid())?;
        let (width, height) = decoder.dimensions();
        if u64::from(width) * u64::from(height) > 16_000_000 {
            return Err(invalid());
        }
        let orientation = decoder.orientation().map_err(|_| invalid())?;
        let mut image = image::DynamicImage::from_decoder(decoder).map_err(|_| invalid())?;
        image.apply_orientation(orientation);
        let mut assets = Vec::new();
        for (variant, filename, size) in [
            ("webp", "web.webp", 1600),
            ("thumbnail", "thumbnail.webp", 400),
        ] {
            let resized = image.thumbnail(size, size).to_rgba8();
            let mut bytes = Vec::new();
            image::codecs::webp::WebPEncoder::new_lossless(&mut bytes)
                .encode(
                    &resized,
                    resized.width(),
                    resized.height(),
                    image::ExtendedColorType::Rgba8,
                )
                .map_err(|_| invalid())?;
            assets.push(Asset {
                variant,
                filename,
                media_type: "image/webp",
                bytes,
                width: resized.width(),
                message: "JSON inválido ou campos desconhecidos".into(),
            }])
        })?;

    name: dispatching-parallel-agents
    description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
    ---
    
    # Dispatching Parallel Agents
    
    ## Overview
    
    You delegate tasks to specialized agents with isolated context. By precisely crafting their instructions and context, you ensure they stay focused and succeed at their task. They should never inherit your session's context or history — you construct exactly what they need. This also preserves your own context for coordination work.
    
    When you have multiple unrelated failures (different test files, different subsystems, different bugs), investigating them sequentially wastes time. Each investigation is independent and can happen in parallel.
    
    **Core principle:** Dispatch one agent per independent problem domain. Let them work concurrently.
    
    ## When to Use
    
    ```dot
    digraph when_to_use {
        "Multiple failures?" [shape=diamond];
        "Are they independent?" [shape=diamond];
        "Single agent investigates all" [shape=box];
        "One agent per problem domain" [shape=box];
        "Can they work in parallel?" [shape=diamond];
        "Sequential agents" [shape=box];
        "Parallel dispatch" [shape=box];
    
        "Multiple failures?" -> "Are they independent?" [label="yes"];
        "Are they independent?" -> "Single agent investigates all" [label="no - related"];
        "Are they independent?" -> "Can they work in parallel?" [label="yes"];
        "Can they work in parallel?" -> "Parallel dispatch" [label="yes"];
        "Can they work in parallel?" -> "Sequential agents" [label="no - shared state"];
    }
    ```
    
    **Use when:**
    - 3+ test files failing with different root causes
    - Multiple subsystems broken independently
    - Each problem can be understood without context from others
    - No shared state between investigations
    
    **Don't use when:**
    - Failures are related (fix one might fix others)
    - Need to understand full system state
    - Agents would interfere with each other
    
    ## The Pattern
    
    ### 1. Identify Independent Domains
    
    Group failures by what's broken:
    - File A tests: Tool approval flow
    - File B tests: Batch completion behavior
    - File C tests: Abort functionality
    
    Each domain is independent - fixing tool approval doesn't affect abort tests.
    
    ### 2. Create Focused Agent Tasks
    
    Each agent gets:
    - **Specific scope:** One test file or subsystem
    - **Clear goal:** Make these tests pass
    - **Constraints:** Don't change other code
    - **Expected output:** Summary of what you found and fixed
    
    ### 3. Dispatch in Parallel
    
    Issue all three subagent dispatches in the same response — they run in parallel:
    
    ```text
    Subagent (general-purpose): "Fix agent-tool-abort.test.ts failures"
    Subagent (general-purpose): "Fix batch-completion-behavior.test.ts failures"
    Subagent (general-purpose): "Fix tool-approval-race-conditions.test.ts failures"
    # All three run concurrently.
    ```
    
    Multiple dispatch calls in one response = parallel execution. One per response = sequential.
    
    ### 4. Review and Integrate
    
    When agents return:
    - Read each summary
    - Verify fixes don't conflict
    - Run full test suite
    - Integrate all changes
    
    ## Agent Prompt Structure
    
    Good agent prompts are:
    1. **Focused** - One clear problem domain
    "use client"
    
    import { erpFetch } from "@/lib/api/client"
    
    import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
    import type { CompanySnapshot } from "./company-types"
    
    type Profile = { company: CompanySnapshot | null; message: string; status: number; reload: () => void }
    const CompanyProfileContext = createContext<Profile | null>(null)
    
    export function CompanyProfileProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
      const [company, setCompany] = useState<CompanySnapshot | null>(null)
      const [message, setMessage] = useState("Carregando empresa ativa…")
      const [status, setStatus] = useState(0)
      const [retry, setRetry] = useState(0)
    
      useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController()
        erpFetch("/api/erp/company", { cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal })
          .then(async response => {
            const value = await response.json()
            if (controller.signal.aborted) return
            setStatus(response.status)
            if (response.ok) setCompany(value)
            else { setCompany(null); setMessage(value.title || "Não foi possível consultar a empresa") }
          }).catch(() => {
            if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setCompany(null); setStatus(503); setMessage("Não foi possível consultar a empresa") }
          })
        return () => controller.abort()
      }, [retry])
    
      function reload() {
        setCompany(null); setStatus(0); setMessage("Carregando empresa ativa…"); setRetry(value => value + 1)
      }
    
      return <CompanyProfileContext.Provider value={{ company, message, status, reload }}>{children}</CompanyProfileContext.Provider>
    }
    
    export function useCompanyProfile() {
      const profile = useContext(CompanyProfileContext)
      if (!profile) throw new Error("CompanyProfileProvider required")
      return profile
    }

    "use client"
    
    import Image from "next/image"
    import { useState } from "react"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    
    export function CompanyLogo({ value, disabled, onChange, onBusy }: { value: string; disabled: boolean; onChange: (value: string) => void; onBusy: (busy: boolean) => void }) {
      const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      return <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex min-h-32 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border bg-white p-4">
          {value ? <Image unoptimized src={value} alt="Logo da empresa" width={1024} height={1024} className="h-auto max-h-32 w-auto max-w-full object-contain" /> : <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">Nenhuma logo cadastrada</p>}
        </div>
        <label className="field">Selecionar logo da empresa<input type="file" accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp" disabled={disabled || busy} onChange={async event => {
          const input = event.currentTarget
          const file = input.files?.[0]
          if (!file) return
          setError(""); setBusy(true); onBusy(true)
          let bitmap: ImageBitmap | undefined
          try {
            if (!["image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/webp"].includes(file.type) || file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error("Escolha PNG, JPG ou WebP de até 10 MB.")
            bitmap = await createImageBitmap(file)
            if (bitmap.width * bitmap.height > 16_000_000) throw new Error("Escolha uma imagem de até 16 megapixels.")
            let size = 1024
            let logo = ""
            do {
              const scale = Math.min(1, size / Math.max(bitmap.width, bitmap.height))
              const canvas = document.createElement("canvas")
              canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.width * scale)); canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.height * scale))
              const context = canvas.getContext("2d")
              if (!context) throw new Error("Não foi possível preparar a imagem neste navegador.")
              context.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)
              logo = canvas.toDataURL("image/png")
              size = Math.floor(size / 2)
            } while (logo.length > 349000 && size >= 128)
            if (logo.length > 349000) throw new Error("Escolha uma imagem menor para a logo.")
            onChange(logo)
          } catch (reason) { setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Não foi possível abrir a imagem.") }
          finally { bitmap?.close(); input.value = ""; setBusy(false); onBusy(false) }
        }} /></label>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">PNG, JPG ou WebP. A logo aparece no cabeçalho da proposta e no PDF.</p>
        {busy && <p role="status">Preparando logo…</p>}
        {error && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
        {value && <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={disabled || busy} onClick={() => { onChange(""); setError("") }}>Remover logo</Button>}
      </div>
    }

    +fn valid_logo(value: &str) -> bool {
    +    use base64::{Engine, engine::general_purpose::STANDARD};
    +    use image::{ImageDecoder, ImageFormat, ImageReader};
    +
    +    if value.is_empty() {
    +        return true;
    +    }
    +    let Some((prefix, encoded)) = value.split_once(',') else {
    +        return false;
    +    };
    +    let format = match prefix {
    +        "data:image/png;base64" => ImageFormat::Png,
    +        "data:image/jpeg;base64" => ImageFormat::Jpeg,
    +        "data:image/webp;base64" => ImageFormat::WebP,
    +        _ => return false,
    +    };
    +    const MAX_BYTES: usize = 256 * 1024;
    +    if encoded.len() > MAX_BYTES.div_ceil(3) * 4 {
    +        return false;
    +    }
    +    let Ok(bytes) = STANDARD.decode(encoded) else {
    +        return false;
    +    };
    +    if bytes.len() > MAX_BYTES || image::guess_format(&bytes).ok() != Some(format) {
    +        return false;
    +    }
    +    let mut reader = ImageReader::with_format(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes), format);
    +    let mut limits = image::Limits::default();
    +    limits.max_image_width = Some(1024);
    +    limits.max_image_height = Some(1024);
    +    limits.max_alloc = Some(8 * 1024 * 1024);
    +    reader.limits(limits);
    +    let Ok(decoder) = reader.into_decoder() else {
    +        return false;
    +    };
    +    let (width, height) = decoder.dimensions();
    +    width > 0
    +        && height > 0
    +        && width <= 1024
    +        && height <= 1024
    +        && image::DynamicImage::from_decoder(decoder).is_ok()
    +}

    +    fn logo_url(format: image::ImageFormat, width: u32, height: u32) -> String {
    +        use base64::Engine;
    +        let mut bytes = std::io::Cursor::new(Vec::new());
    +        image::DynamicImage::new_rgb8(width, height)
    +            .write_to(&mut bytes, format)
    +            .unwrap();
    +        let mime = match format {
    +            image::ImageFormat::Png => "png",
    +            image::ImageFormat::WebP => "webp",
    +            image::ImageFormat::Jpeg => "jpeg",
    +            _ => unreachable!(),
    +        };
    +        format!(
    +            "data:image/{mime};base64,{}",
    +            base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(bytes.into_inner())
    +        )
    +    }

      await page.goto("/preferencias/empresa/dados?secao=contato")
      for (const theme of ["light", "dark"]) {
        await page.evaluate(value => localStorage.setItem("erp-theme", value), theme)

        await expect(page.getByLabel("Celular", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
        if (theme === "dark") await expect(page.locator("html")).toHaveClass(/dark/)
        else await expect(page.locator("html")).not.toHaveClass(/dark/)
        for (const width of [320, 390, 915, 1600]) {
          await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 950 })
          expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(width)
          await expect(page.locator("[data-company-section]:visible")).toHaveCount(1)
          if (width === 915 || width === 390) {
            await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0))
            await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Alterar dados da empresa", exact: true })).toBeInViewport()
            await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath(`company-sections-${theme}-${width}.png`), fullPage: true })
          }
        }
      }
    })

    "use client"
    import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
    import Link from "next/link"
    import { erpFetch } from "@/lib/api/client"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import type { TaxProfile, FiscalScenario } from "./tax-profile-model"
    export function TaxProfilePicker({
      tenant,
      onApply
    }: {
      tenant: string
      onApply: (profile: TaxProfile, revision: number, scenario?: FiscalScenario) => void
    }) {
      const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<TaxProfile[]>([]),
        [selected, setSelected] = useState(""),
        [revision, setRevision] = useState(0),
        [error, setError] = useState(""),
        [notice, setNotice] = useState(""),
        [reload, setReload] = useState(0)
      const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false)
      const [scenario, setScenario] = useState<FiscalScenario | "">("")
      useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController()
        erpFetch("/api/erp/registration-settings/tax-profiles", { cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal })
          .then(async (response) => {
            const value = await response.json()
            if (!response.ok) throw Error(value.title || "Não foi possível carregar os perfis tributários")
            if (value.tenantId !== tenant) throw Error("A empresa da sessão mudou. Reabra a nota")
            if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
              setLoaded(true)
              setProfiles(value.data.profiles.filter((v: TaxProfile) => v.active))
              setRevision(value.revision)
              setSelected("")
              setError("")
            }
          })
          .catch((reason) => {
            if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(reason.message)
          })
        return () => controller.abort()
      }, [tenant, reload])
      return (
        <section className="form-section space-y-3" aria-label="Perfil tributário">
          <h2 className="font-semibold">Perfil tributário</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Selecione e aplique o perfil. Revise CFOP, origem, CST e as demais alíquotas de cada operação antes de
            salvar.
          </p>

    export function OperationNaturePicker({tenant,onApply}:{tenant:string;onApply:(nature:OperationNature,revision:number)=>void}) {
      const [items,setItems] = useState<OperationNature[]>([])
      const [revision,setRevision] = useState(0)
      const [selected,setSelected] = useState("")
      const [error,setError] = useState("")
      useEffect(()=>{
        const controller = new AbortController()
        erpFetch("/api/erp/fiscal/settings/operation-natures",{cache:"no-store",signal:controller.signal}).then(async response=>{
          const value = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(value.title || "Não foi possível consultar as naturezas")
          if (value.tenantId !== tenant || !Array.isArray(value.data?.items)) throw new Error("Reabra o rascunho para conferir a empresa")
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setItems(value.data.items.filter((item:OperationNature)=>item.active && item.model===55 && item.purpose===1 && item.direction==="outgoing")); setRevision(value.revision) }
        }).catch(reason=>{if (!controller.signal.aborted) {setItems([]);setError(reason.message)}})
        return ()=>controller.abort()
      },[tenant])
      return <div className="space-y-2">
        {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3"><label className="grid min-w-0 flex-1 gap-2 text-sm">Natureza cadastrada<select value={selected} onChange={event=>setSelected(event.target.value)} className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3"><option value="">Selecione uma natureza cadastrada</option>{items.map(item=><option key={item.id} value={item.id}>{item.code}: {item.name}</option>)}</select></label><Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={!selected} onClick={()=>{const item=items.find(item=>item.id===selected);if(item)onApply(item,revision)}}>Aplicar natureza</Button></div>
        <Link href="/preferencias/fiscal/naturezas" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-sm text-primary underline">Gerenciar naturezas de operação</Link>
      </div>
    }

    ---
    name: systematic-debugging
    description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
    ---
    
    # Systematic Debugging
    
    ## Overview
    
    **Core principle:** ALWAYS find root cause before attempting fixes. Symptom fixes are failure.
    
    **Violating the letter of this process is violating the spirit of debugging.**
    
    ## The Iron Law
    
    ```
    NO FIXES WITHOUT ROOT CAUSE INVESTIGATION FIRST
    ```
    
    If you haven't completed Phase 1, you cannot propose fixes.
    
    ## When to Use
    
    Use for ANY technical issue:
    - Test failures
    - Bugs in production
    - Unexpected behavior
    - Performance problems
    - Build failures
    - Integration issues
    
    **Use this ESPECIALLY when:**
    - Under time pressure (emergencies make guessing tempting)
    - "Just one quick fix" seems obvious
    - You've already tried multiple fixes
    - Previous fix didn't work
    - You don't fully understand the issue
    
    **Don't skip when:**
    - Issue seems simple (simple bugs have root causes too)
    - You're in a hurry (rushing guarantees rework)
    - Manager wants it fixed NOW (systematic is faster than thrashing)
    
    ## The Four Phases
    
    You MUST complete each phase before proceeding to the next.
    
    ### Phase 1: Root Cause Investigation
    
    **BEFORE attempting ANY fix:**
    
    1. **Read Error Messages Carefully**
       - Don't skip past errors or warnings
       - They often contain the exact solution
       - Read stack traces completely
       - Note line numbers, file paths, error codes
    
    2. **Reproduce Consistently**
       - Can you trigger it reliably?
       - What are the exact steps?
       - Does it happen every time?
       - If not reproducible → gather more data, don't guess
    
    3. **Check Recent Changes**
       - What changed that could cause this?
       - Git diff, recent commits
       - New dependencies, config changes
       - Environmental differences
    
    4. **Gather Evidence in Multi-Component Systems**
    
       **WHEN system has multiple components (CI → build → signing, API → service → database):**
    
       **BEFORE proposing fixes, add diagnostic instrumentation:**
       ```
       For EACH component boundary:
         - Log what data enters component
         - Log what data exits component
         - Verify environment/config propagation
         - Check state at each layer
    
       Run once to gather evidence showing WHERE it breaks
       THEN analyze evidence to identify failing component
       THEN investigate that specific component
       ```
    
       **Example (multi-layer system):**
       ```bash
       # Layer 1: Workflow
       echo "=== Secrets available in workflow: ==="
       echo "IDENTITY: $([ -n "${IDENTITY:-}" ] && echo SET || echo UNSET)"
    
       # Layer 2: Build script
       echo "=== Env vars in build script: ==="
       printenv IDENTITY >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "IDENTITY in environment" || echo "IDENTITY not in environment"
    
       # Layer 3: Signing script
       echo "=== Keychain state: ==="
       security list-keychains
       security find-identity -v
    
       # Layer 4: Actual signing
       codesign --sign "$IDENTITY" --verbose=4 "$APP"
       ```
    
       **This reveals:** Which layer fails (secrets → workflow ✓, workflow → build ✗)
    
    5. **Trace Data Flow**
    
       **WHEN error is deep in call stack:**
    
       See `root-cause-tracing.md` in this directory for the complete backward tracing technique.
    
       **Quick version:**
       - Where does bad value originate?

    title: use client
    description: Learn how to use the use client directive to render a component on the client.
    ---
    
    The `'use client'` directive declares an entry point for the components to be rendered on the **client side** and should be used when creating interactive user interfaces (UI) that require client-side JavaScript capabilities, such as state management, event handling, and access to browser APIs. This is a React feature.
    
    > **Good to know:**
    >
    > You do not need to add the `'use client'` directive to every file that contains Client Components. You only need to add it to the files whose components you want to render directly within Server Components. The `'use client'` directive defines the [server and client boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary), and the components exported from such a file serve as entry points to the client.
    
    ## Usage
    
    To declare an entry point for the Client Components, add the `'use client'` directive **at the top of the file**, before any imports. The directive applies to the entire module and cannot be placed inside a component or function:

    export function FiscalPreferences({ section }: { section: "nfce" | "operation-natures" | "delivery" }) {
      const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<Snapshot | null>(null)

      const pending = useRef(false)

      const endpoint = `/api/erp/fiscal/settings/${section}`
      const title = section === "nfce" ? "Configurações de NFC-e" : section === "delivery" ? "E-mail e acesso ao XML" : "Naturezas de operação"
      useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController()
        erpFetch(endpoint, { cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal }).then(async response => {
          const value = await response.json() as Snapshot & { title?: string }
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(value.title || "Não foi possível consultar a configuração fiscal")
          const version = response.headers.get("etag")
          if (!version || !value.tenantId) throw new Error("Resposta sem empresa ou revisão")
          if (controller.signal.aborted) return

              : (value.data || { items: [] }) as { items: OperationNature[] }

      async function save(event: React.FormEvent) {
        event.preventDefault()
        if (!snapshot?.canEdit || blocked || pending.current) return
        pending.current = true; setSaving(true); setError(""); setNotice("")
        try {
          const body = section === "nfce" ? { environment: nfce.environment, state: nfce.state, series: nfce.series, nextNumber: nfce.nextNumber, cscId: nfce.cscId, ...(csc ? { csc } : {}) } : section === "delivery" ? { notificationEmail: delivery.notificationEmail.trim() || null, authorizedPeople: delivery.authorizedPeople } : draft
          const response = await erpFetch(endpoint, { method: "PUT", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Tenant-Id": snapshot.tenantId, "If-Match": etag }, body: JSON.stringify(body) })
          const value = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) {
            if ([401,403,409,412].includes(response.status) || response.status >= 500) setBlocked(true)
            throw new Error(value.title || "Não foi possível salvar a configuração")
          }
          const version = response.headers.get("etag")
          if (!version || value.tenantId !== snapshot.tenantId || !value.data) { setBlocked(true); throw new Error("Recarregue para conferir a gravação") }
          setSnapshot(value); setDraft(value.data); setBaseline(JSON.stringify(value.data)); setEtag(version); setCsc(""); setNotice("Configuração salva no servidor.")
        } catch (reason) {

    +  const first = { id: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", code: "001", name: "Venda importada", active: true, direction: "outgoing", model: 55, purpose: 1, internalCfop: "5101", interstateCfop: "6101", foreignCfop: "" }
    +  const second = { ...first, id: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", code: "002", name: "Venda nacional" }
    +  let items: typeof first[] = []
    +  let revision = 1
    +  await page.route("**/api/erp/fiscal/settings/operation-natures", route => route.fulfill({ json: { tenantId: tenant, revision, data: { items } } }))
    +  await page.goto("/fiscal/notas-saida/nova")
    +  const select = page.getByLabel("Natureza cadastrada", { exact: true })
    +  await expect(select.locator("option")).toHaveCount(1)
    +  await page.getByLabel("Série", { exact: true }).fill("7")
    +  await page.getByLabel("Natureza da operação", { exact: true }).fill("Texto preservado")
    +  items = [first, second, { ...first, id: "inactive", active: false }, { ...first, id: "incoming", direction: "incoming" }, { ...first, id: "nfce", model: 65 }, { ...first, id: "return", purpose: 4 }]
    +  revision = 3
    +  await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("focus")))
    +  await expect(select.locator("option")).toHaveCount(3)
    +  await expect(page.getByLabel("Série", { exact: true })).toHaveValue("7")
    +  await expect(page.getByLabel("Natureza da operação", { exact: true })).toHaveValue("Texto preservado")
    +  await select.selectOption(first.id)
    +  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Aplicar natureza", exact: true }).click()
    +  await expect(page.getByLabel("Natureza da operação", { exact: true })).toHaveValue(first.name)
    +  await expect(page.getByLabel("Referência da instrução fiscal", { exact: true })).toHaveValue("001 · revisão 3")
    +  items = [second]
    +  revision = 4
    +  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Atualizar naturezas", exact: true }).click()
    +  await expect(select.locator("option")).toHaveCount(2)
    +  await expect(select).toHaveValue("")
    +  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Aplicar natureza", exact: true })).toBeDisabled()
    +  await expect(page.getByLabel("Natureza da operação", { exact: true })).toHaveValue(first.name)
    +})

    +test("operation nature reload failures can be retried and foreign company results stay blocked", async ({ page, context }) => {
    +  await fixture(page, context)
    +  let fail = true

    +  await page.route("**/api/erp/fiscal/settings/operation-natures", route => fail
    +    ? route.fulfill({ status: 503, json: { title: "Consulta de naturezas indisponível" } })
    +    : route.fulfill({ json: { tenantId: responseTenant, revision: 3, data: { items: [nature] } } }))
    +  await page.goto("/fiscal/notas-saida/nova")

    +  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Atualizar naturezas", exact: true }).click()

    +  await expect(select.locator("option")).toHaveCount(2)

    +  responseTenant = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
    +  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Atualizar naturezas", exact: true }).click()
    +  await expect(page.getByText("Reabra o rascunho para conferir a empresa", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    +  await expect(select.locator("option")).toHaveCount(1)
    +  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Aplicar natureza", exact: true })).toBeDisabled()
    +})

    export function NfeRecipientPicker({ tenant, onApply }: { tenant: string; onApply: (recipient: DraftInput["recipient"]) => void }) {
      const [query, setQuery] = useState("")
      const [rows, setRows] = useState<Schema<"Party">[]>([])
      const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
      const [message, setMessage] = useState("")
      const active = useRef<AbortController | null>(null)
      useEffect(() => () => active.current?.abort(), [tenant])
      async function search() {
        active.current?.abort()
        const controller = new AbortController(); active.current = controller
        setBusy(true); setMessage(""); setRows([])
        try {
          const response = await erpFetch(`/api/erp/parties?role=customer&status=active&limit=20&q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`, { signal: controller.signal })
          const value = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(value.title || "Não foi possível buscar os clientes")
          if (value.tenantId !== tenant) throw new Error("A empresa da sessão mudou. Reabra a nota.")
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setRows(value.data); if (!value.data.length) setMessage("Nenhum cliente encontrado. Você pode preencher manualmente.") }
        } catch (reason) { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setMessage(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Consulta indisponível") }
        finally { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setBusy(false) }
      }
      async function choose(id: string) {
        active.current?.abort()
        const controller = new AbortController(); active.current = controller
        setBusy(true); setMessage("")
        try {
          const [response, meResponse] = await Promise.all([erpFetch(`/api/erp/parties/${id}`, { signal: controller.signal }), erpFetch("/api/erp/me", { signal: controller.signal })])
          const [value, me] = await Promise.all([response.json(), meResponse.json()])
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(value.title || "Não foi possível abrir o cliente")
          if (!meResponse.ok || me.tenant?.id !== tenant || value.tenantId !== tenant) throw new Error("A empresa da sessão mudou. Reabra a nota.")
          const party: Schema<"Party"> = value.data
          const addresses = party.addresses || []
          const address = addresses.find(item => item.primary) || (addresses.length === 1 ? addresses[0] : undefined)
          if (controller.signal.aborted) return
          onApply({ taxId: party.taxId, legalName: party.legalName, state: address?.state || "", municipalityCode: "", postalCode: address?.postalCode.replace(/\D/g, "") || "", street: address?.street || "", number: address?.number || "", district: address?.district || "", complement: address?.complement || null, phone: party.phone?.replace(/\D/g, "") || null, email: party.email || null, cityName: address?.city || null })
          setRows([]); setMessage("Cadastro copiado. Confira o endereço e informe o código IBGE do destinatário.")
        } catch (reason) { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setMessage(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Consulta indisponível") }
        finally { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setBusy(false) }
      }
      return <div className="space-y-3 rounded-lg border bg-muted/20 p-3"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2"><label className="grid min-w-0 flex-1 gap-2 text-sm">Buscar cliente cadastrado<Input value={query} onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)} placeholder="Nome ou CPF/CNPJ" /></label><Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={busy || !query.trim()} onClick={() => void search()}>{busy ? "Consultando…" : "Buscar cliente"}</Button></div>{rows.length > 0 && <ul className="space-y-2">{rows.map(row => <li key={row.id}><Button className="h-auto max-w-full whitespace-normal text-left" type="button" variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void choose(row.id)}>Usar {row.legalName} · {row.taxId}</Button></li>)}</ul>}{message && <p role="status" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{message}</p>}</div>
    }

    const normalize = (value: string) => value.trim().replace(/[.\s/-]/g, "").toUpperCase()
    
    export function validCnpj(value: string) {
      if (!/^[A-Z\d]{12}\d{2}$/.test(value) || /^(.)\1+$/.test(value)) return false
      const digit = (base: string) => {
        let weight = base.length - 7
        const sum = [...base].reduce((total, character) => {
          const result = total + (character.charCodeAt(0) - 48) * weight
          weight = weight === 2 ? 9 : weight - 1
          return result
        }, 0)
        const remainder = sum % 11
        return String(remainder < 2 ? 0 : 11 - remainder)
      }
      return digit(value.slice(0, 12)) === value[12] && digit(value.slice(0, 13)) === value[13]
    }
    
    const companyFields = ["legalName", "tradeName", "personType", "postalCode", "state", "city", "street", "district", "number", "complement", "cnae", "activityDescription", "companySize", "taxRegime", "email", "phone"]
    
    export function fillCompanyFields(form: HTMLFormElement, data: RegistryData) {
      let count = 0
      const fill = (name: string, value?: string) => {
        const input = form.elements.namedItem(name)
        if (!(input instanceof HTMLInputElement || input instanceof HTMLSelectElement) || input.matches(":disabled") || input.value.trim() || !value?.trim()) return
        if (input instanceof HTMLSelectElement && !Array.from(input.options).some(option => option.value === value)) return
        input.value = value
        count++
      }
      for (const field of companyFields) fill(field, data.fields[field])
      const state = form.elements.namedItem("state")
      if (state instanceof HTMLSelectElement) {
        const active = [...new Set(data.stateRegistrations.filter(item => item.state === state.value && item.active === true).map(item => item.number))]
        if (active.length === 1) fill("stateRegistration", active[0])
      }
      return count
    }

    impl LookupInput {
        pub fn normalize(&mut self) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
            let raw = self.value.trim();
            if raw.len() > 32 || raw.is_empty() {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Informe o documento ou CEP"));
            }
            self.value = match self.kind {
                LookupKind::Cep => {
                    let plain = raw.replace('-', "");
                    if !plain.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit())
                        || plain.len() != 8
                        || !(raw.len() == 8 || (raw.len() == 9 && raw.as_bytes()[5] == b'-'))
                    {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Informe um CEP com oito dígitos"));
                    }
                    plain
                }
                _ => {
                    if !raw
                        .chars()
                        .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || "./- ".contains(c))
                    {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid("CNPJ contém caracteres inválidos"));
                    }
                    let plain: String = raw
                        .chars()
                        .filter(char::is_ascii_alphanumeric)
                        .map(|c| c.to_ascii_uppercase())
                        .collect();
                    if !valid_document(&plain, "juridica") {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                            "Informe CNPJ com dígitos verificadores válidos. CPF não possui consulta neste serviço",
                        ));
                    }
                    plain
                }
            };
            self.state = self.state.as_ref().map(|s| s.trim().to_ascii_uppercase());
            if self
                .state
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|s| !STATES.contains(&s.as_str()))
                || (self.kind == LookupKind::Ie && self.state.is_none())
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Selecione a UF para consultar a inscrição estadual",
                ));
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    pub fn text(value: &Value, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let raw = value.get(key)?.as_str()?.trim();
        (!raw.is_empty() && raw.chars().count() <= 200 && !raw.chars().any(char::is_control))
            .then(|| raw.to_owned())
    }
    
    fn normalize_id(raw: &str) -> String {
        raw.chars()
            .filter(|c| !"./- ".contains(*c))
            .map(|c| c.to_ascii_uppercase())
            .collect()
    }

            value
        };
        let identity = text(record, if cep { "cep" } else { "cnpj" })?;
        if normalize_id(&identity) != requested {
            return None;
        }
        let mut fields = BTreeMap::new();
        let mapping: &[(&str, &str)] = if cep {
            if via {
                &[
                    ("postalCode", "cep"),
                    ("state", "uf"),
                    ("city", "localidade"),
                    ("street", "logradouro"),
                    ("district", "bairro"),
                ]
            } else {
                &[
                    ("postalCode", "cep"),
                    ("state", "state"),
                    ("city", "city"),
                    ("street", "street"),
                    ("district", "neighborhood"),
                ]
            }
        } else if ws {
            &[
                ("postalCode", "cep"),
                ("street", "logradouro"),
                ("district", "bairro"),
                ("number", "numero"),
                ("complement", "complemento"),
                ("tradeName", "nome_fantasia"),
                ("email", "email"),
            ]
        } else {
            &[
                ("postalCode", "cep"),
                ("state", "uf"),
                ("city", "municipio"),
                ("street", "logradouro"),
                ("district", "bairro"),
                ("number", "numero"),
                ("complement", "complemento"),
                ("tradeName", "nome_fantasia"),
                ("activityDescription", "cnae_fiscal_descricao"),
                ("email", "email"),
            ]
        };
        for &(target, key) in mapping {
            if record
                .get(key)
                .is_some_and(|v| !v.is_null() && !v.is_string())
            {
                return None;
            }
            if let Some(mut val) = text(record, key) {
                if target == "postalCode" {
                    val = normalize_id(&val);

                }
                if let Some(val) = record

    fn present_collection<'de, D, T>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Option<Vec<T>>, D::Error>
    where
        D: serde::Deserializer<'de>,
        T: Deserialize<'de>,
    {
        Vec::<T>::deserialize(deserializer).map(Some)
    }
    
    fn optional_text(value: &mut Option<String>, maximum: usize) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        *value = value
            .as_deref()
            .map(str::trim)
            .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
            .map(str::to_owned);
        if value
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|s| s.chars().count() > maximum || s.chars().any(char::is_control))
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Contato ou nome fantasia fora do limite permitido",
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    impl PartyInput {
        fn validate(&mut self) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
            self.legal_name = self.legal_name.trim().to_owned();
            if self.legal_name.is_empty()
                || self.legal_name.chars().count() > 200
                || self.legal_name.chars().any(char::is_control)
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Nome deve conter de 1 a 200 caracteres, sem caracteres de controle",
                ));
            }
            if !["fisica", "juridica"].contains(&self.person_type.as_str()) {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Selecione pessoa física ou jurídica"));
            }
            if !self
                .tax_id
                .chars()
                .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || "./- ".contains(c))
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "CPF ou CNPJ contém caracteres inválidos",
                ));
            }
            self.tax_id = self
                .tax_id
                .chars()
                .filter(char::is_ascii_alphanumeric)
                .map(|c| c.to_ascii_uppercase())
                .collect();
            if !valid_document(&self.tax_id, &self.person_type) {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Informe um CPF ou CNPJ válido para o tipo de pessoa",
                ));
            }
            optional_text(&mut self.trade_name, 200)?;
            optional_text(&mut self.email, 254)?;
            optional_text(&mut self.phone, 40)?;
            if let Some(email) = &self.email {
                let mut parts = email.split('@');
                let local = parts.next().unwrap_or("");
                let domain = parts.next().unwrap_or("");
                if local.is_empty()
                    || domain.is_empty()
                    || parts.next().is_some()
                    || !email.is_ascii()
                    || email.chars().any(char::is_whitespace)
                {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                        "Informe um endereço de e-mail válido ou deixe em branco",
                    ));
                }
            }
            if !self.is_customer && !self.is_supplier {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Selecione cliente, fornecedor ou ambos",
                ));
            }
            if !["active", "archived"].contains(&self.status.as_str()) {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Situação inválida"));
            }
            party_complements::validate(&mut self.addresses, &mut self.contacts)
        }
    }

    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use utoipa::ToSchema;
    
    #[derive(Clone, Deserialize, Serialize, ToSchema)]
    #[serde(deny_unknown_fields, rename_all = "camelCase")]
    pub struct PartyAddress {
        pub label: String,
        pub postal_code: String,
        pub state: String,
        pub city: String,
        pub street: String,
        pub number: String,
        pub district: String,
        pub complement: Option<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub primary: bool,
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone, Deserialize, Serialize, ToSchema)]
    #[serde(deny_unknown_fields, rename_all = "camelCase")]
    pub struct PartyContact {
        pub name: String,
        pub role: Option<String>,
        pub email: Option<String>,
        pub phone: Option<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub primary: bool,
    }
    
    fn text(value: &mut String, max: usize) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        *value = value.trim().to_owned();
        if value.is_empty() || value.chars().count() > max || value.chars().any(char::is_control) {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Endereço ou contato contém texto obrigatório vazio, inválido ou acima do limite",
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    fn optional(value: &mut Option<String>, max: usize) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        *value = value
            .as_deref()
            .map(str::trim)
            .filter(|v| !v.is_empty())
            .map(str::to_owned);
        if let Some(value) = value {
            text(value, max)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    pub fn validate(
        addresses: &mut Option<Vec<PartyAddress>>,
        contacts: &mut Option<Vec<PartyContact>>,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        if let Some(items) = addresses {
            if items.len() > 10 || items.iter().filter(|item| item.primary).count() > 1 {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Máximo de dez endereços e um endereço principal",
                ));
            }
            for item in items {
                text(&mut item.label, 80)?;
                text(&mut item.city, 200)?;
                text(&mut item.street, 200)?;
                text(&mut item.number, 40)?;
                text(&mut item.district, 200)?;
                optional(&mut item.complement, 200)?;
                if !item
                    .postal_code
                    .chars()
                    .all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit() || ".- ".contains(c))
                {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid("CEP deve conter oito dígitos"));
                }
                item.postal_code.retain(|c| c.is_ascii_digit());
                item.state = item.state.trim().to_ascii_uppercase();
                if item.postal_code.len() != 8
                    || ![
                        "AC", "AL", "AP", "AM", "BA", "CE", "DF", "ES", "GO", "MA", "MT", "MS", "MG",
                        "PA", "PB", "PR", "PE", "PI", "RJ", "RN", "RS", "RO", "RR", "SC", "SP", "SE",
                        "TO",
                    ]
                    .contains(&item.state.as_str())
                {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Informe CEP e UF válidos"));
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some(items) = contacts {
            if items.len() > 10 || items.iter().filter(|item| item.primary).count() > 1 {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Máximo de dez contatos e um contato principal",
                ));
            }
            for item in items {
                text(&mut item.name, 200)?;
                optional(&mut item.role, 80)?;
                optional(&mut item.email, 254)?;
                optional(&mut item.phone, 40)?;
                if item.email.is_none() && item.phone.is_none() {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                        "Contato precisa de e-mail ou telefone",
                    ));
                }
                if item.email.as_ref().is_some_and(|email| {
                    !email.is_ascii()
                        || email.chars().any(char::is_whitespace)
                        || !email.split_once('@').is_some_and(|(local, domain)| {
                            !local.is_empty() && domain.contains('.') && !domain.contains('@')
                        })
                }) {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid("E-mail do contato inválido"));
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    use super::{model::*, parse};

    fn input(kind: LookupKind, value: &str) -> LookupInput {
        LookupInput {
            kind,
            value: value.into(),
            context: LookupContext::Party,
            state: None,
        }
    }
    
    #[test]
    fn input_preserves_letters_and_rejects_cpf_or_hidden_cep_characters() {
        let mut cnpj = input(LookupKind::Cnpj, "12.abc.345/01de-35");
        cnpj.normalize().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(cnpj.value, "12ABC34501DE35");
        for raw in [
            "abc01001000",
            "01001--000",
            "01001/000",
            "01001 000",
            "01001💥000",
        ] {
            assert!(input(LookupKind::Cep, raw).normalize().is_err(), "{raw}");
        }
        assert!(input(LookupKind::Cnpj, "52998224725").normalize().is_err());
    }
    
    #[test]
    fn cep_handles_generic_address_but_refuses_wrong_identity_or_malformed_success() {
        let value =
            json!({"cep":"01001-000","uf":"SP","localidade":"São Paulo","logradouro":"","bairro":""});
        let (data, _) = parse::parse("ViaCEP", LookupKind::Cep, "01001000", None, &value).unwrap();
        assert!(data.generic_postal_code);
        assert_eq!(data.fields["city"], "São Paulo");
        assert!(!data.fields.contains_key("street"));
        assert!(parse::parse("ViaCEP", LookupKind::Cep, "99999999", None, &value).is_none());
        for bad in [
            json!({"erro":true}),
            json!({"cep":"01001000","uf":"XX","localidade":"Cidade"}),
            json!({"cep":"01001000","uf":"SP","localidade":[]}),
            json!([]),
        ] {
            assert!(parse::parse("ViaCEP", LookupKind::Cep, "01001000", None, &bad).is_none());
        }
    }
    
    #[test]
    fn cnpj_exposes_only_form_fields_and_never_infers_taxpayer_status() {
        let value = json!({"cnpj":"12ABC34501DE35","razao_social":"Empresa","uf":"SP","municipio":"São Paulo","cnae_fiscal":6201501,"qsa":[{"nome_socio":"Segredo","cnpj_cpf_do_socio":"123"}],"capital_social":100000});
        let (data, _) = parse::parse(
            "BrasilAPI",
            LookupKind::Cnpj,
            "12ABC34501DE35",
            None,
            &value,
        )
        .unwrap();
        let output = serde_json::to_string(&data).unwrap();
        assert!(!output.contains("Segredo"));
        assert!(!output.contains("capital_social"));
        assert_eq!(data.taxpayer_status, "unknown");
        assert_eq!(data.fields["cnae"], "6201501");
        assert!(data.state_registrations.is_empty());
    }
    
    #[test]

    import { useEffect, useId, useState } from "react"
    import { erpFetch } from "@/lib/api/client"
    import type { Schema } from "@/lib/api/types"
    
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

    import { RegistryLookup } from "@/features/records/registry-lookup"
    
    export type PartyAddress = Schema<"PartyAddress">
    export type PartyContact = Schema<"PartyContact">
    const blankAddress: PartyAddress = {
      label: "",
      postalCode: "",
      state: "",
      city: "",
      street: "",
      number: "",
      district: "",
      complement: null,
      primary: false
    }
    const blankContact: PartyContact = { name: "", role: null, email: null, phone: null, primary: false }
    
    export function PartyComplements({
      addresses,
      contacts,
      onAddresses,
      onContacts,
      tenantId
    }: {
      addresses: PartyAddress[]
      contacts: PartyContact[]
      onAddresses?: (value: PartyAddress[]) => void
      onContacts?: (value: PartyContact[]) => void
      tenantId?: string
    }) {
      const listId = useId()
      const editing = !!onContacts
      const [contactTypes, setContactTypes] = useState<string[]>([])
      useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController()
        if (editing)
          erpFetch("/api/erp/registration-settings/contact-types", {
            cache: "no-store",
            signal: controller.signal
          })
            .then(async (response) => {
              if (!response.ok) return
              const value = await response.json()
              if (
                !controller.signal.aborted &&
                Array.isArray(value.data?.labels) &&
                value.data.labels.every((label: unknown) => typeof label === "string")
              )
                setContactTypes(value.data.labels)

    import type { Schema } from "@/lib/api/types"
    
    export type PartyDraft = Schema<"PartyInput"> & { addresses: NonNullable<Schema<"PartyInput">["addresses"]>; contacts: NonNullable<Schema<"PartyInput">["contacts"]> }
    const contactFields = ["legalName", "tradeName", "email", "phone"] as const
    type ContactField = typeof contactFields[number]
    export type PartyCnpjProvenance = { fields: Partial<Record<ContactField, string>>; address: Schema<"PartyAddress"> | null }
    export const emptyCnpjProvenance = (): PartyCnpjProvenance => ({ fields: {}, address: null })
    
    export function fillPartyCnpj(current: PartyDraft, fields: Record<string, string>, previous: PartyCnpjProvenance) {
      const draft = { ...current }
      const provenance = { fields: { ...previous.fields }, address: previous.address }
      let count = 0
      const value = (field: string, maximum: number) => fields[field]?.trim() && [...fields[field]].length <= maximum ? fields[field] : ""
      for (const field of contactFields) {
        const available = value(field, field === "email" ? 254 : field === "phone" ? 40 : 200)
        if (!draft[field]?.trim() && available) {
          draft[field] = available
          provenance.fields[field] = available
          count++
        }
      }
      const placeholder = draft.addresses.length === 1 && !draft.addresses[0].primary && ["label", "postalCode", "state", "city", "street", "number", "district", "complement"].every(field => !draft.addresses[0][field as keyof Schema<"PartyAddress">])
      if ((!draft.addresses.length || placeholder) && ["postalCode", "state", "city", "street", "number", "district"].some(field => fields[field]?.trim())) {
        const address: Schema<"PartyAddress"> = {
          label: "Endereço cadastral", postalCode: fields.postalCode || "", state: fields.state || "",
          city: value("city", 200), street: value("street", 200), number: value("number", 40),
          district: fields.district || "", complement: fields.complement || null, primary: false,
        }
        draft.addresses = [address]
        provenance.address = address
        count++
      }
      return { draft, provenance, count }
    }
    
    export function clearPartyCnpj(current: PartyDraft, provenance: PartyCnpjProvenance): PartyDraft {
      const draft = { ...current }
      for (const field of contactFields) {
        if (provenance.fields[field] !== undefined && draft[field] === provenance.fields[field]) {
          if (field === "legalName") draft.legalName = ""
          else draft[field] = null
        }
      }
      if (provenance.address && JSON.stringify(draft.addresses[0]) === JSON.stringify(provenance.address)) {
        draft.addresses = draft.addresses.slice(1)
      }
      return draft
    }

    # ERP Next em produção
    
    Imagens são construídas somente pelo GitHub CI, pelo workflow
    `production-release.yml`, com `source_ref` fixado no commit completo,
    depois das verificações de cada componente. PRs não reempacotam imagens.
    A implantação exige o resultado completo da execução aprovado.
    Os artefatos `erp-api-<sha>` e `erp-web-<sha>` contêm imagens Docker por SHA.
    O artefato `erp-fiscal-<sha>` contém o motor fiscal, após os testes próprios.
    O artefato `erp-fiscal-mcp-<sha>` contém o MCP Python com schemas fixados e
    DANFE Simplificado Tipo 2. O job também testa o container sem root, com
    filesystem somente leitura, usando XML sintético e sem comunicação com SEFAZ.
    
    Antes da primeira publicação desta versão, instale o dispatcher atualizado
    `production-deploy.sh` pelo acesso administrativo autorizado. O workflow envia
    imagens e Compose; ele não substitui esse dispatcher automaticamente. O pacote
    atual exige as quatro imagens. Confira também as migrations incrementais e os
    grants das tabelas novas antes de trocar a API; não repita a importação do legado.
    
    O workflow de release tem timeout de 20 minutos para API e 15 para web.
    Falhas não autorizam build no servidor ou a retirada de testes.
    Os navegadores usam Chrome do runner.
    
    O workflow `production-migrate.yml`, com `release_run` apontando para uma
    execução já aprovada, executa migrations/bootstrap e importação **no runner GitHub**,
    conectado ao PostgreSQL por túnel SSH restrito a `172.17.0.1:5432`, sujeito a
    autenticação SCRAM em vez das regras trust de loopback. A chave do
    túnel não permite sessão ou execução de comandos. Os segredos são configurados
    no GitHub: `ERP_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL`, `ERP_DB_TUNNEL_KEY`,
    `ERP_DB_KNOWN_HOSTS`, `ERP_DB_SSH_HOST`, `ERP_BOOTSTRAP_SUB` e
    `ERP_BOOTSTRAP_TENANT` e `ERP_LEGACY_DATABASE_URL`. Nunca executar o comando
    `migrate` no servidor. O importador recusa um destino que já contém os schemas
    legados; não repetir o fluxo após a importação concluída.
    Antes de usar a imagem, confere que a revisão de origem possui os mesmos fontes
    Rust, lockfile e migrations da revisão que está fazendo o provisionamento.
    
    O bootstrap cria uma empresa com cadastro fiscal pendente e associa a identidade
    real confirmada de `nicolas@avilaops.com` ao papel de administrador. O banco é
    independente do legado e recebe a cópia e projeção dos dados após o bootstrap.
    A conexão de runtime usa papel sem superusuário,
    sem BYPASSRLS e sem propriedade das tabelas.
    
    O diretório de release recebe somente `compose.yaml`, imagens prontas e arquivos
    privados `api.env`, `web.env` e `.env`. `api.env` contém `DATABASE_URL`,
    `AUTH_ISSUER=https://auth.avilaops.com`, `NFE_PRODUCTION_ENABLED=false` e
    `NFE_PRODUCTION_TENANT_ID` vazio. Se a emissão de produção for liberada para
    uma única empresa, as duas variáveis devem ser ativadas juntas e o UUID do
    tenant autorizado deve ser informado; não existe liberação global segura.

    async fn guard(State(state): State<McpState>, request: Request, next: Next) -> Response {
        let origin = request
            .headers()
            .get("origin")
            .and_then(|h| h.to_str().ok())
            .map(str::to_owned);
        if request.headers().contains_key("origin")
            && !origin.as_ref().is_some_and(|o| state.origins.contains(o))
        {
            return StatusCode::FORBIDDEN.into_response();
        }
        let mut response = next.run(request).await;
        response
            .headers_mut()
            .insert("cache-control", "no-store".parse().unwrap());
        response
            .headers_mut()
            .insert("x-content-type-options", "nosniff".parse().unwrap());
        if let Some(origin) = origin {
            response
                .headers_mut()
                .insert("access-control-allow-origin", origin.parse().unwrap());
            response
                .headers_mut()
                .insert("vary", "Origin".parse().unwrap());
            response.headers_mut().insert(
                "access-control-expose-headers",
                "WWW-Authenticate, MCP-Protocol-Version, X-Request-Id"
                    .parse()

    //! Native, stateless Streamable HTTP MCP. Business handlers remain authoritative.
    mod catalog;
    mod oauth;
    
    use crate::platform::{
        auth::{self, AuthenticatedIdentity, VerifiedEmail},
        state::AppState,
    };
    use axum::{
        Json, Router,
        body::{Bytes, to_bytes},
        extract::{DefaultBodyLimit, Request, State},
        http::{HeaderMap, StatusCode},
        middleware::{self, Next},
        response::{IntoResponse, Response},
        routing::{get, post},
    };
    use base64::{Engine, engine::general_purpose::STANDARD};
    use serde_json::{Value, json};
    use std::{sync::Arc, time::Duration};
    use tower::ServiceExt;
    
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct McpState {
        app: AppState,
        dispatch: Router,
        tools: Arc<Vec<catalog::Tool>>,
        origin: String,
        origins: Arc<Vec<String>>,
    }
    impl McpState {
        pub fn resource(&self) -> String {
            format!("{}/mcp", self.origin)
        }
    }
    
    pub fn router(app: AppState, dispatch: Router) -> Router {
        let origin =
            std::env::var("ERP_MCP_ORIGIN").unwrap_or_else(|_| "https://erp.avilaops.com".into());
        let url = reqwest::Url::parse(&origin).expect("ERP_MCP_ORIGIN must be an absolute origin");
        assert!(
            url.username().is_empty()
                && url.password().is_none()
                && url.path() == "/"
                && url.query().is_none()
                && url.fragment().is_none()
                && (url.scheme() == "https"
                    || (url.scheme() == "http"
                        && matches!(url.host_str(), Some("localhost" | "127.0.0.1" | "[::1]")))),
            "ERP_MCP_ORIGIN must be HTTPS or loopback"
        );
        let origin = url.origin().ascii_serialization();
        let mut origins = vec![
            origin.clone(),
            "https://chatgpt.com".into(),
            "https://chat.openai.com".into(),
            "https://claude.ai".into(),
            "https://claude.com".into(),
        ];
        if let Ok(extra) = std::env::var("ERP_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS") {
            origins.extend(
                extra
                    .split(',')
                    .map(str::trim)
                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
                    .map(str::to_owned),
            );
        }
        let state = McpState {
            app: app.clone(),
            dispatch,
            tools: Arc::new(catalog::catalog(&crate::http::openapi::value())),
            origin,

    impl Line {
        fn finish_information(&self) -> Option<String> {
            let values = [
                ("Estrutura", &self.structure_color),
                ("Anilheiros", &self.plate_holder_color),
                ("Tipo de anilheiro", &self.plate_holder_type),
                ("Estofado", &self.upholstery_color),
            ]
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|(label, value)| {
                value
                    .as_deref()
                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
                    .map(|s| format!("{label}: {s}"))
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
            (!values.is_empty()).then(|| values.join("; "))
        }
    }
    
    async fn order(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        id: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<Order, DomainError> {
        let mut order = sqlx::query_as::<_, Order>("SELECT id,revision,customer_id,customer_name,customer_tax_id,status,amount_cents FROM sales_orders WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2")
            .bind(tenant).bind(id).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?.ok_or(DomainError::NotFound)?;
        if !["confirmed", "completed"].contains(&order.status.as_str()) {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "A preparação fiscal exige um pedido confirmado ou concluído desta empresa",
            ));
        }
        // A simulated commercial total already includes IPI. Fiscal preparation
        // starts from the preserved net sale and still requires explicit tax declarations.
        let net: Option<i64> = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT (snapshot#>>'{sale,netSaleCents}')::bigint FROM order_pricing_snapshots WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2")
            .bind(tenant).bind(id).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        if let Some(net) = net {
            order.amount_cents = net;
        }
        Ok(order)
    }
    
    async fn lines(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        id: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Line>, DomainError> {
        let mut lines = sqlx::query_as::<_, Line>("SELECT product_id,sku,name,unit,quantity_micros,price_cents,amount_cents,structure_color,plate_holder_color,plate_holder_type,upholstery_color FROM sales_order_lines WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2 ORDER BY line_number")
            .bind(tenant).bind(id).fetch_all(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        if lines.is_empty() || lines.len() > 990 {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "O pedido deve conter de 1 a 990 itens para a preparação fiscal",
            ));
        }
        let simulated: Option<(i64,i64)> = sqlx::query_as("SELECT (snapshot#>>'{sale,unitWithoutIpiCents}')::bigint,(snapshot#>>'{sale,netSaleCents}')::bigint FROM order_pricing_snapshots WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2")
            .bind(tenant).bind(id).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        if let Some((unit, net)) = simulated {
            if lines.len() != 1 {
                return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                    "A composição do pedido diverge da simulação preservada",
                ));
            }
            lines[0].price_cents = unit;
            lines[0].amount_cents = net;
        }
        for line in &lines {
            if line.quantity_micros % 100 != 0 {
                return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                    "O pedido tem quantidades com mais de quatro casas decimais; revise a origem antes da preparação fiscal",
                ));
            }
            if line.sku.len() > 60 {
                return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                    "O SKU registrado no pedido excede 60 caracteres; a origem exige revisão antes da preparação fiscal",
                ));
            }
        }
        Ok(lines)
    }

    export const validMunicipalityCode = (code: unknown, state: string): code is string => typeof code === "string" && /^\d{7}$/.test(code) && !!prefixes[state.toUpperCase()] && code.startsWith(prefixes[state.toUpperCase()])
    const digits = (value: string) => value.replace(/\D/g, "")
    const city = (value: string) => value.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ").toUpperCase()
    type RecipientAddress = { taxId: string; postalCode: string; state: string; cityName?: string | null; municipalityCode: string; street?: string; number?: string; district?: string; complement?: string | null }
    export function applyMunicipalityCode<T extends RecipientAddress>(current: T, expected: RecipientAddress, code: string): T {
      const fields = ["taxId", "postalCode", "state", "cityName", "street", "number", "district", "complement"] as const
      if (current.municipalityCode.trim() || !validMunicipalityCode(code, current.state) || fields.some(field => current[field] !== expected[field])) return current
      return { ...current, municipalityCode: code }
    }
    export function municipalityMatchesAddress(fields: Record<string, string>, address: { state: string; city: string; postalCode: string }) {
      return validMunicipalityCode(fields.municipalityCode, address.state) && fields.state?.toUpperCase() === address.state.toUpperCase() && !!address.city.trim() && city(fields.city || "") === city(address.city) && (!fields.postalCode || digits(fields.postalCode) === digits(address.postalCode))
    }
    export async function lookupMunicipalityCode(recipient: RecipientAddress, tenant: string, signal: AbortSignal, fetcher: (url: string, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>): Promise<string | null> {
      if (recipient.municipalityCode.trim() || !/^\d{8}$/.test(digits(recipient.postalCode)) || !prefixes[recipient.state.toUpperCase()] || !recipient.cityName?.trim()) return null
      const response = await fetcher("/api/erp/registry-lookups", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Tenant-Id": tenant }, body: JSON.stringify({ kind: "cep", context: "party", value: digits(recipient.postalCode) }), signal })
      if (!response.ok || signal.aborted) return null
      const reply = await response.json()
      const valid = () => !signal.aborted && reply.tenantId === tenant && reply.kind === "cep" && typeof reply.value === "string" && digits(reply.value) === digits(recipient.postalCode) && reply.status === "found" && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(reply.expiresAt)) && Date.parse(reply.expiresAt) > Date.now() && reply.data?.fields && municipalityMatchesAddress(reply.data.fields, { state: recipient.state, city: recipient.cityName!, postalCode: recipient.postalCode })
      if (!valid()) return null
      // A different tab may have changed the shared session cookie during the lookup.
      const sessionResponse = await fetcher("/api/erp/me", { signal })
      if (!sessionResponse.ok) return null
      const session = await sessionResponse.json()
      return session.tenant?.id === tenant && valid() ? reply.data.fields.municipalityCode : null
    }

            Some((_, "")) => return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Alíquota decimal inválida")),
            Some(parts) => parts,
            None => (rate, ""),

            return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Alíquota deve ser menor que 100"));
        }
        Ok(crate::domains::decimal(value, 4))
    }

    O diretório de release recebe somente `compose.yaml`, imagens prontas e arquivos
    privados `api.env`, `web.env` e `.env`. `api.env` contém `DATABASE_URL`,
    `AUTH_ISSUER=https://auth.avilaops.com`, `NFE_PRODUCTION_ENABLED=false` e
    `NFE_PRODUCTION_TENANT_ID` vazio. Se a emissão de produção for liberada para
    uma única empresa, as duas variáveis devem ser ativadas juntas e o UUID do
    tenant autorizado deve ser informado; não existe liberação global segura.
    Quando o pacote documental estiver habilitado, o mesmo `api.env` recebe
    `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USERNAME`, `SMTP_PASSWORD` e `SMTP_FROM`; esses
    valores são secretos do relay e não podem ser copiados para `web.env` ou
    versionados.
    O workflow de migração também aplica `deploy/grant-commercial-contracts.sql`,
    concedendo ao papel runtime somente `SELECT`, `INSERT` e `UPDATE` na tabela de
    estado do pacote; a API não recebe permissão de exclusão desses registros.

## Activity

    $ @'
        A preparação da NF-e deixava o código IBGE vazio ao copiar clientes, os perfis sugeridos não podiam ser salvos e o comando de transmissão só aparecia depois da primeira gravação. O fluxo agora permite copiar ou consultar o IBGE pelo CEP, salvar os perfis sem metadados incompletos e localizar a transmissão à SEFAZ com os pré-requisitos explícitos.
        
        As consultas preservam edições manuais, conferem empresa, endereço e validade e descartam respostas antigas. Notas originadas de pedidos também recebem o IBGE. Naturezas e perfis são atualizados ao retornar do cadastro. Homologação e produção têm prontidão própria; salvar continua separado de transmitir, com confirmação, revisão e idempotência.
        
        Inclui a logo da empresa nas preferências e proposta/PDF, além da data de saída preenchida inicialmente nas novas NF-e.
        
        Validação local: testes de navegador dos fluxos afetados, TypeScript, ESLint, formatação Rust, 25 testes de empresa, 16 testes dos módulos reais de endereço/consultas e teste do validador Rust com os presets enviados pela interface. A verificação Rust integral ficou para o CI porque a compilação local excedeu a memória disponível.
        
        Sem novas migrations ou emissão fiscal nesta PR. A liberação operacional de produção foi solicitada pelo usuário e aplicada somente ao tenant da Ludus; configurações privadas permanecem fora do repositório.
