    name: Production release
    on:
      push:
        branches: [main]
      workflow_dispatch:
        inputs:
          source_ref:
            description: Exact source commit to validate and package
            required: true
            type: string
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    jobs:
      fiscal-mcp:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 15
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
          - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
            with:
              version: 0.12.24
          - run: uv sync --frozen --extra dev --python 3.12
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-mcp
          - run: node --test scripts/fiscal/test/deploy-config.test.mjs
          - run: uv run --frozen --extra dev pytest tests/test_fiscal_schema.py tests/test_simplified_danfe.py tests/test_nfe_assinatura.py
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-mcp
          - run: docker build -f apps/fiscal-mcp/Dockerfile -t erp-next-fiscal-mcp:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} .
          - name: Exercise MCP in its restricted runtime container
            shell: bash
            run: |
              docker run --detach --name fiscal-mcp-smoke --network host --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m,mode=1777 --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --cap-drop ALL --memory 512m --pids-limit 128 -e XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/cache erp-next-fiscal-mcp:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              trap 'docker rm -f fiscal-mcp-smoke >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
              cd apps/fiscal-mcp
              uv run --frozen --extra dev python scripts/smoke_runtime.py
          - run: docker save erp-next-fiscal-mcp:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} | gzip > fiscal-mcp-image.tar.gz
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-fiscal-mcp-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: fiscal-mcp-image.tar.gz
              compression-level: 0
              retention-days: 7
      fiscal-engine:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 10
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
          - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
          - run: npm test
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
          - run: docker build -f apps/fiscal-engine/Dockerfile -t erp-next-fiscal:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} .
          - run: docker save erp-next-fiscal:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} | gzip > fiscal-image.tar.gz
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-fiscal-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: fiscal-image.tar.gz
              compression-level: 0
              retention-days: 7
      api:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 20
        services:
          postgres:
            image: postgres:18-alpine
            env:
              POSTGRES_DB: erp_next_test
              POSTGRES_USER: postgres
              POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ci_isolated_only
            ports: ['5432:5432']
            options: >-
              --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
              --health-interval 2s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 20
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:ci_isolated_only@127.0.0.1:5432/erp_next_test
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
          - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.1
            with:
              components: rustfmt,clippy
          - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
          - run: cargo fmt --all --check
          - run: cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
          - name: Test and export the exact source contract
            run: |
              mkdir -p artifacts/contracts
              ERP_OPENAPI_OUTPUT="$PWD/artifacts/contracts/candidate.json" cargo test --locked --workspace -- --test-threads=2
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-release-openapi-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: artifacts/contracts/candidate.json
              if-no-files-found: error
              retention-days: 7
          - run: cargo build --release --locked -p erp-next-api
          - run: docker build -f deploy/api.Dockerfile -t erp-next-api:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} .
          - run: docker save erp-next-api:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} | gzip > api-image.tar.gz
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-api-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: api-image.tar.gz
              compression-level: 0
              retention-days: 7
      web:
        needs: api
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 20
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:

          - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
            with:
              version: 11.11.0
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
              cache: pnpm
          - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          - run: pnpm --filter web lint
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-release-openapi-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: artifacts/contracts/
          - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
            working-directory: scripts/contracts/consumer
          - run: node scripts/contracts/generate-web.mjs
          - run: node --import ./tests/helpers/register-typescript.mjs --test tests/fiscal-tax-model.node.mjs
            working-directory: apps/web
          - run: pnpm --filter web build
          - name: Reserve browser fixture ports outside ephemeral allocation
            run: sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_reserved_ports=33118-33120,33128-33130,33928-33929,33941
          - run: timeout 600s pnpm --filter web test:danfe
            env:
              ERP_BROWSER_CHANNEL: chrome
          - run: timeout 120s pnpm --filter web test:monitor
            env:
              ERP_BROWSER_CHANNEL: chrome
          - name: Build the technical contract validation template
            run: node scripts/contracts/build-validation-template.mjs
            env:
              ERP_BROWSER_CHANNEL: chrome
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-contract-model-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: artifacts/contract-validation/
              retention-days: 7
          - run: docker build -f deploy/web.Dockerfile -t erp-next-web:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} .
          - run: docker save erp-next-web:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} | gzip > web-image.tar.gz
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-web-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: web-image.tar.gz
              compression-level: 0
              retention-days: 7
    
      mlops-evidence:
        name: MLOps verified release evidence
        needs: [fiscal-engine, fiscal-mcp, api, web]
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        permissions:
          contents: read
          actions: read
        env:
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          MLOPS_ARTIFACTS_DIR: artifacts/mlops-input
        steps:
          - name: Checkout exact evaluated source
            uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              persist-credentials: false
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:

          - name: Download actual OpenAPI contract from API job
            uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            with:

          - name: Download actual browser-validated template from web job

            with:

              path: artifacts/mlops-input/validation
          - name: Validate source, job outcomes, contract and evidence digests
            run: node scripts/mlops/release-gate.mjs
          - name: Preserve signed-by-digest evidence
            uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:

              path: artifacts/mlops-release/
              retention-days: 30
              if-no-files-found: error

        needs: [fiscal-engine, fiscal-mcp, api, web, mlops-evidence]
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 15
        environment: production
        permissions:
          contents: read
          actions: read
        concurrency:
          group: erp-production-deploy
          cancel-in-progress: false
        env:

        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              persist-credentials: false
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-api-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: bundle
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            with:

          - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            with:

    Antes da primeira publicação desta versão, instale o dispatcher atualizado
    `production-deploy.sh` pelo acesso administrativo autorizado. O workflow envia
    imagens e Compose; ele não substitui esse dispatcher automaticamente. O pacote
    atual exige as quatro imagens. Confira também as migrations incrementais e os
    grants das tabelas novas antes de trocar a API; não repita a importação do legado.
    
    O workflow de release tem timeout de 20 minutos para API e 15 para web.
    Falhas não autorizam build no servidor ou a retirada de testes.
    Os navegadores usam Chrome do runner.
    
    O workflow `production-migrate.yml`, com `release_run` apontando para uma
    execução já aprovada, executa migrations/bootstrap e importação **no runner GitHub**,
    conectado ao PostgreSQL por túnel SSH restrito a `172.17.0.1:5432`, sujeito a
    autenticação SCRAM em vez das regras trust de loopback. A chave do
    túnel não permite sessão ou execução de comandos. Os segredos são configurados
    no GitHub: `ERP_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL`, `ERP_DB_TUNNEL_KEY`,
    `ERP_DB_KNOWN_HOSTS`, `ERP_DB_SSH_HOST`, `ERP_BOOTSTRAP_SUB` e
    `ERP_BOOTSTRAP_TENANT` e `ERP_LEGACY_DATABASE_URL`. Nunca executar o comando
    `migrate` no servidor. O importador recusa um destino que já contém os schemas
    legados; não repetir o fluxo após a importação concluída.
    Antes de usar a imagem, confere que a revisão de origem possui os mesmos fontes
    Rust, lockfile e migrations da revisão que está fazendo o provisionamento.
    
    O bootstrap cria uma empresa com cadastro fiscal pendente e associa a identidade
    real confirmada de `nicolas@avilaops.com` ao papel de administrador. O banco é
    independente do legado e recebe a cópia e projeção dos dados após o bootstrap.
    A conexão de runtime usa papel sem superusuário,
    sem BYPASSRLS e sem propriedade das tabelas.
    
    O diretório de release recebe somente `compose.yaml`, imagens prontas e arquivos
    privados `api.env`, `web.env` e `.env`. `api.env` contém `DATABASE_URL`,
    `AUTH_ISSUER=https://auth.avilaops.com`, `NFE_PRODUCTION_ENABLED=false` e
    `NFE_PRODUCTION_TENANT_ID` vazio. Se a emissão de produção for liberada para
    uma única empresa, as duas variáveis devem ser ativadas juntas e o UUID do
    tenant autorizado deve ser informado; não existe liberação global segura.
    Nos releases `compose.json` que usam `network_mode: service:api`, uma recriação
    da API exige recriar também `web`, `fiscal-engine` e `fiscal-mcp`, para que todos
    usem a rede da nova API. Recrie os quatro serviços juntos. Depois confira o
    `/api/health` público, a prontidão da API e a resposta do `/mcp`; o estado
    `healthy` de um container antigo não confirma o acesso pela rede atual.
    Quando o pacote documental estiver habilitado, o mesmo `api.env` recebe
    `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USERNAME`, `SMTP_PASSWORD` e `SMTP_FROM`; esses
    valores são secretos do relay e não podem ser copiados para `web.env` ou
    versionados.
    O workflow de migração também aplica `deploy/grant-commercial-contracts.sql`,
    concedendo ao papel runtime somente `SELECT`, `INSERT` e `UPDATE` na tabela de
    estado do pacote; a API não recebe permissão de exclusão desses registros.
    `web.env` contém `ERP_AUTH_CLIENT_ID`, `ERP_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET`,
    `ERP_SESSION_SECRET` e `ERP_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID`. `.env` fixa `ERP_API_IMAGE` e
    `ERP_WEB_IMAGE` e `ERP_RELEASE_SHA`. Não versionar esses arquivos preenchidos.
    
    Web e API compartilham o namespace de rede do serviço API; o BFF usa
    `http://127.0.0.1:8080`. Isso mantém a exigência existente de HTTPS ou loopback,
    sem liberar HTTP para hosts arbitrários. As duas portas são publicadas pelo
    serviço API, somente no loopback do servidor.
    
    O cliente OIDC dedicado `erp-next` pertence ao app Auth `erp` e aceita somente
    `https://erp.avilaops.com/api/auth/callback` como redirect de login e
    `https://erp.avilaops.com/api/auth/logout/central/callback` como post-logout
    redirect. Não alterar o segredo do cliente
    legado `erp`. O BFF mantém tokens em cookie HttpOnly cifrado e a API consulta
    userinfo e valida a associação da empresa. O usuário conclui o login no Auth;
    nenhuma senha pessoal é necessária ao deploy.
    
    A saída começa com POST de mesma origem, apaga os cookies locais e cria um
    marcador cifrado HttpOnly com validade de dois minutos. A navegação seguinte
    consulta o `end_session_endpoint` do discovery do issuer configurado e usa
    somente o cliente e o retorno definidos pelo servidor. Os GETs de continuação
    e callback exigem a fase correspondente desse marcador; o callback não apaga
    uma sessão criada depois da saída. Falha no Auth não comprova logout global.
    Os controles de saída usam fetch com redirecionamento manual antes de navegar,
    preservando a verificação de origem sob a política `no-referrer`.
    
    Carregar imagens com `docker load`; iniciar por `docker compose up -d --no-build
    --wait`. O web escuta somente em `127.0.0.1:3140`, compatível com o proxy do
    domínio; a API em `127.0.0.1:3141`. Conferir saúde da API, web e redirect OIDC.
    O legado permanece parado e preservado em seu diretório. Rollback interrompe
    somente o projeto Compose `erp-next`; nunca restaura dados por troca de imagem.
    
    ## Motor fiscal em homologação
    
    O overlay opcional `fiscal-compose.yaml` adiciona a imagem fiscal validada pela
    mesma execução de release. Carregar `fiscal-image.tar.gz` e configurar, no `.env`
    privado do release, `ERP_FISCAL_ENGINE_IMAGE=erp-next-fiscal:sha-<sha-completo>` e
    `ERP_FISCAL_ENGINE_TOKEN` com segredo aleatório de pelo menos 24 caracteres. Não
    usar token de exemplo nem imprimir `docker compose config` sem ocultar segredos.
    
    O motor compartilha o namespace da API e escuta somente `127.0.0.1:8091`, sem
    publicação de porta. O overlay configura a mesma origem/token na API. O health
    check autenticado confirma o processo e o ambiente de homologação; não consulta
    a SEFAZ e não comprova certificado ou autorização de uma nota.
    
    Após migrations e configuração autorizadas, usar os dois arquivos Compose com
    `up -d --no-build --wait`. A imagem do motor roda sem root, com filesystem somente
    leitura e diretório temporário limitado. A API conserva os certificados cifrados
    e envia material em memória somente durante uma operação autenticada.
    
    A habilitação de consulta automática DF-e requer também o tenant e responsável
    explicitamente configurados no `api.env`. Não configurar automação como efeito
    colateral do provisionamento do motor. Produção fiscal continua bloqueada.

    type FiscalEvent = { id: string; kind: string; sequence: number; revision: number; status: string; request: { text?: string }; result: { reason?: string; protocol?: string } }
    type FiscalEvents = { tenantId: string; data: FiscalEvent[] }
    type Danfe = { url: string; filename: string; xmlHash: string; pdfHash: string }
    const labels: Record<string, string> = { preparing: "Preparação pendente", prepared: "XML preparado", unknown: "Resultado fiscal incerto", rejected: "Rejeitada", cancelled: "Cancelada na SEFAZ" }
    
    async function sha256(bytes: BufferSource) {
      return [...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes))].map(byte => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("")
    }
    
    export function EmissionActions({ id, tenantId, draftRevision, environment, model = 55, canIssue, canTransmit, canCancel, canCorrect, dirty, onLocked, onDocument }: { id: string; tenantId: string; draftRevision: number; environment: "homologation" | "production"; model?: 55 | 65; canIssue: boolean; canTransmit: boolean; canCancel: boolean; canCorrect: boolean; dirty: boolean; onLocked: (locked: boolean) => void; onDocument?: (document: { number: number; series: number } | null) => void }) {
      const resource = useResource<Emission>(`/api/erp/fiscal/nfe/${id}/emission`)
      const events = useResource<FiscalEvents>(`/api/erp/fiscal/nfe/${id}/events`)
      const command = useCommand()
      const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState("issue")
      const [event, setEvent] = useState("correction")
      const [text, setText] = useState("")
      const [notice, setNotice] = useState("")
      const [danfe, setDanfe] = useState<Danfe | null>(null)
      const [danfeBusy, setDanfeBusy] = useState(false)
      const document = resource.value
      const documentModel = document?.model || model
      const documentLabel = documentModel === 65 ? "NFC-e" : "NF-e"
      const cancellationLabel = documentModel === 65 ? "Cancelamento da NFC-e" : "Cancelamento da NF-e"
      const environmentLabel = (document?.environment || environment) === "production" ? "produção" : "homologação"
      const selectedEvent = event === "cancel" && canCancel ? "cancel" : canCorrect ? "correction" : "cancel"
      const allowed = (action: string) => action === "cancel" ? canCancel : action === "correction" ? canCorrect : action === "issue" ? canIssue && canTransmit : action === "consult" && canIssue
      useEffect(() => { onDocument?.(document ? { number: document.number, series: document.series } : null) }, [document, onDocument])
      useEffect(() => { onLocked(Boolean(document?.accessKey || command.busy || command.uncertain)) }, [document?.accessKey, command.busy, command.uncertain, onLocked])
      useEffect(() => () => { if (danfe) URL.revokeObjectURL(danfe.url) }, [danfe])
      const revision = document ? resource.etag : `"${draftRevision}"`
      const mismatched = Boolean(document && (document.tenantId !== tenantId || document.environment && document.environment !== environment))
      async function act(action: string) {
        if (command.busy || mismatched || dirty || !allowed(action)) return
        if (!command.uncertain && !window.confirm(action === "issue" ? `Emitir esta ${documentLabel} em ${environmentLabel}, gerando XML e transmitindo à SEFAZ?` : action === "consult" ? `Consultar e reconciliar este documento em ${environmentLabel} na SEFAZ?` : `Transmitir este evento fiscal em ${environmentLabel} com o texto informado?`)) return
        setPendingAction(action); setNotice("")
        const result = await command.send<Emission>(`/api/erp/fiscal/nfe/${id}/${action}`, tenantId, ["cancel", "correction"].includes(action) ? { text } : {}, revision)
        if (result) { setNotice("Resultado registrado. Confira a situação fiscal atualizada abaixo."); resource.reload(); events.reload() }
      }
      async function download() {
        try {
          const response = await erpFetch(`/api/erp/fiscal/nfe/${id}/xml`, { headers: { "X-Tenant-Id": tenantId } })
          if (!response.ok) { const error = await response.json(); throw new Error(error.title || "XML indisponível") }
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(await response.blob()), link = window.document.createElement("a")
          link.href = url; link.download = `${documentModel === 65 ? "NFCE" : "NFE"}-${document?.accessKey || id}.xml`; link.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
        } catch (error) { setNotice(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Falha ao baixar XML") }
      }
      async function generateDanfe() {
        if (danfeBusy || !document?.accessKey) return
        setDanfeBusy(true); setDanfe(null); setNotice("")
        try {
          const xmlResponse = await erpFetch(`/api/erp/fiscal/nfe/${id}/xml`, { headers: { "X-Tenant-Id": tenantId } })
          if (!xmlResponse.ok) { const error = await xmlResponse.json(); throw new Error(error.title || "XML autorizado indisponível") }
          const xml = await xmlResponse.text()
          const response = await erpFetch("/api/erp/fiscal/danfe", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Tenant-Id": tenantId }, body: JSON.stringify({ xml }) })
          if (!response.ok) { const error = await response.json(); throw new Error(error.title || "Geração do DANFE recusada") }
          if (!response.headers.get("content-type")?.startsWith("application/pdf")) throw new Error("Resposta sem documento PDF")
          const pdf = await response.arrayBuffer()
          const xmlHash = await sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(xml))
          const pdfHash = await sha256(pdf)
          if (xmlHash !== response.headers.get("x-xml-sha256") || pdfHash !== response.headers.get("x-pdf-sha256")) throw new Error("O DANFE recebido não corresponde aos hashes da geração")
          const filename = response.headers.get("content-disposition")?.match(/filename="(DANFE-[0-9]{44}\.pdf)"/)?.[1]
          if (!filename) throw new Error("Nome do DANFE inválido")
          setDanfe({ url: URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([pdf], { type: "application/pdf" })), filename, xmlHash, pdfHash })
        } catch (error) { setNotice(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Falha ao gerar o DANFE") }
        finally { setDanfeBusy(false) }
      }
      return <section id="fiscal-emission" className="form-section min-w-0 space-y-4" aria-label={`Emissão e eventos da ${documentLabel}`}>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Emissão e eventos da {documentLabel}</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{environmentLabel === "homologação" ? "Homologação, sem valor fiscal." : "Produção: confira os dados antes da transmissão."} Salve e confira o rascunho antes de transmitir. Cancelar a nota não desfaz automaticamente a venda ou transfere dinheiro.</p>
        {resource.loading ? <p role="status">Consultando emissão…</p> : mismatched ? <p role="alert">A empresa da sessão mudou. Reabra a nota.</p> : document ? <>

          <p>{documentLabel} {document.number} · Série {document.series}</p>
          {document.accessKey && <p className="break-all text-sm">Chave: {document.accessKey}</p>}
          {document.protocol && <p className="break-all text-sm">Protocolo: {document.protocol}</p>}
          {document.result?.reason && <p className="text-sm">{document.result.reason}</p>}
          {document.result?.blockers?.map(blocker => <p role="alert" key={blocker}>{blockerLabels[blocker] || "Revise a preparação fiscal"}</p>)}
        </> : resource.status === 404 ? <p>Nenhuma emissão iniciada para este rascunho.</p> : <p role="alert">{resource.error}</p>}
        {notice && <p role="status">{notice}</p>}
        {command.error && <p role="alert">{command.error}</p>}
        {dirty && <p>Salve as alterações do rascunho para habilitar os comandos fiscais.</p>}
        {command.uncertain ? <Button className="min-h-11" disabled={command.busy || !allowed(pendingAction)} onClick={() => void act(pendingAction)}>Conferir mesma operação fiscal</Button> : <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
          {(!document || ["preparing", "prepared", "unknown"].includes(document.status)) && <Button className="h-auto min-h-11 max-w-full whitespace-normal text-center" disabled={!canIssue || !canTransmit || dirty || command.busy || resource.loading || mismatched || command.stale || !document && resource.status !== 404} onClick={() => void act("issue")}>Transmitir {documentLabel} à SEFAZ em {environmentLabel}</Button>}

          {document?.accessKey && <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => void download()}>Baixar XML da emissão</Button>}
          {document?.status === "authorized" && document.accessKey && <Button variant="outline" disabled={danfeBusy} onClick={() => void generateDanfe()}>{danfeBusy ? "Gerando DANFE…" : `Gerar DANFE ${documentLabel}`}</Button>}
          <Button variant="outline" disabled={command.busy} onClick={() => { command.reset(); resource.reload() }}>Atualizar situação fiscal</Button>
        </div>}

    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -Eeuo pipefail
    umask 077
    
    readonly ROOT=/mnt/HC_Volume_106542212/erp-next
    readonly APPLICATION=erp-next
    
    fail() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
    
    [[ $# == 0 ]] || fail 'invalid dispatcher arguments'
    original_command=${SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND:-}
    [[ "$original_command" =~ ^deploy\ erp-next\ ([0-9a-f]{40})$ ]] || fail 'invalid deploy command'
    source_sha=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
    [[ $EUID == 0 ]] || fail 'dispatcher requires root'
    
    exec 9>"$ROOT/.deploy.lock"
    flock -n 9 || fail 'another ERP deployment is running'
    
    previous_release=$(docker inspect --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir" }}' erp-next-web-1)
    [[ "$previous_release" == "$ROOT/releases/"* ]] || fail 'active release is not managed by this dispatcher'
    
    staging=$(mktemp -d "$ROOT/.incoming.XXXXXX")
    release="$ROOT/releases/$source_sha"
    cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$staging"; }
    trap cleanup EXIT
    
    # Extract the complete stream first, then enforce the allow-list below. GNU tar
    # does not reliably match the selected names when the sender emits ./ prefixes.
    tar --extract --gzip --no-same-owner --directory "$staging" --file -
    
    for file in api-image.tar.gz web-image.tar.gz fiscal-image.tar.gz fiscal-mcp-image.tar.gz compose.yaml fiscal-compose.yaml; do
      [[ -s "$staging/$file" ]] || fail "missing artifact: $file"
    done
    [[ ! -e "$release" ]] || fail 'release already exists'
    
    for image in api web fiscal fiscal-mcp; do
      docker load --input "$staging/$image-image.tar.gz" >/dev/null
      docker image inspect "erp-next-$image:sha-$source_sha" >/dev/null || fail "image not loaded: $image"
    done
    
    mkdir -m 700 "$release"
    
    compose_overlay_args=()
    if [[ -f "$previous_release/compose.json" ]]; then
      # Current production still uses a generated, self-contained Compose JSON.
      # Keep its private runtime configuration on the server and replace only the
      # three immutable image references.
      cp -p "$previous_release/compose.json" "$release/compose.json"
      python3 - "$release/compose.json" "$source_sha" <<'PY'
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import sys
    
    target = Path(sys.argv[1])
    config = json.loads(target.read_text())
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-web-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: web-image.tar.gz
              compression-level: 0
              retention-days: 7
    
      mlops-evidence:
        name: MLOps verified release evidence
        needs: [fiscal-engine, fiscal-mcp, api, web]
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        permissions:
          contents: read
          actions: read
        env:
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          MLOPS_ARTIFACTS_DIR: artifacts/mlops-input
        steps:
          - name: Checkout exact evaluated source
            uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              persist-credentials: false
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
          - name: Download actual OpenAPI contract from API job
            uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-release-openapi-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: artifacts/mlops-input/contracts
          - name: Download actual browser-validated template from web job
            uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-contract-model-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: artifacts/mlops-input/validation
          - name: Validate source, job outcomes, contract and evidence digests
            run: node scripts/mlops/release-gate.mjs
          - name: Preserve signed-by-digest evidence
            uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-mlops-evidence-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
              path: artifacts/mlops-release/
              retention-days: 30
              if-no-files-found: error
    
      deploy:
        name: Deploy production
        needs: [fiscal-engine, fiscal-mcp, api, web, mlops-evidence]
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 15
        environment: production
        permissions:
          contents: read
          actions: read
        concurrency:
          group: erp-production-deploy
          cancel-in-progress: false
        env:
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              persist-credentials: false
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-api-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: bundle
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-web-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: bundle
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-fiscal-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: bundle
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-fiscal-mcp-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: bundle
          - name: Send immutable release to applications
            env:
              DEPLOY_HOST: ${{ secrets.ERP_DEPLOY_HOST }}
              DEPLOY_USER: ${{ secrets.ERP_DEPLOY_USER }}
              DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.ERP_DEPLOY_SSH_KEY }}
              DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS: ${{ secrets.ERP_DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS }}
            shell: bash
            run: |
              set -euo pipefail
              [[ "$SOURCE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
              [[ "$DEPLOY_HOST" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.-]*$ ]]
              [[ "$DEPLOY_USER" =~ ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]*$ ]]
              test -s bundle/api-image.tar.gz
              test -s bundle/web-image.tar.gz
              test -s bundle/fiscal-image.tar.gz
              test -s bundle/fiscal-mcp-image.tar.gz
              bundle_dir=$(mktemp -d)
              ssh_dir=$(mktemp -d)
              trap 'rm -rf "$bundle_dir" "$ssh_dir"' EXIT
              cp bundle/api-image.tar.gz bundle/web-image.tar.gz bundle/fiscal-image.tar.gz bundle/fiscal-mcp-image.tar.gz "$bundle_dir/"
              cp deploy/compose.yaml deploy/fiscal-compose.yaml "$bundle_dir/"
              chmod 700 "$ssh_dir"
              printf '%s\n' "$DEPLOY_KEY" > "$ssh_dir/key"
              printf '%s\n' "$DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS" > "$ssh_dir/known_hosts"
              chmod 600 "$ssh_dir/key" "$ssh_dir/known_hosts"
              tar -C "$bundle_dir" -czf - . | ssh -T \
                -i "$ssh_dir/key" -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \
                -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$ssh_dir/known_hosts" \
                -o ConnectTimeout=20 -o ServerAliveInterval=15 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 \
                "$DEPLOY_USER@$DEPLOY_HOST" "deploy erp-next $SOURCE_SHA"

    rg: apps/web/src/features/settings/tax-profiles*: IO error for operation on apps/web/src/features/settings/tax-profiles*: O sistema não pode encontrar o caminho especificado. (os error 3)
    A preparação da NF-e deixava o código IBGE vazio ao copiar clientes, os perfis sugeridos não podiam ser salvos e o comando de transmissão só aparecia depois da primeira gravação. O fluxo agora permite copiar ou consultar o IBGE pelo CEP, salvar os perfis sem metadados incompletos e localizar a transmissão à SEFAZ com os pré-requisitos explícitos.
    
    As consultas preservam edições manuais, conferem empresa, endereço e validade e descartam respostas antigas. Notas originadas de pedidos também recebem o IBGE. Naturezas e perfis são atualizados ao retornar do cadastro. Homologação e produção têm prontidão própria; salvar continua separado de transmitir, com confirmação, revisão e idempotência.
    
    Inclui a logo da empresa nas preferências e proposta/PDF, além da data de saída preenchida inicialmente nas novas NF-e.
    
    Validação local: testes de navegador dos fluxos afetados, TypeScript, ESLint, formatação Rust, 25 testes de empresa, 16 testes dos módulos reais de endereço/consultas e teste do validador Rust com os presets enviados pela interface. A verificação Rust integral ficou para o CI porque a compilação local excedeu a memória disponível.
    
    Sem novas migrations ou emissão fiscal nesta PR. A liberação operacional de produção foi solicitada pelo usuário e aplicada somente ao tenant da Ludus; configurações privadas permanecem fora do repositório.

    # Verification Before Completion
    
    ## Overview
    
    **Core principle:** Evidence before claims, always.
    
    **Violating the letter of this rule is violating the spirit of this rule.**
    
    ## The Iron Law
    
    ```
    NO COMPLETION CLAIMS WITHOUT FRESH VERIFICATION EVIDENCE
    ```
    
    If you haven't run the verification command in this message, you cannot claim it passes.
    
    ## The Gate Function
    
    ```
    BEFORE claiming any status or expressing satisfaction:
    
    1. IDENTIFY: What command proves this claim?
    2. RUN: Execute the FULL command (fresh, complete)
    3. READ: Full output, check exit code, count failures
    4. VERIFY: Does output confirm the claim?
       - If NO: State actual status with evidence
       - If YES: State claim WITH evidence
    5. ONLY THEN: Make the claim
    
    Skip any step = lying, not verifying
    ```
    
    ## Common Failures
    
    | Claim | Requires | Not Sufficient |
    |-------|----------|----------------|
    | Tests pass | Test command output: 0 failures | Previous run, "should pass" |
    | Linter clean | Linter output: 0 errors | Partial check, extrapolation |
    | Build succeeds | Build command: exit 0 | Linter passing, logs look good |
    | Bug fixed | Test original symptom: passes | Code changed, assumed fixed |
    | Regression test works | Red-green cycle verified | Test passes once |
    | Agent completed | VCS diff shows changes | Agent reports "success" |
    | Requirements met | Line-by-line checklist | Tests passing |
    
    ## Red Flags - STOP
    
    - Using "should", "probably", "seems to"
    - Expressing satisfaction before verification ("Great!", "Perfect!", "Done!", etc.)
    - About to commit/push/PR without verification
    - Trusting agent success reports
    - Relying on partial verification
    - Thinking "just this once"
    - Tired and wanting work over
    - **ANY wording implying success without having run verification**
    
    ## Rationalization Prevention
    
    | Excuse | Reality |
    |--------|---------|
    | "Should work now" | RUN the verification |
    | "I'm confident" | Confidence ≠ evidence |
    | "Just this once" | No exceptions |
    | "Linter passed" | Linter ≠ compiler |
    | "Agent said success" | Verify independently |
    | "I'm tired" | Exhaustion ≠ excuse |
    | "Partial check is enough" | Partial proves nothing |
    | "Different words so rule doesn't apply" | Spirit over letter |
    
    ## Key Patterns
    
    **Tests:**
    ```
    ✅ [Run test command] [See: 34/34 pass] "All tests pass"
    ❌ "Should pass now" / "Looks correct"
    ```
    
    **Regression tests (TDD Red-Green):**
    ```
    ✅ Write → Run (pass) → Revert fix → Run (MUST FAIL) → Restore → Run (pass)
    ❌ "I've written a regression test" (without red-green verification)
    ```
    
    **Build:**
    ```
    ✅ [Run build] [See: exit 0] "Build passes"
    ❌ "Linter passed" (linter doesn't check compilation)
    ```
    
    **Requirements:**
    ```
    ✅ Re-read plan → Create checklist → Verify each → Report gaps or completion
    ❌ "Tests pass, phase complete"
    ```
    
    **Agent delegation:**
    ```
    ✅ Agent reports success → Check VCS diff → Verify changes → Report actual state
    ❌ Trust agent report
    ```
    
    ## When To Apply
    
    **ALWAYS before:**
    - ANY variation of success/completion claims
    - ANY expression of satisfaction

    //! Request-scoped SMTP delivery with a durable, non-retriable delivery intent.
    //! The attachment is a captured commercial snapshot; no browser HTML or URL is accepted.
    use super::*;
    use crate::platform::{access, mail::MailAttachment};
    use serde_json::json;
    
    #[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, ToSchema)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase", deny_unknown_fields)]
    pub struct ProposalEmailInput {
        recipient: String,
        subject: String,
        message: String,
    }
    
    #[derive(Serialize, FromRow, ToSchema)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
    pub struct ProposalEmailDelivery {
        id: Uuid,
        status: String,
        recipient: String,
        created_at: String,
    }
    
    #[derive(Serialize, ToSchema)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
    pub struct ProposalEmailStatus {
        tenant_id: Uuid,
        can_send: bool,
        email_ready: bool,
        recipient: Option<String>,
        deliveries: Vec<ProposalEmailDelivery>,
    }
    
    #[derive(Serialize, ToSchema)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
    pub struct ProposalEmailReceipt {
        tenant_id: Uuid,
        revision: i64,
        delivery: ProposalEmailDelivery,
    }
    
    const DELIVERY: &str = "SELECT id,status,recipient,created_at::text AS created_at FROM sales_proposal_email_deliveries";
    
    #[utoipa::path(get,path="/api/v1/proposals/{id}/email",tag="Sales",security(("bearerAuth"=[])),params(("id"=Uuid,Path),("X-Tenant-Id"=Uuid,Header)),responses((status=200,body=ProposalEmailStatus),(status=403,description="Sem permissão")))]
    pub async fn get(
        State(state): State<AppState>,
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
        Path(id): Path<Uuid>,
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        let (tenant, mut tx, manage) =
            authorized(&state, &headers, &identity, READ, MANAGE, false).await?;
        let current = load(&mut tx, tenant, id, manage).await?;
        let recipient: Option<String> =
            sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT email FROM parties WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2")
                .bind(tenant)
                .bind(current.data.customer_id)
                .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
                .await
                .map_err(db)?;
        let deliveries = sqlx::query_as::<_, ProposalEmailDelivery>(&format!(
            "{DELIVERY} WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND proposal_id=$2 ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 50"
        ))
        .bind(tenant)
        .bind(id)
        .fetch_all(&mut *tx)
        .await
        .map_err(db)?;
        let today: time::Date =
            sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date")
                .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
                .await
                .map_err(db)?;
        let value = ProposalEmailStatus {
            tenant_id: tenant,
            can_send: manage
                && ["draft", "sent"].contains(&current.data.status.as_str())
                && current.data.order_id.is_none()
                && super::super::date(&current.data.valid_until)? >= today,
            email_ready: state.mail.is_some(),
            recipient,
            deliveries,
        };
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(StatusCode::OK, None, value))
    }
    
    fn normalize(mut input: ProposalEmailInput) -> Result<ProposalEmailInput, DomainError> {
        if input.recipient.chars().any(char::is_control) || input.subject.chars().any(char::is_control)
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Endereço e assunto não podem conter caracteres de controle",
            ));
        }
        input.recipient = input.recipient.trim().to_owned();
        input.subject = input.subject.trim().to_owned();
        input.message = input.message.trim().to_owned();
        // A single plain address only: no display names, recipient lists or header controls.
        if input.recipient.len() > 254
            || input
                .recipient
                .chars()
                .any(|c| c.is_control() || c.is_whitespace())
            || input.recipient.parse::<lettre::Address>().is_err()
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Informe um único endereço de e-mail válido",
            ));
        }
        if input.subject.is_empty()
            || input.subject.chars().count() > 200
            || input.subject.chars().any(char::is_control)
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Assunto obrigatório, sem quebras de linha e com até 200 caracteres",
            ));
        }
        if input.message.is_empty()
            || input.message.chars().count() > 10000
            || input
                .message
                .chars()
                .any(|c| c.is_control() && c != '\n' && c != '\r' && c != '\t')
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Mensagem obrigatória e com até 10000 caracteres",
            ));
        }
        Ok(input)
    }
    
    fn escape(value: &str) -> String {
        value
            .replace('&', "&amp;")
            .replace('<', "&lt;")
            .replace('>', "&gt;")
            .replace('"', "&quot;")
            .replace('\'', "&#39;")
    }
    
    fn attachment(current: &ProposalSnapshot, company: &str, tax_id: &str) -> MailAttachment {
        let data = &current.data;
        let mut html = format!(
            "<!doctype html><html lang=\"pt-BR\"><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><title>Proposta {}</title><style>body{{font:14px Arial,sans-serif;margin:32px;color:#17202a}}table{{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}}th,td{{padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;text-align:left}}.terms{{white-space:pre-wrap}}</style><body><h1>{}</h1><p>CNPJ/CPF: {}</p><h2>Proposta {} · versão {}</h2><p>Cliente: {} · CPF/CNPJ: {}</p><p>Validade: {}</p><table><thead><tr><th>Produto</th><th>Acabamento</th><th>Quantidade</th><th>Unitário (R$)</th><th>Total (R$)</th></tr></thead><tbody>",
            escape(&data.number),
            escape(company),
            escape(tax_id),
            escape(&data.number),
            data.version,
            escape(&data.customer_name),
            escape(&data.customer_tax_id),
            escape(&data.valid_until)
        );
        for item in &current.items {
            let finishes = [
                item.structure_color
                    .as_ref()
                    .map(|v| format!("Estrutura: {v}")),
                item.upholstery_color
                    .as_ref()
                    .map(|v| format!("Estofado: {v}")),
                item.plate_holder_color
                    .as_ref()
                    .map(|v| format!("Anilheiros: {v}")),
                item.plate_holder_type
                    .as_ref()
                    .map(|v| format!("Tipo: {v}")),
            ]
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join(" · ");
            html.push_str(&format!("<tr><td>{}<br><small>{}</small></td><td>{}</td><td>{} {}</td><td>{}</td><td>{}</td></tr>", escape(&item.name), escape(&item.sku), escape(&finishes), escape(&item.quantity), escape(&item.unit), escape(&item.unit_price), escape(&item.amount)));
        }
        html.push_str(&format!("</tbody></table><p><strong>Total: R$ {}</strong></p><h3>Pagamento</h3><p class=\"terms\">{}</p><h3>Entrega</h3><p class=\"terms\">{}</p><h3>Observações</h3><p class=\"terms\">{}</p></body></html>", escape(&data.amount), escape(&data.payment_terms), escape(&data.delivery_terms), escape(&data.notes)));
        MailAttachment {
            filename: format!("proposta-{}-v{}.html", data.number, data.version),
            content_type: "text/html; charset=utf-8".to_owned(),
            bytes: html.into_bytes(),
        }
    }
    
    async fn receipt(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        delivery: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<ProposalEmailReceipt, DomainError> {
        let value = sqlx::query_as::<_, ProposalEmailDelivery>(&format!(
            "{DELIVERY} WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2"
        ))
        .bind(tenant)
        .bind(delivery)
        .fetch_optional(&mut **tx)
        .await
        .map_err(db)?
        .ok_or(DomainError::NotFound)?;
        let revision = sqlx::query_scalar(
            "SELECT result_revision FROM sales_proposal_email_deliveries WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2",
        )
        .bind(tenant)
        .bind(delivery)
        .fetch_one(&mut **tx)
        .await
        .map_err(db)?;
        Ok(ProposalEmailReceipt {
            tenant_id: tenant,
            revision,
            delivery: value,
        })
    }
    
    #[utoipa::path(post,path="/api/v1/proposals/{id}/email",tag="Sales",request_body=ProposalEmailInput,security(("bearerAuth"=[])),params(("id"=Uuid,Path),("X-Tenant-Id"=Uuid,Header),("If-Match"=String,Header),("Idempotency-Key"=Uuid,Header)),responses((status=200,body=ProposalEmailReceipt),(status=503,description="E-mail não configurado"),(status=412,description="Versão divergente")))]
    pub async fn send(
        State(state): State<AppState>,
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
        Path(id): Path<Uuid>,
        payload: Result<Json<ProposalEmailInput>, JsonRejection>,
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        let key = command_key(&headers)?;
        let expected = revision(&headers)?;
        let (tenant, mut tx, _) = authorized(&state, &headers, &identity, READ, MANAGE, true).await?;
        let Json(input) =
            payload.map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("JSON inválido ou campos desconhecidos"))?;
        let input = normalize(input)?;
        let request = json!({"id":id,"revision":expected,"input":input});
        if let Some(previous) = replay(
            &mut tx,
            tenant,
            &identity.subject,
            key,
            "proposal.email",
            &request,
        )
        .await?
        {
            let delivery = previous["deliveryId"]
                .as_str()
                .and_then(|v| Uuid::parse_str(v).ok())
                .ok_or(AccessError::Internal)?;
            let value = receipt(&mut tx, tenant, delivery).await?;
            tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
            return Ok(response(StatusCode::OK, Some(value.revision), value));
        }
        let current = load(&mut tx, tenant, id, true).await?;
        if current.data.revision != expected {
            return Err(DomainError::StaleRevision);
        }
        let today: time::Date =
            sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date")
                .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
                .await
                .map_err(db)?;
        if !["draft", "sent"].contains(&current.data.status.as_str())
            || current.data.order_id.is_some()
            || super::super::date(&current.data.valid_until)? < today
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "Somente a versão atual e válida de uma proposta em rascunho ou enviada pode ser enviada por e-mail",
            ));
        }
        let Some(mailer) = state.mail.as_ref() else {
            // Nothing is persisted or published when SMTP is unavailable.
            return Ok(response(
                StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
                None,
                json!({"title":"O envio de e-mail não está configurado. Nenhuma mensagem foi enviada.","status":503}),
            ));
        };
        let (company, tax_id): (String, String) =
            sqlx::query_as("SELECT legal_name,tax_id FROM tenants WHERE id=$1")
                .bind(tenant)
                .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
                .await
                .map_err(db)?;
        let file = attachment(&current, &company, &tax_id);
        let delivery = Uuid::now_v7();
        // Persist uncertainty before crossing the SMTP boundary. A crash can never cause a replay to resend.
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO sales_proposal_email_deliveries(id,tenant_id,proposal_id,version,proposal_revision,result_revision,subject_id,command_key,recipient,snapshot_html,status) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,'uncertain')")
            .bind(delivery).bind(tenant).bind(id).bind(current.data.version).bind(expected).bind(&identity.subject).bind(key).bind(&input.recipient).bind(std::str::from_utf8(&file.bytes).map_err(|_| AccessError::Internal)?).execute(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        record(&mut tx, tenant, &identity, &headers, DomainChange { kind: "sales_proposal", id, event: "proposal.email_requested", details: json!({"deliveryId":delivery,"version":current.data.version,"revision":expected,"recipient":input.recipient}) }).await?;
        remember(
            &mut tx,
            tenant,
            &identity.subject,
            key,
            "proposal.email",
            &request,
            &json!({"deliveryId":delivery}),
        )
        .await?;
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
    
        let result = mailer
            .send_with_attachments(
                std::slice::from_ref(&input.recipient),
                &input.subject,
                &input.message,
                &[file],
            )
            .await;
        let mut tx = access::tenant_transaction(&state, tenant).await?;
        // Same tenant lock order as all commercial commands. Mark only the captured revision as sent.
        sqlx::query("SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE")
            .bind(tenant)
            .execute(&mut *tx)
            .await
            .map_err(db)?;
        let status = delivery_status(&result);
        if result.is_ok() {
            let changed: Option<i64> = sqlx::query_scalar("UPDATE sales_proposals SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND revision=$3 AND current_version=$4 AND order_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sales_proposal_versions v WHERE v.tenant_id=$1 AND v.proposal_id=$2 AND v.version=$4 AND v.status IN ('draft','sent')) RETURNING revision")
                .bind(tenant).bind(id).bind(expected).bind(current.data.version).fetch_optional(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
            if changed.is_some() {
                sqlx::query("UPDATE sales_proposal_versions SET status='sent',sent_at=COALESCE(sent_at,now()) WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND proposal_id=$2 AND version=$3")
                    .bind(tenant).bind(id).bind(current.data.version).execute(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
                sqlx::query("UPDATE sales_proposal_email_deliveries SET result_revision=$3 WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2")
                    .bind(tenant).bind(delivery).bind(expected+1).execute(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
            }
        }
        sqlx::query("UPDATE sales_proposal_email_deliveries SET status=$3,sent_at=CASE WHEN $3='sent' THEN now() ELSE NULL END,updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2")
            .bind(tenant).bind(delivery).bind(status).execute(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        record(&mut tx, tenant, &identity, &headers, DomainChange { kind: "sales_proposal", id, event: match status { "sent" => "proposal.email_sent", "failed" => "proposal.email_failed", _ => "proposal.email_uncertain" }, details: json!({"deliveryId":delivery,"version":current.data.version,"recipient":input.recipient}) }).await?;
        // SMTP errors are intentionally not exposed: provider messages may contain credentials or personal data.
        let value = receipt(&mut tx, tenant, delivery).await?;
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(StatusCode::OK, Some(value.revision), value))
    }
    
    fn delivery_status(result: &anyhow::Result<()>) -> &'static str {
        match result {
            Ok(()) => "sent",
            // Explicit 4xx/5xx SMTP responses confirm rejection. Transport loss and timeouts
            // may occur after the server accepted DATA, so they must remain uncertain.
            Err(error)
                if error
                    .downcast_ref::<lettre::transport::smtp::Error>()
                    .is_some_and(|smtp| smtp.is_transient() || smtp.is_permanent()) =>
            {
                "failed"
            }
            Err(_) => "uncertain",
        }
    }

    //! One invitation carries the commercial order and the contract signing link.
    //! Every value comes from the immutable contract snapshot, never the send request.
    use serde_json::{Value, json};
    
    use super::{api::ContractEmail, model};
    
    /// Escape both Markdown and the provider's email-variable syntax. In particular,
    /// product/customer text must never introduce another signing or document link.
    fn literal(value: &str) -> String {
        let mut text = String::new();
        for character in value.chars() {
            match character {
                '&' => text.push_str("&amp;"),
                '<' => text.push_str("&lt;"),
                '>' => text.push_str("&gt;"),
                '{' => text.push_str("&#123;"),
                '}' => text.push_str("&#125;"),
                '\\' | '`' | '*' | '_' | '[' | ']' | '(' | ')' | '#' | '+' | '-' | '!' | '|' => {
                    text.push('\\');
                    text.push(character);
                }
                '\r' => {}
                character if character.is_control() && character != '\n' => text.push(' '),
                character => text.push(character),
            }
        }
        text
    }
    
    fn decimal(value: &Value, money: bool) -> String {
        let raw = value.as_str().unwrap_or("");
        let (integer, fraction) = raw.split_once('.').unwrap_or((raw, ""));
        let mut grouped = String::new();
        for (index, digit) in integer.chars().enumerate() {
            if index > 0 && (integer.len() - index).is_multiple_of(3) {
                grouped.push('.');
            }
            grouped.push(digit);
        }
        let fraction = if money {
            fraction
        } else {
            fraction.trim_end_matches('0')
        };
        if !fraction.is_empty() {
            grouped.push(',');
            grouped.push_str(fraction);
        }
        if money {
            format!("R$ {grouped}")
        } else {
            grouped
        }
    }
    
    fn due_date(snapshot: &Value) -> String {
        let raw = snapshot["order"]["dueDate"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
        match raw.split('-').collect::<Vec<_>>().as_slice() {
            [year, month, day] => format!("{day}/{month}/{year}"),
            _ => raw.to_owned(),
        }
    }
    
    fn contents(snapshot: &Value, fields: &Value, escape: bool) -> String {
        let text = |value: &str| {
            if escape {
                literal(value)
            } else {
                value.to_owned()
            }
        };
        let string = |value: &Value| text(value.as_str().unwrap_or(""));
        let mut sections = vec![
            format!("Pedido {}", model::order_number(snapshot)),
            format!("Empresa: {}", string(&snapshot["company"]["legalName"])),
            format!("Cliente: {}", string(&snapshot["customer"]["name"])),
            format!(
                "Documento do cliente: {}",
                string(&snapshot["customer"]["taxId"])
            ),
            "Itens do pedido:".into(),
        ];
        for item in snapshot["items"].as_array().into_iter().flatten() {
            sections.push(format!(
                "{} · {}\nQuantidade: {} {}\nUnitário: {} · Total: {}",
                string(&item["sku"]),
                string(&item["name"]),
                text(&decimal(&item["quantity"], false)),
                string(&item["unit"]),
                text(&decimal(&item["unitPrice"], true)),
                text(&decimal(&item["amount"], true)),
            ));
            for (key, label) in [
                ("structureColor", "Estrutura"),
                ("upholsteryColor", "Estofado"),
            ] {
                if let Some(color) = item[key].as_str().filter(|value| !value.is_empty()) {
                    sections.push(format!("{label}: {}", text(color)));
                }
            }
        }
        sections.push(format!(
            "Total do pedido: {}",
            text(&decimal(&snapshot["order"]["amount"], true))
        ));
        sections.push(format!("Vencimento: {}", text(&due_date(snapshot))));
        for (key, source, label) in [
            ("condicoes", "paymentTerms", "Condições comerciais"),
            ("entrega", "deliveryTerms", "Condições de entrega"),
            ("observacoes", "notes", "Observações comerciais"),
        ] {
            // The accepted proposal is authoritative even when the PDF model does
            // not declare a corresponding field. Historical snapshots keep theirs.
            if let Some(value) = snapshot["proposal"][source]
                .as_str()
                .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
                .or_else(|| {
                    fields[key]
                        .as_str()
                        .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
                })
            {
                sections.push(format!("{label}: {}", text(value)));
            }
        }
        sections.join("\n\n")
    }
    
    pub fn preview(snapshot: &Value, fields: &Value) -> ContractEmail {
        ContractEmail {
            subject: format!(
                "Pedido {} e contrato para assinatura",
                model::order_number(snapshot)
            ),
            text: format!(
                "{}\n\nO e-mail inclui o link individual para revisar e assinar o contrato.",
                contents(snapshot, fields, false)
            ),
        }
    }
    
    pub fn invitation(snapshot: &Value, fields: &Value) -> Value {
        let preview = preview(snapshot, fields);
        json!({
            "send_email": true,
            "message": {
                "subject": preview.subject,
                "body": format!("Olá.\n\n{}\n\nRevise o pedido e o contrato antes de assinar.\n\n[Abrir contrato e assinar]({{submitter.link}})", contents(snapshot, fields, true)),
            }
        })
    }
    
    #[cfg(test)]
    mod tests {
        use super::*;
    
        #[test]
        fn order_invitation_uses_commercial_snapshot_and_one_signing_link_without_internal_costs() {
            let snapshot = json!({
                "order":{"id":"internal-id","number":"42","amount":"123.45","dueDate":"2026-12-01"},
                "company":{"legalName":"Empresa"},"customer":{"name":"Cliente","taxId":"123"},
                "items":[{"sku":"SKU-1","name":"Produto {documents.link} [site](https://invalid.test) <b>","quantity":"2.000000","unit":"UN","unitPrice":"61.72","amount":"123.45","structureColor":"Azul","upholsteryColor":"Preto","cost":"SECRET_COST"}],
                "profit":"SECRET_PROFIT"
            });
            let fields = json!({"condicoes":"Entrada combinada","entrega":"Após confirmação"});
            let email = invitation(&snapshot, &fields);
            assert_eq!(
                email["message"]["subject"],
                "Pedido PV-000042 e contrato para assinatura"
            );
            let body = email["message"]["body"].as_str().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(body.matches("{submitter.link}").count(), 1);
            assert!(!body.contains("{documents.link}"));
            assert!(body.contains("&#123;documents.link&#125;"));
            assert!(!body.contains("[site](https://invalid.test)"));
            assert!(!body.contains("<b>"));
            assert!(body.contains("R$ 123,45"));
            assert!(body.contains("Quantidade: 2 UN"));
            assert!(body.contains("01/12/2026"));
            assert!(body.contains("Entrada combinada"));
            assert!(body.contains("Estrutura: Azul"));
            assert!(!body.contains("SECRET_"));
            assert!(!body.contains("internal-id"));
            assert!(
                preview(&snapshot, &fields)
                    .text
                    .contains("Produto {documents.link}")
            );
        }
    
        #[test]
        fn historical_snapshot_keeps_its_identifier_without_inventing_an_order_number() {
            let snapshot = json!({"order":{"id":"historical-id"}});
            assert_eq!(model::order_number(&snapshot), "historical-id");
            assert_eq!(decimal(&json!("1234567.89"), true), "R$ 1.234.567,89");
            assert_eq!(decimal(&json!("1000.250000"), false), "1.000,25");
        }
    
        #[test]
        fn accepted_proposal_terms_are_used_even_without_pdf_fields_and_escaped() {
            let snapshot = json!({"proposal":{"paymentTerms":"Entrada {submitter.link}","deliveryTerms":"Entrega <b>combinada</b>","notes":"Conferir [acesso](https://invalid.test)"}});
            let email = invitation(
                &snapshot,
                &json!({"condicoes":"Do not replace accepted terms"}),
            );
            let body = email["message"]["body"].as_str().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(body.matches("{submitter.link}").count(), 1);
            assert!(body.contains("Entrada &#123;submitter.link&#125;"));
            assert!(body.contains("Entrega &lt;b&gt;combinada&lt;/b&gt;"));
            assert!(!body.contains("[acesso](https://invalid.test)"));
            assert!(!body.contains("Do not replace"));
            let historical = invitation(
                &json!({}),
                &json!({"condicoes":"Manual historical terms","observacoes":"Historical notes"}),
            );
            assert!(
                historical["message"]["body"]
                    .as_str()
                    .unwrap()
                    .contains("Manual historical terms")
            );
            assert!(
                historical["message"]["body"]
                    .as_str()
                    .unwrap()
                    .contains("Historical notes")
            );
        }
    }
    use std::{env, sync::Arc, time::Duration};
    
    use anyhow::{Context, ensure};
    use lettre::{
        AsyncSmtpTransport, AsyncTransport, Message, Tokio1Executor,
        message::{Attachment, MultiPart, SinglePart, header::ContentType},
        transport::smtp::authentication::Credentials,
    };
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    pub struct SmtpMailer {
        transport: Arc<AsyncSmtpTransport<Tokio1Executor>>,
        from: String,
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct MailAttachment {
        pub filename: String,
        pub content_type: String,
        pub bytes: Vec<u8>,
    }
    
    impl SmtpMailer {
        pub fn from_env() -> anyhow::Result<Option<Self>> {
            let host = match env::var("SMTP_HOST")
                .ok()
                .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
            {
                Some(value) => value,
                None => return Ok(None),
            };
            let port: u16 = env::var("SMTP_PORT")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "587".to_owned())
                .parse()
                .context("SMTP_PORT must be a valid port")?;
            let username =
                env::var("SMTP_USERNAME").context("SMTP_USERNAME is required when SMTP_HOST is set")?;
            let password =
                env::var("SMTP_PASSWORD").context("SMTP_PASSWORD is required when SMTP_HOST is set")?;
            let from = env::var("SMTP_FROM").context("SMTP_FROM is required when SMTP_HOST is set")?;
            let _ = from
                .parse::<lettre::message::Mailbox>()
                .context("SMTP_FROM must be a valid mailbox")?;
            ensure!(
                !username.is_empty() && !password.is_empty(),
                "SMTP credentials must not be empty"
            );
            let transport = AsyncSmtpTransport::<Tokio1Executor>::relay(&host)
                .context("failed to configure SMTP relay")?
                .port(port)
                .credentials(Credentials::new(username, password))
                .timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(20)))
                .build();
            Ok(Some(Self {
                transport: Arc::new(transport),
                from,
            }))
        }
    
        pub async fn send_with_attachments(
            &self,
            recipients: &[String],
            subject: &str,
            body: &str,
            attachments: &[MailAttachment],
        ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
            ensure!(!recipients.is_empty(), "at least one recipient is required");
            let builder = Message::builder().from(self.from.parse()?);
            let builder = recipients
                .iter()
                .try_fold(builder, |builder, recipient| {
                    Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(builder.to(recipient.parse()?))
                })?
                .subject(subject);
            let parts = attachments.iter().map(|attachment| {
                let content_type = ContentType::parse(&attachment.content_type).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
                    ContentType::parse("application/octet-stream").expect("static content type")
                });
                Attachment::new(attachment.filename.clone())
                    .body(attachment.bytes.clone(), content_type)
            });
            let message = parts.fold(
                MultiPart::mixed().singlepart(SinglePart::plain(body.to_owned())),
                |multipart, part| multipart.singlepart(part),
            );
            self.transport.send(builder.multipart(message)?).await?;
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    # Brainstorming
    
    You are very good at building. You build what you believe your human
    partner wants, and that belief is usually thinner than it feels. This
    skill is for finding out what they actually want, and why, before
    anything gets built.
    
    People often haven't finished working out what they want. Good questions
    help them think it through. When you understand the why, you make the
    hundred decisions they never mention the way they would have made them.
    
    ## First: What Do You Actually Know?
    
    Before you reply, ask yourself: what do I know about what they want, and
    why?
    
    - **Everything that matters is in the request** ("make the icon cornflower
      blue"). This is a quick, clear task. Do it, and say what you did.
    - **Something non-trivial is missing.** Start the conversation.
    
    Before you start implementing, you must, in order:
    
    1. Lay out the approaches in a message of their own, and have your
       human partner pick one (see Lay out the approaches).
    2. Write the design doc, short or full (see Size the Work).
    3. Get their approval of that doc.
    4. Invoke the superpowers:writing-plans skill.
    
    Two things aren't implementing: a spike they said yes to (see Spike to
    feel things out), and doing what they asked once they've opted out of
    the questions.
    
    ## Look Before You Ask
    
    In an existing project, or when they've given you context (a spec, a plan,
    a handoff, files they pointed at, earlier conversation), dig in before your
    first message. Read what they referred to and the code or material it
    connects to, and keep reading until you can explain how the relevant
    parts work today and what this change would touch. Never ask what the
    project or their context already answers.
    
    ## Your First Message
    
    Move the work forward, with one of these:
    
    - **They've already said what they want** (a spec, a plan, a detailed
      request): aim for about 200 words for the whole message. Echo their
      request back in your own words, so they can see whether you've got its
      shape: what they want, who it's for, and why, as far as they've said.
      Add what you found that bears on it: how the relevant parts work today
      and what the change would touch. If you found something they may not
      have considered that would change what they're asking for or how it
      has to be built, like a constraint, a conflict, or a cheaper path, say
      so plainly. How to build it comes later, once you understand what they
      want (see Lay out the approaches). End with one line inviting
      corrections, then one question about what they want: the thing their
      request leaves open whose answer would most change what gets built.
      Specs are often incomplete, so confirm before you build on one.
    - **They haven't:** one open question, in their own terms, about the
      biggest thing their request leaves unsettled. Say why you're asking:
      what the answer would change about what you build. For "a website for
      my bakery": "If it's mostly for people deciding whether to stop by,
      I'd lead with hours and what's in the case today; taking orders is a
      different site. What do you want someone to do when they land on it?"
    
    How the message ends depends on whether their message asked for
    brainstorming:
    
    - **They asked for it** (by name, by invoking it, or by asking for a
      design discussion): end with your question. They want this
      conversation.
    - **They didn't:** they may not want a conversation at all. After your
      question, add a light, one-line offer to just get going instead, like
      "Or if you'd rather I just dive in, say so." If they take you up on
      it, this skill is done: state any significant how-it-gets-made choice
      (platform, language, medium) in one plain line, then do what they
      asked through the normal workflow.
    
    That's the whole message.
    
    ## The Conversation
    
    Each message ends with one question: a single sentence with no list of
    example answers hanging off it. Use plain language, pitched just a little
    above where your human partner is. Match their vocabulary; never use
    process jargon. You never need to quote this skill to your human
    partner.
    
    Be clear and concise. Lead with what matters. Avoid jargon. When you
    report what you found, give them the most important findings and offer
    the rest.
    
    **Get them describing.** Open questions come first. Their own words carry
    intent that your options can't. Offer a short menu only when they're
    stuck. When they say "just guess" or "what do you think?", propose
    something concrete.
    
    **How it gets made.** Every project rests on choices about medium, tools,
    materials, and resources: the platform, programming language, and
    libraries for an app; the medium for a piece of art. Find out early which
    of those choices they want to make, which they're handing to you, and what
    they already have to work with. Someone with strong views or skills will
    want to talk it through. Someone counting on you needs sensible defaults,
    said in plain words. When there's existing work, build on what it already
    uses. Any choice you make goes in the design as your call, never as
    something they agreed to.
    
    **Ground to cover.** This is territory, not a script. Never read these
    out as questions:
    
    - what kind of thing this is, and what makes it special
    - why now, and what success looks like to them
    - goals, non-goals, and anti-goals (what would make this a failure even
      if it technically works)
    - prior art: what they've seen elsewhere, loved or hated
    - current state: what exists now, what they've tried
    - the details they care about
    
    **Make every question specific** to their project and what they've told
    you. Ask Socratically, the way a sharp colleague would: build each
    question on their last answer or on something you found, so it helps
    them think through a consequence or a case they may have missed
    ("Voting closes before the meeting, and two members joined this month.
    Does someone who joins mid-round get a vote?"). When the reason isn't
    already plain, say what you're hoping to learn or what the answer would
    change. A proposal they can correct, plus your reason for it, often
    beats a question.
    
    **Offer recon.** Once you have a bit of grounding and looking further
    would help, offer to go look: deeper into their codebase or project,
    their own files and data, or the web. Say what you'd look for. They
    decide whether you go.
    
    **Lay out the approaches.** Once you understand what they want, and
    before you write anything up, put the ways of building it in a message
    of its own. Come up with several real alternatives and drop the weak
    ones, including any that work against why they want it and any the
    existing work rules out. Present the two or three that remain, grounding
    each in what the project actually does and saying what it trades off.
    Recommend one and say why, then ask which way they want to go. When
    there's genuinely one sensible way, say so and explain why the others
    don't fit. This is for how it gets built; for what they want, get them
    describing first.
    
    **Show, don't tell.** Offer the visual companion (below) whenever seeing
    would help more than reading:
    
    - something they'll look at: a screen, a page, a printout, a sign
    - a layout or arrangement: of a screen, a room, a schedule
    - a flow or a sequence of steps
    - options that would look different from each other
    - a structure that's easier to see than read: a diagram, a timeline, a map
    
    Once they've accepted, use it for mockups to react to, side-by-side
    options, and throwaway prototypes they can click.
    
    **Spike to feel things out.** Agentic work is waterfall, but very, very
    fast. A quick throwaway build is often the cheapest way to learn what
    they want or whether something works. Offer one when it would help.
    When they just want to spike, get out of the way. Spikes get no tests
    or minimal ones, aren't bulletproof, and skip the plan, implementation,
    and review process. Bring what the spike taught you back into the
    conversation.
    
    ## Play It Back
    
    Play back as you go. As soon as you understand one part well enough to
    describe it (what it's for and who it serves, say, or how one piece
    behaves), describe that part back in about 200-300 words, then return to
    questions about the next part. Playback and questions alternate through
    the whole conversation; the last chunk covers whatever is left.
    
    Only what they said goes in as theirs. Anything you filled in goes in
    as your proposal, with your reason. End each chunk by asking what's wrong
    or missing.
    
    Before you send a chunk, check it: does it describe something they'll
    look at, like a page, a screen, a schedule, or a printout? If so, and
    they haven't seen the visual companion offer yet, send the offer instead
    (its own message, below) and hold the chunk for the next message. Once
    they've accepted, put a mockup next to the description.
