    use serde_json::{Value, json};
    use sqlx::{Postgres, Transaction};
    use uuid::Uuid;
    
    use super::model::Contract;
    use crate::{
        domains::fiscal::danfe_client::{DanfeClient, RenderError},
        domains::{DomainError, db},
        platform::mail::MailAttachment,
    };
    
    pub struct CustomerPackage {
        pub recipients: Vec<String>,
        pub subject: String,
        pub body: String,
        pub attachments: Vec<MailAttachment>,
        pub manifest: Value,
    }
    
    fn rtf_text(value: &str) -> String {
        value
            .chars()
            .map(|character| match character {
                '\\' => "\\\\".to_owned(),
                '{' => "\\{".to_owned(),
                '}' => "\\}".to_owned(),
                '\n' => "\\par ".to_owned(),
                character if character.is_ascii() => character.to_string(),
                character => format!(r#"\\u{}?"#, character as i32),
            })
            .collect()
    }
    
    fn money(cents: i64) -> String {
        format!("R$ {},{:02}", cents / 100, cents.abs() % 100)
    }
    
    fn order_document(snapshot: &Value) -> Vec<u8> {
        let order = &snapshot["order"];
        let mut lines = vec![
            format!("PEDIDO {}", order["number"].as_str().unwrap_or("")),
            format!(
                "Empresa: {}",
                snapshot["company"]["legalName"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
            ),
            format!(
                "Cliente: {}",
                snapshot["customer"]["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
            ),
            String::new(),
            "Itens:".to_owned(),
        ];
        for item in snapshot["items"].as_array().into_iter().flatten() {
            lines.push(format!(
                "{} | {} {} | unitário {} | total {}",
                item["sku"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                item["quantity"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                item["unit"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                item["unitPrice"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                item["amount"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
            ));
        }
        lines.push(String::new());
        lines.push(format!("Total: {}", order["amount"].as_str().unwrap_or("")));
        lines.push(format!(
            "Vencimento: {}",
            order["dueDate"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
        ));
        let text = lines
            .iter()
            .map(|line| rtf_text(line))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\\par ");
        format!(r#"{{\rtf1\ansi\deff0 {{\fonttbl {{\f0 Arial;}}}}\f0\fs22 {text}\par }}"#).into_bytes()
    }
    
    fn payment_document(
        snapshot: &Value,
        amount_cents: i64,
        method: &str,
        reference: &str,
        occurred_on: &str,
    ) -> Vec<u8> {
        let lines = [
            "COMPROVANTE DE RECEBIMENTO".to_owned(),
            format!(
                "Pedido: {}",
                snapshot["order"]["number"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
            ),
            format!(
                "Cliente: {}",
                snapshot["customer"]["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
            ),
            format!("Valor recebido: {}", money(amount_cents)),
            format!("Forma de pagamento: {method}"),
            format!("Referência: {reference}"),
            format!("Data do recebimento: {occurred_on}"),
        ];
        let text = lines
            .iter()
            .map(|line| rtf_text(line))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\\par ");
        format!(r#"{{\rtf1\ansi\deff0 {{\fonttbl {{\f0 Arial;}}}}\f0\fs22 {text}\par }}"#).into_bytes()
    }
    
    pub async fn build(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        contract: &Contract,
        danfe: Option<&DanfeClient>,
    ) -> Result<CustomerPackage, DomainError> {
        let recipients: Vec<super::model::Recipient> =
            serde_json::from_value(contract.recipients.clone())
                .map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("Destinatários do contrato inválidos"))?;
        let recipients = recipients
            .into_iter()
            .map(|recipient| recipient.email.trim().to_ascii_lowercase())
            .filter(|email| !email.is_empty())
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        if recipients.is_empty() {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "O cliente não possui destinatário de e-mail válido",
            ));
        }
    
        let contract_file: Option<(Vec<u8>, String)> = sqlx::query_as(
            "SELECT content,kind FROM commercial_contract_files WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND contract_id=$2 AND kind IN ('signed','preview') ORDER BY CASE kind WHEN 'signed' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,position LIMIT 1",
        )
        .bind(contract.tenant_id)
        .bind(contract.id)
        .fetch_optional(&mut **tx)
        .await
        .map_err(db)?;
        let Some((contract_bytes, contract_kind)) = contract_file else {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "O contrato ainda não possui PDF preservado",
            ));
        };
    
        let nfe: Option<(String, i64, i32, String)> = sqlx::query_as(
            "SELECT authorized_xml,number,series,access_key FROM fiscal_nfe_documents WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND source_order_id=$2 AND status='authorized' AND authorized_xml IS NOT NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1",
        )
        .bind(contract.tenant_id)
        .bind(contract.order_id)
        .fetch_optional(&mut **tx)
        .await
        .map_err(db)?;
        let Some((nfe_xml, nfe_number, nfe_series, nfe_key)) = nfe else {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "O pedido ainda não possui NF-e autorizada",
            ));
        };
    
        let payment: Option<(String, Uuid, i64, String, String, String)> = sqlx::query_as(
            "SELECT r.status,r.payment_id,p.amount_cents,p.method,p.reference,p.occurred_on::text FROM receivables r LEFT JOIN receivable_payments p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.id=r.payment_id WHERE r.tenant_id=$1 AND r.order_id=$2",
    //! One invitation carries the commercial order and the contract signing link.
    //! Every value comes from the immutable contract snapshot, never the send request.
    use serde_json::{Value, json};
    
    use super::{api::ContractEmail, model};
    
    /// Escape both Markdown and the provider's email-variable syntax. In particular,
    /// product/customer text must never introduce another signing or document link.
    fn literal(value: &str) -> String {
        let mut text = String::new();
        for character in value.chars() {
            match character {
                '&' => text.push_str("&amp;"),
                '<' => text.push_str("&lt;"),
                '>' => text.push_str("&gt;"),
                '{' => text.push_str("&#123;"),
                '}' => text.push_str("&#125;"),
                '\\' | '`' | '*' | '_' | '[' | ']' | '(' | ')' | '#' | '+' | '-' | '!' | '|' => {
                    text.push('\\');
                    text.push(character);
                }
                '\r' => {}
                character if character.is_control() && character != '\n' => text.push(' '),
                character => text.push(character),
            }
        }
        text
    }
    
    fn decimal(value: &Value, money: bool) -> String {
        let raw = value.as_str().unwrap_or("");
        let (integer, fraction) = raw.split_once('.').unwrap_or((raw, ""));
        let mut grouped = String::new();
        for (index, digit) in integer.chars().enumerate() {
            if index > 0 && (integer.len() - index).is_multiple_of(3) {
                grouped.push('.');
            }
            grouped.push(digit);
        }
        let fraction = if money {
            fraction
        } else {
            fraction.trim_end_matches('0')
        };
        if !fraction.is_empty() {
            grouped.push(',');
            grouped.push_str(fraction);
        }
        if money {
            format!("R$ {grouped}")
        } else {
            grouped
        }
    }
    
    fn due_date(snapshot: &Value) -> String {
        let raw = snapshot["order"]["dueDate"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
        match raw.split('-').collect::<Vec<_>>().as_slice() {
            [year, month, day] => format!("{day}/{month}/{year}"),
            _ => raw.to_owned(),
        }
    }
    
    fn contents(snapshot: &Value, fields: &Value, escape: bool) -> String {
        let text = |value: &str| {
            if escape {
                literal(value)
            } else {
                value.to_owned()
            }
        };
        let string = |value: &Value| text(value.as_str().unwrap_or(""));
        let mut sections = vec![
            format!("Pedido {}", model::order_number(snapshot)),
            format!("Empresa: {}", string(&snapshot["company"]["legalName"])),
            format!("Cliente: {}", string(&snapshot["customer"]["name"])),
            format!(
                "Documento do cliente: {}",
                string(&snapshot["customer"]["taxId"])
            ),
            "Itens do pedido:".into(),
        ];
        for item in snapshot["items"].as_array().into_iter().flatten() {
            sections.push(format!(
                "{} · {}\nQuantidade: {} {}\nUnitário: {} · Total: {}",
                string(&item["sku"]),
                string(&item["name"]),
                text(&decimal(&item["quantity"], false)),
                string(&item["unit"]),
                text(&decimal(&item["unitPrice"], true)),
                text(&decimal(&item["amount"], true)),
            ));
            for (key, label) in [
                ("structureColor", "Estrutura"),
                ("upholsteryColor", "Estofado"),
            ] {
                if let Some(color) = item[key].as_str().filter(|value| !value.is_empty()) {
                    sections.push(format!("{label}: {}", text(color)));
                }
            }
        }
        sections.push(format!(
            "Total do pedido: {}",
            text(&decimal(&snapshot["order"]["amount"], true))
        ));

    import { PageTitle } from "@/components/workspace/page-title"

    export type OperationNature = { id: string; code: string; name: string; direction: string; purpose: number; model: number; internalCfop: string; interstateCfop: string; foreignCfop: string; active: boolean }
    type Nfce = { environment: string; state: string; series: number | ""; nextNumber: number | ""; cscId: string; cscConfigured?: boolean }
    type AuthorizedXmlPerson = { id: string; name: string; email: string; taxId: string; role: string; active: boolean }
    type Delivery = { notificationEmail: string; authorizedPeople: AuthorizedXmlPerson[] }
    type Data = Nfce | { items: OperationNature[] } | Delivery
    type Snapshot = { tenantId: string; revision: number; canEdit: boolean; secretStorageAvailable: boolean; data: Data | null }
    const emptyNfce: Nfce = { environment: "", state: "", series: "", nextNumber: "", cscId: "" }
    const emptyDelivery: Delivery = { notificationEmail: "", authorizedPeople: [] }
    const selectClass = "h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
    
    export function FiscalPreferences({ section }: { section: "nfce" | "operation-natures" | "delivery" }) {
      const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<Snapshot | null>(null)
      const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Data>(section === "nfce" ? emptyNfce : section === "delivery" ? emptyDelivery : { items: [] })
      const [baseline, setBaseline] = useState("")
      const [csc, setCsc] = useState("")
      const [etag, setEtag] = useState("")
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const [notice, setNotice] = useState("")
      const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
      const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
      const [blocked, setBlocked] = useState(false)
      const [reload, setReload] = useState(0)
      const pending = useRef(false)
      const dirty = !!snapshot && (JSON.stringify(draft) !== baseline || !!csc)
      const endpoint = `/api/erp/fiscal/settings/${section}`
      const title = section === "nfce" ? "Configurações de NFC-e" : section === "delivery" ? "E-mail e acesso ao XML" : "Naturezas de operação"
      useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController()
        erpFetch(endpoint, { cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal }).then(async response => {
          const value = await response.json() as Snapshot & { title?: string }
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(value.title || "Não foi possível consultar a configuração fiscal")
          const version = response.headers.get("etag")
          if (!version || !value.tenantId) throw new Error("Resposta sem empresa ou revisão")
          if (controller.signal.aborted) return
          const raw = value.data as Partial<Delivery> | null
          const data = section === "nfce"
            ? (value.data || { ...emptyNfce }) as Nfce
            : section === "delivery"
              ? { notificationEmail: raw?.notificationEmail ?? "", authorizedPeople: raw?.authorizedPeople ?? [] }
              : (value.data || { items: [] }) as { items: OperationNature[] }
          setSnapshot(value); setDraft(data); setBaseline(JSON.stringify(data)); setEtag(version); setCsc(""); setError(""); setBlocked(false)
        }).catch(reason => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setError(reason.message); setSnapshot(null) } })
          .finally(() => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false) })

          const response = await erpFetch(endpoint, { method: "PUT", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Tenant-Id": snapshot.tenantId, "If-Match": etag }, body: JSON.stringify(body) })
          const value = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) {
            if ([401,403,409,412].includes(response.status) || response.status >= 500) setBlocked(true)
            throw new Error(value.title || "Não foi possível salvar a configuração")

      const updatePerson = (index: number, patch: Partial<AuthorizedXmlPerson>) => setDraft({ ...delivery, authorizedPeople: people.map((person, i) => i === index ? { ...person, ...patch } : person) })
      return <main className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-6 px-4 pb-28 pt-8 lg:px-6">

        <header><PageTitle className="text-3xl font-semibold">{title}</PageTitle><p className="mt-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Configuração da empresa ativa. Preencha os dados conforme as instruções do responsável fiscal.</p></header>

              <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">

                <label className="grid gap-2 text-sm">UF do emitente<Input value={nfce.state} required pattern="[A-Z]{2}" maxLength={2} onChange={event => setDraft({ ...nfce, state: event.target.value.toUpperCase() })} /></label>
                <label className="grid gap-2 text-sm">Série da NFC-e<Input type="number" required min={0} max={999} value={nfce.series} onChange={event => setDraft({ ...nfce, series: event.target.value ? Number(event.target.value) : "" })} /></label>
                <label className="grid gap-2 text-sm">Próximo número da NFC-e<Input type="number" required min={1} max={999999999} value={nfce.nextNumber} onChange={event => setDraft({ ...nfce, nextNumber: event.target.value ? Number(event.target.value) : "" })} /></label>
                <label className="grid gap-2 text-sm">Identificador do CSC<Input required inputMode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]{1,6}" maxLength={6} value={nfce.cscId} onChange={event => setDraft({ ...nfce, cscId: event.target.value })} /></label>
                <label className="grid gap-2 text-sm">Código de segurança do contribuinte (CSC)<Input type="password" autoComplete="new-password" minLength={16} maxLength={36} required={!nfce.cscConfigured} disabled={!snapshot.secretStorageAvailable} value={csc} onChange={event => setCsc(event.target.value)} /><span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{nfce.cscConfigured ? "CSC cadastrado. Deixe vazio para preservar; informe novamente ao mudar ambiente, UF ou identificador." : "Informe o código fornecido pela SEFAZ para este ambiente."}</span></label>
              </div>

                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Esta configuração identifica o destinatário fiscal da empresa e registra quem está autorizado a acessar XML. Salvar não envia mensagens nem cria uma fila de entrega.</p>
                <label className="grid max-w-xl gap-2 text-sm">E-mail fiscal para avisos<Input type="email" autoComplete="email" value={delivery.notificationEmail} onChange={event => setDraft({ ...delivery, notificationEmail: event.target.value })} /></label>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-4">

                {people.length === 0 && <p>Nenhuma pessoa autorizada cadastrada nesta empresa.</p>}

                  <label className="grid gap-2 text-sm">Nome completo<Input required maxLength={120} value={person.name} onChange={event => updatePerson(index, { name: event.target.value })} /></label>
                  <label className="grid gap-2 text-sm">E-mail autorizado<Input type="email" required maxLength={254} value={person.email} onChange={event => updatePerson(index, { email: event.target.value })} /></label>
                  <label className="grid gap-2 text-sm">CPF ou CNPJ<Input required maxLength={18} value={person.taxId} onChange={event => updatePerson(index, { taxId: event.target.value })} /></label>
                  <label className="grid gap-2 text-sm">Função ou relação<Input required maxLength={60} value={person.role} onChange={event => updatePerson(index, { role: event.target.value })} /></label>
                  <label className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 text-sm"><input type="checkbox" checked={person.active} onChange={event => updatePerson(index, { active: event.target.checked })} />Autorização ativa</label>
                </div></section>)}
              </div>
            </section> : <section className="space-y-4">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Cadastre natureza, finalidade e CFOPs sem inferir tributação. Desative os registros que não devem mais ser oferecidos.</p>
              {items.length === 0 && <p>Nenhuma natureza de operação cadastrada nesta empresa.</p>}

                <label className="grid gap-2 text-sm">Modelo<select aria-label="Modelo" className={selectClass} value={item.model} onChange={event => updateNature(index,{model:Number(event.target.value)})}><option value={55}>55: NF-e</option><option value={65}>65: NFC-e</option></select></label>
                <label className="grid gap-2 text-sm">Finalidade<select aria-label="Finalidade" className={selectClass} value={item.purpose} onChange={event => updateNature(index,{purpose:Number(event.target.value)})}><option value={1}>Normal</option><option value={2}>Complementar</option><option value={3}>Ajuste</option><option value={4}>Devolução</option></select></label>
                {([['internalCfop','CFOP interno'],['interstateCfop','CFOP interestadual'],['foreignCfop','CFOP exterior']] as const).map(([field,label]) => <label key={field} className="grid gap-2 text-sm">{label}<Input inputMode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]{4}" maxLength={4} value={item[field]} onChange={event => updateNature(index,{[field]:event.target.value})} /></label>)}
                <label className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 text-sm"><input type="checkbox" checked={item.active} onChange={event => updateNature(index,{active:event.target.checked})} />Ativa</label>
              </div></section>)}
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={items.length >= 200} onClick={() => setDraft({ items: [...items,{id:crypto.randomUUID(),code:"",name:"",direction:"",purpose:1,model:55,internalCfop:"",interstateCfop:"",foreignCfop:"",active:true}] })}>Adicionar natureza</Button>
            </section>}
          </fieldset>
          {!snapshot.canEdit && <p>Seu acesso permite somente consultar estas configurações.</p>}
          <Button type="submit" disabled={!snapshot.canEdit || saving || blocked || !dirty || section === "nfce" && !snapshot.secretStorageAvailable}>{saving ? "Salvando…" : "Salvar configuração"}</Button>
        </form>}
        {error && <p role="alert" className="text-destructive">{error}</p>}
        {notice && <p role="status">{notice}</p>}
        {!loading && <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => { if (!dirty || window.confirm("Descartar a edição e carregar os dados do servidor?")) { setLoading(true); setNotice(""); setReload(value => value+1) } }}>Recarregar dados do servidor</Button>}
      </main>
    }

    name: systematic-debugging
    description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
    ---
    
    # Systematic Debugging
    
    ## Overview
    
    **Core principle:** ALWAYS find root cause before attempting fixes. Symptom fixes are failure.
    
    **Violating the letter of this process is violating the spirit of debugging.**
    
    ## The Iron Law
    
    ```
    NO FIXES WITHOUT ROOT CAUSE INVESTIGATION FIRST
    ```
    
    If you haven't completed Phase 1, you cannot propose fixes.
    
    ## When to Use
    
    Use for ANY technical issue:
    - Test failures
    - Bugs in production
    - Unexpected behavior
    - Performance problems
    - Build failures
    - Integration issues
    
    **Use this ESPECIALLY when:**
    - Under time pressure (emergencies make guessing tempting)
    - "Just one quick fix" seems obvious
    - You've already tried multiple fixes
    - Previous fix didn't work
    - You don't fully understand the issue
    
    **Don't skip when:**
    - Issue seems simple (simple bugs have root causes too)
    - You're in a hurry (rushing guarantees rework)
    - Manager wants it fixed NOW (systematic is faster than thrashing)
    
    ## The Four Phases
    
    You MUST complete each phase before proceeding to the next.
    
    ### Phase 1: Root Cause Investigation
    
    **BEFORE attempting ANY fix:**
    
    1. **Read Error Messages Carefully**
       - Don't skip past errors or warnings
       - They often contain the exact solution
       - Read stack traces completely
       - Note line numbers, file paths, error codes
    
    2. **Reproduce Consistently**
       - Can you trigger it reliably?
       - What are the exact steps?
       - Does it happen every time?
       - If not reproducible → gather more data, don't guess
    
    3. **Check Recent Changes**
       - What changed that could cause this?
       - Git diff, recent commits
       - New dependencies, config changes
       - Environmental differences
    
    4. **Gather Evidence in Multi-Component Systems**
    
       **WHEN system has multiple components (CI → build → signing, API → service → database):**
    
       **BEFORE proposing fixes, add diagnostic instrumentation:**
       ```
       For EACH component boundary:
         - Log what data enters component
         - Log what data exits component
         - Verify environment/config propagation
         - Check state at each layer
    
       Run once to gather evidence showing WHERE it breaks
       THEN analyze evidence to identify failing component
       THEN investigate that specific component
       ```
    
       **Example (multi-layer system):**
       ```bash
       # Layer 1: Workflow
       echo "=== Secrets available in workflow: ==="
       echo "IDENTITY: $([ -n "${IDENTITY:-}" ] && echo SET || echo UNSET)"
    
       # Layer 2: Build script
       echo "=== Env vars in build script: ==="
       printenv IDENTITY >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "IDENTITY in environment" || echo "IDENTITY not in environment"

                        {(
                          [
                            ["name", "Nome do perfil", 80],
                            ["operationNature", "Natureza da operação", 60],
                            ["pisRate", "PIS (%)", 7],
                            ["cofinsRate", "COFINS (%)", 7],
                            ["ibsCbsCst", "CST IBS/CBS", 3],
                            ["classCode", "cClassTrib", 6]
                          ] as const
                        ).map(([key, label, max]) => (
                          <label className="space-y-2 text-sm" key={key}>
                            {label}
                            <Input
                              required
                              aria-label={`Perfil ${index + 1}: ${label}`}
                              maxLength={max}
                              inputMode={key === "name" || key === "operationNature" ? "text" : "decimal"}
                              pattern={

                                  ? "[0-9]{3}"

                                    : key.endsWith("Rate")
                                      ? "[0-9]{1,2}([.][0-9]{1,4})?"
                                      : undefined
                              }
                              value={value[key]}
                              onChange={(event) =>
                                profile(index, {
                                  [key]: key.endsWith("Rate")
                                    ? event.target.value.replace(",", ".")
                                    : event.target.value
                                })
                              }
                            />
                          </label>
                        ))}
                        <label className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={value.active}
                            onChange={(event) => profile(index, { active: event.target.checked })}
                          />
                          Perfil ativo
                        </label>
                        <LineTaxRulesEditor value={value} index={index + 1} update={patch => profile(index, patch)} />
                        <TaxProfileDefaultFields index={index} value={value.defaults ?? {}} onChange={defaults => profile(index, { defaults })} />
                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          variant="outline"
                          onClick={() =>
                            setData({ ...data, profiles: data.profiles?.filter((_, i) => i !== index) })
                          }
                        >
                          Remover perfil
                        </Button>
                      </fieldset>
                    ))}

        assert.equal(payload.productLine, undefined);
        assert.equal(payload.lineRules, undefined);
        assert.ok(payload.defaults);
      }

    test("draft tax fields remain optional for historical drafts and decisions start blank", () => {
      const draft = blankDraft();
      draft.items = [{ ...blankItem(), code: "T", unitPrice: "100", origin: 0, csosn: "102" }];
      assert.equal(submission(draft).taxDeclaration, undefined);
      assert.equal(blankTaxDeclaration().finalConsumer, null);
      draft.taxDeclaration = blankTaxDeclaration();
      assert.throws(() => submission(draft), /Declare/);
    });
    
    test("declared percentage normalization preserves zero, rejects extra precision and sums item-rounded IPI", () => {
      const draft = blankDraft();
      draft.items = [1, 2].map(() => ({ ...blankItem(), unitPrice: "0,05", origin: 0, icmsCst: "00" }));
      draft.taxDeclaration = { ...blankTaxDeclaration(), recipientTaxpayer: false, finalConsumer: true, ipiInIcmsBase: true, icmsOutOfContributions: false, icmsRate: "0", ipiCst: "50", ipiFrameCode: "999", ipiRate: "10", ibsCbs: { cst: "000", classCode: "000001", ibsStateRate: "0,1", ibsCityRate: "0", cbsRate: "0,9" } };
      assert.equal(invoiceTotal(draft), "0.12");
      assert.equal(submission(draft).taxDeclaration?.icmsRate, "0.0000");
      assert.equal(submission(draft).taxDeclaration?.ibsCbs.ibsStateRate, "0.1000");
      draft.taxDeclaration.icmsRate = "18.00001"; assert.throws(() => submission(draft));
      draft.taxDeclaration.icmsRate = "100"; assert.throws(() => submission(draft));
    });
    
    test("applying a reusable profile preserves item origin, CFOP, recipient decisions and unknown rates", () => {
     const draft=blankDraft(); draft.items[0].origin=2; draft.items[0].cfop="5102";
     const profile={name:"Importados",operationNature:"Venda",pisRate:"1.6500",cofinsRate:"7.6000",ibsCbsCst:"000",classCode:"000001",active:true};
     const applied=applyTaxProfile(draft,profile,4);
     assert.equal(applied.items[0].origin,2); assert.equal(applied.items[0].cfop,"5102");
     assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.pisRate,"1.6500"); assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.cofinsRate,"7.6000");
     assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.ibsCbs.classCode,"000001"); assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.ibsCbs.cst,"000");
     assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.icmsRate,null); assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.finalConsumer,null);
     assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.ibsCbs.cbsRate,""); assert.equal(draft.taxDeclaration,undefined);
     assert.throws(()=>submission(applied),/Informe|Declare/);

    });
    
    test("freight and discount retain original gross prices and round IPI per commercial item", () => {
      const draft = blankDraft();
      draft.freightMode = "0";
      draft.items = [{ ...blankItem(), unitPrice: "100", origin: 0, icmsCst: "00", freightAmount: "20,00", discountAmount: "5" }];
      draft.taxDeclaration = { ...blankTaxDeclaration(), recipientTaxpayer: false, finalConsumer: true, ipiInIcmsBase: true, icmsOutOfContributions: false, ipiRate: "10", destinationIcmsRate: "20", destinationFcpRate: "0", ibsCbs: { cst: "000", classCode: "000001", ibsStateRate: "0,1", ibsCityRate: "0", cbsRate: "0,9" } };
      assert.equal(invoiceTotal(draft), "126.50");
      const saved = submission(draft);
      assert.equal(saved.productsTotal, "100.00");
      assert.equal(saved.items[0].unitPrice, "100.0000000000");
      assert.equal(saved.items[0].freightAmount, "20.00");
      assert.equal(saved.items[0].discountAmount, "5.00");
      assert.equal(saved.taxDeclaration.destinationIcmsRate, "20.0000");
      assert.equal(saved.taxDeclaration.destinationFcpRate, "0.0000");
      draft.freightMode = "9";
      assert.throws(() => submission(draft), /Frete/);
      draft.freightMode = "0";
      draft.items[0].discountAmount = "100,01";
      assert.throws(() => submission(draft), /desconto/);
    });

      assert.equal(applied.items[0].origin, -1);
      assert.equal(applied.items[0].cfop, "");
      assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.ipiCst, "50");
      assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.ipiFrameCode, "999");
      assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.ipiRate, null);
      assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.icmsRate, null);
      assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.recipientTaxpayer, null);
      assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.finalConsumer, true);
      assert.deepEqual(applied.taxDeclaration.ibsCbs, { cst: "000", classCode: "000001", ibsStateRate: "0.1000", ibsCityRate: "0.0000", cbsRate: "0.9000" });
      assert.equal(applyTaxProfile(draft, national, 2).taxDeclaration.ipiCst, "53");
    });

      const draft = blankDraft();
      draft.items[0] = { ...blankItem(), icmsCst: "40", pisCst: "07", cofinsCst: "07", origin: 2, cfop: "6102" };

      assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.finalConsumer, false);
      assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.ipiInIcmsBase, false);
      assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.ipiCst, "53");
      assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.ipiFrameCode, "001");
      assert.equal(applied.taxDeclaration.ibsCbs.cbsRate, "0.0000");
      draft.items[0] = { ...blankItem(), csosn: "102" };

    });

    fn normalize_profile_rate(rate: &str) -> Result<String, DomainError> {
        let (whole, fraction) = match rate.split_once('.') {
            Some((_, "")) => return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Alíquota decimal inválida")),
            Some(parts) => parts,
            None => (rate, ""),
        };
        let value = crate::domains::fixed(&format!("{whole}.{fraction:0<4}"), 4)?;
        if value >= 1_000_000 {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Alíquota deve ser menor que 100"));
        }
        Ok(crate::domains::decimal(value, 4))
    }
    
    impl TaxProfile {
        pub fn validate(&mut self) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
            if self
                .product_line
                .as_deref()
                .is_some_and(|line| !matches!(line, "imported" | "national"))
                || self.product_line.is_some() != self.line_rules.is_some()
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Regras da nota exigem uma linha comercial válida",
                ));
            }
            if let Some(rules) = self.line_rules.as_mut() {
                rules.validate()?;
            }
            if let Some(defaults) = &mut self.defaults {
                for rate in [
                    &mut defaults.ibs_state_rate,
                    &mut defaults.ibs_city_rate,
                    &mut defaults.cbs_rate,
                ]
                .into_iter()
                .flatten()
                {
                    *rate = normalize_profile_rate(rate)?;
                }
                if defaults
                    .ipi_frame_code
                    .as_deref()
                    .is_some_and(|v| v.len() != 3 || !v.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()))
                {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                        "Enquadramento do IPI exige três dígitos",
                    ));
                }
            }
            self.name = self.name.trim().to_string();
            self.operation_nature = self.operation_nature.trim().to_string();
            if self.name.is_empty()
                || self.name.chars().count() > 80
                || self.operation_nature.is_empty()
                || self.operation_nature.chars().count() > 60
                || self
                    .name
                    .chars()
                    .chain(self.operation_nature.chars())
                    .any(char::is_control)
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Nome ou natureza do perfil inválidos"));
            }
            self.pis_rate = normalize_profile_rate(&self.pis_rate)?;
            self.cofins_rate = normalize_profile_rate(&self.cofins_rate)?;
            if self.ibs_cbs_cst.len() != 3
                || !self.ibs_cbs_cst.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit())
                || self.class_code.len() != 6
                || !self.class_code.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit())
                || !self.class_code.starts_with(&self.ibs_cbs_cst)
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "CST IBS/CBS ou cClassTrib inválidos ou incompatíveis",
                ));
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    async fn call(
        router: &Router,
        method: &str,
        subject: &str,
        tenant: &str,
        etag: Option<&str>,
        value: Value,
    ) -> (StatusCode, Value) {
        let mut request = Request::builder()
            .method(method)
            .uri("/api/v1/registration-settings/products")
            .header("x-tenant-id", tenant)
            .header("content-type", "application/json");
        if !subject.is_empty() {
            request = request.header("authorization", format!("Bearer {subject}"));
        }
        if let Some(etag) = etag {
            request = request.header("if-match", etag);
        }
        let response = router
            .clone()
            .oneshot(request.body(Body::from(value.to_string())).unwrap())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let status = response.status();
        (
            status,
            serde_json::from_slice(&to_bytes(response.into_body(), 100000).await.unwrap()).unwrap(),
        )
    }

    ---
    title: use client
    description: Learn how to use the use client directive to render a component on the client.
    ---
    
    The `'use client'` directive declares an entry point for the components to be rendered on the **client side** and should be used when creating interactive user interfaces (UI) that require client-side JavaScript capabilities, such as state management, event handling, and access to browser APIs. This is a React feature.
    
    > **Good to know:**
    >
    > You do not need to add the `'use client'` directive to every file that contains Client Components. You only need to add it to the files whose components you want to render directly within Server Components. The `'use client'` directive defines the [server and client boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary), and the components exported from such a file serve as entry points to the client.
    
    ## Usage
    
    To declare an entry point for the Client Components, add the `'use client'` directive **at the top of the file**, before any imports. The directive applies to the entire module and cannot be placed inside a component or function:
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```

    mod domains {
    #[derive(Debug)] pub enum DomainError { Invalid(&'static str) }
    pub fn fixed(raw: &str, scale: usize) -> Result<i64, DomainError> {
        let (whole, fraction) = raw.split_once('.').ok_or(DomainError::Invalid(
            "Informe decimal com ponto e escala fixa",
        ))?;
        if whole.is_empty()
            || whole.len() > 12
            || (whole.len() > 1 && whole.starts_with('0'))
            || fraction.len() != scale
            || !whole
                .bytes()
                .chain(fraction.bytes())
                .all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit())
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Decimal inválido ou fora da escala permitida",
            ));
        }
        format!("{whole}{fraction}")
            .parse()
            .map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("Valor fora do limite"))
    }
    pub fn decimal(value: i64, scale: u32) -> String {
        let factor = 10_i64.pow(scale);
        format!(
            "{}.{:0width$}",
            value / factor,
            value % factor,
            width = scale as usize
        )
    }

    ---
    name: requesting-code-review
    description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
    ---
    
    # Requesting Code Review
    
    Dispatch a code reviewer subagent to catch issues before they cascade. The reviewer gets precisely crafted context for evaluation — never your session's history.
    
    **Core principle:** Review early, review often.
    
    ## When to Request Review
    
    **Mandatory:**
    - After each task in subagent-driven development
    - After completing major feature
    - Before merge to main
    
    **Optional but valuable:**
    - When stuck (fresh perspective)
    - Before refactoring (baseline check)
    - After fixing complex bug
    
    ## How to Request
    
    **1. Get git SHAs:**
    ```bash
    BASE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)  # or: git merge-base origin/main HEAD
    HEAD_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
    ```
    
    **2. Dispatch code reviewer subagent:**
    
    Dispatch a `general-purpose` subagent, filling the template at [code-reviewer.md](code-reviewer.md)
    
    **Placeholders:**
    - `{DESCRIPTION}` - Brief summary of what you built
    - `{PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS}` - What it should do
    - `{BASE_SHA}` - Starting commit
    - `{HEAD_SHA}` - Ending commit
    
    **3. Act on feedback:**
    - Fix Critical issues immediately
    - Fix Important issues before proceeding
    - Note Minor issues for later
    - Push back if reviewer is wrong (with reasoning)
    
    ## Example
    
    ```
    [Just completed Task 2: Add verification function]
    
    You: Let me request code review before proceeding.
    
    BASE_SHA=$(git log --oneline | grep "Task 1" | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f1)
    HEAD_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
    
    [Dispatch code reviewer subagent]
      DESCRIPTION: Added verifyIndex() and repairIndex() with 4 issue types
      PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: Task 2 from docs/superpowers/plans/deployment-plan.md
      BASE_SHA: a7981ec
      HEAD_SHA: 3df7661
    
    [Subagent returns]:
      Strengths: Clean architecture, real tests
      Issues:
        Important: Missing progress indicators
        Minor: Magic number (100) for reporting interval
      Assessment: Ready to proceed
    
    You: [Fix progress indicators]
    [Continue to Task 3]
    ```

    #[utoipa::path(put,path="/api/v1/registration-settings/{section}",operation_id="put_registration_settings",tag="Catalog",security(("bearerAuth"=[])),params(("section"=String,Path),("X-Tenant-Id"=Uuid,Header),("If-Match"=String,Header)),request_body=RegistrationInput,responses((status=200,body=RegistrationSnapshot),(status=403,description="Exige gestão da empresa"),(status=404,description="Seção desconhecida"),(status=412,description="Revisão alterada"),(status=422,description="Configuração inválida"),(status=428,description="If-Match obrigatório")))]
    pub async fn put(
        State(state): State<AppState>,
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
        Path(section): Path<String>,
        payload: Result<Json<RegistrationInput>, JsonRejection>,
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        let expected = revision(&headers)?;
        let Json(value) = payload.map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("JSON inválido"))?;
        let data = validate(
            &section,
            serde_json::to_value(value).map_err(|_| access::AccessError::Internal)?,
        )?;
        let (tenant, mut tx, can_edit) =
            transaction(&state, &headers, &identity, &section, true).await?;
        let (current, _) = load(&mut tx, tenant, &section).await?;
        if expected != current {
            return Err(DomainError::StaleRevision);
        }
        let next = current
            .checked_add(1)
            .ok_or(access::AccessError::Internal)?;
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO registration_settings(tenant_id,section,data,revision) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,section) DO UPDATE SET data=$3,revision=$4,updated_at=now()").bind(tenant).bind(&section).bind(&data).bind(next).execute(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO audit_log(tenant_id,identity_id,action,entity_type,details) SELECT $1,id,'registration_settings.updated','registration_settings',$3 FROM identities WHERE auth_subject=$2").bind(tenant).bind(&identity.subject).bind(json!({"section":section,"previousRevision":current,"revision":next})).execute(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(
            StatusCode::OK,
            Some(next),
            RegistrationSnapshot {
                tenant_id: tenant,
                revision: next,
                can_edit,
                data,
            },
        ))
    }
    #[cfg(test)]
    mod tests {
        use super::*;
        #[test]
        fn validation_rejects_unknown_fields_and_duplicates() {
            assert!(
                validate(
                    "products",
                    json!({"requireNcm":true,"requireCest":false,"admin":true})
                )
                .is_err()
            );
            assert!(
                validate(
                    "contact-types",
                    json!({"labels":["Financeiro"," financeiro "]})
                )
                .is_err()
            );
            assert!(validate("bad", json!({})).is_err());
        }
        #[test]
        fn tax_defaults_are_explicit_and_preserve_zeroes() {
            let data = json!({"profiles":[{"name":"Importados","operationNature":"Venda de mercadorias","pisRate":"1.6500","cofinsRate":"7.6000","ibsCbsCst":"000","classCode":"000001","active":true}]});
            assert_eq!(validate("tax-profiles", data.clone()).unwrap(), data);
            let mut invalid = data;
            invalid["profiles"][0]["pisRate"] = json!("100.0000");
            assert!(validate("tax-profiles", invalid).is_err());
        }
    }

    ) -> Result<(i64, Value), DomainError> {
        let default = default_data(section)?;
        Ok(sqlx::query_as(
            "SELECT revision,data FROM registration_settings WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND section=$2",
        )

    async fn transaction<'a>(
        state: &'a AppState,
        headers: &HeaderMap,
        identity: &AuthenticatedIdentity,
        section: &str,
        write: bool,
    ) -> Result<(Uuid, Transaction<'a, Postgres>, bool), DomainError> {
        default_data(section)?;
        let tenant = access::tenant_id(headers)?;
        let mut tx = access::tenant_transaction(state, tenant).await?;
        if write {
            sqlx::query("SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE")
                .bind(tenant)
                .execute(&mut *tx)
                .await
                .map_err(db)?;
        }
        let member = access::load_access(&mut tx, tenant, &identity.subject).await?;
        let can_edit = access::require_permission(&member, "platform.company.manage").is_ok();
        if write {
            access::require_permission(&member, "platform.company.manage")?;
        } else if !can_edit
            && ![
                "platform.company.read",
                match section {
                    "products" => "catalog.products.read",
                    "tax-profiles" => "fiscal.nfe.read",
                    _ => "catalog.parties.read",
                },
            ]
            .iter()
            .any(|p| access::require_permission(&member, p).is_ok())
        {
            return Err(access::AccessError::Forbidden.into());
        }
        Ok((tenant, tx, can_edit))
    }

    name: CI
    
    on:
      pull_request:
      push:
        branches: [main]
    
    permissions:
      contents: read
    
    concurrency:
      group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    
    env:
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
      npm_config_fetch_retries: 0
      npm_config_fetch_timeout: 10000
    
    jobs:
      context-source:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
          - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
            with:
              version: 11.11.0
          - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          - run: pnpm test:architecture
          - name: Validate MLOps release evidence gate (deterministic fixtures)
            run: node --test scripts/mlops/release-gate.test.mjs
          - name: Enforce documented architecture
            run: |
              mkdir -p artifacts
              pnpm --silent check:architecture > artifacts/architecture.json
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            if: always()
            with:
              name: erp-architecture-${{ github.sha }}
              path: artifacts/architecture.json
          - run: pnpm context:erp
    
      fiscal-engine:

        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
          - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
          - run: npm test
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
    
      rust-build:
        timeout-minutes: 10
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.1
          - uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
            with:
              path: |
                /home/runner/.cargo/bin
                /home/runner/.cargo/.crates.toml
                /home/runner/.cargo/.crates2.json
                /home/runner/.cargo/registry
                /home/runner/.cargo/git
                ${{ github.workspace }}/target
              key: v0-rust-rust-Linux-x64-daeb8fa6-9ef83cd1
          - name: Compile complete Rust test suite
            run: |
              mkdir -p artifacts
              timeout 480s cargo test --workspace --locked --no-run --message-format=json > artifacts/rust-build.jsonl
              python3 -B scripts/contracts/package-test-binary.py
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-rust-tests-${{ github.sha }}
              path: artifacts/rust-tests/
              if-no-files-found: error
              retention-days: 1
    
      rust:
        needs: rust-build

        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        services:

              POSTGRES_PASSWORD: erp_next_ci_only

          - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.1

          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4

          - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4

          - run: node scripts/contracts/gate.mjs artifacts/contracts/baseline.json artifacts/contracts/candidate.json artifacts/contracts
          - name: Verify fiscal integration examples against the generated OpenAPI
            run: node scripts/fiscal/check-contract.mjs artifacts/contracts/candidate.json
          - name: Check fixed company consumer
            working-directory: scripts/contracts/consumer
            run: |
              npm run generate
              npm run check
              npm test
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            if: always()
            with:
              name: erp-openapi-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}

        if: always()

        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - name: Verify the MLOps evidence exporter
            run: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/mlops -p 'test_*.py'
          - name: Export immutable CI evidence with source and tested merge SHAs
            if: always()
            env:

          - name: Preserve CI gate evidence
            if: always()
            uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4

            working-directory: apps/fiscal-mcp

    ---
    name: brainstorming
    description: "You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, modifying behavior, or planning anything new, in software or out of it (a talk, a business, a renovation)."
    ---
    
    # Brainstorming
    
    You are very good at building. You build what you believe your human
    partner wants, and that belief is usually thinner than it feels. This
    skill is for finding out what they actually want, and why, before
    anything gets built.
    
    People often haven't finished working out what they want. Good questions
    help them think it through. When you understand the why, you make the
    hundred decisions they never mention the way they would have made them.
    
    ## First: What Do You Actually Know?
    
    Before you reply, ask yourself: what do I know about what they want, and
    why?
    
    - **Everything that matters is in the request** ("make the icon cornflower
      blue"). This is a quick, clear task. Do it, and say what you did.
    - **Something non-trivial is missing.** Start the conversation.
    
    Before you start implementing, you must, in order:
    
    1. Lay out the approaches in a message of their own, and have your
       human partner pick one (see Lay out the approaches).
    2. Write the design doc, short or full (see Size the Work).
    3. Get their approval of that doc.
    4. Invoke the superpowers:writing-plans skill.
    
    Two things aren't implementing: a spike they said yes to (see Spike to
    feel things out), and doing what they asked once they've opted out of
    the questions.
    
    ## Look Before You Ask
    
    In an existing project, or when they've given you context (a spec, a plan,
    a handoff, files they pointed at, earlier conversation), dig in before your
    first message. Read what they referred to and the code or material it
    connects to, and keep reading until you can explain how the relevant
    parts work today and what this change would touch. Never ask what the
    project or their context already answers.
    
    ## Your First Message
    
    Move the work forward, with one of these:
    
    - **They've already said what they want** (a spec, a plan, a detailed
      request): aim for about 200 words for the whole message. Echo their
      request back in your own words, so they can see whether you've got its
      shape: what they want, who it's for, and why, as far as they've said.
      Add what you found that bears on it: how the relevant parts work today
      and what the change would touch. If you found something they may not
      have considered that would change what they're asking for or how it
      has to be built, like a constraint, a conflict, or a cheaper path, say
    ✓ • 224ms

## Activity

    import { mkdir, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
    import { createRequire } from "node:module";
    import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path";
    import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
    import { readOpenApi } from "./gate.mjs";
    
    const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../", import.meta.url));
    const require = createRequire(new URL("./consumer/package.json", import.meta.url));
    
    export async function generateWeb(input, output = resolve(root, "apps/web/src/lib/api/generated.d.ts")) {
      if (!input) throw new Error("OPENAPI_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED");
      const { document } = await readOpenApi(resolve(input));
      const { default: openapiTS, astToString } = require("openapi-typescript");
      const source = astToString(await openapiTS(document));
      await mkdir(dirname(output), { recursive: true });
      await writeFile(output, source);
      return source;
    }
    
    if (process.argv[1] && pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href === import.meta.url) {
      await generateWeb(process.argv[2] || resolve(root, "artifacts/contracts/candidate.json"));
    }
    import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
    import { readFile, mkdir, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
    import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
    import { resolve, join } from "node:path";
    import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
    
    const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../", import.meta.url));
    const sha256 = bytes => createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const SHA = /^[a-f0-9]{40}$/;
    const TEXT_MAX = 20 * 1024 * 1024;
    
    export function validateReleaseInputs(input) {
      if (!SHA.test(input.sourceSha ?? "") || !SHA.test(input.checkoutSha ?? "") ||
          input.sourceSha !== input.checkoutSha) throw new Error("SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH");
      if (input.ref !== "refs/heads/main") throw new Error("NOT_MAIN_BRANCH");
      if (!/^[0-9]+$/.test(String(input.runId ?? "")) || !/^[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(String(input.runAttempt ?? ""))) {
        throw new Error("INVALID_RUN_ID");
      }
      if (typeof input.repository !== "string" || input.repository.toLowerCase() !== "avilaops/erp-next") {
        throw new Error("REPOSITORY_MISMATCH");
      }
      for (const name of ["fiscal-engine", "fiscal-mcp", "api", "web"]) {
        if (input.jobs?.[name]?.result !== "success") throw new Error("REQUIRED_JOB_NOT_SUCCESS:" + name);
      }
    }
    
    export function inspectOpenApi(bytes) {
      if (!bytes.length || bytes.length > TEXT_MAX) throw new Error("INVALID_OPENAPI_SIZE");
      const doc = JSON.parse(bytes.toString("utf8"));
      if (!/^3\.[01]\.\d+$/.test(doc.openapi ?? "") ||
          !doc.info?.title || !doc.paths || Array.isArray(doc.paths) ||
          Object.keys(doc.paths).length === 0) throw new Error("INVALID_OPENAPI");
      function refs(value) {
        if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return;
        if (Object.hasOwn(value, "$ref") && (typeof value.$ref !== "string" || !value.$ref.startsWith("#/"))) {
          throw new Error("EXTERNAL_OPENAPI_REF");
        }
        for (const child of Object.values(value)) refs(child);
      }
      refs(doc);
      return { pathCount: Object.keys(doc.paths).length, sha256: sha256(bytes) };
    }
    
    export function inspectValidation(manifestBytes, pdfBytes, pngBytes) {
      if (manifestBytes.length > 100_000 || pdfBytes.length > TEXT_MAX || pngBytes.length > TEXT_MAX) throw new Error("INVALID_VALIDATION_SIZE");
      const doc = JSON.parse(manifestBytes.toString("utf8"));
      if (!Array.isArray(doc.fields) || doc.fields.length !== 11 || new Set(doc.fields.map(f => f.name)).size !== 11) {
        throw new Error("INVALID_VALIDATION_FIELDS");
      }
      if (!pdfBytes.subarray(0, 5).equals(Buffer.from("%PDF-"))) throw new Error("INVALID_VALIDATION_PDF");
      if (!pngBytes.subarray(0, 8).equals(Buffer.from([137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10]))) throw new Error("INVALID_VALIDATION_PNG");
      if (sha256(pdfBytes) !== doc.sha256) throw new Error("VALIDATION_PDF_HASH_MISMATCH");
      return { fieldCount: 11, manifestSha256: sha256(manifestBytes), pdfSha256: sha256(pdfBytes), pngSha256: sha256(pngBytes) };
    }
    
    export async function evaluateRelease(input, artifactDirectory) {
      validateReleaseInputs(input);
      const evidence = resolve(artifactDirectory);
      const [contract, manifest, pdf, png] = await Promise.all([
        readFile(join(evidence, "contracts", "candidate.json")),
        readFile(join(evidence, "validation", "validation.json")),
        readFile(join(evidence, "validation", "validation.pdf")),
        readFile(join(evidence, "validation", "validation.png")),
      ]);
      return {
        schemaVersion: "avila-mlops-release-evidence/1",
        identity: {
          repository: input.repository, sourceSha: input.sourceSha,
          workflowRunId: String(input.runId), attempt: Number(input.runAttempt),
        },
        jobs: Object.fromEntries(["fiscal-engine", "fiscal-mcp", "api", "web"].map(n => [n, "success"])),
        evidence: { openapi: inspectOpenApi(contract), validation: inspectValidation(manifest, pdf, png) },
        metrics: { aiQuality: null, tokenCostUsd: null, llmLatencyMs: null, regressionsMeasured: null },
        technicalVerdict: "passed",
        humanApproval: "not_evaluated",
        productionSmoke: "not_evaluated",
        note: "Apenas contrato e artefatos produzidos nos jobs reais deste workflow. Não prova deploy nem aprovação humana.",
      };
    }
    
    async function main() {
      const input = {
        repository: process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY,
        sourceSha: process.env.SOURCE_SHA,
        checkoutSha: execFileSync("git", ["rev-parse", "HEAD"], { encoding: "utf8", cwd: root }).trim(),
        ref: process.env.GITHUB_REF,
        runId: process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID,
        runAttempt: process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT,
        jobs: JSON.parse(process.env.NEEDS_JSON ?? "{}"),
      };
      const report = await evaluateRelease(input, process.env.MLOPS_ARTIFACTS_DIR ?? join(root, "artifacts", "mlops-input"));
      const out = join(root, "artifacts", "mlops-release", report.identity.sourceSha);
      await mkdir(out, { recursive: true });
      const data = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2) + "\n");
      await writeFile(join(out, "report.json"), data, { flag: "wx", mode: 0o600 });
      const digest = sha256(data);
      await writeFile(join(out, "report.sha256"), digest + "  report.json\n", { flag: "wx", mode: 0o600 });
      const lines = [
        "### Ávila MLOps · verificação técnica de release",
        `- Commit: \`${report.identity.sourceSha}\``,
        `- Workflow: ${report.identity.workflowRunId} / tentativa ${report.identity.attempt}`,
        `- Contrato OpenAPI: ${report.evidence.openapi.pathCount} caminhos; SHA-256 \`${report.evidence.openapi.sha256}\``,
        `- Template: ${report.evidence.validation.fieldCount} campos; PDF SHA-256 \`${report.evidence.validation.pdfSha256}\``,
        "- Testes prévios: fiscal-engine, API e web bem-sucedidos",
        "- IA/Langfuse e smoke de produção: não avaliados nesta etapa",
        `- Evidência: \`${digest}\` (SHA-256 de report.json)`,
      ];
      if (process.env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY) await writeFile(process.env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, lines.join("\n") + "\n", { flag: "a" });
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ technicalVerdict: report.technicalVerdict, sha: report.identity.sourceSha, reportSha256: digest }));
    }
    
    if (process.argv[1] && fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) === resolve(process.argv[1])) {
      main().catch(error => { console.error("MLOPS_RELEASE_GATE_FAILED", error instanceof Error ? error.message : "unknown"); process.exitCode = 1; });
    }

    name: Auto merge validated PRs

      workflow_run:
        workflows: [CI]
        types: [completed]
    
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    
    concurrency:
      group: erp-auto-merge-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    
    jobs:
      merge-and-release:
        if: >-
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository &&
          github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number != null
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          ATTEMPT: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.run_attempt }}
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
        steps:
          - name: Merge the exact candidate approved by CI and start production release
            shell: bash
            run: |
              set -euo pipefail
              [[ "$PR" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$RUN_ID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$ATTEMPT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
              [[ "$EXPECTED_HEAD" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]]
    
              candidate=$(gh api "repos/$GH_REPO/pulls/$PR")
              if ! jq -e --arg repo "$GH_REPO" --arg head "$EXPECTED_HEAD" '
                .draft == false and .base.ref == "main" and
                .head.repo.full_name == $repo and .head.sha == $head and
                ((.state == "open" and .mergeable == true) or (.state == "closed" and .merged == true))
              ' <<<"$candidate" >/dev/null; then
                echo '::notice::PR is a draft, has changed, or is not an eligible merge candidate.'
                exit 0
              fi
    
              gh api --paginate "repos/$GH_REPO/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/attempts/$ATTEMPT/jobs" \
                --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name == "gate" and .conclusion == "success") | .id' | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' >/dev/null
              # Find the tested synthetic merge even after the PR has been merged.
              artifacts=$(gh api --paginate "repos/$GH_REPO/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/artifacts" \
                --jq '.artifacts[] | select(.expired == false) | .name')
              mapfile -t matches < <(printf '%s\n' "$artifacts" | grep -E "^erp-mlops-ci-[a-f0-9]{40}-$ATTEMPT$")
              [[ "${#matches[@]}" == 1 ]]
              artifact=${matches[0]}
              tested_merge=${artifact#erp-mlops-ci-}
              tested_merge=${tested_merge%-$ATTEMPT}
              if jq -e '.state == "open"' <<<"$candidate" >/dev/null; then
                [[ "$(jq -er '.merge_commit_sha' <<<"$candidate")" == "$tested_merge" ]]
              fi
              evidence=$(mktemp -d)
              trap 'rm -rf "$evidence"' EXIT
              gh run download "$RUN_ID" --name "$artifact" --dir "$evidence"
              jq -e --arg repo "$GH_REPO" --arg head "$EXPECTED_HEAD" --arg tested "$tested_merge" \
                --argjson run "$RUN_ID" --argjson attempt "$ATTEMPT" '
                  .schema == "avila-mlops-ci-attestation/1" and .repository == $repo and
                  .workflow == "CI" and .event == "pull_request" and .sourceSha == $head and
                  .testedSha == $tested and .runId == $run and .runAttempt == $attempt and
                  .ciGate == "passed" and (.validationJobs | length > 0 and all(.[]; . == "success"))
                ' "$evidence/ci-attestation.json" >/dev/null
    
              if jq -e '.state == "open"' <<<"$candidate" >/dev/null; then
                # GitHub still enforces the protected branch rules on this merge.
                result=$(gh api --method PUT "repos/$GH_REPO/pulls/$PR/merge" -f sha="$EXPECTED_HEAD" -f merge_method=merge)
                release_sha=$(jq -er 'select(.merged == true) | .sha | select(test("^[a-f0-9]{40}$"))' <<<"$result")

                # Recover a dispatch failure after a successful merge; never merge again.
                release_sha=$(jq -er '.merge_commit_sha | select(test("^[a-f0-9]{40}$"))' <<<"$candidate")
              fi
              tested_commit=$(gh api "repos/$GH_REPO/git/commits/$tested_merge")
              release_commit=$(gh api "repos/$GH_REPO/git/commits/$release_sha")
              jq -e --arg head "$EXPECTED_HEAD" --argjson tested "$tested_commit" '
                .tree.sha == $tested.tree.sha and (.parents | length) == 2 and
                .parents[1].sha == $head and ($tested.parents | length) == 2 and
                $tested.parents[1].sha == $head

              # Do not publish an older merged PR over a newer main release.
              current_main=$(gh api "repos/$GH_REPO/git/ref/heads/main" --jq '.object.sha')
              if [[ "$current_main" != "$release_sha" ]]; then
                echo '::notice::Main has advanced; skipping release of this older merge.'
                exit 0
              fi
              # A merge by GITHUB_TOKEN does not trigger a separate push workflow.
              gh workflow run production-release.yml --ref main -f source_ref="$release_sha"

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """GitHub Actions CI gate evidence. Records job outcomes, never invents test counts."""
    import hashlib
    import json
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    import re
    import sys
    
    SCHEMA = "avila-mlops-ci-attestation/1"
    SHA = re.compile(r"^[a-f0-9]{40}$")
    
    def attest(jobs, source_sha, repository, run_id, attempt, workflow, event, tested_sha=None):
        if not SHA.fullmatch(source_sha):
            raise ValueError("source_sha must be a full commit SHA")
        if tested_sha is not None and not SHA.fullmatch(tested_sha):
            raise ValueError("tested_sha must be a full commit SHA")
        if not repository.startswith("avilaops/") or "/" not in repository:
            raise ValueError("repository must be in avilaops")
        if not isinstance(jobs, dict) or not jobs:
            raise ValueError("CI dependencies not provided")
        outcomes = {}
        for name, result in sorted(jobs.items()):
            status = result.get("result") if isinstance(result, dict) else None
            if status not in ("success", "failure", "cancelled", "skipped"):
                raise ValueError("Unknown CI dependency outcome")
            outcomes[name] = status
        passed = all(status == "success" for status in outcomes.values())
        payload = {
            "schema": SCHEMA,
            "repository": repository,
            "sourceSha": source_sha,
            "testedSha": tested_sha or source_sha,
            "testTarget": "github-pr-merge-ref" if event == "pull_request" else "source-commit",
            "workflow": workflow,
            "event": event,
            "runId": int(run_id),
            "runAttempt": int(attempt),
            "url": f"https://github.com/{repository}/actions/runs/{run_id}",
            "ciGate": "passed" if passed else "failed",
            "validationJobs": outcomes,
            "testCounts": None,
            "contractVerdict": None,
            "securityVerdict": None,
            "humanApproval": None,
            "deployment": None,
            "postDeployHealth": None,
            "note": "CI job results only; no MLOps, human approval or production-health attestation.",
        }
        payload["evidenceSha256"] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
        return payload
    
    def main():
        data = attest(
            json.loads(os.environ["VALIDATION_JOBS"]),
            os.environ["SOURCE_HEAD_SHA"],

    import hashlib
    import json

    from pathlib import Path
    import re
    import subprocess
    import sys

    from contextlib import contextmanager
    
    
    BASELINE_REPAIR = json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name("baseline-1196d52.json").read_text())
    
    
    @contextmanager
    def baseline_compilation_repair(root, revision):
        """Instrument one non-compiling historical tree; never patch another baseline."""
        if revision != BASELINE_REPAIR["revision"]:
            yield None
            return
        target = root / BASELINE_REPAIR["path"]
        original = target.read_bytes()
        if hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest() != BASELINE_REPAIR["beforeSha256"]:
            raise ValueError("BASELINE_REPAIR_SOURCE_MISMATCH")
        before = BASELINE_REPAIR["original"].encode()
        if original.count(before) != 1:
            raise ValueError("BASELINE_REPAIR_NOT_UNIQUE")
        repaired = original.replace(before, BASELINE_REPAIR["replacement"].encode())
        if hashlib.sha256(repaired).hexdigest() != BASELINE_REPAIR["afterSha256"]:
            raise ValueError("BASELINE_REPAIR_OUTPUT_MISMATCH")
        try:
            target.write_bytes(repaired)
            yield BASELINE_REPAIR
        finally:
            target.write_bytes(original)
    
    
    def run(arguments, cwd, **kwargs):
        return subprocess.run(arguments, cwd=cwd, check=True, **kwargs)
    
    
    def git(root, *arguments):
        return subprocess.check_output(["git", *arguments], cwd=root).decode().strip()

      local status=$?
      trap - EXIT
      printf '%s\n' 'ERP deploy failed; restoring previous release' >&2
      if [[ -f "$previous_release/compose.json" ]]; then
        docker compose --project-name "$APPLICATION" --project-directory "$previous_release" \
          --file "$previous_release/compose.json" up --detach --no-build --remove-orphans --wait --wait-timeout 120 || true

        docker compose --project-name "$APPLICATION" --project-directory "$previous_release" \
          --env-file "$previous_release/.env" --file "$previous_release/compose.yaml" \
          --file "$previous_release/fiscal-compose.yaml" up --detach --no-build --remove-orphans --wait --wait-timeout 120 || true
      fi
      exit "$status"
    }

    ---
    name: dispatching-parallel-agents
    description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
    ---
    
    # Dispatching Parallel Agents
    
    ## Overview
    
    You delegate tasks to specialized agents with isolated context. By precisely crafting their instructions and context, you ensure they stay focused and succeed at their task. They should never inherit your session's context or history — you construct exactly what they need. This also preserves your own context for coordination work.
    
    When you have multiple unrelated failures (different test files, different subsystems, different bugs), investigating them sequentially wastes time. Each investigation is independent and can happen in parallel.
    
    **Core principle:** Dispatch one agent per independent problem domain. Let them work concurrently.
    
    ## When to Use
    
    ```dot
    digraph when_to_use {
        "Multiple failures?" [shape=diamond];
        "Are they independent?" [shape=diamond];
        "Single agent investigates all" [shape=box];
        "One agent per problem domain" [shape=box];
        "Can they work in parallel?" [shape=diamond];
        "Sequential agents" [shape=box];
        "Parallel dispatch" [shape=box];
    
        "Multiple failures?" -> "Are they independent?" [label="yes"];
        "Are they independent?" -> "Single agent investigates all" [label="no - related"];
        "Are they independent?" -> "Can they work in parallel?" [label="yes"];
        "Can they work in parallel?" -> "Parallel dispatch" [label="yes"];
        "Can they work in parallel?" -> "Sequential agents" [label="no - shared state"];
    }
    ```
    
    **Use when:**
    - 3+ test files failing with different root causes
    - Multiple subsystems broken independently
    - Each problem can be understood without context from others
    - No shared state between investigations
    
    **Don't use when:**
    - Failures are related (fix one might fix others)
    - Need to understand full system state
    - Agents would interfere with each other
    
    ## The Pattern
    
    ### 1. Identify Independent Domains
    
    Group failures by what's broken:
    - File A tests: Tool approval flow
    - File B tests: Batch completion behavior
    - File C tests: Abort functionality

            let nfe_production_enabled = parse_legacy_fiscal_flag(

    name: CI
    
    on:
      pull_request:
      workflow_dispatch:
    
    permissions:
      contents: read
    
    concurrency:
      group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    
    env:
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
    
    jobs:
      changes:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 2
        outputs:
          web: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.web }}
          api: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.api }}
          fiscal: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.fiscal }}
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              fetch-depth: 0
          - run: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p 'test_*.py'
          - id: scope
            env:
              BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || format('{0}^', github.sha) }}
            run: python3 -B scripts/ci/pr-gate.py plan
    
      web:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.web == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
            with:
              version: 11.11.0
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
              cache: pnpm
              cache-dependency-path: pnpm-lock.yaml
          - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline
          - run: pnpm --filter web lint
          - run: node --import ./tests/helpers/register-typescript.mjs --test tests/*-model.node.mjs
            working-directory: apps/web
    
      api:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.api == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 20
        services:
          postgres:
            image: postgres:18-alpine
            env:
              POSTGRES_DB: erp_next_test
              POSTGRES_USER: postgres
              POSTGRES_PASSWORD: erp_next_ci_only
            ports:
              - 5432:5432
            options: >-
              --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d erp_next_test"
              --health-interval 2s
              --health-timeout 3s
              --health-retries 20
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:erp_next_ci_only@127.0.0.1:5432/erp_next_test
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.1
            with:
              components: rustfmt
          - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
            with:
              shared-key: pr-api
          - run: cargo fmt --all --check
          - run: cargo test --workspace --locked
    
      fiscal:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.fiscal == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
              cache: npm
              cache-dependency-path: apps/fiscal-engine/package-lock.json
          - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
          - run: npm test
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
    
      gate:
        needs: [changes, web, api, fiscal]
        if: always()
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 2
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - name: Validate selected checks and record explicit skips
            env:
              SOURCE_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
              VALIDATION_JOBS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
            run: python3 -B scripts/ci/pr-gate.py gate artifacts/mlops/ci-attestation.json
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            if: always()
            with:
              name: erp-mlops-ci-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
              path: artifacts/mlops/ci-attestation.json
              if-no-files-found: error
              retention-days: 14

    # ERP Next em produção
    
    ## CI e publicação
    
    O workflow `CI` valida PRs pelo escopo alterado: lint e testes de modelo da web,
    formatação e testes Rust com PostgreSQL para API/migrations e testes npm do motor
    fiscal. O check obrigatório continua sendo `gate`; skips só são aceitos quando o
    planejador exclui explicitamente o componente, e o artefato registra esse escopo.

    segunda execução de CI no push para `main`.

    a evidência do PR e não inicia publicação. Deploy e migrations seguem o procedimento
    direto no servidor; `Production release` permanece disponível apenas manualmente.
    
    Imagens são construídas somente pelo GitHub CI, pelo workflow
    `production-release.yml`, com `source_ref` fixado no commit completo,
    depois das verificações de cada componente. PRs não reempacotam imagens.
