    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """Plan bounded PR checks and attest their exact outcomes; fail closed."""
    import hashlib
    import json
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    import re
    import subprocess
    import sys
    
    DOMAINS = ("web", "api", "fiscal")
    
    
    def plan(paths):
        scope = dict.fromkeys(DOMAINS, False)
        for path in paths:
            if path.startswith(("docs/", "context/")) or path.endswith(".md"):
                continue
            if path.startswith(("apps/web/", "packages/")):
                scope["web"] = True
            elif path.startswith(("apps/api/", "migrations/", "queries/")) or path in (
                "Cargo.toml", "Cargo.lock", "rust-toolchain.toml"
            ):
                scope["api"] = True
            elif path.startswith(("apps/fiscal-engine/", "scripts/fiscal/", "integrations/fiscal/")):
                scope["fiscal"] = True
            else:
                # Unknown/new infrastructure must not silently bypass validation.
                scope = dict.fromkeys(DOMAINS, True)
        return scope
    
    
    def verdict(jobs):
        if not isinstance(jobs, dict) or set(jobs) != {"changes", *DOMAINS}:
            raise ValueError("Missing or unexpected validation jobs")
        changes = jobs["changes"]
        outputs = changes.get("outputs", {})
        if set(outputs) != set(DOMAINS) or any(value not in ("true", "false") for value in outputs.values()):
            raise ValueError("Missing or invalid scope")
        scope = {key: outputs[key] == "true" for key in DOMAINS}
        outcomes = {key: value["result"] for key, value in jobs.items()}
        passed = changes["result"] == "success" and all(
            outcomes[key] == ("success" if scope[key] else "skipped") for key in DOMAINS
        )
        return passed, scope, outcomes
    
    
    def attest(jobs, env):
        passed, scope, outcomes = verdict(jobs)
        for key in ("SOURCE_HEAD_SHA", "GITHUB_SHA"):
            if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{40}", env[key]):
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid {key}")
        data = {
            "schema": "avila-mlops-ci-attestation/2",
            "repository": env["GITHUB_REPOSITORY"],
            "sourceSha": env["SOURCE_HEAD_SHA"],
            "testedSha": env["GITHUB_SHA"],
            "workflow": env["GITHUB_WORKFLOW"],
            "event": env["GITHUB_EVENT_NAME"],
            "runId": int(env["GITHUB_RUN_ID"]),
            "runAttempt": int(env["GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"]),
            "ciGate": "passed" if passed else "failed",
            "validationScope": scope,
            "validationJobs": outcomes,
            "note": "Scoped PR checks only; skipped domains were not tested. No production or full regression attestation.",
        }
        data["evidenceSha256"] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
        return data
    
    
    def main():
        if sys.argv[1] == "plan":
            paths = subprocess.check_output([
                "git", "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames", "-z", os.environ["BASE_SHA"], "HEAD"
            ]).decode().split("\0")
            scope = plan([path for path in paths if path])
            with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
                for domain, selected in scope.items():
                    output.write(f"{domain}={str(selected).lower()}\n")
            print(json.dumps(scope, sort_keys=True))
        elif sys.argv[1] == "gate":
            data = attest(json.loads(os.environ["VALIDATION_JOBS"]), os.environ)
            target = Path(sys.argv[2])
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            print(data["ciGate"], json.dumps(data["validationJobs"], sort_keys=True))
            return 0 if data["ciGate"] == "passed" else 1
        else:
            raise ValueError("Expected plan or gate")
        return 0
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())

          s=v.replace('\\','/')
          return '/app'+s[len(workspace):] if s.startswith(workspace) else v
         if isinstance(v,list): return [rebase(x) for x in v]

        with tarfile.open('artifacts/erp-profile-web-1ce712b.tar.gz','w:gz',compresslevel=1) as tar:
         def add_bytes(name,data):

         add_bytes('apps/web/server.js',('\n'.join(lines)+'\n').encode())

    import importlib.util
    import itertools
    from pathlib import Path
    import unittest
    
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("pr_gate", Path(__file__).with_name("pr-gate.py"))
    gate = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(gate)
    
    
    class ScopeTests(unittest.TestCase):
        def test_frontend_does_not_rebuild_api(self):
            self.assertEqual(gate.plan(["apps/web/src/page.tsx"]), {"web": True, "api": False, "fiscal": False})
    
        def test_migrations_and_rust_select_api(self):
            for path in ("migrations/123.sql", "apps/api/src/main.rs", "Cargo.lock", "queries/users.sql"):
                with self.subTest(path=path):
                    self.assertEqual(gate.plan([path]), {"web": False, "api": True, "fiscal": False})
    
        def test_fiscal_and_shared_packages(self):
            self.assertEqual(gate.plan(["apps/fiscal-engine/src/main.ts", "packages/shared/test.ts"]),
                             {"web": True, "api": False, "fiscal": True})
    
        def test_unknown_and_ci_paths_require_all(self):
            for path in (".github/workflows/ci.yml", "scripts/ci/pr-gate.py", "new-service/main.py", "pnpm-lock.yaml"):
                self.assertTrue(all(gate.plan([path]).values()), path)
    
        def test_documentation_only_and_empty_diff(self):
            self.assertFalse(any(gate.plan(["docs/design.json", "README.md"]).values()))
            self.assertFalse(any(gate.plan([]).values()))
    
        def test_runtime_markdown_selects_own_domain(self):
            for path, selected in (("apps/web/prompts/runtime.md", "web"), ("apps/api/prompts/runtime.md", "api")):
                self.assertEqual(gate.plan([path]), {domain: domain == selected for domain in gate.DOMAINS})
    
        def test_python_mcp_selects_fiscal(self):
            self.assertEqual(gate.plan(["apps/fiscal-mcp/src/server.py"]), {"web": False, "api": False, "fiscal": True})
    
    
    class GateTests(unittest.TestCase):
        def jobs(self):
            return {"changes": {"result": "success", "outputs": {"web": "true", "api": "false", "fiscal": "false"}},
                    "web": {"result": "success"}, "api": {"result": "skipped"}, "fiscal": {"result": "skipped"}}
    
        def test_explicit_unselected_skips_pass(self):
            self.assertTrue(gate.verdict(self.jobs())[0])
    
        def test_all_scope_and_outcome_combinations(self):
            # Every failure/cancellation must fail, including nonselected jobs.
            for selected in itertools.product((False, True), repeat=3):
                for statuses in itertools.product(("success", "failure", "cancelled", "skipped"), repeat=4):
                    jobs = {"changes": {"result": statuses[0], "outputs": dict(zip(
                        gate.DOMAINS, (str(value).lower() for value in selected)))}}
                    jobs.update({name: {"result": result} for name, result in zip(gate.DOMAINS, statuses[1:])})
                    expected = statuses[0] == "success" and all(
                        result == ("success" if required else "skipped")
                        for required, result in zip(selected, statuses[1:]))
                    self.assertEqual(gate.verdict(jobs)[0], expected, (selected, statuses))
    
        def test_every_selected_failure_cancellation_or_skip_fails(self):
            for job in ("changes", "web"):
                for result in ("failure", "cancelled", "skipped"):
                    jobs = self.jobs()
                    jobs[job]["result"] = result
                    self.assertFalse(gate.verdict(jobs)[0], (job, result))
    
        def test_unselected_failures_cannot_be_hidden(self):
            for result in ("success", "failure", "cancelled"):
                jobs = self.jobs()
                jobs["api"]["result"] = result
                self.assertFalse(gate.verdict(jobs)[0], result)
    
        def test_missing_extra_or_invalid_scope_fails_closed(self):
            for mutation in (
                lambda jobs: jobs.pop("web"),
                lambda jobs: jobs.update(extra={"result": "success"}),
                lambda jobs: jobs["changes"].update(outputs={}),
                lambda jobs: jobs["changes"]["outputs"].update(api="maybe"),
            ):
                jobs = self.jobs()
                mutation(jobs)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    gate.verdict(jobs)
    
        def test_attestation_keeps_skipped_evidence_and_commit_identity(self):
            env = {"SOURCE_HEAD_SHA": "a" * 40, "GITHUB_SHA": "b" * 40,
                   "GITHUB_REPOSITORY": "avilaops/erp-next", "GITHUB_WORKFLOW": "CI",
                   "GITHUB_EVENT_NAME": "pull_request", "GITHUB_RUN_ID": "10", "GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT": "2"}
            evidence = gate.attest(self.jobs(), env)
            self.assertEqual(evidence["ciGate"], "passed")
            self.assertEqual(evidence["validationJobs"]["api"], "skipped")
            self.assertFalse(evidence["validationScope"]["api"])
            self.assertEqual(evidence["sourceSha"], "a" * 40)
            self.assertEqual(evidence["testedSha"], "b" * 40)
            jobs = self.jobs()
            jobs["web"]["result"] = "failure"
            self.assertEqual(gate.attest(jobs, env)["ciGate"], "failed")
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":

        inputs:

            description: Capture the exact version currently served by ERP and request independent confirmation

            default: false
    
    permissions:

      group: erp-context-synchronization
      cancel-in-progress: false
    
    jobs:

        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
          - name: Select code capture or the exact served release
            id: source
            env:
              CONFIRM_PRODUCTION: ${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' || inputs.confirm_production == true }}
            run: |
              node --input-type=module <<'JS'
              import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
              import { appendFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
              if (process.env.CONFIRM_PRODUCTION === 'true') {
                const response = await fetch('https://erp.avilaops.com/api/health', { redirect: 'error', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000) });
                const health = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok || health.ok !== true || health.application !== 'erp-next' || !/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(health.commit)) throw new Error('Served ERP version unavailable');
                execFileSync('git', ['fetch', '--depth=1', 'origin', health.commit], { stdio: 'inherit' });
                execFileSync('git', ['checkout', '--detach', health.commit], { stdio: 'inherit' });
              }
              const supported = existsSync('verification/product-context-publish.mjs');
              appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, `supported=${supported}\n`);
              if (!supported) console.log('::notice::The served release predates context publishing; no context or publication observation was fabricated.');
              JS

            if: steps.source.outputs.supported == 'true'

    /* Shared workspace geometry. Public pages retain their own art direction. */
    /* Scope typography to authenticated pages, including menus rendered in portals. */
    body:has(.erp-workspace) {
      --workspace-font-title: 18px;
      --workspace-font-body: 14px;
      --workspace-font-auxiliary: 12px;
      --text-xs: var(--workspace-font-auxiliary);
      --text-xs--line-height: 18px;
      --text-sm: var(--workspace-font-body);
      --text-sm--line-height: 22px;
      --text-base: var(--workspace-font-body);
      --text-base--line-height: 22px;
      --text-lg: var(--workspace-font-title);
      --text-lg--line-height: 26px;
      --text-xl: var(--workspace-font-title);
      --text-xl--line-height: 26px;
      --text-2xl: var(--workspace-font-title);
      --text-2xl--line-height: 26px;
      --text-3xl: var(--workspace-font-title);
      --text-3xl--line-height: 26px;
      --text-4xl: var(--workspace-font-title);
      --text-4xl--line-height: 26px;
      --font-weight-bold: 600;
      font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: var(--workspace-font-body);
      line-height: 22px;
    }
    .workspace-page-title { font-size: clamp(24px, 2.4vw, 32px); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
    .workspace-pagination { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding-block: 16px; }
    .workspace-resource-state { margin-block: 24px; padding: 24px; }
    .erp-content {
      --workspace-control-height: 44px;
      --workspace-control-radius: 8px;
      font-size: var(--workspace-font-body);
      line-height: 22px;
    }
    
    .erp-content :is(h1, h2), .erp-content .workspace-page-title { font-size: var(--workspace-font-title); font-weight: 600; line-height: 26px; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
    .erp-content h3 { font-size: var(--workspace-font-body); font-weight: 600; line-height: 22px; letter-spacing: normal; }
    .erp-content :is(strong, b) { font-weight: 600; }
    .erp-content :is(small, [role=status]) { font-size: var(--workspace-font-auxiliary); line-height: 18px; }
    .erp-content :where(.form-section) { box-shadow: none; }
    .erp-content :where(.form-grid) { gap: 20px; }
    .erp-content :where(.field) { gap: 8px; font-weight: 500; }
    .erp-content :where(input:not([type=checkbox], [type=radio], [type=range], [type=color], [type=file], [type=hidden]), select, textarea) {
      min-height: var(--workspace-control-height);
      border-radius: var(--workspace-control-radius);
      border-color: var(--input);
      background-color: var(--background);
      color: var(--foreground);
      box-shadow: none;
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .erp-content :where(textarea) { min-height: 104px; padding: 12px; }
    .erp-content [data-slot=button][data-size=default] { min-height: var(--workspace-control-height); font-size: 14px; }
    .erp-content :where(input, select, textarea):disabled { cursor: not-allowed; background-color: var(--muted); color: var(--muted-foreground); }
    .erp-content :where(input, select, textarea)[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: var(--destructive); }
    .erp-content :where(table) { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .erp-content :where(thead) { background: var(--muted); color: var(--muted-foreground); }
    .erp-content :where(th) { padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; }
    .erp-content tbody th[scope=row] { font-size: var(--workspace-font-body); font-weight: 500; }
    .erp-content :where(td) { padding: 14px 16px; }
    .erp-content :where(tbody tr) { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .erp-content :where(tbody tr:last-child) { border-bottom: 0; }
    .erp-content :where(tbody tr:hover) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 65%, transparent); }
    .erp-content :where(th, td) { vertical-align: middle; }
    .erp-content :where([role=tablist], .erp-section-nav) {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 4px;
      padding: 4px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      .form-actions {
        @apply sticky bottom-4 z-30 flex min-h-14 flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background/95 p-3 shadow-sm backdrop-blur-xl;
      }
    
      .field {
        @apply grid gap-2 text-sm font-medium;

      .field input,

      .field textarea {
        @apply min-h-11 w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm font-normal text-foreground shadow-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground;
      }
    
      .field.span-2 {
        @apply md:col-span-2;

      .check-card {
        @apply inline-flex min-h-10 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition has-[:checked]:border-primary/40 has-[:checked]:bg-primary/10 has-[:checked]:text-foreground;

    export function ColorChoice({ label, options = [], value, onChange, catalog }: { label: string; options?: string[]; value: string; onChange: (value: string) => void; catalog?: { productId: string; tenantId: string; field: "structureColors" | "upholsteryColors" | "plateHolderColors" | "plateHolderTypes" } }) {
      const id = useId()
      const [refreshed, setRefreshed] = useState<string[] | null>(null)
      const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const choices = refreshed ?? options
      async function refresh() {
        if (!catalog || loading) return
        setLoading(true); setError("")
        try {
          const response = await erpFetch(`/api/erp/products/${catalog.productId}`, { cache: "no-store" })
          const product = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok || product.tenantId !== catalog.tenantId) throw new Error("Não foi possível atualizar as opções deste produto.")
          const colors = product.data[catalog.field] || []
          setRefreshed(colors)
          if (!colors.length) setError("Ainda não há opções cadastradas. Salve as cores no produto e atualize novamente.")
        } catch (reason) { setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Falha ao consultar opções.") }
        finally { setLoading(false) }
      }
      return <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-2 text-sm">
        <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
        <select id={id} className="min-h-10 w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3" value={value} required={choices.length > 0} disabled={loading || !choices.length && !value} onChange={event => onChange(event.target.value)}>
          <option value="">{choices.length ? "Escolha uma cor" : "Sem opções cadastradas"}</option>
          {value && !choices.includes(value) && <option value={value}>{value} · seleção registrada</option>}
          {choices.map(color => <option key={color} value={color}>{color}</option>)}
        </select>
        {catalog && !choices.length && <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <Link className={linkClass} href={`/cadastros/produtos/${catalog.productId}/editar#product-colors`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label={`Cadastrar opções de ${label} (nova aba)`}>Cadastrar opções</Link>
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={loading} aria-label={`Atualizar opções de ${label}`} onClick={() => void refresh()}>{loading ? "Atualizando…" : "Atualizar opções"}</Button>
        </div>}
        {error && <p role="alert">{error}</p>}
      </div>
    }

    pub(super) struct PreparedQuote {
        pub line: String,
        pub quote: Quote,
        pub digest: String,
        pub product: Value,
        pub version: i64,
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn prepare(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        code: &str,
        input: &QuoteInput,
    ) -> Result<PreparedQuote, DomainError> {
        line(code)?;
        let row: Option<(i64, Value, Value, Value, i64)> = sqlx::query_as("SELECT v.version,v.policy_snapshot,i.product_snapshot,i.cost_snapshot,i.price_without_ipi_cents FROM price_table_versions v JOIN price_table_items i ON i.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND i.version_id=v.id JOIN products p ON p.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND p.id=i.product_id WHERE v.tenant_id=$1 AND v.id=$2 AND v.product_line=$3 AND i.product_id=$4 AND p.status='active' AND p.unit=i.product_snapshot->>'unit'")
            .bind(tenant).bind(input.version_id).bind(code).bind(input.product_id).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        let (version, policy, product, cost, price) = row.ok_or(DomainError::NotFound)?;
        let params: CommercialParameters = serde_json::from_value(policy)
            .map_err(|_| DomainError::Conflict("Política publicada incompatível"))?;
        let cost: PublishedCost = serde_json::from_value(cost)
            .map_err(|_| DomainError::Conflict("Custo publicado incompatível"))?;
        let quote = super::pricing_model::quote(input, price, &cost, &params)?;
        let raw = json!({"tenantId":tenant,"line":code,"input":input,"calculator":CALCULATOR,"sale":quote.sale,"director":quote.director});
        let digest = format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(raw.to_string().as_bytes()));
        Ok(PreparedQuote {
            line: code.into(),
            quote,
            digest,
            product,
            version,
        })
    }
    
    pub(super) fn redact(
        prepared: PreparedQuote,
        input: &QuoteInput,
        director: bool,
        tenant: Uuid,
    ) -> Value {
        let mut result = json!({"tenantId":tenant,"line":prepared.line,"versionId":input.version_id,"version":prepared.version,"product":prepared.product,"input":input,"digest":prepared.digest,"sale":prepared.quote.sale});
        if director {
            result["director"] = json!(prepared.quote.director);
        }
        result
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn sees_costs(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        subject: &str,
    ) -> Result<bool, DomainError> {
        let rights = access::load_access(tx, tenant, subject).await?;
        Ok(access::require_permission(&rights, DIRECTOR).is_ok())
    }

    // Keep the full rational until the final cent. Round upwards to preserve the
    // managerial margin at the configured free discount; never use f64 for money.
    fn calculate(
        p: &CommercialParameters,
        costs_bps: u32,
        cost: &CostRow,
    ) -> Result<(i64, i64), DomainError> {
        let retained = i128::from(10_000 - p.income_tax_bps);
        let share = (10_000 - i128::from(costs_bps)) * retained - i128::from(p.net_margin_bps) * 10_000;
        let adjusted = i128::from(cost.purchase_cost_cents)
            * i128::from(10_000 - cost.tax_credit_bps)
            * i128::from(10_000 + p.cost_safety_bps)
            + i128::from(cost.packaging_cents) * 100_000_000;
        let denominator = share * i128::from(10_000 - p.free_discount_bps);
        if denominator <= 0 || adjusted <= 0 {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "O custo ajustado e a margem disponível devem ser positivos para publicar",
            ));
        }
        let base = (adjusted * retained + denominator - 1) / denominator;
        let total = (base * i128::from(10_000 + p.ipi_bps) + 9_999) / 10_000;
        if total > 1_000_000_000_000 || base > 1_000_000_000_000 {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Preço calculado ultrapassa o limite de R$ 10 bilhões",
            ));
        }
        Ok((base as i64, total as i64))
    }

    async fn prepare(

        if !matches!(input.line.as_str(), "imported" | "national") {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Linha comercial inválida"));
        }
        let (version, saved_revision, current_revision, policy): (i64, i64, i64, Value) = sqlx::query_as("SELECT v.version,v.settings_revision,s.revision,v.policy_snapshot FROM commercial_settings s JOIN price_table_versions v ON v.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND v.id=s.active_price_version_id WHERE s.tenant_id=$1 AND s.product_line=$2 AND v.id=$3")
            .bind(tenant).bind(&input.line).bind(input.version_id).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?.ok_or(DomainError::StaleRevision)?;
        if saved_revision != current_revision {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "Parâmetros alterados após a publicação. Publique a tabela atualizada antes de simular",
            ));
        }
        let parameters: CommercialParameters =
            serde_json::from_value(policy.clone()).map_err(|_| access::AccessError::Internal)?;
        let (rules_revision, rules) = rules(tx, tenant).await?;
        if input.items.is_empty() || input.items.len() > 100 {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Simulação exige de 1 a 100 equipamentos",
            ));
        }

    CREATE FUNCTION validate_price_item_source() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
    DECLARE kind text;
    BEGIN
        SELECT source_kind INTO kind FROM price_table_versions
        WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.version_id;
        IF NEW.cost_revision IS NULL AND kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'legacy' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only legacy price snapshots may omit a current cost revision';
        END IF;
        IF kind = 'legacy' AND (
            NEW.cost_revision IS NOT NULL
            OR NEW.source_snapshot->>'source' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ludus.avilaops.com'
            OR NOT (NEW.source_snapshot ?& ARRAY['advisory_cost','tax_credit','packaging','product_id','version'])
            OR NOT (NEW.cost_snapshot ?& ARRAY['purchaseCostCents','taxCreditBps','packagingCents'])
            OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.cost_snapshot->'purchaseCostCents') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
            OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.cost_snapshot->'taxCreditBps') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
            OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.cost_snapshot->'packagingCents') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
            OR (NEW.cost_snapshot->>'purchaseCostCents')::bigint < 0
            OR (NEW.cost_snapshot->>'packagingCents')::bigint < 0
            OR (NEW.cost_snapshot->>'taxCreditBps')::integer NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Legacy publication requires an attributable frozen cost snapshot';
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
    END;
    $$;

        FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_price_item_source();

    -- Legacy publications preserve frozen costs without inventing current cost revisions.
    ALTER TABLE price_table_versions
        ADD COLUMN source_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'calculated'
            CHECK (source_kind IN ('calculated', 'legacy')),
        ADD COLUMN source_reference jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
            CHECK (jsonb_typeof(source_reference) = 'object');
    ALTER TABLE price_table_versions ADD CONSTRAINT legacy_price_source_required
        CHECK (source_kind <> 'legacy' OR COALESCE(
            (jsonb_typeof(source_reference->'source') = 'string'
             AND length(btrim(source_reference->>'source')) > 0
             AND source_reference ? 'version' AND source_reference ? 'historicalVersionId'), false));
    ALTER TABLE price_table_items ALTER COLUMN cost_revision DROP NOT NULL;
    ALTER TABLE price_table_items ADD COLUMN source_snapshot jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
        CHECK (jsonb_typeof(source_snapshot) = 'object');
    
    CREATE FUNCTION validate_price_item_source() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
    DECLARE kind text; source_name text;
    BEGIN
        SELECT source_kind,source_reference->>'source' INTO kind,source_name FROM price_table_versions
        WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.version_id;
        IF NEW.cost_revision IS NULL AND kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'legacy' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only legacy price snapshots may omit a current cost revision';
        END IF;
        IF kind = 'legacy' AND (
            NEW.cost_revision IS NOT NULL
            OR NEW.source_snapshot->>'source' IS DISTINCT FROM source_name
            OR NOT (NEW.source_snapshot ?& ARRAY['advisory_cost','tax_credit','packaging','product_id','version'])
            OR NOT (NEW.cost_snapshot ?& ARRAY['purchaseCostCents','taxCreditBps','packagingCents'])
            OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.cost_snapshot->'purchaseCostCents') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
            OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.cost_snapshot->'taxCreditBps') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
            OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.cost_snapshot->'packagingCents') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
            OR (NEW.cost_snapshot->>'purchaseCostCents')::bigint < 0
            OR (NEW.cost_snapshot->>'packagingCents')::bigint < 0
            OR (NEW.cost_snapshot->>'taxCreditBps')::integer NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Legacy publication requires an attributable frozen cost snapshot';
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
    END;
    $$;
    CREATE TRIGGER price_item_source_guard BEFORE INSERT ON price_table_items
        FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_price_item_source();

    import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
    import { useRouter } from "next/navigation"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { useCommand } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    import { ColorChoice, Lookup, type Choice } from "@/features/sales/orders"
    import type { Equipment, Simulation } from "./simulator-model"
    
    export function SimulationOrder({ value, equipment, line, onLocked }: {
      value: Simulation; equipment: Equipment; line: string; onLocked: (locked: boolean) => void
    }) {
      const command = useCommand()
      const router = useRouter()
      const [customer, setCustomer] = useState<Choice | null>(null)
      const [dueDate, setDueDate] = useState("")
      const [structure, setStructure] = useState("")
      const [upholstery, setUpholstery] = useState("")
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const frozen = command.busy || command.uncertain
      useEffect(() => { onLocked(frozen) }, [frozen, onLocked])
      return <section className="form-section min-w-0 space-y-4" aria-label="Criar pedido da simulação">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">Criar pedido</h2><p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">O rascunho preserva a versão, os preços e as condições desta simulação.</p>
        <Lookup endpoint="parties" label="cliente" disabled={frozen} searchOnly choose={setCustomer} selectedName={customer?.legalName} />
        <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={async event => {
          event.preventDefault()
          if (!customer || command.busy) return
          setError("")
          const result = await command.send<{ tenantId: string; id: string; status: string }>(`/api/erp/sales-simulator/${line}/orders`, value.tenantId, {
            quote: value.input, digest: value.digest, customerId: customer.id, dueDate,
            structureColor: structure || null, upholsteryColor: upholstery || null,
          })
          if (result?.tenantId === value.tenantId && result.status === "draft" && /^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/.test(result.id)) router.replace(`/vendas/pedidos/${result.id}`)
          else if (result) setError("Confirmação divergente. Consulte os pedidos antes de repetir.")
        }}>
          <fieldset disabled={frozen} className="space-y-4">
            <label className="grid gap-2">Vencimento<Input required type="date" value={dueDate} onChange={event => setDueDate(event.target.value)} /></label>
            <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2"><ColorChoice label="Cor da estrutura" options={equipment.structureColors} value={structure} onChange={setStructure} /><ColorChoice label="Cor do estofado" options={equipment.upholsteryColors} value={upholstery} onChange={setUpholstery} /></div>
          </fieldset>
          {(error || command.error) && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={error || command.error} status={error ? undefined : command.status} /></p>}
          {command.stale && <p>Refaça a simulação antes de criar outro pedido.</p>}
          {command.uncertain && <p role="status">Resultado pendente. A repetição confere o mesmo comando.</p>}
          <Button type="submit" disabled={!customer || command.busy || command.stale || !!error}>{command.busy ? "Confirmando…" : command.uncertain ? "Conferir criação do pedido" : "Criar rascunho com estas condições"}</Button>
        </form>
      </section>
    }

    "use client"
    
    import { useState } from "react"
    import Link from "next/link"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { useCommand, useResource } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    import { useNavigationGuard } from "@/components/shell/navigation-guard"
    
    type Item = { productId: string; sku: string; name: string; priceWithoutIpiCents: number; ipiBps: number; priceWithIpiCents: number }
    type Preview = { tenantId: string; line: string; revision: number; digest: string; items: Item[] }
    type Current = { tenantId: string; line: string; data: { version: number; publishedAt: string; items: Item[] } | null }
    const money = (cents: number) => (cents / 100).toLocaleString("pt-BR", { style: "currency", currency: "BRL" })
    
    export function PriceTables() {
      const [line, setLine] = useState<"imported" | "national">("imported")
      const [locked, setLocked] = useState(false)
      return <main className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-5 px-4 pb-24 pt-6">
    
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3"><Link href="/vendas/simulador" className="text-primary underline">Simular negociação</Link><Link href="/preferencias/comercial" className="text-primary underline">Parâmetros comerciais</Link><Link href="/preferencias/despesas-fixas" className="text-primary underline">Despesas fixas</Link></div>
        <label className="grid max-w-xs gap-1">Linha comercial<select disabled={locked} className="min-h-10 rounded-lg border bg-background px-2" value={line} onChange={e => setLine(e.target.value as typeof line)}><option value="imported">Importada</option><option value="national">Nacional</option></select></label>
        <Publication key={line} line={line} onLocked={setLocked} />
      </main>
    }
    
    function Publication({ line, onLocked }: { line: "imported" | "national"; onLocked: (value: boolean) => void }) {
      const current = useResource<Current>(`/api/erp/price-tables/${line}`)
      const command = useCommand()
      const [preview, setPreview] = useState<Preview | null>(null)
      const [preparing, setPreparing] = useState(false)
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const [notice, setNotice] = useState("")
      useNavigationGuard(command.busy || command.uncertain ? "A publicação ainda não foi confirmada. Sair?" : null)
      async function prepare() {
        if (!current.value || preparing || command.busy || command.uncertain) return
        onLocked(true); setPreparing(true); setPreview(null); setError(""); setNotice(""); command.reset()
        try {
          const response = await fetch(`/api/erp/price-tables/${line}/preview`, { cache: "no-store" })
          const result = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) throw Error(result.title || "Não foi possível preparar a tabela.")
          if (result.tenantId !== current.value.tenantId || result.line !== line || response.headers.get("etag") !== `"${result.revision}"` || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(result.digest) || !Array.isArray(result.items) || !result.items.length) throw Error("Prévia incompleta. Recarregue antes de publicar.")
          setPreview(result)
        } catch (reason) { setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Prévia indisponível.") }
        finally { setPreparing(false); onLocked(false) }
      }
      async function publish() {
        if (!preview || !current.value || command.busy) return
        onLocked(true)
        const result = await command.send<{ tenantId: string; line: string; status: string; version: number }>(`/api/erp/price-tables/${line}/publish`, current.value.tenantId, { digest: preview.digest }, `"${preview.revision}"`)
        if (result?.tenantId === current.value.tenantId && result.line === line && result.status === "published") {
          setNotice(`Versão ${result.version} publicada.`); setPreview(null); current.reload(); onLocked(false)
        } else if (result) { setError("Resposta divergente. Confira a versão publicada."); onLocked(false) }
      }
      return <div className="space-y-5">
        <p>Publicar cria uma versão da tabela com os custos dos produtos ativos e os parâmetros salvos. Produtos e pedidos existentes mantêm os preços cadastrados.</p>
        <Button variant="outline" disabled={!current.value || preparing || command.busy || command.uncertain} onClick={prepare}>{preparing ? "Preparando…" : "Preparar prévia"}</Button>
        {preview && <section className="form-section space-y-3"><h2 className="font-semibold">Conferência antes de publicar</h2><p>{preview.items.length} produtos · revisão {preview.revision}</p><Prices items={preview.items} /><Button disabled={command.busy || command.stale} onClick={publish}>{command.uncertain ? "Repetir confirmação" : "Confirmar publicação"}</Button></section>}
        {notice && <p role="status">{notice}</p>}{(error || command.error) && <p role="alert">{error || command.error}</p>}
        {command.stale && <p>Os dados mudaram. Prepare nova prévia e confira os valores.</p>}
        <section className="form-section space-y-3"><h2 className="font-semibold">Versão publicada</h2>{current.loading ? <p role="status">Carregando…</p> : current.error ? <p role="alert"><RequestError message={current.error} status={current.status} /></p> : current.value?.data ? <><p>Versão {current.value.data.version} · {new Date(current.value.data.publishedAt).toLocaleString("pt-BR")}</p><Prices items={current.value.data.items} /></> : <p>Nenhuma versão publicada nesta linha.</p>}</section>
      </div>
    }
    
    function Prices({ items }: { items: Item[] }) {
      return <ul className="space-y-2">{items.map(item => <li key={item.productId} className="rounded-lg border p-3"><strong>{item.sku} · {item.name}</strong><div>Sem IPI: {money(item.priceWithoutIpiCents)} · Com IPI: {money(item.priceWithIpiCents)}</div></li>)}</ul>
    }

    ## The Rule
    
    **Invoke relevant or requested skills BEFORE any response or action** — including clarifying questions, exploring the codebase, or checking files. If it turns out wrong for the situation, you don't have to use it.
    
    **Before entering plan mode:** if you haven't already brainstormed, invoke the brainstorming skill first.
    
    Then announce "Using [skill] to [purpose]" and follow the skill exactly. If it has a checklist, create a todo per item.
    
    ## Skill Priority
    
    When multiple skills apply, process skills come first — they set the approach, then implementation skills (frontend-design, etc.) carry it out. Brainstorming and systematic-debugging are Superpowers' most common process skills, but the rule holds for any of them.
    
    - "Let's build X" → superpowers:brainstorming first, then implementation skills.
    - "Fix this bug" → superpowers:systematic-debugging first, then domain skills.
    
    ## Red Flags
    
    These thoughts mean STOP—you're rationalizing:
    
    | Thought | Reality |
    |---------|---------|
    | "This is just a simple question" | Questions are tasks. Check for skills. |
    | "I need more context first" | Skill check comes BEFORE clarifying questions. |
    | "Let me explore the codebase first" | Skills tell you HOW to explore. Check first. |
    | "I can check git/files quickly" | Files lack conversation context. Check for skills. |
    | "Let me gather information first" | Skills tell you HOW to gather information. |
    | "This doesn't need a formal skill" | If a skill exists, use it. |
    | "I remember this skill" | Skills evolve. Read current version. |
    | "This doesn't count as a task" | Action = task. Check for skills. |
    | "The skill is overkill" | Simple things become complex. Use it. |
    | "I'll just do this one thing first" | Check BEFORE doing anything. |
    | "This feels productive" | Undisciplined action wastes time. Skills prevent this. |
    | "I know what that means" | Knowing the concept ≠ using the skill. Invoke it. |

    -- Legacy publications preserve frozen costs without inventing current cost revisions.
    ALTER TABLE price_table_versions
        ADD COLUMN source_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'calculated'
            CHECK (source_kind IN ('calculated', 'legacy')),
        ADD COLUMN source_reference jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
            CHECK (jsonb_typeof(source_reference) = 'object');
    ALTER TABLE price_table_versions ADD CONSTRAINT legacy_price_source_required
        CHECK (source_kind <> 'legacy' OR COALESCE(
            (jsonb_typeof(source_reference->'source') = 'string'
             AND length(btrim(source_reference->>'source')) > 0
             AND source_reference ? 'version' AND source_reference ? 'historicalVersionId'), false));
    ALTER TABLE price_table_items ALTER COLUMN cost_revision DROP NOT NULL;
    ALTER TABLE price_table_items ADD COLUMN source_snapshot jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
        CHECK (jsonb_typeof(source_snapshot) = 'object');
    
    CREATE FUNCTION validate_price_item_source() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
    DECLARE kind text; source_name text;
    BEGIN
        SELECT source_kind,source_reference->>'source' INTO kind,source_name FROM price_table_versions
        WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.version_id;
        IF NEW.cost_revision IS NULL AND kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'legacy' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only legacy price snapshots may omit a current cost revision';
        END IF;
        IF kind = 'legacy' AND (
            NEW.cost_revision IS NOT NULL
            OR NEW.source_snapshot->>'source' IS DISTINCT FROM source_name
            OR NOT (NEW.source_snapshot ?& ARRAY['advisory_cost','tax_credit','packaging','product_id','version'])
            OR NOT (NEW.cost_snapshot ?& ARRAY['purchaseCostCents','taxCreditBps','packagingCents'])
            OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.cost_snapshot->'purchaseCostCents') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
            OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.cost_snapshot->'taxCreditBps') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
            OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.cost_snapshot->'packagingCents') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
            OR (NEW.cost_snapshot->>'purchaseCostCents')::bigint < 0
            OR (NEW.cost_snapshot->>'packagingCents')::bigint < 0
            OR (NEW.cost_snapshot->>'taxCreditBps')::integer NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Legacy publication requires an attributable frozen cost snapshot';
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
    END;
    $$;
    CREATE TRIGGER price_item_source_guard BEFORE INSERT ON price_table_items
        FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_price_item_source();

    \if :{?import_actor}

    \echo 'Set import_actor to the authenticated importing identity UUID'
    \quit 3
    \endif
    BEGIN;
    SET LOCAL lock_timeout='10s';

    (6,'imported','9e66ff66-0d40-7345-2f9a-1138e237c921',91,'3a658e1f8258b171253b5da32db680eb','044b29973433de52b7fdcd31d31ce987');

            'netMarginBps',round((v.parameters->>'target_net_profit')::numeric*10000)::integer,

            'domesticIcmsBps',round((v.parameters->>'icms_sp')::numeric*10000)::integer,
            'pisCofinsBps',round((v.parameters->>'pis_cofins')::numeric*10000)::integer,
            'ipiBps',round((v.parameters->>'ipi')::numeric*10000)::integer,
            'incomeTaxBps',round((v.parameters->>'income_tax')::numeric*10000)::integer,
            'commissionBps',round((v.parameters->>'commission')::numeric*10000)::integer,
            'adsBps',round((v.parameters->>'ads')::numeric*10000)::integer,
            'gatewayBps',round((v.parameters->>'gateway')::numeric*10000)::integer,
            'otherFeesBps',round((v.parameters->>'other_sales_rate')::numeric*10000)::integer,
            'interstateBps',round((v.parameters->>'icms_interstate')::numeric*10000)::integer,
            'lossBps',round((v.parameters->>'loss_provision')::numeric*10000)::integer,
            'warrantyBps',round((v.parameters->>'warranty_provision')::numeric*10000)::integer,
            'badDebtBps',round((v.parameters->>'default_provision')::numeric*10000)::integer,
            'proposalValidityDays',(v.parameters->>'proposal_validity_days')::integer,
            'fixedOrderFeeCents',round((v.parameters->>'fixed_fee_per_order')::numeric*100)::bigint,
            'monthlyExpensesCents',round((v.parameters->>'fixed_monthly_expenses')::numeric*100)::bigint,
            'stateRates',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('state',h.details->>'uf','internalBps',round((h.details->>'internal_icms')::numeric*10000)::integer,'fcpBps',round((h.details->>'fcp')::numeric*10000)::integer,'outgoingBps',round((h.details->>'outbound_icms')::numeric*10000)::integer) ORDER BY h.details->>'uf')
               FROM legacy_history h WHERE h.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND h.collection='price_table_state_rates' AND (h.details->>'version')::bigint=v.version)) AS policy
    FROM legacy_evolution.price_versions v JOIN activation_expected e ON e.historical_id=v.id AND e.version=v.version
    WHERE v.tenant_id='9bcd03ef-0fee-471c-8f30-12a6271a09cc';
    DO $$

      FROM legacy_evolution.price_items i JOIN products p ON p.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND p.id=i.product_id WHERE i.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND i.version_id=v.id;
      IF n<>v.item_count OR p<>v.price_md5 OR c<>v.cost_md5 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source fingerprint mismatch version %',v.version; END IF;
      IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legacy_evolution.price_items i JOIN products p ON p.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND p.id=i.product_id WHERE i.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND i.version_id=v.id AND (p.status<>'active' OR p.sku IS DISTINCT FROM i.snapshot->>'code')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Product mapping changed'; END IF;
      IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM commercial_settings s WHERE s.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND s.product_line=v.line AND s.revision=2 AND s.parameters=v.policy AND (s.active_price_version_id IS NULL OR s.active_price_version_id=v.id)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Settings revision/policy/pointer changed'; END IF;
      IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM price_table_versions WHERE tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND product_line=v.line AND id<>v.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unexpected operational publication'; END IF;
      IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM price_table_versions WHERE id=v.id AND (tenant_id<>v.tenant_id OR source_kind<>'legacy' OR policy_snapshot<>v.policy OR version<>v.version OR published_at<>v.published_at OR settings_revision<>2)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Existing publication differs'; END IF;
     END LOOP;
    END $$;
    -- Inserting only absent versions makes exact reruns harmless despite immutable history.

    INSERT INTO price_table_versions(id,tenant_id,product_line,version,settings_revision,policy_snapshot,calculator_version,digest,published_by,published_at,source_kind,source_reference)
    SELECT id,tenant_id,line,version,2,policy,'legacy-frozen-import-v1',encode(sha256(convert_to(tenant_id::text||':'||id::text||':'||price_md5||':'||cost_md5||':'||policy::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),(SELECT id FROM activation_actor),published_at,'legacy',jsonb_build_object('source','ludus.avilaops.com','version',version,'historicalVersionId',id,'sourceHistoryId',source_history_id,'priceFingerprint',price_md5,'costFingerprint',cost_md5) FROM activation_new;
    INSERT INTO price_table_items(tenant_id,version_id,product_id,product_snapshot,cost_revision,cost_snapshot,price_without_ipi_cents,ipi_bps,price_with_ipi_cents,source_snapshot)
    SELECT i.tenant_id,i.version_id,i.product_id,jsonb_build_object('sku',p.sku,'name',i.snapshot->>'name','unit',p.unit,'revision',p.revision),NULL,
    jsonb_build_object('purchaseCostCents',round((i.snapshot->>'advisory_cost')::numeric*100)::bigint,'taxCreditBps',round((i.snapshot->>'tax_credit')::numeric*10000)::integer,'packagingCents',round((i.snapshot->>'packaging')::numeric*100)::bigint),i.price_cents,(v.policy->>'ipiBps')::integer,i.price_with_ipi_cents,i.snapshot||jsonb_build_object('source','ludus.avilaops.com','historicalVersionId',v.id)
    FROM legacy_evolution.price_items i JOIN activation_new v ON v.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND v.id=i.version_id JOIN products p ON p.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND p.id=i.product_id;

        } else if (result) { setError("Resposta divergente. Confira a versão publicada."); onLocked(false) }
      }
      return <div className="space-y-5">
        <p>Publicar cria uma versão da tabela com os custos dos produtos ativos e os parâmetros salvos. Produtos e pedidos existentes mantêm os preços cadastrados.</p>
        <Button variant="outline" disabled={!current.value || preparing || command.busy || command.uncertain} onClick={prepare}>{preparing ? "Preparando…" : "Preparar prévia"}</Button>
        {preview && <section className="form-section space-y-3"><h2 className="font-semibold">Conferência antes de publicar</h2><p>{preview.items.length} produtos · revisão {preview.revision}</p><Prices items={preview.items} /><Button disabled={command.busy || command.stale} onClick={publish}>{command.uncertain ? "Repetir confirmação" : "Confirmar publicação"}</Button></section>}

      </div>
    }

    function key(value: string) {

    }
    
    export type CatalogPalette = "dhz-hammerforce"
    
    export function catalogPaletteFor(structureColors?: readonly string[]): CatalogPalette | undefined {
      const colors = new Set((structureColors ?? []).map(key))
      return colors.has("pianoblack") && colors.has("titaniumgrey") && (colors.has("graphiteblack") || colors.has("mattegraphiteblack")) ? "dhz-hammerforce" : undefined
    }
    
    const hammerForceAliases: Record<string, string> = {
      preto: "Piano Black",
      grafite: "Matte Graphite Black",
      cinza: "Light Grey",
      vermelho: "Performance Red",
      laranja: "Hermès Orange",
      azul: "Ocean Blue",
    }
    
    export function catalogColorPhoto(value: string, palette?: CatalogPalette) {
      // Resolve legacy swing-arm labels only after the same product identifies its palette.
      const aliasKey = key(value)
      const alias = palette === "dhz-hammerforce" && Object.hasOwn(hammerForceAliases, aliasKey) ? hammerForceAliases[aliasKey] : undefined
      const normalized = key(alias ?? value)
      // The supplier's shortened label refers to the same named graphite finish.
      return photos.find(photo => key(photo.name) === normalized || (photo.name === "Matte Graphite Black" && normalized === "graphiteblack"))
    }

    ---
    name: verification-before-completion
    description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
    ---
    
    # Verification Before Completion
    
    ## Overview
    
    **Core principle:** Evidence before claims, always.
    
    **Violating the letter of this rule is violating the spirit of this rule.**
    
    ## The Iron Law
    
    ```
    NO COMPLETION CLAIMS WITHOUT FRESH VERIFICATION EVIDENCE
    ```
    
    If you haven't run the verification command in this message, you cannot claim it passes.
    
    ## The Gate Function
    
    ```
    BEFORE claiming any status or expressing satisfaction:
    
    1. IDENTIFY: What command proves this claim?
    2. RUN: Execute the FULL command (fresh, complete)
    3. READ: Full output, check exit code, count failures
    4. VERIFY: Does output confirm the claim?
       - If NO: State actual status with evidence
       - If YES: State claim WITH evidence
    5. ONLY THEN: Make the claim
    
    Skip any step = lying, not verifying
    ```
    
    ## Common Failures
    
    | Claim | Requires | Not Sufficient |
    |-------|----------|----------------|
    | Tests pass | Test command output: 0 failures | Previous run, "should pass" |
    | Linter clean | Linter output: 0 errors | Partial check, extrapolation |
    | Build succeeds | Build command: exit 0 | Linter passing, logs look good |
    | Bug fixed | Test original symptom: passes | Code changed, assumed fixed |
    | Regression test works | Red-green cycle verified | Test passes once |
    | Agent completed | VCS diff shows changes | Agent reports "success" |
    | Requirements met | Line-by-line checklist | Tests passing |
    
    ## Red Flags - STOP
    
    - Using "should", "probably", "seems to"
    - Expressing satisfaction before verification ("Great!", "Perfect!", "Done!", etc.)
    - About to commit/push/PR without verification
    - Trusting agent success reports
    - Relying on partial verification
    - Thinking "just this once"
    - Tired and wanting work over
    - **ANY wording implying success without having run verification**
    
    ## Rationalization Prevention
    
    | Excuse | Reality |
    |--------|---------|
    | "Should work now" | RUN the verification |
    | "I'm confident" | Confidence ≠ evidence |
    | "Just this once" | No exceptions |
    | "Linter passed" | Linter ≠ compiler |
    | "Agent said success" | Verify independently |
    | "I'm tired" | Exhaustion ≠ excuse |
    | "Partial check is enough" | Partial proves nothing |
    | "Different words so rule doesn't apply" | Spirit over letter |
    
    ## Key Patterns
    
    **Tests:**
    ```
    ✅ [Run test command] [See: 34/34 pass] "All tests pass"
    ❌ "Should pass now" / "Looks correct"
    ```
    
    **Regression tests (TDD Red-Green):**
    ```
    ✅ Write → Run (pass) → Revert fix → Run (MUST FAIL) → Restore → Run (pass)
    ❌ "I've written a regression test" (without red-green verification)
    ```
    
    **Build:**
    ```
    ✅ [Run build] [See: exit 0] "Build passes"

    """Package a locally compiled ELF, migrate, deploy with previous compose rollback."""
    import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, urllib.request
    
    sha, expected_hash = sys.argv[1:]
    if len(sha) != 40 or any(c not in '0123456789abcdef' for c in sha):
        raise RuntimeError('Invalid source revision')
    root = pathlib.Path('/mnt/HC_Volume_106542212/erp-next')
    binary = root / 'source' / sha / 'erp-next-api'
    with binary.open('rb') as stream:
        if stream.read(4) != b'\x7fELF': raise RuntimeError('Expected Linux executable')
    with binary.open('rb') as stream:
        if hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest() != expected_hash:
            raise RuntimeError('Uploaded executable checksum mismatch')
    os.chmod(binary, 0o755)
    current = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'inspect', 'erp-next-api-1'], text=True))[0]
    previous = pathlib.Path(current['Config']['Labels']['com.docker.compose.project.working_dir'])
    if not previous.is_relative_to(root / 'releases'): raise RuntimeError('Unexpected current release')
    config = json.loads((previous / 'compose.json').read_text())
    image = 'erp-next-api:sha-' + sha
    package = 'erp-api-package-' + sha[:12]
    subprocess.run(['docker','create','--name',package,current['Config']['Image']],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    try:
        subprocess.run(['docker','cp',str(binary),package+':/usr/local/bin/erp-next-api'],check=True)
        subprocess.run(['docker','commit','--change','LABEL org.opencontainers.image.revision='+sha,package,image],check=True)
    finally:
        subprocess.run(['docker','rm',package],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    subprocess.run(['docker','run','--rm','--network','none','--read-only',image,'openapi'],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    backup = root / 'backups' / ('schema-before-api-' + sha[:12] + '.sql')
    with backup.open('wb') as output:
        os.chmod(backup,0o600)
        subprocess.run(['pg_dump','-h','127.0.0.1','-U','postgres','-d','erp_next','--schema-only','--no-owner'],check=True,stdout=output)
    values = dict(config['services']['api']['environment'])
    values['DATABASE_URL'] = 'postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/erp_next'
    fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='erp-api-migrate-',dir=root/'private')
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as output:
            for key,value in values.items():
                if '\n' in str(value) or '\r' in str(value): raise RuntimeError('Multiline environment')
                output.write(f'{key}={value}\n')
        subprocess.run(['docker','run','--rm','--network','host','--read-only','--tmpfs','/tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=32m','--env-file',name,image,'migrate'],check=True)
    finally:
        os.unlink(name)
    release = root/'releases'/sha
    release.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    config['services']['api']['image'] = image
    compose = release/'compose.json'
    compose.write_text(json.dumps(config,indent=2)+'\n')
    os.chmod(compose,0o600)
    def command(directory):
        return ['docker','compose','--project-name','erp-next','--project-directory',str(directory),'--file',str(directory/'compose.json'),'up','--detach','--no-build','--force-recreate','--wait','--wait-timeout','120','api','web','fiscal-engine','fiscal-mcp']
    try:
        subprocess.run(command(release),check=True)
        with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:3141/health/ready',timeout=10) as response:
            if json.load(response).get('status') != 'ready': raise RuntimeError('API unavailable')
        with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:3140/api/health',timeout=10) as response:
            if json.load(response).get('ok') is not True: raise RuntimeError('Web unavailable')
    except BaseException:
        subprocess.run(command(previous),check=True)
        raise
    print('API_DEPLOY_OK',sha)

    pub async fn create(
        State(state): State<AppState>,
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        Path(code): Path<String>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
        payload: Result<Json<CreateInput>, JsonRejection>,
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        let key = command_key(&headers)?;
        let (tenant, mut tx, _) = authorized(
            &state,
            &headers,
            &identity,
            pricing::READ,
            pricing::MANAGE,
            true,
        )
        .await?;
        let Json(input) = payload.map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("Dados do pedido inválidos"))?;
        pricing::line(&code)?;
        let request = json!({"line":code,"input":input});
        if let Some(previous) = replay(
            &mut tx,
            tenant,
            &identity.subject,
            key,
            "order.simulated",
            &request,
        )
        .await?
        {
            tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
            return Ok(response(StatusCode::CREATED, Some(1), previous));
        }
        let prepared = pricing::prepare(&mut tx, tenant, &code, &input.quote).await?;
        if prepared.digest != input.digest {
            return Err(DomainError::StaleRevision);
        }
        let order_input = super::OrderInput {
            customer_id: input.customer_id,
            due_date: input.due_date.clone(),
            items: vec![super::OrderItemInput {
                product_id: input.quote.product_id,
                quantity: format!("{}.000000", input.quote.quantity),
                structure_color: input.structure_color,
                arm_color: None,
                plate_holder_color: input.plate_holder_color,
                plate_holder_type: input.plate_holder_type,
                upholstery_color: input.upholstery_color,
            }],
        };
        let mut order = super::prepare_order(&mut tx, tenant, &order_input, None).await?;
        order.total = prepared.quote.sale.invoice_total_cents;
        order.lines[0].price = prepared.quote.sale.unit_with_ipi_cents;
        order.lines[0].amount = order.total;
        order.lines[0].sku = prepared.product["sku"]
            .as_str()
            .ok_or(DomainError::Conflict("SKU publicado inválido"))?
            .into();
        order.lines[0].name = prepared.product["name"]
            .as_str()
            .ok_or(DomainError::Conflict("Nome publicado inválido"))?
            .into();
        let id = Uuid::now_v7();
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO sales_orders(id,tenant_id,customer_id,customer_name,customer_tax_id,due_date,amount_cents,status) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,'draft')")
            .bind(id).bind(tenant).bind(input.customer_id).bind(&order.customer_name).bind(&order.customer_tax_id).bind(order.due).bind(order.total).execute(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        super::store_lines(&mut tx, tenant, id, &order.lines).await?;
        let needs_approval = prepared.quote.sale.needs_approval;
        let snapshot = pricing::redact(prepared, &input.quote, true, tenant);
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO order_pricing_snapshots(tenant_id,order_id,version_id,snapshot,needs_approval) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5)")
            .bind(tenant).bind(id).bind(input.quote.version_id).bind(snapshot).bind(needs_approval).execute(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        record(&mut tx, tenant, &identity, &headers, DomainChange {
            kind:"sales_order", id, event:"order.created",
            details:json!({"revision":1,"source":"sales_simulator","versionId":input.quote.version_id,"needsApproval":needs_approval}),
        }).await?;
        let result = json!({"tenantId":tenant,"id":id,"revision":1,"status":"draft","needsApproval":needs_approval});
        remember(
            &mut tx,
            tenant,
            &identity.subject,
            key,
            "order.simulated",
            &request,
            &result,
        )
        .await?;
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(StatusCode::CREATED, Some(1), result))
    }

    fn legacy_plate_holder_color<'a>(
        plate_holder_color: Option<&'a str>,
        arm_color: Option<&'a str>,
    ) -> Result<Option<&'a str>, DomainError> {
        if let (Some(current), Some(legacy)) = (plate_holder_color, arm_color)
            && !current.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(legacy.trim())
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Informe a cor dos anilheiros apenas em plateHolderColor",
            ));
        }
        Ok(plate_holder_color.or(arm_color))
    }

    async fn prepare(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        input: &SimulationInput,
    ) -> Result<Prepared, DomainError> {
        if !matches!(input.line.as_str(), "imported" | "national") {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Linha comercial inválida"));
        }
        let (version, saved_revision, current_revision, policy): (i64, i64, i64, Value) = sqlx::query_as("SELECT v.version,v.settings_revision,s.revision,v.policy_snapshot FROM commercial_settings s JOIN price_table_versions v ON v.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND v.id=s.active_price_version_id WHERE s.tenant_id=$1 AND s.product_line=$2 AND v.id=$3")
            .bind(tenant).bind(&input.line).bind(input.version_id).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?.ok_or(DomainError::StaleRevision)?;
        if saved_revision != current_revision {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "Parâmetros alterados após a publicação. Publique a tabela atualizada antes de simular",
            ));
        }
        let parameters: CommercialParameters =
            serde_json::from_value(policy.clone()).map_err(|_| access::AccessError::Internal)?;
        let (rules_revision, rules) = rules(tx, tenant).await?;
        if input.items.is_empty() || input.items.len() > 100 {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Simulação exige de 1 a 100 equipamentos",
            ));
        }
        let mut sources = Vec::with_capacity(input.items.len());
        for item in &input.items {
            let source: SourceItem = sqlx::query_as("SELECT i.product_id,i.product_snapshot->>'sku' AS sku,i.product_snapshot->>'name' AS name,i.product_snapshot->>'unit' AS unit,p.revision AS product_revision,i.cost_revision,i.price_without_ipi_cents AS price_cents,(i.cost_snapshot->>'purchaseCostCents')::bigint AS purchase_cents,(i.cost_snapshot->>'taxCreditBps')::integer AS credit_bps,(i.cost_snapshot->>'packagingCents')::bigint AS packaging_cents FROM price_table_items i JOIN products p ON p.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND p.id=i.product_id JOIN price_table_versions v ON v.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND v.id=i.version_id LEFT JOIN product_costs c ON c.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND c.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.tenant_id=$1 AND i.version_id=$2 AND i.product_id=$3 AND p.status='active' AND v.product_line=$4 AND p.unit=i.product_snapshot->>'unit' AND p.revision=(i.product_snapshot->>'revision')::bigint AND ((v.source_kind='calculated' AND c.product_line=$4 AND c.revision=i.cost_revision) OR (v.source_kind='legacy' AND i.cost_revision IS NULL AND i.source_snapshot->>'source'=v.source_reference->>'source'))")

        </fieldset><p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">As permissões de gerente e diretoria são atribuídas em Usuários e perfis.     pub(super) async fn prepare(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        code: &str,
        input: &QuoteInput,
    ) -> Result<PreparedQuote, DomainError> {
        line(code)?;
        let row: Option<(i64, Value, Value, Value, i64)> = sqlx::query_as("SELECT v.version,v.policy_snapshot,i.product_snapshot,i.cost_snapshot,i.price_without_ipi_cents FROM price_table_versions v JOIN price_table_items i ON i.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND i.version_id=v.id JOIN products p ON p.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND p.id=i.product_id WHERE v.tenant_id=$1 AND v.id=$2 AND v.product_line=$3 AND i.product_id=$4 AND p.status='active' AND p.unit=i.product_snapshot->>'unit'")
            .bind(tenant).bind(input.version_id).bind(code).bind(input.product_id).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        let (version, policy, product, cost, price) = row.ok_or(DomainError::NotFound)?;
        let params: CommercialParameters = serde_json::from_value(policy)
            .map_err(|_| DomainError::Conflict("Política publicada incompatível"))?;
        let cost: PublishedCost = serde_json::from_value(cost)
            .map_err(|_| DomainError::Conflict("Custo publicado incompatível"))?;
        let quote = super::pricing_model::quote(input, price, &cost, &params)?;
        let raw = json!({"tenantId":tenant,"line":code,"input":input,"calculator":CALCULATOR,"sale":quote.sale,"director":quote.director});
        let digest = format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(raw.to_string().as_bytes()));
        Ok(PreparedQuote {
            line: code.into(),
            quote,
            digest,
            product,
            version,
        })
    }
    
    pub(super) fn redact(
        prepared: PreparedQuote,
        input: &QuoteInput,
        director: bool,
        tenant: Uuid,
    ) -> Value {
        let mut result = json!({"tenantId":tenant,"line":prepared.line,"versionId":input.version_id,"version":prepared.version,"product":prepared.product,"input":input,"digest":prepared.digest,"sale":prepared.quote.sale});
        if director {
            result["director"] = json!(prepared.quote.director);
        }
        result
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn sees_costs(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        subject: &str,
    ) -> Result<bool, DomainError> {
        let rights = access::load_access(tx, tenant, subject).await?;
        Ok(access::require_permission(&rights, DIRECTOR).is_ok())
    }
    
    #[utoipa::path(post,path="/api/v1/sales-simulator/{line}/quote",operation_id="quote_sales_simulator",tag="Sales",security(("bearerAuth"=[])),params(("line"=String,Path),("X-Tenant-Id"=Uuid,Header)),request_body=QuoteInput,responses((status=200,body=Value),(status=404,description="Versão ou equipamento indisponível"),(status=422,description="Condições inválidas")))]
    pub async fn quote(
        State(state): State<AppState>,
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        Path(code): Path<String>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
        payload: Result<Json<QuoteInput>, JsonRejection>,
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        let (tenant, mut tx, _) = authorized(&state, &headers, &identity, READ, MANAGE, false).await?;
        let Json(input) = payload
            .map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("Preencha as condições sem campos desconhecidos"))?;
        let prepared = prepare(&mut tx, tenant, &code, &input).await?;
        let director = sees_costs(&mut tx, tenant, &identity.subject).await?;
        let result = redact(prepared, &input, director, tenant);
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(StatusCode::OK, None, result))
    }

    ---
    
    # Brainstorming
    
    You are very good at building. You build what you believe your human
    partner wants, and that belief is usually thinner than it feels. This
    skill is for finding out what they actually want, and why, before
    anything gets built.
    
    People often haven't finished working out what they want. Good questions
    help them think it through. When you understand the why, you make the
    hundred decisions they never mention the way they would have made them.
    
    ## First: What Do You Actually Know?
    
    Before you reply, ask yourself: what do I know about what they want, and
    why?
    
    - **Everything that matters is in the request** ("make the icon cornflower
      blue"). This is a quick, clear task. Do it, and say what you did.
    - **Something non-trivial is missing.** Start the conversation.
    
    Before you start implementing, you must, in order:
    
    1. Lay out the approaches in a message of their own, and have your
       human partner pick one (see Lay out the approaches).
    2. Write the design doc, short or full (see Size the Work).
    3. Get their approval of that doc.
    4. Invoke the superpowers:writing-plans skill.
    
    Two things aren't implementing: a spike they said yes to (see Spike to
    feel things out), and doing what they asked once they've opted out of
    the questions.
    
    ## Look Before You Ask
    
    In an existing project, or when they've given you context (a spec, a plan,
    a handoff, files they pointed at, earlier conversation), dig in before your
    first message. Read what they referred to and the code or material it
    connects to, and keep reading until you can explain how the relevant
    parts work today and what this change would touch. Never ask what the
    project or their context already answers.
    
    ## Your First Message
    
    Move the work forward, with one of these:
    
    - **They've already said what they want** (a spec, a plan, a detailed
      request): aim for about 200 words for the whole message. Echo their
      request back in your own words, so they can see whether you've got its
      shape: what they want, who it's for, and why, as far as they've said.
      Add what you found that bears on it: how the relevant parts work today
      and what the change would touch. If you found something they may not
      have considered that would change what they're asking for or how it
      has to be built, like a constraint, a conflict, or a cheaper path, say
      so plainly. How to build it comes later, once you understand what they
      want (see Lay out the approaches). End with one line inviting
      corrections, then one question about what they want: the thing their
      request leaves open whose answer would most change what gets built.
      Specs are often incomplete, so confirm before you build on one.
    - **They haven't:** one open question, in their own terms, about the
      biggest thing their request leaves unsettled. Say why you're asking:
      what the answer would change about what you build. For "a website for
      my bakery": "If it's mostly for people deciding whether to stop by,
      I'd lead with hours and what's in the case today; taking orders is a
      different site. What do you want someone to do when they land on it?"
    
    How the message ends depends on whether their message asked for
    brainstorming:
    
    - **They asked for it** (by name, by invoking it, or by asking for a
      design discussion): end with your question. They want this
      conversation.
    - **They didn't:** they may not want a conversation at all. After your
      question, add a light, one-line offer to just get going instead, like
      "Or if you'd rather I just dive in, say so." If they take you up on
      it, this skill is done: state any significant how-it-gets-made choice
      (platform, language, medium) in one plain line, then do what they
      asked through the normal workflow.
    
    That's the whole message.
    
    ## The Conversation
    
    Each message ends with one question: a single sentence with no list of
    example answers hanging off it. Use plain language, pitched just a little
    above where your human partner is. Match their vocabulary; never use
    process jargon. You never need to quote this skill to your human
    partner.
    
    Be clear and concise. Lead with what matters. Avoid jargon. When you
    report what you found, give them the most important findings and offer
    the rest.
    
    **Get them describing.** Open questions come first. Their own words carry
    intent that your options can't. Offer a short menu only when they're
    stuck. When they say "just guess" or "what do you think?", propose
    something concrete.
    
    **How it gets made.** Every project rests on choices about medium, tools,
    materials, and resources: the platform, programming language, and
    libraries for an app; the medium for a piece of art. Find out early which
    of those choices they want to make, which they're handing to you, and what
    they already have to work with. Someone with strong views or skills will
    want to talk it through. Someone counting on you needs sensible defaults,
    said in plain words. When there's existing work, build on what it already
    uses. Any choice you make goes in the design as your call, never as
    something they agreed to.
    
    **Ground to cover.** This is territory, not a script. Never read these
    out as questions:
    
    - what kind of thing this is, and what makes it special
    - why now, and what success looks like to them
    - goals, non-goals, and anti-goals (what would make this a failure even
      if it technically works)
    - prior art: what they've seen elsewhere, loved or hated
    - current state: what exists now, what they've tried
    - the details they care about
    
    **Make every question specific** to their project and what they've told
    you. Ask Socratically, the way a sharp colleague would: build each
    question on their last answer or on something you found, so it helps
    them think through a consequence or a case they may have missed
    ("Voting closes before the meeting, and two members joined this month.
    Does someone who joins mid-round get a vote?"). When the reason isn't
    already plain, say what you're hoping to learn or what the answer would
    change. A proposal they can correct, plus your reason for it, often
    beats a question.
    
    **Offer recon.** Once you have a bit of grounding and looking further
    would help, offer to go look: deeper into their codebase or project,
    their own files and data, or the web. Say what you'd look for. They
    decide whether you go.
    
    **Lay out the approaches.** Once you understand what they want, and
    before you write anything up, put the ways of building it in a message
    of its own. Come up with several real alternatives and drop the weak
    ones, including any that work against why they want it and any the
    existing work rules out. Present the two or three that remain, grounding
    each in what the project actually does and saying what it trades off.
    Recommend one and say why, then ask which way they want to go. When
    there's genuinely one sensible way, say so and explain why the others
    don't fit. This is for how it gets built; for what they want, get them
    describing first.
    
    **Show, don't tell.** Offer the visual companion (below) whenever seeing
    would help more than reading:
    
    - something they'll look at: a screen, a page, a printout, a sign
    - a layout or arrangement: of a screen, a room, a schedule
    - a flow or a sequence of steps
    - options that would look different from each other
    - a structure that's easier to see than read: a diagram, a timeline, a map
    
    Once they've accepted, use it for mockups to react to, side-by-side
    options, and throwaway prototypes they can click.
    
    **Spike to feel things out.** Agentic work is waterfall, but very, very
    fast. A quick throwaway build is often the cheapest way to learn what
    they want or whether something works. Offer one when it would help.
    When they just want to spike, get out of the way. Spikes get no tests
    or minimal ones, aren't bulletproof, and skip the plan, implementation,
    and review process. Bring what the spike taught you back into the
    conversation.
    
    ## Play It Back
    
    Play back as you go. As soon as you understand one part well enough to
    describe it (what it's for and who it serves, say, or how one piece
    behaves), describe that part back in about 200-300 words, then return to
    questions about the next part. Playback and questions alternate through
    the whole conversation; the last chunk covers whatever is left.
    
    Only what they said goes in as theirs. Anything you filled in goes in
    as your proposal, with your reason. End each chunk by asking what's wrong
    or missing.

        <nav className="flex flex-wrap gap-4"><Link className="text-primary underline" href="/vendas/tabela-precos">Tabela de preços</Link>{table.value?.canManage && <><Link className="text-primary underline" href="/preferencias/comercial">Parâmetros e metas</Link><Link className="text-primary underline" href="/preferencias/aprovacao-comercial">Regras de aprovação</Link></>}</nav>
        <label className="grid max-w-sm gap-2">Linha comercial<select className={selectClass} disabled={lineLocked} value={line} onChange={e => { if (!document.querySelector("[data-simulation-dirty='true']") || window.confirm("Descartar a simulação desta linha?")) setLine(e.target.value) }}><option value="imported">Importada</option><option value="national">Nacional</option></select></label>
        {table.loading ? <p role="status">Carregando versão publicada…</p> : table.error ? <p role="alert"><RequestError message={table.error} status={table.status} /></p> : table.value && (opportunityTenant && opportunityTenant !== table.value.tenantId ? <p role="alert">A empresa da sessão mudou. Reabra a oportunidade.</p> : <Simulator key={`${line}:${table.value.tenantId}:${table.value.data?.id}`} table={table.value} opportunity={opportunity} onLineLockChange={setLineLocked} initialProduct={line === initialLine ? initialProduct : ""} />)}

    function Simulator({ table, initialProduct, opportunity, onLineLockChange }: { table: PriceTable; initialProduct: string; opportunity?: Opportunity; onLineLockChange: (locked: boolean) => void }) {
