                <caption className="sr-only">Pedidos de venda</caption>
                <thead className="bg-muted/50"><tr><th scope="col" className="p-3">Pedido</th><th scope="col" className="p-3">Cliente</th><th scope="col" className="p-3">Situação</th><th scope="col" className="p-3">Vencimento</th><th scope="col" className="p-3 text-right">Valor</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>{result.value.data.map(order => <tr className="border-t hover:bg-muted/30" key={order.id}>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap p-3"><Link className={linkClass} href={`/vendas/pedidos/${order.id}`}>{orderNumber(order.number)}</Link></td>
                  <td className="min-w-48 p-3"><Link className={`${linkClass} break-words`} href={`/vendas/pedidos/${order.id}`}>{order.customerName}</Link><span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{order.customerTaxId}</span></td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap p-3">{labels[order.status] || order.status}</td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap p-3">{order.dueDate ? order.dueDate.split("-").reverse().join("/") : "Não informado"}</td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap p-3 text-right tabular-nums">{commercialMoney(order.amount)}</td>
                </tr>)}</tbody>
              </DataTable>
            </div> : <p>{query.q ? "Nenhum pedido encontrado para esta pesquisa." : "Nenhum pedido cadastrado."}</p>}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3"><Button variant="outline" disabled={!query.offset} onClick={() => setQuery(value => ({ ...value, offset: Math.max(0, value.offset - 25) }))}>Anterior</Button><span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Página {Math.floor(query.offset / 25) + 1}</span><Button variant="outline" disabled={query.offset >= 100000 || query.offset + 25 >= (result.value?.total || 0)} onClick={() => setQuery(value => ({ ...value, offset: value.offset + 25 }))}>Próxima</Button></div>
          </>}
        </section>
      </>
    }
    
    function OrderEditor({ id }: { id?: string }) {
      const access = useResource<Listing | Detail>(id ? `/api/erp/orders/${id}` : "/api/erp/orders?limit=1")
      if (access.loading) return <><PageHeader breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Vendas", href: "/vendas" }, { label: "Pedidos", href: "/vendas/pedidos" }, { label: id ? "Editar" : "Novo" }]} title={id ? "Editar pedido de venda" : "Novo pedido de venda"} description="Selecione o cliente e adicione os produtos do pedido." /><p role="status">Carregando rascunho e permissões…</p></>
      if (access.error || !access.value) return <><PageHeader breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Vendas", href: "/vendas" }, { label: "Pedidos", href: "/vendas/pedidos" }, { label: id ? "Editar" : "Novo" }]} title={id ? "Editar pedido de venda" : "Novo pedido de venda"} description="Selecione o cliente e adicione os produtos do pedido." /><Link className={linkClass} href="/vendas/pedidos">Voltar à lista</Link><section className="form-section space-y-3"><p role="alert"><RequestError message={access.error || "Pedido indisponível"} status={access.status} /></p><Button onClick={access.reload}>Tentar novamente</Button></section></>
      const initial = "items" in access.value ? access.value : undefined
      if (initial?.pricingOrigin) return <><PageHeader eyebrow="Vendas" title="Condições preservadas" description="Este pedido mantém os itens e preços da simulação publicada." /><Link className={linkClass} href={`/vendas/pedidos/${initial.data.id}`}>Consultar pedido e condições</Link></>
      if (!access.value.canEdit || (initial && initial.data.status !== "draft")) {
        return <><PageHeader eyebrow="Vendas" title="Edição do pedido" description="Alterações são permitidas somente em rascunhos com autorização de gestão." /><section className="form-section space-y-3"><p role="status">{!access.value.canEdit ? "Somente consulta. Solicite permissão para alterar pedidos." : "Este pedido não está em rascunho e não pode ser editado."}</p><Link className={linkClass} href={id ? `/vendas/pedidos/${id}` : "/vendas/pedidos"}>Voltar aos pedidos</Link></section></>
      }
      return <OrderForm key={`${id || "new"}:${access.etag}`} initial={initial} etag={access.etag} tenantId={access.value.tenantId} reload={access.reload} />
    }
    
    function OrderForm({ initial, etag, tenantId, reload }: { initial?: Detail; etag: string; tenantId: string; reload: () => void }) {
      const router = useRouter()
      const command = useCommand()
      const originalCustomer: Choice | null = initial ? { id: initial.data.customerId, legalName: initial.data.customerName } : null
      const [customer, setCustomer] = useState<Choice | null>(originalCustomer)
      const [items, setItems] = useState<SelectedItem[]>(() => initial?.items.map(item => ({ id: item.productId, name: item.name, sku: item.sku, unit: item.unit, basePrice: item.unitPrice, quantity: item.quantity, preserved: true, structureColor: item.structureColor || "", upholsteryColor: item.upholsteryColor || "", plateHolderColor: item.plateHolderColor || "", plateHolderType: item.plateHolderType || "" })) || [])
      const [dueDate, setDueDate] = useState(initial?.data.dueDate || "")
      const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false)
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const frozen = command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale
      useEffect(() => {
        if (!initial) return
        const controller = new AbortController()
        void Promise.all(initial.items.map(async item => {
          const response = await erpFetch(`/api/erp/products/${item.productId}`, { cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal })
          const value = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok || value.tenantId !== tenantId) throw new Error("Não foi possível consultar as opções de cores. As escolhas registradas foram mantidas; recarregue para alterar o acabamento.")
          return { id: item.productId, structureColors: value.data.structureColors || [], upholsteryConfigurable: value.data.upholsteryConfigurable, upholsteryColors: value.data.upholsteryColors || [], plateHolderColors: value.data.plateHolderColors || [], plateHolderTypes: value.data.plateHolderTypes || [], hasPhoto: value.data.hasPhoto }
        })).then(products => {
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) setItems(previous => previous.map(item => ({ ...item, ...products.find(product => product.id === item.id) })))
        }).catch(reason => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Falha ao consultar cores") })
        return () => controller.abort()
      }, [initial, tenantId])
      useEffect(() => {
        const prevent = (event: BeforeUnloadEvent) => { if (dirty || command.uncertain) event.preventDefault() }
        window.addEventListener("beforeunload", prevent); return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", prevent)
      }, [dirty, command.uncertain])
      return <><PageHeader breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Vendas", href: "/vendas" }, { label: "Pedidos", href: "/vendas/pedidos" }, ...(initial ? [{ label: orderNumber(initial.data.number), href: `/vendas/pedidos/${initial.data.id}` }] : []), { label: initial ? "Editar" : "Novo" }]} title={initial ? "Editar pedido" : "Novo pedido"} description="Selecione o cliente, adicione os produtos e informe o vencimento." />
        <section className="form-section min-w-0 space-y-3 sm:space-y-5">
            <Link className={linkClass} href={initial ? `/vendas/pedidos/${initial.data.id}` : "/vendas/pedidos"} onClick={event => { if ((dirty || command.uncertain) && !window.confirm("Sair sem confirmar as alterações deste rascunho?")) event.preventDefault() }}>Voltar aos pedidos</Link>
            <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-2 sm:gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2"><Lookup endpoint="parties" label="cliente" searchOnly selectedName={customer?.legalName} disabled={frozen} choose={value => { setCustomer(value.id === originalCustomer?.id ? originalCustomer : value); setDirty(true) }} /><Lookup endpoint="products" label="produto" searchOnly disabled={frozen || items.length >= 100} choose={value => {
              if (items.some(item => item.id === value.id)) { setError("Produto já incluído. Altere a quantidade no item existente."); return }
              const saved = initial?.items.find(item => item.productId === value.id)
              const choice = saved ? { id: saved.productId, name: saved.name, sku: saved.sku, unit: saved.unit, basePrice: saved.unitPrice } : value
              setItems(previous => [...previous, { ...value, ...choice, quantity: "1", preserved: Boolean(saved), structureColor: saved?.structureColor || "", upholsteryColor: saved?.upholsteryColor || "", plateHolderColor: saved?.plateHolderColor || "", plateHolderType: saved?.plateHolderType || "" }]); setDirty(true); setError("")
            }} /></div>
            <OrderSalesRules tenantId={tenantId} />
            <form className="space-y-2 sm:space-y-4" onSubmit={async event => {
              event.preventDefault(); setError("")
              if (!customer || !items.length || items.some(item => !quantity(item.quantity))) { setError("Selecione cliente e itens com quantidades decimais válidas."); return }
              const value = await command.send<Detail>(initial ? `/api/erp/orders/${initial.data.id}` : "/api/erp/orders", tenantId, { customerId: customer.id, dueDate, items: items.map(item => ({ productId: item.id, quantity: quantity(item.quantity), structureColor: item.structureColor, upholsteryColor: item.upholsteryColor, plateHolderColor: item.plateHolderColor, plateHolderType: item.plateHolderType })) }, initial ? etag : "", initial ? "PUT" : "POST")
              if (value) { setDirty(false); router.replace(`/vendas/pedidos/${value.data.id}`) }
            }}>
              <fieldset disabled={frozen} className="min-w-0 space-y-2 sm:space-y-4">
                <label className="block min-w-0 space-y-2">Vencimento da conta a receber<Input type="date" required value={dueDate} onChange={event => { setDueDate(event.target.value); setDirty(true) }} /></label>
                {items.map(item => <div key={item.id} role="group" aria-label={`Item do pedido: ${item.name}`} className="min-w-0 space-y-2 rounded-xl border p-2 sm:space-y-3 sm:p-4"><div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3"><ProductThumbnail id={item.id} name={item.name || item.sku || "Produto"} tenantId={tenantId} hasPhoto={item.hasPhoto} decorative /><strong className="min-w-0 break-words">{item.name}</strong></div><p className="break-all text-sm">SKU {item.sku} · {item.preserved ? "Preço registrado" : "Preço base consultado"}: {item.basePrice ? commercialMoney(item.basePrice) : "Não informado"}</p><label className="block min-w-0 space-y-2">Quantidade de {item.name}<Input required inputMode="decimal" pattern={decimalPattern(6)} maxLength={19} value={item.quantity} onChange={event => { setItems(previous => previous.map(value => value.id === item.id ? { ...value, quantity: event.target.value } : value)); setDirty(true) }} /></label>
                  <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><ColorChoice label={`Cor da estrutura de ${item.name}`} catalog={{ productId: item.id, tenantId, field: "structureColors" }} options={item.structureColors} value={item.structureColor} onChange={color => { setItems(previous => previous.map(value => value.id === item.id ? { ...value, structureColor: color } : value)); setDirty(true) }} /><ColorChoice label={`Cor dos anilheiros de ${item.name}`} catalog={{ productId: item.id, tenantId, field: "plateHolderColors" }} options={item.plateHolderColors} value={item.plateHolderColor} onChange={color => { setItems(previous => previous.map(value => value.id === item.id ? { ...value, plateHolderColor: color } : value)); setDirty(true) }} /><ColorChoice label={`Tipo de anilheiro de ${item.name}`} catalog={{ productId: item.id, tenantId, field: "plateHolderTypes" }} options={item.plateHolderTypes} value={item.plateHolderType} onChange={plateHolderType => { setItems(previous => previous.map(value => value.id === item.id ? { ...value, plateHolderType } : value)); setDirty(true) }} />{item.upholsteryConfigurable !== false && <ColorChoice palette={catalogPaletteFor(item.structureColors)} label={`${catalogPaletteFor(item.structureColors) ? "Cor dos braços" : "Cor do estofado"} de ${item.name}`} catalog={{ productId: item.id, tenantId, field: "upholsteryColors" }} options={item.upholsteryColors} value={item.upholsteryColor} onChange={color => { setItems(previous => previous.map(value => value.id === item.id ? { ...value, upholsteryColor: color } : value)); setDirty(true) }} />}</div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">O acabamento fica registrado neste item. O saldo de estoque continua controlado por produto.</p>
                  <Button type="button" variant="outline" className="h-auto min-h-10 max-w-full whitespace-normal break-words text-left" onClick={() => { setItems(previous => previous.filter(value => value.id !== item.id)); setDirty(true) }}>Remover {item.name}</Button></div>)}
              </fieldset>
              {(error || command.error) && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={error || command.error} status={error ? undefined : command.status} /></p>}
    "use client"
    
    import { DataTable } from "@/components/workspace/data-table"
    
    import Link from "next/link"
    import { useRouter } from "next/navigation"
    import { useEffect, useId, useState, type ComponentProps } from "react"
    import { ProductThumbnail } from "@/features/catalog/product-thumbnail"
    import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header"
    import { useNavigationGuard } from "@/components/shell/navigation-guard"
    import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { SearchInput } from "@/components/search-input"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { erpFetch } from "@/lib/api/client"
    import type { Schema } from "@/lib/api/types"
    import { commercialMoney, commercialMoneyInput, normalizeCommercialMoney } from "./order-presentation"
    import { quantity, useCommand, useResource } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    import { ColorChoice, Lookup, type Choice } from "./orders"
    import { ProposalDocument, type ProposalIssuer } from "./proposal-document"
    import "./proposals-print.css"
    
    type Detail = Schema<"ProposalSnapshot">
    type Listing = Schema<"ProposalList">
    type Selected = Choice & { quantity: string; structureColor: string; upholsteryColor: string; plateHolderColor: string; plateHolderType: string }
    const labels: Record<string, string> = { draft: "Rascunho", sent: "Enviada", accepted: "Aceita", rejected: "Rejeitada", cancelled: "Cancelada", expired: "Expirada", superseded: "Substituída" }
    const linkClass = "font-medium text-primary underline underline-offset-4"
    const textareaClass = "erp-commercial-text w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-background p-3"
    const money = commercialMoney
    const proposalTrail = [{ label: "Vendas", href: "/vendas" }, { label: "Propostas", href: "/vendas/propostas" }]
    
    function CommercialText({ label, ...props }: ComponentProps<"textarea"> & { label: string }) {
      const id = useId()
      return <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-1 sm:gap-2"><label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label><textarea id={id} rows={2} className={textareaClass} {...props} /></div>
    }
    
    export function Proposals({ id, create = false, edit = false }: { id?: string; create?: boolean; edit?: boolean }) {
      if (create || edit) return <ProposalEditor id={edit ? id : undefined} />
      if (id) return <ProposalDetail key={id} id={id} />
      return <ProposalList />
    }
    
    function ProposalList() {
      const statusId = useId()
      const [query, setQuery] = useState({ q: "", status: "", offset: 0 })
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ q: query.q, status: query.status, offset: String(query.offset), limit: "25" })
      const result = useResource<Listing>(`/api/erp/proposals?${params}`)
      return <>
        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3">
          {result.value?.canEdit && <Link className={buttonVariants({ size: "sm" })} href="/vendas/propostas/novo">Nova proposta</Link>}
        </div>
        <section className="min-w-0 space-y-3 text-sm" aria-label="Propostas comerciais">
          <form role="search" aria-label="Pesquisar propostas" className="grid min-w-0 items-end gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_12rem_auto]" onSubmit={event => { event.preventDefault(); const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget); setQuery({ q: String(data.get("q") || ""), status: String(data.get("status") || ""), offset: 0 }) }}>
            <label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium">Cliente ou número<SearchInput className="h-9 text-sm" onSearch={(q, form) => setQuery({ q, status: form ? String(new FormData(form).get("status") || "") : query.status, offset: 0 })} name="q" maxLength={160} /></label>
            <label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium" htmlFor={statusId}>Situação<select id={statusId} aria-label="Situação" name="status" className="h-9 w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 text-sm font-normal"><option value="">Todas</option>{Object.entries(labels).filter(([key]) => key !== "superseded").map(([key, label]) => <option key={key} value={key}>{label}</option>)}</select></label>
            <Button type="submit" className="h-9">Pesquisar propostas</Button>
          </form>
          {result.loading ? <p role="status">Carregando propostas…</p> : result.error ? <div role="alert"><RequestError message={result.error} status={result.status} /><Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={result.reload}>Tentar novamente</Button></div> : <>
            <p role="status" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{result.value?.total || 0} proposta(s)</p>
            {result.value?.data.length ? <div className="max-w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border" role="region" aria-label="Lista de propostas" tabIndex={0}>
              <DataTable>
                <caption className="sr-only">Propostas comerciais</caption>
                <thead className="bg-muted/50"><tr>
                  <th scope="col" className="p-3">Cliente</th><th scope="col" className="p-3">Situação</th><th scope="col" className="p-3 text-right">Versão</th><th scope="col" className="p-3">Validade</th><th scope="col" className="p-3 text-right">Valor</th>
                </tr></thead>
                <tbody>{result.value.data.map(item => <tr className="border-t hover:bg-muted/30" key={item.id}>
                  <td className="min-w-48 p-3"><Link className={`${linkClass} break-words`} href={`/vendas/propostas/${item.id}`}>{item.customerName}</Link></td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap p-3">{labels[item.expired ? "expired" : item.status] || item.status}</td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap p-3 text-right tabular-nums">{item.version}</td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap p-3">{item.validUntil ? item.validUntil.split("-").reverse().join("/") : "Não informado"}</td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap p-3 text-right tabular-nums">{money(item.amount)}</td>
                </tr>)}</tbody>
              </DataTable>
            </div> : <p>Nenhuma proposta encontrada para estes filtros.</p>}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3"><Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={!query.offset} onClick={() => setQuery(value => ({ ...value, offset: value.offset - 25 }))}>Anterior</Button><span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Página {Math.floor(query.offset / 25) + 1}</span><Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={query.offset + 25 >= (result.value?.total || 0)} onClick={() => setQuery(value => ({ ...value, offset: value.offset + 25 }))}>Próxima</Button></div>
          </>}
        </section>
      </>
    }
    
    function ProposalEditor({ id }: { id?: string }) {
      const result = useResource<Listing | Detail>(id ? `/api/erp/proposals/${id}` : "/api/erp/proposals?limit=1")
      if (result.loading) return <p role="status">Carregando proposta e permissões…</p>
      if (result.error || !result.value) return <section className="form-section"><p role="alert"><RequestError message={result.error || "Proposta indisponível"} status={result.status} /></p><Button onClick={result.reload}>Tentar novamente</Button></section>
      const initial = "items" in result.value ? result.value : undefined
      if (!result.value.canEdit || (initial && initial.data.status !== "draft")) return <section className="form-section space-y-4"><p>Esta proposta não está disponível para edição. É necessário um rascunho e permissão de gestão.</p><Link className={linkClass} href={id ? `/vendas/propostas/${id}` : "/vendas/propostas"}>Voltar às propostas</Link></section>
      return <ProposalForm key={`${id || "new"}:${result.etag}`} initial={initial} tenantId={result.value.tenantId} etag={result.etag} reload={result.reload} />
    }
    
    function ProposalForm({ initial, tenantId, etag, reload }: { initial?: Detail; tenantId: string; etag: string; reload: () => void }) {
      const router = useRouter()
      const command = useCommand()
      const [customer, setCustomer] = useState<Choice | null>(initial ? { id: initial.data.customerId, legalName: initial.data.customerName } : null)
      const [items, setItems] = useState<Selected[]>(() => initial?.items.map(item => ({ id: item.productId, name: item.name, sku: item.sku, unit: item.unit, basePrice: commercialMoneyInput(item.unitPrice), quantity: item.quantity, structureColor: item.structureColor || "", upholsteryColor: item.upholsteryColor || "", plateHolderColor: item.plateHolderColor || "", plateHolderType: item.plateHolderType || "" })) || [])
      const [validUntil, setValidUntil] = useState(initial?.data.validUntil || "")
      const [paymentTerms, setPaymentTerms] = useState(initial?.data.paymentTerms || "")
      const [deliveryTerms, setDeliveryTerms] = useState(initial?.data.deliveryTerms || "")
      const [notes, setNotes] = useState(initial?.data.notes || "")
      const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false)
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const frozen = command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale
      useNavigationGuard(dirty || command.uncertain ? "Sair sem confirmar as alterações desta proposta?" : null)
      useEffect(() => {
        if (!initial) return
        const controller = new AbortController()
        Promise.all(initial.items.map(async item => {
          const response = await erpFetch(`/api/erp/products/${item.productId}`, { cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal })
          const product = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok || product.tenantId !== tenantId) throw new Error("Não foi possível atualizar as opções de acabamento. As escolhas registradas foram preservadas.")
          return { id: item.productId, structureColors: product.data.structureColors || [], upholsteryConfigurable: product.data.upholsteryConfigurable, upholsteryColors: product.data.upholsteryColors || [], plateHolderColors: product.data.plateHolderColors || [], plateHolderTypes: product.data.plateHolderTypes || [], hasPhoto: product.data.hasPhoto }
        })).then(products => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setItems(previous => previous.map(item => ({ ...item, ...products.find(product => product.id === item.id) }))) })
          .catch(reason => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Falha ao consultar produtos") })
        return () => controller.abort()
      }, [initial, tenantId])
      function changeItem(id: string, patch: Partial<Selected>) { setItems(previous => previous.map(item => item.id === id ? { ...item, ...patch } : item)); setDirty(true) }
      return <><PageHeader eyebrow="Vendas / Propostas" breadcrumbs={[...proposalTrail, ...(initial ? [{ label: `Proposta ${initial.data.number}`, href: `/vendas/propostas/${initial.data.id}` }, { label: "Editar" }] : [{ label: "Nova proposta" }])]} title={initial ? `Editar proposta ${initial.data.number} · versão ${initial.data.version}` : "Nova proposta"} description="Defina o escopo e as condições comerciais. O rascunho fica salvo na empresa ativa." />
        <section className="form-section min-w-0 space-y-3 sm:space-y-5">
          <Link className={linkClass} href={initial ? `/vendas/propostas/${initial.data.id}` : "/vendas/propostas"} onClick={event => { if ((dirty || command.uncertain) && !window.confirm("Sair sem confirmar as alterações desta proposta?")) event.preventDefault() }}>Voltar às propostas</Link>
          <div className="grid items-start gap-2 sm:gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2"><Lookup endpoint="parties" label="cliente" searchOnly selectedName={customer?.legalName} disabled={frozen} choose={value => { setCustomer(value); setDirty(true) }} /><Lookup endpoint="products" label="produto" searchOnly disabled={frozen || items.length >= 100} choose={value => {
            if (items.some(item => item.id === value.id)) { setError("Produto já incluído. Altere a quantidade do item existente."); return }
            const saved = initial?.items.find(item => item.productId === value.id)
            setItems(previous => [...previous, { ...value, ...(saved ? { name: saved.name, sku: saved.sku, basePrice: saved.unitPrice } : {}), basePrice: commercialMoneyInput(saved?.unitPrice || value.basePrice || ""), quantity: "1", structureColor: saved?.structureColor || "", upholsteryColor: saved?.upholsteryColor || "", plateHolderColor: saved?.plateHolderColor || "", plateHolderType: saved?.plateHolderType || "" }]); setDirty(true); setError("")
          }} /></div>
          <form className="space-y-3 sm:space-y-5" onSubmit={async event => {
            event.preventDefault(); setError("")
            if (!customer || !items.length || items.some(item => !quantity(item.quantity) || !normalizeCommercialMoney(item.basePrice || ""))) { setError("Selecione cliente e itens com quantidades e preços válidos."); return }
            const value = await command.send<Detail>(initial ? `/api/erp/proposals/${initial.data.id}` : "/api/erp/proposals", tenantId, { customerId: customer.id, validUntil, paymentTerms, deliveryTerms, notes, items: items.map(item => ({ productId: item.id, quantity: quantity(item.quantity), unitPrice: normalizeCommercialMoney(item.basePrice || ""), structureColor: item.structureColor || null, upholsteryColor: item.upholsteryColor || null, plateHolderColor: item.plateHolderColor || null, plateHolderType: item.plateHolderType || null })) }, initial ? etag : "", initial ? "PUT" : "POST")
            if (value) { setDirty(false); router.replace(`/vendas/propostas/${value.data.id}`) }
          }}>
            <fieldset disabled={frozen} className="min-w-0 space-y-2 sm:space-y-4" onChange={() => setDirty(true)}>
              <label className="grid min-w-0 grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] gap-2">Validade da proposta<Input type="date" className="block max-w-full appearance-none [&::-webkit-date-and-time-value]:min-w-0 [&::-webkit-date-and-time-value]:text-start" required value={validUntil} onChange={event => setValidUntil(event.target.value)} /></label>
              <CommercialText label="Condições de pagamento" required maxLength={2000} value={paymentTerms} onChange={event => setPaymentTerms(event.target.value)} />
              <CommercialText label="Condições de entrega" required maxLength={2000} value={deliveryTerms} onChange={event => setDeliveryTerms(event.target.value)} />
              <CommercialText label="Observações" maxLength={10000} value={notes} onChange={event => setNotes(event.target.value)} />
              {items.map(item => <section className="min-w-0 space-y-2 rounded-xl border p-2 sm:space-y-3 sm:p-4" key={item.id} aria-label={`Item da proposta: ${item.name}`}>
                <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
                  <ProductThumbnail id={item.id} name={item.name || item.sku || "Produto"} tenantId={tenantId} hasPhoto={item.hasPhoto} />
                  <h2 className="min-w-0 break-words font-medium">{item.name} · {item.sku}</h2>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,3fr)_minmax(0,2fr)] items-end gap-2 sm:gap-3">
                  <label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1">Preço unitário (R$)<Input aria-label={`Preço unitário de ${item.name}`} readOnly value={item.basePrice || ""} /></label>
                  <label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1">Quantidade<Input aria-label={`Quantidade de ${item.name}`} inputMode="decimal" required value={item.quantity} onChange={event => changeItem(item.id, { quantity: event.target.value })} /></label>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Preço unitário somente para consulta nesta proposta.</p>
                <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2"><ColorChoice label={`Estrutura de ${item.name}`} catalog={{ productId: item.id, tenantId, field: "structureColors" }} options={item.structureColors} value={item.structureColor} onChange={value => changeItem(item.id, { structureColor: value })} />{(item.plateHolderTypes?.length || item.plateHolderColors?.length || item.plateHolderType || item.plateHolderColor) ? <ColorChoice label={`Cor dos anilheiros de ${item.name}`} catalog={{ productId: item.id, tenantId, field: "plateHolderColors" }} options={item.plateHolderColors} value={item.plateHolderColor} onChange={value => changeItem(item.id, { plateHolderColor: value })} /> : null}<ColorChoice label={`Tipo de anilheiro de ${item.name}`} catalog={{ productId: item.id, tenantId, field: "plateHolderTypes" }} options={item.plateHolderTypes} value={item.plateHolderType} onChange={value => changeItem(item.id, { plateHolderType: value })} />{item.upholsteryConfigurable !== false && <ColorChoice label={`Estofado de ${item.name}`} catalog={{ productId: item.id, tenantId, field: "upholsteryColors" }} options={item.upholsteryColors} value={item.upholsteryColor} onChange={value => changeItem(item.id, { upholsteryColor: value })} />}</div>
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" className="h-auto max-w-full whitespace-normal break-words text-left" onClick={() => { setItems(previous => previous.filter(value => value.id !== item.id)); setDirty(true) }}>Remover {item.name}</Button>
              </section>)}
            </fieldset>
            {(error || command.error) && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={error || command.error} status={error ? undefined : command.status} /></p>}
            {command.stale && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { if (window.confirm("Recarregar e descartar as alterações locais?")) { command.reset(); reload() } }}>Recarregar proposta</Button>}
            {command.uncertain && <p role="status">Resultado pendente. Repita a confirmação para conferir o mesmo comando.</p>}
            <Button type="submit" disabled={command.busy || command.stale || !customer || !items.length}>{command.busy ? "Confirmando…" : command.uncertain ? "Repetir confirmação" : "Salvar proposta"}</Button>
          </form>
        </section>
      </>
    }
    
    function ProposalDetail({ id }: { id: string }) {
      const [version, setVersion] = useState("")
      const result = useResource<Detail>(`/api/erp/proposals/${id}${version ? `?version=${version}` : ""}`)
      const access = useResource<{ tenant: { id: string; legalName: string }; permissions: string[] }>("/api/erp/me")
      const issuer = useResource<{ tenantId: string; data: ProposalIssuer }>("/api/erp/company")
      const command = useCommand()
      const [action, setAction] = useState("")
      const [reason, setReason] = useState("")
      const [dueDate, setDueDate] = useState("")
      const [notice, setNotice] = useState("")
      const value = result.value
      const frozen = command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale
      const sameTenant = access.value?.tenant.id === value?.tenantId
      const canDecide = sameTenant && access.value?.permissions.includes("sales.proposals.decide")
      const canConvert = sameTenant && ["sales.orders.read", "sales.orders.manage"].every(permission => access.value?.permissions.includes(permission))
      async function confirm() {
        if (!value || !action) return
        const body = action === "convert" ? { dueDate } : action === "revise" ? {} : { reason: reason || null }
        const updated = await command.send<Detail>(`/api/erp/proposals/${id}/${action}`, value.tenantId, body, result.etag)
        if (updated) { setNotice("Operação confirmada no servidor."); setAction(""); setReason(""); setVersion(""); result.reload() }
      }
      return <><div className="print:hidden"><PageHeader eyebrow="Vendas / Propostas" breadcrumbs={[...proposalTrail, { label: value ? `Proposta ${value.data.number} · versão ${value.data.version}` : "Proposta" }]} title={value ? `Proposta ${value.data.number}` : "Proposta comercial"} description="Consulte o documento comercial e registre as decisões sobre cada versão." /></div>
        <div className="print:hidden"><Link className={linkClass} href="/vendas/propostas">Voltar às propostas</Link></div>
        <section className="mt-5 min-w-0 space-y-5">
          {notice && <p role="status" className="print:hidden">{notice}</p>}
          {result.loading ? <p role="status">Carregando proposta…</p> : result.error ? <div role="alert"><RequestError message={result.error} status={result.status} /><Button onClick={result.reload}>Tentar novamente</Button></div> : value && <>
            <div className="flex justify-end print:hidden"><Button variant="outline" onClick={() => window.print()}>Imprimir / salvar PDF</Button></div>
            <label className="grid gap-2 print:hidden">Histórico de versões<select className="min-h-10 rounded-lg border bg-background px-3" value={version} disabled={frozen} onChange={event => { setVersion(event.target.value); setAction("") }}><option value="">Versão atual</option>{value.versions.map(item => <option key={item.version} value={String(item.version)}>Versão {item.version} · {labels[item.status]} · {money(item.amount)}</option>)}</select></label>
            <ProposalDocument snapshot={value} issuer={issuer.value?.tenantId === value.tenantId ? issuer.value.data : undefined} issuerName={sameTenant ? access.value?.tenant.legalName : undefined} />
            {value.data.decisionReason && <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap print:hidden">Motivo registrado: {value.data.decisionReason}</p>}
            {value.data.orderId && <Link className={`${linkClass} print:hidden`} href={`/vendas/pedidos/${value.data.orderId}`}>Consultar pedido gerado</Link>}
            {!value.data.isCurrent && <p className="print:hidden">Versão histórica. Consulte a versão atual para realizar operações.</p>}
            <div className="space-y-4 print:hidden">
              {command.error && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={command.error} status={command.status} /></p>}
              {command.stale && <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => { command.reset(); setAction(""); result.reload() }}>Recarregar proposta</Button>}
              {value.data.isCurrent && !value.data.orderId && !action && <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                {value.canEdit && value.data.status === "draft" && <><Link className={linkClass} href={`/vendas/propostas/${id}/editar`}>Editar rascunho</Link><Button disabled={frozen} onClick={() => setAction("send")}>Marcar como enviada</Button></>}
                {canDecide && value.data.status === "sent" && <><Button disabled={frozen || value.data.expired} onClick={() => setAction("accept")}>Registrar aceite</Button><Button disabled={frozen} variant="outline" onClick={() => setAction("reject")}>Registrar rejeição</Button></>}
                {value.canEdit && ["sent", "accepted", "rejected"].includes(value.data.status) && <Button disabled={frozen} variant="outline" onClick={() => setAction("revise")}>Criar nova versão</Button>}
                {value.canEdit && ["draft", "sent", "accepted"].includes(value.data.status) && <Button disabled={frozen} variant="outline" onClick={() => setAction("cancel")}>Cancelar proposta</Button>}
                {value.canEdit && canConvert && value.data.status === "accepted" && <Button disabled={frozen} onClick={() => setAction("convert")}>Gerar pedido em rascunho</Button>}
              </div>}
              {action && <form className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border p-4" onSubmit={event => { event.preventDefault(); void confirm() }}>
    "use client"
    
    import { useState } from "react"
    import Link from "next/link"
    import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header"
    import { DataTable } from "@/components/workspace/data-table"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { useResource } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    import { money, percent, type PriceTable } from "./negotiation-types"
    
    export function CommercialTable() {
      const [line, setLine] = useState("imported")
      const [query, setQuery] = useState("")
      const [offset, setOffset] = useState(0)
      const table = useResource<PriceTable>(`/api/erp/commercial/tables/${line}`)
      const items = (table.value?.data?.items || []).filter(item => `${item.name} ${item.sku}`.toLocaleLowerCase("pt-BR").includes(query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("pt-BR")))
      const limit = 14
      return <main className="mx-auto min-w-0 max-w-6xl space-y-5 px-4 pb-24 pt-6 [--workspace-control-height:2.25rem]">
        <PageHeader eyebrow="Vendas" title="Tabela de preços" description="Consulte a versão publicada e simule as condições antes de criar o pedido." />
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3"><Link className="text-primary underline" href="/vendas/simulador">Simulador</Link>{table.value?.canManage && <><Link className="inline-flex h-9 items-center rounded-lg bg-primary px-3 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground" href={`/preferencias/tabela-precos?linha=${line}`}>Nova tabela de preços</Link><Link className="text-primary underline" href="/preferencias/comercial">Preços e metas por destino</Link></>}</div>
        <div className="flex gap-2" aria-label="Linha comercial">{[["imported", "Importada"], ["national", "Nacional"]].map(([value, label]) => <Button key={value} variant={line === value ? "default" : "outline"} aria-pressed={line === value} onClick={() => { setLine(value); setOffset(0) }}>{label}</Button>)}</div>
        <label className="grid gap-2">Buscar equipamento por nome ou código<Input type="search" value={query} onChange={e => { setQuery(e.target.value); setOffset(0) }} /></label>
        {table.loading ? <p role="status">Carregando tabela…</p> : table.error ? <div role="alert"><RequestError message={table.error} status={table.status} /><Button variant="outline" onClick={table.reload}>Tentar novamente</Button></div> : !table.value?.data ? <section className="form-section space-y-3"><p>Nenhuma tabela publicada nesta linha.</p>{table.value?.canManage && <Link className="text-primary underline" href={`/preferencias/tabela-precos?linha=${line}`}>Criar tabela de preços</Link>}</section> : <>
          <p>Tabela v{table.value.data.version} · {new Date(table.value.data.publishedAt).toLocaleDateString("pt-BR")} · Preço em destaque com IPI</p>
          <div className="min-w-0 overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border">
            <DataTable aria-label="Preços publicados">
              <thead><tr><th>Equipamento</th><th className="text-right">Sem IPI</th><th className="text-right">Com IPI</th><th className="text-right">Desconto livre</th><th><span className="sr-only">Ações</span></th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{items.slice(offset, offset + limit).map(item => <tr key={item.productId}>
                <td><Link className="font-medium text-primary underline" href={`/cadastros/produtos/${item.productId}`}>{item.name}</Link><div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{item.sku}</div></td>
                <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-right tabular-nums">{money(item.priceWithoutIpiCents)}</td>
                <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-right font-semibold tabular-nums">{money(item.priceWithIpiCents)}</td>
                <td className="text-right tabular-nums">{percent(table.value!.data!.freeDiscountBps)}</td>
                <td className="whitespace-nowrap"><Link className="text-primary underline" href={`/vendas/simulador?linha=${line}&produto=${item.productId}`}>Simular pedido</Link></td>
              </tr>)}</tbody>
            </DataTable>
          </div>
          {!items.length && <p role="status">Nenhum equipamento corresponde à busca.</p>}
          <nav aria-label="Paginação da tabela" className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>{items.length ? `${offset + 1} a ${Math.min(offset + limit, items.length)} de ${items.length}` : "0 equipamentos"}</span><div className="flex gap-2"><Button variant="outline" disabled={offset === 0} onClick={() => setOffset(value => Math.max(0, value - limit))}>Anterior</Button><Button variant="outline" disabled={offset + limit >= items.length} onClick={() => setOffset(value => value + limit)}>Próxima</Button></div></nav>
        </>}
      </main>
    }
    "use client"
    
    import { erpFetch } from "@/lib/api/client"
    
    import type { Schema } from "@/lib/api/types"
    
    import Link from "next/link"
    import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { SearchInput } from "@/components/search-input"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { decimalPattern, normalizeDecimal } from "@/lib/decimal-input"
    
    type Stock = Schema<"Stock">
    type Movement = Schema<"Movement">
    type StockList = Schema<"StockList">
    type History = Schema<"MovementList">
    type Draft = { direction: "receipt" | "issue"; quantity: string; reason: string }
    const blank: Draft = { direction: "receipt", quantity: "", reason: "" }
    const selectClass = "block h-9 w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
    
    export function StockWorkspace() {
      const [query, setQuery] = useState({ q: "", offset: 0 })
      const [stocks, setStocks] = useState<StockList | null>(null)
      const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
      const [listError, setListError] = useState("")
      const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Stock | null>(null)
      const [history, setHistory] = useState<History | null>(null)
      const [historyOffset, setHistoryOffset] = useState(0)
      const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false)
      const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState("")
      const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Draft>({ ...blank })
      const [reversal, setReversal] = useState<Movement | null>(null)
      const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
      const [uncertain, setUncertain] = useState(false)
      const [writeError, setWriteError] = useState("")
      const [notice, setNotice] = useState("")
      const [refresh, setRefresh] = useState(0)
      const pending = useRef(false)
      const command = useRef<{ key: string; body: string } | null>(null)
      const dirty = Boolean(draft.quantity || draft.reason || reversal)
    
      useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController()
        const params = new URLSearchParams({ q: query.q, offset: String(query.offset), limit: "25" })
        erpFetch(`/api/erp/stock?${params}`, { cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal }).then(async response => {
          const value = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(value.title || "Estoque indisponível")
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setStocks(value); setListError("") }
        }).catch(error => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setStocks(null); setListError(error.message) } })
          .finally(() => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false) })
        return () => controller.abort()
      }, [query, refresh])
    
      useEffect(() => {
        if (!selected) return
        const controller = new AbortController()
        const params = new URLSearchParams({ productId: selected.productId, offset: String(historyOffset), limit: "25" })
        erpFetch(`/api/erp/stock/movements?${params}`, { cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal }).then(async response => {
          const value = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(value.title || "Histórico indisponível")
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setHistory(value); setHistoryError("") }
        }).catch(error => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setHistory(null); setHistoryError(error.message) } })
          .finally(() => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setHistoryLoading(false) })
        return () => controller.abort()
      }, [selected, historyOffset, refresh])
    
      useEffect(() => {
        const prevent = (event: BeforeUnloadEvent) => { if (dirty || uncertain) event.preventDefault() }
        window.addEventListener("beforeunload", prevent)
        return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", prevent)
      }, [dirty, uncertain])
    
      function choose(stock: Stock) {
        if (pending.current || uncertain) return
        if (dirty && !window.confirm("Descartar o lançamento ainda não confirmado?")) return
        setSelected(stock); setHistory(null); setHistoryOffset(0); setHistoryLoading(true)
        setDraft({ ...blank }); setReversal(null); setWriteError(""); setNotice(""); command.current = null
      }
    
      async function save(event: React.FormEvent) {
        event.preventDefault()
        if (!selected || !stocks?.canEdit || !history?.canEdit || pending.current) return
        const normalizedQuantity = normalizeDecimal(draft.quantity, 6)
        if (!uncertain && normalizedQuantity === null) {
          setWriteError("Informe quantidade decimal positiva com até seis casas e sem zeros à esquerda")
          return
        }
        pending.current = true; setSaving(true); setWriteError(""); setNotice("")
        if (!uncertain) command.current = {
          key: crypto.randomUUID(),
          body: JSON.stringify({ productId: selected.productId, ...draft, quantity: normalizedQuantity, reversesId: reversal?.id || null }),
        }
        try {
          const response = await erpFetch("/api/erp/stock/movements", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Tenant-Id": stocks.tenantId, "Idempotency-Key": command.current!.key },
            body: command.current!.body,
          })
          const value = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) {
            setUncertain(response.status >= 500)
            throw new Error(value.title || "Lançamento recusado")
          }
          setUncertain(false); command.current = null; setDraft({ ...blank }); setReversal(null)
          setNotice(`Movimento confirmado. Saldo após o lançamento: ${value.balanceAfter} ${selected.unit}.`)
          setSelected({ ...selected, quantity: value.balanceAfter }); setHistoryOffset(0)
          setHistoryLoading(true); setLoading(true); setRefresh(value => value + 1)
        } catch (error) {
          // A lost response can follow a committed transaction: preserve the exact command for retry.
          if (error instanceof TypeError || error instanceof SyntaxError) setUncertain(true)
          setWriteError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Não foi possível confirmar o lançamento")
        } finally { pending.current = false; setSaving(false) }
      }
    
      return <div className="mx-auto w-full min-w-0 max-w-[1600px] px-4 pb-24 pt-6 sm:px-6">
    
        <section className="form-section min-w-0 space-y-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3"><h2 className="font-semibold">Saldos por produto</h2><Link className="text-primary underline" href="/cadastros/produtos">Consultar catálogo</Link></div>
          <form className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3" onSubmit={event => {
            event.preventDefault(); setLoading(true)
            setQuery({ q: String(new FormData(event.currentTarget).get("q") || ""), offset: 0 })
          }}>
            <label className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-2">Buscar produto ou SKU<SearchInput onSearch={q => { setLoading(true); setQuery({ q, offset: 0 }) }} name="q" maxLength={160} /></label>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={loading}>Buscar</Button>
          </form>
          <Link className="inline-flex min-h-11 w-fit items-center font-medium text-primary underline underline-offset-4" href="/cadastros/produtos/novo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Cadastrar produto</Link>
          {loading ? <p role="status">Carregando saldos…</p> : listError ? <div role="alert" className="space-y-3"><p>{listError}</p><Button variant="outline" onClick={() => { setLoading(true); setRefresh(value => value + 1) }}>Tentar novamente</Button></div> : stocks && <>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{stocks.total} produto(s) · {stocks.canEdit ? "Consulta e movimentação" : "Somente consulta"}</p>
            {stocks.data.length ? <ul className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">{stocks.data.map(stock => <li className="min-w-0" key={stock.productId}>
              <button className="h-full w-full rounded-xl border p-4 text-left hover:border-primary disabled:opacity-60" disabled={saving || uncertain} aria-pressed={selected?.productId === stock.productId} onClick={() => choose(stock)}>
                <strong className="block break-words">{stock.name}</strong><span className="block break-all text-sm text-muted-foreground">SKU {stock.sku} · {stock.status === "active" ? "Ativo" : "Arquivado"}</span>
                <span className="mt-2 block break-all font-medium">Saldo: {stock.quantity} {stock.unit}</span>
                <span className="mt-1 block break-all text-sm">Reservado: {stock.reserved} · Disponível: {stock.available}</span>
              </button>
            </li>)}</ul> : <p>Nenhum produto encontrado. Cadastre um produto para movimentar o estoque.</p>}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><Button variant="outline" disabled={!query.offset} onClick={() => { setLoading(true); setQuery({ ...query, offset: query.offset - 25 }) }}>Anterior</Button><span className="text-sm">Página {query.offset / 25 + 1}</span><Button variant="outline" disabled={query.offset + 25 >= stocks.total} onClick={() => { setLoading(true); setQuery({ ...query, offset: query.offset + 25 }) }}>Próxima</Button></div>
          </>}
        </section>
    
        {selected && <section className="form-section mt-5 min-w-0 space-y-5" aria-label="Movimentos do produto">
          <h2 className="break-words font-semibold">Movimentos de {selected.name}</h2>
          {notice && <p role="status">{notice}</p>}
          {historyLoading ? <p role="status">Carregando movimentos…</p> : historyError ? <div role="alert"><p>{historyError}</p><Button variant="outline" onClick={() => { setHistoryLoading(true); setRefresh(value => value + 1) }}>Recarregar histórico</Button></div> : history && <>
            {!history.canEdit && <p>Somente consulta. Você não pode movimentar o estoque.</p>}
            {history.canEdit && stocks?.canEdit && <form onSubmit={save} className="space-y-4">
              <h3 className="font-medium">{reversal ? "Estornar movimento" : "Novo lançamento"}</h3>

    name: dispatching-parallel-agents
    description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies

    # Dispatching Parallel Agents
    
    ## Overview
    
    You delegate tasks to specialized agents with isolated context. By precisely crafting their instructions and context, you ensure they stay focused and succeed at their task. They should never inherit your session's context or history — you construct exactly what they need. This also preserves your own context for coordination work.
    
    When you have multiple unrelated failures (different test files, different subsystems, different bugs), investigating them sequentially wastes time. Each investigation is independent and can happen in parallel.
    
    **Core principle:** Dispatch one agent per independent problem domain. Let them work concurrently.
    
    ## When to Use
    
    ```dot
    digraph when_to_use {
        "Multiple failures?" [shape=diamond];
        "Are they independent?" [shape=diamond];
        "Single agent investigates all" [shape=box];
        "One agent per problem domain" [shape=box];
        "Can they work in parallel?" [shape=diamond];
        "Sequential agents" [shape=box];
        "Parallel dispatch" [shape=box];
    
        "Multiple failures?" -> "Are they independent?" [label="yes"];
        "Are they independent?" -> "Single agent investigates all" [label="no - related"];
        "Are they independent?" -> "Can they work in parallel?" [label="yes"];
        "Can they work in parallel?" -> "Parallel dispatch" [label="yes"];
        "Can they work in parallel?" -> "Sequential agents" [label="no - shared state"];
    }
    ```
    
    **Use when:**
    - 3+ test files failing with different root causes
    - Multiple subsystems broken independently
    - Each problem can be understood without context from others
    - No shared state between investigations
    
    **Don't use when:**
    - Failures are related (fix one might fix others)
    - Need to understand full system state
    - Agents would interfere with each other
    
    ## The Pattern
    
    ### 1. Identify Independent Domains
    
    Group failures by what's broken:
    - File A tests: Tool approval flow
    - File B tests: Batch completion behavior
    - File C tests: Abort functionality
    
    Each domain is independent - fixing tool approval doesn't affect abort tests.
    
    ### 2. Create Focused Agent Tasks
    
    Each agent gets:
    - **Specific scope:** One test file or subsystem
    - **Clear goal:** Make these tests pass
    - **Constraints:** Don't change other code
    - **Expected output:** Summary of what you found and fixed
    
    ### 3. Dispatch in Parallel
    
    Issue all three subagent dispatches in the same response — they run in parallel:
    
    ```text
    Subagent (general-purpose): "Fix agent-tool-abort.test.ts failures"
    Subagent (general-purpose): "Fix batch-completion-behavior.test.ts failures"
    Subagent (general-purpose): "Fix tool-approval-race-conditions.test.ts failures"
    # All three run concurrently.
    ```
    
    Multiple dispatch calls in one response = parallel execution. One per response = sequential.
    
    ### 4. Review and Integrate
    
    When agents return:
    - Read each summary
    - Verify fixes don't conflict
    - Run full test suite
    - Integrate all changes
    
    ## Agent Prompt Structure
    
    Good agent prompts are:
    1. **Focused** - One clear problem domain
    2. **Self-contained** - All context needed to understand the problem
    3. **Specific about output** - What should the agent return?
    
    ```markdown
    Fix the 3 failing tests in src/agents/agent-tool-abort.test.ts:
    
    1. "should abort tool with partial output capture" - expects 'interrupted at' in message
    2. "should handle mixed completed and aborted tools" - fast tool aborted instead of completed
    3. "should properly track pendingToolCount" - expects 3 results but gets 0
    
    These are timing/race condition issues. Your task:
    
    1. Read the test file and understand what each test verifies
    2. Identify root cause - timing issues or actual bugs?
    3. Fix by:
       - Replacing arbitrary timeouts with event-based waiting
       - Fixing bugs in abort implementation if found
       - Adjusting test expectations if testing changed behavior
    
    Do NOT just increase timeouts - find the real issue.
    
    Return: Summary of what you found and what you fixed.
    ```
    
    ## Common Mistakes
    
    **❌ Too broad:** "Fix all the tests" - agent gets lost
    **✅ Specific:** "Fix agent-tool-abort.test.ts" - focused scope
    
    **❌ No context:** "Fix the race condition" - agent doesn't know where
    **✅ Context:** Paste the error messages and test names
    
    **❌ No constraints:** Agent might refactor everything
    **✅ Constraints:** "Do NOT change production code" or "Fix tests only"
    
    **❌ Vague output:** "Fix it" - you don't know what changed
    **✅ Specific:** "Return summary of root cause and changes"
    
    ## When NOT to Use
    
    **Related failures:** Fixing one might fix others - investigate together first
    **Need full context:** Understanding requires seeing entire system
    **Exploratory debugging:** You don't know what's broken yet
    **Shared state:** Agents would interfere (editing same files, using same resources)
    
    ## Real Example from Session
    
    **Scenario:** 6 test failures across 3 files after major refactoring
    
    **Failures:**
    - agent-tool-abort.test.ts: 3 failures (timing issues)
    - batch-completion-behavior.test.ts: 2 failures (tools not executing)
    - tool-approval-race-conditions.test.ts: 1 failure (execution count = 0)
    
    **Decision:** Independent domains - abort logic separate from batch completion separate from race conditions
    
    **Dispatch:**
    ```
    Agent 1 → Fix agent-tool-abort.test.ts
    Agent 2 → Fix batch-completion-behavior.test.ts
    Agent 3 → Fix tool-approval-race-conditions.test.ts
    ```
    
    **Results:**
    - Agent 1: Replaced timeouts with event-based waiting
    - Agent 2: Fixed event structure bug (threadId in wrong place)
    - Agent 3: Added wait for async tool execution to complete
    
    **Integration:** All fixes independent, no conflicts, full suite green
    
    ## Verification
    
    After agents return:
    1. **Review each summary** - Understand what changed
    2. **Check for conflicts** - Did agents edit same code?
    3. **Run full suite** - Verify all fixes work together
    4. **Spot check** - Agents can make systematic errors

    type Receivable = Schema<"Receivable">
    type Detail = Schema<"ReceivableSnapshot">

    function situation(account: Receivable) {
      if (account.status === "cancelled") return "Cancelado"
      return account.status === "paid" ? "Recebimento declarado" : account.receivedAmount === "0.00" ? "Em aberto" : "Recebimento parcial declarado"
    }
    
    export function Receivables({ id }: { id?: string }) {
      return id ? <ReceivableDetail key={id} id={id} /> : <ReceivableList />

        <section className="form-section mt-5 min-w-0 space-y-5">

            {!value.canEdit ? <p>Somente consulta.</p> : cancelled ? <p>Título cancelado. O histórico foi preservado.</p> : <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={async event => {

              if (!reversing && normalizedAmount === null) return
              const body = reversing ? { paymentId: reversalId, reason: reference, occurredOn } : { amount: normalizedAmount, method, reference, occurredOn, financialAccountId: financialAccountId || null }
              const response = await command.send<Detail>(`/api/erp/receivables/${id}/${reversing ? "reverse-payment" : "payments"}`, value.tenantId, body, result.etag)
              if (response) { setNotice("Registro confirmado no servidor."); clearForm(); result.reload() }

                <label className="min-w-0 space-y-2">{reversing ? "Data do estorno" : "Data do recebimento"}<Input required type="date" value={occurredOn} onChange={event => setOccurredOn(event.target.value)} /></label>
                <label className="min-w-0 space-y-2">{reversing ? "Motivo do estorno" : "Referência do recebimento"}<Input required minLength={3} maxLength={200} value={reference} onChange={event => setReference(event.target.value)} /></label>
              </fieldset>

              {command.uncertain && <p role="status">Confirmação pendente. A repetição usa o mesmo comando.</p>}
              {command.stale && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => {

              <Button className="h-auto max-w-full whitespace-normal" type="submit" disabled={command.busy || command.stale || !result.etag}>{command.busy ? "Confirmando…" : command.uncertain ? "Repetir confirmação financeira" : reversing ? "Confirmar estorno do recebimento" : "Confirmar recebimento declarado"}</Button>
              {reversing && !paid && <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={frozen} onClick={() => { clearForm(); command.reset() }}>Voltar ao recebimento</Button>}
            </form>}
            <h3 className="font-medium">Histórico de recebimentos</h3>

          </>}
        </section>
      </>

    import { catalogColorPhoto, type CatalogPalette } from "./catalog-color-photo-model"
    
    type CatalogColorPhotosProps = {
      label: string
      options?: readonly string[]
      value?: string
      onChange?: (value: string) => void
      disabled?: boolean
      palette?: CatalogPalette
      readOnly?: boolean
    }
    
    export function CatalogColorPhotos({ label, options, value, onChange, disabled, palette, readOnly = false }: CatalogColorPhotosProps) {
      const matches = [...new Set(options ?? [])].flatMap(option => {
        const photo = catalogColorPhoto(option, palette)
        return photo || readOnly ? [{ option, photo }] : []
      })
      if (!matches.length) return null
    
      return <div className="space-y-2" role="group" aria-label={`${label}: fotos do catálogo DHZ`}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {matches.map(({ option, photo }) => {
            if (!photo) return <span key={option} className="self-center rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-sm">{option}</span>
            const scale = 56 / photo.width
            const content = <>
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="flex h-10 items-center"><span className="block shrink-0 rounded-sm" style={{
                width: 56,
                height: photo.height * scale,
                backgroundImage: 'url("/catalog/dhz-hammerforce-pro-original-colors.jpeg")',
                backgroundRepeat: "no-repeat",
                backgroundSize: `${1245 * scale}px ${1759 * scale}px`,
                backgroundPosition: `${-photo.x * scale}px ${-photo.y * scale}px`,
              }} /></span>
              <span className="break-words">{option}</span>
            </>
            const cardClass = "flex w-24 flex-col items-center gap-1 rounded-md border p-2 text-center text-xs"
            return readOnly ? <div key={option} className={cardClass}>{content}</div> : <button key={option} type="button" disabled={disabled || !onChange} aria-pressed={value === option} onClick={() => onChange?.(option)} title={option}
              className={`${cardClass} focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${value === option ? "border-primary ring-1 ring-primary" : "border-border hover:border-primary"}`}>{content}</button>
          })}
        </div>
        {matches.some(match => match.photo) && <a className="text-xs text-muted-foreground underline underline-offset-2" href="/catalog/dhz-hammerforce-pro-original-colors.jpeg" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Ver cores no catálogo DHZ · HammerForce Pro, pág. 101</a>}
      </div>
    }

    test("BFF encaminha pesquisa e paginação e rejeita filtros desconhecidos ou duplicados", async ({ context }) => {
      const requests: string[] = []
      const server = createServer((request, response) => {
        requests.push(request.url || "")
        response.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "application/json" })
        response.end(JSON.stringify({ tenantId: tenant, canEdit: false, data: [], total: 0 }))
      })
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => { server.once("error", reject); server.listen(33119, "127.0.0.1", resolve) })
      try {
        const response = await context.request.get("/api/erp/orders?q=Cliente%20%26%20Filhos&offset=25&limit=25")
        expect(response.status()).toBe(200)
        expect(requests).toEqual(["/api/v1/orders?q=Cliente+%26+Filhos&offset=25&limit=25"])
        for (const query of ["q=a&q=b", "unknown=1"]) expect((await context.request.get(`/api/erp/orders?${query}`)).status()).toBe(400)
        expect(requests).toHaveLength(1)
      } finally {
        await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve()))
      }
    })

    "use client"
    
    import { useId, useState } from "react"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { useCommand, useResource } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    import { orderNumber } from "./order-presentation"
    
    type Delivery = { id: string; status: "sent" | "failed" | "uncertain"; recipient: string; createdAt: string }
    type EmailStatus = { tenantId: string; recipient: string | null; canSend: boolean; emailReady: boolean; deliveries: Delivery[] }
    type Receipt = { tenantId: string; revision: number; delivery: Delivery }
    const deliveryLabels = { sent: "Aceito pelo servidor de e-mail", failed: "Recusado pelo servidor de e-mail", uncertain: "Confirmação pendente · não reenviar" }
    
    export function OrderEmail({ id, number, tenantId, etag, onReload }: { id: string; number: string; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void }) {
      const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
      // Only consult delivery configuration/history when the composer is opened.
      return <>
        <Button variant="outline" className="h-9 px-3" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Enviar por e-mail</Button>
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
          <DialogContent className="max-h-[90dvh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-xl">
            <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Enviar {orderNumber(number)} por e-mail</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>Confira o destinatário e a mensagem antes de enviar o documento do pedido.</DialogDescription></DialogHeader>
            {open && <OrderEmailComposer id={id} number={number} tenantId={tenantId} etag={etag} onReload={onReload} />}
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </>
    }
    
    function OrderEmailComposer({ id, number, tenantId, etag, onReload }: { id: string; number: string; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void }) {
      const messageId = useId()
      const resource = useResource<EmailStatus>(`/api/erp/orders/${id}/email`)
      const command = useCommand()
      const [recipientOverride, setRecipientOverride] = useState<string | null>(null)
      const [subject, setSubject] = useState(`Pedido ${orderNumber(number)}`)
      const [message, setMessage] = useState(`Olá,\n\nSegue em anexo o pedido ${orderNumber(number)} para sua conferência.\n\nFicamos à disposição.`)
      const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState<Delivery | null>(null)
      const value = resource.value?.tenantId === tenantId ? resource.value : null
      const recipient = recipientOverride ?? value?.recipient ?? ""
      const pendingDelivery = receipt?.status === "uncertain" || value?.deliveries.some(delivery => delivery.status === "uncertain")
      const frozen = command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale || !!pendingDelivery || receipt?.status === "sent"
      if (resource.loading && !value) return <p role="status">Consultando envio de e-mail…</p>
      if (resource.error || !value) return <div className="space-y-3"><p role="alert"><RequestError message={resource.error || "Não foi possível consultar o envio deste pedido."} status={resource.status} /></p><Button variant="outline" onClick={resource.reload}>Consultar novamente</Button></div>
      return <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={async event => {
        event.preventDefault()
        if (!command.uncertain && (!value.canSend || !value.emailReady || frozen)) return
        const result = await command.send<Receipt>(`/api/erp/orders/${id}/email`, tenantId, { recipient, subject, message }, etag)
        if (result?.tenantId === tenantId) { setReceipt(result.delivery); resource.reload() }
      }}>
        {!value.emailReady && <p role="status" className="rounded-lg border p-3">O envio de e-mail ainda não está configurado no servidor. Nenhuma mensagem será enviada até a configuração estar disponível.</p>}
        {!value.canSend && <p role="status">Envio indisponível: verifique sua permissão de gestão e se o pedido está cancelado.</p>}
        <fieldset disabled={frozen || !value.canSend || !value.emailReady} className="space-y-3">
          <label className="block space-y-2">Destinatário<Input type="email" autoComplete="email" required maxLength={254} value={recipient} onChange={event => setRecipientOverride(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <label className="block space-y-2">Assunto<Input required maxLength={200} value={subject} onChange={event => setSubject(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <div className="space-y-2"><label htmlFor={messageId} className="block">Mensagem</label><textarea id={messageId} required maxLength={10000} rows={5} className="w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-background p-3" value={message} onChange={event => setMessage(event.target.value)} /></div>
        </fieldset>
        <p className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3 text-sm">Anexo: documento do pedido em HTML, com cliente, itens, acabamentos e valores registrados. Para enviar o contrato para assinatura, use “Pedido e contratos”.</p>
        {command.error && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={command.error} status={command.status} /></p>}
        {command.stale && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { command.reset(); onReload(); resource.reload() }}>Recarregar pedido</Button>}
        {receipt && <p role="status">{deliveryLabels[receipt.status]} · {receipt.recipient}{receipt.status === "sent" ? ". A entrega na caixa do destinatário depende do provedor." : "."}</p>}
        {pendingDelivery && <p role="status">Há um envio sem confirmação definitiva. Consulte o histórico e confirme com o provedor antes de realizar outro envio.</p>}
        {command.uncertain && <p role="status">Resultado ainda não confirmado. A consulta abaixo repete o mesmo comando, sem criar um novo envio.</p>}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button type="submit" disabled={command.busy || command.stale || (!command.uncertain && (!value.canSend || !value.emailReady || frozen || !etag))}>{command.busy ? "Confirmando envio…" : command.uncertain ? "Consultar resultado do envio" : "Enviar e-mail com anexo"}</Button>
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={command.busy} onClick={resource.reload}>Atualizar histórico</Button>
        </div>
        {!!value.deliveries.length && <details><summary className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium">Histórico de envios</summary><ul className="mt-3 space-y-3 text-sm">{value.deliveries.map(delivery => <li key={delivery.id} className="break-words rounded-lg border p-3">{deliveryLabels[delivery.status]}<br />{delivery.recipient} · {new Date(delivery.createdAt).toLocaleString("pt-BR")}</li>)}</ul></details>}
      </form>
    }
    import { normalizeDecimal } from "@/lib/decimal-input"
    
    export function orderNumber(number: string | undefined) {
      return number ? `PV-${number.padStart(6, "0")}` : "Pedido"
    }
    
    // Format fixed-point API strings without rounding through floating-point numbers.
    export function commercialQuantity(value: string) {
      const [integer, fraction = ""] = value.split(".")
      const decimals = fraction.replace(/0+$/, "")
      const grouped = integer.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ".")
      return decimals ? `${grouped},${decimals}` : grouped
    }
    
    export function commercialMoney(value: string) {
      const [integer, fraction = ""] = value.split(".")
      return `R$ ${integer.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ".")},${fraction.padEnd(2, "0")}`
    }
    
    export function normalizeCommercialMoney(raw: string) {
      const value = raw.trim().replace(/^R\$\s*/, "")
      const grouped = /^[1-9][0-9]{0,2}(?:\.[0-9]{3})+(?:,[0-9]{1,2})?$/.test(value)
      return normalizeDecimal(grouped ? value.replaceAll(".", "") : value, 2)
    }
    
    export function commercialMoneyInput(value: string) {
      const normalized = normalizeCommercialMoney(value)
      return normalized ? commercialMoney(normalized).slice(3) : value
    }

    export async function installFrontendFixture(context: BrowserContext, fixtureOrigin = origin, fixtureTenant = tenant, fixtureAccessToken = "frontend-integration-fixture") {
      const iv = randomBytes(12)
      const cipher = createCipheriv("aes-256-gcm", createHash("sha256").update(secret).digest(), iv)
      cipher.setAAD(Buffer.from("erp-session"))
      const data = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(JSON.stringify({ accessToken: fixtureAccessToken, tenantId: fixtureTenant, expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600_000 })), cipher.final()])
      await context.addCookies([{ name: "erp_session", value: Buffer.concat([iv, cipher.getAuthTag(), data]).toString("base64url"), url: fixtureOrigin, httpOnly: true, sameSite: "Lax" }])

    """Package compiled Windows Next output with existing Linux runtime dependencies."""
    import io, json, pathlib, re, sys, tarfile
    
    workspace = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
    dist = workspace / 'apps/web/.next-commercial-release'
    standalone = dist / 'standalone/apps/web'
    original = (standalone / 'server.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    match = re.search(r'^const nextConfig = (.+)$', original, re.M)
    if not match: raise RuntimeError('Standalone config missing')
    config = json.loads(match.group(1))
    def rebase(value):
        if isinstance(value, dict): return {k: rebase(v) for k,v in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, list): return [rebase(v) for v in value]
        if isinstance(value, str):
            normalized = value.replace('\\','/')
            root = workspace.as_posix()
            if normalized.lower().startswith(root.lower()): return '/app' + normalized[len(root):]
        return value
    config = rebase(config)
    config['distDir'] = './.next'
    config['distDirRoot'] = '.next'
    server = original[:match.start(1)] + json.dumps(config,separators=(',',':')) + original[match.end(1):]
    output = workspace / 'artifacts' / ('commercial-web-' + sys.argv[1][:12] + '.tar.gz')
    entries = 0
    with tarfile.open(output,'w:gz',compresslevel=6) as archive:
        def add_bytes(name, data):
            global entries
            item = tarfile.TarInfo(name); item.size=len(data); item.mode=0o644
            archive.addfile(item,io.BytesIO(data)); entries+=1
        add_bytes('apps/web/server.js',server.encode())
        add_bytes('apps/web/package.json',(workspace/'apps/web/package.json').read_bytes())
        def add_tree(source, prefix):
            for path in source.rglob('*'):
                relative = path.relative_to(source)
                if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink() or any(part in {'node_modules','cache','dev','.git'} or part.startswith('.env') for part in relative.parts): continue
                raw = path.read_bytes()
                if path.name=='required-server-files.json':
                    manifest=rebase(json.loads(raw)); manifest['config']=config
                    raw=json.dumps(manifest,separators=(',',':')).encode()
                add_bytes(prefix+'/'+relative.as_posix(),raw)
        add_tree(standalone/config.get('distDirRoot','.next'),'apps/web/.next') if (standalone/'.next').exists() else add_tree(standalone/'.next-commercial-release','apps/web/.next')
        add_tree(dist/'static','apps/web/.next/static')
        add_tree(workspace/'apps/web/public','apps/web/public')
    print(json.dumps({'archive':str(output),'bytes':output.stat().st_size,'files':entries}))

    ---
    title: use client
    description: Learn how to use the use client directive to render a component on the client.
    ---
    
    The `'use client'` directive declares an entry point for the components to be rendered on the **client side** and should be used when creating interactive user interfaces (UI) that require client-side JavaScript capabilities, such as state management, event handling, and access to browser APIs. This is a React feature.
    
    > **Good to know:**
    >
    > You do not need to add the `'use client'` directive to every file that contains Client Components. You only need to add it to the files whose components you want to render directly within Server Components. The `'use client'` directive defines the [server and client boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary), and the components exported from such a file serve as entry points to the client.
    
    ## Usage
    
    To declare an entry point for the Client Components, add the `'use client'` directive **at the top of the file**, before any imports. The directive applies to the entire module and cannot be placed inside a component or function:
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/components/counter.js" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    When using the `'use client'` directive, the props of the Client Components must be [serializable](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client#serializable-types). This means the props need to be in a format that React can serialize when sending data from the server to the client.

          try {
            const response = await erpFetch(url, { cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal })
            if (!response.ok) throw Error(label)
            const value = await response.json() as T
            if (value.tenantId !== order.tenantId) throw Error(label)
            return value
          } catch { if (!controller.signal.aborted) failures.push(label); return undefined }

          canReadCustomer ? read<Party>(`/api/erp/parties/${order.data.customerId}`, "Cadastro do cliente") : Promise.resolve(undefined)
        ]).then(([quote, pricing, party]) => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setSources({ key, quote, pricing, party, failures }) })
        return () => controller.abort()
      }, [key, order.tenantId, order.data.id, order.data.customerId, order.pricingOrigin, canReadCustomer])
