    export type Director = { band: string; targetBps: number; taxBps: number; taxesCents: number; difalBps: number; difalCents: number; equipmentCostCents: number; fixedFeeCents: number; profitBeforeIncomeTaxCents: number; incomeTaxCents: number; netProfitCents: number; netProfitBps: number; supplierPaymentCents: number; targetProfitCents: number; downPaymentCommissionCents: number; requiredDownPaymentCents: number; requiredDownPaymentBps: number; minimumAtTargetCents: number; maximumAtTargetDiscountBps: number; maximumNoLossDiscountBps: number }
    export type Simulation = { tenantId: string; version: number; digest: string; sale: Sale; director: Director | null }
    export const money = (cents: number) => (cents / 100).toLocaleString("pt-BR", { style: "currency", currency: "BRL" })
    export const percent = (bps: number) => `${(bps / 100).toLocaleString("pt-BR", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}%`
    export const inputAmount = (cents: number) => (cents / 100).toFixed(2).replace(".", ",")
    export function parseAmount(raw: string): number | null {
      const normalized = raw.trim().replace(",", ".")
      if (!/^\d{1,12}(?:\.\d{0,2})?$/.test(normalized)) return null
      const [whole, fraction = ""] = normalized.split(".")
      const value = Number(BigInt(whole) * BigInt(100) + BigInt(fraction.padEnd(2, "0")))
      return Number.isSafeInteger(value) ? value : null
    }

    import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test"
    import { createCipheriv, createHash, randomBytes } from "node:crypto"
    import { origin, secret } from "../playwright.danfe.config"
    
    test.beforeEach(async ({ context }) => {
      const iv = randomBytes(12)
      const cipher = createCipheriv("aes-256-gcm", createHash("sha256").update(secret).digest(), iv)
      cipher.setAAD(Buffer.from("erp-session"))
      const encrypted = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(JSON.stringify({ accessToken: "frontend-controls-fixture", tenantId: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600_000 })), cipher.final()])

    async function session(context: BrowserContext, reader = false) {
      const iv = randomBytes(12)
      const cipher = createCipheriv("aes-256-gcm", createHash("sha256").update(process.env.ERP_SESSION_SECRET!).digest(), iv)
      cipher.setAAD(Buffer.from("erp-session"))
      const encrypted = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(JSON.stringify({ accessToken: reader ? "fixture-reader-token" : "fixture-editor-token", tenantId: tenant, expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600_000 })), cipher.final()])
      await context.addCookies([{ name: "erp_session", value: Buffer.concat([iv, cipher.getAuthTag(), encrypted]).toString("base64url"), url: origin, httpOnly: true, sameSite: "Lax" }])
    }

    # Revisão responsiva das telas — 09/11/2026
    
    A revisão parte dos problemas de leitura e operação no celular apontados nas capturas: listas que exigem deslocamento lateral, títulos e ações inconsistentes, espaços vazios sem orientação e formulários muito altos.
    
    ## Inventário e alcance
    
    Foram inventariados **228 arquivos `page.tsx`** em `apps/web/src/app`. Rotas dinâmicas e estados de permissão, carregamento, erro e edição multiplicam as telas possíveis; esse número não representa 228 telas visitadas manualmente.
    
    | Grupo de rotas | Arquivos de página |
    | --- | ---: |
    | Cadastros | 52 |
    | Preferências | 41 |
    | Vendas | 29 |
    | Estoque | 17 |
    | Fiscal | 16 |
    | Financeiro | 15 |
    | Logística | 15 |
    | Compras | 11 |
    | Serviços | 10 |
    | Relatórios | 7 |
    | Demais entradas, acesso, ajuda, dashboards e avisos | 15 |
    | **Total** | **228** |
    
    A triagem estática considerou entradas de rota, componentes compartilhados, tabelas, larguras mínimas, grades, distribuição de ações e testes existentes nos módulos. Houve leitura aprofundada da estrutura de navegação, `PageHeader`, `PageTitle`, `DataTable`, `Pagination`, estilos globais do workspace, contas a receber/pagar e seletores de cadastros auxiliares. Os fluxos de pedidos, propostas, produtos, estoque e preços recebem alterações específicas na mesma revisão.
    
    ## Causas e correções
    
    - Os cabeçalhos compartilhados precisam permitir que títulos e ações encolham e quebrem linha. `PageTitle` passa a quebrar também nomes longos sem espaços, enquanto `PageHeader` limita e permite quebra das ações.
    - Contas a receber e pagar não tinham título principal durante a consulta autenticada. As listas passam a apresentar cabeçalho, atalho de consulta da origem e explicação do estado vazio.
    - As listas financeiras passam a usar linhas compactas. No celular, identificação e saldo ficam visíveis lado a lado; vencimento, valor e situação acompanham a identificação. As colunas completas retornam a partir de 768 px. Valores monetários preservam as strings decimais e datas aparecem em dia/mês/ano.
    - Listas financeiras vazias ou com uma única página dispensam os controles de paginação. Caso uma página posterior fique vazia, o retorno à página anterior continua disponível.
    - O seletor de grupos de tags tinha dois botões longos em uma linha sem quebra dentro de um painel estreito. O grupo agora permite quebra de linha.
    
    Não houve alteração de cálculo financeiro, payload, autorização, confirmação ou estorno nessas correções de apresentação.
    
    ## Verificação focada
    
    `frontend-states-ui.spec.ts` recebeu casos para contas a receber e pagar nas larguras 320, 390, 768 e 1280 px: nome longo, saldo visível, metadados preservados, colunas de desktop e ausência de overflow na página e na lista. Há casos separados para estado vazio com atalho útil e sem paginação, além de cadastro de tags com seletor estreito e título sem espaços.
    
    As execuções de navegador e os resultados finais são consolidados pela revisão conjunta. Este inventário não declara aprovação visual manual de todas as rotas. As fixtures de interface validam apresentação e navegação; não substituem testes de persistência e permissões reais.
    
    ## Cobertura existente e pontos a conferir
    
    - `navigation-ui.spec.ts` cobre menu, foco, contexto de rota, larguras de desktop/tablet/celular e exemplos de listas auxiliares.
    - `company-account-ui.spec.ts`, `company-sections-ui.spec.ts` e `registration-settings-ui.spec.ts` cobrem várias seções de empresa, temas, auditoria e configurações em larguras móveis.
    - `catalog-navigation-ui.spec.ts`, `orders-list-ui.spec.ts`, `proposals-ui.spec.ts`, `frontend-states-ui.spec.ts` e `frontend-controls-ui.spec.ts` são a cobertura mais próxima das telas apontadas nas capturas.
    - Clientes/fornecedores, funcionários e cadastros auxiliares ainda usam tabelas com largura mínima e rolagem local. A página mantém sua largura, mas a leitura de todas as colunas pode exigir deslocamento. Avaliar cada fluxo antes de condensar seus dados.
    - Tabelas fiscais extensas, editor de itens da NF-e e extrato da assinatura mantêm rolagem local por conterem muitas colunas. Conferir foco, campos editáveis e ações no navegador móvel, incluindo Safari/iOS.
    - Compras, produção, comissões, ledger e funil têm cabeçalhos/estruturas próprias que merecem uma rodada visual adicional. A triagem do código não confirma legibilidade de todos os estados com nomes e valores de produção.
    - Há rotas legadas marcadas como indisponíveis em `demonstration-routes.ts`. Elas montam o aviso compartilhado, sem montar os antigos componentes demonstrativos; revisar o aviso é diferente de validar uma operação inexistente.
    
    Para uma rodada visual ampliada, priorizar 320/390 px, o início da navegação lateral em 900 px, nomes longos, listas vazias, erros de consulta e formulários com alterações pendentes. Evitar generalizar o sucesso de uma fixture para todos os perfis e dados reais.

    "use client"
    
    import type { Schema } from "@/lib/api/types"
    
    import { useSuggestedPaymentMethod } from "@/features/finance/settings/use-suggested-payment-method"
    import { commercialMoney } from "@/features/sales/order-presentation"
    
    import { decimalPattern, normalizeDecimal } from "@/lib/decimal-input"
    
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    
    import Link from "next/link"
    import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
    import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { DataTable } from "@/components/workspace/data-table"
    import { Pagination } from "@/components/workspace/pagination"
    import { useCommand, useResource } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    import { money, purchaseLink, purchaseSelect } from "./purchase-types"
    
    type Account = Schema<"UnifiedPayable">
    type Detail = Schema<"UnifiedPayableSnapshot">
    type Listing = Schema<"UnifiedPayableList">
    type FinancialAccounts = { data: { id: string; code: string; name: string }[] }
    const situation = (account: Account) => account.status === "cancelled" ? "Cancelado" : account.status === "paid" ? "Pagamento integral declarado" : account.paidAmount === "0.00" ? "Em aberto" : "Pagamento parcial declarado"
    
    export function Payables({ id }: { id?: string }) {
      return id ? <PayableDetail key={id} id={id} /> : <PayableList />
    }
    
    function PayableList() {
      const [offset, setOffset] = useState(0)
      const result = useResource<Listing>(`/api/erp/financial-payables?offset=${offset}&limit=25`)
      const total = result.value?.total || 0
      return <>
        <PageHeader eyebrow="Financeiro" title="Contas a pagar" description="Consulte vencimentos, saldos e pagamentos declarados das obrigações da empresa." actions={<Button nativeButton={false} variant="outline" render={<Link href="/compras/pedidos" />}>Consultar compras</Button>} />
        <section className="min-w-0 space-y-3" aria-label="Consulta de contas a pagar">
          {result.loading ? <p role="status">Carregando contas a pagar…</p> : result.error ? <div role="alert"><p><RequestError message={result.error} status={result.status} /></p><Button onClick={result.reload}>Tentar novamente</Button></div> : <>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{total} conta(s) a pagar</p>

    test("repetição após falha usa o mesmo comando e exige motivo para rejeição", async ({ page }) => {
      const value = detail()
      value.data.status = "sent"
      await page.route("**/api/erp/me", route => route.fulfill({ json: { tenant: { id: tenant, legalName: "Empresa de teste" }, permissions: ["sales.proposals.read", "sales.proposals.decide"] } }))
      await page.route(`**/api/erp/proposals/${record}`, route => route.fulfill({ headers: { ETag: '"1"' }, json: value }))
      const commands: { key: string; body: unknown }[] = []
      await page.route(`**/api/erp/proposals/${record}/reject`, route => {
        commands.push({ key: route.request().headers()["idempotency-key"], body: route.request().postDataJSON() })
        return commands.length === 1 ? route.fulfill({ status: 503, json: { title: "Resultado indisponível" } }) : route.fulfill({ headers: { ETag: '"2"' }, json: value })
      })
      await page.goto(`/vendas/propostas/${record}`)
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Registrar rejeição", exact: true }).click()
      await expect(page.getByLabel("Motivo", { exact: true })).toHaveAttribute("required", "")
      await page.getByLabel("Motivo", { exact: true }).fill("Cliente adiou a compra")
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirmar operação", exact: true }).click()
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Repetir confirmação", exact: true }).click()
      await expect(page.getByText("Operação confirmada no servidor.", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
      expect(commands).toHaveLength(2)
      expect(commands[1]).toEqual(commands[0])
      expect(commands[0].body).toEqual({ reason: "Cliente adiou a compra" })
    })

    "use client"
    
    import { erpFetch } from "@/lib/api/client"
    
    import Image from "next/image"
    import { ImageIcon } from "lucide-react"
    import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
    
    export function ProductThumbnail({ id, name, tenantId, hasPhoto, decorative = false, eager = false }: { id: string; name: string; tenantId: string; hasPhoto?: boolean; decorative?: boolean; eager?: boolean }) {
      const root = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null)
      const [photo, setPhoto] = useState("")
      const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false)
      useEffect(() => {
        if (hasPhoto === false || !root.current) return
        const controller = new AbortController()
        function loadPhoto() {
          void erpFetch(`/api/erp/products/${id}`, { cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal }).then(async response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Foto indisponível")
            const result = await response.json()
            if (result.tenantId !== tenantId || result.data?.id !== id) throw new Error("Empresa ou produto alterado")
            if (!controller.signal.aborted) setPhoto(result.data.photoUrl || result.data.photoDataUrl || "")
          }).catch(() => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setFailed(true) })
        }
        if (eager) {
          loadPhoto()
          return () => controller.abort()
        }
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
          if (!entries.some(entry => entry.isIntersecting)) return
          observer.disconnect()
          loadPhoto()
        }, { rootMargin: "100px" })
        observer.observe(root.current)
        return () => { observer.disconnect(); controller.abort() }
      }, [id, tenantId, hasPhoto, eager])
      return <span ref={root} className="grid size-14 shrink-0 place-items-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg border bg-muted/40" title={failed ? "Não foi possível carregar a foto" : hasPhoto === false ? "Sem foto cadastrada" : undefined}>
        {photo ? <Image unoptimized loading={eager ? "eager" : undefined} src={photo} alt={decorative ? "" : `Foto de ${name}`} width={56} height={56} className="size-14 object-contain" onError={() => { setPhoto(""); setFailed(true) }} /> : <ImageIcon className="size-5 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />}
      </span>
    }

    type Item = { productId: string; sku: string; name: string; priceWithoutIpiCents: number; ipiBps: number; priceWithIpiCents: number }

    type Current = { tenantId: string; line: string; data: { version: number; publishedAt: string; items: Item[] } | null }
    const money = (cents: number) => (cents / 100).toLocaleString("pt-BR", { style: "currency", currency: "BRL" })
    
    export function PriceTables({ initialLine = "imported" }: { initialLine?: "imported" | "national" }) {
      const [line, setLine] = useState<"imported" | "national">(initialLine)
      const [locked, setLocked] = useState(false)
      return <main className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-5 px-4 pb-24 pt-6 [--workspace-control-height:2.25rem]">
        <PageHeader eyebrow="Vendas / Tabelas de preços" title="Nova tabela de preços" description="Escolha a linha, confira os preços calculados e publique uma nova versão." />
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3"><Link href="/vendas/simulador" className="text-primary underline">Simular negociação</Link><Link href="/preferencias/comercial" className="text-primary underline">Parâmetros comerciais</Link><Link href="/preferencias/despesas-fixas" className="text-primary underline">Despesas fixas</Link></div>
        <label className="grid max-w-xs gap-1">Linha comercial<select disabled={locked} className="min-h-10 rounded-lg border bg-background px-2" value={line} onChange={e => setLine(e.target.value as typeof line)}><option value="imported">Importada</option><option value="national">Nacional</option></select></label>
        <Publication key={line} line={line} onLocked={setLocked} />
      </main>
    }
    
    function Publication({ line, onLocked }: { line: "imported" | "national"; onLocked: (value: boolean) => void }) {
      const current = useResource<Current>(`/api/erp/price-tables/${line}`)
      const command = useCommand()
      const [preview, setPreview] = useState<Preview | null>(null)
      const [preparing, setPreparing] = useState(false)
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const [notice, setNotice] = useState("")
      useNavigationGuard(command.busy || command.uncertain ? "A publicação ainda não foi confirmada. Sair?" : null)
      async function prepare() {
        if (!current.value || preparing || command.busy || command.uncertain) return
        onLocked(true); setPreparing(true); setPreview(null); setError(""); setNotice(""); command.reset()
        try {
          const response = await fetch(`/api/erp/price-tables/${line}/preview`, { cache: "no-store" })
          const result = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) throw Error(result.title || "Não foi possível preparar a tabela.")
          if (result.tenantId !== current.value.tenantId || result.line !== line || response.headers.get("etag") !== `"${result.revision}"` || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(result.digest) || !Array.isArray(result.items) || !result.items.length) throw Error("Prévia incompleta. Recarregue antes de publicar.")
          setPreview(result)
        } catch (reason) { setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Prévia indisponível.") }
        finally { setPreparing(false); onLocked(false) }
      }
      async function publish() {
        if (!preview || !current.value || command.busy) return
        onLocked(true)
        const result = await command.send<{ tenantId: string; line: string; status: string; version: number }>(`/api/erp/price-tables/${line}/publish`, current.value.tenantId, { digest: preview.digest }, `"${preview.revision}"`)
        if (result?.tenantId === current.value.tenantId && result.line === line && result.status === "published") {
          setNotice(`Versão ${result.version} publicada.`); setPreview(null); current.reload(); onLocked(false)
        } else if (result) { setError("Resposta divergente. Confira a versão publicada."); onLocked(false) }
      }
      return <div className="space-y-5">
        <p>Publicar cria uma versão da tabela com os custos dos produtos ativos e os parâmetros salvos. Produtos e pedidos existentes mantêm os preços cadastrados.</p>
        <Button variant="outline" disabled={!current.value || preparing || command.busy || command.uncertain} onClick={prepare}>{preparing ? "Preparando…" : "Preparar prévia"}</Button>
        {preview && <section className="form-section space-y-3"><h2 className="font-semibold">Conferência antes de publicar</h2><p>{preview.items.length} produtos · revisão {preview.revision}</p><Prices items={preview.items} /><Button disabled={command.busy || command.stale} onClick={publish}>{command.uncertain ? "Repetir confirmação" : "Confirmar publicação"}</Button></section>}
        {notice && <p role="status">{notice}</p>}{(error || command.error) && <p role="alert">{error || command.error}</p>}
        {command.stale && <p>Os dados mudaram. Prepare nova prévia e confira os valores.</p>}
        <section className="form-section space-y-3"><h2 className="font-semibold">Versão publicada</h2>{current.loading ? <p role="status">Carregando…</p> : current.error ? <p role="alert"><RequestError message={current.error} status={current.status} /></p> : current.value?.data ? <><p>Versão {current.value.data.version} · {new Date(current.value.data.publishedAt).toLocaleString("pt-BR")}</p><Prices items={current.value.data.items} /></> : <p>Nenhuma versão publicada nesta linha.</p>}</section>
      </div>
    }

    }

    name: systematic-debugging

    # Systematic Debugging
    
    ## Overview
    
    **Core principle:** ALWAYS find root cause before attempting fixes. Symptom fixes are failure.
    
    **Violating the letter of this process is violating the spirit of debugging.**
    
    ## The Iron Law
    
    ```
    NO FIXES WITHOUT ROOT CAUSE INVESTIGATION FIRST
    ```
    
    If you haven't completed Phase 1, you cannot propose fixes.
    
    ## When to Use
    
    Use for ANY technical issue:
    - Test failures
    - Bugs in production
    - Unexpected behavior
    - Performance problems
    - Build failures
    - Integration issues
    
    **Use this ESPECIALLY when:**
    - Under time pressure (emergencies make guessing tempting)
    - "Just one quick fix" seems obvious
    - You've already tried multiple fixes
    - Previous fix didn't work
    - You don't fully understand the issue
    
    **Don't skip when:**
    - Issue seems simple (simple bugs have root causes too)
    - You're in a hurry (rushing guarantees rework)
    - Manager wants it fixed NOW (systematic is faster than thrashing)
    
    ## The Four Phases
    
    You MUST complete each phase before proceeding to the next.
    
    ### Phase 1: Root Cause Investigation
    
    **BEFORE attempting ANY fix:**
    
    1. **Read Error Messages Carefully**
       - Don't skip past errors or warnings
       - They often contain the exact solution
       - Read stack traces completely
       - Note line numbers, file paths, error codes
    
    2. **Reproduce Consistently**
       - Can you trigger it reliably?
       - What are the exact steps?
       - Does it happen every time?
       - If not reproducible → gather more data, don't guess
    
    3. **Check Recent Changes**
       - What changed that could cause this?
       - Git diff, recent commits
       - New dependencies, config changes
       - Environmental differences
    
    4. **Gather Evidence in Multi-Component Systems**
    
       **WHEN system has multiple components (CI → build → signing, API → service → database):**
    
       **BEFORE proposing fixes, add diagnostic instrumentation:**
       ```
       For EACH component boundary:
         - Log what data enters component
         - Log what data exits component
         - Verify environment/config propagation
         - Check state at each layer
    
       Run once to gather evidence showing WHERE it breaks
       THEN analyze evidence to identify failing component
       THEN investigate that specific component
       ```
    
       **Example (multi-layer system):**
       ```bash
       # Layer 1: Workflow
       echo "=== Secrets available in workflow: ==="
       echo "IDENTITY: $([ -n "${IDENTITY:-}" ] && echo SET || echo UNSET)"
    
       # Layer 2: Build script
       echo "=== Env vars in build script: ==="
       printenv IDENTITY >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "IDENTITY in environment" || echo "IDENTITY not in environment"
    
       # Layer 3: Signing script
       echo "=== Keychain state: ==="
       security list-keychains
       security find-identity -v
    
       # Layer 4: Actual signing
       codesign --sign "$IDENTITY" --verbose=4 "$APP"
       ```
    
       **This reveals:** Which layer fails (secrets → workflow ✓, workflow → build ✗)
    
    5. **Trace Data Flow**
    
       **WHEN error is deep in call stack:**

    function Editor({ snapshot, etag, reload }: { snapshot: Snapshot; etag: string; reload: () => void }) {
      const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Draft>(() => toDraft(snapshot.data, snapshot.monthlyExpensesCents))

      useNavigationGuard(dirty ? "Descartar os parâmetros comerciais não salvos?" : null)
      function change(next: Draft) { setDraft(next); setDirty(true); setCalculation(null); setSuggestion(null); setError(""); setNotice("") }
      async function submit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault()
        if (busy || blocked || !snapshot.canEdit) return
        const save = (event.nativeEvent as SubmitEvent).submitter?.getAttribute("value") === "save"
        if (save && !etag) { setBlocked(true); setError("Revisão ausente. Recarregue antes de salvar."); return }
        let parameters
        try { parameters = toParameters(draft) } catch (reason) { setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Parâmetros inválidos"); return }
        setBusy(true); setError(""); setNotice("")
        try {
          const response = await fetch(`/api/erp/commercial-settings/${snapshot.line}${save ? "" : "/preview"}`, {
            method: save ? "PUT" : "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Tenant-Id": snapshot.tenantId, ...(save ? { "If-Match": etag } : {}) }, body: JSON.stringify(parameters),
          })
          const result = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) throw Error(result.title || "Operação recusada")
          if (result.tenantId !== snapshot.tenantId || result.line !== snapshot.line || !result.calculation || (save && (!response.headers.get("etag") || result.revision !== snapshot.revision + 1))) throw Error("Confirmação incompleta. Recarregue para conferir.")
          if (save) { setDirty(false); setNotice("Parâmetros salvos. A tabela de preços ainda não foi publicada."); reload() } else { setCalculation(result.calculation); setSuggestion(result.suggestedDownPayment || null) }
        } catch (reason) { if (save) setBlocked(true); setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Falha na operação") }
        finally { setBusy(false) }
      }
      return <form noValidate className="min-w-0 space-y-5" data-commercial-dirty={dirty} onSubmit={submit}>

        {!snapshot.data && <p role="status">Esta linha ainda não tem parâmetros. Informe as alíquotas da empresa.</p>}

"default" : "outline"} aria-pressed={section === index} aria-controls={`commercial-section-${index}`} className="shrink-0" onClick={() => setSection(index)}>{label}</Button>)}</nav>
        <fieldset disabled={busy || blocked || !snapshot.canEdit} className="min-w-0 space-y-5">
          {fieldGroups.map((group, index) => <section id={`commercial-section-${index}`} hidden={section !== index} className="form-section space-y-4" key={group.title}><h2 className="font-semibold">{group.title}</h2>{index === 0 && <label className="grid max-w-sm gap-2">UF de origem<select required className="min-h-10 rounded-lg border bg-background px-2" value={draft.originState} onChange={e => change({ ...draft, originState: e.target.value })}><option value="">Selecione</option>{states.map(state => <option key={state}>{state}</option>)}</select></label>}<div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">{group.fields.map(([key, label, unit]) => <label key={key} className="grid gap-1">{label} ({unit === "percent" ? "%" : unit === "money" ? "R$" : "dias"})<Input required readOnly={key === "monthlyExpensesCents"} inputMode={unit === "days" ? "numeric" : "decimal"} value={draft[key]} onChange={e => change({ ...draft, [key]: e.target.value })} /></label>)}</div>{group.title === "Provisões e despesas" && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Despesas fixas são somadas dos cadastros vigentes. <Link className="text-primary underline" href="/preferencias/despesas-fixas">Gerenciar despesas fixas</Link></p>}</section>)}
          <section id="commercial-section-4" hidden={section !== 4} className="form-section min-w-0 space-y-3"><h2 className="font-semibold">ICMS por UF de destino</h2><p id="state-rates-help" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Valores em %. Saída em branco usa a alíquota interestadual padrão.     ---
    title: use client
    description: Learn how to use the use client directive to render a component on the client.
    ---
    
    The `'use client'` directive declares an entry point for the components to be rendered on the **client side** and should be used when creating interactive user interfaces (UI) that require client-side JavaScript capabilities, such as state management, event handling, and access to browser APIs. This is a React feature.
    
    > **Good to know:**
    >
    > You do not need to add the `'use client'` directive to every file that contains Client Components. You only need to add it to the files whose components you want to render directly within Server Components. The `'use client'` directive defines the [server and client boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary), and the components exported from such a file serve as entry points to the client.
    
    ## Usage
    
    To declare an entry point for the Client Components, add the `'use client'` directive **at the top of the file**, before any imports. The directive applies to the entire module and cannot be placed inside a component or function:
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {

        <PageHeader eyebrow="Vendas" title="Simulador comercial" description="Confira preços, entrada e condições antes de criar um pedido." />
        {opportunity && <section className="rounded-lg border p-4"><h2 className="font-semibold">{opportunity.title}</h2><p>{opportunity.customerName || opportunity.companyName} · {opportunity.contactName}</p><p className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-muted-foreground">{opportunity.notes}</p><Link className="text-primary underline" href={`/vendas/funil/${opportunity.id}`}>Abrir oportunidade de origem</Link></section>}
        <nav className="flex flex-wrap gap-4"><Link className="text-primary underline" href="/vendas/tabela-precos">Tabela de preços</Link>{table.value?.canManage && <><Link className="text-primary underline" href="/preferencias/comercial">Parâmetros e metas</Link><Link className="text-primary underline" href="/preferencias/aprovacao-comercial">Regras de aprovação</Link></>}</nav>
        <label className="grid max-w-sm gap-2">Linha comercial<select className={selectClass} disabled={lineLocked} value={line} onChange={e => { if (!document.querySelector("[data-simulation-dirty='true']") || window.confirm("Descartar a simulação desta linha?")) setLine(e.target.value) }}><option value="imported">Importada</option><option value="national">Nacional</option></select></label>
        {table.loading ? <p role="status">Carregando versão publicada…</p> : table.error ? <p role="alert"><RequestError message={table.error} status={table.status} /></p> : table.value && (opportunityTenant && opportunityTenant !== table.value.tenantId ? <p role="alert">A empresa da sessão mudou. Reabra a oportunidade.</p> : <Simulator key={`${line}:${table.value.tenantId}:${table.value.data?.id}`} table={table.value} opportunity={opportunity} onLineLockChange={setLineLocked} initialProduct={line === initialLine ? initialProduct : ""} />)}
      </main>
    }
    
    function Simulator({ table, initialProduct, opportunity, onLineLockChange }: { table: PriceTable; initialProduct: string; opportunity?: Opportunity; onLineLockChange: (locked: boolean) => void }) {
      const router = useRouter()
      const command = useCommand()
      const [items, setItems] = useState<Selected[]>(() => table.data?.items.some(i => i.productId === initialProduct) ? [{ productId: initialProduct, quantity: "1", structureColor: "", upholsteryColor: "", plateHolderColor: "", plateHolderType: "" }] : [])
      const [product, setProduct] = useState("")
      const [search, setSearch] = useState("")
      const [destination, setDestination] = useState(table.data?.originState || "")
      const [taxpayer, setTaxpayer] = useState("false")
      const [discount, setDiscount] = useState<{ kind: "percent" | "amount" | "total"; raw: string }>({ kind: "percent", raw: "0" })
      const [freight, setFreight] = useState("")
      const [ourFreight, setOurFreight] = useState(false)
      const [downPayment, setDownPayment] = useState("")
      const [customer, setCustomer] = useState<Choice | null>(opportunity?.customerId ? { id: opportunity.customerId, legalName: opportunity.customerName || "Cliente da oportunidade" } : null)
      const [dueDate, setDueDate] = useState("")
      const [result, setResult] = useState<{ value: Simulation; input: SimulationInput } | null>(null)
      const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
      const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false)
      const [everCalculated, setEverCalculated] = useState(false)
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const frozen = busy || command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale
      useEffect(() => { onLineLockChange(frozen) }, [frozen, onLineLockChange])
      useNavigationGuard(dirty || command.uncertain ? "Sair sem concluir esta negociação?" : null)
      function change() { setResult(null); setDirty(true); setError(""); command.reset() }
      function simulationInput(): SimulationInput {
        if (!table.data) throw Error("Publique uma tabela antes de simular.")
        const value = parseAmount(discount.raw)
        const freightCents = ourFreight ? parseAmount(freight) : 0
        const entry = downPayment.trim() ? parseAmount(downPayment) : null
        if (value === null || freightCents === null || (downPayment.trim() && entry === null) || !items.length || items.some(i => !/^\d{1,7}$/.test(i.quantity) || Number(i.quantity) < 1 || Number(i.quantity) > 1000000)) throw Error("Confira quantidade, desconto, frete e entrada. Use até duas casas decimais para valores.")
        return { line: table.line, versionId: table.data.id, destinationState: destination, taxpayer: taxpayer === "true", discount: { kind: discount.kind, value }, freightCents, downPaymentCents: entry, items: items.map(i => ({ productId: i.productId, quantity: Number(i.quantity), structureColor: i.structureColor || null, upholsteryColor: i.upholsteryColor || null, plateHolderColor: i.plateHolderColor || null, plateHolderType: i.plateHolderType || null })) }
      }
      async function simulate() {
        if (frozen) return
        let input: SimulationInput
        try { input = simulationInput() } catch (reason) { setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Confira as condições."); jumpTo(!items.length || items.some(i => !/^\d{1,7}$/.test(i.quantity) || Number(i.quantity) < 1 || Number(i.quantity) > 1000000) ? "equipment" : "conditions"); return }
        setBusy(true); setError(""); setResult(null)
        try {
          const response = await erpFetch("/api/erp/commercial/simulate", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Tenant-Id": table.tenantId }, body: JSON.stringify(input) })
          const value: Simulation & { title?: string } = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) throw Error(value.title || "Não foi possível simular.")
          if (value.tenantId !== table.tenantId || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(value.digest) || !value.sale) throw Error("Resposta da simulação incompleta.")
          setResult({ value, input }); setEverCalculated(true)
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            document.getElementById("simulator-result")?.focus({ preventScroll: true })
            if (window.matchMedia("(max-width: 1023px)").matches) jumpTo("result")
          })
        } catch (reason) { setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Simulação indisponível.") }
        finally { setBusy(false) }
      }
      async function convert() {
        if (!result || !customer || !dueDate) { setError("Selecione o cliente e informe o vencimento antes de criar o pedido."); return }
        const value = await command.send<{ tenantId: string; id: string }>("/api/erp/commercial/orders", table.tenantId, { simulation: result.input, digest: result.value.digest, customerId: customer.id, dueDate, ...(opportunity ? { opportunityId: opportunity.id, opportunityRevision: opportunity.revision } : {}) })
        if (value?.tenantId === table.tenantId && value.id) { setDirty(false); router.push(`/vendas/pedidos/${value.id}`) }
      }
      if (!table.data) return <section className="form-section space-y-3"><p>Nenhuma tabela publicada nesta linha.</p>{table.canManage && <Link className="text-primary underline" href="/preferencias/tabela-precos">Publicar tabela de preços</Link>}</section>
      const choices = table.data.items.filter(i => `${i.sku} ${i.name}`.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) && !items.some(selected => selected.productId === i.productId))
      return <div data-simulation-dirty={dirty} className="space-y-4">
        <div className="sticky top-[52px] z-20 space-y-2 border-y bg-background py-2 lg:top-16">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center justify-between gap-2">
            {(error || command.error) ? <p role="alert" className="min-w-0 text-xs sm:text-sm"><RequestError message={error || command.error} status={command.status || undefined} /></p> : <p role="status" className="min-w-0 text-xs text-muted-foreground sm:text-sm">Tabela v{table.data.version} · {result ? "Calculada" : everCalculated ? "Alterada após o cálculo: simule novamente" : "Simulação não salva"}</p>}
            <Button type="button" disabled={frozen || !items.length} onClick={simulate}>{busy ? "Calculando…" : "Simular"}</Button>
          </div>
          <nav aria-label="Etapas da simulação" className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            {[["equipment", "Equipamentos"], ["conditions", "Condições"], ["result", "Resultado"], ["customer", "Cliente"]].map(([id, label]) => <a key={id} href={`#simulator-${id}`} className="flex min-h-10 min-w-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1 font-medium hover:bg-muted focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring" onClick={event => { event.preventDefault(); jumpTo(id) }}>{label}</a>)}
          </nav>
        </div>
        <div className="grid min-w-0 items-start gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.65fr)_minmax(0,1fr)] lg:gap-5">
          <div className="min-w-0 space-y-4"><fieldset disabled={frozen} className="form-section min-w-0 space-y-3 !p-3 sm:!p-5">
            <h2 id="simulator-equipment" tabIndex={-1} className={sectionHeadingClass}>Equipamentos</h2>
            <label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1 sm:gap-2">Buscar equipamento<Input type="search" value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} /></label>
            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap gap-2"><select aria-label="Equipamento da tabela" className={`${selectClass} w-full flex-1`} value={product} onChange={e => setProduct(e.target.value)}><option value="">Selecione um equipamento</option>{choices.map(i => <option key={i.productId} value={i.productId}>{i.sku} · {i.name}</option>)}</select><Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={!product || items.length >= 100} onClick={() => { if (items.some(i => i.productId === product)) return; setItems([...items, { productId: product, quantity: "1", structureColor: "", upholsteryColor: "", plateHolderColor: "", plateHolderType: "" }]); setProduct(""); change() }}>Adicionar</Button></div>
            {items.length ? <DataTable aria-label="Equipamentos da simulação" className="table-fixed"><thead><tr className="border-b text-xs text-muted-foreground"><th scope="col" className="py-2 font-medium">Equipamento</th><th scope="col" className="w-20 px-1 py-2 font-medium">Qtd.</th><th scope="col" className="w-11 py-2"><span className="sr-only">Ações</span></th></tr></thead><tbody>{items.map((item, index) => <SelectedProduct key={item.productId} item={item} name={table.data!.items.find(i => i.productId === item.productId)?.name || item.productId} sku={table.data!.items.find(i => i.productId === item.productId)?.sku || ""} tenant={table.tenantId} update={next => { setItems(items.map((i, n) => n === index ? next : i)); change() }} remove={() => { setItems(items.filter((_, n) => n !== index)); change() }} />)}</tbody></DataTable> : <p className="py-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Adicione os equipamentos para iniciar a negociação.</p>}
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{items.length} equipamento{items.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} · Abra os acabamentos para escolher as cores do catálogo.</p>
          </fieldset>
          <fieldset disabled={frozen} className="form-section min-w-0 space-y-3 !p-3 sm:space-y-4 sm:!p-5">
            <h2 id="simulator-conditions" tabIndex={-1} className={sectionHeadingClass}>Condições comerciais</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,2fr)] gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-4"><label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1 sm:gap-2">UF de destino<select className={selectClass} value={destination} onChange={e => { setDestination(e.target.value); change() }}>{states.map(uf => <option key={uf}>{uf}</option>)}</select></label><label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1 sm:gap-2">Inscrição estadual<select className={selectClass} value={taxpayer} onChange={e => { setTaxpayer(e.target.value); change() }}><option value="false">Cliente sem IE / não contribuinte</option><option value="true">Cliente contribuinte com IE</option></select></label></div>
            <label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1 sm:gap-2">Preencher negociação por<select className={selectClass} value={discount.kind} onChange={e => { const kind = e.target.value as typeof discount.kind; const sale = result?.value.sale; setDiscount({ kind, raw: sale ? inputAmount(kind === "percent" ? sale.discountBps : kind === "amount" ? sale.discountCents : sale.totalCents) : kind === "total" ? "" : "0" }); change() }}><option value="percent">Desconto em percentual (%)</option><option value="amount">Desconto em reais, sem IPI (R$)</option><option value="total">Cliente quer pagar: total com IPI (R$)</option></select></label>
            <label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1 sm:gap-2">{discount.kind === "percent" ? "Desconto (%)" : discount.kind === "amount" ? "Desconto em reais" : "Total que o cliente quer pagar"}<Input inputMode="decimal" value={discount.raw} onChange={e => { setDiscount({ ...discount, raw: e.target.value }); change() }} /></label>
            {discount.kind === "percent" && <input aria-label="Ajustar desconto percentual" type="range" min="0" max="99.99" step="0.01" className="w-full" value={(parseAmount(discount.raw) || 0) / 100} onChange={e => { setDiscount({ kind: "percent", raw: e.target.value }); change() }} />}
            <p className="text-sm">Livre até {percent(table.data.freeDiscountBps)}. Acima disso, exige aprovação.</p>
            {result && <p className="text-sm">Desconto calculado: {percent(result.value.sale.discountBps)} · {money(result.value.sale.discountCents)} sem IPI. Total: {money(result.value.sale.totalCents)}.</p>}
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2"><input type="checkbox" checked={ourFreight} onChange={e => { setOurFreight(e.target.checked); change() }} />Frete por nossa conta</label>
            {ourFreight && <label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1 sm:gap-2">Frete pago pela empresa (R$)<Input inputMode="decimal" value={freight} onChange={e => { setFreight(e.target.value); change() }} /></label>}
            <label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1 sm:gap-2"><span>Entrada negociada (R$)<span className="sr-only">, deixe vazia para usar a política</span></span><Input aria-describedby="simulator-entry-help" inputMode="decimal" value={downPayment} onChange={e => { setDownPayment(e.target.value); change() }} /></label>
            <p id="simulator-entry-help" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Deixe a entrada vazia para usar a política comercial.</p>
          </fieldset>
          </div>
          <aside className="min-w-0 space-y-3 lg:sticky lg:top-48 lg:row-span-2 lg:max-h-[calc(100dvh-13rem)] lg:overflow-y-auto lg:overscroll-contain" aria-labelledby="simulator-result">
            <h2 id="simulator-result" tabIndex={-1} className={sectionHeadingClass}>Resultado</h2>
            {result ? <NegotiationResult sale={result.value.sale} director={result.value.director} /> : <section className="form-section space-y-3 !p-3 sm:!p-5">
              <p className="font-medium">{items.length ? "Tudo pronto para calcular" : "Monte sua negociação"}</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{items.length ? `${items.length} equipamento${items.length === 1 ? " selecionado" : "s selecionados"}. Confira as condições e clique em Simular.` : "Adicione equipamentos, ajuste as condições e simule para conferir o total e a entrada."}</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{everCalculated ? "As condições foram alteradas. Simule novamente para atualizar os valores." : "Os valores serão calculados com a tabela publicada."}</p>
            </section>}
            {command.stale && <p>A tabela ou a política mudou. Recarregue a página e simule novamente.</p>}
          </aside>
          <section className="form-section min-w-0 space-y-3 !p-3 sm:space-y-4 sm:!p-5 lg:col-start-1"><h2 id="simulator-customer" tabIndex={-1} className={sectionHeadingClass}>Dados para criar o pedido</h2><Lookup endpoint="parties" label="cliente" searchOnly selectedName={customer?.legalName} disabled={frozen} choose={value => { setCustomer(value); setDirty(true) }} /><label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1 sm:gap-2">Vencimento da conta a receber<Input type="date" disabled={frozen} value={dueDate} onChange={e => { setDueDate(e.target.value); setDirty(true) }} /></label>{result && <Button className="h-auto min-h-11 max-w-full whitespace-normal" disabled={!customer || !dueDate || busy || command.busy || command.stale} onClick={convert}>{command.uncertain ? "Conferir criação com o mesmo comando" : "Criar pedido com estas condições"}</Button>}</section>
        </div>
      </div>
    }
    
    function SelectedProduct({ item, name, sku, tenant, update, remove }: { item: Selected; name: string; sku: string; tenant: string; update: (next: Selected) => void; remove: () => void }) {
      const product = useResource<{ tenantId: string; data: { structureColors?: string[]; upholsteryColors?: string[]; upholsteryConfigurable?: boolean; plateHolderColors?: string[]; plateHolderTypes?: string[] } }>(`/api/erp/products/${item.productId}`)
      const colors = product.value?.tenantId === tenant ? product.value.data : null
      const palette = catalogPaletteFor(colors?.structureColors)
      const selectedFinishes = [item.structureColor, item.upholsteryColor, item.plateHolderColor, item.plateHolderType].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")
      return <>
        <tr>
          <th scope="row" className="min-w-0 break-words py-3 pr-2 text-left align-top font-medium"><span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{sku}</span>{name}</th>
          <td className="px-1 py-3 align-top"><Input aria-label={`Quantidade de ${name}`} className="px-2 text-center tabular-nums" inputMode="numeric" value={item.quantity} onChange={e => update({ ...item, quantity: e.target.value })} /></td>
          <td className="py-3 align-top"><Button variant="ghost" size="icon" type="button" aria-label={`Remover equipamento ${name}`} onClick={remove}><X aria-hidden="true" /></Button></td>
        </tr>
        <tr className="border-b last:border-0"><td colSpan={3} className="min-w-0 pb-3">
          {product.error && <p role="alert">{product.error}</p>}
          <details className="group min-w-0">
            <summary className="min-h-10 cursor-pointer rounded-md py-2 text-sm font-medium focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring">Acabamentos<span className="sr-only"> de {name}</span><span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground group-open:hidden">{selectedFinishes || "Escolher cores"}</span></summary>
            <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-4 pt-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <FinishChoice title="Estrutura" label={`Cor da estrutura de ${name}`} options={colors?.structureColors} value={item.structureColor} onChange={value => update({ ...item, structureColor: value })} />
              {(colors?.plateHolderColors?.length || 0) > 0 && <FinishChoice title="Anilheiros" label={`Cor dos anilheiros de ${name}`} options={colors?.plateHolderColors} value={item.plateHolderColor} onChange={value => update({ ...item, plateHolderColor: value })} />}
              {(colors?.plateHolderTypes?.length || 0) > 0 && <FinishChoice title="Tipo de anilheiro" label={`Tipo de anilheiro de ${name}`} options={colors?.plateHolderTypes} value={item.plateHolderType} onChange={value => update({ ...item, plateHolderType: value })} />}
              {colors?.upholsteryConfigurable !== false && <FinishChoice title={palette ? "Braços" : "Estofado"} palette={palette} label={`${palette ? "Cor dos braços" : "Cor do estofado"} de ${name}`} options={colors?.upholsteryColors} value={item.upholsteryColor} onChange={value => update({ ...item, upholsteryColor: value })} />}
            </div>
          </details>
        </td></tr>
      </>
    }
    
    function FinishChoice({ title, ...props }: Parameters<typeof ColorChoice>[0] & { title: string }) {
      return <div className="min-w-0 space-y-2 [&_label]:sr-only"><p className="text-sm font-medium">{title}</p><ColorChoice {...props} /></div>
    }
        {error && <p role="alert">{error}. Sua edição foi preservada.</p>}
        {blocked && <Button type="button" onClick={() => { if (window.confirm("Descartar edição e recarregar?")) { setDirty(false); reload() } }}>Recarregar</Button>}
        {calculation && <section className="form-section space-y-5" aria-label="Resultado gerencial"><h2 className="font-semibold">Resultado gerencial</h2>
          <div><p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Preço de tabela</p><p className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold">custo ajustado × {calculation.tableCostMultiplier.toLocaleString("pt-BR", { minimumFractionDigits: 3, maximumFractionDigits: 3 })}</p><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Markup de {calculation.markupPercent.toLocaleString("pt-BR", { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}%</p></div>
          <dl className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">{[
            ["Pior destino", `${calculation.worstState}, ${calculation.worstNonContributor ? "não contribuinte" : "contribuinte"} · ICMS ${(calculation.worstIcmsBps / 100).toLocaleString("pt-BR")}%`],
            ["Tributos, taxas e provisões", `${(calculation.variableCostsBps / 100).toLocaleString("pt-BR", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}%`],
            ["Lucro antes do IR necessário", `${calculation.requiredPretaxMarginPercent.toLocaleString("pt-BR", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}%`],
            ["Venda com desconto", `custo ajustado × ${calculation.discountedCostMultiplier.toLocaleString("pt-BR", { minimumFractionDigits: 3, maximumFractionDigits: 3 })}`],
            ["Despesas fixas por mês", (calculation.monthlyExpensesCents / 100).toLocaleString("pt-BR", { style: "currency", currency: "BRL" })],
            ["Faturamento de equilíbrio", calculation.breakEvenRevenue == null ? "Sem equilíbrio nesta condição" : calculation.breakEvenRevenue.toLocaleString("pt-BR", { style: "currency", currency: "BRL" })],
          ].map(([label, value]) => <div key={label}><dt className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{label}</dt><dd className="mt-1 font-medium">{value}</dd></div>)}</dl>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Venda com desconto = custo ajustado ÷ (1 − tributos, taxas e provisões − lucro antes do IR). A tabela considera também o desconto livre. Alterações só chegam à tabela publicada após preparar e confirmar uma nova versão.</p>
          {suggestion && <div className="space-y-3 rounded-lg border p-4"><h3 className="font-semibold">Entrada mínima sugerida: {(suggestion.recommendedBps / 100).toLocaleString("pt-BR")}%</h3><p className="text-sm">Pior produto: {suggestion.worstSku}. Necessidade de {(suggestion.exactBps / 100).toLocaleString("pt-BR")}% no desconto livre, arredondada para cima em passos de 5 pontos percentuais.</p>{suggestion.canApply ? <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={busy || blocked} onClick={() => { change({ ...draft, minimumDownPaymentBps: String(suggestion.recommendedBps / 100).replace(".", ",") }); setNotice("Sugestão aplicada à edição. Salve os parâmetros para confirmar.") }}>Usar entrada sugerida</Button> : <p role="alert">A necessidade supera 100% da venda. Revise custos e política antes de adotar uma entrada.</p>}</div>}
        </section>}
      </form>
    }
    import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test"

    const product = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
    const version = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
    const name = "HammerForce Pro · Desenvolvimento de ombros articulado"
    const structureColors = ["Piano Black", "Titanium Grey", "Matte Graphite Black"]
    
    for (const width of [390, 1280]) test(`navegação conserva negociação e acabamentos em ${width}px`, async ({ context, page }) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })

      await page.route("**/api/erp/commercial/tables/imported", route => route.fulfill({ json: { tenantId: tenant, line: "imported", canManage: false, data: { id: version, version: 6, originState: "SP", freeDiscountBps: 2000, minimumDownPaymentBps: 7000, items: [{ productId: product, sku: "HF-101", name, unit: "UN", priceWithoutIpiCents: 20000, priceWithIpiCents: 22600 }] } } }))
      await page.route(`**/api/erp/products/${product}`, route => route.fulfill({ json: { tenantId: tenant, data: { structureColors, upholsteryColors: ["Preto", "Vermelho"], plateHolderColors: ["Piano Black"], plateHolderTypes: ["Olímpico"] } } }))
      let sent: Record<string, unknown> | undefined

    type ApiProblem = { title?: unknown }
    
    async function readJson(response: Response): Promise<unknown> {
      const body = await response.text()
      if (!body.trim()) throw new Error("O ERP retornou uma resposta vazia. Atualize o serviço e tente novamente.")
      try { return JSON.parse(body) } catch { throw new Error("O ERP retornou uma resposta inválida. Tente novamente.") }
    }
    
    function message(value: unknown, fallback: string) {
      return typeof (value as ApiProblem | null)?.title === "string" ? (value as ApiProblem).title as string : fallback
    }
    
    export function useResource<T>(url: string) {
      const [state, setState] = useState<{ url: string; value: T | null; etag: string; error: string; pending: boolean; status: number }>({ url, value: null, etag: "", error: "", pending: true, status: 0 })
      const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0)
      useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController()
        let status = 0
        erpFetch(url, { cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal }).then(async response => {
          status = response.status
          const value = await readJson(response)
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(message(value, "Consulta indisponível"))
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) setState({ url, value: value as T, etag: response.headers.get("etag") || "", error: "", pending: false, status })
        }).catch(reason => {
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) setState({ url, value: null, etag: "", error: reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Consulta indisponível", pending: false, status })
        })
        return () => controller.abort()
      }, [url, revision])
      function reload() { setState(previous => ({ ...previous, pending: true })); setRevision(value => value + 1) }
      return { value: state.url === url ? state.value : null, etag: state.url === url ? state.etag : "", loading: state.url !== url || state.pending, error: state.url === url ? state.error : "", status: state.url === url ? state.status : 0, reload }
    }
    
    type Command = { url: string; tenant: string; body: string; etag: string; key: string; method: "POST" | "PUT" }
    
    export function useCommand() {
      const current = useRef<Command | null>(null)
      const running = useRef(false)
      const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
      const [uncertain, setUncertain] = useState(false)
      const [stale, setStale] = useState(false)
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const [status, setStatus] = useState(0)
    
      async function send<T>(url: string, tenant: string, body: object, etag = "", method: "POST" | "PUT" = "POST"): Promise<T | null> {
        if (running.current || stale) return null
        running.current = true; setBusy(true); setError(""); setStatus(0)
        if (!uncertain) current.current = { url, tenant, body: JSON.stringify(body), etag, key: crypto.randomUUID(), method }
        const command = current.current!
        try {
          const response = await erpFetch(command.url, {
            method: command.method,
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Tenant-Id": command.tenant, "Idempotency-Key": command.key, ...(command.etag ? { "If-Match": command.etag } : {}) },
            body: command.body,
          })
          setStatus(response.status)
          const value = await readJson(response)
          if (!response.ok) {
            setUncertain(response.status >= 500); setStale(response.status === 412)
            setError(message(value, "Operação recusada"))
            return null
          }
          if (!response.headers.get("etag")) throw new Error("Confirmação sem revisão")

    import { useEffect, useRef, type ComponentProps } from "react"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    
    type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<"input">, "ref"> & {
      onSearch: (value: string, form: HTMLFormElement | null) => void
    }
    
    /** Only invokes a read callback; never submits an enclosing business form. */
    export function SearchInput({ onSearch, onChange, onCompositionStart, onCompositionEnd, onKeyDown, defaultValue, ...props }: Props) {
      const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
      const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)
      const composing = useRef(false)
      const callback = useRef(onSearch)
      const submitted = useRef(String(defaultValue ?? ""))
      useEffect(() => { callback.current = onSearch }, [onSearch])
      useEffect(() => {
        if (defaultValue !== undefined && String(defaultValue) !== submitted.current && input.current) {
          input.current.value = String(defaultValue)
          submitted.current = String(defaultValue)
        }
      }, [defaultValue])
      function cancel() { if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current); timer.current = null }
      useEffect(() => {
        const form = input.current?.form
        form?.addEventListener("submit", cancel, true)
        return () => { cancel(); form?.removeEventListener("submit", cancel, true) }
      }, [])
      function schedule(element: HTMLInputElement) {
        cancel()
        if (composing.current) return
        const value = element.value
        timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
          timer.current = null
          if (!element.isConnected || element.disabled || element.closest("fieldset[disabled]") || element.value !== value) return
          submitted.current = value
          callback.current(value, element.form)
        }, 300)
      }
      return <Input {...props} ref={input} defaultValue={defaultValue} autoComplete="off"
        onChange={event => { onChange?.(event); schedule(event.currentTarget) }}
        onCompositionStart={event => { composing.current = true; cancel(); onCompositionStart?.(event) }}
        onCompositionEnd={event => { composing.current = false; onCompositionEnd?.(event); schedule(event.currentTarget) }}
        onKeyDown={event => { if (event.key === "Escape" || event.key === "Enter") cancel(); onKeyDown?.(event) }} />
    }

            <Button className="self-end" type="submit" disabled={loading}>Buscar</Button>

            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{result.total} pessoa(s) · {result.canEdit ? "Consulta e edição" : "Somente consulta"}</p>
            {result.data.length ? <div className="workspace-list-scroll" role="region" aria-label="Lista de clientes e fornecedores" tabIndex={0}><DataTable aria-label="Clientes e fornecedores" className="min-w-[640px]">

              <tbody>{result.data.map(party => <tr key={party.id}>
                <th scope="row" className="font-medium"><Link className={linkClass} href={`/cadastros/clientes-fornecedores/${party.id}`}>{party.legalName}</Link></th>
                <td className="whitespace-nowrap">{party.taxId}</td><td>{relationship(party)}</td><td>{party.email || party.phone || "Não informado"}</td><td>{party.status === "active" ? "Ativo" : "Arquivado"}</td>

          </>}
        </section>
      </>
    }

        requested: Option<&str>,
        available: &[String],
        previous: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<Option<String>, DomainError> {
        let selected = requested
            .or(previous)
            .map(str::trim)
            .filter(|value| !value.is_empty());
        let Some(selected) = selected else {
            return if available.is_empty() {
                Ok(None)
            } else {
                Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Escolha as cores disponíveis da estrutura e do estofado antes de salvar",
                ))
            };
        };
        if previous == Some(selected) {
            return Ok(Some(selected.to_owned()));
        }
        available
            .iter()
            .find(|color| color.to_lowercase() == selected.to_lowercase())
            .cloned()
            .map(Some)
            .ok_or(DomainError::Invalid(
                "A cor escolhida não está disponível neste produto; atualize as opções antes de salvar",
            ))
    }

          <Link className="mt-2 inline-flex min-h-11 items-center text-primary underline"

        </section>

    use super::{select_color, select_optional_color, select_plate_holder_type};
    
    #[test]
    fn plate_holder_type_is_fixed_and_independent_of_catalog_options() {
        for (requested, expected) in [
            ("Standard", "Standard"),
            (" standard ", "Standard"),
            ("Olímpico", "Olímpico"),
            ("OLÍMPICO", "Olímpico"),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(
                select_plate_holder_type(Some(requested), None)
                    .unwrap()
                    .as_deref(),
                Some(expected)
            );
        }
        for requested in [None, Some(""), Some(" "), Some("Não se aplica")] {
            assert_eq!(
                select_plate_holder_type(requested, Some("Olímpico")).unwrap(),
                None
            );
        }
        assert!(select_plate_holder_type(Some("Cônico"), None).is_err());
        assert_eq!(
            select_plate_holder_type(Some("Redondo"), Some("Redondo"))
                .unwrap()
                .as_deref(),
            Some("Redondo")
        );
        assert!(select_plate_holder_type(Some("Redondo"), Some("Cônico")).is_err());
    }
    
    #[test]
    fn legacy_plate_holder_color_is_optional_without_relaxing_other_colors() {
        let available = vec!["Preto".to_owned()];
        assert_eq!(select_optional_color(None, &available, None).unwrap(), None);
        assert_eq!(
            select_optional_color(None, &available, Some("Azul")).unwrap(),
            None
        );
        assert_eq!(
            select_optional_color(Some(" "), &available, None).unwrap(),
            None
        );
        assert_eq!(
            select_optional_color(Some("preto"), &available, None)
                .unwrap()
                .as_deref(),
            Some("Preto")
        );
        assert_eq!(
            select_optional_color(Some("Azul"), &available, Some("Azul"))
                .unwrap()
                .as_deref(),
            Some("Azul")
        );
        assert!(select_optional_color(Some("Azul"), &available, None).is_err());
        assert!(select_color(None, &available, None).is_err());
    }
    }
    
    // Holder colors remain accepted for older clients, but are never required.
    fn select_optional_color(
        requested: Option<&str>,
        available: &[String],
        previous: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<Option<String>, DomainError> {
        let Some(selected) = requested.map(str::trim).filter(|value| !value.is_empty()) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        select_color(Some(selected), available, previous)
    }
    
    // Sales options are fixed, independent of legacy product catalog choices.
    fn select_plate_holder_type(
        requested: Option<&str>,
        previous: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<Option<String>, DomainError> {
        let Some(selected) = requested.map(str::trim).filter(|value| !value.is_empty()) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        match selected.to_lowercase().as_str() {
            "não se aplica" => Ok(None),
            "standard" => Ok(Some("Standard".to_owned())),
            "olímpico" => Ok(Some("Olímpico".to_owned())),
            _ if previous == Some(selected) => Ok(Some(selected.to_owned())),
            _ => Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Tipo de anilheiro deve ser Standard, Olímpico ou Não se aplica",
            )),
        }
    }
    
    fn legacy_plate_holder_color<'a>(
        plate_holder_color: Option<&'a str>,
        arm_color: Option<&'a str>,
    ) -> Result<Option<&'a str>, DomainError> {
        if let (Some(current), Some(legacy)) = (plate_holder_color, arm_color)
            && !current.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(legacy.trim())
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Informe a cor dos anilheiros apenas em plateHolderColor",
            ));
        }
        Ok(plate_holder_color.or(arm_color))
    }

    impl Line {
        fn finish_information(&self) -> Option<String> {
            self.describe_finish(false)
        }
    
        // Previously generated linked drafts may retain the old description.
        fn recorded_finish_information(&self) -> Option<String> {
            self.describe_finish(true)
        }
    
        fn describe_finish(&self, include_legacy_holder_color: bool) -> Option<String> {
            let values = [
                ("Estrutura", &self.structure_color, true),
                (
                    "Anilheiros",
                    &self.plate_holder_color,
                    include_legacy_holder_color,
                ),
                ("Tipo de anilheiro", &self.plate_holder_type, true),
                ("Estofado", &self.upholstery_color, true),
            ]
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|(_, _, include)| *include)
            .filter_map(|(label, value, _)| {
                value
                    .as_deref()
                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
                    .map(|s| format!("{label}: {s}"))
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
            (!values.is_empty()).then(|| values.join("; "))
        }
    }

    test("tabela publicada mantém preços desconto e ação acessíveis no celular", async ({ page }) => {
      const input = { versionId: version, productId: product, quantity: 1, destination: "SP", taxpayer: false, discount: { kind: "percent", value: 3000 }, freightCents: 0 }
      const snapshot = { tenantId: tenant, line: "imported", versionId: version, version: 6, digest: "a".repeat(64), product: { sku: equipment.sku, name: equipment.name, unit: "UN" }, input, sale: { ...sale, needsApproval: true, approvalReasons: ["discount_above_free"] }, director }
      await page.route(`**/api/erp/orders/${orderId}`, route => route.fulfill({ headers: { ETag: `"${revision}"` }, json: { tenantId: tenant, canEdit: true, pricingOrigin: true, data: { id: orderId, number: "1", customerId: customer, customerName: "Cliente de teste", customerTaxId: "52998224725", dueDate: "2026-12-30", amount: "226.00", status: "draft", revision }, items: [{ productId: product, sku: equipment.sku, name: equipment.name, unit: "UN", quantity: "1.000000", unitPrice: "226.00", amount: "226.00" }] } }))
      await page.route("**/api/erp/sales-settings", route => route.fulfill({ json: { tenantId: tenant, canEdit: false, data: null } }))
      await page.route(`**/api/erp/orders/${orderId}/pricing`, route => route.fulfill({ headers: { ETag: `"${revision}"` }, json: { tenantId: tenant, canApprove: true, data: { snapshot, needsApproval: true, approved } } }))
      await page.route(`**/api/erp/orders/${orderId}/pricing/approve`, route => {
        expect(route.request().headers()["if-match"]).toBe('"1"')
        expect(route.request().headers()["idempotency-key"]).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/)
        expect(route.request().postDataJSON()).toEqual({ reason: "Negociação revisada" })
        revision += 1; approved = true
        return route.fulfill({ headers: { ETag: '"2"' }, json: { tenantId: tenant, id: orderId, revision, approved } })
      })
      await page.goto(`/vendas/pedidos/${orderId}`)
      await expect(page.getByRole("link", { name: "Editar rascunho", exact: true })).toHaveCount(0)
      await page.getByText("Negociação e condições comerciais", { exact: true }).click()
      await page.getByLabel("Motivo da aprovação", { exact: true }).fill("Negociação revisada")
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Aprovar exceção comercial", exact: true }).click()
      const approvedNotice = page.getByText("Exceção comercial aprovada pela gestão.", { exact: true })
      await expect(approvedNotice).toBeAttached()
      // Reloading the order restores its compact sections after the decision.
      if (!await approvedNotice.isVisible()) await page.getByText("Negociação e condições comerciais", { exact: true }).click()
      await expect(approvedNotice).toBeVisible()
      await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Aprovar exceção comercial", exact: true })).toHaveCount(0)
    })

## Assistant

Publicado em [erp.avilaops.com](https://erp.avilaops.com).

As telas enviadas estão mais compactas e responsivas, com campos agrupados, fotos menores e seções opcionais recolhidas.

Removi **cor dos anilheiros**. Na negociação, ficam apenas **Standard, Olímpico ou Não se aplica**.

Build local, testes aprovados e repositório sincronizado. Pode atualizar a página.

[Image #1]aqui não tem como colocar o envio ppor email?

## Assistant

Vou conferir o envio por e-mail na tela da proposta e deixá-lo visível junto ao botão de PDF, com destinatário, mensagem e anexo para revisar antes de enviar.

    "use client"
    
    import { useId, useState } from "react"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { useCommand, useResource } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    import { orderNumber } from "./order-presentation"
    
    type Delivery = { id: string; status: "sent" | "failed" | "uncertain"; recipient: string; createdAt: string }
    type EmailStatus = { tenantId: string; recipient: string | null; canSend: boolean; emailReady: boolean; deliveries: Delivery[] }
    type Receipt = { tenantId: string; revision: number; delivery: Delivery }
    const deliveryLabels = { sent: "Aceito pelo servidor de e-mail", failed: "Recusado pelo servidor de e-mail", uncertain: "Confirmação pendente · não reenviar" }
    
    export function OrderEmail({ id, number, tenantId, etag, onReload }: { id: string; number: string; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void }) {
      const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
      // Only consult delivery configuration/history when the composer is opened.
      return <>
        <Button variant="outline" className="h-9 px-3" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Enviar por e-mail</Button>
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
          <DialogContent className="max-h-[90dvh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-xl">
            <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Enviar {orderNumber(number)} por e-mail</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>Confira o destinatário e a mensagem antes de enviar o documento do pedido.</DialogDescription></DialogHeader>
            {open && <OrderEmailComposer id={id} number={number} tenantId={tenantId} etag={etag} onReload={onReload} />}
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </>
    }
    
    function OrderEmailComposer({ id, number, tenantId, etag, onReload }: { id: string; number: string; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void }) {
      const messageId = useId()
      const resource = useResource<EmailStatus>(`/api/erp/orders/${id}/email`)
      const command = useCommand()
      const [recipientOverride, setRecipientOverride] = useState<string | null>(null)
      const [subject, setSubject] = useState(`Pedido ${orderNumber(number)}`)
      const [message, setMessage] = useState(`Olá,\n\nSegue em anexo o pedido ${orderNumber(number)} para sua conferência.\n\nFicamos à disposição.`)
      const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState<Delivery | null>(null)
      const value = resource.value?.tenantId === tenantId ? resource.value : null
      const recipient = recipientOverride ?? value?.recipient ?? ""
      const pendingDelivery = receipt?.status === "uncertain" || value?.deliveries.some(delivery => delivery.status === "uncertain")
      const frozen = command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale || !!pendingDelivery || receipt?.status === "sent"
      if (resource.loading && !value) return <p role="status">Consultando envio de e-mail…</p>
      if (resource.error || !value) return <div className="space-y-3"><p role="alert"><RequestError message={resource.error || "Não foi possível consultar o envio deste pedido."} status={resource.status} /></p><Button variant="outline" onClick={resource.reload}>Consultar novamente</Button></div>
      return <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={async event => {
        event.preventDefault()
        if (!command.uncertain && (!value.canSend || !value.emailReady || frozen)) return
        const result = await command.send<Receipt>(`/api/erp/orders/${id}/email`, tenantId, { recipient, subject, message }, etag)
        if (result?.tenantId === tenantId) { setReceipt(result.delivery); resource.reload() }
      }}>
        {!value.emailReady && <p role="status" className="rounded-lg border p-3">O envio de e-mail ainda não está configurado no servidor. Nenhuma mensagem será enviada até a configuração estar disponível.</p>}
        {!value.canSend && <p role="status">Envio indisponível: verifique sua permissão de gestão e se o pedido está cancelado.</p>}
        <fieldset disabled={frozen || !value.canSend || !value.emailReady} className="space-y-3">
          <label className="block space-y-2">Destinatário<Input type="email" autoComplete="email" required maxLength={254} value={recipient} onChange={event => setRecipientOverride(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <label className="block space-y-2">Assunto<Input required maxLength={200} value={subject} onChange={event => setSubject(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <div className="space-y-2"><label htmlFor={messageId} className="block">Mensagem</label><textarea id={messageId} required maxLength={10000} rows={5} className="w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-background p-3" value={message} onChange={event => setMessage(event.target.value)} /></div>
        </fieldset>
        <p className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3 text-sm">Anexo: documento do pedido em HTML, com cliente, itens, acabamentos e valores registrados. Para enviar o contrato para assinatura, use “Pedido e contratos”.</p>
        {command.error && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={command.error} status={command.status} /></p>}
        {command.stale && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { command.reset(); onReload(); resource.reload() }}>Recarregar pedido</Button>}
        {receipt && <p role="status">{deliveryLabels[receipt.status]} · {receipt.recipient}{receipt.status === "sent" ? ". A entrega na caixa do destinatário depende do provedor." : "."}</p>}
        {pendingDelivery && <p role="status">Há um envio sem confirmação definitiva. Consulte o histórico e confirme com o provedor antes de realizar outro envio.</p>}
        {command.uncertain && <p role="status">Resultado ainda não confirmado. A consulta abaixo repete o mesmo comando, sem criar um novo envio.</p>}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button type="submit" disabled={command.busy || command.stale || (!command.uncertain && (!value.canSend || !value.emailReady || frozen || !etag))}>{command.busy ? "Confirmando envio…" : command.uncertain ? "Consultar resultado do envio" : "Enviar e-mail com anexo"}</Button>
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={command.busy} onClick={resource.reload}>Atualizar histórico</Button>
        </div>
        {!!value.deliveries.length && <details><summary className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium">Histórico de envios</summary><ul className="mt-3 space-y-3 text-sm">{value.deliveries.map(delivery => <li key={delivery.id} className="break-words rounded-lg border p-3">{deliveryLabels[delivery.status]}<br />{delivery.recipient} · {new Date(delivery.createdAt).toLocaleString("pt-BR")}</li>)}</ul></details>}
      </form>
    }

    pub async fn get(
        State(state): State<AppState>,
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
        Path(id): Path<Uuid>,
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        let (tenant, mut tx, manage) =
            authorized(&state, &headers, &identity, READ, MANAGE, false).await?;
        let current = load(&mut tx, tenant, id, manage).await?;
        let recipient: Option<String> =
            sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT email FROM parties WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2")
                .bind(tenant)
                .bind(current.data.customer_id)
                .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
                .await
                .map_err(db)?;
        let deliveries = sqlx::query_as::<_, ProposalEmailDelivery>(&format!(
            "{DELIVERY} WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND proposal_id=$2 ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 50"
        ))
        .bind(tenant)
        .bind(id)
        .fetch_all(&mut *tx)
        .await
        .map_err(db)?;
        let today: time::Date =
            sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date")
                .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
                .await
                .map_err(db)?;
        let value = ProposalEmailStatus {
            tenant_id: tenant,
            can_send: manage
                && ["draft", "sent"].contains(&current.data.status.as_str())
                && current.data.order_id.is_none()
                && super::super::date(&current.data.valid_until)? >= today,
            email_ready: state.mail.is_some(),
            recipient,
            deliveries,
        };
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(StatusCode::OK, None, value))
    }
    
    fn normalize(mut input: ProposalEmailInput) -> Result<ProposalEmailInput, DomainError> {
        if input.recipient.chars().any(char::is_control) || input.subject.chars().any(char::is_control)
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        let key = command_key(&headers)?;
        let expected = revision(&headers)?;
        let (tenant, mut tx, _) = authorized(&state, &headers, &identity, READ, MANAGE, true).await?;
        let Json(input) =
            payload.map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("JSON inválido ou campos desconhecidos"))?;
        let input = normalize(input)?;
        let request = json!({"id":id,"revision":expected,"input":input});
        if let Some(previous) = replay(
            &mut tx,
            tenant,
            &identity.subject,
            key,
            "proposal.email",
            &request,

        {
