                .as_str()
                .and_then(|v| Uuid::parse_str(v).ok())
                .ok_or(AccessError::Internal)?;
            let value = receipt(&mut tx, tenant, delivery).await?;
            tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
            return Ok(response(StatusCode::OK, Some(value.revision), value));
        }
        let current = load(&mut tx, tenant, id, true).await?;
        if current.data.revision != expected {
            return Err(DomainError::StaleRevision);
        }
        let today: time::Date =
            sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date")
                .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
                .await
                .map_err(db)?;
        if !["draft", "sent"].contains(&current.data.status.as_str())
            || current.data.order_id.is_some()
            || super::super::date(&current.data.valid_until)? < today
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "Somente a versão atual e válida de uma proposta em rascunho ou enviada pode ser enviada por e-mail",
            ));
        }
        let Some(mailer) = state.mail.as_ref() else {
            // Nothing is persisted or published when SMTP is unavailable.
            return Ok(response(
                StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
                None,
                json!({"title":"O envio de e-mail não está configurado. Nenhuma mensagem foi enviada.","status":503}),
            ));

            .bind(delivery).bind(tenant).bind(id).bind(current.data.version).bind(expected).bind(&identity.subject).bind(key).bind(&input.recipient).bind(std::str::from_utf8(&file.bytes).map_err(|_| AccessError::Internal)?).execute(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;

        remember(
            &mut tx,
            tenant,
            &identity.subject,
            key,
            "proposal.email",
            &request,
            &json!({"deliveryId":delivery}),

        .await?;

            .send_with_attachments(

                &input.subject,
                &input.message,

            .bind(tenant).bind(delivery).bind(status).execute(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;

    fn delivery_status(result: &anyhow::Result<()>) -> &'static str {
        match result {
            Ok(()) => "sent",
            // Explicit 4xx/5xx SMTP responses confirm rejection. Transport loss and timeouts
            // may occur after the server accepted DATA, so they must remain uncertain.
      const [dueDate, setDueDate] = useState("")
      const [notice, setNotice] = useState("")
      const value = result.value
      const frozen = command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale
      const sameTenant = access.value?.tenant.id === value?.tenantId
      const canDecide = sameTenant && access.value?.permissions.includes("sales.proposals.decide")
      const canConvert = sameTenant && ["sales.orders.read", "sales.orders.manage"].every(permission => access.value?.permissions.includes(permission))
      async function confirm() {
        if (!value || !action) return
        const body = action === "convert" ? { dueDate } : action === "revise" ? {} : { reason: reason || null }
        const updated = await command.send<Detail>(`/api/erp/proposals/${id}/${action}`, value.tenantId, body, result.etag)
        if (updated) { setNotice("Operação confirmada no servidor."); setAction(""); setReason(""); setVersion(""); result.reload() }
      }
      return <><div className="print:hidden"><PageHeader eyebrow="Vendas / Propostas" breadcrumbs={[...proposalTrail, { label: value ? `Proposta ${value.data.number} · versão ${value.data.version}` : "Proposta" }]} title={value ? `Proposta ${value.data.number}` : "Proposta comercial"} description="Consulte o documento comercial e registre as decisões sobre cada versão." /></div>
        <div className="print:hidden"><Link className={linkClass} href="/vendas/propostas">Voltar às propostas</Link></div>
        <section className="mt-5 min-w-0 space-y-5">
          {notice && <p role="status" className="print:hidden">{notice}</p>}
          {result.loading ? <p role="status">Carregando proposta…</p> : result.error ? <div role="alert"><RequestError message={result.error} status={result.status} /><Button onClick={result.reload}>Tentar novamente</Button></div> : value && <>
            <div className="flex justify-end print:hidden"><Button variant="outline" onClick={() => window.print()}>Imprimir / salvar PDF</Button></div>
            <label className="grid min-w-0 gap-2 print:hidden">Histórico de versões<select className="min-h-10 w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border bg-background px-3" value={version} disabled={frozen} onChange={event => { setVersion(event.target.value); setAction("") }}><option value="">Versão atual</option>{value.versions.map(item => <option key={item.version} value={String(item.version)}>Versão {item.version} · {labels[item.status]} · {money(item.amount)}</option>)}</select></label>
            <ProposalDocument snapshot={value} issuer={issuer.value?.tenantId === value.tenantId ? issuer.value.data : undefined} issuerName={sameTenant ? access.value?.tenant.legalName : undefined} />
            {value.data.decisionReason && <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap print:hidden">Motivo registrado: {value.data.decisionReason}</p>}
            {value.data.orderId && <Link className={`${linkClass} print:hidden`} href={`/vendas/pedidos/${value.data.orderId}`}>Consultar pedido gerado</Link>}
            {!value.data.isCurrent && <p className="print:hidden">Versão histórica. Consulte a versão atual para realizar operações.</p>}
            <div className="space-y-4 print:hidden">
              {command.error && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={command.error} status={command.status} /></p>}
              {command.stale && <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => { command.reset(); setAction(""); result.reload() }}>Recarregar proposta</Button>}
              {value.data.isCurrent && !value.data.orderId && !action && <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                {value.canEdit && value.data.status === "draft" && <><Link className={linkClass} href={`/vendas/propostas/${id}/editar`}>Editar rascunho</Link><Button disabled={frozen} onClick={() => setAction("send")}>Marcar como enviada</Button></>}
                {canDecide && value.data.status === "sent" && <><Button disabled={frozen || value.data.expired} onClick={() => setAction("accept")}>Registrar aceite</Button><Button disabled={frozen} variant="outline" onClick={() => setAction("reject")}>Registrar rejeição</Button></>}
                {value.canEdit && ["sent", "accepted", "rejected"].includes(value.data.status) && <Button disabled={frozen} variant="outline" onClick={() => setAction("revise")}>Criar nova versão</Button>}
                {value.canEdit && ["draft", "sent", "accepted"].includes(value.data.status) && <Button disabled={frozen} variant="outline" onClick={() => setAction("cancel")}>Cancelar proposta</Button>}
                {value.canEdit && canConvert && value.data.status === "accepted" && <Button disabled={frozen} onClick={() => setAction("convert")}>Gerar pedido em rascunho</Button>}
              </div>}
              {action && <form className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border p-4" onSubmit={event => { event.preventDefault(); void confirm() }}>
                <p>{action === "send" ? "Confirme que esta versão já foi enviada ao cliente. O conteúdo ficará bloqueado; este botão não envia mensagens." : action === "accept" ? "Registre o aceite recebido do cliente. Este registro interno não equivale a uma assinatura digital." : action === "revise" ? "Uma nova versão em rascunho será criada, preservando o conteúdo anterior." : action === "convert" ? "Será criado um pedido em rascunho com os preços acordados. A reserva e a cobrança seguem o fluxo do pedido." : "Informe o motivo desta decisão."}</p>
                {["reject", "cancel"].includes(action) && <CommercialText label="Motivo" required maxLength={2000} disabled={frozen} value={reason} onChange={event => setReason(event.target.value)} />}
                {action === "convert" && <label className="grid min-w-0 gap-2">Vencimento do pedido<Input type="date" className="block max-w-full appearance-none [&::-webkit-date-and-time-value]:min-w-0 [&::-webkit-date-and-time-value]:text-start" required disabled={frozen} value={dueDate} onChange={event => setDueDate(event.target.value)} /></label>}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3"><Button type="submit" disabled={command.busy || command.stale}>{command.uncertain ? "Repetir confirmação" : "Confirmar operação"}</Button><Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={frozen} onClick={() => setAction("")}>Voltar</Button></div>
              </form>}
            </div>
          </>}
        </section>
      </>
    }

    ---
    title: use client
    description: Learn how to use the use client directive to render a component on the client.
    ---
    
    The `'use client'` directive declares an entry point for the components to be rendered on the **client side** and should be used when creating interactive user interfaces (UI) that require client-side JavaScript capabilities, such as state management, event handling, and access to browser APIs. This is a React feature.
    
    > **Good to know:**
    >
    > You do not need to add the `'use client'` directive to every file that contains Client Components. You only need to add it to the files whose components you want to render directly within Server Components. The `'use client'` directive defines the [server and client boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary), and the components exported from such a file serve as entry points to the client.
    
    ## Usage
    
    To declare an entry point for the Client Components, add the `'use client'` directive **at the top of the file**, before any imports. The directive applies to the entire module and cannot be placed inside a component or function:

    name: dispatching-parallel-agents
    description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
    ---
    
    # Dispatching Parallel Agents
    
    ## Overview
    
    You delegate tasks to specialized agents with isolated context. By precisely crafting their instructions and context, you ensure they stay focused and succeed at their task. They should never inherit your session's context or history — you construct exactly what they need. This also preserves your own context for coordination work.
    
    When you have multiple unrelated failures (different test files, different subsystems, different bugs), investigating them sequentially wastes time. Each investigation is independent and can happen in parallel.
    
    **Core principle:** Dispatch one agent per independent problem domain. Let them work concurrently.
    
    ## When to Use
    
    ```dot
    digraph when_to_use {
        "Multiple failures?" [shape=diamond];
        "Are they independent?" [shape=diamond];
        "Single agent investigates all" [shape=box];
        "One agent per problem domain" [shape=box];
        "Can they work in parallel?" [shape=diamond];
        "Sequential agents" [shape=box];
        "Parallel dispatch" [shape=box];
    
        "Multiple failures?" -> "Are they independent?" [label="yes"];
        "Are they independent?" -> "Single agent investigates all" [label="no - related"];
        "Are they independent?" -> "Can they work in parallel?" [label="yes"];
        "Can they work in parallel?" -> "Parallel dispatch" [label="yes"];
        "Can they work in parallel?" -> "Sequential agents" [label="no - shared state"];
    }
    ```
    
    **Use when:**
    - 3+ test files failing with different root causes
    - Multiple subsystems broken independently
    - Each problem can be understood without context from others
    - No shared state between investigations
    
    **Don't use when:**
    - Failures are related (fix one might fix others)
    - Need to understand full system state
    - Agents would interfere with each other
    
    ## The Pattern
    
    ### 1. Identify Independent Domains
    
    Group failures by what's broken:
    - File A tests: Tool approval flow
    - File B tests: Batch completion behavior
    - File C tests: Abort functionality

      { name: "Piano Black", x: 71, y: 939, width: 90, height: 62 },
      { name: "Matte Graphite Black", x: 172, y: 939, width: 90, height: 62 },
      { name: "Light Grey", x: 273, y: 939, width: 90, height: 62 },
      { name: "Performance Red", x: 374, y: 939, width: 90, height: 62 },
      { name: "Titanium Grey", x: 75, y: 174, width: 92, height: 64 },
      { name: "Hermès Orange", x: 971, y: 939, width: 90, height: 62 },
      { name: "Apple Green", x: 1072, y: 939, width: 90, height: 62 },
      { name: "Ocean Blue", x: 75, y: 263, width: 92, height: 63 },
      { name: "Saddle Brown", x: 510, y: 1695, width: 180, height: 62 },
      { name: "Reddish Brown", x: 760, y: 1695, width: 180, height: 62 },
      { name: "Mocha", x: 1010, y: 1695, width: 180, height: 62 },
    ] as const
    
    function key(value: string) {
      return value.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/[\s-]+/g, "")
    }
    
    export type CatalogPalette = "dhz-hammerforce"
    
    export function catalogPaletteFor(structureColors?: readonly string[] | null): CatalogPalette | undefined {
      const colors = new Set((structureColors ?? []).map(key))
      return colors.has("pianoblack") && colors.has("titaniumgrey") && (colors.has("graphiteblack") || colors.has("mattegraphiteblack")) ? "dhz-hammerforce" : undefined
    }
    
    const hammerForceAliases: Record<string, string> = {
      preto: "Piano Black",
      grafite: "Matte Graphite Black",
      cinza: "Light Grey",
      vermelho: "Performance Red",
      laranja: "Hermès Orange",
      azul: "Ocean Blue",
    }
    
    export function catalogColorPhoto(value: string, palette?: CatalogPalette) {
      // Resolve legacy swing-arm labels only after the same product identifies its palette.
      const aliasKey = key(value)
      const alias = palette === "dhz-hammerforce" && Object.hasOwn(hammerForceAliases, aliasKey) ? hammerForceAliases[aliasKey] : undefined
      const normalized = key(alias ?? value)
      // The supplier's shortened label refers to the same named graphite finish.
      return photos.find(photo => key(photo.name) === normalized || (photo.name === "Matte Graphite Black" && normalized === "graphiteblack"))
    }
    "use client"
    
    import { catalogColorPhoto, type CatalogPalette } from "./catalog-color-photo-model"
    
    type CatalogColorPhotosProps = {
      label: string
      options?: readonly string[]
      value?: string
      onChange?: (value: string) => void
      disabled?: boolean
      palette?: CatalogPalette
      readOnly?: boolean
    }
    
    export function CatalogColorPhotos({ label, options, value, onChange, disabled, palette, readOnly = false }: CatalogColorPhotosProps) {
      const matches = [...new Set(options ?? [])].flatMap(option => {
        const photo = catalogColorPhoto(option, palette)
        return photo || readOnly ? [{ option, photo }] : []
      })
      if (!matches.length) return null
    
      return <div className="space-y-2" role="group" aria-label={`${label}: fotos do catálogo DHZ`}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {matches.map(({ option, photo }) => {
            if (!photo) return <span key={option} className="self-center rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-sm">{option}</span>
            const scale = 56 / photo.width
            const content = <>
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="flex h-10 items-center"><span className="block shrink-0 rounded-sm" style={{
                width: 56,
                height: photo.height * scale,
                backgroundImage: 'url("/catalog/dhz-hammerforce-pro-original-colors.jpeg")',
                backgroundRepeat: "no-repeat",
                backgroundSize: `${1245 * scale}px ${1759 * scale}px`,
                backgroundPosition: `${-photo.x * scale}px ${-photo.y * scale}px`,
              }} /></span>
              <span className="break-words">{option}</span>
            </>
            const cardClass = "flex w-[4.5rem] flex-col items-center gap-1 rounded-md border p-1 text-center text-xs"
            return readOnly ? <div key={option} className={cardClass}>{content}</div> : <button key={option} type="button" disabled={disabled || !onChange} aria-pressed={value === option} onClick={() => onChange?.(option)} title={option}
              className={`${cardClass} focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${value === option ? "border-primary ring-1 ring-primary" : "border-border hover:border-primary"}`}>{content}</button>
          })}
        </div>
        {matches.some(match => match.photo) && <a className="text-xs text-muted-foreground underline underline-offset-2" href="/catalog/dhz-hammerforce-pro-original-colors.jpeg" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Ver cores no catálogo DHZ · HammerForce Pro, pág. 101</a>}
      </div>
    }

    "use client"
    
    import { useId, useState } from "react"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { useCommand, useResource } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    
    type Delivery = { id: string; status: "sent" | "failed" | "uncertain"; recipient: string; createdAt: string }
    type EmailStatus = { tenantId: string; recipient: string | null; canSend: boolean; emailReady: boolean; deliveries: Delivery[] }
    type Receipt = { tenantId: string; revision: number; delivery: Delivery }
    const deliveryLabels = { sent: "Aceito pelo servidor de e-mail", failed: "Recusado pelo servidor de e-mail", uncertain: "Confirmação pendente · não reenviar" }
    
    export function ProposalEmail({ id, number, version, tenantId, etag, onReload, disabled = false }: { id: string; number: string; version: number; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void; disabled?: boolean }) {
      const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
      // Only consult delivery configuration/history when the composer is opened.
      return <>
        <Button variant="outline" className="h-9 px-3" disabled={disabled} title={disabled ? "Consulte a versão atual para enviar por e-mail" : undefined} onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Enviar por e-mail</Button>
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
          <DialogContent className="max-h-[90dvh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-xl">
            <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Enviar proposta {number} por e-mail</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>Confira o destinatário e a mensagem antes de enviar o documento da proposta.</DialogDescription></DialogHeader>
            {open && <ProposalEmailComposer id={id} number={number} version={version} tenantId={tenantId} etag={etag} onReload={onReload} />}
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </>
    }
    
    function ProposalEmailComposer({ id, number, version, tenantId, etag, onReload }: { id: string; number: string; version: number; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void }) {
      const messageId = useId()
      const resource = useResource<EmailStatus>(`/api/erp/proposals/${id}/email`)
      const command = useCommand()
      const [recipientOverride, setRecipientOverride] = useState<string | null>(null)
      const [subject, setSubject] = useState(`Proposta ${number} · versão ${version}`)
      const [message, setMessage] = useState(`Olá,\n\nSegue em anexo a proposta ${number} para sua conferência.\n\nFicamos à disposição.`)
      const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState<Delivery | null>(null)
      const value = resource.value?.tenantId === tenantId ? resource.value : null
      const recipient = recipientOverride ?? value?.recipient ?? ""
      const pendingDelivery = receipt?.status === "uncertain" || value?.deliveries.some(delivery => delivery.status === "uncertain")
      const frozen = command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale || !!pendingDelivery || receipt?.status === "sent"
      if (resource.loading && !value) return <p role="status">Consultando envio de e-mail…</p>
      if (resource.error || !value) return <div className="space-y-3"><p role="alert"><RequestError message={resource.error || "Não foi possível consultar o envio desta proposta."} status={resource.status} /></p><Button variant="outline" onClick={resource.reload}>Consultar novamente</Button></div>
      return <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={async event => {
        event.preventDefault()
        if (!command.uncertain && (!value.canSend || !value.emailReady || frozen)) return
        const result = await command.send<Receipt>(`/api/erp/proposals/${id}/email`, tenantId, { recipient, subject, message }, etag)
        if (result?.tenantId === tenantId) { setReceipt(result.delivery); resource.reload(); if (result.delivery.status === "sent") onReload() }
      }}>
        {!value.emailReady && <p role="status" className="rounded-lg border p-3">O envio de e-mail ainda não está configurado no servidor. Nenhuma mensagem será enviada até a configuração estar disponível.</p>}
        {!value.canSend && <p role="status">Envio indisponível: confira sua permissão, a validade e a situação da proposta.</p>}
        <fieldset disabled={frozen || !value.canSend || !value.emailReady} className="space-y-3">
          <label className="block space-y-2">Destinatário<Input type="email" autoComplete="email" required maxLength={254} value={recipient} onChange={event => setRecipientOverride(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <label className="block space-y-2">Assunto<Input required maxLength={200} value={subject} onChange={event => setSubject(event.target.value)} /></label>

    export function ColorChoice({ label, options = [], value, onChange, catalog, palette }: { label: string; palette?: CatalogPalette; options?: string[]; value: string; onChange: (value: string) => void; catalog?: { productId: string; tenantId: string; field: "structureColors" | "upholsteryColors" | "plateHolderColors" | "plateHolderTypes" } }) {
      const id = useId()
      const [refreshed, setRefreshed] = useState<string[] | null>(null)
      const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const choices = refreshed ?? options
      async function refresh() {
        if (!catalog || loading) return
        setLoading(true); setError("")
        try {
          const response = await erpFetch(`/api/erp/products/${catalog.productId}`, { cache: "no-store" })
          const product = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok || product.tenantId !== catalog.tenantId) throw new Error("Não foi possível atualizar as opções deste produto.")
          const colors = product.data[catalog.field] || []
          setRefreshed(colors)
          if (!colors.length) setError("Ainda não há opções cadastradas. Salve o acabamento no produto e atualize novamente.")
        } catch (reason) { setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Falha ao consultar opções.") }
        finally { setLoading(false) }
      }
      if (!choices.length && !value) return null
      return <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-2 text-sm">
        <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
        <select id={id} className="min-h-10 w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3" value={value} required={choices.length > 0} disabled={loading || !choices.length && !value} onChange={event => onChange(event.target.value)}>
          <option value="">{choices.length ? (catalog?.field === "plateHolderTypes" ? "Escolha um tipo" : "Escolha uma cor") : "Sem opções cadastradas"}</option>
          {value && !choices.includes(value) && <option value={value}>{value} · seleção registrada</option>}
          {choices.map(color => <option key={color} value={color}>{color}</option>)}
        </select>
        <CatalogColorPhotos label={label} options={choices} value={value} onChange={onChange} disabled={loading} palette={palette ?? catalogPaletteFor(choices)} />
        {catalog && !choices.length && <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <Link className={linkClass} href={`/cadastros/produtos/${catalog.productId}/editar#product-colors`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label={`Cadastrar opções de ${label} (nova aba)`}>Cadastrar opções</Link>
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={loading} aria-label={`Atualizar opções de ${label}`} onClick={() => void refresh()}>{loading ? "Atualizando…" : "Atualizar opções"}</Button>
        </div>}
        {error && <p role="alert">{error}</p>}
      </div>
    }

              {(search || query.q) && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { setSearch(""); setQuery({ q: "", offset: 0 }) }}>Limpar</Button>}
            </form>
          </div>
          {result.loading ? <p role="status">Carregando pedidos…</p> : result.error ? <div role="alert"><p><RequestError message={result.error} status={result.status} /></p><Button onClick={result.reload}>Tentar novamente</Button></div> : <>
            <p role="status" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{result.value?.total || 0} pedido(s){query.q && " encontrado(s)"}</p>
            {result.value?.data.length ? <div className="workspace-list-scroll" role="region" aria-label="Lista de pedidos" tabIndex={0}>
              <DataTable className="table-fixed text-left text-sm sm:table-auto">
                <caption className="sr-only">Pedidos de venda</caption>
                <thead className="bg-muted/50"><tr><th scope="col" className="hidden p-3 sm:table-cell">Pedido</th><th scope="col" className="w-[60%] p-2 sm:w-auto sm:p-3">Cliente</th><th scope="col" className="hidden p-3 sm:table-cell">Situação</th><th scope="col" className="hidden p-3 lg:table-cell">Vencimento</th><th scope="col" className="w-[40%] p-2 text-right sm:w-auto sm:p-3">Valor</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>{result.value.data.map(order => <tr className="border-t hover:bg-muted/30" key={order.id}>
                  <td className="hidden whitespace-nowrap p-3 sm:table-cell"><Link className={linkClass} href={`/vendas/pedidos/${order.id}`}>{orderNumber(order.number)}</Link></td>
                  <td className="min-w-0 p-2 align-top sm:p-3"><Link className={`${linkClass} line-clamp-2 break-words [overflow-wrap:anywhere] sm:line-clamp-none`} title={order.customerName} href={`/vendas/pedidos/${order.id}`}>{order.customerName}</Link><span className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground sm:block">{order.customerTaxId}</span><div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-x-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground sm:hidden"><Link className="underline underline-offset-2" href={`/vendas/pedidos/${order.id}`}>{orderNumber(order.number)}</Link><span>{labels[order.status] || order.status}</span></div><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:hidden">Vence {order.dueDate ? order.dueDate.split("-").reverse().join("/") : "—"}</p></td>
                  <td className="hidden whitespace-nowrap p-3 sm:table-cell">{labels[order.status] || order.status}</td>
                  <td className="hidden whitespace-nowrap p-3 lg:table-cell">{order.dueDate ? order.dueDate.split("-").reverse().join("/") : "Não informado"}</td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap p-2 text-right align-top tabular-nums sm:p-3">{commercialMoney(order.amount)}</td>
                </tr>)}</tbody>
              </DataTable>
            </div> : <p>{query.q ? "Nenhum pedido encontrado para esta pesquisa." : "Nenhum pedido cadastrado."}</p>}
            <Pagination offset={query.offset} pageSize={25} total={result.value?.total || 0} maxOffset={100000} onOffsetChange={offset => setQuery(value => ({ ...value, offset }))} />
          </>}
        </section>
      </>
    }
    
    function OrderEditor({ id }: { id?: string }) {

"Editar pedido de venda" : "Novo pedido de venda"} description="Selecione o cliente e adicione os produtos do pedido." /><p role="status">Carregando rascunho e permissões…</p></>
      if (access.error || !access.value) return <><PageHeader breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Vendas", href: "/vendas" }, { label: "Pedidos", href: "/vendas/pedidos" }, { label: id ? "Editar" : "Novo" }]} title={id ? "Editar pedido de venda" : "Novo pedido de venda"} description="Selecione o cliente e adicione os produtos do pedido." /><Link className={linkClass} href="/vendas/pedidos">Voltar à lista</Link><section className="form-section space-y-3"><p role="alert"><RequestError message={access.error || "Pedido indisponível"} status={access.status} /></p><Button onClick={access.reload}>Tentar novamente</Button></section></>

"Somente consulta. Solicite permissão para alterar pedidos." : "Este pedido não está em rascunho e não pode ser editado."}</p><Link className={linkClass} href={id ? `/vendas/pedidos/${id}` : "/vendas/pedidos"}>Voltar aos pedidos</Link></section></>
      }
      return <OrderForm key={`${id || "new"}:${access.etag}`} initial={initial} etag={access.etag} tenantId={access.value.tenantId} reload={access.reload} />

          return { id: item.productId, structureColors: value.data.structureColors || [], upholsteryConfigurable: value.data.upholsteryConfigurable, upholsteryColors: value.data.upholsteryColors || [], plateHolderColors: value.data.plateHolderColors || [], plateHolderTypes: value.data.plateHolderTypes || [], hasPhoto: value.data.hasPhoto }
        })).then(products => {
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) setItems(previous => previous.map(item => ({ ...item, ...products.find(product => product.id === item.id) })))
        }).catch(reason => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Falha ao consultar cores") })

      }, [dirty, command.uncertain])
      return <><PageHeader breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Vendas", href: "/vendas" }, { label: "Pedidos", href: "/vendas/pedidos" }, ...(initial ? [{ label: orderNumber(initial.data.number), href: `/vendas/pedidos/${initial.data.id}` }] : []), { label: initial ? "Editar" : "Novo" }]} title={initial ? "Editar pedido" : "Novo pedido"} description="Selecione o cliente, adicione os produtos e informe o vencimento." />
        <section className="form-section min-w-0 space-y-3 sm:space-y-5">

            <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-2 sm:gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2"><Lookup compact endpoint="parties" label="cliente" searchOnly selectedName={customer?.legalName} disabled={frozen} choose={value => { setCustomer(value.id === originalCustomer?.id ? originalCustomer : value); setDirty(true) }} /><Lookup compact endpoint="products" label="produto" searchOnly disabled={frozen || items.length >= 100} choose={value => {

            <form className="space-y-2 sm:space-y-4" onSubmit={async event => {

"PUT" : "POST")

"Preço registrado" : "Preço base consultado"}: {item.basePrice ? commercialMoney(item.basePrice) : "Não informado"}</p><label className="block min-w-0 space-y-2">Quantidade de {item.name}<Input required inputMode="decimal" pattern={decimalPattern(6)} maxLength={19} value={item.quantity} onChange={event => { setItems(previous => previous.map(value => value.id === item.id ? { ...value, quantity: event.target.value } : value)); setDirty(true) }} /></label>

              <Button type="submit" disabled={command.busy || command.stale || !customer || !items.length}>{command.busy ? "Confirmando…" : command.uncertain ? initial ? "Conferir alteração do pedido" : "Conferir criação do pedido" : initial ? "Salvar rascunho" : "Criar rascunho"}</Button>
            </form>
        </section>

    function OrderDetail({ id }: { id: string }) {
      const result = useResource<Detail>(`/api/erp/orders/${id}`)
      const access = useResource<{ tenant: { id: string }; permissions: string[] }>("/api/erp/me")
      const command = useCommand()
      const [notice, setNotice] = useState("")
      const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState("")
      const value = result.value
      async function act(action: string) {
        if (!value || !result.etag) return
        setPendingAction(action); setNotice("")
        const response = await command.send<Detail>(`/api/erp/orders/${id}/${action}`, value.tenantId, {}, result.etag)
        if (response) { setNotice("Operação confirmada no servidor."); result.reload() }
      }
      return <><PageHeader breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Vendas", href: "/vendas" }, { label: "Pedidos", href: "/vendas/pedidos" }, { label: value ? orderNumber(value.data.number) : "Detalhe" }]} title={value ? orderNumber(value.data.number) : "Pedido de venda"} />
        <section className="min-w-0 space-y-4" aria-label="Detalhes do pedido">
          {notice && <p role="status">{notice}</p>}
          {result.loading ? <p role="status">Carregando pedido…</p> : result.error ? <p role="alert"><RequestError message={result.error} status={result.status} /></p> : value && <>
            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-4">
              <div className="min-w-0"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3"><span className="rounded-md bg-muted px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium">{labels[value.data.status]}</span></div><p className="mt-1 break-words">{value.data.customerName}</p></div>
              <dl className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-8 gap-y-2 text-sm"><div><dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Total do pedido</dt><dd className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{commercialMoney(value.data.amount)}</dd></div><div><dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Vencimento</dt><dd className="tabular-nums">{value.data.dueDate.split("-").reverse().join("/")}</dd></div></dl>
            </div>
            {["completed", "cancelled"].includes(value.data.status) && <p className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/35 px-3 py-2 text-sm">Pedido {value.data.status === "completed" ? "concluído" : "cancelado"}: os dados comerciais estão disponíveis para consulta.</p>}
            <div className="space-y-2 print:hidden" role="group" aria-label="Documentos do pedido">
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Documentos</p>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:flex sm:flex-wrap [&>button]:w-full sm:[&>button]:w-auto">
              <Button variant="outline" className="h-9 px-3" onClick={() => window.print()}>Salvar PDF</Button>
              <OrderEmail id={id} number={value.data.number} tenantId={value.tenantId} etag={result.etag} onReload={result.reload} />
              <Link className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", className: "col-span-2 h-9 px-3" })} href={`/vendas/pedidos/${id}/contratos`}>Pedido e contratos</Link>
              </div>
            </div>
            {["confirmed", "completed"].includes(value.data.status) && ["fiscal.nfe.read", "fiscal.nfe.manage", "catalog.parties.read", "catalog.products.read"].every(permission => access.value?.permissions.includes(permission)) && <Link className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", className: "h-9 px-3" })} href={`/fiscal/notas-saida/nova?pedido=${id}`}>Preparar NF-e deste pedido</Link>}
            {!value.canEdit && <p>Somente consulta.</p>}
            {command.error && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={command.error} status={command.status} /></p>}
            {command.stale && <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => { command.reset(); result.reload() }}>Recarregar pedido</Button>}
            {command.uncertain ? <Button disabled={command.busy} onClick={() => act(pendingAction)}>Repetir confirmação do pedido</Button> : value.canEdit && ["draft", "confirmed"].includes(value.data.status) && <div className="space-y-2 border-y py-3 print:hidden"><p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Ações do pedido</p><div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 [&>button:first-child]:basis-full sm:[&>button:first-child]:basis-auto">
              {value.data.status === "draft" && <Button className="h-auto min-h-11 max-w-full whitespace-normal px-3" disabled={command.busy || command.stale || !result.etag} onClick={() => act("confirm")}>Confirmar e reservar estoque</Button>}
              {value.data.status === "confirmed" && <Button className="h-auto max-w-full whitespace-normal" disabled={command.busy || command.stale || !result.etag} onClick={() => { if (window.confirm("Registrar saída de estoque e gerar a conta a receber deste pedido?")) void act("complete") }}>Concluir e gerar conta a receber</Button>}
              {value.data.status === "draft" && !value.pricingOrigin && !command.busy && !command.stale && <Link className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", className: "h-9 flex-1 px-3 sm:flex-none" })} href={`/vendas/pedidos/${id}/editar`}>Editar rascunho</Link>}
              <Button variant="outline" className="h-9 flex-1 px-3 sm:flex-none" disabled={command.busy || command.stale || !result.etag} onClick={() => { if (window.confirm("Cancelar o pedido e liberar sua reserva, se houver?")) void act("cancel") }}>Cancelar pedido</Button>
            </div></div>}
            <OrderDetailCommercial order={value} permissions={access.value?.tenant.id === value.tenantId ? access.value.permissions : []} />
            <div className="divide-y border-y">
              <details className="py-3"><summary className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium">Negociação e condições comerciais</summary><div className="space-y-4 pt-3"><OrderNegotiation id={id} onDecision={result.reload} showDirector={access.value?.tenant.id === value.tenantId && ["sales.approvals.director", "platform.company.manage"].every(permission => access.value?.permissions.includes(permission))} />{value.data.status === "draft" && <OrderSalesRules tenantId={value.tenantId} />}{value.pricingOrigin && <OrderPricing id={id} onSaved={result.reload} showDirector={access.value?.tenant.id === value.tenantId && ["sales.approvals.director", "platform.company.manage"].every(permission => access.value?.permissions.includes(permission))} />}</div></details>
              {access.value?.permissions.includes("finance.commissions.read") && <details className="py-3"><summary className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium">Comissões do pedido</summary><div className="pt-3"><OrderCommissionTerms orderId={id} onSaved={result.reload} /></div></details>}
            </div>
            {value.data.status === "completed" && <Link className={linkClass} href="/financeiro/contas-receber">Consultar contas a receber</Link>}
            {["completed", "cancelled"].includes(value.data.status) && <CommercialReturn kind="sale" id={id} tenantId={value.tenantId} etag={result.etag} reversed={value.data.status === "cancelled"} canManage={value.canEdit && access.value?.tenant.id === value.tenantId && ["inventory.stock.manage", "finance.receivables.manage"].every(permission => access.value!.permissions.includes(permission))} disabled={command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale} onSuccess={() => { setNotice("Cancelamento integral confirmado. Consulte o histórico e acompanhe a situação fiscal da NF-e."); result.reload() }} onReload={result.reload} />}
          </>}
        </section>
      </>
    }

    import io, json, pathlib, re, sys, tarfile, os
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
    
    workspace = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
    dist = workspace / 'apps/web/.next-commercial-release'
    standalone = dist / 'standalone/apps/web'
    original = (standalone / 'server.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    match = re.search(r'^const nextConfig = (.+)$', original, re.M)
    if not match: raise RuntimeError('Standalone config missing')
    config = json.loads(match.group(1))
    def rebase(value):
        if isinstance(value, dict): return {k: rebase(v) for k,v in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, list): return [rebase(v) for v in value]
        if isinstance(value, str):
            normalized = value.replace('\\','/')
            root = workspace.as_posix()
            if normalized.lower().startswith(root.lower()): return '/app' + normalized[len(root):]
        return value
    config = rebase(config)
    config['distDir'] = './.next'
    config['distDirRoot'] = '.next'
    server = original[:match.start(1)] + json.dumps(config,separators=(',',':')) + original[match.end(1):]
    output = workspace / 'artifacts' / ('commercial-web-' + sys.argv[1][:12] + '.tar.gz')
    entries = 0
    with tarfile.open(output,'w:gz',compresslevel=6) as archive:
        def add_bytes(name, data):
            global entries
            item = tarfile.TarInfo(name); item.size=len(data); item.mode=0o644
            archive.addfile(item,io.BytesIO(data)); entries+=1
        add_bytes('apps/web/server.js',server.encode())
        add_bytes('apps/web/package.json',(workspace/'apps/web/package.json').read_bytes())
        def add_tree(source, prefix):
            paths=[]
            for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(source, followlinks=False):
                dirs[:]=[name for name in dirs if name not in {'node_modules','cache','dev','.git'} and not name.startswith('.env')]
                paths.extend(pathlib.Path(directory)/name for name in files if not name.startswith('.env'))
            def read(path):
                if path.is_symlink(): raise RuntimeError('Unexpected bundle symlink')
                raw = path.read_bytes()
                if path.name=='required-server-files.json':
                    manifest=rebase(json.loads(raw)); manifest['config']=config
                    raw=json.dumps(manifest,separators=(',',':')).encode()
                return path,raw
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
                for path, raw in pool.map(read, paths, buffersize=32):
                    add_bytes(prefix+'/'+path.relative_to(source).as_posix(),raw)
        add_tree(standalone/config.get('distDirRoot','.next'),'apps/web/.next') if (standalone/'.next').exists() else add_tree(standalone/'.next-commercial-release','apps/web/.next')
        add_tree(dist/'static','apps/web/.next/static')
        add_tree(workspace/'apps/web/public','apps/web/public')
    print(json.dumps({'archive':str(output),'bytes':output.stat().st_size,'files':entries}))

    title: use client
    description: Learn how to use the use client directive to render a component on the client.
    ---
    
    The `'use client'` directive declares an entry point for the components to be rendered on the **client side** and should be used when creating interactive user interfaces (UI) that require client-side JavaScript capabilities, such as state management, event handling, and access to browser APIs. This is a React feature.
    
    > **Good to know:**
    >
    > You do not need to add the `'use client'` directive to every file that contains Client Components. You only need to add it to the files whose components you want to render directly within Server Components. The `'use client'` directive defines the [server and client boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary), and the components exported from such a file serve as entry points to the client.
    
    ## Usage
    
    To declare an entry point for the Client Components, add the `'use client'` directive **at the top of the file**, before any imports. The directive applies to the entire module and cannot be placed inside a component or function:
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/components/counter.js" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    When using the `'use client'` directive, the props of the Client Components must be [serializable](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client#serializable-types). This means the props need to be in a format that React can serialize when sending data from the server to the client.
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={4} switcher
    'use client'
    
    export default function Counter({
      onClick /* ❌ Function is not serializable */,
    }) {
      return (
        <div>
          <button onClick={onClick}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/components/counter.js" highlight={4} switcher
    'use client'
    
    export default function Counter({
      onClick /* ❌ Function is not serializable */,
    }) {
      return (
        <div>
          <button onClick={onClick}>Increment</button>
        </div>

    name: verification-before-completion
    description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
    ---
    
    # Verification Before Completion
    
    ## Overview
    
    **Core principle:** Evidence before claims, always.
    
    **Violating the letter of this rule is violating the spirit of this rule.**
    
    ## The Iron Law
    
    ```
    NO COMPLETION CLAIMS WITHOUT FRESH VERIFICATION EVIDENCE
    ```
    
    If you haven't run the verification command in this message, you cannot claim it passes.
    
    ## The Gate Function
    
    ```
    BEFORE claiming any status or expressing satisfaction:
    
    1. IDENTIFY: What command proves this claim?
    2. RUN: Execute the FULL command (fresh, complete)
    3. READ: Full output, check exit code, count failures
    4. VERIFY: Does output confirm the claim?
       - If NO: State actual status with evidence
       - If YES: State claim WITH evidence
    5. ONLY THEN: Make the claim
    
    Skip any step = lying, not verifying
    ```
    
    ## Common Failures
    
    | Claim | Requires | Not Sufficient |
    |-------|----------|----------------|
    | Tests pass | Test command output: 0 failures | Previous run, "should pass" |
    | Linter clean | Linter output: 0 errors | Partial check, extrapolation |
    | Build succeeds | Build command: exit 0 | Linter passing, logs look good |
    | Bug fixed | Test original symptom: passes | Code changed, assumed fixed |
    | Regression test works | Red-green cycle verified | Test passes once |
    | Agent completed | VCS diff shows changes | Agent reports "success" |
    | Requirements met | Line-by-line checklist | Tests passing |
    
    ## Red Flags - STOP
    
    - Using "should", "probably", "seems to"
    - Expressing satisfaction before verification ("Great!", "Perfect!", "Done!", etc.)
    - About to commit/push/PR without verification
    - Trusting agent success reports
    - Relying on partial verification
    - Thinking "just this once"
    - Tired and wanting work over
    - **ANY wording implying success without having run verification**
    
    ## Rationalization Prevention
    
    | Excuse | Reality |
    |--------|---------|
    | "Should work now" | RUN the verification |
    | "I'm confident" | Confidence ≠ evidence |
    | "Just this once" | No exceptions |
    | "Linter passed" | Linter ≠ compiler |
    | "Agent said success" | Verify independently |
    | "I'm tired" | Exhaustion ≠ excuse |
    | "Partial check is enough" | Partial proves nothing |
    | "Different words so rule doesn't apply" | Spirit over letter |
    
    ## Key Patterns
    
    **Tests:**
    ```
    ✅ [Run test command] [See: 34/34 pass] "All tests pass"
    ❌ "Should pass now" / "Looks correct"
    ```
    
    **Regression tests (TDD Red-Green):**
    ```
    ✅ Write → Run (pass) → Revert fix → Run (MUST FAIL) → Restore → Run (pass)
    ❌ "I've written a regression test" (without red-green verification)
    ```
    
    **Build:**
    ```
    ✅ [Run build] [See: exit 0] "Build passes"
    ❌ "Linter passed" (linter doesn't check compilation)
    ```
    
    **Requirements:**
    ```
    ✅ Re-read plan → Create checklist → Verify each → Report gaps or completion
    ❌ "Tests pass, phase complete"
    ```
    
    **Agent delegation:**
    ```
    ✅ Agent reports success → Check VCS diff → Verify changes → Report actual state
    ❌ Trust agent report
    ```
    
    ## When To Apply
    
    **ALWAYS before:**
    - ANY variation of success/completion claims
    - ANY expression of satisfaction
    - ANY positive statement about work state
    - Committing, PR creation, task completion
    - Moving to next task
    - Delegating to agents
    
    **Rule applies to:**
    - Exact phrases
    - Paraphrases and synonyms
    - Implications of success
    - ANY communication suggesting completion/correctness

      await context.addCookies([{ name: "erp_session", value: Buffer.concat([iv, cipher.getAuthTag(), encrypted]).toString("base64url"), url: origin, httpOnly: true, sameSite: "Lax" }])
    }

    test("BFF encaminha pesquisa e paginação e rejeita filtros desconhecidos ou duplicados", async ({ context }) => {
      const requests: string[] = []
      const server = createServer((request, response) => {
        requests.push(request.url || "")
        response.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "application/json" })
        response.end(JSON.stringify({ tenantId: tenant, canEdit: false, data: [], total: 0 }))
      })
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => { server.once("error", reject); server.listen(33119, "127.0.0.1", resolve) })
      try {
        const response = await context.request.get("/api/erp/orders?q=Cliente%20%26%20Filhos&offset=25&limit=25")
        expect(response.status()).toBe(200)
        expect(requests).toEqual(["/api/v1/orders?q=Cliente+%26+Filhos&offset=25&limit=25"])
        for (const query of ["q=a&q=b", "unknown=1"]) expect((await context.request.get(`/api/erp/orders?${query}`)).status()).toBe(400)
        expect(requests).toHaveLength(1)
      } finally {
        await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve()))
      }
    })

    "use client"
    
    import { useId, useState } from "react"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { useCommand, useResource } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    
    type Delivery = { id: string; status: "sent" | "failed" | "uncertain"; recipient: string; createdAt: string }
    type EmailStatus = { tenantId: string; recipient: string | null; canSend: boolean; emailReady: boolean; deliveries: Delivery[] }
    type Receipt = { tenantId: string; revision: number; delivery: Delivery }
    const deliveryLabels = { sent: "Aceito pelo servidor de e-mail", failed: "Recusado pelo servidor de e-mail", uncertain: "Confirmação pendente · não reenviar" }
    
    export function ProposalEmail({ id, number, version, tenantId, etag, onReload, disabled = false }: { id: string; number: string; version: number; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void; disabled?: boolean }) {
      const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
      // Only consult delivery configuration/history when the composer is opened.
      return <>
        <Button variant="outline" className="h-9 px-3" disabled={disabled} title={disabled ? "Consulte a versão atual e aguarde operações pendentes para enviar" : undefined} onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Enviar por e-mail</Button>
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
          <DialogContent className="max-h-[90dvh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-xl">
            <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Enviar proposta {number} por e-mail</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>Confira o destinatário e a mensagem antes de enviar o documento da proposta.</DialogDescription></DialogHeader>
            {open && <ProposalEmailComposer id={id} number={number} version={version} tenantId={tenantId} etag={etag} onReload={onReload} />}
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </>
    }
    
    function ProposalEmailComposer({ id, number, version, tenantId, etag, onReload }: { id: string; number: string; version: number; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void }) {
      const messageId = useId()
      const resource = useResource<EmailStatus>(`/api/erp/proposals/${id}/email`)
      const command = useCommand()
      const [recipientOverride, setRecipientOverride] = useState<string | null>(null)
      const [subject, setSubject] = useState(`Proposta ${number} · versão ${version}`)
      const [message, setMessage] = useState(`Olá,\n\nSegue em anexo a proposta ${number} para sua conferência.\n\nFicamos à disposição.`)
      const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState<Delivery | null>(null)
      const value = resource.value?.tenantId === tenantId ? resource.value : null
      const recipient = recipientOverride ?? value?.recipient ?? ""
      const pendingDelivery = receipt?.status === "uncertain" || value?.deliveries.some(delivery => delivery.status === "uncertain")
      const frozen = command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale || !!pendingDelivery || receipt?.status === "sent"
      if (resource.loading && !value) return <p role="status">Consultando envio de e-mail…</p>
      if (resource.error || !value) return <div className="space-y-3"><p role="alert"><RequestError message={resource.error || "Não foi possível consultar o envio desta proposta."} status={resource.status} /></p><Button variant="outline" onClick={resource.reload}>Consultar novamente</Button></div>
      return <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={async event => {
        event.preventDefault()
        if (!command.uncertain && (!value.canSend || !value.emailReady || frozen)) return
        const result = await command.send<Receipt>(`/api/erp/proposals/${id}/email`, tenantId, { recipient, subject, message }, etag)
        if (result?.tenantId === tenantId) { setReceipt(result.delivery); resource.reload(); if (result.delivery.status === "sent") onReload() }
      }}>
        {!value.emailReady && <p role="status" className="rounded-lg border p-3">O envio de e-mail ainda não está configurado no servidor. Nenhuma mensagem será enviada até a configuração estar disponível.</p>}
        {!value.canSend && <p role="status">Envio indisponível: confira sua permissão, a validade e a situação da proposta.</p>}
        <fieldset disabled={frozen || !value.canSend || !value.emailReady} className="space-y-3">
          <label className="block space-y-2">Destinatário<Input type="email" autoComplete="email" required maxLength={254} value={recipient} onChange={event => setRecipientOverride(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <label className="block space-y-2">Assunto<Input required maxLength={200} value={subject} onChange={event => setSubject(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <div className="space-y-2"><label htmlFor={messageId} className="block">Mensagem</label><textarea id={messageId} required maxLength={10000} rows={5} className="w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-background p-3" value={message} onChange={event => setMessage(event.target.value)} /></div>
        </fieldset>
        <p className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3 text-sm">Anexo: documento da proposta em HTML, com cliente, itens, acabamentos e valores registrados. A versão da proposta é capturada pelo servidor no momento do envio.</p>
        {command.error && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={command.error} status={command.status} /></p>}
        {command.stale && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { command.reset(); onReload(); resource.reload() }}>Recarregar proposta</Button>}
        {receipt && <p role="status">{deliveryLabels[receipt.status]} · {receipt.recipient}{receipt.status === "sent" ? ". A entrega na caixa do destinatário depende do provedor." : "."}</p>}
        {pendingDelivery && <p role="status">Há um envio sem confirmação definitiva. Consulte o histórico e confirme com o provedor antes de realizar outro envio.</p>}
        {command.uncertain && <p role="status">Resultado ainda não confirmado. A consulta abaixo repete o mesmo comando, sem criar um novo envio.</p>}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button type="submit" disabled={command.busy || command.stale || (!command.uncertain && (!value.canSend || !value.emailReady || frozen || !etag))}>{command.busy ? "Confirmando envio…" : command.uncertain ? "Consultar resultado do envio" : "Enviar e-mail com anexo"}</Button>
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={command.busy} onClick={resource.reload}>Atualizar histórico</Button>
        </div>
        {!!value.deliveries.length && <details><summary className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium">Histórico de envios</summary><ul className="mt-3 space-y-3 text-sm">{value.deliveries.map(delivery => <li key={delivery.id} className="break-words rounded-lg border p-3">{deliveryLabels[delivery.status]}<br />{delivery.recipient} · {new Date(delivery.createdAt).toLocaleString("pt-BR")}</li>)}</ul></details>}
      </form>
    }

    name: CI
    
    on:
      pull_request:
      workflow_dispatch:
    
    permissions:
      contents: read
    
    concurrency:
      group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    
    env:
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
    
    jobs:
      changes:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 2
        outputs:
          web: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.web }}
          api: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.api }}
          fiscal: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.fiscal }}
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              fetch-depth: 0
          - run: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p 'test_*.py'
          - id: scope
            env:
              BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || format('{0}^', github.sha) }}
            run: python3 -B scripts/ci/pr-gate.py plan
    
      web:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.web == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
            with:
              version: 11.11.0
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
              cache: pnpm
              cache-dependency-path: pnpm-lock.yaml
          - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline
          - run: pnpm --filter web lint
          - run: node --import ./tests/helpers/register-typescript.mjs --test tests/*-model.node.mjs
            working-directory: apps/web
    
      api:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.api == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 20
        services:
          postgres:
            image: postgres:18-alpine
            env:
              POSTGRES_DB: erp_next_test
              POSTGRES_USER: postgres
              POSTGRES_PASSWORD: erp_next_ci_only
            ports:
              - 5432:5432
            options: >-
              --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d erp_next_test"
              --health-interval 2s
              --health-timeout 3s
              --health-retries 20
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:erp_next_ci_only@127.0.0.1:5432/erp_next_test
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.1
            with:
              components: rustfmt
          - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
            with:
              shared-key: pr-api
          - run: cargo fmt --all --check
          - run: cargo test --workspace --locked -- --test-threads=2
    
      fiscal:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.fiscal == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
              cache: npm
              cache-dependency-path: apps/fiscal-engine/package-lock.json
          - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
          - run: npm test
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
          - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
            with:
              version: 0.12.24
          - run: uv sync --frozen --extra dev --python 3.12
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-mcp
          - run: uv run --frozen --extra dev pytest tests/test_fiscal_schema.py tests/test_simplified_danfe.py tests/test_nfe_assinatura.py
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-mcp
    
      gate:
        needs: [changes, web, api, fiscal]
        if: always()
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    ---
    name: requesting-code-review
    description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
    ---
    
    # Requesting Code Review
    
    Dispatch a code reviewer subagent to catch issues before they cascade. The reviewer gets precisely crafted context for evaluation — never your session's history.
    
    **Core principle:** Review early, review often.
    
    ## When to Request Review
    
    **Mandatory:**
    - After each task in subagent-driven development
    - After completing major feature
    - Before merge to main
    
    **Optional but valuable:**
    - When stuck (fresh perspective)
    - Before refactoring (baseline check)
    - After fixing complex bug
    
    ## How to Request
    
    **1. Get git SHAs:**
    ```bash
    BASE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)  # or: git merge-base origin/main HEAD
    HEAD_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
    ```
    
    **2. Dispatch code reviewer subagent:**
    
    Dispatch a `general-purpose` subagent, filling the template at [code-reviewer.md](code-reviewer.md)
    
    **Placeholders:**
    - `{DESCRIPTION}` - Brief summary of what you built
    - `{PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS}` - What it should do
    - `{BASE_SHA}` - Starting commit
    - `{HEAD_SHA}` - Ending commit
    
    **3. Act on feedback:**
    - Fix Critical issues immediately
    - Fix Important issues before proceeding
    - Note Minor issues for later
    - Push back if reviewer is wrong (with reasoning)
    
    ## Example
    
    ```
    [Just completed Task 2: Add verification function]
    
    You: Let me request code review before proceeding.
    
    BASE_SHA=$(git log --oneline | grep "Task 1" | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f1)
    HEAD_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
    
    [Dispatch code reviewer subagent]
      DESCRIPTION: Added verifyIndex() and repairIndex() with 4 issue types
      PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: Task 2 from docs/superpowers/plans/deployment-plan.md
      BASE_SHA: a7981ec
      HEAD_SHA: 3df7661
    
    [Subagent returns]:
      Strengths: Clean architecture, real tests
      Issues:
        Important: Missing progress indicators
        Minor: Magic number (100) for reporting interval
      Assessment: Ready to proceed
    
    You: [Fix progress indicators]
    [Continue to Task 3]
    ```
    
    ## Common Rationalizations
    
    | Excuse | Reality |
    |--------|---------|
    | "I'll just review the diff myself instead of dispatching a reviewer" | You're the coordinator — reviewing the diff inline burns the context window you need to keep driving the work. Dispatch a reviewer subagent: the diff and the evaluation live in its context, and only the findings come back to you. |
    | "The reviewer needs my whole session history to understand the change" | Hand it precisely crafted context, never your session's history. That keeps the reviewer on the work product, not your thought process. |
    
    ## Red Flags
    
    **Never:**
    - Skip review because "it's simple"
    - Ignore Critical issues
    - Proceed with unfixed Important issues
    - Argue with valid technical feedback
    
    **If reviewer wrong:**
    - Push back with technical reasoning
    - Show code/tests that prove it works
    - Request clarification
    
    See template at: [code-reviewer.md](code-reviewer.md)
    # Code Reviewer Prompt Template
    
    Use this template when dispatching a code reviewer subagent.
    
    **Purpose:** Review completed work against requirements and code quality standards before it cascades into more work.
    
    ```
    Subagent (general-purpose):
      description: "Review code changes"
      prompt: |
        You are a Senior Code Reviewer with expertise in software architecture,
        design patterns, and best practices. Your job is to review completed work
        against its plan or requirements and identify issues before they cascade.
    
        ## What Was Implemented
    
        [DESCRIPTION]
    
        ## Requirements / Plan
    
        [PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS]
    
        ## Git Range to Review
    
        **Base:** [BASE_SHA]
        **Head:** [HEAD_SHA]
    
        ```bash
        git diff --stat [BASE_SHA]..[HEAD_SHA]
        git diff [BASE_SHA]..[HEAD_SHA]
        ```
    
        ## The spec is a vision document
    
        The spec says what the software must do. It does not enumerate every
        input, environment, or condition the software will meet. For behavior
        the spec is silent on, judge by what a reasonable person using this
        software would expect: a reasonable person's expectation is a
        requirement, and a spec's silence is not permission. Grade such
        findings by their effect on that person, not by whether the spec
        mentions the trigger.
    
        ## Declined to judge
    
        Before your verdict, list every behavior you considered and set aside
        as outside the plan or spec, one line each, with the reason. The
        executor rules on each line; nothing you set aside is dropped
        silently. An empty list means you set nothing aside.
    
        ## Read-Only Review
    
        Your review is read-only on this checkout. Do not mutate the working tree, the index, HEAD, or branch state in any way. Use tools like `git show`, `git diff`, and `git log` to inspect history. If you need a working copy of a different revision, check it out into a separate temporary directory (e.g. `git worktree add /tmp/review-[SHA] [SHA]`) — never move HEAD on this checkout.
    
        ## You Do Not Dispatch Subagents
    
        Do all of this review yourself. Never spawn a subagent to review part
        of the diff, and never spawn another reviewer for a second opinion.
        This process already provides every review seat the work gets; a
        reviewer you spawn duplicates one of them at full cost, and its
        verdict counts for nothing. If the diff feels too large for one
        pass, review it in passes yourself and say so in your report.
    
        ## What to Check
    
        **Plan alignment:**
        - Does the implementation match the plan / requirements?
        - Are deviations justified improvements, or problematic departures?
        - Is all planned functionality present?
    
        **Code quality:**
        - Clean separation of concerns?
        - Proper error handling?
        - Type safety where applicable?
        - DRY without premature abstraction?
        - Edge cases handled?
    
        **Architecture:**
        - Sound design decisions?
        - Reasonable scalability and performance?
        - Security concerns?
        - Integrates cleanly with surrounding code?
    
        **Testing:**
        - Tests verify real behavior, not mocks?
        - Edge cases covered?
        - Integration tests where they matter?
        - All tests passing?
    
        **Production readiness:**
        - Migration strategy if schema changed?
        - Backward compatibility considered?
        - Documentation complete?
        - No obvious bugs?
    
        ## Calibration
    
        Categorize issues by actual severity. Not everything is Critical.
        Acknowledge what was done well before listing issues — accurate praise
        helps the implementer trust the rest of the feedback.
    
        If you find significant deviations from the plan, flag them specifically
        so the implementer can confirm whether the deviation was intentional.
        If you find issues with the plan itself rather than the implementation,
        say so.
    
        ## Output Format
    
        ### Strengths
        [What's well done? Be specific.]
    
        ### Issues
    
        #### Critical (Must Fix)
        [Bugs, security issues, data loss risks, broken functionality]
    
        #### Important (Should Fix)
        [Architecture problems, missing features, poor error handling, test gaps]
    
        #### Minor (Nice to Have)
        [Code style, optimization opportunities, documentation polish]
    
        For each issue:
        - File:line reference
        - What's wrong
        - Why it matters
        - How to fix (if not obvious)
    
        ### Recommendations
        [Improvements for code quality, architecture, or process]
    
        ### Assessment
    
        **Ready to merge?** [Yes | No | With fixes]
    
        **Reasoning:** [1-2 sentence technical assessment]
    
        ## Critical Rules
    
        **DO:**
        - Categorize by actual severity
        - Be specific (file:line, not vague)
        - Explain WHY each issue matters
        - Acknowledge strengths
        - Give a clear verdict
    
        **DON'T:**
        - Say "looks good" without checking
        - Mark nitpicks as Critical
        - Give feedback on code you didn't actually read
        - Be vague ("improve error handling")
        - Avoid giving a clear verdict
    ```
    
    **Placeholders:**
    - `[DESCRIPTION]` — brief summary of what was built
    - `[PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS]` — what it should do (plan file path, task text, or requirements)
    - `[BASE_SHA]` — starting commit
    - `[HEAD_SHA]` — ending commit
    
    **Reviewer returns:** Strengths, Issues (Critical / Important / Minor), Recommendations, Assessment
    
    ## Example Output
    
    ```
    ### Strengths
    - Clean database schema with proper migrations (db.ts:15-42)
    - Comprehensive test coverage (18 tests, all edge cases)
    - Good error handling with fallbacks (summarizer.ts:85-92)
    
    ### Issues
    
    #### Important
    1. **Missing help text in CLI wrapper**
       - File: index-conversations:1-31
       - Issue: No --help flag, users won't discover --concurrency
       - Fix: Add --help case with usage examples
    
    2. **Date validation missing**
       - File: search.ts:25-27
       - Issue: Invalid dates silently return no results

    function key(value: string) {
      return value.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/[\s-]+/g, "")
    }
    
    export type CatalogPalette = "dhz-hammerforce"
    
    export function catalogPaletteFor(structureColors?: readonly string[] | null): CatalogPalette | undefined {
      const colors = new Set((structureColors ?? []).map(key))
      return colors.has("pianoblack") && colors.has("titaniumgrey") && (colors.has("graphiteblack") || colors.has("mattegraphiteblack")) ? "dhz-hammerforce" : undefined
    }
    
    const hammerForceAliases: Record<string, string> = {
      preto: "Piano Black",
      grafite: "Matte Graphite Black",
      cinza: "Light Grey",
      vermelho: "Performance Red",
      laranja: "Hermès Orange",
      azul: "Ocean Blue",
    }
    
    export function catalogColorPhoto(value: string, palette?: CatalogPalette) {
      // Resolve legacy swing-arm labels only after the same product identifies its palette.
      const aliasKey = key(value)
      const alias = palette === "dhz-hammerforce" && Object.hasOwn(hammerForceAliases, aliasKey) ? hammerForceAliases[aliasKey] : undefined
      const normalized = key(alias ?? value)
      // The supplier's shortened label refers to the same named graphite finish.
      return photos.find(photo => key(photo.name) === normalized || (photo.name === "Matte Graphite Black" && normalized === "graphiteblack"))
    }

    "use client"
    
    import { useId, useState } from "react"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { useCommand, useResource } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    import { orderNumber } from "./order-presentation"
    
    type Delivery = { id: string; status: "sent" | "failed" | "uncertain"; recipient: string; createdAt: string }
    type EmailStatus = { tenantId: string; recipient: string | null; canSend: boolean; emailReady: boolean; deliveries: Delivery[] }
    type Receipt = { tenantId: string; revision: number; delivery: Delivery }
    const deliveryLabels = { sent: "Aceito pelo servidor de e-mail", failed: "Recusado pelo servidor de e-mail", uncertain: "Confirmação pendente · não reenviar" }
    
    export function OrderEmail({ id, number, tenantId, etag, onReload }: { id: string; number: string; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void }) {
      const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
      // Only consult delivery configuration/history when the composer is opened.
      return <>
        <Button variant="outline" className="h-9 px-3" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Enviar por e-mail</Button>
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
          <DialogContent className="max-h-[90dvh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-xl">
            <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Enviar {orderNumber(number)} por e-mail</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>Confira o destinatário e a mensagem antes de enviar o documento do pedido.</DialogDescription></DialogHeader>
            {open && <OrderEmailComposer id={id} number={number} tenantId={tenantId} etag={etag} onReload={onReload} />}
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </>
    }
    
    function OrderEmailComposer({ id, number, tenantId, etag, onReload }: { id: string; number: string; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void }) {
      const messageId = useId()
      const resource = useResource<EmailStatus>(`/api/erp/orders/${id}/email`)
      const command = useCommand()
      const [recipientOverride, setRecipientOverride] = useState<string | null>(null)
      const [subject, setSubject] = useState(`Pedido ${orderNumber(number)}`)
      const [message, setMessage] = useState(`Olá,\n\nSegue em anexo o pedido ${orderNumber(number)} para sua conferência.\n\nFicamos à disposição.`)
      const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState<Delivery | null>(null)
      const value = resource.value?.tenantId === tenantId ? resource.value : null
      const recipient = recipientOverride ?? value?.recipient ?? ""
      const pendingDelivery = receipt?.status === "uncertain" || value?.deliveries.some(delivery => delivery.status === "uncertain")
      const frozen = command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale || !!pendingDelivery || receipt?.status === "sent"
      if (resource.loading && !value) return <p role="status">Consultando envio de e-mail…</p>
      if (resource.error || !value) return <div className="space-y-3"><p role="alert"><RequestError message={resource.error || "Não foi possível consultar o envio deste pedido."} status={resource.status} /></p><Button variant="outline" onClick={resource.reload}>Consultar novamente</Button></div>
      return <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={async event => {
        event.preventDefault()
        if (!command.uncertain && (!value.canSend || !value.emailReady || frozen)) return
        const result = await command.send<Receipt>(`/api/erp/orders/${id}/email`, tenantId, { recipient, subject, message }, etag)
        if (result?.tenantId === tenantId) { setReceipt(result.delivery); resource.reload() }
      }}>
        {!value.emailReady && <p role="status" className="rounded-lg border p-3">O envio de e-mail ainda não está configurado no servidor. Nenhuma mensagem será enviada até a configuração estar disponível.</p>}
        {!value.canSend && <p role="status">Envio indisponível: verifique sua permissão de gestão e se o pedido está cancelado.</p>}
        <fieldset disabled={frozen || !value.canSend || !value.emailReady} className="space-y-3">
          <label className="block space-y-2">Destinatário<Input type="email" autoComplete="email" required maxLength={254} value={recipient} onChange={event => setRecipientOverride(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <label className="block space-y-2">Assunto<Input required maxLength={200} value={subject} onChange={event => setSubject(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <div className="space-y-2"><label htmlFor={messageId} className="block">Mensagem</label><textarea id={messageId} required maxLength={10000} rows={5} className="w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-background p-3" value={message} onChange={event => setMessage(event.target.value)} /></div>
