"Conferir criação com o mesmo comando" : "Criar pedido com estas condições"}</Button>}</details>
        </div>
      </div>
    }
    
    function SelectedProduct({ item, name, sku, tenant, update, remove }: { item: Selected; name: string; sku: string; tenant: string; update: (next: Selected) => void; remove: () => void }) {
      const product = useResource<{ tenantId: string; data: { structureColors?: string[]; upholsteryColors?: string[]; upholsteryConfigurable?: boolean; plateHolderColors?: string[]; plateHolderTypes?: string[] } }>(`/api/erp/products/${item.productId}`)
      const colors = product.value?.tenantId === tenant ? product.value.data : null
      const palette = catalogPaletteFor(colors?.structureColors)
      const selectedFinishes = [item.structureColor, item.upholsteryColor, item.plateHolderType].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")
      return <>
        <tr>
          <th scope="row" className="min-w-0 break-words py-3 pr-2 text-left align-top font-medium"><span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{sku}</span>{name}</th>
          <td className="px-1 py-3 align-top"><Input aria-label={`Quantidade de ${name}`} className="px-2 text-center tabular-nums" inputMode="numeric" value={item.quantity} onChange={e => update({ ...item, quantity: e.target.value })} /></td>
          <td className="py-3 align-top"><Button variant="ghost" size="icon" type="button" aria-label={`Remover equipamento ${name}`} onClick={remove}><X aria-hidden="true" /></Button></td>
        </tr>
        <tr className="border-b last:border-0"><td colSpan={3} className="min-w-0 pb-3">
          {product.error && <p role="alert">{product.error}</p>}
          <details className="group min-w-0">
            <summary className="min-h-10 cursor-pointer rounded-md py-2 text-sm font-medium focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring">Acabamentos<span className="sr-only"> de {name}</span><span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground group-open:hidden">{selectedFinishes || "Escolher cores"}</span></summary>
            <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-4 pt-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <FinishChoice title="Estrutura" label={`Cor da estrutura de ${name}`} options={colors?.structureColors} value={item.structureColor} onChange={value => update({ ...item, structureColor: value })} />
    
              <PlateHolderChoice label={`Tipo de anilheiro de ${name}`} value={item.plateHolderType} onChange={value => update({ ...item, plateHolderType: value })} />
              {colors?.upholsteryConfigurable !== false && <FinishChoice title={palette ? "Braços" : "Estofado"} palette={palette} label={`${palette ? "Cor dos braços" : "Cor do estofado"} de ${name}`} options={colors?.upholsteryColors} value={item.upholsteryColor} onChange={value => update({ ...item, upholsteryColor: value })} />}
            </div>
          </details>
        </td></tr>
      </>
    }
    
    function FinishChoice({ title, ...props }: Parameters<typeof ColorChoice>[0] & { title: string }) {
      return <div className="min-w-0 space-y-2 [&_label]:sr-only"><p className="text-sm font-medium">{title}</p><ColorChoice {...props} /></div>
    }
    "use client"
    
    import { useState } from "react"
    import Link from "next/link"
    import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header"

    import { useResource } from "@/hooks/use-operation"

    export function CommercialTable() {
      const [line, setLine] = useState("imported")

      const items = (table.value?.data?.items || []).filter(item => `${item.name} ${item.sku}`.toLocaleLowerCase("pt-BR").includes(query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("pt-BR")))
      const limit = 14
      return <main className="mx-auto min-w-0 max-w-6xl space-y-5 pb-24 pt-3 sm:px-4 sm:pt-6 [--workspace-control-height:2.25rem]">
        <PageHeader eyebrow="Vendas" title="Tabela de preços" description="Consulte a versão publicada e simule as condições antes de criar o pedido." />
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3"><Link className="text-primary underline" href="/vendas/simulador">Simulador</Link>{table.value?.canManage && <><Link className="inline-flex h-9 items-center rounded-lg bg-primary px-3 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground" href={`/preferencias/tabela-precos?linha=${line}`}>Nova tabela de preços</Link><Link className="text-primary underline" href="/preferencias/comercial">Preços e metas por destino</Link></>}</div>
        <div className="flex gap-2" aria-label="Linha comercial">{[["imported", "Importada"], ["national", "Nacional"]].map(([value, label]) => <Button key={value} variant={line === value ? "default" : "outline"} aria-pressed={line === value} onClick={() => { setLine(value); setOffset(0) }}>{label}</Button>)}</div>
        <label className="grid gap-2">Buscar equipamento por nome ou código<Input type="search" value={query} onChange={e => { setQuery(e.target.value); setOffset(0) }} /></label>
        {table.loading ? <p role="status">Carregando tabela…</p> : table.error ? <div role="alert"><RequestError message={table.error} status={table.status} /><Button variant="outline" onClick={table.reload}>Tentar novamente</Button></div> : !table.value?.data ? <section className="form-section space-y-3"><p>Nenhuma tabela publicada nesta linha.</p>{table.value?.canManage && <Link className="text-primary underline" href={`/preferencias/tabela-precos?linha=${line}`}>Criar tabela de preços</Link>}</section> : <>
          <p>Tabela v{table.value.data.version} · {new Date(table.value.data.publishedAt).toLocaleDateString("pt-BR")} · Preço em destaque com IPI</p>
          <div className="min-w-0 rounded-lg border">
            <DataTable aria-label="Preços publicados" className="table-fixed [&_td]:px-2 [&_th]:px-2 lg:[&_td]:px-4 lg:[&_th]:px-4">
              <thead><tr><th scope="col" className="w-[54%] lg:w-[34%]">Equipamento</th><th scope="col" className="hidden text-right lg:table-cell lg:w-[17%]">Sem IPI</th><th scope="col" className="w-[46%] text-right lg:w-[17%]">Com IPI</th><th scope="col" className="hidden text-right lg:table-cell lg:w-[15%]">Desconto livre</th><th scope="col" className="hidden lg:table-cell lg:w-[17%]"><span className="sr-only">Ações</span></th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{items.slice(offset, offset + limit).map(item => <tr key={item.productId}>
                <th scope="row" className="text-left font-normal align-top [overflow-wrap:anywhere]"><Link className="font-medium text-primary underline underline-offset-4" href={`/cadastros/produtos/${item.productId}`}>{item.name}</Link><div className="mt-1 text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">SKU {item.sku} · {item.unit}</div><Link className="mt-2 inline-flex min-h-9 items-center text-sm font-medium text-primary underline underline-offset-4 lg:hidden" href={`/vendas/simulador?linha=${line}&produto=${item.productId}`}>Simular pedido</Link></th>
                <td className="hidden text-right tabular-nums [overflow-wrap:anywhere] lg:table-cell">{money(item.priceWithoutIpiCents)}</td>
                <td className="text-right align-top tabular-nums [overflow-wrap:anywhere]">
                  <span className="font-semibold">{money(item.priceWithIpiCents)}</span><span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:hidden">Com IPI</span>
                  <dl className="mt-2 space-y-2 text-xs lg:hidden"><div><dt className="text-muted-foreground">Sem IPI</dt><dd>{money(item.priceWithoutIpiCents)}</dd></div><div><dt className="text-muted-foreground">Desconto livre</dt><dd>{percent(table.value!.data!.freeDiscountBps)}</dd></div></dl>
                </td>
                <td className="hidden text-right tabular-nums lg:table-cell">{percent(table.value!.data!.freeDiscountBps)}</td>
                <td className="hidden [overflow-wrap:anywhere] lg:table-cell"><Link className="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center text-primary underline underline-offset-4" href={`/vendas/simulador?linha=${line}&produto=${item.productId}`}>Simular pedido</Link></td>
              </tr>)}</tbody>
            </DataTable>
          </div>
          {!items.length && <p role="status">Nenhum equipamento corresponde à busca.</p>}
          <nav aria-label="Paginação da tabela" className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>{items.length ? `${offset + 1} a ${Math.min(offset + limit, items.length)} de ${items.length}` : "0 equipamentos"}</span><div className="flex gap-2"><Button variant="outline" disabled={offset === 0} onClick={() => setOffset(value => Math.max(0, value - limit))}>Anterior</Button><Button variant="outline" disabled={offset + limit >= items.length} onClick={() => setOffset(value => value + limit)}>Próxima</Button></div></nav>
        </>}
      </main>
    }
    "use client"
    
    import { useState } from "react"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { useResource, useCommand } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { NegotiationResult } from "./negotiation-result"
    import type { Sale, Director, SimulationInput } from "./negotiation-types"
    
    type Snapshot = { tenantId: string; revision: number; data: { sale: Sale; version: number; input?: Pick<SimulationInput, "destinationState" | "taxpayer"> } | null; director: Director | null; approvalStatus: string; canApprove: boolean; decisions: { decision: string; reason: string; createdAt: string; decidedBy: string }[] }
    const statuses: Record<string, string> = { not_required: "Dentro da política", pending: "Aguardando aprovação", approved: "Aprovada", rejected: "Recusada: refaça a negociação" }
    export function OrderNegotiation({ id, onDecision, showDirector = false }: { id: string; onDecision: () => void; showDirector?: boolean }) {
      const resource = useResource<Snapshot>(`/api/erp/commercial/orders/${id}`)
      const command = useCommand()
      const [reason, setReason] = useState("")
      const [pending, setPending] = useState<boolean | null>(null)
      async function decide(approved: boolean) {
        if (!resource.value || !resource.etag || !reason.trim()) return
        setPending(approved)
        const result = await command.send(`/api/erp/commercial/orders/${id}/decision`, resource.value.tenantId, { approved, reason }, resource.etag)
        if (result) { setReason(""); setPending(null); resource.reload(); onDecision() }
      }
      if (resource.loading) return <p role="status">Conferindo condições negociadas…</p>
      if (resource.error) return <p role="alert"><RequestError message={resource.error} status={resource.status} /></p>
      const value = resource.value
      if (!value?.data) return null
      return <section className="min-w-0 space-y-4"><h2 className="font-semibold">Negociação · tabela v{value.data.version}</h2><p role="status">{statuses[value.approvalStatus] || value.approvalStatus}</p>
        {value.data.input && <p className="text-sm">Destino: {value.data.input.destinationState} · {value.data.input.taxpayer ? "Contribuinte de ICMS" : "Não contribuinte de ICMS"}</p>}
        <NegotiationResult sale={value.data.sale} director={showDirector ? value.director : null} />
        {value.approvalStatus === "pending" && value.canApprove && <div className="form-section space-y-3"><label className="grid gap-2">Motivo da decisão<Input disabled={command.busy || command.uncertain} maxLength={1000} value={reason} onChange={e => setReason(e.target.value)} /></label><div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3"><Button disabled={!reason.trim() || command.busy || command.stale || (command.uncertain && pending !== true)} onClick={() => decide(true)}>Aprovar negociação</Button><Button variant="outline" disabled={!reason.trim() || command.busy || command.stale || (command.uncertain && pending !== false)} onClick={() => decide(false)}>Recusar negociação</Button></div></div>}
        {value.decisions.length > 0 && <details><summary>Histórico de decisões</summary><ul className="space-y-3 pt-3">{value.decisions.map((decision, index) => <li key={index} className="rounded-lg border p-3"><p>{decision.decision === "approved" ? "Aprovada" : "Recusada"} · {decision.decidedBy} · {new Date(decision.createdAt).toLocaleString("pt-BR")}</p><p className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">{decision.reason}</p></li>)}</ul></details>}
        {command.error && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={command.error} status={command.status} /></p>}{command.stale && <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => { command.reset(); resource.reload(); onDecision() }}>Conferir revisão atual</Button>}
      </section>
    }
    "use client"
    
    import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
    import { DataTable } from "@/components/workspace/data-table"
    import { ProductThumbnail } from "@/features/catalog/product-thumbnail"
    import { erpFetch } from "@/lib/api/client"
    import type { Schema } from "@/lib/api/types"
    import { commercialMoney, commercialQuantity } from "./order-presentation"
    import { money, percent, approvalLabels, type Sale, type Director, type SimulationInput } from "./negotiation-types"
    import type { Simulation as LegacySimulation } from "@/features/commercial-settings/simulator-model"
    
    type Order = Schema<"OrderSnapshot">
    type Quote = { tenantId: string; data: { sale: Sale; input: SimulationInput; version: number } | null; director?: Director | null; approvalStatus?: string }
    type Pricing = { tenantId: string; data: { snapshot: LegacySimulation; approved: boolean; needsApproval: boolean } | null }
    type Party = Schema<"PartySnapshot">
    const approvals: Record<string, string> = { not_required: "Dentro da política", pending: "Aguardando aprovação", approved: "Aprovada", rejected: "Recusada" }
    
    function Fields({ values }: { values: [string, string | undefined | null][] }) {
      const visible = values.filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== "")
      if (!visible.length) return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Não informado.</p>
      return <dl className="grid min-w-0 gap-x-5 gap-y-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">{visible.map(([label, value]) => <div className={`min-w-0 ${["Razão social", "Endereço cadastral", "E-mail"].includes(label) ? "sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3" : ""}`} key={label}><dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</dt><dd className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm">{value}</dd></div>)}</dl>
    }
    
    export function OrderDetailCommercial({ order, permissions }: { order: Order; permissions: string[] }) {
      const [sources, setSources] = useState<{ key: string; quote?: Quote; pricing?: Pricing; party?: Party; failures: string[] } | null>(null)
      const key = `${order.tenantId}:${order.data.id}:${order.data.revision}`
      const canReadCustomer = permissions.includes("catalog.parties.read")
      const canReadDirector = permissions.includes("sales.approvals.director") && permissions.includes("platform.company.manage")
      useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController()
        const failures: string[] = []
        async function read<T extends { tenantId: string }>(url: string, label: string): Promise<T | undefined> {
          try {
            const response = await erpFetch(url, { cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal })
            if (!response.ok) throw Error(label)
            const value = await response.json() as T
            if (value.tenantId !== order.tenantId) throw Error(label)
            return value
          } catch { if (!controller.signal.aborted) failures.push(label); return undefined }
        }
        Promise.all([
          read<Quote>(`/api/erp/commercial/orders/${order.data.id}`, "Condições comerciais"),
          order.pricingOrigin ? read<Pricing>(`/api/erp/orders/${order.data.id}/pricing`, "Simulação preservada") : Promise.resolve(undefined),
          canReadCustomer ? read<Party>(`/api/erp/parties/${order.data.customerId}`, "Cadastro do cliente") : Promise.resolve(undefined)
        ]).then(([quote, pricing, party]) => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setSources({ key, quote, pricing, party, failures }) })
        return () => controller.abort()
      }, [key, order.tenantId, order.data.id, order.data.customerId, order.pricingOrigin, canReadCustomer])
      const loaded = sources?.key === key ? sources : null
      const quote = loaded?.quote?.data
      const legacySnapshot = loaded?.pricing?.data?.snapshot
      const legacy = legacySnapshot?.tenantId === order.tenantId ? legacySnapshot : undefined
      const sale = quote?.sale
      const customer = loaded?.party?.data
      const address = customer?.addresses?.find(item => item.primary) || customer?.addresses?.[0]
      const contact = customer?.contacts?.find(item => item.primary) || customer?.contacts?.[0]
      const tableTotal = sale?.tableTotalCents ?? legacy?.sale.tableTotalCents
      const discount = sale?.discountCents ?? legacy?.sale.discountCents
      const discountBps = sale?.discountBps ?? legacy?.sale.discountBps
      const total = sale?.totalCents ?? legacy?.sale.invoiceTotalCents
      const entry = sale?.downPaymentCents
      const freight = sale?.freightCents ?? legacy?.sale.freightCents
      const freeDiscount = sale?.freeDiscountBps ?? legacy?.sale.freeDiscountBps
      const director = canReadDirector ? loaded?.quote?.director : null
      const legacyDirector = canReadDirector && legacy?.tenantId === order.tenantId ? legacy.director : undefined
      const amount = (value: number | undefined) => value === undefined ? undefined : money(value)
      const version = quote?.version ?? legacy?.version
      const hasComposition = Boolean(sale || legacy)
      const itemColumns = hasComposition
        ? ["Quantidade", "Tabela sem IPI", "Desconto", "IPI unitário", "Unitário com IPI", "Total"]
        : ["Quantidade", "Unitário", "Total"]
      return <div className="min-w-0 space-y-5 text-sm" aria-label="Condições e composição do pedido">
        {!loaded && <p role="status" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Consultando dados comerciais e cadastro do cliente…</p>}
        {loaded?.failures.length ? <p role="status" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Não foi possível consultar: {loaded.failures.join(", ")}.</p> : null}
        <section className="min-w-0 space-y-2" aria-label="Itens do pedido">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2"><h2 className="font-semibold">Equipamentos <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">({order.items.length})</span></h2>{version !== undefined && <span className="rounded-md border bg-muted/40 px-2 py-1 text-xs">Tabela v{version}</span>}</div>
          <div className="max-w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border" role="region" aria-label="Tabela de itens" tabIndex={0}>
            <DataTable className="w-full table-fixed text-left text-sm sm:table-auto print:table-auto">
              <caption className="sr-only">Itens do pedido</caption>
              <thead className="bg-muted/50"><tr><th scope="col" className="p-3">Produto e acabamento</th>{itemColumns.map(label => <th scope="col" className="hidden p-3 text-right sm:table-cell print:table-cell" key={label}>{label}</th>)}</tr></thead>
              <tbody>{order.items.map(item => {
                const negotiated = sale?.items.find(line => line.productId === item.productId)
                const preserved = legacy && order.items.length === 1 && legacy.input.productId === item.productId ? legacy : undefined
                const tableUnit = negotiated?.tableUnitCents ?? preserved?.sale.tableUnitCents
                const itemDiscount = negotiated ? negotiated.tableUnitCents * negotiated.quantity - negotiated.netCents : preserved?.sale.discountCents
                const ipiUnit = negotiated && negotiated.quantity > 0 ? negotiated.ipiCents / negotiated.quantity : preserved ? preserved.sale.unitWithIpiCents - preserved.sale.unitWithoutIpiCents : undefined
                const withIpi = negotiated && negotiated.quantity > 0 ? negotiated.totalCents / negotiated.quantity : preserved?.sale.unitWithIpiCents
                const prices = hasComposition
                  ? [amount(tableUnit), amount(itemDiscount), amount(ipiUnit), amount(withIpi) ?? `Não informado · Registrado: ${commercialMoney(item.unitPrice)}`]
                  : [commercialMoney(item.unitPrice)]
                const values = [`${commercialQuantity(item.quantity)} ${item.unit}`, ...prices, commercialMoney(item.amount)]
                return <tr className="border-t hover:bg-muted/20" key={item.productId}>
                  <td className="min-w-0 p-2 sm:min-w-40 sm:p-3"><div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3"><ProductThumbnail id={item.productId} name={item.name} tenantId={order.tenantId} decorative /><div className="min-w-0"><strong className="break-words font-medium">{item.name}</strong><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{item.sku}</p><p className="break-words text-xs text-muted-foreground">{[item.structureColor && `Estrutura: ${item.structureColor}`, item.plateHolderType && `Tipo de anilheiro: ${item.plateHolderType}`, item.upholsteryColor && `Estofado: ${item.upholsteryColor}`].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}</p></div></div>
                    <dl className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-xs sm:hidden print:hidden">
                      {itemColumns.map((label, index) => <div className="min-w-0" key={label}><dt className="text-muted-foreground">{label}</dt><dd className="break-words tabular-nums">{values[index] ?? "Não informado"}</dd></div>)}
                    </dl>
                  </td>
                  {itemColumns.map((label, index) => <td className="hidden p-3 text-right tabular-nums sm:table-cell print:table-cell" key={label}>{values[index] ?? "Não informado"}</td>)}
                </tr>
              })}</tbody>
            </DataTable>
          </div>
          {!hasComposition && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">IPI e descontos não informados neste pedido.</p>}
        </section>
        <section className="space-y-3 border-t pt-4" aria-label="Cliente do pedido"><h2 className="font-semibold">Cliente</h2><Fields values={[
          ["Razão social", order.data.customerName], ["CPF / CNPJ", order.data.customerTaxId?.replace(/^(\d{2})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{4})(\d{2})$/, "$1.$2.$3/$4-$5").replace(/^(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{2})$/, "$1.$2.$3-$4")], ["Inscrição estadual", undefined],
          ["Nome fantasia", customer?.tradeName], ["Contato", contact?.name], ["Telefone", contact?.phone || customer?.phone], ["E-mail", contact?.email || customer?.email],
          ["Endereço cadastral", address ? [address.street, address.number, address.complement, address.district, `${address.city}/${address.state}`, address.postalCode].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") : undefined]
        ]} /></section>
        <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-5 lg:grid-cols-2">
          <section className="min-w-0 space-y-3 border-t pt-4" aria-label="Entrega do pedido"><h2 className="font-semibold">Entrega</h2><Fields values={[
            ["UF de destino negociada", quote?.input.destinationState || legacy?.input.destination], ["Contribuinte de ICMS", quote ? (quote.input.taxpayer ? "Sim" : "Não") : legacy ? (legacy.input.taxpayer ? "Sim" : "Não") : undefined],
            ["Prazo de fabricação", undefined], ["Frete pago pela empresa", amount(freight)], ["Observações de entrega", undefined]
          ]} /></section>
          <section className="min-w-0 space-y-3 border-t pt-4" aria-label="Pagamento do pedido"><h2 className="font-semibold">Pagamento</h2><Fields values={[
            ["Entrada negociada", amount(entry)], ["Saldo após entrada negociada", total !== undefined && entry !== undefined ? money(total - entry) : undefined], ["Forma de pagamento", undefined], ["Vencimento", order.data.dueDate?.split("-").reverse().join("/")]
          ]} />{entry !== undefined && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Valores negociados. Consulte os recebimentos no financeiro.</p>}</section>
        </div>
        {hasComposition && <section className="space-y-3 border-t pt-4" aria-label="Desconto e aprovação"><h2 className="font-semibold">Desconto e aprovação</h2><Fields values={[
          ["Desconto aplicado", discountBps === undefined ? undefined : percent(discountBps)], ["Desconto em reais", amount(discount)], ["Limite sem aprovação", freeDiscount === undefined ? undefined : percent(freeDiscount)],
          ["Situação da aprovação", quote ? approvals[loaded?.quote?.approvalStatus || ""] || loaded?.quote?.approvalStatus : legacy ? (loaded?.pricing?.data?.approved ? "Aprovada" : loaded?.pricing?.data?.needsApproval ? "Aguardando aprovação" : "Dentro da política") : undefined]
        ]} />{discountBps !== undefined && freeDiscount !== undefined && <div className="space-y-1"><div role="meter" aria-label="Desconto aplicado em relação ao limite livre" aria-valuenow={discountBps / 100} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuetext={`${percent(discountBps)} aplicado; limite livre ${percent(freeDiscount)}`} className="relative h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted"><span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-primary" style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, discountBps / 100))}%` }} /><span className="absolute inset-y-0 border-l-2 border-foreground" style={{ left: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, freeDiscount / 100))}%` }} /></div><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Desconto {percent(discountBps)} · limite livre {percent(freeDiscount)}</p></div>}
          {sale?.approvalReasons.length ? <ul className="list-inside list-disc text-xs text-muted-foreground">{sale.approvalReasons.map(reason => <li key={reason}>{approvalLabels[reason] || reason}</li>)}</ul> : null}
        </section>}
        <section className="space-y-3 rounded-lg border bg-muted/25 p-4" aria-label="Resumo financeiro do pedido"><h2 className="font-semibold">Resumo do pedido</h2><Fields values={[

    export type Sale = { calculatorVersion: string; items: { productId: string; name: string; sku: string; quantity: number; tableUnitCents: number; netCents: number; ipiCents: number; totalCents: number }[]; tableTotalCents: number; discountCents: number; discountBps: number; netSaleCents: number; ipiBps: number; ipiCents: number; totalCents: number; maximumAtTargetDiscountBps?: number; requiredDownPaymentCents?: number; freeDiscountBps: number; minimumDownPaymentBps: number; minimumDownPaymentCents: number; downPaymentCents: number; freightCents: number; approvalReasons: string[] }
    export type Director = { band: string; targetBps: number; taxBps: number; taxesCents: number; difalBps: number; difalCents: number; equipmentCostCents: number; fixedFeeCents: number; profitBeforeIncomeTaxCents: number; incomeTaxCents: number; netProfitCents: number; netProfitBps: number; supplierPaymentCents: number; targetProfitCents: number; downPaymentCommissionCents: number; requiredDownPaymentCents: number; requiredDownPaymentBps: number; minimumAtTargetCents: number; maximumAtTargetDiscountBps: number; maximumNoLossDiscountBps: number }
    export type Simulation = { tenantId: string; version: number; digest: string; sale: Sale; director: Director | null }
    export const money = (cents: number) => (cents / 100).toLocaleString("pt-BR", { style: "currency", currency: "BRL" })
    export const percent = (bps: number) => `${(bps / 100).toLocaleString("pt-BR", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}%`
    export const inputAmount = (cents: number) => (cents / 100).toFixed(2).replace(".", ",")
    export function parseAmount(raw: string): number | null {
      const normalized = raw.trim().replace(",", ".")
      if (!/^\d{1,12}(?:\.\d{0,2})?$/.test(normalized)) return null
      const [whole, fraction = ""] = normalized.split(".")
      const value = Number(BigInt(whole) * BigInt(100) + BigInt(fraction.padEnd(2, "0")))
      return Number.isSafeInteger(value) ? value : null
    }

    "use client"
    
    import { useState } from "react"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { useResource, useCommand } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { NegotiationResult } from "./negotiation-result"
    import type { Sale, Director, SimulationInput } from "./negotiation-types"
    
    type Snapshot = { tenantId: string; revision: number; data: { sale: Sale; version: number; input?: Pick<SimulationInput, "destinationState" | "taxpayer"> } | null; director: Director | null; approvalStatus: string; canApprove: boolean; decisions: { decision: string; reason: string; createdAt: string; decidedBy: string }[] }
    const statuses: Record<string, string> = { not_required: "Dentro da política", pending: "Aguardando aprovação", approved: "Aprovada", rejected: "Recusada: refaça a negociação" }
    export function OrderNegotiation({ id, onDecision, showDirector = false }: { id: string; onDecision: () => void; showDirector?: boolean }) {
      const resource = useResource<Snapshot>(`/api/erp/commercial/orders/${id}`)
      const command = useCommand()
      const [reason, setReason] = useState("")
      const [pending, setPending] = useState<boolean | null>(null)
      async function decide(approved: boolean) {
        if (!resource.value || !resource.etag || !reason.trim()) return
        setPending(approved)
        const result = await command.send(`/api/erp/commercial/orders/${id}/decision`, resource.value.tenantId, { approved, reason }, resource.etag)
        if (result) { setReason(""); setPending(null); resource.reload(); onDecision() }
      }
      if (resource.loading) return <p role="status">Conferindo condições negociadas…</p>
      if (resource.error) return <p role="alert"><RequestError message={resource.error} status={resource.status} /></p>
      const value = resource.value
      if (!value?.data) return null

    type Guard = () => string | null
    type NavigationGuard = { register: (guard: Guard) => () => void; confirmNavigation: () => boolean; allowNextUnload: () => () => void }
    const NavigationGuardContext = createContext<NavigationGuard>({ register: () => () => {}, confirmNavigation: () => true, allowNextUnload: () => () => {} })
    
    export function NavigationGuardProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
      const activeGuard = useRef<Guard | null>(null)
      const approvedUnload = useRef(false)
      const allowNextUnload = useCallback(() => {
        approvedUnload.current = true
        return () => { approvedUnload.current = false }
      }, [])
      const register = useCallback((guard: Guard) => {
        activeGuard.current = guard
        return () => { if (activeGuard.current === guard) activeGuard.current = null }
      }, [])
      const confirmNavigation = useCallback(() => {
        const message = activeGuard.current?.()
        return !message || window.confirm(message)
      }, [])
      useEffect(() => {
        const beforeUnload = (event: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
          if (approvedUnload.current) { approvedUnload.current = false; return }
          if (activeGuard.current?.()) { event.preventDefault(); event.returnValue = "" }
        }
        window.addEventListener("beforeunload", beforeUnload)
        return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", beforeUnload)
      }, [])
      const value = useMemo(() => ({ register, confirmNavigation, allowNextUnload }), [register, confirmNavigation, allowNextUnload])
      return <NavigationGuardContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</NavigationGuardContext.Provider>
    }
    
    export function useNavigationGuard(message: string | null) {
      const { register } = useContext(NavigationGuardContext)
      useEffect(() => register(() => message), [message, register])
    }
    
    export function useConfirmNavigation() {
      return useContext(NavigationGuardContext).confirmNavigation
    }
    
    export function useAllowNextUnload() {
      return useContext(NavigationGuardContext).allowNextUnload
    }

      const confirmNavigation = useConfirmNavigation()
      const pathname = usePathname()
      const search = useSearchParams()
      const href = typeof props.href === "string" ? listNavigationHref(props.href, pathname, search.toString()) : props.href
      return <NextLink {...props} href={href} onNavigate={event => {
        if (!confirmNavigation()) { event.preventDefault(); return }
        onNavigate?.(event)
      }} />
    }

    const listRoute = /^\/(?:cadastros\/[^/]+|vendas\/(?:pedidos|propostas)|compras\/pedidos|financeiro\/(?:contas-pagar|contas-receber)|servicos\/ordens)(?=\/|$)/
    
    /** Carry a list's URL through its records without changing unrelated navigation. */
    export function listNavigationHref(href: string, pathname: string, search: string) {
      const list = pathname.match(listRoute)?.[0]
      if (!list || !href.startsWith("/") || href.startsWith("//")) return href
      try {
        const target = new URL(href, "https://erp.local")
        const params = new URLSearchParams(search)
        const previous = params.get("returnTo")
        const source = pathname === list && search ? list + "?" + search : previous
        if (!source || !source.startsWith(list + "?")) return href
        const origin = new URL(source, "https://erp.local")
        if (origin.origin !== target.origin || origin.pathname !== list) return href
        if (target.pathname === list && !target.search) return list + origin.search + target.hash
        if (target.pathname.startsWith(list + "/") && !target.searchParams.has("returnTo")) {
          target.searchParams.set("returnTo", list + origin.search)
          return target.pathname + target.search + target.hash
        }
      } catch { return href }
      return href
    }

    ---
    name: executing-plans
    description: Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available
    ---
    
    # Executing Plans
    
    Execute the plan yourself, task by task, in this session: no implementer
    subagent per task, no reviewer per task. One fresh-context review of the
    whole branch at the end.
    
    **Why inline:** Subagent-driven development pays for a fresh implementer
    and a fresh reviewer on every task, each re-reading the codebase from zero.
    Inline execution pays for one context (yours) plus one reviewer at the end.
    What it gives up is a fresh context per task and a second pair of eyes per
    task. This skill keeps what those two things bought, by other means: the
    brief is the spec, the ledger is your memory, TDD is the per-task gate, and
    the final reviewer is the second pair of eyes.
    
    **Core principle:** The plan already did the thinking. Execute it exactly,
    prove each step with a test you watched fail and then pass, and leave a
    record that survives your own forgetting.
    
    **Narration:** between tool calls, narrate at most one short line — the
    ledger and the tool results carry the record.
    
    **Continuous execution:** Do not pause to check in with your human partner
    between tasks. They chose inline execution to spend less, not to answer
    "should I continue?" after every task. Execute all tasks from the plan
    without stopping.
    
    **Rulings, not stalls.** Conflicts, ambiguities, plan defects — decide them.
    The spec is the binding authority, the plan is its argument, and your
    judgment settles what neither answers. Record every decision in the ledger
    as `Ruling: <what you decided> — <why> — <what it costs if wrong>`, and keep
    going. Deviating from the plan without a ledgered ruling is a decision made
    in secret.
    
    Four things stop you, and only these: an irreversible or destructive
    operation; a security-sensitive action; a side effect outside this worktree
    that norms say you ask about first (a merge, a push to a shared branch, a
    publish); and a plan so broken that every path forward is a guess. For
    those, stop and ask.
    
    ## When to Use
    
    - You have a plan from superpowers:writing-plans and your human partner
      chose inline execution at the handoff.
    - Your harness has no subagent tool (see the per-platform references in
      `../using-superpowers/references/`). Never fabricate a dispatch; run
      the plan here.
    - Tasks are mostly independent — the same precondition as
      superpowers:subagent-driven-development.
    
    A fully specified plan makes inline execution transcription plus testing:
    it runs well on a mid-tier session model, and the one place the most
    capable model earns its cost is the final review, which this skill
    dispatches separately. Tell your human partner so when they choose inline.
    
    Prefer superpowers:subagent-driven-development when your human partner
    wants a review gate on every task, or when the plan is long enough that
    its later tasks would run on a compacted context. Inline execution over a
    long plan still works — the ledger is what makes it recoverable — but the
    last tasks get the least of you.
    
    ## The Process
    
    ```dot
    digraph process {
        rankdir=TB;
    
        subgraph cluster_per_task {
            label="Per Task";
            "task-start: brief + BASE; read the brief" [shape=box];
            "Work the steps in order: TDD, run every verification, read every output" [shape=box];
            "Step output matches plan's Expected?" [shape=diamond];
            "Plan wrong? Rule and ledger. Code wrong? systematic-debugging" [shape=box];
            "Commit as the plan's commit steps say" [shape=box];
            "Completion contract met?" [shape=diamond];
            "task-done: run tests, ledger the result; mark todo complete" [shape=box];
        }
    
        "Setup: worktree, workspace + ledger, read plan + spec, pre-flight scan" [shape=box];

        "Final whole-branch review (fresh reviewer if you have one)" [shape=box];
        "Re-grade, then: Critical/Important → ONE fix pass, each fix RED→GREEN + green suite; Minor → ledger" [shape=box];
        "Final review clean: delete this plan's workspace" [shape=box];
        "Use superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch" [shape=box style=filled fillcolor=lightgreen];
    ```

    ## Setup
    
    Ensure the work happens in an isolated workspace: use
    superpowers:using-git-worktrees to create one or verify the existing one.
    Never start implementation on a main/master branch without your human
    partner's explicit consent.
    
    Conversation memory does not survive compaction. An inline executor that
    loses its place re-implements tasks whose commits already exist — the same
    failure as a controller re-dispatching them, paid for in your own context.
    Track progress in a ledger file, not only in todos. Harness todos are a
    live view; the ledger is the record.
    
    The workspace and ledger are shared with superpowers:subagent-driven-development
    — same directory, same format — so a plan can change executors mid-flight
    and the new one resumes from the same ledger.
    
    - Each plan owns a workspace: at skill start, run
      `../subagent-driven-development/scripts/sdd-workspace PLAN_FILE` — it
      prints the plan's git-ignored directory
      (`<repo-root>/.superpowers/sdd/<plan-basename>/`), home to every
      artifact for THIS plan: ledger, briefs, review packages. Another plan's
      directory is never yours to read or write.
    - Check for this plan's ledger at `<workspace>/progress.md`. If its first
      line names your plan file, tasks with a `Task <N>: complete` line are
      DONE — do not redo them; resume at the first task without one. Their
      commits exist in git even when your context no longer remembers making
      them: after compaction, trust the ledger and `git log` over your own
      recollection. A ledger whose first line names a different plan file is
      another plan's progress: leave it and start your own, fresh.
    - Create the ledger with its identity as the first line:
      `# SDD ledger — plan: <plan file path>`.
    - `git clean -fdx` will destroy the workspace (it's git-ignored scratch);
    ✓ • 310ms

    # Comercial e navegação — Implementation Plan
    
    > **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
    
    **Goal:** Concluir e verificar tabela publicada → simulação → pedido, com navegação compacta, valores consistentes e preservação do acordo comercial.
    
    **Architecture:** Reutilizar o domínio comercial e os snapshots existentes. Corrigir cálculos e a origem fiscal no servidor; manter o navegador responsável por preenchimento, navegação e apresentação. Os testes usam dados sintéticos ou PostgreSQL isolado, sem vendas, e-mails ou transmissão fiscal reais.
    
    **Tech Stack:** Rust/Axum/SQLx/PostgreSQL; Next.js/React/TypeScript; Playwright e testes de domínio/HTTP existentes.
    
    **Spec:** Critérios comerciais e de navegação de AVL-432 e AVL-17, com as correções explícitas do usuário: sem cor de anilheiro; tipo Standard, Olímpico ou não se aplica na negociação; cores fotográficas do catálogo; interface compacta e responsiva.
    
    ## Global Constraints
    
    - Preservar preços, parâmetros, documentos e dados reais existentes.
    - Cálculos monetários em centavos; percentuais em pontos-base; servidor decide preços, aprovação e permissões.
    - Preservar tenant, revisão, digest, idempotência, auditoria e histórico imutável.
    - Não executar operações comerciais, financeiras, e-mails ou emissões fiscais reais como teste.
    - Compilação local ou em CI; nenhuma compilação no servidor de produção.
    - Interface legível em 320, 390, 430, 1366 e 1440 pixels, com teclado e indicação dos requisitos antes de criar o pedido.
    
    ## Review Focus
    
    - Arredondamento no limite livre não deve criar uma exceção inexistente.
    - Um total desejado não deve ser ultrapassado por um centavo.
    - Sem desconto, a simulação deve conservar o preço publicado com IPI.
    - Custos e margens exigem as mesmas permissões na simulação e no pedido preservado.
    - Reabrir ou atualizar uma negociação não pode perder cliente/acabamentos nem repetir um comando incerto.
    
    ## Baseline
    
    - Base: d64acfea4b12be1a318d094d9d1e9c2a162ff09f.
    - 26 testes existentes de simulador, navegação e pedidos aprovados com a build de produção local.
    - Lacunas identificadas: cálculo comercial novo diverge do arredondamento já protegido no motor anterior; preparação fiscal considera somente o snapshot antigo; ausência de teste de conversão bem-sucedida da tabela ao detalhe.

    - [ ] Adicionar regressão para desconto de exatamente 2000 pontos-base não exceder o limite livre de 2000 por arredondamento subcentavo.
    - [ ] Reutilizar as regras inteiras verificadas do motor anterior e preservar alçadas de lucro/frete/entrada.

    export type CatalogQuery = { q: string; status: string; offset: number; categoryId?: string }
    export const catalogMaxOffset = 100_000
    
    export function catalogReturnHref(value: string | null) {
      if (!value?.startsWith("/cadastros/produtos?")) return "/cadastros/produtos"
      try {
        const url = new URL(value, "https://erp.local")
        return url.origin === "https://erp.local" && url.pathname === "/cadastros/produtos" ? url.pathname + url.search : "/cadastros/produtos"
      } catch { return "/cadastros/produtos" }
    }
    
    export function parseCatalogQuery(params: Pick<URLSearchParams, "get">, pageSize = 25): CatalogQuery {
      const q = (params.get("q") || "").trim().slice(0, 160)
      const rawStatus = params.get("status")
      const status = rawStatus === "active" || rawStatus === "archived" ? rawStatus : ""
      const rawOffset = params.get("offset") || "0"
      const number = /^\d{1,7}$/.test(rawOffset) ? Number(rawOffset) : 0
      const size = [10, 25, 50, 100].includes(pageSize) ? pageSize : 25
      const offset = number <= catalogMaxOffset ? Math.floor(number / size) * size : 0
      const categoryId = params.get("category_id") || ""
      return { q, status, offset, ...(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(categoryId) ? { categoryId } : {}) }
    }
    
    export function catalogQueryString(query: CatalogQuery) {
      const params = new URLSearchParams()
      if (query.q) params.set("q", query.q)
      if (query.status) params.set("status", query.status)
      if (query.categoryId) params.set("category_id", query.categoryId)
      if (query.offset) params.set("offset", String(query.offset))
      return params.toString()
    }

    export async function installFrontendFixture(context: BrowserContext, fixtureOrigin = origin, fixtureTenant = tenant, fixtureAccessToken = "frontend-integration-fixture") {
      const iv = randomBytes(12)
      const cipher = createCipheriv("aes-256-gcm", createHash("sha256").update(secret).digest(), iv)
      cipher.setAAD(Buffer.from("erp-session"))
      const data = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(JSON.stringify({ accessToken: fixtureAccessToken, tenantId: fixtureTenant, expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600_000 })), cipher.final()])
      await context.addCookies([{ name: "erp_session", value: Buffer.concat([iv, cipher.getAuthTag(), data]).toString("base64url"), url: fixtureOrigin, httpOnly: true, sameSite: "Lax" }])
      await context.route("**/api/erp/**", route => route.fulfill({ status: route.request().method() === "GET" ? 503 : 405, json: { title: "Operação indisponível na fixture de leitura" } }))
    }

    use super::company_tests::{cleanup, setup};
    use axum::{
        Router,
        body::{Body, to_bytes},
        http::{Request, StatusCode},
    };
    use serde_json::{Value, json};
    use sqlx::PgPool;
    use tower::ServiceExt;
    use uuid::Uuid;
    
    const TENANT: &str = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
    
    async fn call(
        router: &Router,
        method: &str,
        path: &str,
        who: &str,
        etag: Option<&str>,
        key: Option<Uuid>,
        body: Value,
    ) -> (StatusCode, Value) {
        let mut request = Request::builder()
            .method(method)
            .uri(path)
            .header("x-tenant-id", TENANT)
            .header("authorization", format!("Bearer {who}"))
            .header("content-type", "application/json");
        if let Some(etag) = etag {
            request = request.header("if-match", etag);
        }
        if let Some(key) = key {
            request = request.header("idempotency-key", key.to_string());
        }
        let reply = router
            .clone()
            .oneshot(request.body(Body::from(body.to_string())).unwrap())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let status = reply.status();
        let raw = to_bytes(reply.into_body(), 1_000_000).await.unwrap();
        (status, serde_json::from_slice(&raw).unwrap())
    }

    "use client"
    
    import { useEffect, useRef, type ComponentProps } from "react"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    
    type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<"input">, "ref"> & {
      onSearch: (value: string, form: HTMLFormElement | null) => void
    }
    
    /** Only invokes a read callback; never submits an enclosing business form. */
    export function SearchInput({ onSearch, onChange, onCompositionStart, onCompositionEnd, onKeyDown, defaultValue, ...props }: Props) {
      const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
      const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)
      const composing = useRef(false)
      const callback = useRef(onSearch)
      const submitted = useRef(String(defaultValue ?? ""))
      useEffect(() => { callback.current = onSearch }, [onSearch])
      useEffect(() => {
        if (defaultValue !== undefined && String(defaultValue) !== submitted.current && input.current) {
          input.current.value = String(defaultValue)
          submitted.current = String(defaultValue)
        }
      }, [defaultValue])
      function cancel() { if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current); timer.current = null }
      useEffect(() => {
        const form = input.current?.form
        form?.addEventListener("submit", cancel, true)
        return () => { cancel(); form?.removeEventListener("submit", cancel, true) }
      }, [])
      function schedule(element: HTMLInputElement) {
        cancel()
        if (composing.current) return
        const value = element.value
        timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
          timer.current = null
          if (!element.isConnected || element.disabled || element.closest("fieldset[disabled]") || element.value !== value) return
          submitted.current = value
          callback.current(value, element.form)
        }, 300)
      }
      return <Input {...props} ref={input} defaultValue={defaultValue} autoComplete="off"
        onChange={event => { onChange?.(event); schedule(event.currentTarget) }}
        onCompositionStart={event => { composing.current = true; cancel(); onCompositionStart?.(event) }}
        onCompositionEnd={event => { composing.current = false; onCompositionEnd?.(event); schedule(event.currentTarget) }}
        onKeyDown={event => { if (event.key === "Escape" || event.key === "Enter") cancel(); onKeyDown?.(event) }} />
    }

    title: useSearchParams
    description: API Reference for the useSearchParams hook.
    ---
    
    `useSearchParams` is a **Client Component** hook that lets you read the current URL's **query string**.
    
    `useSearchParams` returns a **read-only** version of the [`URLSearchParams`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams) interface.
    
    ```tsx filename="app/dashboard/search-bar.tsx" switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
    
    export default function SearchBar() {
      const searchParams = useSearchParams()
    
      const search = searchParams.get('search')
    
      // URL -> `/dashboard?search=my-project`
      // `search` -> 'my-project'
      return <>Search: {search}</>
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/dashboard/search-bar.js" switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
    
    export default function SearchBar() {
      const searchParams = useSearchParams()
    
      const search = searchParams.get('search')
    
      // URL -> `/dashboard?search=my-project`
      // `search` -> 'my-project'
      return <>Search: {search}</>
    }
    ```
    
    ## Parameters
    
    ```tsx
    const searchParams = useSearchParams()
    ```
    
    `useSearchParams` does not take any parameters.
    
    ## Returns
    
    `useSearchParams` returns a **read-only** version of the [`URLSearchParams`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams) interface, which includes utility methods for reading the URL's query string:
    
    - [`URLSearchParams.get()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/get): Returns the first value associated with the search parameter. For example:
    
      | URL                  | `searchParams.get("a")`                                                                                         |
      | -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
      | `/dashboard?a=1`     | `'1'`                                                                                                           |
      | `/dashboard?a=`      | `''`                                                                                                            |
      | `/dashboard?b=3`     | `null`                                                                                                          |
      | `/dashboard?a=1&a=2` | `'1'` _- use [`getAll()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/getAll) to get all values_ |
    
    - [`URLSearchParams.has()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/has): Returns a boolean value indicating if the given parameter exists. For example:
    
      | URL              | `searchParams.has("a")` |
      | ---------------- | ----------------------- |
      | `/dashboard?a=1` | `true`                  |
      | `/dashboard?b=3` | `false`                 |
    
    - Learn more about other **read-only** methods of [`URLSearchParams`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams), including the [`getAll()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/getAll), [`keys()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/keys), [`values()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/values), [`entries()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/entries), [`forEach()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/forEach), and [`toString()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/toString).
    
    > **Good to know**:
    >
    > - `useSearchParams` is a [Client Component](/docs/app/getting-started/server-and-client-components) hook and is **not supported** in [Server Components](/docs/app/getting-started/server-and-client-components) to prevent stale values during [partial rendering](/docs/app/getting-started/linking-and-navigating#client-side-transitions).
    > - If you want to fetch data in a Server Component based on search params, it's often a better option to read the [`searchParams` prop](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/page#searchparams-optional) of the corresponding Page. You can then pass it down by props to any component (Server or Client) within that Page.
    > - If an application includes the `/pages` directory, `useSearchParams` will return `ReadonlyURLSearchParams | null`. The `null` value is for compatibility during migration since search params cannot be known during prerendering of a page that doesn't use `getServerSideProps`
    
    ## Behavior
    
    ### Prerendering
    
    If a route is [prerendered](/docs/app/glossary#prerendering), calling `useSearchParams` will cause the Client Component tree up to the closest [`Suspense` boundary](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/loading#examples) to be client-side rendered.
    
    This allows a part of the route to be prerendered while the dynamic part that uses `useSearchParams` is client-side rendered.
    
    We recommend wrapping the Client Component that uses `useSearchParams` in a `<Suspense/>` boundary. This will allow any Client Components above it to be prerendered and sent as part of initial HTML.
    
    See [Next.js encountered URL data in a Client Component outside of Suspense](/docs/messages/blocking-prerender-client-hook) for full fix options and trade-offs.
    
    For example:
    
    ```tsx filename="app/dashboard/search-bar.tsx" switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
    
    export default function SearchBar() {
      const searchParams = useSearchParams()
    
      const search = searchParams.get('search')
    
      // This will not be logged on the server during prerendering
      console.log(search)
    
      return <>Search: {search}</>
    }
    ```

    export type CommercialTableQuery = { line: "imported" | "national"; q: string; offset: number }
    export const commercialTablePageSize = 14
    
    export function readCommercialTableQuery(params: Pick<URLSearchParams, "get">): CommercialTableQuery {
      const raw = params.get("offset") || "0"
      const offset = /^\d{1,6}$/.test(raw) ? Number(raw) : 0
      return { line: params.get("linha") === "national" ? "national" : "imported", q: (params.get("q") || "").trim().slice(0, 160), offset: Math.floor(offset / commercialTablePageSize) * commercialTablePageSize }
    }
    
    export function commercialTableHref(query: CommercialTableQuery) {
      const params = new URLSearchParams()
      if (query.line === "national") params.set("linha", query.line)
      if (query.q) params.set("q", query.q)
      if (query.offset) params.set("offset", String(query.offset))
      return `/vendas/tabela-precos${params.size ? `?${params}` : ""}`
    }
    
    export function commercialTableReturn(value: string | undefined, line: string) {
      const fallback = commercialTableHref({ line: line === "national" ? "national" : "imported", q: "", offset: 0 })
      if (!value?.startsWith("/vendas/tabela-precos")) return fallback
      try {
        const url = new URL(value, "https://erp.local")
        if (url.origin !== "https://erp.local" || url.pathname !== "/vendas/tabela-precos") return fallback
        return commercialTableHref(readCommercialTableQuery(url.searchParams))
      } catch { return fallback }
    }

    async fn commercial_quote(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        id: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<Option<SaleQuote>, DomainError> {
        let sale: Option<serde_json::Value> = sqlx::query_scalar(
            "SELECT public_snapshot->'sale' FROM commercial_order_quotes WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2",
        )
        .bind(tenant)
        .bind(id)
        .fetch_optional(&mut **tx)
        .await
        .map_err(db)?;
        sale.map(|sale| {
            serde_json::from_value(sale)
                .map_err(|_| DomainError::Conflict("A composição da negociação preservada é inválida"))
        })
        .transpose()
    }
    
    async fn order(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        id: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<Order, DomainError> {
        let mut order = sqlx::query_as::<_, Order>("SELECT id,revision,customer_id,customer_name,customer_tax_id,status,amount_cents FROM sales_orders WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2")
            .bind(tenant).bind(id).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?.ok_or(DomainError::NotFound)?;
        if !["confirmed", "completed"].contains(&order.status.as_str()) {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "A preparação fiscal exige um pedido confirmado ou concluído desta empresa",
            ));
        }
        // A simulated commercial total already includes IPI. Fiscal preparation
        // starts from the preserved net sale and still requires explicit tax declarations.
        if let Some(sale) = commercial_quote(tx, tenant, id).await? {
            let net = sale
                .items
                .iter()
                .try_fold(0_i64, |total, item| total.checked_add(item.net_cents));
            if order.amount_cents != sale.total_cents
                || sale.net_sale_cents <= 0
                || net != Some(sale.net_sale_cents)
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                    "A composição do pedido diverge da negociação preservada",
                ));
            }
            order.amount_cents = sale.net_sale_cents;
        } else {
            let net: Option<i64> = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT (snapshot#>>'{sale,netSaleCents}')::bigint FROM order_pricing_snapshots WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2")
                .bind(tenant).bind(id).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
            if let Some(net) = net {
                order.amount_cents = net;
            }
        }
        Ok(order)
    }

    import assert from "node:assert/strict";
    import { test } from "node:test";
    import { installmentPlan, entryFromPercent, entryPercent, addPaymentDays } from "../src/features/sales/commercial-payment-model.ts";
    
    test("parcelas distribuem centavos sem alterar o saldo e atravessam meses pelo calendário", () => {
      const rows = installmentPlan(10000, 3, "2026-12-30", 30, "method");
      assert.deepEqual(rows.map(row => row.amountCents), [3334, 3333, 3333]);
      assert.deepEqual(rows.map(row => row.dueOn), ["2026-12-30", "2027-01-29", "2027-02-28"]);
      assert.equal(rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.amountCents, 0), 10000);
      assert.ok(rows.every(row => row.paymentMethodId === "method"));
      assert.equal(addPaymentDays("2028-02-28", 1), "2028-02-29");
    });
    
    test("entrada em percentual corresponde aos centavos negociados sem cálculo monetário fracionário", () => {
      assert.equal(entryFromPercent(2170121, "70"), 1519085);
      assert.equal(entryPercent(1519085, 2170121), "70,00");
      assert.equal(entryFromPercent(333, "50"), 167);
      assert.equal(entryFromPercent(12345, "100"), 12345);
      assert.equal(entryFromPercent(12345, "0"), 0);
    });
    
    test("plano rejeita parcelas zero, números fora do limite e datas inexistentes", () => {
      for (const args of [[1, 2, "2026-12-30", 30], [100, 121, "2026-12-30", 30], [100, 0, "2026-12-30", 30], [100, 2, "2026-02-30", 30], [100, 2, "2026-12-30", -1]]) {
        assert.throws(() => installmentPlan(...args, "method"));
      }
      for (const value of ["-1", "100,01", "NaN", "70.123"]) assert.equal(entryFromPercent(10000, value), null);
    });

    +export function addPaymentDays(date: string, days: number): string {

    +  const [year, month, day] = date.split("-").map(Number)
    +  const current = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day))
    +  if (year < 1900 || current.getUTCFullYear() !== year || current.getUTCMonth() !== month - 1 || current.getUTCDate() !== day) throw Error("Informe uma data válida para o pagamento.")
    +  current.setUTCDate(current.getUTCDate() + days)
    +  if (current.getUTCFullYear() > 9999) throw Error("O vencimento ultrapassa o limite do calendário.")
    +  return current.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
    +}
    +
    +export function installmentPlan(balance: number, count: number, first: string, interval: number, method: string): PaymentInstallment[] {
    +  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(balance) || balance < 0 || balance > maximumCents || !Number.isInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 120 || !Number.isInteger(interval) || interval < 0 || interval > 3650) throw Error("Confira o saldo, a quantidade e o intervalo das parcelas.")
    +  if (!balance) return []
    +  if (balance < count || !method) throw Error("Cada parcela deve ter valor positivo e uma forma de pagamento.")
    +  const base = BigInt(balance) / BigInt(count)
    +  const remainder = Number(BigInt(balance) % BigInt(count))
    +  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({ paymentMethodId: method, dueOn: addPaymentDays(first, index * interval), amountCents: Number(base) + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0) }))
    +}
    +
    +export function entryFromPercent(total: number, raw: string): number | null {
    +  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total <= 0 || total > maximumCents || !/^\d{1,3}(?:[.,]\d{1,2})?$/.test(raw.trim())) return null
    +  const [whole, fraction = ""] = raw.trim().replace(",", ".").split(".")
    +  const bps = Number(whole) * 100 + Number(fraction.padEnd(2, "0"))
    +  if (bps > 10000) return null
    +  return Number((BigInt(total) * BigInt(bps) + 5000n) / 10000n)
    +}
    +
    +export function entryPercent(entry: number, total: number): string {
    +  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(entry) || !Number.isSafeInteger(total) || entry < 0 || total <= 0 || entry > total) return ""

    fn text(raw: &str, limit: usize) -> Result<String, DomainError> {
        let value = raw.trim();
        if value.chars().count() > limit
            || value
                .chars()
                .any(|c| c.is_control() && !matches!(c, '\n' | '\r' | '\t'))
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Observações excedem o limite ou contêm caracteres inválidos",
            ));
        }
        Ok(value.to_owned())
    }
    
    async fn method(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        id: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<CheckoutPaymentMethod, DomainError> {
        let value: Option<Value> = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'code',code,'name',name,'modality',modality) FROM payment_methods WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND status='active'")
            .bind(tenant).bind(id).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        serde_json::from_value(value.ok_or(DomainError::Invalid(
            "Selecione uma forma de pagamento ativa desta empresa",
        ))?)
        .map_err(|_| crate::platform::access::AccessError::Internal.into())
    }

    pub async fn get_rules(
        State(state): State<AppState>,
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        let (tenant, mut tx, _) =
            authorized(&state, &headers, &identity, POLICY, POLICY, false).await?;
        let row: Option<(i64, Value)> = sqlx::query_as(
            "SELECT revision,rules FROM commercial_approval_settings WHERE tenant_id=$1",
        )
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        Path(id): Path<Uuid>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        let (tenant, mut tx, _) = authorized(&state, &headers, &identity, READ, MANAGE, false).await?;
        let row: Option<(Value,Value,String,bool,i64)> = sqlx::query_as("SELECT q.public_snapshot,q.private_snapshot,q.approval_status,q.requires_director,o.revision FROM commercial_order_quotes q JOIN sales_orders o ON o.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND o.id=q.order_id WHERE q.tenant_id=$1 AND q.order_id=$2")
            .bind(tenant).bind(id).fetch_optional(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        let Some((public, private, status, director, revision)) = row else {
            tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
            return Ok(response(
                StatusCode::OK,
                None,
                json!({"tenantId":tenant,"data":null}),
            ));
        };
        let can_approve = allowed(&mut tx, tenant, &identity, DIRECTOR).await?
            || (!director && allowed(&mut tx, tenant, &identity, APPROVE).await?);
        let details = if allowed(&mut tx, tenant, &identity, POLICY).await?
            && allowed(&mut tx, tenant, &identity, DIRECTOR).await?
        {
            Some(private["director"].clone())
        } else {
            None
        };
        let decisions: Vec<Value> = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT jsonb_build_object('decision',d.decision,'reason',d.reason,'createdAt',d.created_at,'decidedBy',i.display_name) FROM commercial_approval_decisions d JOIN identities i ON i.id=d.decided_by WHERE d.tenant_id=$1 AND d.order_id=$2 ORDER BY d.created_at,d.id")
            .bind(tenant).bind(id).fetch_all(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(
            StatusCode::OK,
            Some(revision),
            json!({"tenantId":tenant,"revision":revision,"data":public,"director":details,"approvalStatus":status,"canApprove":can_approve,"decisions":decisions}),
        ))
    }

    pub async fn load(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        order: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<Option<CheckoutSnapshot>, DomainError> {
        let saved: Option<Saved> = sqlx::query_as("SELECT customer_snapshot,entry_amount_cents,entry_payment_method_id,entry_payment_method,entry_due_on::text,manufacturing_days,delivery_notes,payment_notes,notes FROM sales_order_checkouts WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2")
            .bind(tenant).bind(order).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        let Some(saved) = saved else { return Ok(None) };
        let rows: Vec<Installment> = sqlx::query_as("SELECT id,number,payment_method_id,payment_method,due_on::text,amount_cents FROM sales_order_installments WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2 ORDER BY number")
            .bind(tenant).bind(order).fetch_all(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        let mut due = saved.entry_due_on;
        let mut installments = Vec::new();
        for row in rows {
            if row.number == 0 {
                due = row.due_on;
                continue;
            }
            installments.push(CheckoutInstallmentSnapshot {
                id: row.id,
                number: row.number,
                payment_method_id: row.payment_method_id,
                payment_method: serde_json::from_value(row.payment_method)
                    .map_err(|_| crate::platform::access::AccessError::Internal)?,
                due_on: row
                    .due_on
                    .ok_or(crate::platform::access::AccessError::Internal)?,
                amount_cents: row.amount_cents,
            });
        }
        let state_registration = saved.customer_snapshot["stateRegistration"]
            .as_str()
            .map(str::to_owned);
        Ok(Some(CheckoutSnapshot {
            confirmation_creates_receivables: true,
            entry: CheckoutEntrySnapshot {
                amount_cents: saved.entry_amount_cents,
                payment_method_id: saved.entry_payment_method_id,
                payment_method: saved
                    .entry_payment_method
                    .map(serde_json::from_value)
                    .transpose()
                    .map_err(|_| crate::platform::access::AccessError::Internal)?,
                due_on: due,
            },
            installments,
            manufacturing_days: saved.manufacturing_days.map(|v| v as u16),
            delivery_notes: saved.delivery_notes,
            payment_notes: saved.payment_notes,
            notes: saved.notes,
            customer: saved.customer_snapshot,
            state_registration,
        }))
    }

    export type CommercialSelection = { productId: string; quantity: number }
    export type CommercialTableQuery = { line: "imported" | "national"; q: string; offset: number; destinationState: string; taxpayer: boolean; items: CommercialSelection[] }
    type TableLocation = Pick<CommercialTableQuery, "line" | "q" | "offset"> & Partial<Pick<CommercialTableQuery, "destinationState" | "taxpayer" | "items">>
    export const commercialTablePageSize = 14
    const states = new Set("AC AL AP AM BA CE DF ES GO MA MT MS MG PA PB PR PE PI RJ RN RS RO RR SC SP SE TO".split(" "))
    const uuid = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i
    
    export function readCommercialItems(value: string | null | undefined): CommercialSelection[] {
      if (!value || value.length > 4500) return []
      const entries = value.split(",")
      if (entries.length > 100) return []
      const seen = new Set<string>()
      const items: CommercialSelection[] = []
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const [id, quantity, extra] = entry.split(":")
        const productId = id.toLowerCase()
        if (!uuid.test(id) || extra !== undefined || !/^\d{1,7}$/.test(quantity || "") || Number(quantity) < 1 || Number(quantity) > 1_000_000 || seen.has(productId)) return []
        seen.add(productId)
        items.push({ productId, quantity: Number(quantity) })
      }
      return items
    }
    
    export function readCommercialTableQuery(params: Pick<URLSearchParams, "get">): CommercialTableQuery {
      const raw = params.get("offset") || "0"
      const offset = /^\d{1,6}$/.test(raw) ? Number(raw) : 0
      const destination = (params.get("destinationState") || "").toUpperCase()
      return { line: params.get("linha") === "national" ? "national" : "imported", q: (params.get("q") || "").trim().slice(0, 160), offset: Math.floor(offset / commercialTablePageSize) * commercialTablePageSize, destinationState: states.has(destination) ? destination : "", taxpayer: params.get("taxpayer") === "true", items: readCommercialItems(params.get("itens")) }
    }
    
    export function commercialTableHref(query: TableLocation) {
      const params = new URLSearchParams()
      if (query.line === "national") params.set("linha", query.line)
      if (query.q) params.set("q", query.q)
      if (query.offset) params.set("offset", String(query.offset))
      if (query.destinationState) params.set("destinationState", query.destinationState)
      if (query.taxpayer) params.set("taxpayer", "true")
      if (query.items?.length) params.set("itens", query.items.map(item => `${item.productId}:${item.quantity}`).join(","))
      return `/vendas/tabela-precos${params.size ? `?${params}` : ""}`
    }
    
    export function commercialSimulationHref(query: CommercialTableQuery, product?: string) {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ linha: query.line })
      if (product) params.set("produto", product)
      else if (query.items.length) params.set("itens", query.items.map(item => `${item.productId}:${item.quantity}`).join(","))
      if (query.destinationState) params.set("destinationState", query.destinationState)
      params.set("taxpayer", String(query.taxpayer))
      params.set("returnTo", commercialTableHref(query))
      return `/vendas/simulador?${params}`
    }
    
    export function commercialTableReturn(value: string | undefined, line: string) {
      const fallback = commercialTableHref({ line: line === "national" ? "national" : "imported", q: "", offset: 0 })
      if (!value?.startsWith("/vendas/tabela-precos")) return fallback
      try {
        const url = new URL(value, "https://erp.local")
        if (url.origin !== "https://erp.local" || url.pathname !== "/vendas/tabela-precos") return fallback
        return commercialTableHref(readCommercialTableQuery(url.searchParams))
      } catch { return fallback }
    }

            {rows.length > 0 && <p role="status" className="text-xs">Parcelas: {money(rowsTotal)}{balance !== null ? ` · Saldo: ${money(balance)}${rowsTotal === balance ? " · Soma conferida" : " · Ajuste os valores"}` : ""}</p>}
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={rows.length >= 120 || !balanceMethod} onClick={() => { const next = { key: crypto.randomUUID(), paymentMethodId: balanceMethod, dueOn: rows.at(-1)?.dueOn || dueDate || paymentToday(), amount: "0,00" }; setRows([...rows, next]); setCount(String(rows.length + 1)) }}>Adicionar parcela</Button>
            <label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1">Observações do pagamento<textarea className={textareaClass} rows={2} maxLength={2000} value={paymentNotes} onChange={event => setPaymentNotes(event.target.value)} /></label>
          </section>
          <label className="grid min-w-0 gap-1">Observações do pedido<textarea className={textareaClass} rows={2} maxLength={10000} value={notes} onChange={event => setNotes(event.target.value)} /></label>
        </fieldset>
        {error && <p role="alert" className="text-sm">{error}</p>}
      </div>
    }

    /// The authorized sales orchestrator owns this transaction and the order revision.
    pub(super) async fn confirm(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        order: Uuid,
        identity: &AuthenticatedIdentity,
        headers: &HeaderMap,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        if !exists(tx, tenant, order).await? {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let existing: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
            "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM receivables WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2)",
        )
        .bind(tenant)
        .bind(order)
        .fetch_one(&mut **tx)
        .await
        .map_err(db)?;
        if existing {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "Pedido já possui títulos; concilie antes de confirmar",
            ));
        }
        sqlx::query("UPDATE sales_order_installments SET due_on=(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2 AND kind='entry' AND due_on IS NULL")
            .bind(tenant).bind(order).execute(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        let rows:Vec<(Uuid,time::Date,i64,String)>=sqlx::query_as("SELECT i.id,i.due_on,i.amount_cents,c.customer_snapshot->>'legalName' FROM sales_order_installments i JOIN sales_order_checkouts c ON c.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND c.order_id=i.order_id WHERE i.tenant_id=$1 AND i.order_id=$2 ORDER BY i.number")
            .bind(tenant).bind(order).fetch_all(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        for (installment, due, amount, customer) in rows {
            let id = Uuid::now_v7();
            sqlx::query("INSERT INTO receivables(id,tenant_id,order_id,order_installment_id,customer_name,due_date,amount_cents,status) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,'open')")
                .bind(id).bind(tenant).bind(order).bind(installment).bind(customer).bind(due).bind(amount).execute(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
            record(tx,tenant,identity,headers,DomainChange {kind:"receivable",id,event:"receivable.created",details:json!({"orderId":order,"orderInstallmentId":installment,"amount":decimal(amount,2),"revision":1,"source":"confirmed_order_schedule"})}).await?;
        }
        verify_receivables(tx, tenant, order).await
    }
    
    pub(crate) async fn verify_receivables(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        order: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        let valid:bool=sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_installments i LEFT JOIN receivables r ON r.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND r.order_id=i.order_id AND r.order_installment_id=i.id WHERE i.tenant_id=$1 AND i.order_id=$2 AND (r.id IS NULL OR r.status='cancelled' OR r.amount_cents<>i.amount_cents OR r.due_date<>i.due_on)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM receivables WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2 AND order_installment_id IS NULL) AND (SELECT sum(amount_cents) FROM sales_order_installments WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2)=(SELECT amount_cents FROM sales_orders WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2)")
            .bind(tenant).bind(order).fetch_one(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        if !valid {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "Concilie os títulos das parcelas antes de concluir o pedido",
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn cancel_unpaid(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        order: Uuid,
        identity: &AuthenticatedIdentity,
        headers: &HeaderMap,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        if !exists(tx, tenant, order).await? {
            return Ok(());
        }

            .bind(tenant).bind(order).fetch_one(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
