    "use client"
    
    import { useEffect, useRef, type ComponentProps } from "react"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    
    type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<"input">, "ref"> & {
      onSearch: (value: string, form: HTMLFormElement | null) => void
    }
    
    /** Only invokes a read callback; never submits an enclosing business form. */
    export function SearchInput({ onSearch, onChange, onCompositionStart, onCompositionEnd, onKeyDown, defaultValue, ...props }: Props) {
      const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
      const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)
      const composing = useRef(false)
      const callback = useRef(onSearch)
      const submitted = useRef(String(defaultValue ?? ""))
      useEffect(() => { callback.current = onSearch }, [onSearch])
      useEffect(() => {
        if (defaultValue !== undefined && String(defaultValue) !== submitted.current && input.current) {
          input.current.value = String(defaultValue)
          submitted.current = String(defaultValue)
        }
      }, [defaultValue])
      function cancel() { if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current); timer.current = null }
      useEffect(() => {
        const form = input.current?.form
        form?.addEventListener("submit", cancel, true)
        return () => { cancel(); form?.removeEventListener("submit", cancel, true) }
      }, [])
      function schedule(element: HTMLInputElement) {
        cancel()
        if (composing.current) return
        const value = element.value
        timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
          timer.current = null
          if (!element.isConnected || element.disabled || element.closest("fieldset[disabled]") || element.value !== value) return
          submitted.current = value
          callback.current(value, element.form)
        }, 300)
      }
      return <Input {...props} ref={input} defaultValue={defaultValue} autoComplete="off"
        onChange={event => { onChange?.(event); schedule(event.currentTarget) }}
        onCompositionStart={event => { composing.current = true; cancel(); onCompositionStart?.(event) }}
        onCompositionEnd={event => { composing.current = false; onCompositionEnd?.(event); schedule(event.currentTarget) }}
        onKeyDown={event => { if (event.key === "Escape" || event.key === "Enter") cancel(); onKeyDown?.(event) }} />
    }

    //! Atomic draft creation and explicit approval of pricing exceptions.
    use super::{pricing, pricing_model::QuoteInput};
    use crate::domains::{
        DomainChange, DomainError, authorized, command_key, db, record, remember, replay, response,
        revision,
    };
    use crate::platform::{access, auth::AuthenticatedIdentity, state::AppState};
    use axum::{
        Extension, Json,
        extract::{Path, State, rejection::JsonRejection},
        http::{HeaderMap, StatusCode},
        response::Response,
    };
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use serde_json::{Value, json};
    use uuid::Uuid;
    
    #[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, utoipa::ToSchema)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase", deny_unknown_fields)]
    pub struct CreateInput {
        quote: QuoteInput,
        digest: String,
        customer_id: Uuid,
        due_date: String,
        structure_color: Option<String>,
        plate_holder_color: Option<String>,
        plate_holder_type: Option<String>,
        upholstery_color: Option<String>,
    }
    
    #[utoipa::path(post,path="/api/v1/sales-simulator/{line}/orders",operation_id="create_simulated_order",tag="Sales",security(("bearerAuth"=[])),params(("line"=String,Path),("X-Tenant-Id"=Uuid,Header),("Idempotency-Key"=Uuid,Header)),request_body=CreateInput,responses((status=201,body=Value),(status=412,description="Simule novamente"),(status=422,description="Condições inválidas")))]
    pub async fn create(
        State(state): State<AppState>,
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        Path(code): Path<String>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
        payload: Result<Json<CreateInput>, JsonRejection>,
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        let key = command_key(&headers)?;
        let (tenant, mut tx, _) = authorized(
            &state,
            &headers,
            &identity,
            pricing::READ,
            pricing::MANAGE,
            true,
        )
        .await?;
        let Json(input) = payload.map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("Dados do pedido inválidos"))?;
        pricing::line(&code)?;
        let request = json!({"line":code,"input":input});
        if let Some(previous) = replay(
            &mut tx,
            tenant,
            &identity.subject,
            key,
            "order.simulated",
            &request,
        )
        .await?
        {
            tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
            return Ok(response(StatusCode::CREATED, Some(1), previous));
        }
        let prepared = pricing::prepare(&mut tx, tenant, &code, &input.quote).await?;
        if prepared.digest != input.digest {
            return Err(DomainError::StaleRevision);
        }
        let order_input = super::OrderInput {
            customer_id: input.customer_id,
            due_date: input.due_date.clone(),
            items: vec![super::OrderItemInput {
                product_id: input.quote.product_id,
                quantity: format!("{}.000000", input.quote.quantity),
                structure_color: input.structure_color,
                arm_color: None,
                plate_holder_color: input.plate_holder_color,
                plate_holder_type: input.plate_holder_type,
                upholstery_color: input.upholstery_color,
            }],
        };
        let mut order = super::prepare_order(&mut tx, tenant, &order_input, None, true).await?;
        order.total = prepared.quote.sale.invoice_total_cents;
        order.lines[0].price = prepared.quote.sale.unit_with_ipi_cents;
        order.lines[0].amount = order.total;
        order.lines[0].sku = prepared.product["sku"]
            .as_str()
            .ok_or(DomainError::Conflict("SKU publicado inválido"))?
            .into();
        order.lines[0].name = prepared.product["name"]
            .as_str()
            .ok_or(DomainError::Conflict("Nome publicado inválido"))?
            .into();
        let id = Uuid::now_v7();
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO sales_orders(id,tenant_id,customer_id,customer_name,customer_tax_id,due_date,amount_cents,status) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,'draft')")
            .bind(id).bind(tenant).bind(input.customer_id).bind(&order.customer_name).bind(&order.customer_tax_id).bind(order.due).bind(order.total).execute(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        super::store_lines(&mut tx, tenant, id, &order.lines).await?;
        let needs_approval = prepared.quote.sale.needs_approval;
        let snapshot = pricing::redact(prepared, &input.quote, true, tenant);
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO order_pricing_snapshots(tenant_id,order_id,version_id,snapshot,needs_approval) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5)")
            .bind(tenant).bind(id).bind(input.quote.version_id).bind(snapshot).bind(needs_approval).execute(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        record(&mut tx, tenant, &identity, &headers, DomainChange {
            kind:"sales_order", id, event:"order.created",
            details:json!({"revision":1,"source":"sales_simulator","versionId":input.quote.version_id,"needsApproval":needs_approval}),
        }).await?;
        let result = json!({"tenantId":tenant,"id":id,"revision":1,"status":"draft","needsApproval":needs_approval});
        remember(
            &mut tx,
            tenant,
            &identity.subject,
            key,
            "order.simulated",
            &request,
            &result,
        )
        .await?;
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(StatusCode::CREATED, Some(1), result))
    }
    
    #[utoipa::path(get,path="/api/v1/orders/{id}/pricing",operation_id="get_order_pricing",tag="Sales",security(("bearerAuth"=[])),params(("id"=Uuid,Path),("X-Tenant-Id"=Uuid,Header)),responses((status=200,body=Value),(status=404,description="Pedido não encontrado")))]
    pub async fn get(
        State(state): State<AppState>,

                .fetch_optional(&mut *tx)

        let row: Option<(Value,bool,Option<String>)> = sqlx::query_as("SELECT snapshot,needs_approval,approved_by FROM order_pricing_snapshots WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2")
            .bind(tenant).bind(id).fetch_optional(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        let rights = crate::platform::access::load_access(&mut tx, tenant, &identity.subject).await?;
        let can_approve =
            crate::platform::access::require_permission(&rights, pricing::DIRECTOR).is_ok();
        let director = can_approve
    "use client"
    
    import { useState } from "react"
    import Link from "next/link"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { useCommand, useResource } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    import { useNavigationGuard } from "@/components/shell/navigation-guard"
    import { SimulationResult } from "./simulator-result"
    import type { Simulation } from "./simulator-model"
    
    type Pricing = { tenantId: string; canApprove: boolean; data: { snapshot: Simulation; needsApproval: boolean; approved: boolean } | null }
    
    export function OrderPricing({ id, onSaved, showDirector = false }: { id: string; onSaved: () => void; showDirector?: boolean }) {
      const resource = useResource<Pricing>(`/api/erp/orders/${id}/pricing`)
      const command = useCommand()
      const [reason, setReason] = useState("")
      const [notice, setNotice] = useState("")
      useNavigationGuard(command.busy || command.uncertain ? "A aprovação ainda não foi confirmada. Sair?" : null)
      const value = resource.value
      if (resource.loading) return <p role="status">Consultando condições da simulação…</p>
      if (resource.error) return <div role="alert"><RequestError message={resource.error} status={resource.status} /><Button onClick={resource.reload}>Tentar novamente</Button></div>
      if (!value?.data) return null
      const data = value.data
      return <section className="space-y-4" aria-label="Condições comerciais preservadas">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">Condições comerciais · tabela v{data.snapshot.version}</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Este pedido preserva a simulação e não permite editar seus itens. Para negociar outras condições, cancele o rascunho e <Link className="text-primary underline" href="/vendas/simulador">refaça a simulação</Link>.</p>
        <SimulationResult value={showDirector ? data.snapshot : { ...data.snapshot, director: undefined }} imported={data.snapshot.line === "imported"} />
        {data.needsApproval && <p role="status" className="font-medium">{data.approved ? "Exceção comercial aprovada pela gestão." : "Aguardando aprovação da gestão antes da confirmação."}</p>}
        {notice && <p role="status">{notice}</p>}
        {value.canApprove && data.needsApproval && !data.approved && <form className="space-y-3" onSubmit={async event => {
          event.preventDefault()
          const result = await command.send<{ tenantId: string; approved: boolean }>(`/api/erp/orders/${id}/pricing/approve`, value.tenantId, { reason }, resource.etag)
          if (result?.tenantId === value.tenantId && result.approved) { setNotice("Aprovação registrada."); setReason(""); resource.reload(); onSaved() }
        }}>
          <label className="grid gap-2">Motivo da aprovação<Input required minLength={3} maxLength={2000} value={reason} disabled={command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale} onChange={event => setReason(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <Button type="submit" disabled={command.busy || command.stale}>{command.busy ? "Confirmando…" : command.uncertain ? "Conferir aprovação" : "Aprovar exceção comercial"}</Button>
          {command.error && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={command.error} status={command.status} /></p>}
          {command.stale && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { command.reset(); resource.reload(); onSaved() }}>Recarregar pedido</Button>}
        </form>}
      </section>
    }

    Add: C:\Users\nicol\source\erp-next-main\artifacts\commercial-navigation-pr.md
    Pedidos criados pelo simulador agora preservam cliente, entrega, entrada e parcelas no servidor e nos documentos. A confirmação reserva estoque e gera os títulos abertos de cada vencimento; a conclusão os reutiliza. Recebimentos continuam sendo ações financeiras explícitas, e pedidos antigos mantêm o título único na conclusão.
    
    A tabela compara preços e alçadas por UF/contribuinte e permite montar uma seleção com quantidades. O simulador conserva filtros, acabamentos e condições ao navegar ou recuperar uma publicação alterada. A apresentação móvel fica compacta, com comparações recolhidas e controles acessíveis.
    
    Também corrige arredondamento por unidade/IPI e limite livre, restaura os valores sem IPI preservados na preparação fiscal e exige as permissões combinadas para expor custos e margens.
    
    Validação: 57 testes Rust de domínio/HTTP em PostgreSQL isolado; 74 testes de modelos web; 74 cenários distintos de navegador em 320–1440 px; TypeScript, build de produção, rustfmt e lint sem erros. Revisões independentes de backend e frontend realizadas. Um teste legado de tabela foi atualizado para expandir as comparações móveis e repetido com sucesso. Não foram realizadas vendas, recebimentos, e-mails ou transmissões fiscais reais.
    
    A migration adiciona snapshots e parcelas com RLS e histórico preservado, mantém unicidade de títulos antigos e identifica cada novo título por parcela. Publicação coordenada de API/web com compilação local e backup completo do banco. SMTP continua dependendo da configuração do ambiente.

    Deploy helper syntax OK
    """Package compiled Windows Next output with existing Linux runtime dependencies."""
    import io, json, pathlib, re, sys, tarfile, os
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
    
    workspace = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
    dist = workspace / 'apps/web/.next-commercial-release'
    standalone = dist / 'standalone/apps/web'
    original = (standalone / 'server.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    match = re.search(r'^const nextConfig = (.+)$', original, re.M)
    if not match: raise RuntimeError('Standalone config missing')
    config = json.loads(match.group(1))
    def rebase(value):
        if isinstance(value, dict): return {k: rebase(v) for k,v in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, list): return [rebase(v) for v in value]
        if isinstance(value, str):
            normalized = value.replace('\\','/')
            root = workspace.as_posix()
            if normalized.lower().startswith(root.lower()): return '/app' + normalized[len(root):]
        return value
    config = rebase(config)
    config['distDir'] = './.next'
    config['distDirRoot'] = '.next'
    server = original[:match.start(1)] + json.dumps(config,separators=(',',':')) + original[match.end(1):]
    output = workspace / 'artifacts' / ('commercial-web-' + sys.argv[1][:12] + '.tar.gz')
    entries = 0
    with tarfile.open(output,'w:gz',compresslevel=6) as archive:
        def add_bytes(name, data):
            global entries
            item = tarfile.TarInfo(name); item.size=len(data); item.mode=0o644
            archive.addfile(item,io.BytesIO(data)); entries+=1
        add_bytes('apps/web/server.js',server.encode())
        add_bytes('apps/web/package.json',(workspace/'apps/web/package.json').read_bytes())
        def add_tree(source, prefix):
            paths=[]
            for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(source, followlinks=False):
                dirs[:]=[name for name in dirs if name not in {'node_modules','cache','dev','.git'} and not name.startswith('.env')]
                paths.extend(pathlib.Path(directory)/name for name in files if not name.startswith('.env'))
            def read(path):
                if path.is_symlink(): raise RuntimeError('Unexpected bundle symlink')
                raw = path.read_bytes()
                if path.name=='required-server-files.json':
                    manifest=rebase(json.loads(raw)); manifest['config']=config
                    raw=json.dumps(manifest,separators=(',',':')).encode()
                return path,raw
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
                for path, raw in pool.map(read, paths, buffersize=32):
                    add_bytes(prefix+'/'+path.relative_to(source).as_posix(),raw)
        add_tree(standalone/config.get('distDirRoot','.next'),'apps/web/.next') if (standalone/'.next').exists() else add_tree(standalone/'.next-commercial-release','apps/web/.next')
        add_tree(dist/'static','apps/web/.next/static')
        add_tree(workspace/'apps/web/public','apps/web/public')
    print(json.dumps({'archive':str(output),'bytes':output.stat().st_size,'files':entries}))

    pub(super) async fn require_approval(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        order: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        let status: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
            "SELECT approval_status FROM commercial_order_quotes WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2",
        )
        .bind(tenant)
        .bind(order)
        .fetch_optional(&mut **tx)
        .await
        .map_err(db)?;
        if status
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|status| !matches!(status.as_str(), "approved" | "not_required"))
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "Negociação precisa de aprovação antes de confirmar o pedido",
            ));
        }
        if status.is_none() {
            let simulated: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
                "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_pricing_snapshots WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2)",
            )
            .bind(tenant)
            .bind(order)
            .fetch_one(&mut **tx)
            .await
            .map_err(db)?;
            if simulated {
                return Ok(());
            }
            let bypass: bool = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND l.order_id=o.id JOIN price_table_items i ON i.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND i.product_id=l.product_id JOIN commercial_settings s ON s.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND s.active_price_version_id=i.version_id JOIN price_table_versions v ON v.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND v.id=i.version_id WHERE o.tenant_id=$1 AND o.id=$2 AND o.created_at>=v.published_at AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sales_proposals sp WHERE sp.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND sp.order_id=o.id AND sp.created_at<v.published_at))")
                .bind(tenant).bind(order).fetch_one(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
            if bypass {
                return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                    "Tabela publicada exige negociação calculada. Recrie este rascunho no simulador comercial",
                ));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn require_unquoted(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        order: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        let exists: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
            "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM commercial_order_quotes WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_pricing_snapshots WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2)",
        )
        .bind(tenant)
        .bind(order)
        .fetch_one(&mut **tx)
        .await
        .map_err(db)?;
        if exists {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "Pedido preserva uma negociação ou simulação calculada. Cancele o rascunho e refaça a simulação para negociar outras condições",
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    async fn rules(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<(i64, ApprovalRules), DomainError> {
        let (revision, raw): (i64, Value) = sqlx::query_as(
            "SELECT revision,rules FROM commercial_approval_settings WHERE tenant_id=$1",
        )
        .bind(tenant)
        .fetch_optional(&mut **tx)
        .await
        .map_err(db)?
        .ok_or(DomainError::Conflict(
            "Salve as regras de aprovação da empresa antes de simular",
        ))?;
        Ok((
            revision,
            serde_json::from_value(raw).map_err(|_| access::AccessError::Internal)?,
        ))
    }

    async fn prepare(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        input: &SimulationInput,
    ) -> Result<Prepared, DomainError> {
        if !matches!(input.line.as_str(), "imported" | "national") {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Linha comercial inválida"));
        }
        let (version, saved_revision, current_revision, policy): (i64, i64, i64, Value) = sqlx::query_as("SELECT v.version,v.settings_revision,s.revision,v.policy_snapshot FROM commercial_settings s JOIN price_table_versions v ON v.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND v.id=s.active_price_version_id WHERE s.tenant_id=$1 AND s.product_line=$2 AND v.id=$3")
            .bind(tenant).bind(&input.line).bind(input.version_id).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?.ok_or(DomainError::StaleRevision)?;
        if saved_revision != current_revision {
            return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                "Parâmetros alterados após a publicação. Publique a tabela atualizada antes de simular",
            ));
        }
        let parameters: CommercialParameters =
            serde_json::from_value(policy.clone()).map_err(|_| access::AccessError::Internal)?;
        let (rules_revision, rules) = rules(tx, tenant).await?;
        if input.items.is_empty() || input.items.len() > 100 {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Simulação exige de 1 a 100 equipamentos",
            ));
        }
        let mut sources = Vec::with_capacity(input.items.len());
        for item in &input.items {
            let source: SourceItem = sqlx::query_as("SELECT i.product_id,i.product_snapshot->>'sku' AS sku,i.product_snapshot->>'name' AS name,i.product_snapshot->>'unit' AS unit,p.revision AS product_revision,i.cost_revision,i.price_without_ipi_cents AS price_cents,(i.cost_snapshot->>'purchaseCostCents')::bigint AS purchase_cents,(i.cost_snapshot->>'taxCreditBps')::integer AS credit_bps,(i.cost_snapshot->>'packagingCents')::bigint AS packaging_cents FROM price_table_items i JOIN products p ON p.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND p.id=i.product_id JOIN price_table_versions v ON v.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND v.id=i.version_id LEFT JOIN product_costs c ON c.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND c.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.tenant_id=$1 AND i.version_id=$2 AND i.product_id=$3 AND p.status='active' AND v.product_line=$4 AND p.unit=i.product_snapshot->>'unit' AND p.revision=(i.product_snapshot->>'revision')::bigint AND ((v.source_kind='calculated' AND c.product_line=$4 AND c.revision=i.cost_revision) OR (v.source_kind='legacy' AND i.cost_revision IS NULL AND i.source_snapshot->>'source'=v.source_reference->>'source'))")
                .bind(tenant).bind(input.version_id).bind(item.product_id).bind(&input.line).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?.ok_or(DomainError::Conflict("Produto ou custo alterado, indisponível ou fora da tabela. Atualize e publique a tabela"))?;
            sources.push(source);
        }
        let (sale, director) = model::calculate(&parameters, &rules, input, &sources)?;
        let raw = json!({"tenantId":tenant,"input":input,"rulesRevision":rules_revision,"rules":rules,"policy":policy,"sources":sources,"sale":sale,"director":director});
        let digest = format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(raw.to_string().as_bytes()));
        Ok(Prepared {
            sale,
            director,
            rules,
            policy,
            sources,
            digest,
            version,
        })
    }

    /// Only the quoted public price and the actor's usable percentage leave this helper.
    /// Cost, margin and director projections remain within this transaction.
    fn table_limit(
        parameters: &CommercialParameters,
        rules: &ApprovalRules,
        input: &mut SimulationInput,
        source: &SourceItem,
        authority: TableAuthority,
    ) -> Option<(u32, i64)> {
        let quote_at = |input: &mut SimulationInput, discount| {
            input.discount = model::Discount::Percent(discount);
            model::calculate(parameters, rules, input, std::slice::from_ref(source))
                .ok()
                .filter(|(sale, director)| authority.permits(sale, director))
        };
        quote_at(input, 0)?;
        let (mut low, mut high) = (0_u32, 9_999_u32);
        while low < high {
            let middle = (low + high).div_ceil(2);
            if quote_at(input, middle).is_some() {
                low = middle;
            } else {
                high = middle - 1;
            }
        }
        // Validate the exact unit-cent result rather than trusting an algebraic margin bound.
        quote_at(input, low).map(|(sale, _)| (low, sale.total_cents))
    }
    
    struct TableContext<'a> {
        parameters: &'a CommercialParameters,
        rules: Option<&'a ApprovalRules>,
        version: Uuid,
        line: &'a str,
        destination: &'a str,
        taxpayer: bool,
        globally_available: bool,
        authority: TableAuthority,
    }
    
    fn table_projection(context: TableContext<'_>, rows: &[TableRow]) -> (Vec<Value>, Vec<Value>) {
        let TableContext {
            parameters,
            rules,
            version,
            line,
            destination,
            taxpayer,
            globally_available,
            authority,
        } = context;
        let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(rows.len());
        let mut bounds = [(Some(9_999_u32), 0_usize); 54];
        for row in rows {
            let available = globally_available && row.available;
            let mut selected_limit = None;
            let mut free_price = None;
            if let Some(rules) = rules.filter(|_| available) {
                let mut input = SimulationInput {
                    line: line.into(),
                    version_id: version,
                    destination_state: destination.into(),
                    taxpayer,
                    discount: model::Discount::Percent(parameters.free_discount_bps),
                    freight_cents: 0,
                    down_payment_cents: None,
                    items: vec![model::SimulationItem {
                        product_id: row.source.product_id,
                        quantity: 1,
                        structure_color: None,
                        plate_holder_color: None,
                        plate_holder_type: None,
                        upholstery_color: None,
                    }],
                };
                free_price =
                    model::calculate(parameters, rules, &input, std::slice::from_ref(&row.source))
                        .ok()
                        .map(|(sale, _)| sale.total_cents);
                for (state_index, state) in crate::platform::commercial_settings_model::STATES
                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                {
                    for (taxpayer_index, condition) in [false, true].into_iter().enumerate() {
                        input.destination_state = (*state).into();
                        input.taxpayer = condition;
                        let limit = table_limit(parameters, rules, &mut input, &row.source, authority);
                        if *state == destination && condition == taxpayer {
                            selected_limit = limit;
                        }
                        let entry = &mut bounds[state_index * 2 + taxpayer_index];
                        entry.0 = entry
                            .0
                            .zip(limit.map(|(limit, _)| limit))
                            .map(|(previous, limit)| previous.min(limit));
                        entry.1 += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            items.push(json!({
                "productId":row.source.product_id,"sku":row.source.sku,"name":row.source.name,"unit":row.source.unit,
                "priceWithoutIpiCents":row.source.price_cents,"ipiBps":row.ipi_bps,"priceWithIpiCents":row.price_with_ipi_cents,
                "available":available,
                "unavailableReason":(!available).then_some(if !globally_available {"Confira os parâmetros e as regras de aprovação antes de negociar"} else {"Produto ou custo alterado, indisponível ou fora da tabela. Atualize e publique a tabela"}),
                "freeDiscountPriceWithIpiCents":free_price,
                "maxOwnDiscountBps":selected_limit.map(|(limit, _)| limit),
                "minOwnPriceWithIpiCents":selected_limit.map(|(_, price)| price)
            }));
        }
        let mut destinations = Vec::with_capacity(54);
        for (state_index, state) in crate::platform::commercial_settings_model::STATES
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
        {
            for (taxpayer_index, condition) in [false, true].into_iter().enumerate() {
                let (limit, count) = bounds[state_index * 2 + taxpayer_index];
                destinations.push(json!({"state":state,"taxpayer":condition,"maxOwnDiscountBps":if count > 0 {limit} else {None}}));
            }
        }
        (items, destinations)
    }

    use std::{env, sync::Arc, time::Duration};
    
    use anyhow::{Context, ensure};
    use lettre::{
        AsyncSmtpTransport, AsyncTransport, Message, Tokio1Executor,
        message::{Attachment, MultiPart, SinglePart, header::ContentType},
        transport::smtp::authentication::Credentials,
    };
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    pub struct SmtpMailer {
        transport: Arc<AsyncSmtpTransport<Tokio1Executor>>,
        from: String,
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct MailAttachment {
        pub filename: String,
        pub content_type: String,
        pub bytes: Vec<u8>,
    }
    
    impl SmtpMailer {
        pub fn from_env() -> anyhow::Result<Option<Self>> {
            let host = match env::var("SMTP_HOST")
                .ok()
                .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
            {
                Some(value) => value,
                None => return Ok(None),
            };
            let port: u16 = env::var("SMTP_PORT")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "587".to_owned())
                .parse()
                .context("SMTP_PORT must be a valid port")?;
            let username =
                env::var("SMTP_USERNAME").context("SMTP_USERNAME is required when SMTP_HOST is set")?;
            let password =
                env::var("SMTP_PASSWORD").context("SMTP_PASSWORD is required when SMTP_HOST is set")?;
            let from = env::var("SMTP_FROM").context("SMTP_FROM is required when SMTP_HOST is set")?;
            let _ = from
                .parse::<lettre::message::Mailbox>()
                .context("SMTP_FROM must be a valid mailbox")?;
            ensure!(
                !username.is_empty() && !password.is_empty(),
                "SMTP credentials must not be empty"
            );
            let transport = AsyncSmtpTransport::<Tokio1Executor>::relay(&host)
                .context("failed to configure SMTP relay")?
                .port(port)
                .credentials(Credentials::new(username, password))
                .timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(20)))
                .build();
            Ok(Some(Self {
                transport: Arc::new(transport),
                from,
            }))
        }
    
        pub async fn send_with_attachments(
            &self,
            recipients: &[String],
            subject: &str,
            body: &str,
            attachments: &[MailAttachment],
        ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
            ensure!(!recipients.is_empty(), "at least one recipient is required");
            let builder = Message::builder().from(self.from.parse()?);
            let builder = recipients
                .iter()
                .try_fold(builder, |builder, recipient| {
                    Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(builder.to(recipient.parse()?))
                })?
                .subject(subject);
            let parts = attachments.iter().map(|attachment| {
                let content_type = ContentType::parse(&attachment.content_type).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
                    ContentType::parse("application/octet-stream").expect("static content type")
                });
                Attachment::new(attachment.filename.clone())
                    .body(attachment.bytes.clone(), content_type)
            });
            let message = parts.fold(
                MultiPart::mixed().singlepart(SinglePart::plain(body.to_owned())),
                |multipart, part| multipart.singlepart(part),
            );
            self.transport.send(builder.multipart(message)?).await?;
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    name: systematic-debugging
    description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
    ---
    
    # Systematic Debugging
    
    ## Overview
    
    **Core principle:** ALWAYS find root cause before attempting fixes. Symptom fixes are failure.
    
    **Violating the letter of this process is violating the spirit of debugging.**
    
    ## The Iron Law
    
    ```
    NO FIXES WITHOUT ROOT CAUSE INVESTIGATION FIRST
    ```
    
    If you haven't completed Phase 1, you cannot propose fixes.
    
    ## When to Use
    
    Use for ANY technical issue:
    - Test failures
    - Bugs in production
    - Unexpected behavior
    - Performance problems
    - Build failures
    - Integration issues
    
    **Use this ESPECIALLY when:**
    - Under time pressure (emergencies make guessing tempting)
    - "Just one quick fix" seems obvious
    - You've already tried multiple fixes
    - Previous fix didn't work
    - You don't fully understand the issue
    
    **Don't skip when:**
    - Issue seems simple (simple bugs have root causes too)
    - You're in a hurry (rushing guarantees rework)
    - Manager wants it fixed NOW (systematic is faster than thrashing)
    
    ## The Four Phases
    
    You MUST complete each phase before proceeding to the next.
    
    ### Phase 1: Root Cause Investigation
    
    **BEFORE attempting ANY fix:**
    
    1. **Read Error Messages Carefully**
       - Don't skip past errors or warnings
       - They often contain the exact solution
       - Read stack traces completely
       - Note line numbers, file paths, error codes
    
    2. **Reproduce Consistently**
       - Can you trigger it reliably?
       - What are the exact steps?
       - Does it happen every time?
       - If not reproducible → gather more data, don't guess
    
    3. **Check Recent Changes**
       - What changed that could cause this?
       - Git diff, recent commits
       - New dependencies, config changes
       - Environmental differences
    
    4. **Gather Evidence in Multi-Component Systems**
    
       **WHEN system has multiple components (CI → build → signing, API → service → database):**
    
       **BEFORE proposing fixes, add diagnostic instrumentation:**
       ```
       For EACH component boundary:
         - Log what data enters component
         - Log what data exits component
         - Verify environment/config propagation
         - Check state at each layer
    
       Run once to gather evidence showing WHERE it breaks
       THEN analyze evidence to identify failing component
       THEN investigate that specific component
       ```
    
       **Example (multi-layer system):**
       ```bash
       # Layer 1: Workflow
       echo "=== Secrets available in workflow: ==="
       echo "IDENTITY: $([ -n "${IDENTITY:-}" ] && echo SET || echo UNSET)"
    
       # Layer 2: Build script
       echo "=== Env vars in build script: ==="
       printenv IDENTITY >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "IDENTITY in environment" || echo "IDENTITY not in environment"

    privados `api.env`, `web.env` e `.env`. `api.env` contém `DATABASE_URL`,
    `AUTH_ISSUER=https://auth.avilaops.com`, `NFE_PRODUCTION_ENABLED=false` e
    `NFE_PRODUCTION_TENANT_ID` vazio. Se a emissão de produção for liberada para
    uma única empresa, as duas variáveis devem ser ativadas juntas e o UUID do
    tenant autorizado deve ser informado; não existe liberação global segura.
    Nos releases `compose.json` que usam `network_mode: service:api`, uma recriação
    da API exige recriar também `web`, `fiscal-engine` e `fiscal-mcp`, para que todos
    usem a rede da nova API. Recrie os quatro serviços juntos. Depois confira o
    `/api/health` público, a prontidão da API e a resposta do `/mcp`; o estado
    `healthy` de um container antigo não confirma o acesso pela rede atual.
    Quando o pacote documental estiver habilitado, o mesmo `api.env` recebe
    `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USERNAME`, `SMTP_PASSWORD` e `SMTP_FROM`; esses
    valores são secretos do relay e não podem ser copiados para `web.env` ou
    versionados.
    O workflow de migração também aplica `deploy/grant-commercial-contracts.sql`,
    concedendo ao papel runtime somente `SELECT`, `INSERT` e `UPDATE` na tabela de
    estado do pacote; a API não recebe permissão de exclusão desses registros.
    `web.env` contém `ERP_AUTH_CLIENT_ID`, `ERP_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET`,
    `ERP_SESSION_SECRET` e `ERP_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID`. `.env` fixa `ERP_API_IMAGE` e
    `ERP_WEB_IMAGE` e `ERP_RELEASE_SHA`. Não versionar esses arquivos preenchidos.
    
    Web e API compartilham o namespace de rede do serviço API; o BFF usa
    `http://127.0.0.1:8080`. Isso mantém a exigência existente de HTTPS ou loopback,
    sem novo endpoint ou promessa de API geral de jobs neste documento.

    # Blueprint Mode v39
    
    You are a blunt, pragmatic senior software engineer with dry, sarcastic humor. Your job is to help users safely and efficiently. Always give clear, actionable solutions. You can add short, witty remarks when pointing out inefficiencies, bad practices, or absurd edge cases. Stick to the following rules and guidelines without exception, breaking them is a failure.
    
    ## Core Directives
    
    - Workflow First: Select and execute Blueprint Workflow (Loop, Debug, Express, Main). Announce choice; no narration.
    - User Input: Treat as input to Analyze phase, not replacement. If conflict, state it and proceed with simpler, robust path.
    - Accuracy: Prefer simple, reproducible, exact solutions. Do exactly what user requested, no more, no less. No hacks/shortcuts. If unsure, ask one direct question. Accuracy, correctness, and completeness matter more than speed.
    - Thinking: Always think before acting. Use `think` tool for planning. Do not externalize thought/self-reflection.
    - Retry: On failure, retry internally up to 3 times with varied approaches. If still failing, log error, mark FAILED in todos, continue. After all tasks, revisit FAILED for root cause analysis.
    - Conventions: Follow project conventions. Analyze surrounding code, tests, config first.
    - Libraries/Frameworks: Never assume. Verify usage in project files (`package.json`, `Cargo.toml`, `requirements.txt`, `build.gradle`, imports, neighbors) before using.
    - Style & Structure: Match project style, naming, structure, framework, typing, architecture.
    - Proactiveness: Fulfill request thoroughly, include directly implied follow-ups.
    - No Assumptions: Verify everything by reading files. Don’t guess. Pattern matching ≠ correctness. Solve problems, don’t just write code.
    - Fact Based: No speculation. Use only verified content from files.
    - Context: Search target/related symbols. For each match, read up to 100 lines around. Repeat until enough context. If many files, batch/iterate to save memory and improve performance.
    - Autonomous: Once workflow chosen, execute fully without user confirmation. Only exception: <90 confidence (Persistence rule) → ask one concise question.
    - Final Summary Prep:
    
      1. Check `Outstanding Issues` and `Next`.
      2. For each item:
    
         - If confidence ≥90 and no user input needed → auto-resolve: choose workflow, execute, update todos.
         - If confidence <90 → skip, include in summary.
         - If unresolved → include in summary.
    
    ## Guiding Principles
    
    - Coding: Follow SOLID, Clean Code, DRY, KISS, YAGNI.
    - Core Function: Prioritize simple, robust solutions. No over-engineering or future features or feature bloating.
    - Complete: Code must be functional. No placeholders/TODOs/mocks unless documented as future tasks.
    - Framework/Libraries: Follow best practices per stack.
    
      1. Idiomatic: Use community conventions/idioms.
      2. Style: Follow guides (PEP 8, PSR-12, ESLint/Prettier).
      3. APIs: Use stable, documented APIs. Avoid deprecated/experimental.
      4. Maintainable: Readable, reusable, debuggable.
      5. Consistent: One convention, no mixed styles.
    
    - Facts: Treat knowledge as outdated. Verify project structure, files, commands, libs. Gather facts from code/docs. Update upstream/downstream deps. Use tools if unsure.
    - Plan: Break complex goals into smallest, verifiable steps.
    - Quality: Verify with tools. Fix errors/violations before completion. If unresolved, reassess.
    - Validation: At every phase, check spec/plan/code for contradictions, ambiguities, gaps.
    
    ## Communication Guidelines
    
    - Spartan: Minimal words, use direct and natural phrasing. Don’t restate user input. No Emojis. No commentry. Always prefer first-person statements (“I’ll …”, “I’m going to …”) over imperative phrasing.
    - Address: USER = second person, me = first person.
    - Confidence: 0–100 (confidence final artifacts meet goal).
    - No Speculation/Praise: State facts, needed actions only.
    - Code = Explanation: For code, output is code/diff only. No explanation unless asked. Code must be human-review ready, high-verbosity, clear/readable.
    - No Filler: No greetings, apologies, pleasantries, or self-corrections.
    - Markdownlint: Use markdownlint rules for markdown formatting.
    - Final Summary:
    
      - Outstanding Issues: `None` or list.
      - Next: `Ready for next instruction.` or list.
      - Status: `COMPLETED` / `PARTIALLY COMPLETED` / `FAILED`.
    
    ## Persistence
    
    ### Ensure Completeness
    
    - No Clarification: Don’t ask unless absolutely necessary.
    - Completeness: Always deliver 100%. Before ending, ensure all parts of request are resolved and workflow is complete.
    - Todo Check: If any items remain, task is incomplete. Continue until done.
    
    ### Resolve Ambiguity
    
    When ambiguous, replace direct questions with confidence-based approach. Calculate confidence score (1–100) for interpretation of user goal.
    
    - > 90: Proceed without user input.
    - <90: Halt. Ask one concise question to resolve. Only exception to "don’t ask."
    - Consensus: If c ≥ τ → proceed. If 0.50 ≤ c < τ → expand +2, re-vote once. If c < 0.50 → ask concise question.
    - Tie-break: If Δc ≤ 0.15, choose stronger tail integrity + successful verification; else ask concise question.
    
    ## Tool Usage Policy
    
    - Tools: Explore and use all available tools. You must remember that you have tools for all possible tasks. Use only provided tools, follow schemas exactly. If you say you’ll call a tool, actually call it. Prefer integrated tools over terminal/bash.
    - Safety: Strong bias against unsafe commands unless explicitly required (e.g. local DB admin).
    - Parallelize: Batch read-only reads and independent edits. Run independent tool calls in parallel (e.g. searches). Sequence only when dependent. Use temp scripts for complex/repetitive tasks.
    - Background: Use `&` for processes unlikely to stop (e.g. `npm run dev &`).
    - Interactive: Avoid interactive shell commands. Use non-interactive versions. Warn user if only interactive available.
    - Docs: Fetch latest libs/frameworks/deps with `websearch` and `fetch`. Use Context7.
    - Search: Prefer tools over bash, few examples:
      - `codebase` → search code, file chunks, symbols in workspace.
      - `usages` → search references/definitions/usages in workspace.
      - `search` → search/read files in workspace.
    - Frontend: Use `playwright` tools (`browser_navigate`, `browser_click`, `browser_type`, etc) for UI testing, navigation, logins, actions.
    - File Edits: NEVER edit files via terminal. Only trivial non-code changes. Use `edit_files` for source edits.
    - Queries: Start broad (e.g. "authentication flow"). Break into sub-queries. Run multiple `codebase` searches with different wording. Keep searching until confident nothing remains. If unsure, gather more info instead of asking user.
    - Parallel Critical: Always run multiple ops concurrently, not sequentially, unless dependency requires it. Example: reading 3 files → 3 parallel calls. Plan searches upfront, then execute together.
    - Sequential Only If Needed: Use sequential only when output of one tool is required for the next.
    - Default = Parallel: Always parallelize unless dependency forces sequential. Parallel improves speed 3–5x.
    - Wait for Results: Always wait for tool results before next step. Never assume success and results. If you need to run multiple tests, run in series, not parallel.
    
    ## Self-Reflection (agent-internal)
    
    Internally validate the solution against engineering best practices before completion. This is a non-negotiable quality gate.
    
    ### Rubric (fixed 6 categories, 1–10 integers)
    
    1. Correctness: Does it meet the explicit requirements?
    2. Robustness: Does it handle edge cases and invalid inputs gracefully?
    3. Simplicity: Is the solution free of over-engineering? Is it easy to understand?
    4. Maintainability: Can another developer easily extend or debug this code?
    5. Consistency: Does it adhere to existing project conventions (style, patterns)?
    
    ### Validation & Scoring Process (automated)
    
    - Pass Condition: All categories must score above 8.
    - Failure Condition: Any score below 8 → create a precise, actionable issue.
    - Action: Return to the appropriate workflow step (e.g., Design, Implement) to resolve the issue.
    - Max Iterations: 3. If unresolved after 3 attempts → mark task `FAILED` and log the final failing issue.
    
    ## Workflows
    
    Mandatory first step: Analyze the user's request and project state. Select a workflow. Do this first, always:
    
    - Repetitive across files → Loop.
    - Bug with clear repro → Debug.
    - Small, local change (≤2 files, low complexity, no arch impact) → Express.
    - Else → Main.
    
    ### Loop Workflow
    
    1. Plan:
    
       - Identify all items meeting conditions.
       - Read first item to understand actions.
       - Classify each item: Simple → Express; Complex → Main.
       - Create a reusable loop plan and todos with workflow per item.
    
    2. Execute & Verify:
    
       - For each todo: run assigned workflow.
       - Verify with tools (linters, tests, problems).
       - Run Self Reflection; if any score < 8 or avg < 8.5 → iterate (Design/Implement).
       - Update item status; continue immediately.
    
    3. Exceptions:
    
       - If an item fails, pause Loop and run Debug on it.
       - If fix affects others, update loop plan and revisit affected items.
       - If item is too complex, switch that item to Main.
       - Resume loop.
       - Before finish, confirm all matching items were processed; add missed items and reprocess.
       - If Debug fails on an item → mark FAILED, log analysis, continue. List FAILED items in final summary.
    
    ### Debug Workflow
    
    1. Diagnose: reproduce bug, find root cause and edge cases, populate todos.
    2. Implement: apply fix; update architecture/design artifacts if needed.
    3. Verify: test edge cases; run Self Reflection. If scores < thresholds → iterate or return to Diagnose. Update status.
    
    ### Express Workflow
    
    1. Implement: populate todos; apply changes.
    2. Verify: confirm no new issues; run Self Reflection. If scores < thresholds → iterate. Update status.
    
    ### Main Workflow
    
    1. Analyze: understand request, context, requirements; map structure and data flows.
    2. Design: choose stack/architecture, identify edge cases and mitigations, verify design; act as reviewer to improve it.
    3. Plan: split into atomic, single-responsibility tasks with dependencies, priorities, verification; populate todos.
    4. Implement: execute tasks; ensure dependency compatibility; update architecture artifacts.
    5. Verify: validate against design; run Self Reflection. If scores < thresholds → return to Design. Update status.
    
    ## Controle da equipe
    
    Para coordenar demandas deste projeto, leia [.agents/equipe/README.md](.agents/equipe/README.md).
    O registro de responsaveis, tarefas, decisoes e integracoes fica em `.agents/equipe/controle.json`.
    A skill de coordenacao esta em `.agents/skills/avila-mail-avilaops-com-equipe/SKILL.md`.
    Mantenha evidencias e estado atualizados; as regras especificas deste repositorio continuam valendo.

    ## Login pelo SSO (auth.avilaops.com)
    
    Desde 26/08/2026 a porta do webmail e o `auth.avilaops.com`: `/entrar` redireciona
    para `auth.avilaops.com/login?app=mail&returnTo=https://mail.avilaops.com/api/sessao/sso`.
    Na volta, o webmail repassa o cookie `avila_sso` para `POST /v1/auth/sso` da API,
    que verifica o JWT (`SSO_JWT_SECRET`, o mesmo do auth) e emite a sessao normal
    da caixa, sem senha.
    
    Quem pode abrir o que: caixa cujo endereco e o e-mail da conta, ou caixa com
    `owner_email` igual a ele (`POST /v1/mailboxes` aceita `owner_email`;
    `POST /v1/mailboxes/owner` altera). Varias caixas → seletor em `/entrar/caixas`.
    
    `/entrar?local=1` mantem o login com a senha da caixa (IMAP/apps continuam na
    senha). Webmail precisa de `SSO_ENABLED=true` (unit do systemd); a API, de
    `SSO_JWT_SECRET` no `.env.production`.
    
    Caddy: so `/api/v1/*` vai para a API; o resto de `/api/*` e BFF do webmail.
    
    O [contrato Auth–Mail](docs/contrato-auth-mail.md) detalha a conferência atual de
    acesso/MFA, o prazo SSO limitado ao emissor, o receptor de revogação assinada e
    a reautenticação única das sessões anteriores à identificação de sua origem.
    
    ### Persistência da sessão Mail
    
    O acesso dura `MAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES` (15 minutos por padrão). O refresh
    tem prazo absoluto de `MAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN_DAYS` (30 dias por padrão), contado
    desde o login: renovar o acesso não prolonga esse prazo. A API devolve o tempo
    restante em `refreshExpiresInSeconds`, usado também nos cookies.
    
    O refresh usa o cookie HttpOnly `avila_mail_rt_v2`, restrito ao host, com
    `Path=/`, `Secure` e `SameSite=Strict`. Páginas, downloads e SSE precisam dele
    para recuperar o acesso. `/api/sessao/retomar` migra o cookie legado de
    `Path=/api/sessao`, inclusive em abas que já estavam abertas. As mutações
    continuam exigindo o token CSRF; um erro temporário da API não apaga a sessão.
    
    A rotação é serializada no PostgreSQL por caixa, entre todas as instâncias.
    Durante 10 segundos, chamadas que apresentam o mesmo refresh rotacionado
    recebem a mesma sucessora. O sucessor é armazenado cifrado para essa recuperação;
    reuso após a janela revoga as sessões. Logout invalida a família do aparelho,
    incluindo tokens anteriores, e nunca permite recuperar uma sessão revogada.
    
    O workflow verifica esse contrato com PostgreSQL e Chromium reais no GitHub
    CI. A migração `20261028060000_session_rotation` faz parte do artefato; sua
    aplicação em produção pertence ao procedimento operacional autorizado.
    
    ## Testes
    
    ```bash
    npm test                  # sobe Postgres em container, migra e roda tudo
    npm run test:smoke        # 251 verificações, sem banco e sem rede
    npm run test:security     # 46 verificações de injeção, XSS e token
    npm run test:integration  # exige MAIL_DATABASE_URL; prefira npm test no uso local
    npm --prefix webmail run test:calendar-integrations # integrações mensagem/.ics
    ```
    
    **Servidor: 701 verificações de integração e 251 de smoke. Interface da agenda: 87 verificações.** Os protocolos são conferidos por clientes
    independentes: IMAP pelo `imapflow`, CardDAV/CalDAV pelo `tsdav`. A sondagem de segurança cobre 23 vetores de XSS,
    injeção de cabeçalho CRLF (assunto e nome de exibição), endereços malformados e
    8 formas de falsificar o token de sessão.
    
    O teste de integração cobre o caminho completo: provisionar domínio e caixa,
    receber uma mensagem hostil de verdade (com `<script>`, link `javascript:` e
    pixel de rastreio), autenticar o dono, ler pela API, e confirmar que uma caixa
    não enxerga a correspondência da outra.

    ## Instalação no VPS
    
    ```bash
    # 1. Enviar o código
    #
    # O --exclude '.env*' não é opcional: sem ele, qualquer arquivo de ambiente que
    # exista aqui na estação sobrescreve o /opt/avila-mail/.env.production do
    # servidor. Junto com ele iria embora a MAIL_DKIM_ENCRYPTION_KEY — e as chaves
    # DKIM privadas ficam cifradas com ela no banco. Perdê-la significa gerar par
    # novo e republicar DNS na conta de cada cliente.
    rsync -az --exclude node_modules --exclude dist --exclude '.env*' ./ root@SERVIDOR:/opt/avila-mail/
    
    # 2. Configurar o ambiente
    ssh root@SERVIDOR
    cp /opt/avila-mail/.env.example /opt/avila-mail/.env.production
    openssl rand -hex 32   # → MAIL_DKIM_ENCRYPTION_KEY
    openssl rand -hex 32   # → MAIL_API_TOKEN
    nano /opt/avila-mail/.env.production
    
    # 3. Instalar (idempotente)
    bash /opt/avila-mail/deploy/install.sh
    ```
    
    O script cria usuário de sistema, banco, diretórios, compila, roda as migrações,
    sobe os dois serviços systemd e liga o timer que mantém o certificado em dia.
    Ele **não** mexe em DNS.
    
    ---
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # avila-mail — servidor de e-mail proprio (mail.avilaops.com)
    # Copie para .env.production e preencha. NUNCA versione o arquivo preenchido.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    # Banco dedicado do e-mail, na instancia PostgreSQL que ja roda no VPS
    MAIL_DATABASE_URL="postgresql://avila_mail:TROCAR@127.0.0.1:5432/avila_mail?schema=public"
    
    # Identidade do servidor. Precisa bater com o rDNS do IP e com o A record.
    MAIL_HOSTNAME="mail.avilaops.com"
    
    # Diretorio das mensagens brutas (.eml.gz). Fonte da verdade do conteudo.
    MAIL_STORAGE_DIR="/var/lib/avila-mail/blobs"
    
    # --- Portas SMTP ---
    # 25 = entrada e saida direta. 587/465 = submission autenticada.
    MAIL_INBOUND_PORT="25"
    MAIL_SUBMISSION_PORT="587"
    MAIL_SUBMISSION_TLS_PORT="465"
    
    # Certificado TLS (o mesmo do Caddy/certbot para mail.avilaops.com)
    MAIL_TLS_CERT_PATH="/etc/letsencrypt/live/mail.avilaops.com/fullchain.pem"
    MAIL_TLS_KEY_PATH="/etc/letsencrypt/live/mail.avilaops.com/privkey.pem"
    
    # --- API de provisionamento (consumida pelo portal do cliente e pelo n8n) ---
    MAIL_API_PORT="3040"
    MAIL_API_BIND="127.0.0.1"
    # Token bearer compartilhado com o portal. Gere com: openssl rand -hex 32
    MAIL_API_TOKEN=""
    
    # --- Saida de e-mail ---
    # "direct" — entrega MX-a-MX pelo nosso proprio IP, custo zero, sem terceiros.
    # A Hetzner liberou a porta 25 de saida em 14/08/2026; este e o caminho normal.
    #
    # As pontes seguem disponiveis como contingencia (bloqueio de reputacao do IP,
    # provedor recusando nossa faixa):
    #   smtp = relay em 587/465 com credencial propria
    #   n8n  = ponte pelo workflow de relay do n8n
    #
    # Trocar aqui e reiniciar o MTA e tudo que e preciso. A fila e a mesma.
    MAIL_RELAY_DRIVER="direct"
    
    MAIL_RELAY_SMTP_HOST=""
    MAIL_RELAY_SMTP_PORT="587"
    MAIL_RELAY_SMTP_USER=""
    MAIL_RELAY_SMTP_PASS=""
    
    MAIL_RELAY_N8N_URL=""
    MAIL_RELAY_N8N_TOKEN=""
    
    # --- Aquecimento de IP (so vale para o driver "direct") ---
    # O IP nunca enviou e-mail: volume subito de IP desconhecido e a assinatura
    # classica de spammer para Gmail e Outlook. A rampa segura o excedente na fila
    # ate o dia seguinte (UTC) — nada e recusado nem vira bounce.
    #
    # Data do dia 1 da rampa (YYYY-MM-DD). Vazio = sem aquecimento.
    MAIL_WARMUP_INICIO=""
    # Teto DIARIO de mensagens externas, um valor por semana da rampa.
    # Terminada a lista, o teto some. Mensagem entre caixas nossas nao conta.
    MAIL_WARMUP_CAPS="30,60,120,250,500,1000"
    
    # --- Criptografia das chaves DKIM privadas em repouso ---
    # 32 bytes em hex. Gere com: openssl rand -hex 32
    MAIL_DKIM_ENCRYPTION_KEY=""
    
    # --- Sessao do dono da caixa (webmail) ---
    # Assina o access token. Trocar este valor desconecta todo mundo.
    # Gere com: openssl rand -hex 48
    MAIL_JWT_SECRET=""
    MAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES="15"
    MAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN_DAYS="30"
    # Tentativas de login erradas por janela de 15 min antes de bloquear.
    MAIL_LOGIN_MAX_FAILURES="8"
    
    # --- Cobranca (Mercado Pago) ---
    # Assinatura recorrente no cartao. O cartao e cadastrado na pagina do proprio
    # Mercado Pago: nenhum dado de cartao passa por aqui.
    MP_ACCESS_TOKEN=""
    # Segredo da integracao, em Suas integracoes > Webhooks. Sem ele o endpoint
    # de notificacao recusa tudo — e ele que impede alguem de forjar "pagamento
    # aprovado" para reativar uma caixa suspensa.
    MP_WEBHOOK_SECRET=""
    # Para onde o cliente volta depois de cadastrar o cartao. OBRIGATORIO quando
    # a cobranca esta ligada: precisa ser uma pagina LOGADA do portal que exista de
    # verdade, senao o cliente paga e cai numa tela morta. Sem valor padrao de
    # proposito — dominio embutido sobrevive a mudanca de marca sem ninguem notar.
    MP_BACK_URL=""
    
    # --- Autoatendimento (/v1/public/signup/*) ---
    # Para onde o Mercado Pago devolve quem comprou sozinho. OBRIGATORIO para o
    # host.docker.internal alcança o Postgres do host a partir do container.
    MAIL_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://avila_mail:senha@host.docker.internal:5432/avila_mail
    
    # Automação de caixa de e-mail (fluxo "Auth — Criar caixa de e-mail" no n8n).
    # Ao criar uma conta pelo painel, o auth manda o pedido para cá e o n8n cria a
    # caixa no mail.avilaops.com. Sem as duas variáveis, a opção falha com aviso.
    N8N_CAIXA_WEBHOOK_URL=https://n8n.avilaops.com/webhook/auth-criar-caixa
    N8N_CAIXA_WEBHOOK_TOKEN=
    # Também autentica POST /api/interno/meta/renovar, chamado pela mesma
    # credencial do Auth no n8n. Não usar o cookie SSO para a rotina.
    # O mesmo token serve o envio de e-mail pelo n8n (fluxo "Auth - Enviar e-mail",
    # em .../webhook/auth-enviar-email): quando não há SMTP_* aqui, convites e o
    # cadastro em /criar saem por lá, pela credencial de SMTP guardada no n8n. Só
    # defina N8N_EMAIL_WEBHOOK_URL se o fluxo estiver em outro endereço.
    # N8N_EMAIL_WEBHOOK_URL=
    
    # Envio de e-mail (src/lib/email.ts): confirma o endereço de quem cria a própria
    # conta em /criar. Sem SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USUARIO, SMTP_SENHA e EMAIL_REMETENTE, o
    # cadastro por e-mail fica desligado e o link "Criar conta" só aparece se houver
    # entrada social configurada.
    SMTP_HOST=
    SMTP_PORTA=465
    SMTP_TLS_DIRETO=1
    SMTP_USUARIO=
    SMTP_SENHA=
    EMAIL_REMETENTE=
    EMAIL_REMETENTE_NOME=Avila Ops

    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -Eeuo pipefail
    umask 077
    
    readonly ROOT=/mnt/HC_Volume_106542212/erp-next
    readonly APPLICATION=erp-next
    
    fail() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
    
    [[ $# == 0 ]] || fail 'invalid dispatcher arguments'
    original_command=${SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND:-}
    [[ "$original_command" =~ ^deploy\ erp-next\ ([0-9a-f]{40})$ ]] || fail 'invalid deploy command'
    source_sha=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
    [[ $EUID == 0 ]] || fail 'dispatcher requires root'
    
    exec 9>"$ROOT/.deploy.lock"
    flock -n 9 || fail 'another ERP deployment is running'
    
    previous_release=$(docker inspect --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir" }}' erp-next-web-1)
    [[ "$previous_release" == "$ROOT/releases/"* ]] || fail 'active release is not managed by this dispatcher'
    
    staging=$(mktemp -d "$ROOT/.incoming.XXXXXX")
    release="$ROOT/releases/$source_sha"
    cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$staging"; }
    trap cleanup EXIT
    
    # Extract the complete stream first, then enforce the allow-list below. GNU tar
    # does not reliably match the selected names when the sender emits ./ prefixes.
    tar --extract --gzip --no-same-owner --directory "$staging" --file -
    
    for file in api-image.tar.gz web-image.tar.gz fiscal-image.tar.gz fiscal-mcp-image.tar.gz compose.yaml fiscal-compose.yaml; do
      [[ -s "$staging/$file" ]] || fail "missing artifact: $file"
    done
    [[ ! -e "$release" ]] || fail 'release already exists'
    
    for image in api web fiscal fiscal-mcp; do
      docker load --input "$staging/$image-image.tar.gz" >/dev/null
      docker image inspect "erp-next-$image:sha-$source_sha" >/dev/null || fail "image not loaded: $image"
    done
    
    mkdir -m 700 "$release"
    
    compose_overlay_args=()
    if [[ -f "$previous_release/compose.json" ]]; then
      # Current production still uses a generated, self-contained Compose JSON.

      // Only consult delivery configuration/history when the composer is opened.
      return <>
        <Button variant="outline" className="h-9 px-3" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Enviar por e-mail</Button>
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
          <DialogContent className="max-h-[90dvh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-xl">
            <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Enviar {orderNumber(number)} por e-mail</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>Confira o destinatário e a mensagem antes de enviar o documento do pedido.</DialogDescription></DialogHeader>
            {open && <OrderEmailComposer id={id} number={number} tenantId={tenantId} etag={etag} onReload={onReload} />}
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </>
    }
    
    function OrderEmailComposer({ id, number, tenantId, etag, onReload }: { id: string; number: string; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void }) {
      const messageId = useId()
      const resource = useResource<EmailStatus>(`/api/erp/orders/${id}/email`)
      const command = useCommand()
      const [recipientOverride, setRecipientOverride] = useState<string | null>(null)
      const [subject, setSubject] = useState(`Pedido ${orderNumber(number)}`)
      const [message, setMessage] = useState(`Olá,\n\nSegue em anexo o pedido ${orderNumber(number)} para sua conferência.\n\nFicamos à disposição.`)
      const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState<Delivery | null>(null)
      const value = resource.value?.tenantId === tenantId ? resource.value : null
      const recipient = recipientOverride ?? value?.recipient ?? ""
      const pendingDelivery = receipt?.status === "uncertain" || value?.deliveries.some(delivery => delivery.status === "uncertain")
      const frozen = command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale || !!pendingDelivery || receipt?.status === "sent"
      if (resource.loading && !value) return <p role="status">Consultando envio de e-mail…</p>
      if (resource.error || !value) return <div className="space-y-3"><p role="alert"><RequestError message={resource.error || "Não foi possível consultar o envio deste pedido."} status={resource.status} /></p><Button variant="outline" onClick={resource.reload}>Consultar novamente</Button></div>
      return <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={async event => {
        event.preventDefault()
        if (!command.uncertain && (!value.canSend || !value.emailReady || frozen)) return
        const result = await command.send<Receipt>(`/api/erp/orders/${id}/email`, tenantId, { recipient, subject, message }, etag)
        if (result?.tenantId === tenantId) { setReceipt(result.delivery); resource.reload() }
      }}>
        {!value.emailReady && <p role="status" className="rounded-lg border p-3">O envio de e-mail ainda não está configurado no servidor. Nenhuma mensagem será enviada até a configuração estar disponível.</p>}
        {!value.canSend && <p role="status">Envio indisponível: verifique sua permissão de gestão e se o pedido está cancelado.</p>}
        <fieldset disabled={frozen || !value.canSend || !value.emailReady} className="space-y-3">
          <label className="block space-y-2">Destinatário<Input type="email" autoComplete="email" required maxLength={254} value={recipient} onChange={event => setRecipientOverride(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <label className="block space-y-2">Assunto<Input required maxLength={200} value={subject} onChange={event => setSubject(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <div className="space-y-2"><label htmlFor={messageId} className="block">Mensagem</label><textarea id={messageId} required maxLength={10000} rows={5} className="w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-background p-3" value={message} onChange={event => setMessage(event.target.value)} /></div>
        </fieldset>
        <p className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3 text-sm">Anexo: documento do pedido em HTML, com cliente, itens, acabamentos e valores registrados. Para enviar o contrato para assinatura, use “Pedido e contratos”.</p>
        {command.error && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={command.error} status={command.status} /></p>}
        {command.stale && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { command.reset(); onReload(); resource.reload() }}>Recarregar pedido</Button>}
        {receipt && <p role="status">{deliveryLabels[receipt.status]} · {receipt.recipient}{receipt.status === "sent" ? ". A entrega na caixa do destinatário depende do provedor." : "."}</p>}
        {pendingDelivery && <p role="status">Há um envio sem confirmação definitiva. Consulte o histórico e confirme com o provedor antes de realizar outro envio.</p>}
        {command.uncertain && <p role="status">Resultado ainda não confirmado. A consulta abaixo repete o mesmo comando, sem criar um novo envio.</p>}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button type="submit" disabled={command.busy || command.stale || (!command.uncertain && (!value.canSend || !value.emailReady || frozen || !etag))}>{command.busy ? "Confirmando envio…" : command.uncertain ? "Consultar resultado do envio" : "Enviar e-mail com anexo"}</Button>
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={command.busy} onClick={resource.reload}>Atualizar histórico</Button>
    "use client"

        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
          <DialogContent className="max-h-[90dvh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-xl">

            {open && <ProposalEmailComposer id={id} tenantId={tenantId} etag={etag} onReload={onReload} command={command} receipt={receipt} onReceipt={setReceipt} draft={draft} onDraftChange={patch => setDraft(previous => ({ ...previous, ...patch }))} />}
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </>

    function ProposalEmailComposer({ id, tenantId, etag, onReload, command, receipt, onReceipt, draft, onDraftChange }: { id: string; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void; command: ReturnType<typeof useCommand>; receipt: Delivery | null; onReceipt: (delivery: Delivery) => void; draft: EmailDraft; onDraftChange: (patch: Partial<EmailDraft>) => void }) {

      if (resource.loading && !value) return <p role="status">Consultando envio de e-mail…</p>

      return <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={async event => {
        event.preventDefault()

      }}>

        {!value.canSend && <p role="status">Envio indisponível: confira sua permissão, a validade e a situação da proposta.</p>}
        <fieldset disabled={frozen || !value.canSend || !value.emailReady} className="space-y-3">
          <label className="block space-y-2">Destinatário<Input type="email" autoComplete="email" required maxLength={254} value={recipient} onChange={event => onDraftChange({ recipientOverride: event.target.value })} /></label>
          <label className="block space-y-2">Assunto<Input required maxLength={200} value={subject} onChange={event => onDraftChange({ subject: event.target.value })} /></label>

    # Comercial e navegação — Implementation Plan
    
    > **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [x]`) syntax for tracking.
    
    **Goal:** Concluir e verificar tabela publicada → simulação → pedido, com navegação compacta, valores consistentes e preservação do acordo comercial.
    
    **Architecture:** Reutilizar o domínio comercial e os snapshots existentes. Corrigir cálculos e a origem fiscal no servidor; manter o navegador responsável por preenchimento, navegação e apresentação. Os testes usam dados sintéticos ou PostgreSQL isolado, sem vendas, e-mails ou transmissão fiscal reais.
    
    **Tech Stack:** Rust/Axum/SQLx/PostgreSQL; Next.js/React/TypeScript; Playwright e testes de domínio/HTTP existentes.
    
    **Spec:** Critérios comerciais e de navegação de AVL-432 e AVL-17, com as correções explícitas do usuário: sem cor de anilheiro; tipo Standard, Olímpico ou não se aplica na negociação; cores fotográficas do catálogo; interface compacta e responsiva.
    
    ## Global Constraints
    
    - Preservar preços, parâmetros, documentos e dados reais existentes.
    - Cálculos monetários em centavos; percentuais em pontos-base; servidor decide preços, aprovação e permissões.
    - Preservar tenant, revisão, digest, idempotência, auditoria e histórico imutável.
    - Não executar operações comerciais, financeiras, e-mails ou emissões fiscais reais como teste.
    - Compilação local ou em CI; nenhuma compilação no servidor de produção.
    - Interface legível em 320, 390, 430, 1366 e 1440 pixels, com teclado e indicação dos requisitos antes de criar o pedido.
    
    ## Review Focus
    
    - Arredondamento no limite livre não deve criar uma exceção inexistente.
    - Um total desejado não deve ser ultrapassado por um centavo.
    - Sem desconto, a simulação deve conservar o preço publicado com IPI.
    - Custos e margens exigem as mesmas permissões na simulação e no pedido preservado.
    - Reabrir ou atualizar uma negociação não pode perder cliente/acabamentos nem repetir um comando incerto.
    
    ## Baseline
    
    - Base: d64acfea4b12be1a318d094d9d1e9c2a162ff09f.
    - 26 testes existentes de simulador, navegação e pedidos aprovados com a build de produção local.
    - Lacunas identificadas: cálculo comercial novo diverge do arredondamento já protegido no motor anterior; preparação fiscal considera somente o snapshot antigo; ausência de teste de conversão bem-sucedida da tabela ao detalhe.
