    }
    impl ProductInput {
        pub(crate) fn validate(&mut self) -> Result<i64, DomainError> {
            if let Some(legacy) = self.arm_colors.take() {
                if self.plate_holder_colors.as_ref().is_some_and(|current| {
                    current.len() != legacy.len()
                        || current.iter().zip(&legacy).any(|(current, legacy)| {
                            !current.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(legacy.trim())
                        })
                }) {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                        "Informe as cores dos anilheiros apenas em plateHolderColors",
                    ));
                }
                if self.plate_holder_colors.is_none() {
                    self.plate_holder_colors = Some(legacy);
                }
            }
            if let Some(legacy) = self.plate_holder_type.take() {
                if legacy.trim().is_empty() {
                    if self
                        .plate_holder_types
                        .as_ref()
                        .is_some_and(|current| !current.is_empty())
                    {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                            "Informe os tipos de anilheiro apenas em plateHolderTypes",
                        ));
                    }
                    if self.plate_holder_types.is_none() {
                        self.plate_holder_types = Some(Vec::new());
                    }
                } else {
                    let normalized = match legacy.trim().to_lowercase().as_str() {
                        "standard" => "Standard",
                        "olympic" | "olímpico" => "Olímpico",
                        _ => {
                            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                                "Tipo de anilheiro deve ser Olímpico ou Standard",
                            ));
                        }
                    };
                    if self.plate_holder_types.as_ref().is_some_and(|current| {
                        current.len() != 1 || !current[0].trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(normalized)
                    }) {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                            "Informe os tipos de anilheiro apenas em plateHolderTypes",
                        ));
                    }
                    if self.plate_holder_types.is_none() {
                        self.plate_holder_types = Some(vec![normalized.to_owned()]);
                    }
                }
            }
            if let Some(category) = &mut self.category_id {
                *category = category.trim().to_owned();
                if !category.is_empty() && Uuid::parse_str(category).is_err() {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Categoria inválida"));
                }
            }
            if let Some(photo) = self
                .photo_data_url
                .as_deref()
                .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
            {
                let invalid = || {
                    DomainError::Invalid(
                        "Foto exige JPEG válido com até 256 KiB; selecione a imagem novamente",
                    )
                };
                if photo.len() > 350000 {
                    return Err(invalid());
                }
                let encoded = photo
                    .strip_prefix("data:image/jpeg;base64,")
                    .ok_or_else(invalid)?;
                let bytes = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD
                    .decode(encoded)
                    .map_err(|_| invalid())?;
                if bytes.len() > 262144
                    || !bytes.starts_with(&[0xff, 0xd8, 0xff])
                    || !bytes.ends_with(&[0xff, 0xd9])
                {
                    return Err(invalid());
                }
            }
            self.sku = self.sku.trim().to_ascii_uppercase();
            self.name = self.name.trim().to_owned();
            self.unit = self.unit.trim().to_ascii_uppercase();
            if self.sku.is_empty()
                || self.sku.len() > 80
                || !self
                    .sku
                    .bytes()
                    .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"._/-".contains(&c))
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "SKU deve conter até 80 letras ASCII, números, ponto, barra, hífen ou sublinhado",
                ));
            }
            if self.name.is_empty() || self.name.chars().count() > 200 {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Nome deve conter de 1 a 200 caracteres",
                ));
            }
            if self.unit.is_empty()
                || self.unit.len() > 6
                || !self.unit.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_uppercase())
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Unidade deve conter de 1 a 6 letras"));
            }
            for (code, size) in [(&self.ncm, 8), (&self.cest, 7)] {
                if code
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_some_and(|s| s.len() != size || !s.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()))
                {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                        "NCM exige 8 dígitos e CEST exige 7; use null para não informado",
                    ));
                }
            }
            if !["active", "archived"].contains(&self.status.as_str()) {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Situação inválida"));
            }
            for options in [
                &mut self.structure_colors,
                &mut self.upholstery_colors,
                &mut self.plate_holder_colors,
                &mut self.plate_holder_types,
            ]
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            {
                if options.len() > 32 {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid(

                    if name.is_empty()

                        || name.chars().any(char::is_control)
                        || !names.insert(name.to_lowercase())

                        ));

                }
            }

            }) {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Tipo de anilheiro deve ser Olímpico ou Standard",
                ));

    export async function forwardErp(request: Request, resource: string) {
      const priceListResource = /^\/price-lists(?:\/[a-f0-9-]{36})?$/i.test(resource) && (resource === "/price-lists" ? ["GET", "POST"] : ["GET", "PUT"]).includes(request.method)
      const opportunityResource = /^\/opportunities(?:\/[a-f0-9-]{36})?$/.test(resource) && (resource === "/opportunities" ? ["GET", "POST"] : ["GET", "PUT"]).includes(request.method)
      const metricResource = request.method === "GET" && /^\/commercial\/metrics\/(?:orders|commissions)$/.test(resource)
      const commercialTableResource = request.method === "GET" && /^\/commercial\/tables\/(?:imported|national)$/.test(resource)
      const negotiationResource = metricResource || request.method === "GET" && /^\/commercial\/(?:tables\/(?:imported|national)|orders\/[a-f0-9-]{36}|approval-settings)$/.test(resource)
        || request.method === "POST" && /^\/commercial\/(?:simulate|orders|orders\/[a-f0-9-]{36}\/decision)$/.test(resource)

            csv.push_str(&fields.map(|field| csv_cell(&field)).join(","));
            csv.push_str("\r\n");
        }
        let mut result = Response::new(csv.into());
        *result.status_mut() = StatusCode::OK;
        result.headers_mut().insert(
            header::CONTENT_TYPE,
            "text/csv; charset=utf-8".parse().unwrap(),
        );
        result.headers_mut().insert(
            header::CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
            "attachment; filename=produtos.csv".parse().unwrap(),
        );
        Ok(result)
    }
    fn csv_cell(value: &str) -> String {
        let mut value = value.to_owned();
        if value.starts_with('=')
            || value.starts_with('+')
            || value.starts_with('-')
            || value.starts_with('@')
        {
            value.insert(0, '\'');
        }
        if value.contains(',') || value.contains('"') || value.contains('\n') || value.contains('\r') {
            format!("\"{}\"", value.replace('"', "\"\""))
        } else {
            value
        }
    }
    
    #[cfg(test)]
    mod tests {
        use super::{csv_cell, parse_csv};
    
        #[test]
        fn parses_quoted_fields_and_semicolon_delimiters() {
            let rows = parse_csv("sku;name\nA-1;\"Mesa; grande\"\n").unwrap();
            assert_eq!(rows[1][0], "A-1");
            assert_eq!(rows[1][1], "Mesa; grande");
        }
    
        #[test]
        fn rejects_unclosed_quotes_and_large_files() {
            assert!(parse_csv("sku,name\n\"broken\n").is_err());
            assert!(parse_csv(&format!("sku,name\n{}", "x".repeat(2 * 1024 * 1024))).is_err());
        }
    
        #[test]
        fn neutralizes_formula_cells_and_quotes_special_values() {
            assert_eq!(csv_cell("=SUM(A1:A2)"), "'=SUM(A1:A2)");
            assert_eq!(csv_cell("Nome, especial"), "\"Nome, especial\"");
            assert_eq!(csv_cell("Ele \"disse\""), "\"Ele \"\"disse\"\"\"");
        }

    export function erpFetch(resource: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
      if (!resource.startsWith("/api/erp/") || resource.includes("\\") || resource.includes("#")) {
        return Promise.reject(new Error("Recurso do ERP inválido"))
      }
      return fetch(resource, { cache: "no-store", ...init, credentials: "same-origin" })
    }
    
    export async function readApi<Path extends ApiPath>(
      path: Path, signal?: AbortSignal,
    ): Promise<{ data: JsonReply<Path, "get" & keyof import("./generated").paths[Path]>; etag: string }> {
      const response = await erpFetch(path.replace("/api/v1/", "/api/erp/"), { signal })
      const data = await response.json()
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.title || "Consulta indisponível")
      return { data, etag: response.headers.get("etag") || "" }
    }

    ---
    title: use client
    description: Learn how to use the use client directive to render a component on the client.
    ---
    
    The `'use client'` directive declares an entry point for the components to be rendered on the **client side** and should be used when creating interactive user interfaces (UI) that require client-side JavaScript capabilities, such as state management, event handling, and access to browser APIs. This is a React feature.
    
    > **Good to know:**
    >
    > You do not need to add the `'use client'` directive to every file that contains Client Components. You only need to add it to the files whose components you want to render directly within Server Components. The `'use client'` directive defines the [server and client boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary), and the components exported from such a file serve as entry points to the client.
    
    ## Usage
    
    To declare an entry point for the Client Components, add the `'use client'` directive **at the top of the file**, before any imports. The directive applies to the entire module and cannot be placed inside a component or function:

    # Exportação de produtos confiável — Implementation Plan
    
    > For agentic workers: use superpowers:executing-plans, TDD and one independent final review before integration.
    
    **Goal:** Melhorar o fluxo existente de exportação, preservando filtros, identificando acesso/erros e entregando somente o CSV correto ao navegador.
    
    **Spec:** [AVL-380](https://linear.app/avilaops/issue/AVL-380) pede filtros efetivos, conteúdo/nome/MIME corretos, proteção de planilha e autorização/isolamento no backend. O código atual já possui GET /products/export com catalog.products.export, RLS por empresa e CSV escapado; não reimplementar. A aceitação autenticada continua distinta dos testes sintéticos.
    
    **Architecture:** Somente web e BFF. Manter dados e serialização CSV do backend. Conferir a permissão da sessão via /me, validar filtros e resposta CSV no cliente, guardar os filtros aplicados enquanto a operação estiver em andamento e permitir cancelamento. O BFF conserva o protocolo CSV e a identidade da sessão, sem aceitar empresa pelo navegador.
    
    ## Constraints / Review Focus
    
    - Não iniciar exportação sem acesso conferido; a autorização real permanece no endpoint existente.
    - Nome produtos.csv, MIME CSV e conteúdo devem corresponder ao contrato; JSON/HTML/arquivo vazio não viram download de sucesso.
    - CSV de apenas cabeçalho é válido e indica ausência de produtos no filtro. Não inventar contagem, histórico persistente ou conclusão de gravação em disco.
    - Manter os bytes/células do servidor, inclusive acentos, aspas, quebras de linha, zeros de códigos e fórmulas já neutralizadas. Não reformatar preços.
    - Filtros permanecem preservados em erro/repetição, ficam bloqueados durante a geração e correspondem ao arquivo entregue.
    - Cancelar/sair impede download tardio e não permite duas requisições concorrentes; usar a confirmação existente para links enquanto ocupado.
    - Distinguir erro de sessão/permissão/rede e manter acesso ao catálogo conforme permissão de leitura.
    - Validar desktop/celular em 320/390/430/1366/1440; alvos móveis de44px, teclado e ausência de rolagem lateral.
    - Sem exportação de dados reais como teste sem sessão autenticada autorizada; sem importação, alteração de produtos, envio de mensagens ou operação fiscal.
    - Sem mudança de status/comentário no Linear, nem alteração de API/banco. Build local/CI; publicação somente web, sem compilação em produção.
    
    ### Task 1: Contrato de consulta e arquivo
    
    - [ ] Testar filtros válidos/inválidos, cabeçalho e MIME, UTF-8/células preservadas, erros e CSV sem produtos.
    - [ ] Testar BFF: sessão/tenant, filtros permitidos, recusa de duplicados/métodos indevidos e preservação do protocolo CSV.
    - [ ] Implementar helpers e ajuste do BFF conservando o endpoint e as permissões.
    
    ### Task 2: Tela compacta e recuperação
    
    - [ ] Reproduzir filtros editáveis durante geração e respostas inválidas entregues como arquivo.
    - [ ] Conferir acesso, validar entrada, congelar filtros, cancelar, recuperar erros e informar o envio ao navegador.
    - [ ] Proteger navegação e limpar recursos sem disparo tardio, mantendo os filtros em erro e cancelamento.
    - [ ] Conferir arquivo e estados de acesso/carregamento/vazio/erro em cinco larguras, com dados sintéticos.
    
    ### Task 3: Revisão e publicação
    
    - [ ] Modelos completos, navegador na build de produção, TypeScript, lint, build e capturas.
    - [ ] Revisão independente, correções relevantes, commit e CI aprovada.
    - [ ] Publicação web com revisão pública e saúde dos quatro serviços, sem declarar aceite autenticado completo.

    import assert from "node:assert/strict";
    import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
    import { test } from "node:test";
    import ts from "typescript";
    
    const tenant = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
    const other = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222";
    const uri = source => "data:text/javascript;base64," + Buffer.from(source).toString("base64");
    const session = uri('export const currentSession=async()=>globalThis.__productExportSession;export const currentIdentitySession=currentSession;export const erpConfiguration=()=>({origin:"http://fixture.local",api:"http://backend.local"});');
    const source = readFileSync(new URL("../src/server/bff/erp-proxy.ts", import.meta.url), "utf8").replace('import "server-only"', "").replace('"@/server/auth/erp-session"', JSON.stringify(session)).replace('"@/lib/api/local-fiscal-origin"', JSON.stringify(new URL("../src/lib/api/local-fiscal-origin.ts", import.meta.url).href));
    const { forwardErp } = await import(uri(ts.transpileModule(source, { compilerOptions: { module: ts.ModuleKind.ESNext, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022 } }).outputText));
    
    test("exportação BFF usa empresa da sessão e conserva filtros, CSV e nome do arquivo", async () => {
      const previous = globalThis.fetch;
      globalThis.__productExportSession = { tenantId: tenant, accessToken: "fixture" };
      const calls = [];
      const csv = "sku,name,unit,ncm,cest,base_price,status\r\nA,Academia,UN,01010101,,10.00,active\r\n";
      globalThis.fetch = async (url, init) => { calls.push({ url: new URL(url), init }); return new Response(csv, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8", "Content-Disposition": "attachment; filename=produtos.csv" } }); };
      try {
        const response = await forwardErp(new Request("http://fixture.local/export?q=Academia&status=active", { headers: { "X-Tenant-Id": other } }), "/products/export");
        assert.equal(response.status, 200);
        assert.equal(calls[0].init.headers.get("x-tenant-id"), tenant);
        assert.equal(calls[0].init.headers.get("accept"), "text/csv");
        assert.equal(calls[0].url.searchParams.get("q"), "Academia");
        assert.equal(calls[0].url.searchParams.get("status"), "active");
        assert.equal(response.headers.get("content-disposition"), "attachment; filename=produtos.csv");
        assert.match(response.headers.get("cache-control"), /no-store/);
        assert.equal(await response.text(), csv);
      } finally { globalThis.fetch = previous; delete globalThis.__productExportSession; }
    });
    
    test("exportação BFF recusa sessão ausente, método inválido e filtros de outra empresa", async () => {
      const previous = globalThis.fetch;
      globalThis.fetch = async () => { throw Error("Unexpected upstream request"); };
      try {
        globalThis.__productExportSession = null;
        assert.equal((await forwardErp(new Request("http://fixture.local/export"), "/products/export")).status, 401);
        globalThis.__productExportSession = { tenantId: tenant, accessToken: "fixture" };
        assert.equal((await forwardErp(new Request("http://fixture.local/export?tenantId=" + other), "/products/export")).status, 400);
        assert.equal((await forwardErp(new Request("http://fixture.local/export?q=a&q=b"), "/products/export")).status, 400);
        assert.equal((await forwardErp(new Request("http://fixture.local/export", { method: "POST", headers: { origin: "http://fixture.local", "content-type": "application/json", "x-tenant-id": tenant }, body: "{}" }), "/products/export")).status, 405);
      } finally { globalThis.fetch = previous; delete globalThis.__productExportSession; }
    });

    import assert from "node:assert/strict";
    import { test } from "node:test";
    import * as model from "../src/features/data/export/product-export-model.ts";
    
    const header = "sku,name,unit,ncm,cest,base_price,status";
    
    test("consulta de exportação conserva filtros e recusa valores fora do contrato", () => {
      assert.equal(typeof model.productExportQuery, "function");
      const url = new URL(model.productExportQuery("  A & B  ", "active"), "https://erp.local");
      assert.equal(url.pathname, "/api/erp/products/export");
      assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("q"), "A & B");
      assert.equal(url.searchParams.get("status"), "active");
      assert.equal(model.productExportQuery("", ""), "/api/erp/products/export");
      for (const args of [["x".repeat(161), ""], ["Nome\u0000produto", ""], ["", "invalid"]]) assert.throws(() => model.productExportQuery(...args));
    });
    
    test("arquivo CSV mantém conteúdo, acentos, aspas, códigos e preço originais", async () => {
      assert.equal(typeof model.readProductExport, "function");
      const csv = header + '\r\nLD-A1,"Árvore, ""academia""\nsegunda linha",UN,01010101,0012345,19419.84,active\r\nLD-A2,\'=SUM(A1:A2),UN,,,10.00,archived\r\n';
      const file = await model.readProductExport(new Response(csv, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8" } }));
      assert.equal(await file.blob.text(), csv);
      assert.equal(file.empty, false);
      assert.match(file.blob.type, /^text\/csv/);
    });
    
    test("resposta inválida ou erro não vira um CSV e cabeçalho sem produtos permanece válido", async () => {
      assert.equal(typeof model.readProductExport, "function");
      for (const response of [Response.json({ data: [] }), new Response("<html>Entrar</html>", { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html" } }), new Response("", { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/csv" } }), new Response("outro,cabecalho\r\n", { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/csv" } })]) await assert.rejects(() => model.readProductExport(response), /CSV/);
      await assert.rejects(() => model.readProductExport(Response.json({ title: "Sem permissão para exportar" }, { status: 403 })), /Sem permissão para exportar/);
      const empty = await model.readProductExport(new Response(header + "\r\n", { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/csv" } }));
      assert.equal(empty.empty, true);
      assert.equal(await empty.blob.text(), header + "\r\n");
    });

    import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test"
    import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises"
    import { installFrontendFixture, tenant } from "./helpers/frontend-fixture"
    
    const header = "sku,name,unit,ncm,cest,base_price,status\r\n"
    const csv = header + 'LD-A1,"Árvore, ""academia""",UN,01010101,0012345,19419.84,active\r\nLD-A2,\'=SUM(A1:A2),UN,,,10.00,archived\r\n'
    const endpoint = /\/api\/erp\/products\/export(?:\?|$)/
    async function fixture(page: Page, permissions = ["catalog.products.export", "catalog.products.read"]) {
      const queries: URLSearchParams[] = []
      await page.route("**/api/erp/me", route => route.fulfill({ json: { tenant: { id: tenant }, permissions } }))
      await page.route(endpoint, route => { queries.push(new URL(route.request().url()).searchParams); return route.fulfill({ body: csv, headers: { "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8", "Content-Disposition": "attachment; filename=produtos.csv" } }) })
      return queries
    }
    
    for (const width of [320, 390, 430, 1366, 1440]) test(`exporta o CSV e preserva conteúdo e filtros em ${width}px`, async ({ context, page, baseURL }, info) => {
      await installFrontendFixture(context, baseURL)
      const queries = await fixture(page)
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
      await page.goto("/preferencias/dados/exportacao")
      await page.getByLabel("Buscar por SKU ou nome", { exact: true }).fill("  Academia  ")
      await page.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Situação", exact: true }).selectOption("active")
      const [download] = await Promise.all([page.waitForEvent("download"), page.getByRole("button", { name: "Baixar produtos.csv", exact: true }).click()])
      expect(download.suggestedFilename()).toBe("produtos.csv")
      expect(await readFile((await download.path())!, "utf8")).toBe(csv)

    export type CatalogQuery = { q: string; status: string; offset: number; categoryId?: string }
    export const catalogMaxOffset = 100_000
    
    export function catalogReturnHref(value: string | null) {
      if (!value?.startsWith("/cadastros/produtos?")) return "/cadastros/produtos"
      try {
        const url = new URL(value, "https://erp.local")
        return url.origin === "https://erp.local" && url.pathname === "/cadastros/produtos" ? url.pathname + url.search : "/cadastros/produtos"
      } catch { return "/cadastros/produtos" }
    }
    
    export function parseCatalogQuery(params: Pick<URLSearchParams, "get">, pageSize = 25): CatalogQuery {
      const q = (params.get("q") || "").trim().slice(0, 160)
      const rawStatus = params.get("status")
      const status = rawStatus === "active" || rawStatus === "archived" ? rawStatus : ""
      const rawOffset = params.get("offset") || "0"
      const number = /^\d{1,7}$/.test(rawOffset) ? Number(rawOffset) : 0
      const size = [10, 25, 50, 100].includes(pageSize) ? pageSize : 25
      const offset = number <= catalogMaxOffset ? Math.floor(number / size) * size : 0
      const categoryId = params.get("category_id") || ""
      return { q, status, offset, ...(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(categoryId) ? { categoryId } : {}) }
    }
    
    export function catalogQueryString(query: CatalogQuery) {
      const params = new URLSearchParams()
      if (query.q) params.set("q", query.q)
      if (query.status) params.set("status", query.status)
      if (query.categoryId) params.set("category_id", query.categoryId)
      if (query.offset) params.set("offset", String(query.offset))
      return params.toString()
    }

    import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test"
    import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises"
    import { installFrontendFixture, tenant } from "./helpers/frontend-fixture"
    
    const header = "sku,name,unit,ncm,cest,base_price,status\r\n"
    const csv = header + 'LD-A1,"Árvore, ""academia""",UN,01010101,0012345,19419.84,active\r\nLD-A2,\'=SUM(A1:A2),UN,,,10.00,archived\r\n'
    const endpoint = /\/api\/erp\/products\/export(?:\?|$)/
    async function fixture(page: Page, permissions = ["catalog.products.export", "catalog.products.read"]) {
      const queries: URLSearchParams[] = []
      await page.route("**/api/erp/me", route => route.fulfill({ json: { tenant: { id: tenant }, permissions } }))
      await page.route(endpoint, route => { queries.push(new URL(route.request().url()).searchParams); return route.fulfill({ body: csv, headers: { "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8", "Content-Disposition": "attachment; filename=produtos.csv" } }) })
      return queries
    }
    
    for (const width of [320, 390, 430, 1366, 1440]) test(`exporta o CSV e preserva conteúdo e filtros em ${width}px`, async ({ context, page, baseURL }, info) => {
      await installFrontendFixture(context, baseURL)
      const queries = await fixture(page)
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 })
      await page.goto("/preferencias/dados/exportacao")
      await page.getByLabel("Buscar por SKU ou nome", { exact: true }).fill("  Academia  ")
      await page.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Situação", exact: true }).selectOption("active")
      const [download] = await Promise.all([page.waitForEvent("download"), page.getByRole("button", { name: "Baixar produtos.csv", exact: true }).click()])
      expect(download.suggestedFilename()).toBe("produtos.csv")
      expect(await readFile((await download.path())!, "utf8")).toBe(csv)
      expect(queries.at(-1)?.get("q")).toBe("Academia")
      expect(queries.at(-1)?.get("status")).toBe("active")
      await expect(page.getByRole("status").filter({ hasText: "CSV enviado ao navegador" })).toBeVisible()
      await expect(page.getByRole("link", { name: "Conferir produtos no catálogo", exact: true })).toHaveAttribute("href", "/cadastros/produtos?q=Academia&status=active")
      expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth)).toBe(true)
      if (width < 500) expect((await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Baixar produtos.csv", exact: true }).boundingBox())!.height).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(44)
      await page.screenshot({ path: info.outputPath(`product-export-${width}.png`), fullPage: true })
    })
    
    test("geração congela os filtros que serão usados no arquivo", async ({ context, page, baseURL }) => {
      await installFrontendFixture(context, baseURL)
      await fixture(page)
      let release!: () => void
      const ready = new Promise<void>(resolve => { release = resolve })

      await page.goto("/preferencias/dados/exportacao")

    # Exportação de produtos confiável — Implementation Plan
    
    > For agentic workers: use superpowers:executing-plans, TDD and one independent final review before integration.
    
    **Goal:** Melhorar o fluxo existente de exportação, preservando filtros, identificando acesso/erros e entregando somente o CSV correto ao navegador.
    
    **Spec:** [AVL-380](https://linear.app/avilaops/issue/AVL-380) pede filtros efetivos, conteúdo/nome/MIME corretos, proteção de planilha e autorização/isolamento no backend. O código atual já possui GET /products/export com catalog.products.export, RLS por empresa e CSV escapado; não reimplementar. A aceitação autenticada continua distinta dos testes sintéticos.
    
    **Architecture:** Somente web e BFF. Manter dados e serialização CSV do backend. Conferir a permissão da sessão via /me, validar filtros e resposta CSV no cliente, guardar os filtros aplicados enquanto a operação estiver em andamento e permitir cancelamento. O BFF conserva o protocolo CSV e a identidade da sessão, sem aceitar empresa pelo navegador.
    
    ## Constraints / Review Focus
    
    - Não iniciar exportação sem acesso conferido; a autorização real permanece no endpoint existente.
    - Nome produtos.csv, MIME CSV e conteúdo devem corresponder ao contrato; JSON/HTML/arquivo vazio não viram download de sucesso.
    - CSV de apenas cabeçalho é válido e indica ausência de produtos no filtro. Não inventar contagem, histórico persistente ou conclusão de gravação em disco.
    - Manter os bytes/células do servidor, inclusive acentos, aspas, quebras de linha, zeros de códigos e fórmulas já neutralizadas. Não reformatar preços.
    - Filtros permanecem preservados em erro/repetição, ficam bloqueados durante a geração e correspondem ao arquivo entregue.
    - Cancelar/sair impede download tardio e não permite duas requisições concorrentes; usar a confirmação existente para links enquanto ocupado.
    - Distinguir erro de sessão/permissão/rede e manter acesso ao catálogo conforme permissão de leitura.
    - Validar desktop/celular em 320/390/430/1366/1440; alvos móveis de44px, teclado e ausência de rolagem lateral.
    - Sem exportação de dados reais como teste sem sessão autenticada autorizada; sem importação, alteração de produtos, envio de mensagens ou operação fiscal.
    - Sem mudança de status/comentário no Linear, nem alteração de API/banco. Build local/CI; publicação somente web, sem compilação em produção.

    export function productExportQuery(q: string, status: string) {
      const search = q.trim()
      if (Array.from(search).length > 160 || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(search)) throw Error("Use até 160 caracteres na busca, sem caracteres de controle.")
      if (!["", "active", "archived"].includes(status)) throw Error("Escolha uma situação válida para os produtos.")
      const params = new URLSearchParams()
      if (search) params.set("q", search)
      if (status) params.set("status", status)
      return `/api/erp/products/export${params.size ? `?${params}` : ""}`
    }
    
    export async function readProductExport(response: Response) {
      if (!response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json().catch(() => null)
        throw Error(typeof data?.title === "string" ? data.title : "Não foi possível gerar o CSV. Tente novamente.")
      }
      if (response.headers.get("content-type")?.split(";")[0].trim().toLowerCase() !== "text/csv") throw Error("O serviço não retornou um arquivo CSV. Tente novamente.")
      const bytes = await response.arrayBuffer()
      let text: string
      try { text = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes) } catch { throw Error("O arquivo CSV não está em UTF-8 válido.") }
      const end = text.indexOf("\n")
      const header = (end < 0 ? text : text.slice(0, end)).replace(/\r$/, "")
      if (header !== "sku,name,unit,ncm,cest,base_price,status") throw Error("O arquivo CSV não corresponde ao formato esperado. Tente novamente.")
      return { blob: new Blob([bytes], { type: "text/csv; charset=utf-8" }), empty: end < 0 || !text.slice(end + 1).trim() }
    }

    import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, type ComponentProps, type ReactNode } from "react"
    
    type Guard = () => string | null
    type NavigationGuard = { register: (guard: Guard) => () => void; confirmNavigation: () => boolean; allowNextUnload: () => () => void }
    const NavigationGuardContext = createContext<NavigationGuard>({ register: () => () => {}, confirmNavigation: () => true, allowNextUnload: () => () => {} })
    
    export function NavigationGuardProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
      const activeGuard = useRef<Guard | null>(null)
      const approvedUnload = useRef(false)
      const allowNextUnload = useCallback(() => {
        approvedUnload.current = true
        return () => { approvedUnload.current = false }
      }, [])
      const register = useCallback((guard: Guard) => {
        activeGuard.current = guard
        return () => { if (activeGuard.current === guard) activeGuard.current = null }
      }, [])
      const confirmNavigation = useCallback(() => {
        const message = activeGuard.current?.()
        return !message || window.confirm(message)
      }, [])
      useEffect(() => {
        const beforeUnload = (event: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
          if (approvedUnload.current) { approvedUnload.current = false; return }
          if (activeGuard.current?.()) { event.preventDefault(); event.returnValue = "" }
        }
        window.addEventListener("beforeunload", beforeUnload)
        return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", beforeUnload)
      }, [])
      const value = useMemo(() => ({ register, confirmNavigation, allowNextUnload }), [register, confirmNavigation, allowNextUnload])
      return <NavigationGuardContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</NavigationGuardContext.Provider>
    }
    
    export function useNavigationGuard(message: string | null) {
      const { register } = useContext(NavigationGuardContext)
      useEffect(() => register(() => message), [message, register])
    }
    
    export function useConfirmNavigation() {
      return useContext(NavigationGuardContext).confirmNavigation
    }
    
    export function useAllowNextUnload() {
      return useContext(NavigationGuardContext).allowNextUnload
    }
    
    export function GuardedLink({ onNavigate, ...props }: ComponentProps<typeof NextLink>) {
      const confirmNavigation = useConfirmNavigation()
      const pathname = usePathname()
      const search = useSearchParams()
      const href = typeof props.href === "string" ? listNavigationHref(props.href, pathname, search.toString()) : props.href
      return <NextLink {...props} href={href} onNavigate={event => {
        if (!confirmNavigation()) { event.preventDefault(); return }
        onNavigate?.(event)
      }} />
    }

      const body = await response.text()
      if (!body.trim()) throw new Error("O ERP retornou uma resposta vazia. Atualize o serviço e tente novamente.")
      try { return JSON.parse(body) } catch { throw new Error("O ERP retornou uma resposta inválida. Tente novamente.") }
    }
    
    function message(value: unknown, fallback: string) {
      return typeof (value as ApiProblem | null)?.title === "string" ? (value as ApiProblem).title as string : fallback
    }
    
    export function useResource<T>(url: string) {
      const [state, setState] = useState<{ url: string; value: T | null; etag: string; error: string; pending: boolean; status: number }>({ url, value: null, etag: "", error: "", pending: true, status: 0 })
      const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0)
      useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController()
        let status = 0
        erpFetch(url, { cache: "no-store", signal: controller.signal }).then(async response => {
          status = response.status
          const value = await readJson(response)
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(message(value, "Consulta indisponível"))
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) setState({ url, value: value as T, etag: response.headers.get("etag") || "", error: "", pending: false, status })
        }).catch(reason => {
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) setState({ url, value: null, etag: "", error: reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Consulta indisponível", pending: false, status })
        })
        return () => controller.abort()
      }, [url, revision])
      function reload() { setState(previous => ({ ...previous, pending: true })); setRevision(value => value + 1) }
      return { value: state.url === url ? state.value : null, etag: state.url === url ? state.etag : "", loading: state.url !== url || state.pending, error: state.url === url ? state.error : "", status: state.url === url ? state.status : 0, reload }
    }
    
    type Command = { url: string; tenant: string; body: string; etag: string; key: string; method: "POST" | "PUT" }
    
    export function useCommand() {
      const current = useRef<Command | null>(null)
      const running = useRef(false)
      const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
      const [uncertain, setUncertain] = useState(false)
      const [stale, setStale] = useState(false)
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const [status, setStatus] = useState(0)
    
      async function send<T>(url: string, tenant: string, body: object, etag = "", method: "POST" | "PUT" = "POST"): Promise<T | null> {
        if (running.current || stale) return null
        running.current = true; setBusy(true); setError(""); setStatus(0)
        if (!uncertain) current.current = { url, tenant, body: JSON.stringify(body), etag, key: crypto.randomUUID(), method }
        const command = current.current!
        try {
          const response = await erpFetch(command.url, {
            method: command.method,
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Tenant-Id": command.tenant, "Idempotency-Key": command.key, ...(command.etag ? { "If-Match": command.etag } : {}) },
            body: command.body,
          })
          setStatus(response.status)
          const value = await readJson(response)
          if (!response.ok) {
            setUncertain(response.status >= 500); setStale(response.status === 412)
            setError(message(value, "Operação recusada"))
            return null
          }
          if (!response.headers.get("etag")) throw new Error("Confirmação sem revisão")
          current.current = null; setUncertain(false)
          return value as T
        } catch {
          setUncertain(true); setError("Não foi possível confirmar o resultado. Repita a confirmação com o mesmo comando.")
          return null
        } finally { running.current = false; setBusy(false) }
      }
      function reset() { if (!uncertain && !running.current) { current.current = null; setStale(false); setError("") } }
      return { send, reset, busy, uncertain, stale, error, status }
    }
    
    export function quantity(raw: string) {
      return normalizeDecimal(raw, 6)
    }

    ---
    name: executing-plans
    description: Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available
    ---
    
    # Executing Plans
    
    Execute the plan yourself, task by task, in this session: no implementer
    subagent per task, no reviewer per task. One fresh-context review of the
    whole branch at the end.
    
    **Why inline:** Subagent-driven development pays for a fresh implementer
    and a fresh reviewer on every task, each re-reading the codebase from zero.
    Inline execution pays for one context (yours) plus one reviewer at the end.
    What it gives up is a fresh context per task and a second pair of eyes per
    task. This skill keeps what those two things bought, by other means: the
    brief is the spec, the ledger is your memory, TDD is the per-task gate, and
    the final reviewer is the second pair of eyes.
    
    **Core principle:** The plan already did the thinking. Execute it exactly,
    prove each step with a test you watched fail and then pass, and leave a
    record that survives your own forgetting.
    
    **Narration:** between tool calls, narrate at most one short line — the
    ledger and the tool results carry the record.
    
    **Continuous execution:** Do not pause to check in with your human partner
    between tasks. They chose inline execution to spend less, not to answer
    "should I continue?" after every task. Execute all tasks from the plan
    without stopping.
    
    **Rulings, not stalls.** Conflicts, ambiguities, plan defects — decide them.
    The spec is the binding authority, the plan is its argument, and your
    judgment settles what neither answers. Record every decision in the ledger
    as `Ruling: <what you decided> — <why> — <what it costs if wrong>`, and keep
    going. Deviating from the plan without a ledgered ruling is a decision made
    in secret.
    
    Four things stop you, and only these: an irreversible or destructive
    operation; a security-sensitive action; a side effect outside this worktree
    that norms say you ask about first (a merge, a push to a shared branch, a
    publish); and a plan so broken that every path forward is a guess. For
    those, stop and ask.
    
    ## When to Use
    
    - You have a plan from superpowers:writing-plans and your human partner
      chose inline execution at the handoff.
    - Your harness has no subagent tool (see the per-platform references in
      `../using-superpowers/references/`). Never fabricate a dispatch; run
      the plan here.
    - Tasks are mostly independent — the same precondition as
      superpowers:subagent-driven-development.
    
    A fully specified plan makes inline execution transcription plus testing:
    it runs well on a mid-tier session model, and the one place the most
    capable model earns its cost is the final review, which this skill
    dispatches separately. Tell your human partner so when they choose inline.
    
    Prefer superpowers:subagent-driven-development when your human partner
    wants a review gate on every task, or when the plan is long enough that
    its later tasks would run on a compacted context. Inline execution over a
    long plan still works — the ledger is what makes it recoverable — but the
    last tasks get the least of you.
    
    ## The Process
    
    ```dot
    digraph process {
        rankdir=TB;
    
        subgraph cluster_per_task {
            label="Per Task";
            "task-start: brief + BASE; read the brief" [shape=box];
            "Work the steps in order: TDD, run every verification, read every output" [shape=box];
            "Step output matches plan's Expected?" [shape=diamond];
            "Plan wrong? Rule and ledger. Code wrong? systematic-debugging" [shape=box];
            "Commit as the plan's commit steps say" [shape=box];
            "Completion contract met?" [shape=diamond];
            "task-done: run tests, ledger the result; mark todo complete" [shape=box];
        }
    
        "Setup: worktree, workspace + ledger, read plan + spec, pre-flight scan" [shape=box];
        "More tasks remain?" [shape=diamond];
        "Final whole-branch review (fresh reviewer if you have one)" [shape=box];
        "Re-grade, then: Critical/Important → ONE fix pass, each fix RED→GREEN + green suite; Minor → ledger" [shape=box];
        "Final review clean: delete this plan's workspace" [shape=box];
        "Use superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch" [shape=box style=filled fillcolor=lightgreen];
    
        "Setup: worktree, workspace + ledger, read plan + spec, pre-flight scan" -> "task-start: brief + BASE; read the brief";
        "task-start: brief + BASE; read the brief" -> "Work the steps in order: TDD, run every verification, read every output";
        "Work the steps in order: TDD, run every verification, read every output" -> "Step output matches plan's Expected?";
        "Step output matches plan's Expected?" -> "Plan wrong? Rule and ledger. Code wrong? systematic-debugging" [label="no"];
        "Plan wrong? Rule and ledger. Code wrong? systematic-debugging" -> "Work the steps in order: TDD, run every verification, read every output";
        "Step output matches plan's Expected?" -> "Commit as the plan's commit steps say" [label="yes, last step"];
        "Commit as the plan's commit steps say" -> "Completion contract met?";
        "Completion contract met?" -> "Work the steps in order: TDD, run every verification, read every output" [label="no - finish the task"];
        "Completion contract met?" -> "task-done: run tests, ledger the result; mark todo complete" [label="yes"];
        "task-done: run tests, ledger the result; mark todo complete" -> "More tasks remain?";
        "More tasks remain?" -> "task-start: brief + BASE; read the brief" [label="yes"];
        "More tasks remain?" -> "Final whole-branch review (fresh reviewer if you have one)" [label="no"];
        "Final whole-branch review (fresh reviewer if you have one)" -> "Re-grade, then: Critical/Important → ONE fix pass, each fix RED→GREEN + green suite; Minor → ledger";
        "Re-grade, then: Critical/Important → ONE fix pass, each fix RED→GREEN + green suite; Minor → ledger" -> "Final review clean: delete this plan's workspace";
        "Final review clean: delete this plan's workspace" -> "Use superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch";
    }
    ```
    
    ## Setup
    
    Ensure the work happens in an isolated workspace: use
    superpowers:using-git-worktrees to create one or verify the existing one.
    Never start implementation on a main/master branch without your human
    partner's explicit consent.
    
    Conversation memory does not survive compaction. An inline executor that
    loses its place re-implements tasks whose commits already exist — the same
    failure as a controller re-dispatching them, paid for in your own context.
    Track progress in a ledger file, not only in todos. Harness todos are a
    live view; the ledger is the record.
    
    The workspace and ledger are shared with superpowers:subagent-driven-development
    — same directory, same format — so a plan can change executors mid-flight
    and the new one resumes from the same ledger.
    
    - Each plan owns a workspace: at skill start, run
      `../subagent-driven-development/scripts/sdd-workspace PLAN_FILE` — it
      prints the plan's git-ignored directory
      (`<repo-root>/.superpowers/sdd/<plan-basename>/`), home to every
      artifact for THIS plan: ledger, briefs, review packages. Another plan's
      directory is never yours to read or write.
    - Check for this plan's ledger at `<workspace>/progress.md`. If its first
      line names your plan file, tasks with a `Task <N>: complete` line are
      DONE — do not redo them; resume at the first task without one. Their
      commits exist in git even when your context no longer remembers making
      them: after compaction, trust the ledger and `git log` over your own
      recollection. A ledger whose first line names a different plan file is
      another plan's progress: leave it and start your own, fresh.
    - Create the ledger with its identity as the first line:
      `# SDD ledger — plan: <plan file path>`.
    - `git clean -fdx` will destroy the workspace (it's git-ignored scratch);
      if that happens, recover from `git log`.
    
    Read the plan once, note its context and Global Constraints, and create a
    todo per task. If the plan names a Spec, read that too: the spec is the
    authority the plan argues from, and conflicts inside the plan resolve
    against it. A plan with no reachable spec gets a ledger note saying so —
    rulings made without one are provisional.
    
    **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** load superpowers:test-driven-development now,
    before Task 1. It governs every step of every task below; a plan whose
    steps already say "write the failing test first" does not exempt you
    from reading it.
    
    Before Task 1, scan the plan for conflicts between tasks. The plan's
    Interfaces blocks tell you where to look: for every task that consumes
    what an earlier task produces, one ledger row — the two tasks, what one
    produces against what the other consumes, and what you found. Tasks that
    share nothing get no row; a plan whose tasks share nothing gets the single
    line `Pre-flight: no shared interfaces`. Rule on each conflict a row
    surfaces with the spec as the binding authority, record the ruling beside
    its row, and start Task 1. Each task's own text is checked when you read
    its brief, not here.
    
    ## The Task Loop
    
    Everything you print, and every tool result, stays resident in your
    context for the rest of the session. Redirect long test output to a file
    in the workspace and read its tail; read a brief, not the whole plan.
    
    ### 1. Take the task
    
    - Run this skill's `scripts/task-start PLAN_FILE N`. It prints the brief
      path and BASE (the commit the task's range is cut from) in one call.
      Read the brief for every task, including ones you remember from setup:
      what you remember is a summary, the brief has the exact values,
      signatures, and test cases.
    - Mark the task's todo in_progress.
    
    Every tool call is a turn that re-reads your whole context. Bookkeeping
    rides along with work — a ledger append in the same call as the commit,
    never in a call of its own.
    
    ### 2. Work the steps
    
    The plan's steps are already in RED-GREEN order; follow them in that
    order under superpowers:test-driven-development, loaded at setup. A test
    step's code is written first and run first. Watching it fail is a step,
    not a formality — a test that passes before the implementation exists is
    a finding about the test.
    
    Every step that runs a command has an `Expected:` line. Run the command,
    read its output, and compare. Three outcomes:
    
    - **Matches.** Next step.
    - **The code is wrong.** Use superpowers:systematic-debugging. Find the
      cause; never patch the symptom to make the step's output match.
    - **The plan is wrong** — a step contradicts the spec, an interface from an
      earlier task doesn't match what this task consumes, a command that
      cannot work. Rule on the smallest change that satisfies the spec, ledger
      it as `Task <N>: Ruling: <finding> — <what you decided and why>`, and
    ✓ • 276ms

    import { productExportQuery, readProductExport } from "./product-export-model"
    
    type Access = { tenant?: { id: string } | null; permissions?: string[] }
    
    export function DataExport() {
      return <Suspense fallback={<main className="p-4" role="status">Conferindo acesso…</main>}><ProductExportForm /></Suspense>
    }
    
    function ProductExportForm() {
      const access = useResource<Access>("/api/erp/me")
      const [q, setQ] = useState("")
      const [status, setStatus] = useState("")
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const [responseStatus, setResponseStatus] = useState(0)
      const [message, setMessage] = useState("")
      const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
      const active = useRef<AbortController | null>(null)
      const live = useRef(false)
      const searchInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
      const ready = !access.loading && !access.error && !!access.value?.tenant?.id
      const canExport = ready && !!access.value?.permissions?.includes("catalog.products.export")
      const canReadCatalog = ready && !!access.value?.permissions?.includes("catalog.products.read")
      let previewHref: string | null = null
      try { previewHref = productExportQuery(q, status).replace("/api/erp/products/export", "/cadastros/produtos") } catch { /* Invalid filters are explained on submit. */ }
    
      useEffect(() => {
        live.current = true
        return () => { live.current = false; active.current?.abort(); active.current = null }
      }, [])
      useNavigationGuard(busy ? "Sair antes de concluir o download dos produtos?" : null)
    
      function clearFeedback() { setError(""); setMessage(""); setResponseStatus(0) }
      function refreshAccess() { if (!active.current) { clearFeedback(); access.reload() } }
      async function download() {
        if (active.current || !canExport) return
        clearFeedback()
        let url: string
        try { url = productExportQuery(q, status) } catch (cause) {
          setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Confira os filtros.")
          searchInput.current?.focus()
          return
        }
        const controller = new AbortController()
        active.current = controller
        setBusy(true)
        let requestStatus = 0
        try {
          const response = await erpFetch(url, { signal: controller.signal })
          requestStatus = response.status
          const file = await readProductExport(response)
          if (!live.current || controller.signal.aborted || active.current !== controller) return
          const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file.blob)
          const anchor = document.createElement("a")
          anchor.href = objectUrl
          anchor.download = "produtos.csv"
          document.body.appendChild(anchor)
          try { anchor.click() } finally { anchor.remove(); window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl), 1000) }
          setMessage(file.empty ? "CSV enviado ao navegador. Nenhum produto corresponde aos filtros; o arquivo contém apenas cabeçalhos." : "CSV enviado ao navegador. Confira o download de produtos.csv.")
        } catch (cause) {
          if (!live.current || active.current !== controller) return
          if (controller.signal.aborted) setMessage("Download cancelado. Os filtros foram preservados.")
          else { setResponseStatus(requestStatus); setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Não foi possível gerar o CSV. Tente novamente.") }
        } finally {
          if (live.current && active.current === controller) { active.current = null; setBusy(false) }
        }
      }
    
      return <main className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-3 p-4 [--workspace-control-height:44px] sm:[--workspace-control-height:36px]">

        <form className="space-y-3 rounded-lg border bg-card p-3" onSubmit={event => { event.preventDefault(); void download() }}>
          <fieldset disabled={busy} className="grid min-w-0 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <label className="grid gap-1 text-sm font-medium">Buscar por SKU ou nome<Input ref={searchInput} type="search" maxLength={160} value={q} onChange={event => { setQ(event.target.value); clearFeedback() }} /></label>
            <label className="grid gap-1 text-sm font-medium">Situação<select className="h-11 w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 text-base disabled:opacity-50 sm:h-9 sm:text-sm" value={status} onChange={event => { setStatus(event.target.value); clearFeedback() }}><option value="">Todas</option><option value="active">Ativos</option><option value="archived">Arquivados</option></select></label>
          </fieldset>
          {access.loading ? <p role="status" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Conferindo acesso…</p> : access.error || !access.value?.tenant?.id ? <div role="alert" className="space-y-2 text-sm [&_a]:inline-flex [&_a]:min-h-11 [&_a]:items-center">
            <RequestError message={access.error || "Selecione uma empresa para exportar produtos."} status={access.status} />
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={refreshAccess}>Conferir acesso</Button>
          </div> : !canExport ? <div className="space-y-2 text-sm"><p>Seu acesso não permite exportar produtos. Solicite a permissão à gestão.</p><Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={refreshAccess}>Conferir acesso</Button></div> : null}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Button type="submit" disabled={busy || !canExport}>{busy ? "Gerando CSV…" : "Baixar produtos.csv"}</Button>
            {busy && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { active.current?.abort(); setMessage("Download cancelado. Os filtros foram preservados.") }}>Cancelar download</Button>}
          </div>
          {busy && <p role="status" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Gerando arquivo com os filtros escolhidos…</p>}
          {error && <div role="alert" className="space-y-2 text-sm text-destructive [&_a]:inline-flex [&_a]:min-h-11 [&_a]:items-center"><RequestError message={error} status={responseStatus} />{[401, 403].includes(responseStatus) && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={refreshAccess}>Conferir acesso</Button>}</div>}
          {message && <p role="status" className="rounded-md border p-3 text-sm">{message}</p>}
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">CSV UTF-8 com os filtros escolhidos. O navegador recebe o arquivo para você salvar.</p>
          <nav aria-label="Navegação da exportação" className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 text-sm">
            {canReadCatalog && previewHref && <Link className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center text-primary underline" href={previewHref} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Conferir produtos no catálogo</Link>}
            <Link className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center text-primary underline" href="/preferencias?categoria=exportacao">Voltar às preferências</Link>
          </nav>
        </form>
      </main>
    }

    import type { ApiPath, JsonBody, JsonReply } from "./types"
    
    export function erpFetch(resource: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
      if (!resource.startsWith("/api/erp/") || resource.includes("\\") || resource.includes("#")) {
        return Promise.reject(new Error("Recurso do ERP inválido"))
      }
      return fetch(resource, { cache: "no-store", ...init, credentials: "same-origin" })
    }
    
    export async function readApi<Path extends ApiPath>(
      path: Path, signal?: AbortSignal,
    ): Promise<{ data: JsonReply<Path, "get" & keyof import("./generated").paths[Path]>; etag: string }> {
      const response = await erpFetch(path.replace("/api/v1/", "/api/erp/"), { signal })
      const data = await response.json()
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.title || "Consulta indisponível")
      return { data, etag: response.headers.get("etag") || "" }
    }

    ---
    title: use client
    description: Learn how to use the use client directive to render a component on the client.
    ---
    
    The `'use client'` directive declares an entry point for the components to be rendered on the **client side** and should be used when creating interactive user interfaces (UI) that require client-side JavaScript capabilities, such as state management, event handling, and access to browser APIs. This is a React feature.
    
    > **Good to know:**
    >
    > You do not need to add the `'use client'` directive to every file that contains Client Components. You only need to add it to the files whose components you want to render directly within Server Components. The `'use client'` directive defines the [server and client boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary), and the components exported from such a file serve as entry points to the client.
    
    ## Usage
    
    To declare an entry point for the Client Components, add the `'use client'` directive **at the top of the file**, before any imports. The directive applies to the entire module and cannot be placed inside a component or function:
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/components/counter.js" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    When using the `'use client'` directive, the props of the Client Components must be [serializable](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client#serializable-types). This means the props need to be in a format that React can serialize when sending data from the server to the client.
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={4} switcher
    'use client'
    
    export default function Counter({
      onClick /* ❌ Function is not serializable */,
    }) {
      return (
        <div>
          <button onClick={onClick}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/components/counter.js" highlight={4} switcher
    'use client'
    
    export default function Counter({
      onClick /* ❌ Function is not serializable */,
    }) {
      return (
        <div>
          <button onClick={onClick}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```

    """Package compiled Windows Next output with existing Linux runtime dependencies."""
    import io, json, pathlib, re, sys, tarfile, os
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
    
    workspace = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
    dist = workspace / 'apps/web/.next-commercial-release'
    standalone = dist / 'standalone/apps/web'
    original = (standalone / 'server.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    match = re.search(r'^const nextConfig = (.+)$', original, re.M)
    if not match: raise RuntimeError('Standalone config missing')
    config = json.loads(match.group(1))
    def rebase(value):
        if isinstance(value, dict): return {k: rebase(v) for k,v in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, list): return [rebase(v) for v in value]
        if isinstance(value, str):
            normalized = value.replace('\\','/')
            root = workspace.as_posix()
            if normalized.lower().startswith(root.lower()): return '/app' + normalized[len(root):]
        return value
    config = rebase(config)
    config['distDir'] = './.next'
    config['distDirRoot'] = '.next'
    server = original[:match.start(1)] + json.dumps(config,separators=(',',':')) + original[match.end(1):]
    output = workspace / 'artifacts' / ('commercial-web-' + sys.argv[1][:12] + '.tar.gz')
    entries = 0
    with tarfile.open(output,'w:gz',compresslevel=6) as archive:
        def add_bytes(name, data):
            global entries
            item = tarfile.TarInfo(name); item.size=len(data); item.mode=0o644
            archive.addfile(item,io.BytesIO(data)); entries+=1
        add_bytes('apps/web/server.js',server.encode())
        add_bytes('apps/web/package.json',(workspace/'apps/web/package.json').read_bytes())
        def add_tree(source, prefix):
            paths=[]
            for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(source, followlinks=False):
                dirs[:]=[name for name in dirs if name not in {'node_modules','cache','dev','.git'} and not name.startswith('.env')]
                paths.extend(pathlib.Path(directory)/name for name in files if not name.startswith('.env'))
            def read(path):
                if path.is_symlink(): raise RuntimeError('Unexpected bundle symlink')
                raw = path.read_bytes()
                if path.name=='required-server-files.json':
                    manifest=rebase(json.loads(raw)); manifest['config']=config
                    raw=json.dumps(manifest,separators=(',',':')).encode()
                return path,raw
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
                for path, raw in pool.map(read, paths, buffersize=32):
                    add_bytes(prefix+'/'+path.relative_to(source).as_posix(),raw)
        add_tree(standalone/config.get('distDirRoot','.next'),'apps/web/.next') if (standalone/'.next').exists() else add_tree(standalone/'.next-commercial-release','apps/web/.next')
        add_tree(dist/'static','apps/web/.next/static')
        add_tree(workspace/'apps/web/public','apps/web/public')
    print(json.dumps({'archive':str(output),'bytes':output.stat().st_size,'files':entries}))

    name: CI
    
    on:
      pull_request:
      workflow_dispatch:
    
    permissions:
      contents: read
    
    concurrency:
      group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    
    env:
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
    
    jobs:
      changes:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 2
        outputs:
          web: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.web }}
          api: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.api }}
          fiscal: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.fiscal }}
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              fetch-depth: 0
          - run: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p 'test_*.py'
          - id: scope
            env:
              BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || format('{0}^', github.sha) }}
            run: python3 -B scripts/ci/pr-gate.py plan
    
      web:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.web == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
            with:
              version: 11.11.0
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
              cache: pnpm
              cache-dependency-path: pnpm-lock.yaml
          - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline
          - run: pnpm --filter web lint
          - run: node --import ./tests/helpers/register-typescript.mjs --test tests/*-model.node.mjs
            working-directory: apps/web
    
      api:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.api == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 20
        services:
          postgres:
            image: postgres:18-alpine
            env:
              POSTGRES_DB: erp_next_test
              POSTGRES_USER: postgres
              POSTGRES_PASSWORD: erp_next_ci_only
            ports:
              - 5432:5432
            options: >-
              --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d erp_next_test"
              --health-interval 2s
              --health-timeout 3s
              --health-retries 20
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:erp_next_ci_only@127.0.0.1:5432/erp_next_test
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.1
            with:
              components: rustfmt
          - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
            with:
              shared-key: pr-api
          - run: cargo fmt --all --check
          - run: cargo test --workspace --locked -- --test-threads=2
    
      fiscal:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.fiscal == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
              cache: npm
              cache-dependency-path: apps/fiscal-engine/package-lock.json
          - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
          - run: npm test
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
          - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
            with:
              version: 0.12.24
          - run: uv sync --frozen --extra dev --python 3.12
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-mcp
          - run: uv run --frozen --extra dev pytest tests/test_fiscal_schema.py tests/test_simplified_danfe.py tests/test_nfe_assinatura.py
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-mcp
    
      gate:
        needs: [changes, web, api, fiscal]
        if: always()
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 2
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - name: Validate selected checks and record explicit skips
            env:
              SOURCE_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
              VALIDATION_JOBS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
            run: python3 -B scripts/ci/pr-gate.py gate artifacts/mlops/ci-attestation.json
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            if: always()
            with:
              name: erp-mlops-ci-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
              path: artifacts/mlops/ci-attestation.json
              if-no-files-found: error
              retention-days: 14

    name: using-superpowers
    description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions
    ---
    
    <SUBAGENT-STOP>
    If you were dispatched as a subagent to execute a specific task, ignore this skill.
    </SUBAGENT-STOP>
    
    <EXTREMELY-IMPORTANT>
    If you think there is even a 1% chance a skill might apply to what you are doing, you ABSOLUTELY MUST invoke the skill.
    
    IF A SKILL APPLIES TO YOUR TASK, YOU DO NOT HAVE A CHOICE. YOU MUST USE IT.
    
    This is not negotiable. You cannot rationalize your way out of this.
    </EXTREMELY-IMPORTANT>
    
    ## The Rule
    
    **Invoke relevant or requested skills BEFORE any response or action** — including clarifying questions, exploring the codebase, or checking files. If it turns out wrong for the situation, you don't have to use it.
    
    **Before entering plan mode:** if you haven't already brainstormed, invoke the brainstorming skill first.
    
    Then announce "Using [skill] to [purpose]" and follow the skill exactly. If it has a checklist, create a todo per item.
    
    ## Skill Priority
    
    When multiple skills apply, process skills come first — they set the approach, then implementation skills (frontend-design, etc.) carry it out. Brainstorming and systematic-debugging are Superpowers' most common process skills, but the rule holds for any of them.
    
    - "Let's build X" → superpowers:brainstorming first, then implementation skills.
    - "Fix this bug" → superpowers:systematic-debugging first, then domain skills.
    
    ## Red Flags
    
    These thoughts mean STOP—you're rationalizing:
    
    | Thought | Reality |
    |---------|---------|
    | "This is just a simple question" | Questions are tasks. Check for skills. |
    | "I need more context first" | Skill check comes BEFORE clarifying questions. |
    | "Let me explore the codebase first" | Skills tell you HOW to explore. Check first. |
    | "I can check git/files quickly" | Files lack conversation context. Check for skills. |
    | "Let me gather information first" | Skills tell you HOW to gather information. |
    | "This doesn't need a formal skill" | If a skill exists, use it. |
    | "I remember this skill" | Skills evolve. Read current version. |
    | "This doesn't count as a task" | Action = task. Check for skills. |
    | "The skill is overkill" | Simple things become complex. Use it. |
    | "I'll just do this one thing first" | Check BEFORE doing anything. |
    | "This feels productive" | Undisciplined action wastes time. Skills prevent this. |
    | "I know what that means" | Knowing the concept ≠ using the skill. Invoke it. |
    
    ## Platform Adaptation
    
    If your harness appears here, read its reference file for special instructions:
    
    - Claude Code: `references/claude-code-tools.md`

    ## User Instructions
    
    User instructions (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, etc, direct requests) take precedence over skills, which in turn override default behavior. Only skip skill workflows or instructions when your human partner has explicitly told you to.
