    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct MediaGateway {
        client: reqwest::Client,
        origin: String,
        token: String,
        tenant: Uuid,
    }
    impl MediaGateway {
        pub(super) async fn upload(
            &self,
            key: &str,
            media_type: &str,
            sha: &str,
            bytes: Vec<u8>,
        ) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
            let path = key
                .strip_prefix("ludus/catalogo/uploads/")
                .ok_or(DomainError::Invalid("Localizador de imagem inválido"))?;
            let result = self
                .client
                .put(format!("{}/midias/_upload/{path}", self.origin))
                .bearer_auth(&self.token)
                .header("Content-Type", media_type)
                .header("X-Content-Sha256", sha)
                .body(bytes)
                .send()
                .await
                .map_err(|_| {
                    DomainError::Conflict("Envio não confirmado; a versão anterior foi preservada")
                })?;
            if !result.status().is_success() {
                return Err(DomainError::Conflict(
                    "Não foi possível registrar a foto no R2",
                ));
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        pub fn from_env() -> anyhow::Result<Option<Self>> {
            let Ok(origin) = std::env::var("CATALOG_MEDIA_ORIGIN") else {
                return Ok(None);
            };
            let url = reqwest::Url::parse(&origin)?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                url.scheme() == "https"
                    && url.host_str() == Some("ludusequipamentos.com")
                    && url.path() == "/",
                "Invalid catalog origin"
            );
            let token = std::env::var("CATALOG_MEDIA_TOKEN")?;
            anyhow::ensure!(token.len() >= 32, "Catalog credential too short");
            Ok(Some(Self {
                client: reqwest::Client::builder()
                    .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(20))
                    .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
                    .build()?,
                origin: origin.trim_end_matches('/').to_string(),
                token,
                tenant: std::env::var("CATALOG_MEDIA_TENANT")?.parse()?,
            }))
        }
        fn for_tenant(state: &AppState, tenant: Uuid) -> Result<&Self, DomainError> {
            state
                .catalog_media
                .as_ref()
                .filter(|g| g.tenant == tenant)
                .ok_or(DomainError::Conflict(
                    "Publicação não configurada para esta empresa",
                ))
        }
    }

    pub struct CatalogSource {

        pub url: String,

        pub printed_page: Option<u32>,
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone, Deserialize, Serialize, ToSchema)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase", deny_unknown_fields)]
    pub struct CatalogProfileInput {
        pub collection: String,
        pub muscle_group: String,
        pub technical_category: String,
        pub dimensions_mm: [i32; 3],
        pub description: String,
        pub weight: String,
        pub weight_stack: String,
        pub main_media_id: Option<Uuid>,
        /// Omission preserves metadata written by newer clients; empty clears it.
        pub manufacturer: Option<String>,
        pub manufacturer_model: Option<String>,
        pub catalog_product_name: Option<String>,
        pub live_area: Option<String>,
        pub catalog_sources: Option<Vec<CatalogSource>>,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub new_image: Option<String>,
    }
    impl CatalogProfileInput {
        fn validate(&mut self) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
            if !["core", "premium"].contains(&self.collection.as_str())
                || [&self.muscle_group, &self.technical_category]
                    .iter()
                    .any(|s| s.trim().is_empty() || s.chars().count() > 80)
                || self.dimensions_mm.iter().any(|v| !(1..=50000).contains(v))
                || self.description.chars().count() > 4000
                || self.weight.chars().count() > 80
                || self.weight_stack.chars().count() > 80
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Confira linha, grupo e dimensões em milímetros",
                ));
            }
            for (value, limit) in [
                (&mut self.manufacturer, 80),
                (&mut self.manufacturer_model, 80),
                (&mut self.catalog_product_name, 200),
                (&mut self.live_area, 200),
            ] {
                if let Some(value) = value {
                    *value = value.trim().to_owned();
                    if value.chars().count() > limit || value.chars().any(char::is_control) {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Confira os dados do fabricante"));
                    }
                }
            }
            if let Some(sources) = &mut self.catalog_sources {
                if sources.len() > 10 {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Cadastre até dez fontes do catálogo"));
                }
                for source in sources {
                    source.title = source.title.trim().to_owned();
                    source.url = source.url.trim().to_owned();
                    let url = reqwest::Url::parse(&source.url)
                        .map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("Informe uma fonte HTTPS válida"))?;
                    if source.title.is_empty()
                        || source.title.chars().count() > 160
                        || source.title.chars().any(char::is_control)
                        || source.url.len() > 2048
                        || url.scheme() != "https"
                        || url.host_str().is_none()
                        || !url.username().is_empty()
                        || url.password().is_some()
                        || [source.pdf_page, source.printed_page]
                            .into_iter()
                            .flatten()
                            .any(|page| !(1..=10000).contains(&page))
                    {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                            "Confira título, endereço HTTPS e páginas da fonte",
                        ));
                    }
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    CREATE TABLE product_catalog_profiles (
        tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
        product_id uuid NOT NULL,
        revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0),
        collection text NOT NULL CHECK (collection IN ('core','premium')),
        muscle_group text NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(muscle_group) BETWEEN 1 AND 80),
        technical_category text NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(technical_category) BETWEEN 1 AND 80),
        dimensions_mm integer[] NOT NULL CHECK (array_length(dimensions_mm,1)=3 AND 0 < ALL(dimensions_mm) AND 50000 >= ALL(dimensions_mm)),
        description text NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(description)<=4000),
        weight text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (char_length(weight)<=80),
        weight_stack text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (char_length(weight_stack)<=80),
        public_path text NOT NULL CHECK (public_path ~ '^/(core|loja)/[a-z0-9-]+/$'),
        main_media_id uuid NOT NULL,
        updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,product_id),
        UNIQUE(tenant_id,public_path),
        FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,product_id) REFERENCES products(tenant_id,id),
        FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,main_media_id) REFERENCES product_media_assets(tenant_id,id)
    );
    CREATE TABLE catalog_publications (

        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

        PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,id)
    );

    export async function validateOpenApi(document) {
      try {
        await SwaggerParser.validate(structuredClone(document), {
          resolve: { file: false, http: false },
          dereference: { circular: 'ignore' },
        });
      } catch (error) {
        const failure = new Error('INVALID_OPENAPI');
        failure.details = Array.isArray(error.details) ? error.details.map(({instancePath,keyword,schemaPath})=>({instancePath,keyword,schemaPath})) : [];
        throw failure;
      }
    }

    import NextLink from "next/link"
    import { usePathname, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation"
    import { listNavigationHref } from "@/lib/list-navigation"
    import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, type ComponentProps, type ReactNode } from "react"
    
    type Guard = () => string | null
    type NavigationGuard = { register: (guard: Guard) => () => void; confirmNavigation: () => boolean; allowNextUnload: () => () => void }
    const NavigationGuardContext = createContext<NavigationGuard>({ register: () => () => {}, confirmNavigation: () => true, allowNextUnload: () => () => {} })
    
    export function NavigationGuardProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
      const activeGuard = useRef<Guard | null>(null)
      const approvedUnload = useRef(false)
      const allowNextUnload = useCallback(() => {
        approvedUnload.current = true
        return () => { approvedUnload.current = false }
      }, [])
      const register = useCallback((guard: Guard) => {
        activeGuard.current = guard
        return () => { if (activeGuard.current === guard) activeGuard.current = null }
      }, [])
      const confirmNavigation = useCallback(() => {
        const message = activeGuard.current?.()
        return !message || window.confirm(message)
      }, [])
      useEffect(() => {
        const beforeUnload = (event: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
          if (approvedUnload.current) { approvedUnload.current = false; return }
          if (activeGuard.current?.()) { event.preventDefault(); event.returnValue = "" }
        }
        window.addEventListener("beforeunload", beforeUnload)
        return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", beforeUnload)
      }, [])
      const value = useMemo(() => ({ register, confirmNavigation, allowNextUnload }), [register, confirmNavigation, allowNextUnload])
      return <NavigationGuardContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</NavigationGuardContext.Provider>
    }
    
    export function useNavigationGuard(message: string | null) {
      const { register } = useContext(NavigationGuardContext)
      useEffect(() => register(() => message), [message, register])
    }
    
    export function useConfirmNavigation() {
      return useContext(NavigationGuardContext).confirmNavigation
    }
    
    export function useAllowNextUnload() {
      return useContext(NavigationGuardContext).allowNextUnload
    }
    
    export function GuardedLink({ onNavigate, ...props }: ComponentProps<typeof NextLink>) {
      const confirmNavigation = useConfirmNavigation()
      const pathname = usePathname()
      const search = useSearchParams()
      const href = typeof props.href === "string" ? listNavigationHref(props.href, pathname, search.toString()) : props.href
      return <NextLink {...props} href={href} onNavigate={event => {
        if (!confirmNavigation()) { event.preventDefault(); return }
        onNavigate?.(event)
      }} />
    }

      page.on("request", request => { if (request.url().includes(`/products/${id}/media/`)) media.push(request.url()) })
      await page.route("**/api/erp/**", route => route.fulfill({ status: 503, json: { title: "Consulta não configurada na fixture" } }))
      await page.route("**/api/erp/me", route => route.fulfill({ json: { tenant: { id: tenant, legalName: "Empresa de teste" } } }))
      await page.route(`**/api/erp/products/${id}`, route => route.fulfill({ headers: { etag: '"1"' }, json: { tenantId: tenant, canEdit, data: product } }))
      await page.route(`**/api/erp/products/${id}/catalog`, async route => {
        if (route.request().method() === "GET") return route.fulfill({ headers: { etag: `"${data?.revision || 0}"` }, json: { tenantId: tenant, productId: id, canEdit, data, defaultCollection: "premium", mediaConfigured: false, assets: [] } })
        const body = route.request().postDataJSON()
        writes.push({ body, revision: route.request().headers()["if-match"] })
        if (behavior === "conflict") return route.fulfill({ status: 412, json: { title: "A ficha foi alterada por outra pessoa." } })
        data = { ...body, revision: (data?.revision || 0) + 1, publicPath: sample.publicPath } as typeof sample
        if (behavior === "uncertain") return route.abort("failed")
        return route.fulfill({ headers: { etag: `"${data.revision}"` }, json: { saved: true, revision: data.revision, mainMediaId: null } })
      })
      return { writes, media }
    }

        /// Omission preserves metadata written by newer clients; empty clears it.
        pub manufacturer: Option<String>,
        pub manufacturer_model: Option<String>,
        pub catalog_product_name: Option<String>,

    impl CatalogProfileInput {
        fn validate(&mut self) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
            if !["core", "premium"].contains(&self.collection.as_str())
                || [&self.muscle_group, &self.technical_category]
                    .iter()
                    .any(|s| s.trim().is_empty() || s.chars().count() > 80)
                || self.dimensions_mm.iter().any(|v| !(1..=50000).contains(v))
                || self.description.chars().count() > 4000
                || self.weight.chars().count() > 80
                || self.weight_stack.chars().count() > 80
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Confira linha, grupo e dimensões em milímetros",
                ));
            }
            for (value, limit) in [
                (&mut self.manufacturer, 80),
                (&mut self.manufacturer_model, 80),
                (&mut self.catalog_product_name, 200),
                (&mut self.live_area, 200),
            ] {
                if let Some(value) = value {
                    *value = value.trim().to_owned();
                    if value.chars().count() > limit || value.chars().any(char::is_control) {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Confira os dados do fabricante"));
                    }
                }
            }
            if let Some(sources) = &mut self.catalog_sources {
                if sources.len() > 10 {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Cadastre até dez fontes do catálogo"));
                }
                for source in sources {
                    source.title = source.title.trim().to_owned();
                    source.url = source.url.trim().to_owned();
                    let url = reqwest::Url::parse(&source.url)
                        .map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("Informe uma fonte HTTPS válida"))?;
                    if source.title.is_empty()
                        || source.title.chars().count() > 160
                        || source.title.chars().any(char::is_control)
                        || source.url.len() > 2048
                        || url.scheme() != "https"
                        || url.host_str().is_none()
                        || !url.username().is_empty()
                        || url.password().is_some()
                        || [source.pdf_page, source.printed_page]
                            .into_iter()
                            .flatten()
                            .any(|page| !(1..=10000).contains(&page))
                    {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                            "Confira título, endereço HTTPS e páginas da fonte",
                        ));
                    }
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    """Run on applications host. Default is a complete transactional dry run."""
    import argparse
    import hashlib
    import json
    import os
    import pathlib
    import re
    import subprocess
    import time
    
    TENANT = '9bcd03ef-0fee-471c-8f30-12a6271a09cc'
    ACTOR = '888dc011-4de8-44a9-89ef-9b75cac134d0'
    IMPORT = 'ludus-technical-20261112'
    
    def psql(sql):
        result = subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','-u','postgres','psql','-X','-q','-t','-A','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-d','erp_next'],input=sql,capture_output=True,text=True)
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(result.stderr[-3000:])
        return result.stdout.strip()
    
    def literal(value):
        return "'" + json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False).replace("'","''") + "'::jsonb"
    
    def main():
        parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument('--payload',required=True,type=pathlib.Path)
        parser.add_argument('--sha256',required=True)
        parser.add_argument('--apply',action='store_true')
        args=parser.parse_args()
        raw=args.payload.read_bytes()
        if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != args.sha256: raise RuntimeError('PAYLOAD_HASH_MISMATCH')
        payload=json.loads(raw)
        assert payload['schema']=='ludus-technical-import/1' and payload['tenantId']==TENANT and payload['actorId']==ACTOR
        rows=payload['products']
        assert len(rows)==len({r['id'] for r in rows})==len({r['sku'] for r in rows})==94
        assert sum(r['expectedStatus']=='archived' for r in rows)==3
        assert sum(bool(r['plateHolderTypes']) for r in rows)==42
        for row in rows:
            assert re.fullmatch(r'LD-(A0(0[1-9]|[1-4][0-9]|5[0-6])|B0(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-8]))',row['sku'])
            p=row['profile']
            assert p['collection']=='premium' and p['mainMediaId'] is None
            assert re.fullmatch(r'/loja/[a-z0-9-]+/',row['publicPath'])
            assert all(0<n<=50000 for n in p['dimensionsMm']) and len(p['dimensionsMm'])==3
            assert p['muscleGroup'] and p['technicalCategory'] and p['manufacturerModel']
        sql=f"""BEGIN;
    SET LOCAL standard_conforming_strings=on;
    SET LOCAL app.tenant_id='{TENANT}';
    SET LOCAL lock_timeout='10s';
    SET LOCAL statement_timeout='120s';
    SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('{IMPORT}',0));
    CREATE TEMP TABLE import_rows ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT value AS item FROM jsonb_array_elements({literal(rows)});
    SELECT p.id FROM products p JOIN import_rows i ON p.id=(i.item->>'id')::uuid WHERE p.tenant_id='{TENANT}' ORDER BY p.id FOR UPDATE OF p;
    CREATE TEMP TABLE before_products ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT * FROM products;
    CREATE TEMP TABLE before_profiles ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT * FROM product_catalog_profiles;
    CREATE TEMP TABLE import_result(created integer,unchanged integer) ON COMMIT DROP;
    DO $import$
    DECLARE tenant uuid := '{TENANT}'; actor uuid := '{ACTOR}'; item jsonb; d jsonb; p products%ROWTYPE;
        existing product_catalog_profiles%ROWTYPE; wanted jsonb; created integer:=0; unchanged integer:=0;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenants WHERE id=tenant AND legal_name ILIKE '%LUDUS%')
        OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenant_memberships WHERE tenant_id=tenant AND identity_id=actor AND status='active')
        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TENANT_OR_ACTOR_MISMATCH'; END IF;
      IF NOT has_table_privilege('erp_next_app','product_catalog_profiles','SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME_GRANTS_MISSING'; END IF;
      FOR item IN SELECT i.item FROM import_rows i ORDER BY i.item->>'sku' LOOP
        SELECT * INTO STRICT p FROM products WHERE tenant_id=tenant AND id=(item->>'id')::uuid AND sku=item->>'sku';
        IF p.status<>item->>'expectedStatus' OR p.category_id IS DISTINCT FROM (item->>'expectedCategoryId')::uuid THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRODUCT_SCOPE_CHANGED: %',p.sku; END IF;
        d:=item->'profile';
        wanted:=jsonb_build_object('collection',d->>'collection','muscle_group',d->>'muscleGroup','technical_category',d->>'technicalCategory',
          'dimensions_mm',d->'dimensionsMm','description',d->>'description','weight',d->>'weight','weight_stack',d->>'weightStack',
          'public_path',item->>'publicPath','main_media_id',NULL,'manufacturer',d->>'manufacturer','manufacturer_model',d->>'manufacturerModel',
          'catalog_product_name',d->>'catalogProductName','live_area',d->>'liveArea','catalog_sources',d->'catalogSources');
        SELECT * INTO existing FROM product_catalog_profiles WHERE tenant_id=tenant AND product_id=p.id FOR UPDATE;
        IF FOUND THEN
          IF (to_jsonb(existing)-ARRAY['tenant_id','product_id','revision','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM wanted THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRESERVE_EXISTING_PROFILE: %',p.sku; END IF;
          unchanged:=unchanged+1;
        ELSE
          INSERT INTO product_catalog_profiles(tenant_id,product_id,collection,muscle_group,technical_category,dimensions_mm,description,weight,weight_stack,public_path,main_media_id,manufacturer,manufacturer_model,catalog_product_name,live_area,catalog_sources)
          VALUES(tenant,p.id,d->>'collection',d->>'muscleGroup',d->>'technicalCategory',ARRAY(SELECT value::integer FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(d->'dimensionsMm')),
            d->>'description',d->>'weight',d->>'weightStack',item->>'publicPath',NULL,d->>'manufacturer',d->>'manufacturerModel',d->>'catalogProductName',d->>'liveArea',d->'catalogSources');
          INSERT INTO audit_log(tenant_id,identity_id,action,entity_type,entity_id,request_id,details)
          VALUES(tenant,actor,'catalog.profile.created','product',p.id::text,'{IMPORT}',jsonb_build_object('revision',1,'source','{IMPORT}','payloadSha256','{args.sha256}','sku',p.sku,'manufacturerModel',d->>'manufacturerModel'));
          INSERT INTO outbox_events(tenant_id,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,event_type,payload)
          VALUES(tenant,'product',p.id::text,'catalog.profile.created',jsonb_build_object('revision',1,'source','{IMPORT}','manufacturerModel',d->>'manufacturerModel'));
          created:=created+1;
        END IF;
      END LOOP;
      IF created+unchanged<>94 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INCOMPLETE_IMPORT'; END IF;
      IF EXISTS((SELECT * FROM products EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM before_products) UNION ALL (SELECT * FROM before_products EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM products)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROTECTED_PRODUCT_CHANGED'; END IF;
      IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM before_profiles EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM product_catalog_profiles) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EXISTING_PROFILE_CHANGED'; END IF;
      IF (SELECT count(*) FROM product_catalog_profiles)<>(SELECT count(*) FROM before_profiles)+created THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNEXPECTED_PROFILE_COUNT'; END IF;
      INSERT INTO import_result VALUES(created,unchanged);
    END $import$;
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('created',created,'unchanged',unchanged,'protectedProductChanges',0,
      'profilesVerified',(SELECT count(*) FROM product_catalog_profiles c JOIN import_rows i ON c.product_id=(i.item->>'id')::uuid WHERE c.tenant_id='{TENANT}' AND c.manufacturer_model=i.item->'profile'->>'manufacturerModel'),
      'archivedPreserved',(SELECT count(*) FROM products p JOIN import_rows i ON p.id=(i.item->>'id')::uuid WHERE p.tenant_id='{TENANT}' AND p.status='archived'),
      'legacyPhotosPreserved',true,'coreUnchanged',true) FROM import_result;
    {'COMMIT' if args.apply else 'ROLLBACK'};
    """
        if args.apply:
            backup_dir=pathlib.Path('/mnt/HC_Volume_106542212/erp-next/backups')
            backup=backup_dir/f'technical-before-{time.time_ns()}.json'
            before=psql(f"SELECT jsonb_build_object('products',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)) FROM products p WHERE tenant_id='{TENANT}'),'profiles',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM product_catalog_profiles c WHERE tenant_id='{TENANT}'));")
            parsed=json.loads(before)
            if len(parsed['products'])!=160: raise RuntimeError('BACKUP_PRODUCT_SCOPE_CHANGED')
            fd=os.open(backup,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
            with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as stream: stream.write(before+'\n')
            if json.loads(backup.read_text())!=parsed: raise RuntimeError('BACKUP_READBACK_MISMATCH')
            print(json.dumps({'backup':backup.name,'bytes':backup.stat().st_size}),flush=True)
        output=psql(sql)
        reports=[json.loads(line) for line in output.splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
        assert len(reports)==1 and reports[0]['profilesVerified']==94
        print(json.dumps(dict(applied=args.apply,payloadSha256=args.sha256,**reports[0])),flush=True)
    
    if __name__=='__main__': main()

    """Build the reviewed 94-row technical payload; never modifies ERP data."""
    import hashlib
    import json
    import pathlib
    import re
    import urllib.parse
    
    ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    TENANT = '9bcd03ef-0fee-471c-8f30-12a6271a09cc'
    CATEGORY = '01a1a948-e190-70a9-976e-26c1c32cde72'
    matches = json.loads((ROOT / 'erp-matches-proposed.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    extra = {
        'LD-B010': ('Pernas e panturrilhas', 'Bateria de pesos', 'Desenvolvido para elevação de panturrilhas em pé, com ajuste de altura do apoio dos ombros e suporte estável para os pés. A plataforma contornada favorece um posicionamento seguro e a amplitude natural do tornozelo durante o exercício.'),
        'LD-B011': ('Pernas e glúteos', 'Bateria de pesos', 'Permite treinamento direcionado de quadril e glúteos. A estrutura de resistência bidirecional oferece movimentos controlados nas duas direções, com posicionamento estável do corpo para exercícios de extensão do quadril e ativação dos glúteos.'),
        'LD-B034': ('Pernas e glúteos', 'Bateria de pesos', 'Desenvolvido para reproduzir a biomecânica do agachamento, com uma trajetória de movimento curva e suave. Oferece uma alternativa ao leg press e ao hack squat, buscando reduzir a sobrecarga na região lombar e nos joelhos.'),
    }
    rows = []
    for match in matches:
        erp, cat, prior = match['erp'], match['catalog'], match['priorProfile']
        sku = erp['sku']
        assert erp['categoryId'] == CATEGORY
        assert erp['status'] == ('archived' if sku in extra else 'active')
        dimensions = cat['dimensionsMm']
        assert len(dimensions) == 3 and all(isinstance(n, int) and 0 < n <= 50000 for n in dimensions)
        weight = f"{cat['weightKg']:g} kg"
        if prior:
            assert prior['dimensions_mm'] == dimensions
            assert float(prior['weight'].replace(' kg', '').replace(',', '.')) == cat['weightKg']
            group, category, description = prior['group'], prior['category'], prior['description']
            public_path = urllib.parse.urlsplit(prior['url']).path
        else:
            group, category, description = extra[sku]
            public_path = f"/loja/product-{erp['id']}/"
        assert re.fullmatch(r'/loja/[a-z0-9-]+/', public_path)
        sources = [{'title': src['catalogTitle'], 'url': src['sourceUrl'], 'pdfPage': src['pdfPage'], 'printedPage': src['printedPage']} for src in cat['sources']]
        profile = dict(collection='premium', muscleGroup=group, technicalCategory=category,
            dimensionsMm=dimensions, description=description, weight=weight,
            weightStack=cat['stack'] or '', mainMediaId=None, manufacturer='DHZ Fitness',
            manufacturerModel=cat['code'], catalogProductName=cat['name'],
            liveArea=cat['liveArea'] or '', catalogSources=sources)
        for field, limit in [('muscleGroup',80),('technicalCategory',80),('weight',80),('weightStack',80),('description',4000),('manufacturer',80),('manufacturerModel',80),('catalogProductName',200),('liveArea',200)]:
            assert len(profile[field]) <= limit and '\ufffd' not in profile[field], (sku, field)
        assert group and category and description and len(sources) in (1,2)
        for src in sources:
            url = urllib.parse.urlsplit(src['url'])
            assert url.scheme == 'https' and url.hostname == 'drive.google.com' and not url.username and not url.password
            assert 1 <= src['pdfPage'] <= 10000 and 1 <= src['printedPage'] <= 10000
        applicable = sku == 'LD-A056' or (sku.startswith('LD-A') and 1 <= int(sku[-3:]) <= 41)
        rows.append(dict(id=erp['id'], sku=sku, expectedStatus=erp['status'], expectedCategoryId=CATEGORY,
            publicPath=public_path, profile=profile, plateHolderTypes=['Standard','Olímpico'] if applicable else []))
    assert len(rows) == len({r['id'] for r in rows}) == len({r['sku'] for r in rows}) == 94
    assert sum(bool(r['plateHolderTypes']) for r in rows) == 42
    assert sum(r['expectedStatus'] == 'archived' for r in rows) == 3
    payload = dict(schema='ludus-technical-import/1', tenantId=TENANT, actorId='888dc011-4de8-44a9-89ef-9b75cac134d0', products=rows)
    target = ROOT / 'technical-import-payload.json'
    target.write_text(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(dict(rows=94, active=91, archived=3, withPlateHolderOptions=42, sourceReferences=sum(len(r['profile']['catalogSources']) for r in rows), sha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest())))

    async function authenticate(context: BrowserContext, tenantId = tenant, token = "catalog-navigation-fixture") {
      const iv = randomBytes(12)
      const cipher = createCipheriv("aes-256-gcm", createHash("sha256").update(secret).digest(), iv)
      cipher.setAAD(Buffer.from("erp-session"))
      const encrypted = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(JSON.stringify({ accessToken: token, tenantId, expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600_000 })), cipher.final()])
      await context.addCookies([{ name: "erp_session", value: Buffer.concat([iv, cipher.getAuthTag(), encrypted]).toString("base64url"), url: origin, httpOnly: true, sameSite: "Lax" }])
    }

    """Package compiled Windows Next output with existing Linux runtime dependencies."""
    import io, json, pathlib, re, sys, tarfile, os
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
    
    workspace = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
    dist = workspace / 'apps/web/.next-commercial-release'
    standalone = dist / 'standalone/apps/web'
    original = (standalone / 'server.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    match = re.search(r'^const nextConfig = (.+)$', original, re.M)
    if not match: raise RuntimeError('Standalone config missing')
    config = json.loads(match.group(1))
    def rebase(value):
        if isinstance(value, dict): return {k: rebase(v) for k,v in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, list): return [rebase(v) for v in value]
        if isinstance(value, str):
            normalized = value.replace('\\','/')
            root = workspace.as_posix()
            if normalized.lower().startswith(root.lower()): return '/app' + normalized[len(root):]
        return value
    config = rebase(config)
    config['distDir'] = './.next'
    config['distDirRoot'] = '.next'
    server = original[:match.start(1)] + json.dumps(config,separators=(',',':')) + original[match.end(1):]
    output = workspace / 'artifacts' / ('commercial-web-' + sys.argv[1][:12] + '.tar.gz')
    entries = 0
    with tarfile.open(output,'w:gz',compresslevel=6) as archive:
        def add_bytes(name, data):
            global entries
            item = tarfile.TarInfo(name); item.size=len(data); item.mode=0o644
            archive.addfile(item,io.BytesIO(data)); entries+=1
        add_bytes('apps/web/server.js',server.encode())
        add_bytes('apps/web/package.json',(workspace/'apps/web/package.json').read_bytes())
        def add_tree(source, prefix):
            paths=[]
            for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(source, followlinks=False):
                dirs[:]=[name for name in dirs if name not in {'node_modules','cache','dev','.git'} and not name.startswith('.env')]
                paths.extend(pathlib.Path(directory)/name for name in files if not name.startswith('.env'))
            def read(path):
                if path.is_symlink(): raise RuntimeError('Unexpected bundle symlink')
                raw = path.read_bytes()
                if path.name=='required-server-files.json':
                    manifest=rebase(json.loads(raw)); manifest['config']=config
                    raw=json.dumps(manifest,separators=(',',':')).encode()
                return path,raw
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
                for path, raw in pool.map(read, paths, buffersize=32):
                    add_bytes(prefix+'/'+path.relative_to(source).as_posix(),raw)
        add_tree(standalone/config.get('distDirRoot','.next'),'apps/web/.next') if (standalone/'.next').exists() else add_tree(standalone/'.next-commercial-release','apps/web/.next')
        add_tree(dist/'static','apps/web/.next/static')
        add_tree(workspace/'apps/web/public','apps/web/public')
    print(json.dumps({'archive':str(output),'bytes':output.stat().st_size,'files':entries}))

    name: CI
    
    on:
      pull_request:
      workflow_dispatch:
    
    permissions:
      contents: read
    
    concurrency:
      group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    
    env:
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
    
    jobs:
      changes:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 2
        outputs:
          web: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.web }}
          api: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.api }}
          fiscal: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.fiscal }}
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              fetch-depth: 0
          - run: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p 'test_*.py'
          - id: scope
            env:
              BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || format('{0}^', github.sha) }}
            run: python3 -B scripts/ci/pr-gate.py plan
    
      web:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.web == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
            with:
              version: 11.11.0
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
              cache: pnpm
              cache-dependency-path: pnpm-lock.yaml
          - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline
          - run: pnpm --filter web lint
          - run: node --import ./tests/helpers/register-typescript.mjs --test tests/*-model.node.mjs
            working-directory: apps/web
    
      api:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.api == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 20
        services:
          postgres:
            image: postgres:18-alpine
            env:
              POSTGRES_DB: erp_next_test
              POSTGRES_USER: postgres
              POSTGRES_PASSWORD: erp_next_ci_only
            ports:
              - 5432:5432
            options: >-
              --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d erp_next_test"
              --health-interval 2s
              --health-timeout 3s
              --health-retries 20
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:erp_next_ci_only@127.0.0.1:5432/erp_next_test
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.1
            with:
              components: rustfmt
          - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
            with:
              shared-key: pr-api
          - run: cargo fmt --all --check
          - run: cargo test --workspace --locked -- --test-threads=2
    
      fiscal:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.fiscal == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
              cache: npm
              cache-dependency-path: apps/fiscal-engine/package-lock.json
          - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
          - run: npm test
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
          - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
            with:
              version: 0.12.24
          - run: uv sync --frozen --extra dev --python 3.12
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-mcp
          - run: uv run --frozen --extra dev pytest tests/test_fiscal_schema.py tests/test_simplified_danfe.py tests/test_nfe_assinatura.py
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-mcp
    
      gate:
        needs: [changes, web, api, fiscal]
        if: always()
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 2
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - name: Validate selected checks and record explicit skips
            env:
              SOURCE_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
              VALIDATION_JOBS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
            run: python3 -B scripts/ci/pr-gate.py gate artifacts/mlops/ci-attestation.json
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            if: always()

    # Live Read And Search Safety
    
    When to read: before direct connector range reads, cell reads, or `search_spreadsheet_rows` calls against an existing Google Sheet.
    
    ## Rules
    
    - Read spreadsheet metadata before direct live reads or searches. Record visible sheet titles, `sheetId` values, grid row/column counts, frozen/header rows if exposed, and any relevant named ranges.
    - Use exact visible sheet titles from metadata. Do not assume `Sheet1`, `Sheet2`, localized default names, or title-derived tab names.
    - If a spreadsheet has exactly one visible sheet, you may infer that sheet for read-only inspection after metadata confirms it. For writes, still name the resolved sheet explicitly.
    - Keep `sheet_name` and cell-only `range` separate when the connector has separate arguments. Use a full A1 string with quoted sheet names only for tools that require a single A1 range argument.
    - Quote sheet names in full A1 notation when they contain spaces, punctuation, apostrophes, or non-ASCII characters.
    - Bound `search_spreadsheet_rows` calls to the smallest plausible rectangle. Avoid whole-grid or whole-column searches unless the computed scan is safely below the tool cap.
    - Keep row-search scans under 50,000 cells. Compute `(end_row - start_row + 1) * scanned_column_count` before the call, and chunk by rows or columns when the first useful range would exceed the cap.
    - Do not call row search with an empty query, a query that only repeats a sheet title, or `return_columns` outside the searched rectangle.
    - If a range or tab read fails, do not retry the same guessed range. Re-read metadata, list exact tab names in your working notes, then retry with a metadata-derived sheet and a smaller range.
    - Prefer targeted sentinel reads such as header rows, known id columns, or bounded data rectangles before escalating to broader scans.
    
    ## Recovery Patterns
    
    - Tab not found: re-read metadata, compare against exact visible titles, then use the single visible sheet only if metadata proves there is one.
    - Range parse error: separate `sheet_name` from cell-only `range` when possible, or quote the sheet name in full A1 notation.
    - Range too large: shrink to header plus likely data columns, then page through bounded chunks. Do not repeat the oversized call.
    - No rows found: confirm the query value exists in a small displayed-value read before broadening the search.
    # Edit Workflow
    
    When to read: before existing Google Sheets inspection that may lead to an edit, and before any existing spreadsheet content write or edit operation.
    
    ## Workflow
    
    Read `./reference-live-read-search-safety.md` before connector reads or row search, and `./reference-native-cell-structure.md` before extending populated rows or columns.
    
    1. If the spreadsheet or tab is not already grounded, identify it first and read metadata before deeper reads or writes.
    2. Prefer narrow reads and row search over dumping large tabs into context.
    3. Ground the task in exact sheet, range, header, and formula context before proposing changes.
    4. When a read could influence a write, default to `get_cells`. Treat `get_range` as the exception and use it only when plain displayed values are truly sufficient.
    5. If the task involves filling in, editing, or normalizing existing cells, do not rely on `get_range` alone. Inspect the target cells with `get_cells` first so value choices come from the live cell metadata.
    6. When validation-backed cells may matter, prefer a `get_cells` read that includes the live constraint data you need, for example `dataValidation,formattedValue,effectiveValue,userEnteredValue`.
    7. When preparing to write into existing cells, check whether the target range is constrained by dropdowns or other data validation before choosing values.
    8. Do not infer allowed values from plain neighboring text alone when validation may exist.
    9. If validation is present, restate the allowed values or rule before drafting or applying the write.
    10. Before the first write-heavy `batch_update`, read `./reference-batch-update-recipes.md` for request-shape recall.
    11. Cluster logically related edits into one `batch_update` so the batch is coherent and atomic.
    12. Avoid both mega-batches and one-request micro-batches.
    13. If the user asks to clean, normalize, or restructure data, summarize the intended table shape before writing.
    14. For exact-row, fixed-count, or report-style tasks, keep the findings narrowly scoped to the requested conclusions only.
    15. Do not add extra metrics, adjacent commentary, or bonus rows unless the user asked for them.
    16. After writing, run `./reference-visual-quality.md` before the final answer.
    
    Preserve existing values, formulas, validation, chips, and formatting outside the requested change. For content-only edits, retain the target cell's formatting unless the user asks to change it.
    
    ## Output Conventions
    
    - Always reference the spreadsheet, sheet name, and range when describing findings or planned edits.
    - For `batch_update` work, use a compact table or list with the request type, target range or sheet, proposed change, and reason.

    pub async fn record(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        identity: &AuthenticatedIdentity,
        headers: &HeaderMap,
        change: DomainChange,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        let DomainChange {
            kind,
            id,
            event,
            details,
        } = change;
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO audit_log(tenant_id,identity_id,action,entity_type,entity_id,request_id,details) SELECT $1,id,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7 FROM identities WHERE auth_subject=$2")
            .bind(tenant).bind(&identity.subject).bind(event).bind(kind).bind(id.to_string()).bind(headers.get("x-request-id").and_then(|h|h.to_str().ok())).bind(&details).execute(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO outbox_events(tenant_id,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,event_type,payload) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5)")
            .bind(tenant).bind(kind).bind(id.to_string()).bind(event).bind(details).execute(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(())
    }
    /// Exact nonnegative fixed-point transport; at most 12 whole digits.
    pub fn fixed(raw: &str, scale: usize) -> Result<i64, DomainError> {
        let (whole, fraction) = raw.split_once('.').ok_or(DomainError::Invalid(
            "Informe decimal com ponto e escala fixa",
        ))?;
        if whole.is_empty()
            || whole.len() > 12
            || (whole.len() > 1 && whole.starts_with('0'))
            || fraction.len() != scale
            || !whole
                .bytes()
                .chain(fraction.bytes())
                .all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit())
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Decimal inválido ou fora da escala permitida",
            ));
        }
        format!("{whole}{fraction}")
            .parse()
            .map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("Valor fora do limite"))
    }
    pub fn decimal(value: i64, scale: u32) -> String {
        let factor = 10_i64.pow(scale);
        format!(
            "{}.{:0width$}",
            value / factor,
            value % factor,
            width = scale as usize
        )
    }

    if not match: raise RuntimeError('STANDALONE_CONFIG_MISSING')
    
    def rebase(value):
        if isinstance(value,dict): return {k:rebase(v) for k,v in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value,list): return [rebase(v) for v in value]
        if isinstance(value,str):
            normalized=value.replace('\\','/')
            root=workspace.as_posix()
            if normalized.lower().startswith(root.lower()): return '/app'+normalized[len(root):]
        return value
    
    config=rebase(json.loads(match.group(1)))
    config['distDir']='./.next'
    config['distDirRoot']='.next'
    server=original[:match.start(1)]+json.dumps(config,separators=(',',':'))+original[match.end(1):]
    sha=sys.argv[1]
    assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',sha)
    output=workspace/'artifacts'/('technical-web-'+sha[:12]+'.tar.gz')
    entries=0
    with tarfile.open(output,'w:gz',compresslevel=6) as archive:
        def add_bytes(name,raw):
            global entries
            item=tarfile.TarInfo(name);item.size=len(raw);item.mode=0o644
            archive.addfile(item,io.BytesIO(raw));entries+=1
        def add_tree(source,prefix):
            for directory,dirs,files in os.walk(source,followlinks=False):
                dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d not in {'node_modules','cache','dev','.git'} and not d.startswith('.env')]
                for name in files:
                    path=pathlib.Path(directory)/name
                    if name.startswith('.env'): continue
                    if path.is_symlink(): raise RuntimeError('UNEXPECTED_SYMLINK')
                    raw=path.read_bytes()
                    if name=='required-server-files.json':
                        manifest=rebase(json.loads(raw));manifest['config']=config
                        raw=json.dumps(manifest,separators=(',',':')).encode()
                    add_bytes(prefix+'/'+path.relative_to(source).as_posix(),raw)
        add_bytes('apps/web/server.js',server.encode())
        add_bytes('apps/web/package.json',(workspace/'apps/web/package.json').read_bytes())
        add_tree(standalone/'.next-technical-release','apps/web/.next')
        add_tree(dist/'static','apps/web/.next/static')
        add_tree(workspace/'apps/web/public','apps/web/public')
    with output.open('rb') as stream: digest=hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()
    print(json.dumps(dict(archive=str(output),bytes=output.stat().st_size,files=entries,sha256=digest)))

    import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test"
    import { createServer } from "node:http"

    const issuer = "http://127.0.0.1:33120"
    const logouts: URL[] = []
    const auth = createServer((request, response) => {
      const url = new URL(request.url || "/", issuer)
      if (url.pathname === "/.well-known/openid-configuration") {
        response.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "application/json" })
        response.end(JSON.stringify({ issuer, code_challenge_methods_supported: ["S256"], authorization_endpoint: `${issuer}/authorize`, token_endpoint: `${issuer}/token`, end_session_endpoint: `${issuer}/end-session` }))
      } else if (url.pathname === "/end-session") {
        logouts.push(url)
        response.writeHead(303, { Location: `${origin}/api/auth/logout/central/callback` })
        response.end()
      } else {
        response.writeHead(404)
        response.end()
      }
    })
    
    test.beforeAll(async () => {
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => { auth.once("error", reject); auth.listen(33120, "127.0.0.1", resolve) })

    """Read-only ERP preflight and verified private backups before authorized updates."""
    import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,time
    root=pathlib.Path('/mnt/HC_Volume_106542212/erp-next')
    target=root/'private/catalog-technical-20261112'
    payload=json.loads((target/'technical-import-payload.json').read_text())
    tenant=payload['tenantId']
    sql=f"SELECT jsonb_build_object('products',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.id) FROM products p WHERE tenant_id='{tenant}'),'profiles',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM product_catalog_profiles c WHERE tenant_id='{tenant}'));"
    raw=subprocess.check_output(['sudo','-n','-u','postgres','psql','-X','-t','-A','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-d','erp_next','-c',sql],text=True)
    snapshot=json.loads(raw)
    assert len(snapshot['products'])==160
    by_id={p['id']:p for p in snapshot['products']}
    for row in payload['products']:
        product=by_id[row['id']]
        assert product['sku']==row['sku'] and product['status']==row['expectedStatus'] and product['category_id']==row['expectedCategoryId']
        assert not product['plate_holder_types'],row['sku']
    stamp=str(time.time_ns())
    data=root/'backups'/f'technical-products-before-{stamp}.json'
    with os.fdopen(os.open(data,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600),'w') as stream:stream.write(raw)
    assert json.loads(data.read_text())==snapshot
    backup=root/'backups'/f'full-before-technical-{stamp}.dump'
    with os.fdopen(os.open(backup,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600),'wb') as stream:
        subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','-u','postgres','pg_dump','-d','erp_next','--format=custom','--no-owner'],check=True,stdout=stream)
    assert backup.stat().st_size>1024
    subprocess.run(['pg_restore','--list',str(backup)],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    with backup.open('rb') as stream:digest=hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()
    manifest=dict(productBackup=data.name,databaseBackup=backup.name,databaseBytes=backup.stat().st_size,databaseSha256=digest,productsVerified=160,matchesVerified=94,photosPreserved=160)
    (target/'before-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
    os.chmod(target/'before-manifest.json',0o600)
    print(json.dumps(manifest))

    test("reabrir recupera o rascunho e descartar o remove", async ({ page }) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 })
      await page.goto("/cadastros/produtos/novo")
      const name = page.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Nome do produto", exact: true })
      await name.fill("Rascunho recuperável")
      page.on("dialog", dialog => dialog.accept())
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Abrir menu", exact: true }).click()
      await page.getByRole("dialog").getByRole("link", { name: "Visão geral", exact: true }).click()
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(origin + "/")
      await page.goto("/cadastros/produtos/novo")
      await expect(name).toHaveValue("Rascunho recuperável")
      await expect(page.getByRole("status").filter({ hasText: "Rascunho recuperado" })).toBeVisible()
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Descartar rascunho", exact: true }).click()
      await expect(name).toHaveValue("")
      await page.reload()
      await expect(name).toHaveValue("")
    })
    
    test("rascunho preserva foto grande e cores ao reabrir e salvar", async ({ page }) => {
      await page.goto("/cadastros/produtos")
      const photoDataUrl = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const dialogs: string[] = []
      page.on("dialog", async dialog => { dialogs.push(dialog.type()); await dialog.accept() })
      const request = page.waitForRequest(request => request.url() === `${origin}/api/auth/logout` && request.method() === "POST")
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Sair", exact: true }).click()
      expect((await request).headers().origin).toBe(origin)
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(`${origin}/entrar`)
      expect(dialogs).toEqual(["confirm"])
      expect(logouts).toHaveLength(1)
      expect(logouts[0].searchParams.get("client_id")).toBe("browser-fixture-client")
      expect(logouts[0].searchParams.get("post_logout_redirect_uri")).toBe(`${origin}/api/auth/logout/central/callback`)
      expect((await context.cookies(origin)).filter(cookie => cookie.name.startsWith("erp_"))).toEqual([])
    })

    # Ficha técnica dos equipamentos
    Usuário autorizou criar campos na planilha e no ERP e preencher ambos, em 12/11/2026. O objetivo é relacionar os 104 modelos dos três PDFs aos 160 produtos Ludus e manter informações técnicas editáveis no cadastro, com navegação compacta. Foram confirmadas 94 correspondências: 91 por dimensões, peso e exercício nas fichas Ludus existentes; três por comparação visual do produto original. Dez modelos não têm cadastro; 66 Core não pertencem aos PDFs. Não criar produtos por suposição.
    
    ## Decisão técnica
    Reutilizar product_catalog_profiles, que já contém dimensões, peso, bateria, grupo, categoria técnica e descrição. Hoje o perfil não pode existir sem uma mídia registrada; GET retorna404 e a seção some. Permitir main_media_id nulo, criar o perfil de um produto existente com revisão0 e preservar a foto legada. Nenhuma galeria ou publicação externa é necessária para editar informações técnicas.
    Alternativas consideradas: importar perfis com imagens R2 exigiria configurar gateway e reiniciar serviços sem necessidade; uma nova tabela duplicaria o peso já consumido por pedidos. A extensão do perfil existente conserva uma fonte única de informações.
    
    ## Campos
    Preservar os campos existentes e adicionar fabricante (80 caracteres), modelo do fabricante(80), nome original no catálogo(200), área de treino publicada(200), fontes do catálogo (até10 referências contendo título160, URL HTTPS2048 e páginas PDF/impressa opcionais1..10000). Campos novos são opcionais, vazios quando desconhecidos; omissão por clientes antigos preserva os dados. Dimensões continuam três inteiros positivos de1 a50000mm. Peso e bateria continuam em texto compatível com o sistema, com até80 caracteres. A unidade do peso é kg e a bateria mantém multiplicadores publicados.
    
    ## API e integridade
    GET existente deve confirmar produto/empresa, retornar200 com data:null, revisão0, defaultCollection e mediaConfigured para produto sem perfil; produto alheio/inexistente continua404. PUT exige If-Match, bloqueia produto para concorrência, cria apenas com revisão0 e atualiza com revisão atual. Validar todos os dados e o proprietário de qualquer mídia selecionada. Auditar criação/edição e emitir outbox. Sem mídia principal, a foto legada continua sendo usada; nenhuma publicação é disparada.
    Não modificar preço, NCM/CEST, situação, unidade, categoria, cores, fotos ou estoque. Dados técnicos dos66Core e outros tenants permanecem intactos. SQL da carga deve ter backup, pré-condições, ensaio em transação comROLLBACK, escrita limitada aos94IDs, auditoria/outbox e readback na API.
    
    ## Interface
    Seção “Ficha técnica” no produto em consulta e edição. Resumo legível em duas/três colunas, ação “Editar ficha técnica” e formulário compacto; criação disponível quando não há perfil. Novos campos, descrição, dimensões e fontes são editáveis. Salvar ficha é ação distinta do produto. Impedir perda de edição, tratar conflitos e rede incerta sem repetir criação às cegas. Leitor só consulta. Não renderizar galeria se o gateway não estiver configurado; nenhuma imagem quebrada no perfil sem mídia. Validar320/390/768/1440px.
    
    ## Planilha
    Manter os104 códigos de fabricante. Acrescentar SKU/ID/URLERP e status de relação; aba Relação ERP contém160 produtos com procedência. Preencher NCM, preço de tabela semIPI, IPI, custo/estoque apenas com registros explícitos doERP e cabeçalhos/notas que indiquem fonte e versão. Preço base é campo distinto do preço publicado semIPI. Campos não disponíveis permanecem vazios. Preservar Modelo original e todas as fichas/fontes anteriores.
    
    ## Entrega
    Implementação nativa em worktree isolada, testes antes da produção, revisão independente final, PR/merge/deploy já autorizados na conversa. Compilar localmente; servidor apenas aplica pacotes/migrações. Publicar API/web compatíveis antes da carga e verificar94 perfis, valores comerciais preservados, fotos acessíveis e a planilha por readback.

    ---
    name: finishing-a-development-branch
    description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work
    ---
    
    # Finishing a Development Branch
    
    ## Overview
    
    **Core principle:** Verify tests → Detect environment → Present options → Execute choice → Clean up.
    
    **Announce at start:** "I'm using the finishing-a-development-branch skill to complete this work."
    
    ## Step 1: Verify Tests
    
    Run the project's full test suite (`npm test` / `cargo test` / `pytest` / `go test ./...`).
    
    **If tests fail**, report the failures and stop — the menu comes after a green suite:
    
    ```
    Tests failing (<N> failures). Must fix before completing:
    
    [Show failures]
    ```
    
    **If tests pass:** continue to Step 2.
    
    ## Step 2: Detect Environment
    
    ```bash
    GIT_DIR=$(cd "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)
    GIT_COMMON=$(cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)
    # Capture now, while still inside the workspace — Step 5 changes directory
    # before cleanup (Step 6) needs this value
    WORKTREE_PATH=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
    ```
    
    This determines which menu to show and how cleanup works:
    
    | State | Menu | Cleanup |
    |-------|------|---------|
    | `GIT_DIR == GIT_COMMON` (normal repo) | Standard 3 options | No worktree to clean up |
    | `GIT_DIR != GIT_COMMON`, named branch | Standard 3 options | Provenance-based (see Step 6) |
    | `GIT_DIR != GIT_COMMON`, detached HEAD | Reduced 2 options (no merge) | Externally managed — leave in place |
    
    ## Step 3: Determine Base Branch
    
    The base branch is whatever this work forked from — usually named in the
    plan, the conversation, or the branch's upstream. If it is not already
    known, ask: "This branch split from <your best guess> - is that correct?"
    Confirm before merging: merging into the wrong base is expensive to undo.
    
    ## Step 4: Present Options
    
    **Normal repo and named-branch worktree — present exactly these 3 options:**
    
    ```
    Implementation complete. What would you like to do?
    
    1. Merge back to <base-branch> locally
    2. Push and create a Pull Request
    3. Keep the branch as-is (I'll handle it later)
    
    Which option?
    ```
    
    **Detached HEAD — present exactly these 2 options:**
    
    ```
    Implementation complete. You're on a detached HEAD (externally managed workspace).
    
    1. Push as new branch and create a Pull Request
    2. Keep as-is (I'll handle it later)
    
    Which option?
    ```
    
    Present the menu exactly as written — concise, with every option coming
    from the list above. Discarding the work happens only in response to your
    human partner explicitly asking for it (see "If your human partner asks to
    discard the work" below). Wait for their answer; the integration decision
    is theirs.
    
    ## Step 5: Execute Choice
    
    ### Option 1: Merge Locally
    
    ```bash
    # Get main repo root for CWD safety
    MAIN_ROOT=$(git -C "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/.." rev-parse --show-toplevel)
    cd "$MAIN_ROOT"
    
    # Merge first — verify success before removing anything
    git checkout <base-branch>
    git pull
    git merge <feature-branch>
    
    # Verify tests on merged result
    <test command>
    ```
    
    If tests fail on the merged result: stop, leave the worktree and branch in
    place, and investigate — nothing has been pushed, so the merge is local
    and recoverable.
    
    Once the merged result is green: clean up the worktree (Step 6), then
    delete the branch:
    
    ```bash
    git branch -d <feature-branch>
    ```
    
    ### Option 2: Push and Create PR
    
    ```bash
    git push -u origin <feature-branch>
    # From a detached HEAD, name the new branch on the remote:
    # git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<new-branch>
    ```
    
    Then create the pull/merge request against <base-branch> with the forge's
    tooling — its CLI if one is available, or the creation URL most forges
    print when you push — following the repo's PR template and conventions if
    present, and report the URL to your human partner.
    
    Keep the worktree — your human partner iterates on PR feedback there.
    
    ### Option 3: Keep As-Is
    
    Report: "Keeping branch <name>. Worktree preserved at <path>."
    
    ### If your human partner asks to discard the work
    
    This path exists only as a response to an explicit request to throw the
    work away. Confirm first:
    
    ```
    This will permanently delete:
    - Branch <name>
    - All commits: <commit-list>
    - Worktree at <path>
    
    Type 'discard' to confirm.
    ```
    
    Wait for that exact confirmation. When it arrives:
    
    ```bash
    MAIN_ROOT=$(git -C "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/.." rev-parse --show-toplevel)
    cd "$MAIN_ROOT"
    ```
    
    Then clean up the worktree (Step 6) and force-delete the branch:
    
    ```bash
    git branch -D <feature-branch>
    ```
    
    ## Step 6: Cleanup Workspace
    
    **Runs for Option 1 and confirmed discards.** Options 2 and 3 always
    preserve the worktree. Both callers have already changed directory to the
    main repo root — worktree removal must run from outside the worktree —
    and use the `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_COMMON`/`WORKTREE_PATH` values captured in
    Step 2, from before that directory change.

    """Read-only comparison with the verified pre-write product backup."""
    import argparse,json,pathlib,subprocess
    root=pathlib.Path('/mnt/HC_Volume_106542212/erp-next')
    staging=root/'private/catalog-technical-20261112'
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--profiles',action='store_true');args=parser.parse_args()
    manifest=json.loads((staging/'before-manifest.json').read_text())
    backup=(root/'backups'/manifest['productBackup']).resolve()
    assert backup.is_relative_to(root/'backups')
    before=json.loads(backup.read_text())
    payload=json.loads((staging/'technical-import-payload.json').read_text());tenant=payload['tenantId']
    sql=f"SELECT jsonb_build_object('products',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)) FROM products p WHERE tenant_id='{tenant}'),'profiles',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM product_catalog_profiles c WHERE tenant_id='{tenant}'),'audits',(SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log WHERE tenant_id='{tenant}' AND action='catalog.profile.created' AND request_id='ludus-technical-20261112'),'events',(SELECT count(*) FROM outbox_events WHERE tenant_id='{tenant}' AND event_type='catalog.profile.created' AND payload->>'source'='ludus-technical-20261112'));"
    raw=subprocess.check_output(['sudo','-n','-u','postgres','psql','-X','-t','-A','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-d','erp_next','-c',sql],text=True)
    after=json.loads(raw)
    original={p['id']:p for p in before['products']};current={p['id']:p for p in after['products']}
    assert original.keys()==current.keys() and len(current)==160
    matched={p['id']:p for p in payload['products']};applicable={p['id']:p for p in payload['products'] if p['plateHolderTypes']}
    differences=[]
    for key,old in original.items():
        new=current[key]
        allowed={'plate_holder_types','plate_holder_type','revision','updated_at'} if key in applicable else set()
        changed={field for field in old if old[field]!=new[field]}
        if changed-allowed: differences.append(dict(id=key,sku=old['sku'],fields=sorted(changed-allowed)))
        if key in applicable:
            assert new['plate_holder_types']==applicable[key]['plateHolderTypes'],old['sku']
            assert new['revision']==old['revision']+1,old['sku']
    assert not differences,differences
    result=dict(productsVerified=160,photosIdentical=160,plateHolderChoicesVerified=42,coreProductsUnchanged=66,
        archivedProductsPreserved=sum(p['status']=='archived' for p in current.values()),protectedDifferences=differences)
    if args.profiles:
        profiles={p['product_id']:p for p in after['profiles']}
        assert profiles.keys()==matched.keys() and len(profiles)==94
        mapping=dict(collection='collection',muscleGroup='muscle_group',technicalCategory='technical_category',dimensionsMm='dimensions_mm',description='description',weight='weight',weightStack='weight_stack',mainMediaId='main_media_id',manufacturer='manufacturer',manufacturerModel='manufacturer_model',catalogProductName='catalog_product_name',liveArea='live_area',catalogSources='catalog_sources')
        for key,row in matched.items():
            actual=profiles[key]
            assert actual['public_path']==row['publicPath'] and actual['revision']==1,row['sku']
            for source,destination in mapping.items(): assert actual[destination]==row['profile'][source],(row['sku'],source)
        assert after['audits']==after['events']==94
        result.update(profilesVerified=94,sourceReferences=sum(len(p['catalog_sources']) for p in profiles.values()),auditEventsVerified=94,outboxEventsVerified=94)
    print(json.dumps(result))

    name: Production release
    on:
      push:
        branches: [main]
      workflow_dispatch:
        inputs:
          source_ref:
            description: Exact source commit to validate and package
            required: true
            type: string
          automatic:
            description: Skip deployment when main has moved past this release
            required: false
            default: false
            type: boolean
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    jobs:
      fiscal-mcp:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 15
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
          - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
            with:
              version: 0.12.24
          - run: uv sync --frozen --extra dev --python 3.12
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-mcp
          - run: node --test scripts/fiscal/test/deploy-config.test.mjs
          - run: uv run --frozen --extra dev pytest tests/test_fiscal_schema.py tests/test_simplified_danfe.py tests/test_nfe_assinatura.py
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-mcp
          - run: docker build -f apps/fiscal-mcp/Dockerfile -t erp-next-fiscal-mcp:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} .
          - name: Exercise MCP in its restricted runtime container
            shell: bash
            run: |
              docker run --detach --name fiscal-mcp-smoke --network host --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m,mode=1777 --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --cap-drop ALL --memory 512m --pids-limit 128 -e XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/cache erp-next-fiscal-mcp:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              trap 'docker rm -f fiscal-mcp-smoke >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
              cd apps/fiscal-mcp
              uv run --frozen --extra dev python scripts/smoke_runtime.py
          - run: docker save erp-next-fiscal-mcp:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} | gzip > fiscal-mcp-image.tar.gz
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-fiscal-mcp-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: fiscal-mcp-image.tar.gz
              compression-level: 0

    import type { components, paths } from "./generated"

    export type Operation<Path extends ApiPath, Method extends keyof paths[Path]> = NonNullable<paths[Path][Method]>
    export type JsonBody<Path extends ApiPath, Method extends keyof paths[Path]> =
      Operation<Path, Method> extends { requestBody?: { content: { "application/json": infer Body } } } ? Body : never
    export type JsonReply<Path extends ApiPath, Method extends keyof paths[Path], Status extends number = 200> =
      Operation<Path, Method> extends { responses: infer Replies }
        ? Status extends keyof Replies
          ? Replies[Status] extends { content: { "application/json": infer Body } } ? Body : never
          : never
        : never

## Activity

    $ @'
        Produtos sem uma imagem de apresentação não tinham como receber ficha técnica. Agora o cadastro permite criar e editar fabricante, modelo, medidas, peso, bateria, descrição e fontes dos catálogos, mantendo a foto existente. A migração torna a imagem opcional; o campo continua obrigatório no pedido JSON e aceita null explicitamente para evitar remoção acidental por omissão.
        
        O editor compacto funciona na consulta e na edição, preserva rascunhos em conflitos e confere gravações incertas antes de permitir nova tentativa. Os formulários independentes mantêm seus próprios rascunhos e proteções de saída. O cadastro também permite disponibilizar Standard e Olímpico para seleção no fechamento, usando o campo existente de anilheiro.
        
        Validação: regressões da API com PostgreSQL isolado; 37 testes de navegador no build de produção em Brave; 93 testes de modelos; TypeScript; lint sem erros; build local da web e API Linux. Revisão independente realizada e quatro problemas importantes corrigidos com regressões.
        
        A importação operacional é separada do código e usa backup, ensaio com rollback, escopo por empresa/produto e conferência posterior. Não publica o catálogo externo nem altera preços, fotos, dados fiscais, cores ou estoque.

    on:
      workflow_run:
        workflows: [CI]
        types: [completed]
    
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: write

      queue: max
    
    jobs:
      merge:
        if: >-
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository &&
          github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number != null
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          ATTEMPT: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.run_attempt }}
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
        steps:
          - name: Merge the exact candidate approved by scoped CI
            shell: bash
            run: |
              set -euo pipefail
              [[ "$PR" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$RUN_ID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$ATTEMPT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
              [[ "$EXPECTED_HEAD" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]]
    
              candidate=$(gh api "repos/$GH_REPO/pulls/$PR")
              if ! jq -e --arg repo "$GH_REPO" --arg head "$EXPECTED_HEAD" '
                .base.ref == "main" and
                .head.repo.full_name == $repo and .head.sha == $head and
                ((.state == "open" and .mergeable == true) or (.state == "closed" and .merged == true))
              ' <<<"$candidate" >/dev/null; then
                echo '::notice::PR has changed or is not an eligible merge candidate.'
                exit 0
              fi
    
              gh api --paginate "repos/$GH_REPO/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/attempts/$ATTEMPT/jobs" \
                --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name == "gate" and .conclusion == "success") | .id' | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' >/dev/null
              # Find the tested synthetic merge even after the PR has been merged.
              artifacts=$(gh api --paginate "repos/$GH_REPO/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/artifacts" \
                --jq '.artifacts[] | select(.expired == false) | .name')
              mapfile -t matches < <(printf '%s\n' "$artifacts" | grep -E "^erp-mlops-ci-[a-f0-9]{40}-$ATTEMPT$")
              [[ "${#matches[@]}" == 1 ]]
              artifact=${matches[0]}
              tested_merge=${artifact#erp-mlops-ci-}
              tested_merge=${tested_merge%-$ATTEMPT}
              if jq -e '.state == "open"' <<<"$candidate" >/dev/null; then
                [[ "$(jq -er '.merge_commit_sha' <<<"$candidate")" == "$tested_merge" ]]
              fi
              evidence=$(mktemp -d)
              trap 'rm -rf "$evidence"' EXIT
              gh run download "$RUN_ID" --name "$artifact" --dir "$evidence"
              jq -e --arg repo "$GH_REPO" --arg head "$EXPECTED_HEAD" --arg tested "$tested_merge" \
                --argjson run "$RUN_ID" --argjson attempt "$ATTEMPT" '
                  .schema == "avila-mlops-ci-attestation/2" and .repository == $repo and
                  .workflow == "CI" and .event == "pull_request" and .sourceSha == $head and
                  .testedSha == $tested and .runId == $run and .runAttempt == $attempt and
                  .ciGate == "passed" and
                  (.validationScope | keys == ["api", "fiscal", "web"]) and
                  (.validationJobs | keys == ["api", "changes", "fiscal", "web"]) and
                  .validationJobs.changes == "success" and
                  all(.validationScope | to_entries[];
                    (.value | type) == "boolean") and
                  (. as $e | all(["api", "fiscal", "web"][];
                    $e.validationJobs[.] == (if $e.validationScope[.] then "success" else "skipped" end)))
                ' "$evidence/ci-attestation.json" >/dev/null
    
              if jq -e '.state == "open"' <<<"$candidate" >/dev/null; then
                if jq -e '.draft' <<<"$candidate" >/dev/null; then
                  gh pr ready "$PR"
                fi
                # GitHub still enforces the protected branch rules on this merge.
                result=$(gh api --method PUT "repos/$GH_REPO/pulls/$PR/merge" -f sha="$EXPECTED_HEAD" -f merge_method=merge)
                release_sha=$(jq -er 'select(.merged == true) | .sha | select(test("^[a-f0-9]{40}$"))' <<<"$result")
              else

    export type CatalogSource = { title: string; url: string; pdfPage: number | null; printedPage: number | null }
    export type CatalogProfileInput = {
      collection: string; muscleGroup: string; technicalCategory: string; dimensionsMm: number[]
      description: string; weight: string; weightStack: string; mainMediaId: string | null
      manufacturer: string; manufacturerModel: string; catalogProductName: string; liveArea: string
      catalogSources: CatalogSource[]
    }
    export type CatalogProfileData = CatalogProfileInput & { revision: number; publicPath: string }
    export type CatalogAsset = { id: string; variant: string; version: number; width: number; height: number }
    export type CatalogProfileSnapshot = { tenantId: string; productId?: string; canEdit: boolean; data: CatalogProfileData | null; assets: CatalogAsset[]; defaultCollection?: string; mediaConfigured?: boolean }
    
    export function catalogProfileDraft(data: Partial<CatalogProfileData> | null, collection = "core"): CatalogProfileInput {
      return {
        collection: data?.collection || collection,
        muscleGroup: data?.muscleGroup || "", technicalCategory: data?.technicalCategory || "",
        dimensionsMm: data?.dimensionsMm?.slice(0, 3) || [0, 0, 0],
        description: data?.description || "", weight: data?.weight || "", weightStack: data?.weightStack || "",
        mainMediaId: data?.mainMediaId || null, manufacturer: data?.manufacturer || "",
        manufacturerModel: data?.manufacturerModel || "", catalogProductName: data?.catalogProductName || "",
        liveArea: data?.liveArea || "",
        catalogSources: (data?.catalogSources || []).map(source => ({ title: source.title, url: source.url, pdfPage: source.pdfPage ?? null, printedPage: source.printedPage ?? null })),
      }
    }
    
    export const sameCatalogProfile = (left: CatalogProfileInput, right: CatalogProfileInput) => JSON.stringify(left) === JSON.stringify(right)
    
    export function catalogSourceLink(value: string): string | undefined {
      try { const url = new URL(value); return url.protocol === "https:" && !url.username && !url.password ? value : undefined } catch { return undefined }
    }

    $ @'
        Produtos sem uma imagem de apresentação não tinham como receber ficha técnica. Agora o cadastro permite criar e editar fabricante, modelo, medidas, peso, bateria, descrição e fontes dos catálogos, mantendo a foto existente. A migração torna a imagem opcional; mainMediaId continua obrigatório no JSON e aceita null explicitamente para evitar remoção acidental por omissão.
        
        O editor compacto funciona na consulta e na edição, preserva rascunhos em conflitos e confere gravações incertas antes de permitir nova tentativa. Os formulários independentes mantêm seus próprios rascunhos e proteções de saída. O cadastro também permite disponibilizar Standard e Olímpico para seleção no fechamento, usando o campo existente de anilheiro.
        
        Validação concluída: 37 testes de navegador no build de produção em Brave; 93 testes de modelos; TypeScript; lint sem erros; build local da web. Três testes novos da API e a compatibilidade anterior passaram antes da revisão independente. Quatro problemas importantes da revisão foram corrigidos com regressões: três de recuperação de edição já passaram; a regressão final para omissão de mainMediaId está compilando localmente e será validada também pelo CI completo antes da integração. O pacote final da API Linux ainda está em preparação. Este PR começa como rascunho enquanto essas verificações terminam.
        
        A importação operacional é separada do código e usa backup, ensaio com rollback, escopo por empresa/produto e conferência posterior. Não publica o catálogo externo nem altera preços, fotos, dados fiscais, cores ou estoque.

        Produtos sem uma imagem de apresentação não tinham como receber ficha técnica. Agora o cadastro permite criar e editar fabricante, modelo, medidas, peso, bateria, descrição e fontes dos catálogos, mantendo a foto existente. A migração torna a imagem opcional; mainMediaId continua obrigatório no JSON e aceita null explicitamente para evitar remoção acidental por omissão.
        
        O editor compacto funciona na consulta e na edição, preserva rascunhos em conflitos e confere gravações incertas antes de permitir nova tentativa. Os formulários independentes mantêm seus próprios rascunhos e proteções de saída. O cadastro também permite disponibilizar Standard e Olímpico para seleção no fechamento, usando o campo existente de anilheiro.
        
        Validação: CI completo aprovado (API, web e gate; fiscal explicitamente fora do escopo); 11 testes locais da API incluindo compatibilidade e segurança do catálogo; 37 testes de navegador no build de produção em Brave; 93 testes de modelos; TypeScript; lint sem erros; build local da web.
