    export function NfeRecipientPicker({ tenant, onApply }: { tenant: string; onApply: (recipient: DraftInput["recipient"]) => void }) {
      const [query, setQuery] = useState("")
      const [rows, setRows] = useState<Schema<"Party">[]>([])
      const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
      const [message, setMessage] = useState("")
      const active = useRef<AbortController | null>(null)
      useEffect(() => () => active.current?.abort(), [tenant])
      async function search() {
        active.current?.abort()
        const controller = new AbortController(); active.current = controller
        setBusy(true); setMessage(""); setRows([])
        try {
          const response = await erpFetch(`/api/erp/parties?role=customer&status=active&limit=20&q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`, { signal: controller.signal })
          const value = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(value.title || "Não foi possível buscar os clientes")
          if (value.tenantId !== tenant) throw new Error("A empresa da sessão mudou. Reabra a nota.")
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) { setRows(value.data); if (!value.data.length) setMessage("Nenhum cliente encontrado. Você pode preencher manualmente.") }
        } catch (reason) { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setMessage(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Consulta indisponível") }
        finally { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setBusy(false) }
      }
      async function choose(id: string) {
        active.current?.abort()
        const controller = new AbortController(); active.current = controller
        setBusy(true); setMessage("")
        try {
          const [response, meResponse] = await Promise.all([erpFetch(`/api/erp/parties/${id}`, { signal: controller.signal }), erpFetch("/api/erp/me", { signal: controller.signal })])
          const [value, me] = await Promise.all([response.json(), meResponse.json()])
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(value.title || "Não foi possível abrir o cliente")
          if (!meResponse.ok || me.tenant?.id !== tenant || value.tenantId !== tenant) throw new Error("A empresa da sessão mudou. Reabra a nota.")
          const party: Schema<"Party"> = value.data
          const addresses: PartyAddress[] = party.addresses || []
          const address = addresses.find(item => item.primary) || (addresses.length === 1 ? addresses[0] : undefined)
          if (controller.signal.aborted) return
          onApply({ taxId: party.taxId, legalName: party.legalName, state: address?.state || "", municipalityCode: validMunicipalityCode(address?.municipalityCode, address?.state || "") ? address!.municipalityCode! : "", postalCode: address?.postalCode.replace(/\D/g, "") || "", street: address?.street || "", number: address?.number || "", district: address?.district || "", complement: address?.complement || null, phone: party.phone?.replace(/\D/g, "") || null, email: party.email || null, cityName: address?.city || null })
          setRows([]); setMessage("Cadastro copiado. Confira o endereço e o código IBGE do destinatário.")
        } catch (reason) { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setMessage(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Consulta indisponível") }
        finally { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setBusy(false) }
      }
      return <div className="space-y-3 rounded-lg border bg-muted/20 p-3"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2"><label className="grid min-w-0 flex-1 gap-2 text-sm">Buscar cliente cadastrado<Input value={query} onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)} placeholder="Nome ou CPF/CNPJ" /></label><Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={busy || !query.trim()} onClick={() => void search()}>{busy ? "Consultando…" : "Buscar cliente"}</Button></div>{rows.length > 0 && <ul className="space-y-2">{rows.map(row => <li key={row.id}><Button className="h-auto max-w-full whitespace-normal text-left" type="button" variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void choose(row.id)}>Usar {row.legalName} · {row.taxId}</Button></li>)}</ul>}{message && <p role="status" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{message}</p>}</div>
    }
    
    export function NfeMunicipalityLookup({ tenant, recipient, onResolveMunicipality }: { tenant: string; recipient: DraftInput["recipient"]; onResolveMunicipality: (expected: DraftInput["recipient"], code: string) => void }) {
      const [municipalityMessage, setMunicipalityMessage] = useState("")
      const resolve = useRef(onResolveMunicipality)
      useEffect(() => { resolve.current = onResolveMunicipality })
      useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController()
        const expected = { ...recipient }
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          setMunicipalityMessage("")
          if (!resolve.current || expected.municipalityCode.trim() || !/^\d{8}$/.test(expected.postalCode.replace(/\D/g, "")) || !expected.cityName?.trim() || expected.state.length !== 2 || expected.state === "EX") return
          setMunicipalityMessage("Conferindo o código IBGE pelo CEP…")
          void lookupMunicipalityCode(expected, tenant, controller.signal, erpFetch).then(code => {
            if (controller.signal.aborted) return
            if (code) resolve.current?.(expected, code)
            setMunicipalityMessage(code ? "Código IBGE conferido pelo CEP. Revise antes de salvar." : "Não foi possível confirmar o código IBGE para este endereço. Confira e preencha manualmente.")
          }).catch(() => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setMunicipalityMessage("Consulta de CEP indisponível. Informe o código IBGE manualmente.") })
        }, 300)
        return () => { clearTimeout(timer); controller.abort() }
      }, [tenant, recipient])
      return municipalityMessage ? <p role="status" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{municipalityMessage}</p> : null
    }

    export const blankTaxDeclaration = (): TaxDeclaration => ({ recipientTaxpayer: null, recipientStateRegistration: null, finalConsumer: null, icmsRate: null, pisRate: null, cofinsRate: null, ipiCst: null, ipiFrameCode: null, ipiRate: null, ipiInIcmsBase: null, icmsOutOfContributions: null, ibsCbs: { cst: "", classCode: "", ibsStateRate: "", ibsCityRate: "", cbsRate: "" } })
    export const blankIbptItem = (): IbptDraftItem => ({ ex: "", origin: "", version: null })
    
    export function fixed(value: string, scale: number, wholeDigits: number): string {
      const match = /^(\d+)(?:[.,](\d+))?$/.exec(value.trim())
      if (!match || (match[2]?.length ?? 0) > scale) throw new Error(`Informe um decimal positivo com até ${scale} casas`)
      const whole = BigInt(match[1]).toString()
      if (whole.length > wholeDigits) throw new Error("Valor acima do limite fiscal")
      return `${whole}.${(match[2] || "").padEnd(scale, "0")}`
    }
    const scaled = (value: string) => BigInt(value.replace(".", ""))
    const cents = (value: bigint) => `${value / BigInt(100)}.${(value % BigInt(100)).toString().padStart(2, "0")}`
    
    export function itemTotal(quantity: string, price: string): string {
      return cents((scaled(fixed(quantity, 4, 11)) * scaled(fixed(price, 10, 11)) + BigInt(500_000_000_000)) / BigInt(1_000_000_000_000))
    }
    
    export function productsTotal(items: DraftItem[]): string {
      return cents(items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + scaled(itemTotal(item.quantity, item.unitPrice)), BigInt(0)))
    }
    
    function percent(value: string): string {
      const result = fixed(value, 4, 2)
      if (scaled(result) >= BigInt(1_000_000)) throw new Error("A alíquota percentual deve ser menor que 100")
      return result
    }
    
    export function invoiceTotal(draft: DraftInput): string {
      const ipiRate = draft.taxDeclaration?.ipiRate
      const rate = ipiRate ? scaled(percent(ipiRate)) : BigInt(0)
      return cents(draft.items.reduce((sum, item) => {
        const product = commercialItemCents(item)
        return sum + product + (product * rate + BigInt(500_000)) / BigInt(1_000_000)
      }, BigInt(0)))
    }
    
    function commercialItemCents(item: DraftItem): bigint {
      const gross = scaled(itemTotal(item.quantity, item.unitPrice))
      const freight = scaled(fixed(item.freightAmount || "0", 2, 13))
      const discount = scaled(fixed(item.discountAmount || "0", 2, 13))
      const insurance = scaled(fixed(item.insuranceAmount || "0", 2, 13))
      const other = scaled(fixed(item.otherAmount || "0", 2, 13))
      const net = gross + freight + insurance + other - discount
      if (discount > gross || net <= BigInt(0)) throw new Error("Confira o desconto e o total do item com frete")
      return net
    }
    
    function declaredTaxes(declaration: TaxDeclaration): Schema<"TaxDeclaration"> {
      for (const field of ["recipientTaxpayer", "finalConsumer", "ipiInIcmsBase", "icmsOutOfContributions"] as const) {
        if (typeof declaration[field] !== "boolean") throw new Error("Declare contribuinte, consumidor final e composição das bases conforme a instrução fiscal")
      }
      return {
        ...declaration,
        recipientTaxpayer: declaration.recipientTaxpayer === true,
        finalConsumer: declaration.finalConsumer === true,
        ipiInIcmsBase: declaration.ipiInIcmsBase === true,
        icmsOutOfContributions: declaration.icmsOutOfContributions === true,
        icmsRate: declaration.icmsRate ? percent(declaration.icmsRate) : null,
        pisRate: declaration.pisRate ? percent(declaration.pisRate) : null,
        cofinsRate: declaration.cofinsRate ? percent(declaration.cofinsRate) : null,
        ...(declaration.destinationIcmsRate ? { destinationIcmsRate: percent(declaration.destinationIcmsRate) } : {}),
        ...(declaration.destinationFcpRate ? { destinationFcpRate: percent(declaration.destinationFcpRate) } : {}),
        ipiRate: declaration.ipiRate ? percent(declaration.ipiRate) : null,
        ibsCbs: { ...declaration.ibsCbs, ibsStateRate: percent(declaration.ibsCbs.ibsStateRate), ibsCityRate: percent(declaration.ibsCbs.ibsCityRate), cbsRate: percent(declaration.ibsCbs.cbsRate) },
      }
    }
    
    export function submission(draft: DraftInput): Schema<"DraftInput"> {
      const { taxDeclaration, ibpt, ...input } = draft

        input.transport = { ...emptyTransport(), ...input.transport }
        for (const key of ["netWeight", "grossWeight"] as const) if (input.transport[key]) input.transport[key] = fixed(input.transport[key]!, 3, 12)
      }

    export type ProductInput = Schema<"ProductInput">
    export type ProductCommand = { key: string; body: string }
    export type ProductDraft = { version: 1; draft: ProductInput; baseline: string; etag: string; uncertain: boolean; conflict: boolean; command: ProductCommand | null }
    
    function isProductInput(value: unknown): value is ProductInput {
      if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return false
      const input = value as Record<string, unknown>
      return ([ ["sku", 80], ["name", 200], ["unit", 6], ["basePrice", 15] ] as const).every(([field, max]) => typeof input[field] === "string" && input[field].length <= max)
        && (input.ncm === null || (typeof input.ncm === "string" && input.ncm.length <= 8))
        && (input.cest === null || (typeof input.cest === "string" && input.cest.length <= 7))
        && (input.status === "active" || input.status === "archived")
        && (input.plateHolderType === undefined || input.plateHolderType === "" || input.plateHolderType === "standard" || input.plateHolderType === "olympic")
        && (input.categoryId === undefined || (typeof input.categoryId === "string" && (input.categoryId === "" || /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(input.categoryId))))
        && [input.structureColors, input.upholsteryColors, input.plateHolderColors, input.plateHolderTypes].every(colors => colors === undefined || (Array.isArray(colors) && colors.every(color => typeof color === "string") && colors.join("\n").length <= 1951))
        && (input.photoDataUrl === undefined || (typeof input.photoDataUrl === "string" && input.photoDataUrl.length <= 349000))
    }
    
    export function readProductDraft(key: string): { value: ProductDraft | null; error: string } {
      try {
        const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(key)
        if (!raw) return { value: null, error: "" }
        // A draft may retain the photo in the edit, baseline and pending command.
        if (raw.length > 1_100_000) throw new Error("Invalid draft")
        const value = JSON.parse(raw) as ProductDraft
        if (value.version !== 1 || !isProductInput(value.draft) || typeof value.baseline !== "string" || !isProductInput(JSON.parse(value.baseline))
          || typeof value.etag !== "string" || typeof value.uncertain !== "boolean" || typeof value.conflict !== "boolean") throw new Error("Invalid draft")
        if (value.command !== null && (typeof value.command?.key !== "string" || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(value.command.key)
          || typeof value.command.body !== "string" || !isProductInput(JSON.parse(value.command.body)))) throw new Error("Invalid command")
        if (value.uncertain && !value.command) throw new Error("Missing command")
        return { value, error: "" }
      } catch {
        return { value: null, error: "Não foi possível recuperar o rascunho desta aba. Confira se houve gravação antes de descartar ou iniciar outra edição." }
      }
    }
    
    export function writeProductDraft(key: string, value: ProductDraft | null): boolean {
      try {
        if (value) sessionStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value))
        else sessionStorage.removeItem(key)
        return true
      } catch { return false }
    }

    type Guard = () => string | null
    type NavigationGuard = { register: (guard: Guard) => () => void; confirmNavigation: () => boolean; allowNextUnload: () => () => void }
    const NavigationGuardContext = createContext<NavigationGuard>({ register: () => () => {}, confirmNavigation: () => true, allowNextUnload: () => () => {} })
    
    export function NavigationGuardProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
      const activeGuards = useRef(new Set<Guard>())
      const approvedUnload = useRef(false)
      const allowNextUnload = useCallback(() => {
        approvedUnload.current = true
        return () => { approvedUnload.current = false }
      }, [])
      const register = useCallback((guard: Guard) => {
        activeGuards.current.add(guard)
        return () => { activeGuards.current.delete(guard) }
      }, [])
      const confirmNavigation = useCallback(() => {
        for (const guard of activeGuards.current) {
          const message = guard()
          if (message) return window.confirm(message)
        }
        return true
      }, [])

        window.addEventListener("beforeunload", beforeUnload)
        return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", beforeUnload)
      }, [])
      const value = useMemo(() => ({ register, confirmNavigation, allowNextUnload }), [register, confirmNavigation, allowNextUnload])
      return <NavigationGuardContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</NavigationGuardContext.Provider>
    }

      const { register } = useContext(NavigationGuardContext)
      useEffect(() => register(() => message), [message, register])

      return <NextLink {...props} href={href} onNavigate={event => {
        if (!confirmNavigation()) { event.preventDefault(); return }
        onNavigate?.(event)
      }} />

    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    # Begin one task of an inline plan execution in a single call: extract the
    # task's brief (via subagent-driven-development's task-brief, so both skills
    # share one workspace) and record BASE, the commit the task's review range is
    # cut from. One tool call instead of two, because every call in an inline
    # session is a turn that re-reads the whole context.
    #
    # Usage: task-start PLAN_FILE TASK_NUMBER
    # Prints:
    #   brief: <path to the task's brief file>
    #   base:  <full SHA of HEAD>
    set -euo pipefail
    
    if [ $# -ne 2 ]; then
      echo "usage: task-start PLAN_FILE TASK_NUMBER" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
    
    plan=$1
    n=$2
    sdd="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../subagent-driven-development/scripts" && pwd)"
    
    out=$("$sdd/task-brief" "$plan" "$n")
    brief=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n 's/^wrote \(.*\): [0-9][0-9]* lines$/\1/p')
    [ -n "$brief" ] || { echo "task-brief did not report a path: $out" >&2; exit 1; }
    
    echo "brief: $brief"
    echo "base: $(git rev-parse HEAD)"

    # Clientes e fornecedores: dados fiscais e recuperação
    
    Execução autorizada pelo usuário em 12/11/2026, após a auditoria dos cadastros. Este documento registra decisões de implementação; não representa revisão separada pelo usuário.
    
    O cadastro deve guardar a classificação ICMS declarada (1 contribuinte, 2 contribuinte isento, 9 não contribuinte) e a IE. Ausência de informação permanece desconhecida. A consulta de CNPJ não declara situação tributária. `fiscal` omitido preserva o valor no PUT; null limpa; objeto substitui atomicamente. Registros antigos continuam válidos. Revisão, permissões, isolamento por empresa, auditoria e idempotência existentes são preservados.
    
    Edições ficam em sessionStorage, isoladas por empresa, sessão e cadastro. Recuperação conserva a revisão original, o comando POST e sua chave, inclusive após resposta perdida. Conteúdo inválido ou armazenamento indisponível gera mensagem e impede um novo POST sem proteção. Navegação pede confirmação quando há edição, gravação pendente ou resultado incerto. Respostas tardias não podem navegar ou gravar rascunhos de outra instância.
    
    A seleção de cliente na NF-e copia a classificação declarada, sem inferir alíquotas, CFOP, consumidor final ou regime. Indicador desconhecido continua exigindo preenchimento. O motor mantém compatibilidade com o booleano legado; indicador explícito deve ser consistente com ele. Isento não envia IE; não contribuinte pode ter IE. NFC-e e exterior mantêm seus recortes. Referências: XSD oficial vendorizado leiauteNFe_v4.00.xsd e MOC 7, https://www.confaz.fazenda.gov.br/legislacao/arquivo-manuais/moc7-anexo-i-leiaute-e-rv.pdf.
    
    O pacote inclui testes de contrato e navegador, publicação verificável e preenchimento IBGE apenas quando CEP, município e UF conferirem. Nenhuma inscrição ou classificação fiscal real será inventada. Demais pacotes continuam: custos/tabelas com fonte, categorias/subcategorias, Core com fonte própria, acabamentos independentes fiéis ao catálogo, importação/exportação ampliada e aceitação integrada.

    async fn permissions(admin: &PgPool) {
        sqlx::raw_sql("INSERT INTO role_permissions(role_id,permission_code) SELECT '99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999'::uuid,code FROM permissions WHERE code LIKE 'catalog.parties.%'; INSERT INTO role_permissions(role_id,permission_code) VALUES ('aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa','catalog.parties.read');").execute(admin).await.unwrap();

    #[expect(
        clippy::too_many_arguments,
        reason = "HTTP isolation tests keep tenant, identity and preconditions explicit"
    )]
    async fn call(
        router: &Router,
        method: &str,
        uri: &str,
        tenant: &str,
        subject: &str,
        etag: Option<&str>,
        key: Option<Uuid>,
        body: Value,
    ) -> (StatusCode, HeaderMap, Value) {
        let mut request = Request::builder()
            .method(method)
            .uri(uri)
            .header("x-tenant-id", tenant)
            .header("content-type", "application/json");
        if !subject.is_empty() {
            request = request.header("authorization", format!("Bearer {subject}"));
        }
        if let Some(value) = etag {
            request = request.header("if-match", value);
        }
        if let Some(value) = key {
            request = request.header("idempotency-key", value.to_string());
        }
        let response = router
            .clone()
            .oneshot(request.body(Body::from(body.to_string())).unwrap())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let (parts, body) = response.into_parts();
        let bytes = to_bytes(body, 1_000_000).await.unwrap();
        (
            parts.status,
            parts.headers,
            serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).unwrap_or(Value::Null),
        )
    }

    import type { PartyDraft, PartyCnpjProvenance } from "./party-cnpj"
    
    export type PartyCommand = { key: string; body: string }
    export type StoredPartyDraft = { version: 1; draft: PartyDraft; baseline: string; etag: string; uncertain: boolean; conflict: boolean; command: PartyCommand | null; provenance: PartyCnpjProvenance }
    const object = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> => !!value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)
    const text = (value: unknown, max: number) => typeof value === "string" && value.length <= max
    const optional = (value: unknown, max: number) => value == null || text(value, max)
    
    function address(value: unknown) {
      return object(value) && text(value.label, 80) && text(value.postalCode, 12) && text(value.state, 2) && text(value.city, 200)
        && text(value.street, 200) && text(value.number, 40) && text(value.district, 100) && optional(value.complement, 200)
        && optional(value.municipalityCode, 7) && typeof value.primary === "boolean"
    }
    
    function party(value: unknown): value is PartyDraft {
      if (!object(value)) return false
      const fields = ["personType", "legalName", "tradeName", "taxId", "email", "phone", "isCustomer", "isSupplier", "status", "addresses", "contacts", "fiscal"]
      const fiscal = value.fiscal
      return Object.keys(value).every(key => fields.includes(key)) && ["fisica", "juridica"].includes(String(value.personType))
        && text(value.legalName, 200) && optional(value.tradeName, 200) && text(value.taxId, 30) && optional(value.email, 254) && optional(value.phone, 40)
        && typeof value.isCustomer === "boolean" && typeof value.isSupplier === "boolean" && ["active", "archived"].includes(String(value.status))
        && Array.isArray(value.addresses) && value.addresses.length <= 10 && value.addresses.every(address)
        && Array.isArray(value.contacts) && value.contacts.length <= 10 && value.contacts.every(item => object(item) && text(item.name, 200) && optional(item.role, 100) && optional(item.email, 254) && optional(item.phone, 40) && typeof item.primary === "boolean")
        && (fiscal == null || object(fiscal) && Object.keys(fiscal).every(key => ["taxpayerIndicator", "stateRegistration"].includes(key)) && ["1", "2", "9"].includes(String(fiscal.taxpayerIndicator)) && optional(fiscal.stateRegistration, 14))
    }
    
    function canonical(value: unknown): unknown {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(canonical)
      if (object(value)) return Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(value).sort().map(key => [key, canonical(value[key])]))
      return value
    }
    export const samePartyDraft = (left: PartyDraft, right: PartyDraft) => JSON.stringify(canonical(left)) === JSON.stringify(canonical(right))
    
    export function readPartyDraft(key: string): { value: StoredPartyDraft | null; error: string } {
      try {
        const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(key)
        if (!raw) return { value: null, error: "" }
        if (raw.length > 100_000) throw new Error("Oversized draft")
        const value = JSON.parse(raw) as StoredPartyDraft
        if (value.version !== 1 || !party(value.draft) || !text(value.baseline, 40_000) || !party(JSON.parse(value.baseline))
          || !text(value.etag, 80) || typeof value.uncertain !== "boolean" || typeof value.conflict !== "boolean") throw new Error("Invalid draft")
        if (!object(value.provenance) || !object(value.provenance.fields) || !Object.entries(value.provenance.fields).every(([key, field]) => ["legalName", "tradeName", "email", "phone"].includes(key) && text(field, 254))
          || value.provenance.address !== null && !address(value.provenance.address)) throw new Error("Invalid provenance")
        if (value.command !== null && (!object(value.command) || !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(value.command.key)
          || !text(value.command.body, 40_000) || !party(JSON.parse(value.command.body)) || !samePartyDraft(value.draft, JSON.parse(value.command.body)))) throw new Error("Invalid command")
        if (value.uncertain && !value.command) throw new Error("Missing command")
        return { value, error: "" }
      } catch {
        return { value: null, error: "Não foi possível recuperar o rascunho desta aba. Confira se houve gravação antes de descartar a edição." }
      }
    }
    
    export function writePartyDraft(key: string, value: StoredPartyDraft | null): boolean {
      try {
        if (value) sessionStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value))
        else sessionStorage.removeItem(key)
        return true
      } catch { return false }
    }
    
    export function recoverPartyDraft(value: StoredPartyDraft | null, server: PartyDraft, etag: string, existing: boolean): { value: StoredPartyDraft | null; confirmed: boolean } {
      if (!value) return { value: null, confirmed: false }
      if (existing && value.conflict && value.command && etag !== value.etag && samePartyDraft(server, JSON.parse(value.command.body))) return { value: null, confirmed: true }
      return { value: { ...value, conflict: value.conflict || existing && etag !== value.etag }, confirmed: false }

    fn text(value: &mut String, max: usize) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        *value = value.trim().to_owned();
        if value.is_empty() || value.chars().count() > max || value.chars().any(char::is_control) {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Endereço ou contato contém texto obrigatório vazio, inválido ou acima do limite",
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    fn optional(value: &mut Option<String>, max: usize) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        *value = value
            .as_deref()
            .map(str::trim)
            .filter(|v| !v.is_empty())
            .map(str::to_owned);
        if let Some(value) = value {
            text(value, max)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

        let factor = 10_i64.pow(scale);

            value / factor,
            value % factor,
            width = scale as usize

    pub fn response(status: StatusCode, revision: Option<i64>, value: impl Serialize) -> Response {
        let mut reply = (status, Json(value)).into_response();
        reply
            .headers_mut()
            .insert(header::CACHE_CONTROL, HeaderValue::from_static("no-store"));
        if let Some(value) = revision {
            reply.headers_mut().insert(
                header::ETAG,
                HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("\"{value}\"")).expect("integer ETag"),
            );
        }
        reply
    }

    import assert from "node:assert/strict"
    import { test } from "node:test"
    import { blankDraft, blankTaxDeclaration, applyRecipientFiscal } from "../src/features/fiscal/nfe-draft-model.ts"
    
    test("client fiscal selection preserves tax rates and copies the explicit indicator without assuming final consumer", () => {
      const draft = { ...blankDraft(), taxDeclaration: { ...blankTaxDeclaration(), icmsRate: "18", finalConsumer: null } }
      const result = applyRecipientFiscal(draft, { taxpayerIndicator: "2", stateRegistration: null }, 3)
      assert.equal(result.taxDeclaration.recipientTaxpayerIndicator, "2")
      assert.equal(result.taxDeclaration.recipientTaxpayer, true)
      assert.equal(result.taxDeclaration.recipientStateRegistration, null)
      assert.equal(result.taxDeclaration.icmsRate, "18")
      assert.equal(result.taxDeclaration.finalConsumer, null)
      assert.equal(draft.taxDeclaration.recipientTaxpayer, null)
    })
    
    test("a new client with unknown status clears the previous client's fiscal identity", () => {
      const draft = applyRecipientFiscal(blankDraft(), { taxpayerIndicator: "1", stateRegistration: "110042490114" }, 3)
      const result = applyRecipientFiscal(draft, null, 3)
      assert.equal(result.taxDeclaration.recipientTaxpayer, null)
      assert.equal(result.taxDeclaration.recipientTaxpayerIndicator, undefined)
      assert.equal(result.taxDeclaration.recipientStateRegistration, null)
    })
    
    test("recipient selection does not add a CRT3 declaration to Simples, and NFC-e retains its non-taxpayer scope", () => {
      assert.equal(applyRecipientFiscal(blankDraft(), { taxpayerIndicator: "1", stateRegistration: "110042490114" }, 1).taxDeclaration, undefined)
      const draft = { ...blankDraft(), model: 65, taxDeclaration: blankTaxDeclaration() }
      const result = applyRecipientFiscal(draft, { taxpayerIndicator: "2", stateRegistration: null }, 3)
      assert.equal(result.taxDeclaration.recipientTaxpayerIndicator, "9")
      assert.equal(result.taxDeclaration.recipientTaxpayer, false)
      assert.equal(result.taxDeclaration.recipientStateRegistration, null)
    })

      await page.route(/\/api\/erp\/parties\?/, route => route.fulfill({ json: { tenantId: tenant, canEdit: true, data: [], total: 0 } }))
    }
    async function fill(page: Page) {
      await page.getByLabel("Tipo de pessoa", { exact: true }).selectOption("fisica")
      await page.getByLabel("CPF ou CNPJ", { exact: true }).fill("52998224725")
      await page.getByLabel("Nome ou razão social", { exact: true }).fill("Pessoa declarada")

        writes.push({ body: route.request().postData()!, key: route.request().headers()["idempotency-key"] })
        if (writes.length === 1) await route.abort()
        else await route.fulfill({ status: 201, headers: { ETag: '"1"' }, json: { tenantId: tenant, canEdit: true, data: { ...JSON.parse(writes[0].body), id: record, revision: 1 } } })
      })
      await page.route(`**/api/erp/parties/${record}`, route => route.fulfill({ headers: { ETag: '"1"' }, json: { tenantId: tenant, canEdit: true, data: { ...blank(), personType: "fisica", id: record, revision: 1 } } }))
      await page.goto(`${root}/novo`)
      await fill(page)
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Salvar pessoa", exact: true }).click()
      await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Conferir gravação", exact: true })).toBeVisible()
      page.once("dialog", dialog => dialog.accept())
      await page.reload()
      await expect(page.getByLabel("Nome ou razão social", { exact: true })).toBeDisabled()
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Conferir gravação", exact: true }).click()
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`${record}$`))
      expect(writes).toHaveLength(2)
      expect(writes[1]).toEqual(writes[0])
    })
    
    test("revisão alterada no servidor preserva edição local e bloqueia sobrescrita", async ({ page }) => {
      await fixture(page)
      let revision = 1
      const writes: string[] = []
      await page.route(`**/api/erp/parties/${record}`, route => {
        if (route.request().method() !== "GET") writes.push(route.request().method())
        return route.fulfill({ headers: { ETag: `"${revision}"` }, json: { tenantId: tenant, canEdit: true, data: { ...blank(), id: record, revision } } })
      })
      await page.goto(`${root}/${record}/editar`)
      await page.getByLabel("Nome ou razão social", { exact: true }).fill("Edição preservada")
      await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => Object.values(sessionStorage).some(raw => raw.includes("Edição preservada")))).toBe(true)
      revision = 2
      page.once("dialog", dialog => dialog.accept())
      await page.reload()
      await expect(page.getByLabel("Nome ou razão social", { exact: true })).toHaveValue("Edição preservada")
      await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Salvar pessoa", exact: true })).toBeDisabled()
      await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Recarregar cadastro", exact: true })).toBeVisible()
      expect(writes).toEqual([])
    })
    
    test("armazenamento bloqueado impede POST e informa como preservar os dados", async ({ page }) => {
      await page.addInitScript(() => { Storage.prototype.setItem = function () { throw new DOMException("Quota exceeded", "QuotaExceededError") } })
      await fixture(page)
      const writes: string[] = []
      await page.route(/\/api\/erp\/parties$/, route => { writes.push(route.request().method()); return route.fulfill({ status: 500, json: {} }) })
      await page.goto(`${root}/novo`)
      await fill(page)
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Salvar pessoa", exact: true }).click()
      await expect(page.getByText("Não foi possível proteger a gravação nesta aba. Libere o armazenamento do navegador e tente novamente.")).toBeVisible()
      expect(writes).toEqual([])
    })

            file.sync_all().expect("sync OpenAPI artifact");
        }
    }

    name: systematic-debugging
    description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
    ---
    
    # Systematic Debugging
    
    ## Overview
    
    **Core principle:** ALWAYS find root cause before attempting fixes. Symptom fixes are failure.
    
    **Violating the letter of this process is violating the spirit of debugging.**
    
    ## The Iron Law
    
    ```
    NO FIXES WITHOUT ROOT CAUSE INVESTIGATION FIRST
    ```
    
    If you haven't completed Phase 1, you cannot propose fixes.
    
    ## When to Use
    
    Use for ANY technical issue:
    - Test failures
    - Bugs in production
    - Unexpected behavior
    - Performance problems
    - Build failures
    - Integration issues
    
    **Use this ESPECIALLY when:**
    - Under time pressure (emergencies make guessing tempting)
    - "Just one quick fix" seems obvious
    - You've already tried multiple fixes
    - Previous fix didn't work
    - You don't fully understand the issue
    
    **Don't skip when:**
    - Issue seems simple (simple bugs have root causes too)
    - You're in a hurry (rushing guarantees rework)
    - Manager wants it fixed NOW (systematic is faster than thrashing)
    
    ## The Four Phases
    
    You MUST complete each phase before proceeding to the next.
    
    ### Phase 1: Root Cause Investigation
    
    **BEFORE attempting ANY fix:**
    
    1. **Read Error Messages Carefully**
       - Don't skip past errors or warnings
       - They often contain the exact solution
       - Read stack traces completely
       - Note line numbers, file paths, error codes
    
    2. **Reproduce Consistently**
       - Can you trigger it reliably?
       - What are the exact steps?
       - Does it happen every time?
       - If not reproducible → gather more data, don't guess
    
    3. **Check Recent Changes**
       - What changed that could cause this?
       - Git diff, recent commits
       - New dependencies, config changes
       - Environmental differences
    
    4. **Gather Evidence in Multi-Component Systems**
    
       **WHEN system has multiple components (CI → build → signing, API → service → database):**
    
       **BEFORE proposing fixes, add diagnostic instrumentation:**
       ```
       For EACH component boundary:
         - Log what data enters component
         - Log what data exits component
         - Verify environment/config propagation
         - Check state at each layer
    
       Run once to gather evidence showing WHERE it breaks
       THEN analyze evidence to identify failing component
       THEN investigate that specific component
       ```
    
       **Example (multi-layer system):**
       ```bash
       # Layer 1: Workflow
       echo "=== Secrets available in workflow: ==="
       echo "IDENTITY: $([ -n "${IDENTITY:-}" ] && echo SET || echo UNSET)"
    
       # Layer 2: Build script
       echo "=== Env vars in build script: ==="
       printenv IDENTITY >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "IDENTITY in environment" || echo "IDENTITY not in environment"
    
       # Layer 3: Signing script
       echo "=== Keychain state: ==="
       security list-keychains
       security find-identity -v
    
       # Layer 4: Actual signing
       codesign --sign "$IDENTITY" --verbose=4 "$APP"
       ```
    
       **This reveals:** Which layer fails (secrets → workflow ✓, workflow → build ✗)
    
    5. **Trace Data Flow**
    
       **WHEN error is deep in call stack:**
    
       See `root-cause-tracing.md` in this directory for the complete backward tracing technique.
    
       **Quick version:**
       - Where does bad value originate?
       - What called this with bad value?
       - Keep tracing up until you find the source
       - Fix at source, not at symptom
    
    ### Phase 2: Pattern Analysis
    
    **Find the pattern before fixing:**
    
    1. **Find Working Examples**
       - Locate similar working code in same codebase

    "use client"
    
    import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
    import { erpFetch } from "@/lib/api/client"
    import type { Schema } from "@/lib/api/types"
    
    type Category = Schema<"Reference">
    type CategoryList = Schema<"ReferenceList">
    
    export function ProductCategory({ value, onChange, disabled = false, all = false }: {
      value: string; onChange: (value: string) => void; disabled?: boolean; all?: boolean
    }) {
      const [categories, setCategories] = useState<Category[]>([])
      const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      useEffect(() => {
        const controller = new AbortController()
        async function load() {
          const records: Category[] = []
          let offset = 0
          for (;;) {
            const response = await erpFetch(`/api/erp/product-categories?limit=100&offset=${offset}`, { signal: controller.signal, cache: "no-store" })
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Categorias indisponíveis. O vínculo atual será preservado.")
            const page: CategoryList = await response.json()
            records.push(...page.data)
            offset += page.data.length
            if (offset >= page.total) break
            if (!page.data.length) throw new Error("Não foi possível carregar todas as categorias.")
          }
          if (!controller.signal.aborted) setCategories(records)
        }
        load().catch(reason => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(reason.message) })
          .finally(() => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false) })
        return () => controller.abort()
      }, [])
      return <label className="min-w-0 space-y-1 sm:space-y-2">Categoria
        <select name="category_id" className="block h-10 w-full max-w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3" value={value} disabled={disabled || loading || !!error} onChange={event => onChange(event.target.value)}>
          <option value="">{all ? "Todas as categorias" : "Sem categoria"}</option>
          {value && !categories.some(category => category.id === value) && <option value={value}>Categoria atual ({value})</option>}
          {categories.filter(category => all || category.status === "active" || category.id === value).map(category => <option key={category.id} value={category.id}>{category.name}{category.status === "archived" ? " (arquivada)" : ""}</option>)}
        </select>
        {error && <span role="status" className="block text-sm text-muted-foreground">{error}</span>}
      </label>
    }

          </div>
          <form className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/30 p-4" onSubmit={event => { event.preventDefault(); setQuery({ ...filters, q: filters.q.trim(), offset: 0 }) }}>

            <label className="min-w-[130px] space-y-2 text-sm">Situação<select name="status" className={selectClass} value={filters.status} onChange={event => setFilters({ ...filters, status: event.target.value })}><option value="">Todas</option><option value="active">Ativos</option><option value="archived">Arquivados</option></select></label>
            <Button type="submit" className="min-h-11" disabled={result.loading}>Buscar</Button>
            {(filtered || filters.q || filters.status) && <Button type="button" variant="outline" className="min-h-11" disabled={result.loading} onClick={() => { setFilters({ q: "", status: "" }); setQuery({ q: "", status: "", offset: 0 }) }}>Limpar filtros</Button>}
          </form>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm"><p role="status">{total} registro(s){filtered ? " encontrados" : ""}</p><span className="text-muted-foreground">{result.value.canEdit ? "Consulta e edição" : "Somente consulta"}</span></div>
            {!result.value.data.length ? <div className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed p-8 text-center"><h3 className="font-medium">{filtered ? "Nenhum cadastro corresponde aos filtros." : "Nenhum cadastro encontrado."}</h3><p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{filtered ? "Revise a busca ou limpe os filtros para consultar todos os registros." : result.value.canEdit ? "Use Novo cadastro para adicionar o primeiro registro desta empresa." : "Os registros aparecerão aqui quando forem cadastrados."}</p></div> : <>
              <div className="workspace-list-scroll" role="region" aria-label={`Lista de ${config.title}`} tabIndex={0}><DataTable className="min-w-[560px] w-full text-left text-sm">
                <caption className="sr-only">{config.title} da empresa ativa</caption>
                <thead className="bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground"><tr><th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Código</th><th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Nome</th>{kind === "depositos" && <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Localização</th>}<th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">Situação</th><th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-medium"><span className="sr-only">Ações</span></th></tr></thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-border">{result.value.data.map(item => <tr className="hover:bg-muted/20" key={item.id}><td className="max-w-40 break-all px-4 py-3 font-mono text-xs">{item.code}</td><th scope="row" className="max-w-80 break-words px-4 py-3 font-medium"><Link className={linkClass} href={`${referencePath(kind)}/${item.id}`}>{item.name}</Link></th>{kind === "depositos" && <td className="max-w-60 break-words px-4 py-3">{item.location || "Não informada"}</td>}<td className="px-4 py-3">{statusLabel(item.status)}</td><td className="px-4 py-3">{result.value?.canEdit && <Link className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center text-primary underline" aria-label={`Editar ${item.name}`} href={`${referencePath(kind)}/${item.id}/editar`}>Editar</Link>}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
              </DataTable></div>

    function RecordAccess({ kind, id, mode }: { kind: ReferenceKind; id?: string; mode: "view" | "edit" | "create" }) {
      const config = referenceConfigs[kind]
      const result = useResource<ReferenceSnapshot | ReferenceList>(id ? `/api/erp/${config.endpoint}/${id}` : `/api/erp/${config.endpoint}?limit=1`)
      if (result.loading) return <p role="status">Carregando cadastro e permissões…</p>
      if (result.error || !result.value) return <><PageHeader eyebrow="Cadastros" title={config.title} description={config.description} /><section className="form-section space-y-3"><p role="alert"><RequestError message={result.error || "Cadastro indisponível"} status={result.status} /></p><Button onClick={result.reload}>Tentar novamente</Button><Link className={linkClass} href={`${referencePath(kind)}`}>Voltar à listagem</Link></section></>
      const initial = id && !Array.isArray(result.value.data) ? result.value as ReferenceSnapshot : undefined
      if (mode === "view" && initial) return <Detail kind={kind} value={initial} />
      if (!result.value.canEdit) return <><PageHeader eyebrow="Cadastros" title={config.title} description={config.description} /><section className="form-section space-y-3"><p role="status">Somente consulta. Solicite permissão para alterar este cadastro.</p><Link className={linkClass} href={`${referencePath(kind)}`}>Voltar à listagem</Link></section></>
      return <Editor key={`${id || "new"}:${result.etag}`} kind={kind} initial={initial} tenantId={result.value.tenantId} etag={result.etag} reload={result.reload} />
    }

    name: requesting-code-review
    description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
    ---
    
    # Requesting Code Review
    
    Dispatch a code reviewer subagent to catch issues before they cascade. The reviewer gets precisely crafted context for evaluation — never your session's history.
    
    **Core principle:** Review early, review often.
    
    ## When to Request Review
    
    **Mandatory:**
    - After each task in subagent-driven development
    - After completing major feature
    - Before merge to main
    
    **Optional but valuable:**
    - When stuck (fresh perspective)
    - Before refactoring (baseline check)
    - After fixing complex bug
    
    ## How to Request
    
    **1. Get git SHAs:**
    ```bash
    BASE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)  # or: git merge-base origin/main HEAD
    HEAD_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
    ```
    
    **2. Dispatch code reviewer subagent:**
    
    Dispatch a `general-purpose` subagent, filling the template at [code-reviewer.md](code-reviewer.md)
    
    **Placeholders:**
    - `{DESCRIPTION}` - Brief summary of what you built
    - `{PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS}` - What it should do
    - `{BASE_SHA}` - Starting commit
    - `{HEAD_SHA}` - Ending commit
    
    **3. Act on feedback:**
    - Fix Critical issues immediately
    - Fix Important issues before proceeding
    - Note Minor issues for later
    - Push back if reviewer is wrong (with reasoning)
    
    ## Example
    
    ```
    [Just completed Task 2: Add verification function]
    
    You: Let me request code review before proceeding.
    
    BASE_SHA=$(git log --oneline | grep "Task 1" | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f1)
    HEAD_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
    
    [Dispatch code reviewer subagent]
      DESCRIPTION: Added verifyIndex() and repairIndex() with 4 issue types
      PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: Task 2 from docs/superpowers/plans/deployment-plan.md
      BASE_SHA: a7981ec
      HEAD_SHA: 3df7661
    
    [Subagent returns]:
      Strengths: Clean architecture, real tests
      Issues:
        Important: Missing progress indicators
        Minor: Magic number (100) for reporting interval
      Assessment: Ready to proceed
    
    You: [Fix progress indicators]
    [Continue to Task 3]
    ```
    
    ## Common Rationalizations
    
    | Excuse | Reality |
    |--------|---------|
    | "I'll just review the diff myself instead of dispatching a reviewer" | You're the coordinator — reviewing the diff inline burns the context window you need to keep driving the work. Dispatch a reviewer subagent: the diff and the evaluation live in its context, and only the findings come back to you. |
    | "The reviewer needs my whole session history to understand the change" | Hand it precisely crafted context, never your session's history. That keeps the reviewer on the work product, not your thought process. |
    
    ## Red Flags
    
    **Never:**
    - Skip review because "it's simple"
    - Ignore Critical issues
    - Proceed with unfixed Important issues
    - Argue with valid technical feedback
    
    **If reviewer wrong:**
    - Push back with technical reasoning
    - Show code/tests that prove it works
    - Request clarification
    
    See template at: [code-reviewer.md](code-reviewer.md)
    # Code Reviewer Prompt Template
    
    Use this template when dispatching a code reviewer subagent.
    
    **Purpose:** Review completed work against requirements and code quality standards before it cascades into more work.
    
    ```
    Subagent (general-purpose):
      description: "Review code changes"
      prompt: |
        You are a Senior Code Reviewer with expertise in software architecture,
        design patterns, and best practices. Your job is to review completed work
        against its plan or requirements and identify issues before they cascade.
    
        ## What Was Implemented
    
        [DESCRIPTION]
    
        ## Requirements / Plan
    
        [PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS]
    
        ## Git Range to Review
    
        **Base:** [BASE_SHA]
        **Head:** [HEAD_SHA]
    
        ```bash
        git diff --stat [BASE_SHA]..[HEAD_SHA]
        git diff [BASE_SHA]..[HEAD_SHA]
        ```
    
        ## The spec is a vision document
    
        The spec says what the software must do. It does not enumerate every
        input, environment, or condition the software will meet. For behavior
        the spec is silent on, judge by what a reasonable person using this
        software would expect: a reasonable person's expectation is a
        requirement, and a spec's silence is not permission. Grade such
        findings by their effect on that person, not by whether the spec
        mentions the trigger.
    
        ## Declined to judge
    
        Before your verdict, list every behavior you considered and set aside
        as outside the plan or spec, one line each, with the reason. The
        executor rules on each line; nothing you set aside is dropped
        silently. An empty list means you set nothing aside.
    
        ## Read-Only Review
    
        Your review is read-only on this checkout. Do not mutate the working tree, the index, HEAD, or branch state in any way. Use tools like `git show`, `git diff`, and `git log` to inspect history. If you need a working copy of a different revision, check it out into a separate temporary directory (e.g. `git worktree add /tmp/review-[SHA] [SHA]`) — never move HEAD on this checkout.
    
        ## You Do Not Dispatch Subagents
    
        Do all of this review yourself. Never spawn a subagent to review part
        of the diff, and never spawn another reviewer for a second opinion.
        This process already provides every review seat the work gets; a
        reviewer you spawn duplicates one of them at full cost, and its
        verdict counts for nothing. If the diff feels too large for one
        pass, review it in passes yourself and say so in your report.
    
        ## What to Check
    
        **Plan alignment:**
        - Does the implementation match the plan / requirements?
        - Are deviations justified improvements, or problematic departures?
        - Is all planned functionality present?
    
        **Code quality:**
        - Clean separation of concerns?
        - Proper error handling?
        - Type safety where applicable?
        - DRY without premature abstraction?
        - Edge cases handled?
    
        **Architecture:**
        - Sound design decisions?
        - Reasonable scalability and performance?
        - Security concerns?
        - Integrates cleanly with surrounding code?
    
        **Testing:**
        - Tests verify real behavior, not mocks?
        - Edge cases covered?
        - Integration tests where they matter?
        - All tests passing?
    
        **Production readiness:**
        - Migration strategy if schema changed?
        - Backward compatibility considered?
        - Documentation complete?
        - No obvious bugs?
    
        ## Calibration
    
        Categorize issues by actual severity. Not everything is Critical.
        Acknowledge what was done well before listing issues — accurate praise
        helps the implementer trust the rest of the feedback.
    
        If you find significant deviations from the plan, flag them specifically
        so the implementer can confirm whether the deviation was intentional.
        If you find issues with the plan itself rather than the implementation,
        say so.
    
        ## Output Format
    
        ### Strengths
        [What's well done? Be specific.]
    
        ### Issues
    
        #### Critical (Must Fix)
        [Bugs, security issues, data loss risks, broken functionality]
    
        #### Important (Should Fix)
        [Architecture problems, missing features, poor error handling, test gaps]
    
        #### Minor (Nice to Have)
        [Code style, optimization opportunities, documentation polish]
    
        For each issue:
        - File:line reference
        - What's wrong
        - Why it matters
        - How to fix (if not obvious)
    
        ### Recommendations
        [Improvements for code quality, architecture, or process]
    
        ### Assessment
    
        **Ready to merge?** [Yes | No | With fixes]
    
        **Reasoning:** [1-2 sentence technical assessment]
    
        ## Critical Rules
    
        **DO:**
        - Categorize by actual severity
        - Be specific (file:line, not vague)
        - Explain WHY each issue matters
        - Acknowledge strengths
        - Give a clear verdict
    
        **DON'T:**
        - Say "looks good" without checking
        - Mark nitpicks as Critical
        - Give feedback on code you didn't actually read
        - Be vague ("improve error handling")
        - Avoid giving a clear verdict
    ```
    
    **Placeholders:**
    - `[DESCRIPTION]` — brief summary of what was built
    - `[PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS]` — what it should do (plan file path, task text, or requirements)
    - `[BASE_SHA]` — starting commit
    - `[HEAD_SHA]` — ending commit
    
    **Reviewer returns:** Strengths, Issues (Critical / Important / Minor), Recommendations, Assessment
    
    ## Example Output
    
    ```
    ### Strengths
    - Clean database schema with proper migrations (db.ts:15-42)
    - Comprehensive test coverage (18 tests, all edge cases)
    - Good error handling with fallbacks (summarizer.ts:85-92)
    
    ### Issues
    
    #### Important
    1. **Missing help text in CLI wrapper**
       - File: index-conversations:1-31
       - Issue: No --help flag, users won't discover --concurrency
       - Fix: Add --help case with usage examples
    
    2. **Date validation missing**
       - File: search.ts:25-27
       - Issue: Invalid dates silently return no results
       - Fix: Validate ISO format, throw error with example
    
    #### Minor
    1. **Progress indicators**
       - File: indexer.ts:130
       - Issue: No "X of Y" counter for long operations
       - Impact: Users don't know how long to wait
    
    ### Recommendations
    - Add progress reporting for user experience
    - Consider config file for excluded projects (portability)
    
    ### Assessment
    
    **Ready to merge: With fixes**
    
    **Reasoning:** Core implementation is solid with good architecture and tests. Important issues (help text, date validation) are easily fixed and don't affect core functionality.

    "use client"
    
    import { useId, useRef, useState } from "react"
    import { LogOut } from "lucide-react"
    import { useAllowNextUnload, useConfirmNavigation } from "./navigation-guard"
    
    export function LogoutButton({ label = "Sair", className = "flex min-h-11 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-60" }: { label?: string; className?: string }) {
      const confirmNavigation = useConfirmNavigation()
      const allowNextUnload = useAllowNextUnload()
      const errorId = useId()
      const pending = useRef(false)
      const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
    
      async function logout() {
        if (pending.current || !confirmNavigation()) return
        pending.current = true
        setBusy(true)
        setError("")
        let restoreUnload: (() => void) | undefined
        try {
          // Fetch preserves Origin under no-referrer and applies the cleared cookies.
          const response = await fetch("/api/auth/logout", {
            method: "POST",
            credentials: "same-origin",
            redirect: "manual",
            signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15_000),
          })
          if (response.type !== "opaqueredirect") {
            throw new Error(response.status === 403
              ? "A saída foi recusada. Recarregue a página e tente novamente."
              : "Não foi possível confirmar a saída. Tente novamente.")
          }
          // Full navigation uses the verified flow without following a form redirect.
          restoreUnload = allowNextUnload()
          window.location.assign(new URL("/api/auth/logout/central", window.location.origin).href)
        } catch (reason) {
          restoreUnload?.()
          setError(reason instanceof Error && reason.name === "Error" ? reason.message : "Não foi possível confirmar a saída. Tente novamente.")
          pending.current = false
          setBusy(false)
        }
      }
    
      return <div className="relative">
        <button type="button" onClick={logout} disabled={busy} aria-label={label || "Sair"} aria-busy={busy} aria-describedby={error ? errorId : undefined}
          className={className} title="Encerrar a sessão no ERP e no Ávila Auth">
          <LogOut className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />{busy ? "Saindo…" : label}
        </button>
        {error && <p id={errorId} role="alert" className="absolute right-0 top-full z-50 mt-2 w-72 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] rounded-xl border border-border bg-popover p-4 text-sm text-popover-foreground shadow-lg">{error}</p>}
      </div>
    }
    import type { ApiPath, JsonBody, JsonReply } from "./types"
    
    export function erpFetch(resource: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
      if (!resource.startsWith("/api/erp/") || resource.includes("\\") || resource.includes("#")) {
        return Promise.reject(new Error("Recurso do ERP inválido"))
      }
      return fetch(resource, { cache: "no-store", ...init, credentials: "same-origin" })
    }
    
    export async function readApi<Path extends ApiPath>(
      path: Path, signal?: AbortSignal,
    ): Promise<{ data: JsonReply<Path, "get" & keyof import("./generated").paths[Path]>; etag: string }> {
      const response = await erpFetch(path.replace("/api/v1/", "/api/erp/"), { signal })
      const data = await response.json()
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.title || "Consulta indisponível")
      return { data, etag: response.headers.get("etag") || "" }
    }

    /** Guard same-document browser traversals before Next.js changes its route. */
    export function guardBrowserHistory(confirmNavigation: () => boolean, target: Window = window) {
      const navigation = (target as Window & { navigation?: EventTarget }).navigation
      if (navigation) {
        const guard = (event: Event) => {
          const traversal = event as Event & { navigationType?: string; destination?: { sameDocument?: boolean } }
          if (traversal.navigationType === "traverse" && traversal.destination?.sameDocument && event.cancelable && !confirmNavigation()) event.preventDefault()
        }
        navigation.addEventListener("navigate", guard)
        return () => navigation.removeEventListener("navigate", guard)
      }
    
      // Older engines have no cancellable Navigation API. Preserve Next's state and
      // capture popstate before its handler, restoring the old position on refusal.
      const history = target.history
      const marker = "__erpNavigationIndex"
      let index = Number.isSafeInteger(history.state?.[marker]) ? history.state[marker] as number : 0
      let restoring = false
      const push = history.pushState
      const replace = history.replaceState
      const pushState: History["pushState"] = function (data, unused, url) {
        push.call(history, { ...data, [marker]: index + 1 }, unused, url)
        index++
      }
      const replaceState: History["replaceState"] = function (data, unused, url) {
        replace.call(history, { ...data, [marker]: index }, unused, url)
      }
      replace.call(history, { ...history.state, [marker]: index }, "")
      history.pushState = pushState
      history.replaceState = replaceState
      const guard = (event: PopStateEvent) => {
        if (restoring) { restoring = false; event.stopImmediatePropagation(); return }
        const next = Number.isSafeInteger(event.state?.[marker]) ? event.state[marker] as number : index - 1
        if (!confirmNavigation()) {
          event.stopImmediatePropagation()
          restoring = true
          history.go(index - next || 1)
        } else {
          index = next
          if (!Number.isSafeInteger(event.state?.[marker])) replace.call(history, { ...event.state, [marker]: index }, "")
        }
      }
      target.addEventListener("popstate", guard, true)
      return () => {
        target.removeEventListener("popstate", guard, true)
        if (history.pushState === pushState) history.pushState = push
        if (history.replaceState === replaceState) history.replaceState = replace
      }
    }

    export const partySessionEnded = "erp:party-session-ended"
    const prefix = "erp:party-draft:"
    
    /** Keep only the current authenticated scope; no scope ends the draft session. */
    export function clearPartyDrafts(keepScope?: string): boolean {
      try {
        const keepPrefix = keepScope ? `${prefix}v1:${keepScope}:` : null
        const keys = Object.keys(sessionStorage).filter(key => key.startsWith(prefix) && (!keepPrefix || !key.startsWith(keepPrefix)))
        for (const key of keys) sessionStorage.removeItem(key)
        return true
      } catch { return false }
    }
    
    export function endPartyDraftSession() {
      // Stop mounted editors before removing storage so their effects cannot refill it.
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(partySessionEnded))
      return clearPartyDrafts()
    }

    name: Production release
    on:
      push:
        branches: [main]
      workflow_dispatch:
        inputs:
          source_ref:
            description: Exact source commit to validate and package
            required: true
            type: string
          automatic:
            description: Skip deployment when main has moved past this release
            required: false
            default: false
            type: boolean
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    jobs:
      fiscal-mcp:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 15
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
          - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
            with:
              version: 0.12.24
          - run: uv sync --frozen --extra dev --python 3.12
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-mcp
          - run: node --test scripts/fiscal/test/deploy-config.test.mjs
          - run: uv run --frozen --extra dev pytest tests/test_fiscal_schema.py tests/test_simplified_danfe.py tests/test_nfe_assinatura.py
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-mcp
          - run: docker build -f apps/fiscal-mcp/Dockerfile -t erp-next-fiscal-mcp:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} .
          - name: Exercise MCP in its restricted runtime container
            shell: bash
            run: |
              docker run --detach --name fiscal-mcp-smoke --network host --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m,mode=1777 --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --cap-drop ALL --memory 512m --pids-limit 128 -e XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/cache erp-next-fiscal-mcp:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              trap 'docker rm -f fiscal-mcp-smoke >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
              cd apps/fiscal-mcp
              uv run --frozen --extra dev python scripts/smoke_runtime.py
          - run: docker save erp-next-fiscal-mcp:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} | gzip > fiscal-mcp-image.tar.gz
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-fiscal-mcp-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: fiscal-mcp-image.tar.gz
              compression-level: 0
              retention-days: 7
      fiscal-engine:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 10
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
          - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
          - run: npm test
            working-directory: apps/fiscal-engine
          - run: docker build -f apps/fiscal-engine/Dockerfile -t erp-next-fiscal:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} .
          - run: docker save erp-next-fiscal:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} | gzip > fiscal-image.tar.gz
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-fiscal-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: fiscal-image.tar.gz
              compression-level: 0
              retention-days: 7
      api:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 20
        services:
          postgres:
            image: postgres:18-alpine
            env:
              POSTGRES_DB: erp_next_test
              POSTGRES_USER: postgres
              POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ci_isolated_only
            ports: ['5432:5432']
            options: >-
              --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
              --health-interval 2s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 20
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:ci_isolated_only@127.0.0.1:5432/erp_next_test
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
          - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.1
            with:
              components: rustfmt,clippy
          - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
          - run: cargo fmt --all --check
          - run: cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
          - name: Test and export the exact source contract
            run: |
              mkdir -p artifacts/contracts
              ERP_OPENAPI_OUTPUT="$PWD/artifacts/contracts/candidate.json" cargo test --locked --workspace -- --test-threads=2
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-release-openapi-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: artifacts/contracts/candidate.json
              if-no-files-found: error
              retention-days: 7
          - run: cargo build --release --locked -p erp-next-api
          - run: docker build -f deploy/api.Dockerfile -t erp-next-api:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} .
          - run: docker save erp-next-api:sha-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }} | gzip > api-image.tar.gz
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            with:
              name: erp-api-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: api-image.tar.gz
              compression-level: 0
      deploy:
        name: Deploy production
        needs: [fiscal-engine, fiscal-mcp, api, web, mlops-evidence]
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 15
        environment: production
        permissions:
          contents: read
          actions: read
        concurrency:
          group: erp-production-deploy
          cancel-in-progress: false
        env:
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
        steps:
          - name: Check that the automatic release is still current
            id: current
            env:
              GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
              AUTOMATIC: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.automatic }}
            shell: bash
            run: |
              set -euo pipefail
              if [[ "$AUTOMATIC" == true ]] &&
                 [[ "$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/main" --jq .object.sha)" != "$SOURCE_SHA" ]]; then
                echo '::notice::Skipping deployment because main has advanced.'
                echo 'deploy=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              else
                echo 'deploy=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              fi
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            if: steps.current.outputs.deploy == 'true'
            with:
              ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              persist-credentials: false
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            if: steps.current.outputs.deploy == 'true'
            with:
              name: erp-api-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: bundle
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            if: steps.current.outputs.deploy == 'true'
            with:
              name: erp-web-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: bundle
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            if: steps.current.outputs.deploy == 'true'
            with:
              name: erp-fiscal-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: bundle
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
            if: steps.current.outputs.deploy == 'true'
            with:
              name: erp-fiscal-mcp-${{ inputs.source_ref || github.sha }}
              path: bundle
          - name: Send immutable release to applications
            if: steps.current.outputs.deploy == 'true'
            env:
              DEPLOY_HOST: ${{ secrets.ERP_DEPLOY_HOST }}
              DEPLOY_USER: ${{ secrets.ERP_DEPLOY_USER }}
              DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.ERP_DEPLOY_SSH_KEY }}
              DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS: ${{ secrets.ERP_DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS }}
            shell: bash
            run: |
              set -euo pipefail
              [[ "$SOURCE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
              [[ "$DEPLOY_HOST" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.-]*$ ]]
              [[ "$DEPLOY_USER" =~ ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]*$ ]]
              test -s bundle/api-image.tar.gz
              test -s bundle/web-image.tar.gz
              test -s bundle/fiscal-image.tar.gz
              test -s bundle/fiscal-mcp-image.tar.gz
              bundle_dir=$(mktemp -d)
              ssh_dir=$(mktemp -d)
              trap 'rm -rf "$bundle_dir" "$ssh_dir"' EXIT
              cp bundle/api-image.tar.gz bundle/web-image.tar.gz bundle/fiscal-image.tar.gz bundle/fiscal-mcp-image.tar.gz "$bundle_dir/"
              cp deploy/compose.yaml deploy/fiscal-compose.yaml "$bundle_dir/"
              chmod 700 "$ssh_dir"
              printf '%s\n' "$DEPLOY_KEY" > "$ssh_dir/key"
              printf '%s\n' "$DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS" > "$ssh_dir/known_hosts"
              chmod 600 "$ssh_dir/key" "$ssh_dir/known_hosts"
              tar -C "$bundle_dir" -czf - . | ssh -T \
                -i "$ssh_dir/key" -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \
                -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$ssh_dir/known_hosts" \
                -o ConnectTimeout=20 -o ServerAliveInterval=15 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 \
                "$DEPLOY_USER@$DEPLOY_HOST" "deploy erp-next $SOURCE_SHA"

    "use client"
    
    import { GuardedLink as Link, NavigationGuardProvider } from "@/components/shell/navigation-guard"
    import { Suspense } from "react"
    import { usePathname } from "next/navigation"
    import { PreferencesCommand } from "@/features/preferences/search/preferences-command"
    import { MenuButton, MenuNavigation } from "@/components/shell/menu-navigation"
    import { HeaderTools } from "@/components/shell/header-tools"
    import { DemonstrationPreview } from "@/components/feedback/demonstration-preview"
    
    export function AppShell({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
      return <Suspense fallback={<p role="status" className="p-6 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Preparando o ERP…</p>}><WorkspaceFrame>{children}</WorkspaceFrame></Suspense>
    }
    
    function WorkspaceFrame({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
      // Root layouts persist during client navigation; a request header would keep
      // the previous private shell mounted after navigating to the access page.
      const pathname = usePathname()
      if (pathname === "/entrar" || pathname === "/criar-conta") return <>{children}</>
      return <WorkspaceNavigation><DemonstrationPreview>{children}</DemonstrationPreview></WorkspaceNavigation>
    }
    
    function WorkspaceNavigation({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
      return <NavigationGuardProvider><MenuNavigation>
        <header className="erp-header">
          <MenuButton />
          <Link href="/" className="erp-header-brand" aria-label="Visão geral do Avila ERP"><img src="/brand/avila-erp-symbol.svg" alt="" width="28" height="28" /><strong>Avila ERP</strong></Link>
          <PreferencesCommand />
          <HeaderTools />
        </header>
        <main id="conteudo-principal" className="erp-content">{children}</main>
      </MenuNavigation></NavigationGuardProvider>
    }

    17:44:02
    Edições ficam em sessionStorage, isoladas por empresa, sessão e cadastro. Recuperação conserva a revisão original, o comando POST e sua chave, inclusive após resposta perdida. Conteúdo inválido ou armazenamento indisponível gera mensagem e impede um novo POST sem proteção. Navegação pede confirmação quando há edição, gravação pendente ou resultado incerto. Respostas tardias não podem navegar ou gravar rascunhos de outra instância.
    
    A seleção de cliente na NF-e copia a classificação declarada, sem inferir alíquotas, CFOP, consumidor final ou regime. Indicador desconhecido continua exigindo preenchimento. O motor mantém compatibilidade com o booleano legado; indicador explícito deve ser consistente com ele. Isento não envia IE; não contribuinte pode ter IE. NFC-e e exterior mantêm seus recortes. Referências: XSD oficial vendorizado leiauteNFe_v4.00.xsd e MOC 7, https://www.confaz.fazenda.gov.br/legislacao/arquivo-manuais/moc7-anexo-i-leiaute-e-rv.pdf.
    
    O pacote inclui testes de contrato e navegador, publicação verificável e preenchimento IBGE apenas quando CEP, município e UF conferirem. Nenhuma inscrição ou classificação fiscal real será inventada. Demais pacotes continuam: custos/tabelas com fonte, categorias/subcategorias, Core com fonte própria, acabamentos independentes fiéis ao catálogo, importação/exportação ampliada e aceitação integrada.

    The `<Script />` component accepts a number of additional properties beyond those which are required.
    
    ### `strategy`
    
    The loading strategy of the script. There are four different strategies that can be used:
    
    - `beforeInteractive`: Load before any Next.js code and before any page hydration occurs.
    - `afterInteractive`: (**default**) Load early but after some hydration on the page occurs.
    - `lazyOnload`: Load during browser idle time.
    - `worker`: (experimental) Load in a web worker.
    
    ### `beforeInteractive`
    
    Scripts that load with the `beforeInteractive` strategy are injected into the initial HTML from the server, downloaded before any Next.js module, and executed in the order they are placed.
    
    Scripts denoted with this strategy are preloaded and fetched before any first-party code, but their execution **does not block page hydration from occurring**.
    
    <AppOnly>
    
    Scripts with the `beforeInteractive` strategy must be placed inside a [root layout](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/layout#root-layout), such as `app/layout.tsx` or `app/[locale]/layout.tsx`, and are designed to load scripts that are needed by the entire site (i.e. the script will load when any page in the application has been loaded server-side).
    
    </AppOnly>
    
    <PagesOnly>
    
    `beforeInteractive` scripts must be placed inside the `Document` Component (`pages/_document.js`) and are designed to load scripts that are needed by the entire site (i.e. the script will load when any page in the application has been loaded server-side).
    
    </PagesOnly>
    
    **This strategy should only be used for critical scripts that need to be fetched as soon as possible.**
    
    <AppOnly>
    
    ```tsx filename="app/layout.tsx" switcher
    import Script from 'next/script'
    
    export default function RootLayout({
      children,
    }: {
      children: React.ReactNode
    }) {
      return (
        <html lang="en">
          <body>
            {children}
            <Script
              src="https://example.com/script.js"
              strategy="beforeInteractive"
            />
          </body>
        </html>
      )
    }
    ```
