    """Check the screen manual, route ownership, local links, and relocation audit.
    
    Run `python scripts/docs/check.py`; add --audit-moves to verify the one-time move
    against its base commit. No services or dependencies are required.
    """
    from pathlib import Path
    import argparse
    import csv
    import hashlib
    import json
    import re
    import subprocess
    from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    DOCS = ROOT / 'docs'
    LINK = re.compile(r'!?\[[^\]\n]*\]\(([^\s)]+)(?:[^)\n]*)\)')
    
    
    def git(*args, data=None):
        return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(ROOT), *args], input=data)
    
    
    def local_target(source, href):
        href = href.strip('<>')
        parsed = urlsplit(href)
        if parsed.scheme or href.startswith(('/', '#')) or not parsed.path:
            return None
        return ((ROOT / source).parent / unquote(parsed.path)).resolve()
    
    
    def baseline_files(commit):
        paths = [p for p in git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', '-z', commit).decode('utf-8').split('\0')
                 if p.endswith(('.md', '.mdx'))]
        payload = ''.join(f'{commit}:{p}\n' for p in paths).encode('utf-8')
        process = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(ROOT), 'cat-file', '--batch'], input=payload,
                                 stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=True)
        data, offset, results = process.stdout, 0, {}
        for path in paths:
            end = data.index(b'\n', offset)
            header = data[offset:end].split()
            if len(header) != 3 or header[1] != b'blob':
                raise ValueError(f'Cannot read baseline document: {path}')
            size = int(header[2])
            results[path] = data[end + 1:end + 1 + size]
            offset = end + size + 2
        return results
    
    
    def broken_links(path, text):
        for match in LINK.finditer(text):
            target = local_target(path, match[1])
            if target is not None and not target.exists():
                yield match[1], target
    
    
    def check(audit=False):
        errors = []
        manifest = json.loads((DOCS / 'tecnica/movimentacoes.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        moves = {item['previous']: item['current'] for item in manifest['files']}
        reverse = {new: old for old, new in moves.items()}
        guides = sorted(DOCS.glob('telas/*/*/README.md'))
        rows = list(csv.DictReader((DOCS / 'tecnica/mapa-telas.csv').open(encoding='utf-8', newline='')))
        routes = {}
        for page in (ROOT / 'apps/web/src/app').rglob('page.tsx'):
            part = page.parent.relative_to(ROOT / 'apps/web/src/app').as_posix()
            routes['/' + part if part != '.' else '/'] = page.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        if len({row['rota'] for row in rows}) != len(rows):
            errors.append('Duplicate routes in mapa-telas.csv')
        if {row['rota'] for row in rows} != set(routes):
            errors.append('Route map does not match the current page.tsx files')
        for row in rows:
            if row['fonte'] != routes.get(row['rota']):
                errors.append(f"Wrong page source: {row['rota']}")
            if not (ROOT / row['guia']).is_file():
                errors.append(f"Missing screen guide: {row['guia']}")
        for guide in guides:
            text = guide.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
            for section in ['**Onde acessar:**', '## Regras e limites', '## Referências para manutenção']:
                if section not in text:
                    errors.append(f'Missing {section}: {guide.relative_to(ROOT)}')
    
        # Historical missing links are compared to their old resolved destinations.
        # New screen guides never inherit an allowance from an old document.
        base = baseline_files(manifest['baseCommit'])
        old_missing = set()
        base_paths = set(git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', '-z', manifest['baseCommit']).decode('utf-8').split('\0'))
        for source, content in base.items():
            for match in LINK.finditer(content.decode('utf-8-sig')):
                target = local_target(source, match[1])
                if target is None or not target.is_relative_to(ROOT):
                    continue
                rel = target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
                exists_at_base = rel in base_paths or any(p.startswith(rel.rstrip('/') + '/') for p in base_paths)
                if not exists_at_base:
                    old_missing.add((source, rel))
    
        candidates = [p for p in git('ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z').decode('utf-8').split('\0')
                      if p.endswith(('.md', '.mdx')) and (ROOT / p).is_file()]
        inherited = []
        link_count = 0
        for source in candidates:
            text = (ROOT / source).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
            link_count += len(LINK.findall(text))
            for href, target in broken_links(source, text):
                rel = target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() if target.is_relative_to(ROOT) else str(target)
                identity = (reverse.get(source, source), reverse.get(rel, rel))
                if identity in old_missing and not source.startswith('docs/telas/'):
                    inherited.append((source, href))
                elif identity in old_missing and '/referencias/' in source:
                    inherited.append((source, href))
                else:
                    errors.append(f'Broken link: {source} -> {href}')
    
        # Contract sources are executable consumers, not just Markdown links.
        catalogue = json.loads((ROOT / 'verification/contracts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        def walk(value):
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                for item in value.values():
                    walk(item)
            elif isinstance(value, list):
                for item in value:
                    walk(item)
            elif isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith('docs/') and not (ROOT / value).is_file():
                errors.append(f'Missing contract source: {value}')
        walk(catalogue)
    
        if audit:
            for item in manifest['files']:
                new = ROOT / item['current']
                original = git('show', f"{manifest['baseCommit']}:{item['previous']}")
                if hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest() != item['originalSha256']:
                    errors.append(f"Original hash mismatch: {item['previous']}")
                if not new.is_file():
                    errors.append(f"Relocated file missing: {item['current']}")
                    continue
                current = new.read_bytes()
                if hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest() != item['organizedSha256']:
                    errors.append(f"Relocation hash mismatch: {item['current']}")
                if item['previous'].endswith(('.md', '.mdx')):
                    a = original.decode('utf-8-sig').replace('\r\n', '\n')
                    b = current.decode('utf-8-sig').replace('\r\n', '\n')
                    # Only path changes are authorized inside the old technical records.
                    for old, dest in sorted(moves.items(), key=lambda pair: -len(pair[0])):
                        a = a.replace(old, dest)
                    a = LINK.sub('[link]', a)
                    b = LINK.sub('[link]', b)
                    if a != b:
                        errors.append(f"Content changed beyond links: {item['current']}")
                elif original != current:
                    errors.append(f"Non-Markdown original modified: {item['current']}")
    
        result = dict(screenGuides=len(guides), pageRoutes=len(rows), relocatedDocuments=len(moves),
                      linksChecked=link_count, preExistingBrokenLinks=len(inherited), errors=errors)
        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        return 1 if errors else 0
    
    
    if __name__ == '__main__':
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument('--audit-moves', action='store_true')
        args = parser.parse_args()
        raise SystemExit(check(args.audit_moves))

    name: requesting-code-review
    description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
    ---
    
    # Requesting Code Review
    
    Dispatch a code reviewer subagent to catch issues before they cascade. The reviewer gets precisely crafted context for evaluation — never your session's history.
    
    **Core principle:** Review early, review often.
    
    ## When to Request Review
    
    **Mandatory:**
    - After each task in subagent-driven development
    - After completing major feature
    - Before merge to main
    
    **Optional but valuable:**
    - When stuck (fresh perspective)
    - Before refactoring (baseline check)
    - After fixing complex bug
    
    ## How to Request
    
    **1. Get git SHAs:**
    ```bash
    BASE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)  # or: git merge-base origin/main HEAD
    HEAD_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
    ```
    
    **2. Dispatch code reviewer subagent:**
    
    Dispatch a `general-purpose` subagent, filling the template at [code-reviewer.md](code-reviewer.md)
    
    **Placeholders:**
    - `{DESCRIPTION}` - Brief summary of what you built
    - `{PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS}` - What it should do
    - `{BASE_SHA}` - Starting commit
    - `{HEAD_SHA}` - Ending commit
    
    **3. Act on feedback:**
    - Fix Critical issues immediately
    - Fix Important issues before proceeding
    - Note Minor issues for later
    - Push back if reviewer is wrong (with reasoning)
    
    ## Example
    
    ```
    [Just completed Task 2: Add verification function]
    
    You: Let me request code review before proceeding.
    
    BASE_SHA=$(git log --oneline | grep "Task 1" | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f1)
    HEAD_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
    
    [Dispatch code reviewer subagent]
      DESCRIPTION: Added verifyIndex() and repairIndex() with 4 issue types
      PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: Task 2 from docs/superpowers/plans/deployment-plan.md
      BASE_SHA: a7981ec
      HEAD_SHA: 3df7661
    
    [Subagent returns]:
      Strengths: Clean architecture, real tests
      Issues:
        Important: Missing progress indicators
        Minor: Magic number (100) for reporting interval
      Assessment: Ready to proceed
    
    You: [Fix progress indicators]
    [Continue to Task 3]
    ```
    
    ## Common Rationalizations
    
    | Excuse | Reality |
    |--------|---------|
    | "I'll just review the diff myself instead of dispatching a reviewer" | You're the coordinator — reviewing the diff inline burns the context window you need to keep driving the work. Dispatch a reviewer subagent: the diff and the evaluation live in its context, and only the findings come back to you. |
    | "The reviewer needs my whole session history to understand the change" | Hand it precisely crafted context, never your session's history. That keeps the reviewer on the work product, not your thought process. |
    
    ## Red Flags
    
    **Never:**
    - Skip review because "it's simple"
    - Ignore Critical issues
    - Proceed with unfixed Important issues
    - Argue with valid technical feedback
    
    **If reviewer wrong:**
    - Push back with technical reasoning
    - Show code/tests that prove it works
    - Request clarification
    
    See template at: [code-reviewer.md](code-reviewer.md)

    | Interface e tokens compartilhados | `app/layout.tsx`, `components/app-shell.tsx`, `components/ui`, `globals.css` e `components.json` | Estrutura alinhada; esta inspeção não substitui auditoria visual |
    | Contrato HTTP corresponde ao código | `api/openapi.json` e `apps/api/src/http/mod.rs` | Alinhados quanto às duas rotas disponíveis |
    | Features conforme o roadmap | Roadmap indica `features/users`; código estava em `features/usuarios` | Corrigido nesta organização com atualização dos imports |
    | CI simples e com orçamento explícito | `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, jobs Rust e web | Estrutura simples; orçamento de um minuto exige medição com cache aquecido |

    "use client"
    
    import Link from "next/link"
    import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react"
    import { useRouter } from "next/navigation"
    import { Check, ClipboardCheck, Plus, RefreshCw, ShieldAlert } from "lucide-react"
    import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { erpFetch } from "@/lib/api/client"
    
    type Count = { id: string; status: "open" | "approved" | "cancelled"; reference: string; createdAt: string; lineCount: number; countedLines: number }
    type CountLine = { productId: string; sku: string; name: string; unit: string; expectedQuantity: string; countedQuantity: string | null }
    type CountDetail = { count: Count; lines: CountLine[] }
    const labels = { open: "Aberto", approved: "Aprovado", cancelled: "Cancelado" }
    
    async function read(response: Response) { const value = await response.json(); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(value.title || "Operação indisponível"); return value }
    
    export function InventoryCounts() {
      const [counts, setCounts] = useState<Count[]>([]); const [reference, setReference] = useState(""); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false); const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const load = useCallback(async () => { setLoading(true); setError(""); try { setCounts((await read(await erpFetch("/api/erp/inventory-counts?limit=100&offset=0", { cache: "no-store" }))).data || []) } catch (cause) { setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Inventários indisponíveis") } finally { setLoading(false) } }, [])
      useEffect(() => { const timer = window.setTimeout(() => void load(), 0); return () => window.clearTimeout(timer) }, [load])
      const router = useRouter()
      async function create() { if (reference.trim().length < 2) { setError("Informe uma referência para o inventário."); return } setBusy(true); setError(""); try { const created = await read(await erpFetch("/api/erp/inventory-counts", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ reference: reference.trim() }), headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID() } })); router.push(`/estoque/inventarios/${created.id}`) } catch (cause) { setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Não foi possível criar o inventário") } finally { setBusy(false) } }
      return <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1450px] px-4 pb-24 pt-8 lg:px-6"><div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3">{<Button variant="outline" onClick={() => void load()} disabled={loading}><RefreshCw />Atualizar</Button>}</div><section className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5"><h2 className="font-semibold">Novo inventário</h2><div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row"><Input value={reference} onChange={event => setReference(event.target.value)} placeholder="Ex.: Inventário loja 07/11/2026" maxLength={120} /><Button onClick={() => void create()} disabled={busy}><Plus />Criar sessão</Button></div></section>{error && <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-4 text-sm" role="alert"><ShieldAlert className="mr-2 inline size-4" />{error}</p>}{loading ? <p className="mt-6" role="status">Carregando inventários…</p> : !counts.length ? <section className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-6"><ClipboardCheck className="size-6 text-primary" /><h2 className="mt-3 font-semibold">Nenhum inventário criado</h2><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">A primeira sessão começa com o saldo atual dos produtos ativos.</p></section> : <section className="mt-6 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card"><div className="divide-y divide-border">{counts.map(count => <Link className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 p-4 hover:bg-muted/30" href={`/estoque/inventarios/${count.id}`} key={count.id}><div><strong className="block">{count.reference}</strong><span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{count.countedLines}/{count.lineCount} produtos contados · {new Date(count.createdAt).toLocaleString("pt-BR")}</span></div><span className="rounded-full bg-muted px-3 py-1 text-xs">{labels[count.status]}</span></Link>)}</div></section>}</div>
    }
    
    export function InventoryCountDetail({ id }: { id: string }) {
      const [detail, setDetail] = useState<CountDetail | null>(null); const [error, setError] = useState(""); const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
      const load = useCallback(async () => { try { setDetail(await read(await erpFetch(`/api/erp/inventory-counts/${id}`, { cache: "no-store" }))); setError("") } catch (cause) { setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Inventário indisponível") } }, [id])
      useEffect(() => { const timer = window.setTimeout(() => void load(), 0); return () => window.clearTimeout(timer) }, [load])
      async function save(line: CountLine, value: string) { setBusy(true); try { await read(await erpFetch(`/api/erp/inventory-counts/${id}/lines`, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID() }, body: JSON.stringify({ productId: line.productId, countedQuantity: value }) })); await load() } catch (cause) { setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Contagem não salva") } finally { setBusy(false) } }
      async function approve() { setBusy(true); try { await read(await erpFetch(`/api/erp/inventory-counts/${id}/approve`, { method: "POST", headers: { "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID() } })); await load() } catch (cause) { setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Aprovação não realizada") } finally { setBusy(false) } }
      if (!detail) return <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1450px] px-4 py-8 lg:px-6"><p role={error ? "alert" : "status"}>{error || "Carregando inventário…"}</p></div>
      const { count, lines } = detail
      return <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1450px] px-4 pb-24 pt-8 lg:px-6"><PageHeader eyebrow="Estoque / Inventários" title={count.reference} description={`${count.countedLines} de ${count.lineCount} produtos contados.`} back={{ href: "/estoque/inventarios", label: "Inventários" }} actions={<Button disabled={busy || count.status !== "open" || count.countedLines !== count.lineCount} onClick={() => void approve()}><Check />Aprovar ajustes</Button>} />{error && <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-4 text-sm" role="alert">{error}</p>}<section className="mt-6 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card"><div className="divide-y divide-border">{lines.map(line => <div className="grid gap-3 p-4 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_160px_130px] sm:items-center" key={line.productId}><div><strong className="block">{line.name}</strong><span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{line.sku} · esperado {line.expectedQuantity} {line.unit}</span></div><Input aria-label={`Quantidade contada de ${line.name}`} defaultValue={line.countedQuantity ?? ""} type="number" min="0" step="0.000001" disabled={busy || count.status !== "open"} onBlur={event => { const value = event.currentTarget.value; if (value !== "" && value !== line.countedQuantity) void save(line, value) }} placeholder="Contado" /><span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{line.countedQuantity == null ? "Pendente" : "Contado"}</span></div>)}</div></section></div>
    }
    "use client"
    
    import { useId, useState } from "react"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { useCommand, useResource } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    
    type Delivery = { id: string; status: "sent" | "failed" | "uncertain"; recipient: string; createdAt: string }
    type EmailStatus = { tenantId: string; recipient: string | null; canSend: boolean; emailReady: boolean; deliveries: Delivery[] }
    type Receipt = { tenantId: string; revision: number; delivery: Delivery }
    type EmailDraft = { recipientOverride: string | null; subject: string; message: string }
    const deliveryLabels = { sent: "Aceito pelo servidor de e-mail", failed: "Recusado pelo servidor de e-mail", uncertain: "Confirmação pendente · não reenviar" }
    
    export function ProposalEmail({ id, number, version, tenantId, etag, onReload, disabled = false }: { id: string; number: string; version: number; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void; disabled?: boolean }) {
      const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
      const command = useCommand()
      const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState<Delivery | null>(null)
      const [draft, setDraft] = useState<EmailDraft>({ recipientOverride: null, subject: `Proposta ${number} · versão ${version}`, message: `Olá,\n\nSegue em anexo a proposta ${number} para sua conferência.\n\nFicamos à disposição.` })
      // Only consult delivery configuration/history when the composer is opened.
      return <>
        <Button variant="outline" className="h-9 px-3" disabled={disabled} title={disabled ? "Consulte a versão atual e aguarde operações pendentes para enviar" : undefined} onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Enviar por e-mail</Button>
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
          <DialogContent className="max-h-[90dvh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-xl">
            <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Enviar proposta {number} por e-mail</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>Confira o destinatário e a mensagem antes de enviar o documento da proposta.</DialogDescription></DialogHeader>
            {open && <ProposalEmailComposer id={id} tenantId={tenantId} etag={etag} onReload={onReload} command={command} receipt={receipt} onReceipt={setReceipt} draft={draft} onDraftChange={patch => setDraft(previous => ({ ...previous, ...patch }))} />}
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </>
    }
    
    function ProposalEmailComposer({ id, tenantId, etag, onReload, command, receipt, onReceipt, draft, onDraftChange }: { id: string; tenantId: string; etag: string; onReload: () => void; command: ReturnType<typeof useCommand>; receipt: Delivery | null; onReceipt: (delivery: Delivery) => void; draft: EmailDraft; onDraftChange: (patch: Partial<EmailDraft>) => void }) {
      const messageId = useId()
      const resource = useResource<EmailStatus>(`/api/erp/proposals/${id}/email`)
      const { recipientOverride, subject, message } = draft
      const value = resource.value?.tenantId === tenantId ? resource.value : null
      const recipient = recipientOverride ?? value?.recipient ?? ""
      const pendingDelivery = receipt?.status === "uncertain" || value?.deliveries.some(delivery => delivery.status === "uncertain")
      const frozen = command.busy || command.uncertain || command.stale || !!pendingDelivery || receipt?.status === "sent"
      if (resource.loading && !value) return <p role="status">Consultando envio de e-mail…</p>
      if (resource.error || !value) return <div className="space-y-3"><p role="alert"><RequestError message={resource.error || "Não foi possível consultar o envio desta proposta."} status={resource.status} /></p><Button variant="outline" onClick={resource.reload}>Consultar novamente</Button></div>
      return <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={async event => {
        event.preventDefault()
        if (!command.uncertain && (!value.canSend || !value.emailReady || frozen)) return
        const result = await command.send<Receipt>(`/api/erp/proposals/${id}/email`, tenantId, { recipient, subject, message }, etag)
        if (result?.tenantId === tenantId) { onReceipt(result.delivery); resource.reload(); if (result.delivery.status === "sent") onReload() }
      }}>
        {!value.emailReady && <p role="status" className="rounded-lg border p-3">O envio de e-mail ainda não está configurado no servidor. Nenhuma mensagem será enviada até a configuração estar disponível.</p>}
        {!value.canSend && <p role="status">Envio indisponível: confira sua permissão, a validade e a situação da proposta.</p>}
        <fieldset disabled={frozen || !value.canSend || !value.emailReady} className="space-y-3">
          <label className="block space-y-2">Destinatário<Input type="email" autoComplete="email" required maxLength={254} value={recipient} onChange={event => onDraftChange({ recipientOverride: event.target.value })} /></label>
          <label className="block space-y-2">Assunto<Input required maxLength={200} value={subject} onChange={event => onDraftChange({ subject: event.target.value })} /></label>
          <div className="space-y-2"><label htmlFor={messageId} className="block">Mensagem</label><textarea id={messageId} required maxLength={10000} rows={5} className="w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-background p-3" value={message} onChange={event => onDraftChange({ message: event.target.value })} /></div>
        </fieldset>
        <p className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3 text-sm">Anexo: documento da proposta em HTML, com cliente, itens, acabamentos e valores registrados. A versão da proposta é capturada pelo servidor no momento do envio.</p>
        {command.error && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={command.error} status={command.status} /></p>}
        {command.stale && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { command.reset(); onReload(); resource.reload() }}>Recarregar proposta</Button>}
        {receipt && <p role="status">{deliveryLabels[receipt.status]} · {receipt.recipient}{receipt.status === "sent" ? ". A entrega na caixa do destinatário depende do provedor." : "."}</p>}
        {pendingDelivery && <p role="status">Há um envio sem confirmação definitiva. Consulte o histórico e confirme com o provedor antes de realizar outro envio.</p>}
        {command.uncertain && <p role="status">Resultado ainda não confirmado. A consulta abaixo repete o mesmo comando, sem criar um novo envio.</p>}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button type="submit" disabled={command.busy || command.stale || (!command.uncertain && (!value.canSend || !value.emailReady || frozen || !etag))}>{command.busy ? "Confirmando envio…" : command.uncertain ? "Consultar resultado do envio" : "Enviar e-mail com anexo"}</Button>
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={command.busy} onClick={resource.reload}>Atualizar histórico</Button>
        </div>
        {!!value.deliveries.length && <details><summary className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium">Histórico de envios</summary><ul className="mt-3 space-y-3 text-sm">{value.deliveries.map(delivery => <li key={delivery.id} className="break-words rounded-lg border p-3">{deliveryLabels[delivery.status]}<br />{delivery.recipient} · {new Date(delivery.createdAt).toLocaleString("pt-BR")}</li>)}</ul></details>}
      </form>
    }
    name: CI
    
    on:
      pull_request:
      workflow_dispatch:
    
    permissions:
      contents: read
    
    concurrency:
      group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    
    env:
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
    
    jobs:
      changes:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 2
        outputs:
          web: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.web }}
          api: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.api }}
          fiscal: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.fiscal }}
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            with:
              fetch-depth: 0
          - run: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p 'test_*.py'
          - id: scope
            env:
              BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || format('{0}^', github.sha) }}
            run: python3 -B scripts/ci/pr-gate.py plan
    
      web:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.web == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
            with:
              version: 11.11.0
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
              cache: pnpm
              cache-dependency-path: pnpm-lock.yaml
          - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline
          - run: pnpm --filter web lint
          - run: node --import ./tests/helpers/register-typescript.mjs --test tests/*-model.node.mjs
            working-directory: apps/web
    
      api:
        needs: changes
        if: needs.changes.outputs.api == 'true'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 20
        services:
          postgres:
            image: postgres:18-alpine
            env:
              POSTGRES_DB: erp_next_test

    import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { erpFetch } from "@/lib/api/client"
    
    type Count = { id: string; status: "open" | "approved" | "cancelled"; reference: string; createdAt: string; lineCount: number; countedLines: number }
    type CountLine = { productId: string; sku: string; name: string; unit: string; expectedQuantity: string; countedQuantity: string | null }
    type CountDetail = { count: Count; lines: CountLine[] }
    const labels = { open: "Aberto", approved: "Aprovado", cancelled: "Cancelado" }
    
    async function read(response: Response) { const value = await response.json(); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(value.title || "Operação indisponível"); return value }
    
    export function InventoryCounts() {
      const [counts, setCounts] = useState<Count[]>([]); const [reference, setReference] = useState(""); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false); const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const load = useCallback(async () => { setLoading(true); setError(""); try { setCounts((await read(await erpFetch("/api/erp/inventory-counts?limit=100&offset=0", { cache: "no-store" }))).data || []) } catch (cause) { setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Inventários indisponíveis") } finally { setLoading(false) } }, [])
      useEffect(() => { const timer = window.setTimeout(() => void load(), 0); return () => window.clearTimeout(timer) }, [load])
      const router = useRouter()
      async function create() { if (reference.trim().length < 2) { setError("Informe uma referência para o inventário."); return } setBusy(true); setError(""); try { const created = await read(await erpFetch("/api/erp/inventory-counts", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ reference: reference.trim() }), headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID() } })); router.push(`/estoque/inventarios/${created.id}`) } catch (cause) { setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Não foi possível criar o inventário") } finally { setBusy(false) } }
      return <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1450px] px-4 pb-24 pt-8 lg:px-6"><div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3">{<Button variant="outline" onClick={() => void load()} disabled={loading}><RefreshCw />Atualizar</Button>}</div><section className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5"><h2 className="font-semibold">Novo inventário</h2><div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row"><Input value={reference} onChange={event => setReference(event.target.value)} placeholder="Ex.: Inventário loja 07/11/2026" maxLength={120} /><Button onClick={() => void create()} disabled={busy}><Plus />Criar sessão</Button></div></section>{error && <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-4 text-sm" role="alert"><ShieldAlert className="mr-2 inline size-4" />{error}</p>}{loading ? <p className="mt-6" role="status">Carregando inventários…</p> : !counts.length ? <section className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-6"><ClipboardCheck className="size-6 text-primary" /><h2 className="mt-3 font-semibold">Nenhum inventário criado</h2><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">A primeira sessão começa com o saldo atual dos produtos ativos.</p></section> : <section className="mt-6 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card"><div className="divide-y divide-border">{counts.map(count => <Link className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 p-4 hover:bg-muted/30" href={`/estoque/inventarios/${count.id}`} key={count.id}><div><strong className="block">{count.reference}</strong><span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{count.countedLines}/{count.lineCount} produtos contados · {new Date(count.createdAt).toLocaleString("pt-BR")}</span></div><span className="rounded-full bg-muted px-3 py-1 text-xs">{labels[count.status]}</span></Link>)}</div></section>}</div>
    }
    
    export function InventoryCountDetail({ id }: { id: string }) {
      const [detail, setDetail] = useState<CountDetail | null>(null); const [error, setError] = useState(""); const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
      const load = useCallback(async () => { try { setDetail(await read(await erpFetch(`/api/erp/inventory-counts/${id}`, { cache: "no-store" }))); setError("") } catch (cause) { setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Inventário indisponível") } }, [id])
      useEffect(() => { const timer = window.setTimeout(() => void load(), 0); return () => window.clearTimeout(timer) }, [load])
      async function save(line: CountLine, value: string) { setBusy(true); try { await read(await erpFetch(`/api/erp/inventory-counts/${id}/lines`, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID() }, body: JSON.stringify({ productId: line.productId, countedQuantity: value }) })); await load() } catch (cause) { setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Contagem não salva") } finally { setBusy(false) } }
      async function approve() { setBusy(true); try { await read(await erpFetch(`/api/erp/inventory-counts/${id}/approve`, { method: "POST", headers: { "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID() } })); await load() } catch (cause) { setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Aprovação não realizada") } finally { setBusy(false) } }
      if (!detail) return <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1450px] px-4 py-8 lg:px-6"><p role={error ? "alert" : "status"}>{error || "Carregando inventário…"}</p></div>
      const { count, lines } = detail
      return <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1450px] px-4 pb-24 pt-8 lg:px-6"><PageHeader eyebrow="Estoque / Inventários" title={count.reference} description={`${count.countedLines} de ${count.lineCount} produtos contados.`} back={{ href: "/estoque/inventarios", label: "Inventários" }} actions={<Button disabled={busy || count.status !== "open" || count.countedLines !== count.lineCount} onClick={() => void approve()}><Check />Aprovar ajustes</Button>} />{error && <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-4 text-sm" role="alert">{error}</p>}<section className="mt-6 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card"><div className="divide-y divide-border">{lines.map(line => <div className="grid gap-3 p-4 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_160px_130px] sm:items-center" key={line.productId}><div><strong className="block">{line.name}</strong><span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{line.sku} · esperado {line.expectedQuantity} {line.unit}</span></div><Input aria-label={`Quantidade contada de ${line.name}`} defaultValue={line.countedQuantity ?? ""} type="number" min="0" step="0.000001" disabled={busy || count.status !== "open"} onBlur={event => { const value = event.currentTarget.value; if (value !== "" && value !== line.countedQuantity) void save(line, value) }} placeholder="Contado" /><span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{line.countedQuantity == null ? "Pendente" : "Contado"}</span></div>)}</div></section></div>

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """Plan bounded PR checks and attest their exact outcomes; fail closed."""
    import hashlib
    import json
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    import re
    import subprocess
    import sys
    
    DOMAINS = ("web", "api", "fiscal")
    
    
    def plan(paths):
        scope = dict.fromkeys(DOMAINS, False)
        for path in paths:
            if path.startswith(("docs/", "context/")) or ("/" not in path and path.endswith(".md")):
                continue
            if path.startswith(("apps/web/", "packages/")):
                scope["web"] = True
            elif path.startswith(("apps/api/", "migrations/", "queries/")) or path in (
                "Cargo.toml", "Cargo.lock", "rust-toolchain.toml"
            ):
                scope["api"] = True
            elif path.startswith(("apps/fiscal-engine/", "apps/fiscal-mcp/", "scripts/fiscal/", "integrations/fiscal/")):
                scope["fiscal"] = True
            else:
                # Unknown/new infrastructure must not silently bypass validation.
                scope = dict.fromkeys(DOMAINS, True)
        return scope
    
    
    def verdict(jobs):
        if not isinstance(jobs, dict) or set(jobs) != {"changes", *DOMAINS}:
            raise ValueError("Missing or unexpected validation jobs")
        changes = jobs["changes"]
        outputs = changes.get("outputs", {})
        if set(outputs) != set(DOMAINS) or any(value not in ("true", "false") for value in outputs.values()):
            raise ValueError("Missing or invalid scope")
        scope = {key: outputs[key] == "true" for key in DOMAINS}
        outcomes = {key: value["result"] for key, value in jobs.items()}
        passed = changes["result"] == "success" and all(
            outcomes[key] == ("success" if scope[key] else "skipped") for key in DOMAINS
        )
        return passed, scope, outcomes
    
    
    def attest(jobs, env):
        passed, scope, outcomes = verdict(jobs)
        for key in ("SOURCE_HEAD_SHA", "GITHUB_SHA"):
            if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{40}", env[key]):
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid {key}")
        data = {
            "schema": "avila-mlops-ci-attestation/2",
            "repository": env["GITHUB_REPOSITORY"],
            "sourceSha": env["SOURCE_HEAD_SHA"],
            "testedSha": env["GITHUB_SHA"],
            "workflow": env["GITHUB_WORKFLOW"],
            "event": env["GITHUB_EVENT_NAME"],
            "runId": int(env["GITHUB_RUN_ID"]),
            "runAttempt": int(env["GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"]),
            "ciGate": "passed" if passed else "failed",
            "validationScope": scope,
            "validationJobs": outcomes,
            "note": "Scoped PR checks only; skipped domains were not tested. No production or full regression attestation.",
        }
        data["evidenceSha256"] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
        return data
    
    
    def main():
        if sys.argv[1] == "plan":
            paths = subprocess.check_output([
                "git", "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames", "-z", os.environ["BASE_SHA"], "HEAD"
            ]).decode().split("\0")
            scope = plan([path for path in paths if path])
            with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
                for domain, selected in scope.items():
                    output.write(f"{domain}={str(selected).lower()}\n")
            print(json.dumps(scope, sort_keys=True))
        elif sys.argv[1] == "gate":
            data = attest(json.loads(os.environ["VALIDATION_JOBS"]), os.environ)
            target = Path(sys.argv[2])
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            print(data["ciGate"], json.dumps(data["validationJobs"], sort_keys=True))
            return 0 if data["ciGate"] == "passed" else 1
        else:
            raise ValueError("Expected plan or gate")
        return 0
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())

    .github/workflows\verification.yml
    name: ERP verification inventory
    
    on:
      pull_request:
        paths:
          - 'verification/**'
          - 'scripts/verification/**'
          - 'package.json'
          - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
          - '.github/workflows/verification.yml'
      workflow_dispatch:
    
    permissions:
      contents: read
    
    concurrency:
      group: verification-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    
    jobs:
      inventory:
        timeout-minutes: 1
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
            with:
              version: 11.11.0
          - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
            with:
              node-version: 24
              cache: pnpm
              cache-dependency-path: pnpm-lock.yaml
          - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          - run: pnpm test:verification
          - run: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s verification/ml -p 'test_*.py'
          - run: pnpm verify:erp
          - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
            if: always()
            with:
              name: erp-verification-${{ github.run_id }}
              path: artifacts/verification/
              if-no-files-found: warn

    # Referências técnicas
    
    [Voltar às telas](../README.md)
    
    As instruções de uso ficam nos [guias por tela](../README.md). Os contratos técnicos específicos de uma tela estão na pasta `referencias` ao lado do respectivo guia.
    
    ## Manutenção do projeto
    
    - [CONTEUDO-E-CONTRATOS](CONTEUDO-E-CONTRATOS.md)
    - [CONTEXTO-FUNCIONALIDADES](CONTEXTO-FUNCIONALIDADES.md)
    - [CONTRATOS-ACOES-P0](CONTRATOS-ACOES-P0.md)
    - [LANGFUSE](LANGFUSE.md)
    - [OPENAPI-CI](OPENAPI-CI.md)
    - [PLATFORM-TENANT-ADMINISTRATION](PLATFORM-TENANT-ADMINISTRATION.md)
    - [siscomex-local-evaluation](siscomex-local-evaluation.md)
    - [Planejamento das operações](PLANO-OPERACOES-ERP.mdx).
    
    ## Organização e conferência
    
    - [Mapa de rotas e guias](mapa-telas.csv): relaciona cada `page.tsx` ao guia responsável; lista rotas, não atesta operações executadas.
    - [Caminhos anteriores e atuais](movimentacoes.json): permite localizar os documentos reorganizados e conferir sua preservação.
    - [Verificação do projeto](../../verification/README.md): operações, fontes e verificações existentes.
    
    Para conferir links, fontes e cobertura das telas:
    
    ```powershell
    python scripts/docs/check.py
    ```
    
    Ao acrescentar uma tela, atualize o guia e o mapa. Ao mover um arquivo, atualize seus consumidores, inclusive o catálogo de verificação. Não publique dados pessoais, credenciais ou cópias privadas da operação nestes documentos.

    fn text(value: &str, max: usize) -> Result<String, DomainError> {
        let v = value.trim();
        if v.chars().count() < 3 || v.chars().count() > max || v.chars().any(char::is_control) {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Informe texto de 3 caracteres até o limite, sem controles",
            ));
        }
        Ok(v.into())
    }
    fn money(value: &str) -> Result<i64, DomainError> {
        let v = fixed(value, 2)?;
        if v > 99_999_999_999_999 {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Valor fora do limite"));
        }
        Ok(v)
    }
    fn positive(value: &str) -> Result<i64, DomainError> {
        let v = money(value)?;
        if v == 0 {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Valor deve ser positivo"));
        }
        Ok(v)
    }

    //! Request-scoped SMTP delivery with a durable, non-retriable delivery intent.
    //! The attachment is a captured commercial snapshot; no browser HTML or URL is accepted.
    use super::*;
    use crate::platform::{access, mail::MailAttachment};

    #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]

        can_send: bool,
        email_ready: bool,
        recipient: Option<String>,
        deliveries: Vec<OrderEmailDelivery>,
    }
    
    #[derive(Serialize, ToSchema)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]

    pub async fn get(
        State(state): State<AppState>,
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
        Path(id): Path<Uuid>,
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        let (tenant, mut tx, manage) =
            authorized(&state, &headers, &identity, READ, MANAGE, false).await?;
        let current = load(&mut tx, tenant, id, manage).await?;
        let recipient: Option<String> =
            sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT email FROM parties WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2")
                .bind(tenant)
                .bind(current.data.customer_id)
                .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
                .await
                .map_err(db)?;
        let deliveries = sqlx::query_as::<_, OrderEmailDelivery>(&format!(
            "{DELIVERY} WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND order_id=$2 ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 50"
        ))
        .bind(tenant)
        .bind(id)
        .fetch_all(&mut *tx)
        .await
        .map_err(db)?;
        let value = OrderEmailStatus {
            tenant_id: tenant,
            can_send: manage && current.data.status != "cancelled",
            email_ready: state.mail.is_some(),
            recipient,
            deliveries,
        };
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(StatusCode::OK, None, value))
    }

    fn delivery_status(result: &anyhow::Result<()>) -> &'static str {
        match result {
            Ok(()) => "sent",
            // Explicit 4xx/5xx SMTP responses confirm rejection. Transport loss and timeouts
            // may occur after the server accepted DATA, so they must remain uncertain.
            Err(error)
                if error
                    .downcast_ref::<lettre::transport::smtp::Error>()
                    .is_some_and(|smtp| smtp.is_transient() || smtp.is_permanent()) =>
            {
                "failed"
            }
            Err(_) => "uncertain",
        }
    }

        c['actions'].append(a)
    
    def pos(method,path,title,query=None,body=None,revision=False,permission=None,pre=(),writes=(),transition=None,created=False,pages=None):
        writing=method!='GET'
        headers=['Authorization','X-Tenant-Id']+(['If-Match'] if revision else [])+(['Idempotency-Key'] if writing else [])
        bff=path.replace('/api/v1/','/api/erp/').replace('{id}','[id]')
        sources=['apps/api/src/domains/pos.rs','apps/web/src/app'+bff+'/route.ts','apps/web/src/features/pos/pos-access.tsx']
        input={'headers':headers,'pathParameters':['id'] if '{id}' in path else [],'body':{'source':'apps/api/src/domains/pos.rs','type':body} if body else None,'query':query}
        a={'id':method.lower()+'-'+path.lstrip('/').replace('/','-').replace('{','').replace('}',''),
           'flow':'pos','status':'implemented','operation':{'method':method,'path':path},'actor':'active_tenant_member',
           'permissions':['sales.pos.read']+([permission or 'sales.pos.manage'] if writing else []),
           'input':input,'preconditions':['Empresa ativa, identidade autorizada e isolamento por tenant.',*pre],
           'transition':transition or {'from':'Registros de PDV da empresa','to':'Consulta sem alteração de estado'},
           'effects':{'writes':list(writes),'external':[],'excludes':['Não transmite NFC-e nem executa liquidação em banco, adquirente ou gateway.']},
           'concurrency':{'revision':revision,'idempotency':writing,'rule':('If-Match refere-se à revisão da sessão, inclusive no cancelamento da venda. ' if revision else '')+('Mesma chave e corpo retornam o resultado persistido sem repetir efeitos.' if writing else 'Leitura sem revisão ou chave de comando.')},
           'response':{'successStatuses':[201 if created else 200],'errorStatuses':sorted(set([401,403,404,422,503]+([409,428] if writing else [])+([400,412] if revision else []))),'action':title},
           'recovery':'Em resultado incerto, repetir a mesma chave e corpo; em revisão desatualizada, consultar a sessão antes de uma nova decisão.' if writing else 'Repetir a consulta após conferir acesso; falha não comprova ausência de registros.',
           'ui':{'pages':pages or ['/vendas/pdv','/vendas/pdv/fechamento','/vendas/pdv/historico'],'bff':{'method':method,'path':bff},'gap':None},
           'sources':sources,'verification':{'status':'not_verified_by_catalog','criteria':criteria}}
        assert all(Path(s).is_file() for s in sources), sources
        c['actions'].append(a)
    
    pos('GET','/api/v1/pos/products','Consultar produtos e preços para o PDV',
        query='destination e taxpayer obrigatórios; search até 200 caracteres, offset e limit.',
        pre=['UF e condição de contribuinte explícitas. Preço calculado pela política comercial; disponibilidade desconta reservas.'])
    pos('GET','/api/v1/pos/sessions','Listar sessões de caixa',
        query='status open/closed, register, startDate/endDate ordenados, offset e limit.')
    pos('GET','/api/v1/pos/sessions/current','Consultar sessão aberta',
        query='register opcional.',pre=['Retorna data null quando não houver sessão aberta correspondente.'])
    pos('GET','/api/v1/pos/sessions/{id}','Consultar sessão, movimentos e totais')
    pos('GET','/api/v1/pos/sales','Consultar histórico de vendas',
        query='status completed/cancelled, sessionId, offset e limit.')
    pos('GET','/api/v1/pos/sales/{id}','Consultar venda e sua sessão')
    pos('POST','/api/v1/pos/sessions','Abrir sessão de caixa',body='OpenInput',created=True,
        pre=['Identificação de 1 a 80 caracteres; conta caixa ativa da empresa.','Fundo de abertura não excede saldo financeiro; registro e conta não podem ter outra sessão aberta.'],
        writes=['Sessão, comando, auditoria e outbox na mesma transação.'],
        transition={'from':'Caixa sem sessão aberta','to':'Sessão open com fundo de abertura registrado'})
    pos('POST','/api/v1/pos/sessions/{id}/movements','Registrar suprimento ou sangria',body='MovementInput',revision=True,
        pre=['Sessão aberta com revisão atual; valor positivo e motivo.','Contas ativas distintas e saldo de origem suficiente; contraparte não pertence a outro caixa aberto.','Sangria não excede o dinheiro esperado da sessão.'],
        writes=['Transferência e lançamentos financeiros internos vinculados ao movimento; revisão da sessão, comando, auditoria e outbox.'],
        transition={'from':'Sessão open','to':'Sessão open com movimento registrado e revisão incrementada'})
    pos('POST','/api/v1/pos/sessions/{id}/sales','Concluir venda no PDV',body='CheckoutInput',revision=True,created=True,
        pre=['Sessão aberta com revisão atual; 1 a 100 produtos distintos e 1 a 20 pagamentos.','Cliente, quando informado, ativo e da empresa; UF e contribuinte explícitos.','Preço recalculado e total esperado iguais; soma dos pagamentos coincide com total.','Estoque disponível suficiente, preservando reservas; conta ativa e dinheiro na conta caixa da sessão.'],
        writes=['Venda e snapshots de itens/preços/pagamentos; saída de estoque e lançamentos financeiros internos.','Revisão da sessão, comando, auditoria e outbox confirmados na mesma transação.'],
        transition={'from':'Sessão open e itens conferidos','to':'Venda completed e revisão da sessão incrementada'})
    pos('POST','/api/v1/pos/sessions/{id}/close','Fechar sessão de caixa',body='CloseInput',revision=True,permission='sales.pos.close',
        pre=['Sessão aberta com revisão atual; valor contado válido.','Divergência entre contado e esperado exige justificativa.'],
        writes=['Situação closed, valor contado, motivo e revisão da sessão; comando, auditoria e outbox.'],
        transition={'from':'Sessão open','to':'Sessão closed, mantendo eventual diferença registrada'})
    pos('POST','/api/v1/pos/sales/{id}/cancel','Cancelar e estornar venda de PDV',body='CancelInput',revision=True,permission='sales.pos.cancel',
        pre=['Venda completed da empresa; sessão correspondente ainda aberta e revisão da sessão atual.','Motivo obrigatório; dinheiro esperado e saldos das contas suficientes para os estornos.'],
        writes=['Entrada de estoque vinculada aos movimentos originais e débitos financeiros internos de estorno.','Venda cancelled, revisão da sessão, comando, auditoria e outbox na mesma transação.'],
        transition={'from':'Venda completed em sessão aberta','to':'Venda cancelled uma única vez e revisão da sessão incrementada'})
    
    c['productFlows']['flows'].append({'id':'pos','title':'PDV, fechamento e histórico',
        'goal':'Abrir sessão, registrar vendas e movimentos internos, conferir fechamento e consultar histórico por empresa.',
        'kind':'product','actionGroups':['pos'],'dependencies':['products','financial-accounts','price-tables'],
        'nextStep':'Conferir operação autenticada e extensões; mapeamento não comprova venda real, liquidação bancária ou autorização de NFC-e.',
        'additionalSources':['docs/telas/vendas/pdv/README.md']})
    for item in c['pendingFlows']:
        if item['id']=='pending-11':
            item['title']='PDV — extensões e aceite operacional'
            item['intent']='Conferir a operação publicada e definir extensões além dos contratos de sessão, venda, estorno e fechamento já mapeados.'
    p.write_text(json.dumps(c,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
    print('Added 13 API contracts and linked 15 existing BFF operations; no runtime behavior changed.')

        @'
        from pathlib import Path
        import json,re,subprocess
        p=Path('verification/contracts.json'); desired=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')); original=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:verification/contracts.json']).decode('utf-8'); decoder=json.JSONDecoder(); edits=[]
        for key,spaces,new_values in [('actions',2,desired['actions']),('pendingFlows',2,desired['pendingFlows']),('flows',4,desired['productFlows']['flows'])]:
         m=re.search(r'^'+(' '*spaces)+'"'+key+r'":\s*',original,re.M); assert m,key
         start=m.end(); old_values,end=decoder.raw_decode(original,start); wanted={x['id']:x for x in new_values}; offset=start+1
         for item in old_values:
          while original[offset].isspace() or original[offset]==',': offset+=1
          parsed,stop=decoder.raw_decode(original,offset); assert parsed==item
          if item!=wanted[item['id']]:
           indent=' '*(spaces+2); replacement=json.dumps(wanted[item['id']],ensure_ascii=False,indent=2).replace('\n','\n'+indent)
           edits.append((offset,stop,replacement))
          offset=stop
         old_ids={x['id'] for x in old_values}; additions=[x for x in new_values if x['id'] not in old_ids]
         if additions:
          tail=end-1
          while original[tail-1].isspace(): tail-=1
          indent=' '*(spaces+2)
          addition=',\n'+',\n'.join(indent+json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2).replace('\n','\n'+indent) for x in additions)+'\n'+(' '*spaces)
          edits.append((tail,end-1,addition))
        result=original
        for start,end,value in sorted(edits,reverse=True): result=result[:start]+value+result[end:]
        assert json.loads(result)==desired
        p.write_text(result,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
        print('Formatting preserved; parsed catalogue identical to reviewed version.')

    import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
    import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
    import { join } from "node:path";
    import type { XMLLintOptions, XMLValidationResult } from "xmllint-wasm";
    import manifest from "./schemas/manifest.json" with { type: "json" };
    
    export type FiscalXmlKind = keyof typeof manifest.packages;
    type SchemaFile = { fileName: string; contents: string };
    export type FiscalSchemaBundle = { release: string; entry: string; files: SchemaFile[] };
    type SchemaReader = (relative: string) => Promise<string>;
    type Validator = (options: XMLLintOptions) => Promise<XMLValidationResult>;
    
    /** Both failures block transmission; neither is a rejection from SEFAZ. */
    export class FiscalXmlError extends Error {
      readonly reason: "invalid" | "unavailable";
    
      constructor(reason: "invalid" | "unavailable", message: string) {
        super(message);
        this.name = "FiscalXmlError";
        this.reason = reason;
      }
    }
    
    const unavailable = () => new FiscalXmlError("unavailable", "A conferência local do XML está indisponível. Nada foi transmitido. Tente novamente; se continuar, peça à equipe para conferir o validador e o pacote de schemas.");
    const SCHEMAS = join(process.cwd(), "src/lib/fiscal/schemas");
    const MAX_XML_BYTES = 1_048_576;
    const ROOTS: Record<FiscalXmlKind, string> = { nfe: "NFe", evento: "evento", inutilizacao: "inutNFe" };
    
    /** Fixed, versioned files only. No location from the invoice chooses a file. */
    export async function readFiscalSchemas(kind: FiscalXmlKind, read: SchemaReader = (relative) => readFile(join(SCHEMAS, relative), "utf8")): Promise<FiscalSchemaBundle> {
      try {
        const pack = manifest.packages[kind];
        if (!pack) throw unavailable();
        const files = await Promise.all(pack.files.map(async ({ name, sha256 }) => {
          if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+\.xsd$/.test(name)) throw unavailable();
          const contents = await read(`${kind}/${name}`);
          if (createHash("sha256").update(contents, "utf8").digest("hex") !== sha256) throw unavailable();
          return { fileName: name, contents };
        }));
        const names = new Set(files.map((file) => file.fileName));
        if (!names.has(pack.entry)) throw unavailable();
        for (const file of files) {
          for (const match of file.contents.matchAll(/schemaLocation\s*=\s*["']([^"']+)["']/g)) {
            if (!names.has(match[1])) throw unavailable();
          }
        }
        return { release: pack.release, entry: pack.entry, files };
      } catch {
        throw unavailable();
      }
    }
    
    /** Factored dependencies let tests simulate missing WASM/schemas without disabling the live check. */
    export function createFiscalXmlValidator(
      load: (kind: FiscalXmlKind) => Promise<FiscalSchemaBundle> = readFiscalSchemas,
      validate: Validator = async (options) => (await import("xmllint-wasm")).validateXML(options),
    ) {
      const bundles = new Map<FiscalXmlKind, Promise<FiscalSchemaBundle>>();
      let active = 0;
      return async (xml: string, kind: FiscalXmlKind): Promise<void> => {
        if (typeof xml !== "string" || Buffer.byteLength(xml, "utf8") > MAX_XML_BYTES || xml.includes("\0") || /<!\s*(?:DOCTYPE|ENTITY)\b/i.test(xml)) {
          throw new FiscalXmlError("invalid", "XML fiscal recusado: tamanho máximo de 1 MiB; DTD, entidades e caracteres nulos não são permitidos. Nada foi transmitido.");
        }
        const body = xml.replace(/^\s*<\?xml\b[^?]*\?>\s*/, "").trim();
        const root = /^<(?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*:)?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)\b/.exec(body)?.[1];
        // A namespace prefix changes the spelling, not the XML-DSig element.
        // The pinned XSD below still checks its namespace and document position.
        if (root !== ROOTS[kind] || !/<(?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*:)?Signature\b/.test(body)) throw new FiscalXmlError("invalid", "O XML fiscal não é o documento assinado esperado. Nada foi transmitido.");
        // Each validation starts an isolated worker with a bounded WASM heap.
        if (active >= 4) throw new FiscalXmlError("unavailable", "A conferência local está ocupada. Aguarde alguns instantes e tente novamente. Nada foi transmitido.");
        active += 1;
        try {
          let pending = bundles.get(kind);
          if (!pending) {
            pending = load(kind);
            bundles.set(kind, pending);
          }
          let pack: FiscalSchemaBundle;
          try {
            pack = await pending;
          } catch {
            bundles.delete(kind);
            throw unavailable();
          }
          const entry = pack.files.find((file) => file.fileName === pack.entry);

    impl ProductInput {
        pub(crate) fn validate(&mut self) -> Result<i64, DomainError> {
            if let Some(legacy) = self.arm_colors.take() {
                if self.plate_holder_colors.as_ref().is_some_and(|current| {
                    current.len() != legacy.len()
                        || current.iter().zip(&legacy).any(|(current, legacy)| {
                            !current.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(legacy.trim())
                        })
                }) {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                        "Informe as cores dos anilheiros apenas em plateHolderColors",
                    ));
                }
                if self.plate_holder_colors.is_none() {
                    self.plate_holder_colors = Some(legacy);
                }
            }
            if let Some(legacy) = self.plate_holder_type.take() {
                if legacy.trim().is_empty() {
                    if self
                        .plate_holder_types
                        .as_ref()
                        .is_some_and(|current| !current.is_empty())
                    {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                            "Informe os tipos de anilheiro apenas em plateHolderTypes",
                        ));
                    }
                    if self.plate_holder_types.is_none() {
                        self.plate_holder_types = Some(Vec::new());
                    }
                } else {
                    let normalized = match legacy.trim().to_lowercase().as_str() {
                        "standard" => "Standard",
                        "olympic" | "olímpico" => "Olímpico",
                        _ => {
                            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                                "Tipo de anilheiro deve ser Olímpico ou Standard",
                            ));
                        }
                    };
                    if self.plate_holder_types.as_ref().is_some_and(|current| {
                        current.len() != 1 || !current[0].trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(normalized)
                    }) {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                            "Informe os tipos de anilheiro apenas em plateHolderTypes",
                        ));
                    }
                    if self.plate_holder_types.is_none() {
                        self.plate_holder_types = Some(vec![normalized.to_owned()]);
                    }
                }
            }
            if let Some(category) = &mut self.category_id {
                *category = category.trim().to_owned();
                if !category.is_empty() && Uuid::parse_str(category).is_err() {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Categoria inválida"));
                }
            }
            if let Some(photo) = self
                .photo_data_url
                .as_deref()
                .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
            {
                let invalid = || {
                    DomainError::Invalid(
                        "Foto exige JPEG válido com até 256 KiB; selecione a imagem novamente",
                    )
                };
                if photo.len() > 350000 {
                    return Err(invalid());
                }
                let encoded = photo
                    .strip_prefix("data:image/jpeg;base64,")
                    .ok_or_else(invalid)?;
                let bytes = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD
                    .decode(encoded)
                    .map_err(|_| invalid())?;
                if bytes.len() > 262144
                    || !bytes.starts_with(&[0xff, 0xd8, 0xff])
                    || !bytes.ends_with(&[0xff, 0xd9])
                {
                    return Err(invalid());
                }
            }
            self.sku = self.sku.trim().to_ascii_uppercase();
            self.name = self.name.trim().to_owned();
            self.unit = self.unit.trim().to_ascii_uppercase();
            if self.sku.is_empty()
                || self.sku.len() > 80
                || !self
                    .sku
                    .bytes()
                    .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"._/-".contains(&c))
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "SKU deve conter até 80 letras ASCII, números, ponto, barra, hífen ou sublinhado",
                ));
            }
            if self.name.is_empty() || self.name.chars().count() > 200 {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Nome deve conter de 1 a 200 caracteres",
                ));
            }
            if self.unit.is_empty()
                || self.unit.len() > 6
                || !self.unit.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_uppercase())
            {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Unidade deve conter de 1 a 6 letras"));
            }
            for (code, size) in [(&self.ncm, 8), (&self.cest, 7)] {
                if code
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_some_and(|s| s.len() != size || !s.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()))
                {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                        "NCM exige 8 dígitos e CEST exige 7; use null para não informado",
                    ));
                }
            }
            if !["active", "archived"].contains(&self.status.as_str()) {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Situação inválida"));
            }
            for options in [
                &mut self.structure_colors,
                &mut self.upholstery_colors,
                &mut self.plate_holder_colors,
                &mut self.plate_holder_types,
            ]
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            {
                if options.len() > 32 {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                        "Cadastre até 32 opções por acabamento",
                    ));
                }
                let mut names = std::collections::HashSet::new();
                for name in options {
                    *name = name.trim().to_owned();
                    if name.is_empty()
                        || name.chars().count() > 60
                        || name.chars().any(char::is_control)
                        || !names.insert(name.to_lowercase())
                    {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                            "Opções exigem nomes únicos de 1 a 60 caracteres, sem caracteres de controle",
                        ));
                    }
                }
            }
            if self.plate_holder_types.as_ref().is_some_and(|types| {
                types.len() > 2
                    || types
                        .iter()
                        .any(|value| !["Olímpico", "Standard"].contains(&value.as_str()))
            }) {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Tipo de anilheiro deve ser Olímpico ou Standard",
                ));
            }
            fixed(&self.base_price, 2)
        }
    }

    struct ProductRow {
        main_media_id: Option<Uuid>,
        upholstery_configurable: bool,
        category_id: Option<Uuid>,
        has_photo: bool,
        photo_data_url: Option<String>,
        id: Uuid,
        sku: String,
        name: String,
        unit: String,
        ncm: Option<String>,
        cest: Option<String>,
        price_cents: i64,
        status: String,
        revision: i64,
        structure_colors: Vec<String>,
        upholstery_colors: Vec<String>,
        plate_holder_colors: Vec<String>,
        plate_holder_types: Vec<String>,
        plate_holder_type: String,
    }
    impl From<ProductRow> for Product {
        fn from(r: ProductRow) -> Self {
            let mut plate_holder_types = r.plate_holder_types;
            if plate_holder_types.is_empty() {
                match r.plate_holder_type.as_str() {
                    "standard" => plate_holder_types.push("Standard".to_owned()),
                    "olympic" => plate_holder_types.push("Olímpico".to_owned()),
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
            let plate_holder_type = match plate_holder_types.as_slice() {
                [kind] if kind == "Standard" => Some("standard".to_owned()),
                [kind] if kind == "Olímpico" => Some("olympic".to_owned()),
                _ => None,
            };
            Self {
                photo_url: r
                    .main_media_id
                    .map(|media| format!("/api/erp/products/{}/media/{media}", r.id)),
                upholstery_configurable: r.upholstery_configurable,
                id: r.id,
                revision: r.revision,
                has_photo: r.has_photo,
                data: ProductInput {
                    category_id: r.category_id.map(|id| id.to_string()),
                    photo_data_url: r.photo_data_url,
                    sku: r.sku,
                    name: r.name,
                    unit: r.unit,
                    ncm: r.ncm,
                    cest: r.cest,
                    base_price: decimal(r.price_cents, 2),
                    status: r.status,
                    structure_colors: Some(r.structure_colors),
                    upholstery_colors: Some(r.upholstery_colors),
                    arm_colors: None,
                    plate_holder_colors: Some(r.plate_holder_colors),
                    plate_holder_types: Some(plate_holder_types),
                    plate_holder_type,
                },
            }
        }
    }

    fn select_color(
        requested: Option<&str>,
        available: &[String],
        previous: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<Option<String>, DomainError> {
        let selected = requested
            .or(previous)
            .map(str::trim)
            .filter(|value| !value.is_empty());
        let Some(selected) = selected else {
            return if available.is_empty() {
                Ok(None)
            } else {
                Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                    "Escolha as cores disponíveis da estrutura e do estofado antes de salvar",
                ))
            };
        };
        if previous == Some(selected) {
            return Ok(Some(selected.to_owned()));
        }
        available
            .iter()
            .find(|color| color.to_lowercase() == selected.to_lowercase())
            .cloned()
            .map(Some)
            .ok_or(DomainError::Invalid(
                "A cor escolhida não está disponível neste produto; atualize as opções antes de salvar",
            ))
    }
    
    // Holder colors remain accepted for older clients, but are never required.
    fn select_optional_color(
        requested: Option<&str>,
        available: &[String],
        previous: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<Option<String>, DomainError> {
        let Some(selected) = requested.map(str::trim).filter(|value| !value.is_empty()) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        select_color(Some(selected), available, previous)
    }
    
    // Sales options are fixed, independent of legacy product catalog choices.
    fn select_plate_holder_type(
        requested: Option<&str>,
        previous: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<Option<String>, DomainError> {
        let Some(selected) = requested.map(str::trim).filter(|value| !value.is_empty()) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        match selected.to_lowercase().as_str() {
            "não se aplica" => Ok(None),
            "standard" => Ok(Some("Standard".to_owned())),
            "olímpico" => Ok(Some("Olímpico".to_owned())),
            _ if previous == Some(selected) => Ok(Some(selected.to_owned())),
            _ => Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Tipo de anilheiro deve ser Standard, Olímpico ou Não se aplica",
            )),
        }
    }
    
    fn legacy_plate_holder_color<'a>(
        plate_holder_color: Option<&'a str>,
        arm_color: Option<&'a str>,
    ) -> Result<Option<&'a str>, DomainError> {
        if let (Some(current), Some(legacy)) = (plate_holder_color, arm_color)
            && !current.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(legacy.trim())
        {
            return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                "Informe a cor dos anilheiros apenas em plateHolderColor",
            ));
        }
        Ok(plate_holder_color.or(arm_color))
    }

    impl ProposalInput {
        fn normalize_legacy_component_colors(&mut self) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
            for item in &mut self.items {
                let Some(legacy) = item.arm_color.take() else {
                    continue;
                };
                if item
                    .plate_holder_color
                    .as_deref()
                    .is_some_and(|current| !current.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(legacy.trim()))
                {
                    return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                        "Informe a cor dos anilheiros apenas em plateHolderColor",
                    ));
                }
                if item.plate_holder_color.is_none() {
                    item.plate_holder_color = Some(legacy);
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

            assert text.count(old)==count,(path,old,text.count(old),count)
            text=text.replace(old,new)

        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        Path(code): Path<String>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
        payload: Result<Json<CreateInput>, JsonRejection>,
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        let key = command_key(&headers)?;
        let (tenant, mut tx, _) = authorized(
            &state,
            &headers,
            &identity,
            pricing::READ,
            pricing::MANAGE,
            true,
        )
        .await?;
        let Json(input) = payload.map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("Dados do pedido inválidos"))?;
        pricing::line(&code)?;
        let request = json!({"line":code,"input":input});
        if let Some(previous) = replay(
            &mut tx,
            tenant,
            &identity.subject,
            key,
            "order.simulated",
            &request,
        )
        .await?
        {
            tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
            return Ok(response(StatusCode::CREATED, Some(1), previous));
        }
        let prepared = pricing::prepare(&mut tx, tenant, &code, &input.quote).await?;
        if prepared.digest != input.digest {
            return Err(DomainError::StaleRevision);
        }
        let order_input = super::OrderInput {
            customer_id: input.customer_id,
            due_date: input.due_date.clone(),
            items: vec![super::OrderItemInput {
                product_id: input.quote.product_id,
                quantity: format!("{}.000000", input.quote.quantity),
                structure_color: input.structure_color,
                arm_color: None,
                plate_holder_color: input.plate_holder_color,
                plate_holder_type: input.plate_holder_type,
                upholstery_color: input.upholstery_color,
            }],
        };
        let mut order = super::prepare_order(&mut tx, tenant, &order_input, None, true).await?;
        order.total = prepared.quote.sale.invoice_total_cents;
        order.lines[0].price = prepared.quote.sale.unit_with_ipi_cents;
        order.lines[0].amount = order.total;
        order.lines[0].sku = prepared.product["sku"]
            .as_str()
            .ok_or(DomainError::Conflict("SKU publicado inválido"))?
            .into();
        order.lines[0].name = prepared.product["name"]
            .as_str()
            .ok_or(DomainError::Conflict("Nome publicado inválido"))?
            .into();
        let id = Uuid::now_v7();
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO sales_orders(id,tenant_id,customer_id,customer_name,customer_tax_id,due_date,amount_cents,status) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,'draft')")
            .bind(id).bind(tenant).bind(input.customer_id).bind(&order.customer_name).bind(&order.customer_tax_id).bind(order.due).bind(order.total).execute(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;

    #[derive(FromRow)]
    struct Line {
        structure_color: Option<String>,
        plate_holder_color: Option<String>,
        plate_holder_type: Option<String>,
        upholstery_color: Option<String>,
        product_id: Uuid,
        sku: String,
        name: String,
        unit: String,
        quantity_micros: i64,
        price_cents: i64,
        amount_cents: i64,
    }
    
    impl Line {
        fn finish_information(&self) -> Option<String> {
            self.describe_finish(false)
        }
    
        // Previously generated linked drafts may retain the old description.
        fn recorded_finish_information(&self) -> Option<String> {
            self.describe_finish(true)
        }
    
        fn describe_finish(&self, include_legacy_holder_color: bool) -> Option<String> {
            let values = [
                ("Estrutura", &self.structure_color, true),
                (
                    "Anilheiros",
                    &self.plate_holder_color,
                    include_legacy_holder_color,
                ),
                ("Tipo de anilheiro", &self.plate_holder_type, true),
                ("Estofado", &self.upholstery_color, true),
            ]
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|(_, _, include)| *include)
            .filter_map(|(label, value, _)| {
                value
                    .as_deref()
                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
                    .map(|s| format!("{label}: {s}"))
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
            (!values.is_empty()).then(|| values.join("; "))
        }
    }
