    function key(value: string) {
      return value.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/[\s-]+/g, "")
    }
    
    export type CatalogPalette = "dhz-hammerforce"
    
    export function catalogPaletteFor(structureColors?: readonly string[] | null): CatalogPalette | undefined {
      const colors = new Set((structureColors ?? []).map(key))
      return colors.has("pianoblack") && colors.has("titaniumgrey") && (colors.has("graphiteblack") || colors.has("mattegraphiteblack")) ? "dhz-hammerforce" : undefined
    }
    
    const hammerForceAliases: Record<string, string> = {
      preto: "Piano Black",
      grafite: "Matte Graphite Black",
      cinza: "Light Grey",
      vermelho: "Performance Red",
      laranja: "Hermès Orange",
      azul: "Ocean Blue",
    }
    
    export function catalogColorPhoto(value: string, palette?: CatalogPalette) {
      // Resolve legacy swing-arm labels only after the same product identifies its palette.
      const aliasKey = key(value)
      const alias = palette === "dhz-hammerforce" && Object.hasOwn(hammerForceAliases, aliasKey) ? hammerForceAliases[aliasKey] : undefined
      const normalized = key(alias ?? value)
      // The supplier's shortened label refers to the same named graphite finish.
      return photos.find(photo => key(photo.name) === normalized || (photo.name === "Matte Graphite Black" && normalized === "graphiteblack"))
    }

      structure: { standard: ["Piano Black", "Matte Graphite Black", "Light Grey", "Performance Red"], special: ["Titanium Grey"] },

      structure: { standard: ["Piano Black", "Graphite Black", "Light Grey", "Performance Red", "Titanium Grey"], special: [] },
      swingArm: { standard: ["Piano Black", "Graphite Black", "Light Grey", "Performance Red", "Hermès Orange", "Apple Green", "Ocean Blue"], special: ["Titanium Grey"] },
      upholstery: { standard: ["Black", "Saddle Brown", "Reddish Brown", "Khaki", "Mocha"], special: [] },
     },
    }
    
    export function getCatalogFinishPalette(value?: string | null): CatalogFinishDefinition | undefined {
     return value && Object.hasOwn(palettes, value) ? palettes[value as CatalogFinishPalette] : undefined
    }
    
    function colorKey(value: string, part: CatalogFinishPart) {
     const key = value.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/[\s-]+/g, "")
     // The supplier uses both graphite labels for paint; this does not translate generic fabrics or colors.
     return part !== "upholstery" && key === "mattegraphiteblack" ? "graphiteblack" : key
    }
    
    export function catalogFinishGroups(reference: string | null | undefined, part: CatalogFinishPart, available?: readonly string[] | null) {
     const options = [...(available ?? [])]
     const palette = getCatalogFinishPalette(reference)
     if (!palette) return { standard: [], special: [], other: options }
     const standard = new Set(palette[part].standard.map(name => colorKey(name, part)))
     const special = new Set(palette[part].special.map(name => colorKey(name, part)))
     return {
      standard: options.filter(name => standard.has(colorKey(name, part))),
      special: options.filter(name => !standard.has(colorKey(name, part)) && special.has(colorKey(name, part))),
      other: options.filter(name => !standard.has(colorKey(name, part)) && !special.has(colorKey(name, part))),
     }
    }

    export function parseAmount(raw: string): number | null {
      const normalized = raw.trim().replace(",", ".")
      if (!/^\d{1,12}(?:\.\d{0,2})?$/.test(normalized)) return null
      const [whole, fraction = ""] = normalized.split(".")
      const value = Number(BigInt(whole) * BigInt(100) + BigInt(fraction.padEnd(2, "0")))
      return Number.isSafeInteger(value) ? value : null
    }

    # Acabamentos iguais aos catálogos, sem alterar o histórico
    
    ## Pedido e resultado esperado
    O usuário pediu as mesmas cores, nomes e amostras dos catálogos originais, em cadastro e fechamento de proposta/pedido/venda. Estrutura, braços e estofado são conjuntos distintos. Anilheiro possui somente a escolha de tipo: Standard, Olímpico ou Não se aplica conforme o produto; não existe cor de anilheiro válida na interface.
    
    Os campos atuais misturam upholsteryColors com “Braços”. Corrigir a semântica mantendo upholsteryColors/upholsteryColor para estofado e criando swingArmColors/swingArmColor para braços. armColors/armColor são aliases legados de cor de anilheiro e não podem mudar de significado.
    
    ## Contrato e histórico
    - Acrescentar swingArmColors opcional ao produto e swingArmColor opcional aos itens de simulação, proposta e pedido. Levar a seleção a leitura, gravação, conversões, snapshots e apresentação em documentos/contratos.
    - Acrescentar finishingPalette opcional ao produto, com referências explícitas dhz-hammerforce-pro ou dhz-sforce. Sem referência é válido; string vazia remove a referência; omissão na edição preserva. Não identificar fabricante ou paleta apenas por cor genérica.
    - Listas de cores seguem os limites existentes: até32 nomes únicos,1–60 caracteres, sem controle. Seleções devem pertencer às opções cadastradas para novos itens/escolhas.
    - Omissão de campo novo por clientes antigos preserva os dados na edição. Campos legados de anilheiro continuam independentes. Não reinterpretar Amarelo como Apple Green nem Preto genericamente como uma textura específica.
    - Escolhas históricas inalteradas continuam válidas ao editar quantidade/condições. Não recalcular ou reescrever snapshots antigos após atualizar o produto.
    - A configuração “estofado não configurável” não deve esconder nem apagar a escolha independente dos braços.
    - Manter autorização, isolamento de empresa, revisão, idempotência e preservação de fotos, preços, tributos, status e estoque.
    
    ## Fontes e apresentação
    Usar bytes originais dos rasters dos PDFs, com provenance e SHA, sem geração por IA ou aproximação de cor. Componentes devem mostrar amostras compactas e nomes do fabricante, com seleção por teclado e toque, estados selecionado/desabilitado e rótulos separados para estrutura, braços e estofado. Padrões e especiais devem ser diferenciados quando o catálogo os separa.
    
    HammerForce Pro: PDF local do checkout principal artifacts/catalog-drive-20261112/hammerforce-pro.pdf; imagem original já versionada em public/catalog/dhz-hammerforce-pro-original-colors.jpeg,1245×1759,SHA b352211bae13cfe9e0590f97d83918e8b7cb5bf21017f5b1bbd6ea06c647a7b7,página51/impresso101,xref805. Estrutura padrão: Piano Black,Matte Graphite Black,Light Grey,Performance Red. Braços padrão: os quatro anteriores,Hermès Orange,Apple Green. Estofado: Black,Saddle Brown,Reddish Brown,Mocha. Consultar o raster para opções especiais Titanium Grey/Ocean Blue.
    
    Hammer S-FORCE: PDF local hammer-s-force.pdf,página29,xref546; imagem extraída e visualmente conferida em artifacts/dhz-s-force-original-colors.jpeg,1245×1759,SHA106032e206a9c0bdedb51a450ba665900419bdf80e5fed18b089ec11af9203e4. Estrutura: Piano Black,Graphite Black,Light Grey,Performance Red,Titanium Grey. Braços padrão: Piano Black,Graphite Black,Light Grey,Performance Red,Hermès Orange,Apple Green,Ocean Blue; assinatura também mostra Titanium Grey. Estofado: Black,Saddle Brown,Reddish Brown,Khaki,Mocha.
    
    Cable Motion não declara uma paleta geral: não atribuir automaticamente a de outro catálogo. Cores desconhecidas mantêm nome textual, sem foto aproximada. Havendo mais de uma fonte para o modelo, registrar a referência escolhida e manter as demais fontes; não transformar paleta geral em afirmação não sustentada sobre cada acabamento de cada equipamento.
    
    ## Alinhamento de dados
    Após o contrato ser publicado, alinhar somente os Premium que possuam referência suficiente. Preparar diff por ID/SKU, backup, revisão e validação dos campos protegidos; aplicar e ler de volta antes de declarar preenchido. Não repetir a carga das94 fichas técnicas ou dos42 anilheiros. A planilha permanece em uma única aba e deve ser relida antes de escrever somente células relacionadas, preservando edições nativas.
    
    Continuam excluídos: preenchimento da linha nacional/Core e inserção dos dez modelos sem correspondente. O Excel nacional posteriormente conferido fornece custos de WH065/066, mas o pedido de conversão não revogou a suspensão de preenchimento.
    
    ## Migração antes de ativar uma versão
    Defeito observado na publicação anterior: o deploy trocou as imagens antes de aplicar202611120002 e GETparties retornou500 até a migração explícita. O próximo pacote com mudança de schema deve corrigir essa ordem. Versionar um helper de migração usando a imagem aprovada do mesmo SHA, backup privado prévio e execução SQLx. Executar antes de ativar serviços; falha mantém a versão anterior. Reutilizar o ambiente da API sem expor segredos e conexão local PostgreSQL por peer/socket; não compilar no servidor. Conferir checksums/migração, saúde e uma leitura autenticada após publicação.
    
    ## Aceite
    Produto → proposta/simulação → pedido → conversão/documento preserva os três componentes separados; histórico e clientes antigos continuam legíveis. Paletas e swatches correspondem às fontes, sem cor de anilheiro na UI. Testes cobrem omissão, históricos, permissões, empresa, revisão, repetição, desligamento de estofado e erros. Conferência real do layout em móvel/desktop e da versão publicada; sem envio de e-mail ou emissão fiscal como teste.
    import assert from "node:assert/strict";
    import { test } from "node:test";
    import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
    import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
    import { catalogColorPhoto, catalogPaletteFor } from "../src/features/catalog/catalog-color-photo-model.ts";
    
    test("legacy Portuguese aliases require the complete same-product DHZ signature", () => {
      assert.equal(catalogPaletteFor(["Piano Black", "Titanium Grey", "Graphite Black"]), "dhz-hammerforce");
      assert.equal(catalogPaletteFor(["PianoBlack", "TitaniumGrey", "MatteGraphiteBlack"]), "dhz-hammerforce");
      for (const colors of [undefined, [], ["Preto", "Cinza"], ["Piano Black"], ["Piano Black", "Titanium Grey"]]) {
        assert.equal(catalogPaletteFor(colors), undefined);
      }
      const aliases = { Preto: "Piano Black", Grafite: "Matte Graphite Black", Cinza: "Light Grey", Vermelho: "Performance Red", Laranja: "Hermès Orange", Azul: "Ocean Blue" };
      for (const [stored, name] of Object.entries(aliases)) {
        assert.equal(catalogColorPhoto(stored), undefined);
        assert.equal(catalogColorPhoto(stored, "dhz-hammerforce")?.name, name);
      }
      assert.equal(catalogColorPhoto("Amarelo", "dhz-hammerforce"), undefined);
    });
    
    test("matches distinctive catalog names while preserving the selected stored name", () => {
      assert.equal(catalogColorPhoto("Piano Black")?.name, "Piano Black");
      assert.equal(catalogColorPhoto("Graphite Black")?.name, "Matte Graphite Black");
      assert.equal(catalogColorPhoto("Hermès Orange")?.name, "Hermès Orange");
      assert.equal(catalogColorPhoto("Ocean Blue")?.name, "Ocean Blue");
      assert.equal(catalogColorPhoto("Titanium Grey")?.name, "Titanium Grey");
    });
    
    test("uses the manufacturer's leather rectangle for explicit Black upholstery", () => {
      const leather = catalogColorPhoto("Black");
      assert.ok(leather);
      assert.equal(leather.name, "Black");
      // The upholstery strip is below the equipment images; frame and arm samples are above them.
      assert.ok(leather.y >= 1653);
      assert.ok(catalogColorPhoto("Piano Black").y < 1653);
      assert.ok(catalogColorPhoto("Preto", "dhz-hammerforce").y < 1653);
      assert.ok(catalogColorPhoto("Grafite", "dhz-hammerforce").y < 1653);
      assert.equal(catalogColorPhoto("Preto"), undefined);
    });
    
    test("does not assign DHZ photos to generic or unknown colors", () => {
      for (const color of ["Preto", "Red", "Cinza", "Azul", "Piano Black especial", ""]) {
        assert.equal(catalogColorPhoto(color), undefined);
      }
    });
    
    test("catalog asset keeps the original embedded image bytes recorded in provenance", () => {
      const provenance = JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL("../public/catalog/dhz-hammerforce-pro-original-colors.provenance.json", import.meta.url), "utf8"));
      const image = readFileSync(new URL(`../public/catalog/${provenance.asset}`, import.meta.url));
      assert.equal(image.length, provenance.assetBytes);
      assert.equal(createHash("sha256").update(image).digest("hex"), provenance.assetSha256);
      for (const name of ["Piano Black", "Graphite Black", "Light Grey", "Performance Red", "Titanium Grey", "Hermès Orange", "Apple Green", "Ocean Blue", "Black", "Saddle Brown", "Reddish Brown", "Mocha"]) {
        const rectangle = catalogColorPhoto(name);
        assert.ok(rectangle, name);
        assert.ok(rectangle.x + rectangle.width <= provenance.width, name);
        assert.ok(rectangle.y + rectangle.height <= provenance.height, name);
      }
    });
    import assert from "node:assert/strict";
    import { test } from "node:test";
    import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
    import { createRequire } from "node:module";
    import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
    import React from "react";
    import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
    import ts from "typescript";
    
    const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
    const moduleUrl = source => "data:text/javascript;base64," + Buffer.from(source).toString("base64");
    const model = ts.transpileModule(readFileSync(new URL("../src/features/catalog/catalog-color-photo-model.ts", import.meta.url), "utf8"), { compilerOptions: { module: ts.ModuleKind.ESNext } }).outputText;
    const component = readFileSync(new URL("../src/features/catalog/catalog-color-photos.tsx", import.meta.url), "utf8")
      .replace('"./catalog-color-photo-model"', JSON.stringify(moduleUrl(model)));
    const compiled = ts.transpileModule(`import React from ${JSON.stringify(pathToFileURL(require.resolve("react")).href)};\n${component}`, { compilerOptions: { module: ts.ModuleKind.ESNext, jsx: ts.JsxEmit.React, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022 } }).outputText;
    const { CatalogColorPhotos } = await import(moduleUrl(compiled));
    
    test("product detail presents original palette without disabled tint or editable buttons", () => {
      const html = renderToStaticMarkup(React.createElement(CatalogColorPhotos, { label: "Braços", options: ["Preto", "Laranja", "Amarelo"], palette: "dhz-hammerforce", readOnly: true }));
      assert.equal((html.match(/background-image/g) ?? []).length, 2);
      assert.match(html, /Amarelo/);
      assert.doesNotMatch(html, /<button|disabled|opacity-50|aria-pressed/);
      assert.match(html, /dhz-hammerforce-pro-original-colors.jpeg/);
    });
    
    test("read-only unknown finishes keep their labels without invented photos", () => {
      const html = renderToStaticMarkup(React.createElement(CatalogColorPhotos, { label: "Estrutura", options: ["Preto", "Amarelo"], readOnly: true }));
      assert.match(html, /Preto/);
      assert.match(html, /Amarelo/);
      assert.doesNotMatch(html, /background-image|catálogo DHZ ·/);
    });

    ## Tailwind CSS
    
    [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/) is a utility-first CSS framework that provides low-level utility classes to build custom designs.
    
    <AppOnly>
    
    Install Tailwind CSS:
    
    ```bash package="pnpm"
    pnpm add -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss
    ```
    
    ```bash package="npm"
    npm install -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss
    ```
    
    ```bash package="yarn"
    yarn add -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss
    ```
    
    ```bash package="bun"
    bun add -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss
    ```
    
    Add the PostCSS plugin to your `postcss.config.mjs` file:
    
    ```js filename="postcss.config.mjs"
    export default {
      plugins: {
        '@tailwindcss/postcss': {},
      },
    }
    ```
    
    Import Tailwind in your global CSS file:
    
    ```css filename="app/globals.css"
    @import 'tailwindcss';
    ```
    
    Import the CSS file in your root layout:
    
    ```tsx filename="app/layout.tsx" switcher
    import './globals.css'
    
    export default function RootLayout({
      children,
    }: {
      children: React.ReactNode
    }) {
      return (
        <html lang="en">
          <body>{children}</body>
        </html>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/layout.js" switcher
    import './globals.css'
    
    export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
      return (
        <html lang="en">
          <body>{children}</body>
        </html>
      )
    }
    ```

    +  for (const [reference, asset] of [["dhz-hammerforce-pro", "dhz-hammerforce-pro"], ["dhz-sforce", "dhz-s-force"]]) {
    +    const provenance = JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL(`../public/catalog/${asset}-original-colors.provenance.json`, import.meta.url), "utf8"));
    +    const bytes = readFileSync(new URL(`../public/catalog/${provenance.asset}`, import.meta.url));
    +    assert.equal(bytes.length, provenance.assetBytes);
    +    assert.equal(createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex"), provenance.assetSha256);
    +    const palette = getCatalogFinishPalette(reference);
    +    for (const part of ["structure", "swingArm", "upholstery"]) {
    +      for (const name of [...palette[part].standard, ...palette[part].special]) {
    +        const sample = catalogColorPhoto(name, reference, part);
    +        assert.ok(sample, `${reference}/${part}/${name}`);
    +        assert.equal(sample.asset, palette.source.asset);
    +        assert.ok(sample.x >= 0 && sample.y >= 0);
    +        assert.ok(sample.x + sample.width <= provenance.width);
    +        assert.ok(sample.y + sample.height <= provenance.height);
    +        assert.equal(sample.y >= 1653, part === "upholstery");
    +      }
    +    }

    export function ColorChoice({ label, options = [], value, onChange, catalog, palette }: { label: string; palette?: CatalogPalette; options?: string[]; value: string; onChange: (value: string) => void; catalog?: { productId: string; tenantId: string; field: "structureColors" | "upholsteryColors" | "plateHolderColors" | "plateHolderTypes" } }) {

        </div>}

    from pathlib import Path
    
    def edit(path, replacements, line_replacements=()):
        p=Path(path); text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        for old,new,count in replacements:
            assert text.count(old)==count,(path,old,text.count(old),count)
            text=text.replace(old,new)
        for starts,new in line_replacements:
            lines=text.splitlines(); matches=[i for i,line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith(starts)]
            assert len(matches)==1,(path,starts,len(matches))
            lines[matches[0]]=new; text='\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
        p.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')

    use axum::{
        Router,
        body::{Body, to_bytes},
        http::{Request, StatusCode},
    };
    use serde_json::{Value, json};
    use sqlx::PgPool;
    use tower::ServiceExt;
    use uuid::Uuid;
    
    const TENANT: &str = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
    const CUSTOMER: &str = "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555";
    const PRODUCT: &str = "11111111-2222-4333-8444-666666666666";
    
    async fn call(
        router: &Router,
        method: &str,
        uri: &str,
        subject: &str,
        revision: Option<i64>,
        key: Option<Uuid>,
        body: Value,
    ) -> (StatusCode, Value) {
        let mut request = Request::builder()
            .method(method)
            .uri(uri)
            .header("x-tenant-id", TENANT)
            .header("content-type", "application/json");
        if !subject.is_empty() {
            request = request.header("authorization", format!("Bearer {subject}"));
        }
        if let Some(revision) = revision {
            request = request.header("if-match", format!("\"{revision}\""));
        }
        if let Some(key) = key {
            request = request.header("idempotency-key", key.to_string());
        }
        let result = router
            .clone()
            .oneshot(request.body(Body::from(body.to_string())).unwrap())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let status = result.status();
        let bytes = to_bytes(result.into_body(), 1_000_000).await.unwrap();
        (
            status,
            serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).unwrap_or(Value::Null),
        )
    }

    }

    async fn tax_profile_defaults_persist_with_exact_codes_zero_and_explicit_false(admin: PgPool) {
        let (router, application, server, role) = super::company_tests::setup(&admin).await;
        let input = json!({"profiles":[{"name":"Nacional","productLine":"national","operationNature":"Venda","pisRate":"1.65","cofinsRate":"7.6","ibsCbsCst":"000","classCode":"000001","active":true,"defaults":{"icmsCst":"00","ipiCst":"53","ipiFrameCode":"999","ibsCityRate":"0","finalConsumer":false}}]});
        for (method, revision, body) in [("PUT", Some("\"1\""), input), ("GET", None, Value::Null)] {
            let mut request = Request::builder()
                .method(method)
                .uri("/api/v1/registration-settings/tax-profiles")
                .header("x-tenant-id", TENANT)
                .header("authorization", "Bearer editor")
                .header("content-type", "application/json");
            if let Some(revision) = revision {
                request = request.header("if-match", revision);
            }
            let response = router
                .clone()
                .oneshot(request.body(Body::from(body.to_string())).unwrap())
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::OK);
            let result: Value =
                serde_json::from_slice(&to_bytes(response.into_body(), 100000).await.unwrap()).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(result["revision"], 2);
            let profile = &result["data"]["profiles"][0];
            assert_eq!(profile["pisRate"], "1.6500");
            assert_eq!(profile["productLine"], "national");
            assert!(profile.get("lineRules").is_none());
            assert_eq!(profile["defaults"]["icmsCst"], "00");
            assert_eq!(profile["defaults"]["ipiCst"], "53");
            assert_eq!(profile["defaults"]["ibsCityRate"], "0.0000");
            assert_eq!(profile["defaults"]["finalConsumer"], false);
        }
        assert_eq!(
            sqlx::query_scalar::<_, i64>(
                "SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log WHERE action='registration_settings.updated'"
            )
            .fetch_one(&admin)
            .await
            .unwrap(),
            1
        );
        super::company_tests::cleanup(&admin, application, server, &role).await;
    }

    """Capture in an exclusive CI job, at the same path as the cached compilation."""
    import hashlib
    import json
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    import re
    import subprocess
    import sys
    import time
    from contextlib import contextmanager
    
    
    BASELINE_REPAIR = json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name("baseline-1196d52.json").read_text())
    
    
    @contextmanager
    def baseline_compilation_repair(root, revision):
        """Instrument one non-compiling historical tree; never patch another baseline."""
        if revision != BASELINE_REPAIR["revision"]:
            yield None
            return
        target = root / BASELINE_REPAIR["path"]
        original = target.read_bytes()
        if hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest() != BASELINE_REPAIR["beforeSha256"]:
            raise ValueError("BASELINE_REPAIR_SOURCE_MISMATCH")
        before = BASELINE_REPAIR["original"].encode()
        if original.count(before) != 1:
            raise ValueError("BASELINE_REPAIR_NOT_UNIQUE")
        repaired = original.replace(before, BASELINE_REPAIR["replacement"].encode())
        if hashlib.sha256(repaired).hexdigest() != BASELINE_REPAIR["afterSha256"]:
            raise ValueError("BASELINE_REPAIR_OUTPUT_MISMATCH")
        try:
            target.write_bytes(repaired)
            yield BASELINE_REPAIR
        finally:
            target.write_bytes(original)
    
    
    def run(arguments, cwd, **kwargs):
        return subprocess.run(arguments, cwd=cwd, check=True, **kwargs)
    
    
    def git(root, *arguments):
        return subprocess.check_output(["git", *arguments], cwd=root).decode().strip()
    
    
    def sources(root, revision):
        names = git(root, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", revision, "Cargo.toml", "Cargo.lock",
                    "rust-toolchain.toml", "apps/api", "migrations").splitlines()
        return [{"path": name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(
            subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{revision}:{name}"], cwd=root)).hexdigest()}
            for name in names]
    
    
    def main():
        root = Path.cwd()
        if os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS") != "true":
            raise ValueError("CAPTURE_REQUIRES_EXCLUSIVE_CI_JOB")
        event_base = sys.argv[1]
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", event_base) or git(root, "rev-parse", f"{event_base}^{{commit}}") != event_base:
            raise ValueError("BASELINE_REQUIRES_COMMIT_SHA")
        revision = git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
        if git(root, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no"):
            raise ValueError("DIRTY_CANDIDATE")
        base = event_base
        initial = False
        bootstrap_file = root / "scripts/contracts/initial-baseline.json"
        if bootstrap_file.exists():
            bootstrap = json.loads(bootstrap_file.read_text())
            has_gate = subprocess.run(["git", "cat-file", "-e", f"{event_base}:scripts/contracts/gate.mjs"],
                                      cwd=root, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode == 0
            if not has_gate:
                if bootstrap["eventBaseRevision"] != event_base:
                    raise ValueError("UNREVIEWED_INITIAL_BASELINE")
                base = bootstrap["initialBaselineRevision"]
                if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", base) or git(root, "rev-parse", f"{base}^{{commit}}") != base:
                    raise ValueError("INVALID_INITIAL_BASELINE")
                if subprocess.run(["git", "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", base, revision], cwd=root).returncode != 0:
                    raise ValueError("INITIAL_BASELINE_OUTSIDE_CANDIDATE_HISTORY")
                initial = True
        output = root / "artifacts/contracts"
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        helper = root / "apps/api/src/http/openapi_export.rs"
        helper_bytes = helper.read_bytes()
        manifest = {"schemaVersion": "erp-openapi-capture/1", "eventBaseRevision": event_base,
                    "baselineRevision": base, "initialContract": initial, "historicalCompatibilityVerified": not initial,
                    "candidateRevision": revision, "helperSha256": hashlib.sha256(helper_bytes).hexdigest(),
                    "baselineInstrumented": False, "baselineSources": sources(root, base),
                    "eventBaseSources": sources(root, event_base), "candidateSources": sources(root, revision), "captures": []}
        baseline_source = root / "apps/api/src/http/openapi.rs"
        original = None
        created_helper = False
        try:
            run(["git", "checkout", "--detach", base], root)
            original = baseline_source.read_bytes()
            if b'include!("openapi_export.rs")' not in original:
                if helper.exists():
                    raise ValueError("AMBIGUOUS_BASELINE_HELPER")
                helper.write_bytes(helper_bytes)
                created_helper = True
                baseline_source.write_bytes(original + b'\n#[cfg(test)]\ninclude!("openapi_export.rs");\n')
                manifest["baselineInstrumented"] = True
            destination = output / "baseline.json"
            if destination.exists():
                raise ValueError("ARTIFACT_ALREADY_EXISTS")
            started = time.monotonic()
            environment = dict(os.environ)
            environment.pop("ERP_COMPANY_CONTRACT_OUTPUT", None)
            with baseline_compilation_repair(root, base) as repair:
                if repair:
                    manifest["baselineCompilationRepair"] = repair
                    manifest["historicalCompatibilityVerified"] = False
                run(["cargo", "test", "--locked", "-p", "erp-next-api", "export_openapi_contract_artifact", "--", "--test-threads=1"],
                    root, env={**environment, "ERP_OPENAPI_OUTPUT": str(destination)})
            manifest["captures"].append({"label": "baseline", "sha256": hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                                         "seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)})
        finally:
            if original is not None:
                baseline_source.write_bytes(original)
            if created_helper:
                helper.unlink()
            run(["git", "checkout", "--detach", revision], root)
        manifest["captures"].append({"label": "candidate", "sha256": hashlib.sha256((output / "candidate.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                                     "producer": "candidate Rust test job"})
        (output / "capture.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()

    // Included only under cfg(test). No configuration, database or HTTP startup.
    #[test]
    fn export_openapi_contract_artifact() {
        let document = ApiDoc::openapi();
        assert!(!document.paths.paths.is_empty());
        if let Some(output) = std::env::var_os("ERP_OPENAPI_OUTPUT") {
            let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
                .write(true)
                .create_new(true)
                .open(output)
                .expect("create a new contract artifact");
            serde_json::to_writer_pretty(&file, &document).expect("serialize OpenAPI");
            file.sync_all().expect("sync OpenAPI artifact");
        }
    }
    import { mkdir, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
    import { createRequire } from "node:module";
    import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path";
    import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
    import { readOpenApi } from "./gate.mjs";
    
    const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../", import.meta.url));
    const require = createRequire(new URL("./consumer/package.json", import.meta.url));
    
    export async function generateWeb(input, output = resolve(root, "apps/web/src/lib/api/generated.d.ts")) {
      if (!input) throw new Error("OPENAPI_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED");
      const { document } = await readOpenApi(resolve(input));
      const { default: openapiTS, astToString } = require("openapi-typescript");
      const source = astToString(await openapiTS(document));
      await mkdir(dirname(output), { recursive: true });
      await writeFile(output, source);
      return source;
    }
    
    if (process.argv[1] && pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href === import.meta.url) {
      await generateWeb(process.argv[2] || resolve(root, "artifacts/contracts/candidate.json"));
    }

"order-quantity-control" : undefined}>{orderMode && <Button type="button" variant="outline" aria-label={`Diminuir quantidade de ${name}`} disabled={disabled || !/^\d+$/.test(item.quantity) || Number(item.quantity) <= 1} onClick={() => update({ ...item, quantity: String(Number(item.quantity) - 1) })}><Minus aria-hidden="true" /></Button>}<Input data-order-field={orderMode ? `equipment.quantity.${item.productId}` : undefined} aria-invalid={orderMode && !validOrderQuantity(item.quantity) || undefined} aria-label={`Quantidade de ${name}`} className="px-2 text-center tabular-nums" inputMode="numeric" maxLength={7} disabled={disabled} value={item.quantity} onChange={e => update({ ...item, quantity: e.target.value })} />{orderMode && <Button type="button" variant="outline" aria-label={`Aumentar quantidade de ${name}`} disabled={disabled || !/^\d+$/.test(item.quantity) || Number(item.quantity) >= 1_000_000} onClick={() => update({ ...item, quantity: String(Number(item.quantity) + 1) })}><Plus aria-hidden="true" /></Button>}</div></td>
          {orderMode && <><td className="align-top">{price ? money(price.priceWithoutIpiCents) : "Indisponível"}</td><td className="align-top">{priced ? money(priced.tableUnitCents * priced.quantity - priced.netCents) : "—"}</td><td className="align-top">{priced ? money(priced.totalCents) : "—"}</td></>}
          <td className="py-3 align-top"><Button variant="ghost" size="icon" type="button" disabled={disabled} aria-label={`Remover equipamento ${name}`} onClick={remove}><X aria-hidden="true" /></Button></td>
        </tr>

"Carregando acabamentos…" : "Recarregar acabamentos"}</Button></div>}
          <details className="group min-w-0">
            <summary className="min-h-10 cursor-pointer rounded-md py-2 text-sm font-medium focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring">Acabamentos<span className="sr-only"> de {name}</span><span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground group-open:hidden">{selectedFinishes || "Escolher cores"}</span></summary>
            <fieldset disabled={disabled} className="grid min-w-0 gap-4 pt-3 sm:grid-cols-2">

          </details>

    function FinishChoice({ title, ...props }: Parameters<typeof ColorChoice>[0] & { title: string }) {
      return <div className="min-w-0 space-y-2 [&_label]:sr-only"><p className="text-sm font-medium">{title}</p><ColorChoice {...props} /></div>
    }
    "use client"
    import { catalogPaletteFor } from "@/features/catalog/catalog-color-photo-model"
    
    import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
    import { useRouter } from "next/navigation"
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
    import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
    import { RequestError } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { useCommand } from "@/hooks/use-operation"
    import { ColorChoice, Lookup, type Choice } from "@/features/sales/orders"
    import type { Equipment, Simulation } from "./simulator-model"
    
    export function SimulationOrder({ value, equipment, line, onLocked }: {
      value: Simulation; equipment: Equipment; line: string; onLocked: (locked: boolean) => void
    }) {
      const command = useCommand()
      const router = useRouter()
      const [customer, setCustomer] = useState<Choice | null>(null)
      const [dueDate, setDueDate] = useState("")
      const [structure, setStructure] = useState("")
      const [upholstery, setUpholstery] = useState("")
      const [error, setError] = useState("")
      const frozen = command.busy || command.uncertain
      useEffect(() => { onLocked(frozen) }, [frozen, onLocked])
      return <section className="form-section min-w-0 space-y-4" aria-label="Criar pedido da simulação">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">Criar pedido</h2><p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">O rascunho preserva a versão, os preços e as condições desta simulação.</p>
        <Lookup endpoint="parties" label="cliente" disabled={frozen} searchOnly choose={setCustomer} selectedName={customer?.legalName} />
        <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={async event => {
          event.preventDefault()
          if (!customer || command.busy) return
          setError("")
          const result = await command.send<{ tenantId: string; id: string; status: string }>(`/api/erp/sales-simulator/${line}/orders`, value.tenantId, {
            quote: value.input, digest: value.digest, customerId: customer.id, dueDate,
            structureColor: structure || null, upholsteryColor: upholstery || null,
          })
          if (result?.tenantId === value.tenantId && result.status === "draft" && /^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/.test(result.id)) router.replace(`/vendas/pedidos/${result.id}`)
          else if (result) setError("Confirmação divergente. Consulte os pedidos antes de repetir.")
        }}>
          <fieldset disabled={frozen} className="space-y-4">
            <label className="grid gap-2">Vencimento<Input required type="date" value={dueDate} onChange={event => setDueDate(event.target.value)} /></label>
            <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2"><ColorChoice label="Cor da estrutura" options={equipment.structureColors} value={structure} onChange={setStructure} /><ColorChoice palette={catalogPaletteFor(equipment.structureColors)} label={catalogPaletteFor(equipment.structureColors) ? "Cor dos braços" : "Cor do estofado"} options={equipment.upholsteryColors} value={upholstery} onChange={setUpholstery} /></div>
          </fieldset>
          {(error || command.error) && <p role="alert"><RequestError message={error || command.error} status={error ? undefined : command.status} /></p>}
          {command.stale && <p>Refaça a simulação antes de criar outro pedido.</p>}
          {command.uncertain && <p role="status">Resultado pendente. A repetição confere o mesmo comando.</p>}
          <Button type="submit" disabled={!customer || command.busy || command.stale || !!error}>{command.busy ? "Confirmando…" : command.uncertain ? "Conferir criação do pedido" : "Criar rascunho com estas condições"}</Button>
        </form>
      </section>
    }

    from pathlib import Path
    
    def edit(path, replacements, line_replacements=()):
        p=Path(path); text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        for old,new,count in replacements:
            assert text.count(old)==count,(path,old,text.count(old),count)
            text=text.replace(old,new)
        for starts,new in line_replacements:
            lines=text.splitlines(); matches=[i for i,line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith(starts)]
            assert len(matches)==1,(path,starts,len(matches))
            lines[matches[0]]=new; text='\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
        p.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')

    from pathlib import Path
    
    def edit(path, replacements, line_replacements=()):
        p=Path(path); text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        for old,new,count in replacements:
            assert text.count(old)==count,(path,old,text.count(old),count)
            text=text.replace(old,new)
        for starts,new in line_replacements:
            lines=text.splitlines(); matches=[i for i,line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith(starts)]
            assert len(matches)==1,(path,starts,len(matches))
            lines[matches[0]]=new; text='\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
        p.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')

    ---
    name: systematic-debugging
    description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
    ---
    
    # Systematic Debugging
    
    ## Overview
    
    **Core principle:** ALWAYS find root cause before attempting fixes. Symptom fixes are failure.
    
    **Violating the letter of this process is violating the spirit of debugging.**
    
    ## The Iron Law
    
    ```
    NO FIXES WITHOUT ROOT CAUSE INVESTIGATION FIRST
    ```
    
    If you haven't completed Phase 1, you cannot propose fixes.
    
    ## When to Use
    
    Use for ANY technical issue:
    - Test failures
    - Bugs in production
    - Unexpected behavior
    - Performance problems
    - Build failures
    - Integration issues
    
    **Use this ESPECIALLY when:**
    - Under time pressure (emergencies make guessing tempting)
    - "Just one quick fix" seems obvious
    - You've already tried multiple fixes
    - Previous fix didn't work
    - You don't fully understand the issue
    
    **Don't skip when:**
    - Issue seems simple (simple bugs have root causes too)
    - You're in a hurry (rushing guarantees rework)
    - Manager wants it fixed NOW (systematic is faster than thrashing)
    
    ## The Four Phases
    
    You MUST complete each phase before proceeding to the next.
    
    ### Phase 1: Root Cause Investigation
    
    **BEFORE attempting ANY fix:**
    
    1. **Read Error Messages Carefully**
       - Don't skip past errors or warnings
       - They often contain the exact solution
       - Read stack traces completely
       - Note line numbers, file paths, error codes
    
    2. **Reproduce Consistently**
       - Can you trigger it reliably?
       - What are the exact steps?
       - Does it happen every time?
       - If not reproducible → gather more data, don't guess
    
    3. **Check Recent Changes**
       - What changed that could cause this?
       - Git diff, recent commits
       - New dependencies, config changes
       - Environmental differences
    
    4. **Gather Evidence in Multi-Component Systems**
    
       **WHEN system has multiple components (CI → build → signing, API → service → database):**
    
       **BEFORE proposing fixes, add diagnostic instrumentation:**
       ```
       For EACH component boundary:
         - Log what data enters component
         - Log what data exits component
         - Verify environment/config propagation
         - Check state at each layer
    
       Run once to gather evidence showing WHERE it breaks
       THEN analyze evidence to identify failing component
       THEN investigate that specific component
       ```
    
       **Example (multi-layer system):**
       ```bash
       # Layer 1: Workflow
       echo "=== Secrets available in workflow: ==="
       echo "IDENTITY: $([ -n "${IDENTITY:-}" ] && echo SET || echo UNSET)"
    
       # Layer 2: Build script
       echo "=== Env vars in build script: ==="
       printenv IDENTITY >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "IDENTITY in environment" || echo "IDENTITY not in environment"
    
       # Layer 3: Signing script
       echo "=== Keychain state: ==="
       security list-keychains
       security find-identity -v
    
       # Layer 4: Actual signing
       codesign --sign "$IDENTITY" --verbose=4 "$APP"
       ```
    
       **This reveals:** Which layer fails (secrets → workflow ✓, workflow → build ✗)
    
    5. **Trace Data Flow**
    
       **WHEN error is deep in call stack:**
    
       See `root-cause-tracing.md` in this directory for the complete backward tracing technique.
    
       **Quick version:**
       - Where does bad value originate?
       - What called this with bad value?
       - Keep tracing up until you find the source
       - Fix at source, not at symptom
    
    ### Phase 2: Pattern Analysis
    
    **Find the pattern before fixing:**
    
    1. **Find Working Examples**
       - Locate similar working code in same codebase
       - What works that's similar to what's broken?
    
    2. **Compare Against References**
       - If implementing pattern, read reference implementation COMPLETELY
       - Don't skim - read every line
       - Understand the pattern fully before applying
    
    3. **Identify Differences**
       - What's different between working and broken?
       - List every difference, however small
       - Don't assume "that can't matter"
    
    4. **Understand Dependencies**
       - What other components does this need?
       - What settings, config, environment?
       - What assumptions does it make?
    
    ### Phase 3: Hypothesis and Testing
    
    **Scientific method:**
    
    1. **Form Single Hypothesis**
       - State clearly: "I think X is the root cause because Y"
       - Write it down
       - Be specific, not vague
    
    2. **Test Minimally**
       - Make the SMALLEST possible change to test hypothesis
       - One variable at a time
       - Don't fix multiple things at once
    
    3. **Verify Before Continuing**
       - Did it work? Yes → Phase 4
       - Didn't work? Form NEW hypothesis
       - DON'T add more fixes on top
    
    4. **When You Don't Know**
       - Say "I don't understand X"
       - Don't pretend to know
       - Ask for help
       - Research more
    
    ### Phase 4: Implementation
    
    **Fix the root cause, not the symptom:**
    
    1. **Create Failing Test Case**
       - Simplest possible reproduction
       - Automated test if possible
       - One-off test script if no framework
       - MUST have before fixing
       - Use the `superpowers:test-driven-development` skill for writing proper failing tests
    
    2. **Implement Single Fix**
       - Address the root cause identified
       - ONE change at a time
       - No "while I'm here" improvements
       - No bundled refactoring
    
    3. **Verify Fix**
       - Test passes now?
       - No other tests broken?
       - Issue actually resolved?
       - Use the `superpowers:verification-before-completion` skill before claiming success
    
    4. **If Fix Doesn't Work**
       - STOP
       - Count: How many fixes have you tried?
       - If < 3: Return to Phase 1, re-analyze with new information
       - **If ≥ 3: STOP and question the architecture (step 5 below)**
       - DON'T attempt Fix #4 without architectural discussion
    
    5. **If 3+ Fixes Failed: Question Architecture**
    
       **Pattern indicating architectural problem:**
       - Each fix reveals new shared state/coupling/problem in different place
       - Fixes require "massive refactoring" to implement
       - Each fix creates new symptoms elsewhere
    
       **STOP and question fundamentals:**
       - Is this pattern fundamentally sound?
       - Are we "sticking with it through sheer inertia"?
       - Should we refactor architecture vs. continue fixing symptoms?
    
       **Discuss with your human partner before attempting more fixes**
    
       This is NOT a failed hypothesis - this is a wrong architecture.

    type Reply = Schema<"LookupReply">

    const labels: Record<string, string> = { municipalityCode: "Código IBGE", postalCode: "CEP", state: "UF", city: "Cidade", street: "Rua", district: "Bairro", legalName: "Razão social", tradeName: "Nome fantasia", number: "Número", complement: "Complemento", cnae: "CNAE", activityDescription: "Atividade", stateRegistration: "Inscrição estadual", companySize: "Porte", taxRegime: "Regime informado pela fonte", email: "E-mail", phone: "Telefone" }
    const normalized = (value: string) => value.trim().replace(/[.\s/-]/g, "").toUpperCase()
    const date = (value: string) => Number.isNaN(Date.parse(value)) ? "Data não informada" : new Date(value).toLocaleString("pt-BR")
    
    export function RegistryLookup({ kind, context, tenantId, readValue, readState, onApply, disabled = false, automaticValue, documentField }: {

      onApply: (fields: Record<string, string>) => number; disabled?: boolean; automaticValue?: string; documentField?: ReactNode;

      const active = useRef<AbortController | null>(null)
      const lookupAction = useRef<(automatic: boolean) => Promise<void>>(async () => {})
      const current = useRef({ readValue, readState, onApply, disabled, tenantId })
      useEffect(() => { current.current = { readValue, readState, onApply, disabled, tenantId } })
      useEffect(() => () => active.current?.abort(), [])
      const label = kind === "cep" ? "CEP" : kind === "ie" ? "IE" : "CNPJ"
      const automaticDocument = automaticValue === undefined ? null : normalized(automaticValue)
      useEffect(() => { lookupAction.current = lookup })
      useEffect(() => {
        if (automaticDocument === null || disabled || kind !== "cnpj") return
        const valid = validCnpj(automaticDocument)
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          setResult(null); setMessage(""); setError("")
          if (valid) void lookupAction.current(true)
        }, valid ? 600 : 0)
        return () => { clearTimeout(timer); active.current?.abort() }
      }, [automaticDocument, disabled, kind, context, tenantId])
    
      function key() {

      }
    
      async function lookup(automatic = false) {
        if (current.current.disabled || active.current) return
        const value = current.current.readValue()
        if (!value.trim()) { setError(`Informe ${label === "IE" ? "o CNPJ e a UF" : `o ${label}`} antes de consultar`); return }
        const captured = key()
        const controller = new AbortController()
        active.current = controller
        setPending(true); setResult(null); setMessage(""); setError("")
        try {
          const response = await erpFetch("/api/erp/registry-lookups", {
            method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Tenant-Id": current.current.tenantId },
            body: JSON.stringify({ kind, context, value, ...(kind === "ie" ? { state: current.current.readState?.() } : {}) }),
            signal: controller.signal,

          const reply = await response.json()
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(reply.title || "Consulta indisponível. Continue manualmente")
          if (captured !== key() || reply.tenantId !== current.current.tenantId || normalized(reply.value || "") !== normalized(value) || reply.kind !== kind) {
            setMessage("O documento, CEP ou empresa mudou. Consulte novamente; os campos foram preservados"); return
          }
          if (reply.status !== "found" || !reply.data) {
            setMessage(reply.warnings?.join(" ") || "Sem resultado disponível. Continue manualmente"); return
          }
          if (!reply.source || !reply.expiresAt || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(reply.expiresAt))) throw new Error("Prévia sem origem ou validade. Continue manualmente")
          const preview = { reply, key: captured }
          if (automatic) await applyPreview(reply.data.fields, preview, controller)
          else setResult(preview)

        try { await applyPreview(fields, result, controller) }

        finally { if (active.current === controller) { active.current = null; setPending(false) } }
      }
    
      async function applyPreview(fields: Record<string, string>, preview: { reply: Reply; key: string }, controller: AbortController) {
        function validPreview() {
          if (controller.signal.aborted || current.current.disabled) return false
          if (key() !== preview.key || preview.reply.tenantId !== current.current.tenantId) {

          }
          if (!preview.reply.expiresAt || Date.parse(preview.reply.expiresAt) <= Date.now()) {
            setResult(null); setMessage("A prévia venceu. Consulte novamente; os campos foram preservados"); return false
          }
          return true
        }
        if (!validPreview()) return
        // Another tab can replace the shared session cookie without changing this form's props.
        const response = await erpFetch("/api/erp/me", { signal: AbortSignal.any([controller.signal, AbortSignal.timeout(10_000)]) })
        const session: Schema<"CurrentAccessResponse"> = await response.json()
        if (!response.ok || session?.tenant?.id !== preview.reply.tenantId) {
          setResult(null); setMessage("A empresa da sessão mudou ou o acesso expirou. Recarregue antes de preencher; seus campos foram preservados"); return
        }
        if (current.current.disabled || !validPreview()) return
        const count = current.current.onApply(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(fields).filter(([field, value]) => labels[field] && typeof value === "string" && value.trim())))
        const origin = automaticDocument === null ? "" : ` Fonte: ${preview.reply.source}. Atualização: ${preview.reply.sourceUpdatedAt ? date(preview.reply.sourceUpdatedAt) : "não informada"}. ${preview.reply.warnings.join(" ")}`
        setResult(null); setMessage((count ? "Campos vazios preenchidos. Dados já informados foram preservados; revise antes de salvar" : "Nenhum campo vazio para preencher. Seus dados foram preservados") + origin)
      }
    
      return <div className={documentField ? "min-w-0 space-y-2" : "col-span-full min-w-0 space-y-3 rounded-lg border border-border p-3"}>
        {documentField ? <div className="flex items-end gap-2"><div className="min-w-0 flex-1">{documentField}</div><Button type="button" variant="outline" className="size-9 shrink-0 p-0" aria-label={`Consultar ${label}`} title={`Consultar ${label}`} disabled={disabled || pending} onClick={() => lookup(automaticDocument !== null)}>{pending ? <LoaderCircle aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <Search aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />}</Button></div> : <>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={disabled || pending} onClick={() => lookup(automaticDocument !== null)}>{pending ? `Consultando ${label}…` : `Consultar ${label}`}</Button>
          <p className="min-w-0 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{automaticDocument !== null ? "O CNPJ válido preenche automaticamente dados disponíveis em campos vazios." : kind === "ie" ? "Consulta cadastral não determina a condição de contribuinte." : "Confira a prévia para preencher somente campos vazios."} Você pode preencher manualmente.</p>
        </div>
        </>}
        {pending && <p role="status">Conferindo os dados da consulta de {label}…</p>}
        {error && <p role="alert" className="break-words text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
        {message && <p role="status" className="break-words text-sm">{message}</p>}
        {result && <section aria-label={`Prévia da consulta de ${label}`} className="min-w-0 space-y-3">
          <p role="status" className="break-words text-sm">Fonte: {result.reply.source} · Consultado em {date(result.reply.fetchedAt)}{result.reply.cached ? " · Cache" : ""}{result.reply.expiresAt ? ` · Cache até ${date(result.reply.expiresAt)}` : ""}</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Atualização na fonte: {result.reply.sourceUpdatedAt ? date(result.reply.sourceUpdatedAt) : "não informada"}.</p>
          {result.reply.warnings.map((warning, index) => <p className="break-words text-sm" key={index}>{warning}</p>)}
          <dl className="grid min-w-0 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">{Object.entries(result.reply.data!.fields).filter(([field]) => labels[field]).map(([field, value]) => <div className="min-w-0" key={field}><dt className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{labels[field]}</dt><dd className="break-words">{value}</dd></div>)}</dl>
          {Object.keys(result.reply.data!.fields).length > 0 && <Button type="button" disabled={disabled || pending} onClick={() => apply(result.reply.data!.fields)}>Preencher campos vazios</Button>}
          {result.reply.data!.stateRegistrations.map((registration, index) => <div className="min-w-0 space-y-2" key={index}>
            <p className="break-words text-sm">{registration.state}: {registration.number} · {registration.active === true ? "Ativa na base consultada" : registration.active === false ? "Inativa na base consultada" : "Situação não informada"}</p>
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={disabled || pending} onClick={() => apply({ stateRegistration: registration.number })}>Usar inscrição {registration.state} {registration.number}</Button>
          </div>)}
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" disabled={pending} onClick={() => setResult(null)}>Dispensar prévia</Button>
        </section>}
      </div>
    }

    import { endPartyDraftSession } from "../party-draft-session"
    
    export function erpFetch(resource: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
      if (!resource.startsWith("/api/erp/") || resource.includes("\\") || resource.includes("#")) {
        return Promise.reject(new Error("Recurso do ERP inválido"))
      }
      return fetch(resource, { cache: "no-store", ...init, credentials: "same-origin" }).then(response => {
        if (response.status === 401 && typeof window !== "undefined") endPartyDraftSession()
        return response
      })
    }
    
    export async function readApi<Path extends ApiPath>(
      path: Path, signal?: AbortSignal,
    ): Promise<{ data: JsonReply<Path, "get" & keyof import("./generated").paths[Path]>; etag: string }> {
      const response = await erpFetch(path.replace("/api/v1/", "/api/erp/"), { signal })
      const data = await response.json()
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.title || "Consulta indisponível")
      return { data, etag: response.headers.get("etag") || "" }
    }

    enum Scope {

    }
    type CacheKey = (Scope, LookupKind, String, Option<String>);

        reply: LookupReply,
    }
    #[derive(Default)]
    struct Memory {
        cache: HashMap<CacheKey, CacheEntry>,
        budgets: HashMap<&'static str, VecDeque<Instant>>,
        tenants: HashMap<Scope, VecDeque<Instant>>,
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct RegistryClient {
        http: reqwest::Client,
        memory: Arc<Mutex<Memory>>,
        in_flight: Arc<Semaphore>,
        endpoints: [String; 4],
        cnpj_ws_enabled: bool,
        positive_ttl: [Duration; 2],
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
    enum Provider {
        ViaCep = 0,
        BrasilCep = 1,
        BrasilCnpj = 2,
        CnpjWs = 3,
    }
    impl Provider {
        fn source(self) -> &'static str {
            match self {
                Self::ViaCep => "ViaCEP",
                Self::BrasilCep | Self::BrasilCnpj => "BrasilAPI",
                Self::CnpjWs => "CNPJ.ws",
            }
        }
    }
    
    fn now_string(time: OffsetDateTime) -> String {
        time.format(&Rfc3339).expect("RFC3339 timestamp")
    }
    
    fn reserve(queue: &mut VecDeque<Instant>, maximum: usize, now: Instant) -> bool {
        while queue
            .front()
            .is_some_and(|old| now.duration_since(*old) >= Duration::from_secs(60))
        {
            queue.pop_front();
        }
        if queue.len() >= maximum {
            return false;
        }
        queue.push_back(now);
        true
    }
    
    impl RegistryClient {
        pub fn new(cnpj_ws_enabled: bool) -> anyhow::Result<Self> {
            Ok(Self {
                http: reqwest::Client::builder()
                    .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
                    .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(1))
                    .timeout(PROVIDER_TIMEOUT)
                    .build()?,
                memory: Arc::new(Mutex::new(Memory::default())),
                in_flight: Arc::new(Semaphore::new(8)),
                endpoints: [
                    "https://viacep.com.br/ws".into(),
                    "https://brasilapi.com.br/api/cep/v2".into(),
                    "https://brasilapi.com.br/api/cnpj/v1".into(),
                    "https://publica.cnpj.ws/cnpj".into(),
                ],
                cnpj_ws_enabled,
                positive_ttl: [Duration::from_secs(86_400), Duration::from_secs(21_600)],
            })
        }

        }

    use utoipa::ToSchema;
    use uuid::Uuid;
    
    use crate::{domains::DomainError, platform::valid_document};
    
    pub const STATES: &[&str] = &[
        "AC", "AL", "AP", "AM", "BA", "CE", "DF", "ES", "GO", "MA", "MT", "MS", "MG", "PA", "PB", "PR",
        "PE", "PI", "RJ", "RN", "RS", "RO", "RR", "SC", "SP", "SE", "TO",
    ];
    pub const IE_STATES: &[&str] = &["BA", "GO", "MG", "PB", "PR", "PE", "RS", "SC", "SP", "SE"];
    
    #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Deserialize, Serialize, ToSchema, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
    pub enum LookupKind {
        Cep,
        Cnpj,
        Ie,
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone, Copy, Deserialize, Serialize, ToSchema)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
    pub enum LookupContext {
        Company,
        Party,
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone, Deserialize, Serialize, ToSchema)]
    #[serde(deny_unknown_fields, rename_all = "camelCase")]
    pub struct LookupInput {
        pub kind: LookupKind,
        pub context: LookupContext,
        pub value: String,
        pub state: Option<String>,
    }
    
    impl LookupInput {
        pub fn normalize(&mut self) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
            let raw = self.value.trim();
            if raw.len() > 32 || raw.is_empty() {
                return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Informe o documento ou CEP"));
            }
            self.value = match self.kind {
                LookupKind::Cep => {
                    let plain = raw.replace('-', "");
                    if !plain.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit())
                        || plain.len() != 8
                        || !(raw.len() == 8 || (raw.len() == 9 && raw.as_bytes()[5] == b'-'))
                    {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid("Informe um CEP com oito dígitos"));
                    }
                    plain
                }
                _ => {
                    if !raw
                        .chars()
                        .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || "./- ".contains(c))
                    {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid("CNPJ contém caracteres inválidos"));
                    }
                    let plain: String = raw
                        .chars()
                        .filter(char::is_ascii_alphanumeric)
                        .map(|c| c.to_ascii_uppercase())
                        .collect();
                    if !valid_document(&plain, "juridica") {
                        return Err(DomainError::Invalid(
                            "Informe CNPJ com dígitos verificadores válidos. CPF não possui consulta neste serviço",
                        ));
                    }
                    plain
                }
            };
            self.state = self.state.as_ref().map(|s| s.trim().to_ascii_uppercase());
            if self
                .state
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|s| !STATES.contains(&s.as_str()))

    # Consulta cadastral no cadastro de cliente do pedido
    
    O usuário recebeu `Unexpected end of JSON input` ao consultar um CNPJ em Novo pedido. A consulta autenticada na API de produção encontrou o mesmo CNPJ com BrasilAPI e HTTP200. Isso comprova disponibilidade na leitura realizada, sem reproduzir o defeito transitório do navegador.
    
    ## Causa e limites da evidência
    
    RegistryLookup chama response.json diretamente no POST de consulta e no GET de conferência da sessão. A ausência de corpo em qualquer etapa gera o erro nativo mostrado, interrompendo o preenchimento. O BFF também encaminha corpos vazios ou não JSON da consulta, embora o contrato prometa JSON. O navegador Brave aberto não oferece porta CDP; a origem de um eventual corpo vazio no transporte em produção ainda não foi observada.
    
    ## Implementação
    
    1. Reproduzir a falha com respostas vazias e truncadas no navegador e nos testes do protocolo; incluir leitura de sessão, autorização negada, cancelamento e preservação dos campos.
    2. Normalizar respostas inválidas no BFF somente para as consultas cadastrais. Criar leitura tipada e recuperação limitada a uma repetição dessas operações de consulta; não repetir gravações comerciais.
    3. Manter empresa, documento, origem da prévia, validade e confirmação da sessão antes de aplicar dados; erros devem orientar em português sem expor exceções de JSON.
    4. Verificar modelos, navegador responsivo, tipos, lint e build. Uma revisão final independente; corrigir achados importantes.
    5. Publicar a revisão testada e conferir a consulta real por leitura, sem criar cliente, pedido ou emissão. Preservar as alterações do usuário e o pacote separado de acabamentos.
    
    Não há mudança no banco, inferência de inscrição estadual ou de tributação, nem preenchimento de um documento diferente do consultado. A organização documental por tela já foi concluída no PR194.
