    # Pedidos de venda
    
    [Todas as telas](../../../README.md) · [Vendas](../README.md)
    
    Registrar a venda, conferir as condições e acompanhar a confirmação e a conclusão do pedido.
    
    **Onde acessar:** `/vendas/pedidos`.
    
    ## O que aparece na tela
    
    - Cliente, produtos e quantidades
    - Acabamentos e tipo de anilheiro
    - Vencimento
    - Condições comerciais e aprovação, quando exigida
    - Situação do pedido e documentos vinculados
    
    ## O que você pode fazer
    
    - Buscar, criar, consultar e editar os pedidos permitidos
    - Conferir e confirmar o pedido
    - Concluir a operação conforme as regras e o estoque
    - Consultar contratos, preparar NF-e e acompanhar o recebível
    - Enviar o documento do pedido por e-mail quando houver configuração e permissão
    
    ## Regras e limites
    
    Salvar o pedido mantém uma etapa de rascunho antes da confirmação. Confirmar verifica regras e estoque; concluir registra a saída e gera o título a receber. Receber o pagamento é uma ação própria no Financeiro.
    
    O envio de e-mail permite conferir destinatário, assunto e mensagem e anexa um documento HTML com os dados registrados do pedido. Não pode enviar um pedido cancelado. Se o resultado ficar sem confirmação, não faça um novo envio: consulte o histórico e o resultado da mesma solicitação e confira a situação com o provedor de e-mail. Um envio pendente bloqueia novas mensagens para evitar duplicação.
    
    ## O que ainda precisa de atenção
    
    Manter a escolha Standard, Olímpico ou Não se aplica no fechamento, sem cor de anilheiro. A paridade das paletas com os catálogos ainda precisa ser concluída.
    
    ## Referências para manutenção
    
    Guia conferido no código de 12/11/2026. As ações dependem das permissões e da configuração da empresa. Relatos técnicos antigos descrevem a etapa em que foram escritos.
    
    - [PEDIDOS-FINANCEIRO](referencias/PEDIDOS-FINANCEIRO.md)
    - [sales-order-numbers](referencias/sales-order-numbers.md)
    - [orders](../../../../apps/web/src/features/sales/orders.tsx)
    # Clientes e fornecedores
    
    [Todas as telas](../../../README.md) · [Cadastros](../README.md)
    
    Usar um único cadastro para uma pessoa que pode ser cliente, fornecedor ou ambos.
    
    **Onde acessar:** `/cadastros/clientes-fornecedores`.
    
    ## O que aparece na tela
    
    - CPF ou CNPJ e tipo de pessoa
    - Nome ou razão social e nome fantasia
    - E-mail e telefone
    - Relacionamento comercial e situação
    - Endereços e contatos adicionais
    - Indicador de ICMS e inscrição estadual
    
    ## O que você pode fazer
    
    - Buscar por nome ou documento, filtrar e paginar
    - Criar, consultar ou editar uma pessoa
    - Consultar CNPJ e CEP e conferir os dados antes de aplicar
    - Definir endereço e contato principal
    - Arquivar ou reativar sem apagar o histórico
    
    ## Regras e limites
    
    Selecione pelo menos um relacionamento. Documento duplicado na mesma empresa é recusado, inclusive quando o cadastro está arquivado. Inscrição estadual e indicador de ICMS são dados declarados; salvá-los não comprova regularidade fiscal.
    
    O formulário recupera o rascunho na mesma sessão e avisa sobre alterações pendentes antes da saída. A emissão ainda depende dos campos e das validações da própria nota.
    
    ## Referências para manutenção
    
    Guia conferido no código de 12/11/2026. As ações dependem das permissões e da configuração da empresa. Relatos técnicos antigos descrevem a etapa em que foram escritos.
    
    - [PESSOAS-PERSISTENTES](referencias/PESSOAS-PERSISTENTES.md)
    - [ENDERECOS-CONTATOS-PESSOAS](referencias/ENDERECOS-CONTATOS-PESSOAS.md)
    - [CONSULTAS-CADASTRAIS-AVL-113-114](referencias/CONSULTAS-CADASTRAIS-AVL-113-114.md)

    - [party-workspace](../../../../apps/web/src/features/parties/party-workspace.tsx)
    - [party-draft](../../../../apps/web/src/features/parties/party-draft.ts)
    - [Dados fiscais e recuperação de rascunho](../../../superpowers/specs/2026-11-12-party-fiscal-drafts.md).

    import "server-only"
    
    import { currentSession, erpConfiguration } from "@/server/auth/erp-session"
    
    const uuid = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i
    const allowedQuery = new Set(["q", "status", "limit", "offset"])
    
    export async function forwardPosting(request: Request, resource = "/logistics/postings") {
      const session = await currentSession()
      if (!session) return Response.json({ title: "Entre para acessar os dados da empresa" }, { status: 401, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } })
      const config = erpConfiguration()
      if (request.method !== "GET" && request.headers.get("origin") !== config.origin) return Response.json({ title: "Origem não autorizada" }, { status: 403 })
      if (request.method !== "GET" && request.headers.get("x-tenant-id") !== session.tenantId) return Response.json({ title: "A empresa da sessão mudou. Sua edição foi preservada" }, { status: 409 })
      const url = new URL(request.url)
      const upstream = new URL(`${config.api}/api/v1${resource}`)
      for (const [key, value] of url.searchParams) {
        if (!allowedQuery.has(key) || url.searchParams.getAll(key).length !== 1) return Response.json({ title: "Filtro inválido" }, { status: 400 })
        upstream.searchParams.set(key, value)
      }
      const headers = new Headers({ Authorization: `Bearer ${session.accessToken}`, Accept: "application/json" })
      if (session.tenantId) headers.set("X-Tenant-Id", session.tenantId)
      for (const name of ["content-type", "idempotency-key", "if-match"]) {
        const value = request.headers.get(name)
        if (value) headers.set(name, value)
      }
      let body: string | undefined
      if (request.method === "POST") {
        if (!request.headers.get("content-type")?.startsWith("application/json")) return Response.json({ title: "Envie JSON" }, { status: 415 })
        body = await request.text()
        if (body.length > 65_536) return Response.json({ title: "Cadastro muito grande" }, { status: 413 })
      }
      try {
        const response = await fetch(upstream, { method: request.method, headers, body, cache: "no-store", redirect: "error", signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15_000) })
        const output = new Headers({ "Cache-Control": "no-store, no-transform", "Content-Type": response.headers.get("content-type") || "application/json" })
        for (const name of ["etag", "x-request-id", "idempotency-replayed"]) {
          const value = response.headers.get(name)
          if (value) output.set(name, value)
        }
        return new Response(response.status === 204 ? null : await response.text(), { status: response.status, headers: output })
      } catch {
        return Response.json({ title: "Serviço do ERP indisponível. Sua edição foi preservada" }, { status: 503, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } })
      }
    }
    
    export const GET = (request: Request) => forwardPosting(request)
    export const POST = (request: Request) => forwardPosting(request)
    
    export function validPostingId(id: string) {
      return uuid.test(id)
    }

    export function routeSurface(paths) {
      const routes = paths.filter(name => name.startsWith(`${web}app/`) && /\/(page\.tsx|route\.ts|layout\.tsx)$/.test(name)).sort();
      return { count: routes.length, sha256: createHash("sha256").update(`${routes.join("\n")}\n`).digest("hex") };
    }
    
    function inspect(name, content) {
      const source = ts.createSourceFile(name, content, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true);
      const imports = [];
      let client = false;
      for (const statement of source.statements) {
        if (ts.isExpressionStatement(statement) && ts.isStringLiteral(statement.expression) && statement.expression.text === "use client") client = true;
      }
      const visit = node => {
        if ((ts.isImportDeclaration(node) || ts.isExportDeclaration(node)) && node.moduleSpecifier && ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier)) {
          const clause = node.importClause;
          const bindings = clause?.namedBindings;
          const allTypes = bindings && ts.isNamedImports(bindings) && !clause.name && bindings.elements.length > 0 && bindings.elements.every(item => item.isTypeOnly);
          if (!node.isTypeOnly && !clause?.isTypeOnly && !allTypes) imports.push(node.moduleSpecifier.text);
        }
        if (ts.isCallExpression(node) && node.arguments.length === 1 && ts.isStringLiteral(node.arguments[0]) && (node.expression.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ImportKeyword || (ts.isIdentifier(node.expression) && node.expression.text === "require"))) imports.push(node.arguments[0].text);
        ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
      };
      visit(source);
      return { imports, client };
    }

    import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
    import { readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
    import { validateStructure, routeSurface } from "../scripts/architecture/check.mjs";
    import { validateTypography } from "../scripts/architecture/typography-policy.mjs";
    const git = (...args) => execFileSync("git", args, { encoding: "utf8" }).split("\n").filter(Boolean);
    const tracked = git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "HEAD");
    const current = git("ls-files", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard");
    const changed = new Set(git("diff", "--name-only", "HEAD"));
    const relevant = name => name.startsWith("apps/web/src/") || name.endsWith(".rs");
    const content = name => /\.(ts|tsx|rs|mdx|css)$/.test(name) ? readFile(name, "utf8") : "";
    const candidate = new Map(await Promise.all(current.filter(relevant).map(async name => [name, await content(name)])));
    const baseline = new Map(await Promise.all(tracked.filter(relevant).map(async name => [name, changed.has(name) ? execFileSync("git", ["show", `HEAD:${name}`], { encoding: "utf8" }) : await content(name)])));
    const policy = JSON.parse(await readFile("architecture/structure.json", "utf8"));
    const errors = files => [...validateStructure(files, policy), ...validateTypography(files)].sort();
    const before = errors(baseline), after = errors(candidate);
    const report = { baselineErrors: before.length, candidateErrors: after.length, newErrors: after.filter(error => !before.includes(error)), unchangedRoutes: JSON.stringify(routeSurface(tracked)) === JSON.stringify(routeSurface(current)) };
    await writeFile("artifacts/cnpj-architecture-baseline.json", JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
    console.log(JSON.stringify(report));
    if (report.newErrors.length || !report.unchangedRoutes) process.exitCode = 1;

    Quando a consulta cadastral ou a conferência da sessão devolve um corpo vazio, o cadastro do cliente no pedido exibia uma exceção de JSON e interrompia o preenchimento. A leitura agora valida a resposta e admite uma repetição limitada das consultas; respostas inválidas do serviço cadastral recebem um erro JSON no BFF. Falhas persistentes mantêm a digitação e permitem consultar novamente ou seguir manualmente.
    
    As verificações de empresa, documento, origem, validade e sessão continuam obrigatórias antes de aplicar campos vazios. A recuperação fica restrita às leituras cadastrais e da sessão. Não há alteração de banco nem repetição de comandos comerciais.
    
    Validação: 152 testes de modelo/protocolo e 33 testes de navegador no build de produção, incluindo pedido em 393/1280px e cadastros em 320 a 1920px; build padrão e tipos aprovados; lint sem erros. Revisão independente concluída e achado de resposta parcialmente válida corrigido com regressão RED/GREEN. Checker documental sem erro novo. Auditoria de arquitetura conserva os mesmos 20 achados da base, sem achados novos.
    
    A API de produção encontrou o CNPJ informado pelo usuário; a origem do corpo vazio no transporte real não foi capturada. As regressões reproduzem e corrigem a falha de contrato do formulário e do BFF.

    #[utoipa::path(get,path="/api/v1/sales-simulator/{line}",operation_id="get_sales_simulator",tag="Sales",security(("bearerAuth"=[])),params(OptionsQuery,("line"=String,Path),("X-Tenant-Id"=Uuid,Header)),responses((status=200,body=Value),(status=403,description="Sem acesso a vendas")))]
    pub async fn options(
        State(state): State<AppState>,
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        Path(code): Path<String>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
        query: Result<Query<OptionsQuery>, QueryRejection>,
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        line(&code)?;
        let Query(query) = query.map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("Versão inválida"))?;
        let (tenant, mut tx, can_create) =
            authorized(&state, &headers, &identity, READ, MANAGE, false).await?;
        let versions: Vec<Value> = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'version',version,'publishedAt',published_at) FROM price_table_versions WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND product_line=$2 ORDER BY version DESC")
            .bind(tenant).bind(&code).fetch_all(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        let version: Option<Uuid> = match query.version_id {
            Some(id) => Some(id),
            None => sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT active_price_version_id FROM commercial_settings WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND product_line=$2")
                .bind(tenant).bind(&code).fetch_optional(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?.flatten(),
        };
        let data = if let Some(version) = version {
            let meta: Option<Value> = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'version',version,'publishedAt',published_at,'originState',policy_snapshot->>'originState','freeDiscountBps',policy_snapshot->'freeDiscountBps','minimumDownPaymentBps',policy_snapshot->'minimumDownPaymentBps','ipiBps',policy_snapshot->'ipiBps') FROM price_table_versions WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND product_line=$3")
                .bind(tenant).bind(version).bind(&code).fetch_optional(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
            let mut meta = meta.ok_or(DomainError::NotFound)?;
            let items: Vec<Value> = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT jsonb_build_object('productId',i.product_id,'sku',i.product_snapshot->>'sku','name',i.product_snapshot->>'name','unit',i.product_snapshot->>'unit','priceWithoutIpiCents',i.price_without_ipi_cents,'priceWithIpiCents',i.price_with_ipi_cents,'structureColors',COALESCE(p.structure_colors,'{}'::text[]),'swingArmColors',COALESCE(p.swing_arm_colors,'{}'::text[]),'finishingPalette',p.finishing_palette,'upholsteryColors',COALESCE(p.upholstery_colors,'{}'::text[])) FROM price_table_items i JOIN products p ON p.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND p.id=i.product_id WHERE i.tenant_id=$1 AND i.version_id=$2 AND p.status='active' AND p.unit=i.product_snapshot->>'unit' ORDER BY i.product_snapshot->>'sku',i.product_id")
                .bind(tenant).bind(version).fetch_all(&mut *tx).await.map_err(db)?;
            meta["items"] = json!(items);
            Some(meta)
        } else {
            None
        };
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(
            StatusCode::OK,
            None,
            json!({"tenantId":tenant,"line":code,"canCreate":can_create,"versions":versions,"data":data}),
        ))
    }
    
    pub(super) struct PreparedQuote {
        pub line: String,
        pub quote: Quote,
        pub digest: String,
        pub product: Value,
        pub version: i64,
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn prepare(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        code: &str,
        input: &QuoteInput,
    ) -> Result<PreparedQuote, DomainError> {
        line(code)?;
        let row: Option<(i64, Value, Value, Value, i64)> = sqlx::query_as("SELECT v.version,v.policy_snapshot,i.product_snapshot,i.cost_snapshot,i.price_without_ipi_cents FROM price_table_versions v JOIN price_table_items i ON i.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND i.version_id=v.id JOIN products p ON p.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND p.id=i.product_id WHERE v.tenant_id=$1 AND v.id=$2 AND v.product_line=$3 AND i.product_id=$4 AND p.status='active' AND p.unit=i.product_snapshot->>'unit'")
            .bind(tenant).bind(input.version_id).bind(code).bind(input.product_id).fetch_optional(&mut **tx).await.map_err(db)?;
        let (version, policy, product, cost, price) = row.ok_or(DomainError::NotFound)?;
        let params: CommercialParameters = serde_json::from_value(policy)
            .map_err(|_| DomainError::Conflict("Política publicada incompatível"))?;
        let cost: PublishedCost = serde_json::from_value(cost)
            .map_err(|_| DomainError::Conflict("Custo publicado incompatível"))?;
        let quote = super::pricing_model::quote(input, price, &cost, &params)?;
        let raw = json!({"tenantId":tenant,"line":code,"input":input,"calculator":CALCULATOR,"sale":quote.sale,"director":quote.director});
        let digest = format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(raw.to_string().as_bytes()));
        Ok(PreparedQuote {
            line: code.into(),
            quote,
            digest,
            product,
            version,
        })
    }
    
    pub(super) fn redact(
        prepared: PreparedQuote,
        input: &QuoteInput,
        director: bool,
        tenant: Uuid,
    ) -> Value {
        let mut result = json!({"tenantId":tenant,"line":prepared.line,"versionId":input.version_id,"version":prepared.version,"product":prepared.product,"input":input,"digest":prepared.digest,"sale":prepared.quote.sale});
        if director {
            result["director"] = json!(prepared.quote.director);
        }
        result
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn sees_costs(
        tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
        tenant: Uuid,
        subject: &str,
    ) -> Result<bool, DomainError> {
        let rights = access::load_access(tx, tenant, subject).await?;
        Ok(access::require_permission(&rights, DIRECTOR).is_ok()
            && access::require_permission(&rights, "sales.approvals.director").is_ok())
    }
    
    #[utoipa::path(post,path="/api/v1/sales-simulator/{line}/quote",operation_id="quote_sales_simulator",tag="Sales",security(("bearerAuth"=[])),params(("line"=String,Path),("X-Tenant-Id"=Uuid,Header)),request_body=QuoteInput,responses((status=200,body=Value),(status=404,description="Versão ou equipamento indisponível"),(status=422,description="Condições inválidas")))]
    pub async fn quote(
        State(state): State<AppState>,
        Extension(identity): Extension<AuthenticatedIdentity>,
        Path(code): Path<String>,
        headers: HeaderMap,
        payload: Result<Json<QuoteInput>, JsonRejection>,
    ) -> Result<Response, DomainError> {
        let (tenant, mut tx, _) = authorized(&state, &headers, &identity, READ, MANAGE, false).await?;
        let Json(input) = payload
            .map_err(|_| DomainError::Invalid("Preencha as condições sem campos desconhecidos"))?;
        let prepared = prepare(&mut tx, tenant, &code, &input).await?;
        let director = sees_costs(&mut tx, tenant, &identity.subject).await?;
        let result = redact(prepared, &input, director, tenant);
        tx.commit().await.map_err(db)?;
        Ok(response(StatusCode::OK, None, result))
    }

    # Acabamentos dos catálogos: implementação
    
    > Execução inline por superpowers:executing-plans, com um único revisor final independente. Não delegar implementação.
    
    Goal: separar estrutura, braços e estofado de ponta a ponta e apresentar opções/amostras reais dos catálogos, preservando dados e histórico.
    Architecture: migração aditiva; contrato opcional no produto e itens; componentes existentes de acabamento com paleta explícita e rasters originais. Migração da imagem validada precede ativação da aplicação.
    Tech stack: Rust/SQLx/PostgreSQL, Next16/React19/TypeScript, testes Rust/Node/Playwright e Python para deploy.
    Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-12-catalog-finishes-source-parity.md
    Base: e065b0d5191abd8f176ef4c1310b3e1ffc9c4c3a; branch feat/catalog-finishes-source-parity-20261112; worktree a9e9.
    
    ## Global constraints
    Não preencher nacionais/Core ou inserir dez modelos excluídos. Não sobrescrever fotos, preços, status, impostos, estoque ou histórico. Não reutilizar aliases armColors/armColor. Não gerar aproximações das imagens. Não compilar no servidor nem enviar e-mail/NF-e real nos testes. Publicação e preenchimento Premium já autorizados. Preservar processos e checkout do usuário.

    Interfaces: ProductInput.swing_arm_colors:Option<Vec<String>>,finishing_palette:Option<String>; itens swing_arm_color:Option<String>. upholstery permanece estofado; aliases legados permanecem anilheiro. Novas colunas em products e linhas existentes, sem reescrever dados antigos.

    use super::company_tests::{cleanup, setup};
    use axum::{
        Router,
        body::{Body, to_bytes},
        http::{Request, StatusCode},
    };
    use serde_json::{Value, json};
    use sqlx::PgPool;
    use tower::ServiceExt;
    use uuid::Uuid;
    
    const TENANT: &str = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
    
    async fn call(
        router: &Router,
        method: &str,
        path: &str,
        who: &str,
        etag: Option<&str>,
        key: Option<Uuid>,
        body: Value,
    ) -> (StatusCode, Value) {
        let mut request = Request::builder()
            .method(method)
            .uri(path)
            .header("x-tenant-id", TENANT)
            .header("authorization", format!("Bearer {who}"))
            .header("content-type", "application/json");
        if let Some(etag) = etag {
            request = request.header("if-match", etag);
        }
        if let Some(key) = key {
            request = request.header("idempotency-key", key.to_string());
        }
        let reply = router
            .clone()
            .oneshot(request.body(Body::from(body.to_string())).unwrap())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let status = reply.status();
        let raw = to_bytes(reply.into_body(), 1_000_000).await.unwrap();
        (status, serde_json::from_slice(&raw).unwrap())
    }

    use axum::{
        Router,
        body::{Body, to_bytes},
        http::{Request, StatusCode},
    };
    use serde_json::{Value, json};
    use sqlx::PgPool;
    use tower::ServiceExt;
    use uuid::Uuid;
    
    const TENANT: &str = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
    const PRODUCT: &str = "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555";
    const CUSTOMER: &str = "11111111-2222-4333-8444-666666666666";
    const VERSION: &str = "11111111-2222-4333-8444-777777777777";
    
    async fn call(
        router: &Router,
        method: &str,
        uri: &str,
        actor: (&str, &str),
        revision: Option<&str>,
        key: Option<Uuid>,
        body: Value,
    ) -> (StatusCode, Value) {
        let mut request = Request::builder()
            .method(method)
            .uri(uri)
            .header("x-tenant-id", actor.1)
            .header("content-type", "application/json");
        if !actor.0.is_empty() {
            request = request.header("authorization", format!("Bearer {}", actor.0));
        }
        if let Some(revision) = revision {
            request = request.header("if-match", revision);
        }
        if let Some(key) = key {
            request = request.header("idempotency-key", key.to_string());
        }
        let response = router
            .clone()
            .oneshot(request.body(Body::from(body.to_string())).unwrap())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let status = response.status();
        let bytes = to_bytes(response.into_body(), 1_000_000).await.unwrap();
        (status, serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).unwrap())
    }

    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -Eeuo pipefail
    umask 077
    
    readonly ROOT=/mnt/HC_Volume_106542212/erp-next
    readonly APPLICATION=erp-next
    
    fail() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
    
    [[ $# == 0 ]] || fail 'invalid dispatcher arguments'
    original_command=${SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND:-}
    [[ "$original_command" =~ ^deploy\ erp-next\ ([0-9a-f]{40})$ ]] || fail 'invalid deploy command'
    source_sha=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
    [[ $EUID == 0 ]] || fail 'dispatcher requires root'
    
    exec 9>"$ROOT/.deploy.lock"
    flock -n 9 || fail 'another ERP deployment is running'
    
    previous_release=$(docker inspect --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir" }}' erp-next-web-1)
    [[ "$previous_release" == "$ROOT/releases/"* ]] || fail 'active release is not managed by this dispatcher'
    
    staging=$(mktemp -d "$ROOT/.incoming.XXXXXX")
    release="$ROOT/releases/$source_sha"
    cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$staging"; }
    trap cleanup EXIT
    
    # Extract the complete stream first, then enforce the allow-list below. GNU tar
    # does not reliably match the selected names when the sender emits ./ prefixes.
    tar --extract --gzip --no-same-owner --directory "$staging" --file -
    
    for file in api-image.tar.gz web-image.tar.gz fiscal-image.tar.gz fiscal-mcp-image.tar.gz compose.yaml fiscal-compose.yaml; do
      [[ -s "$staging/$file" ]] || fail "missing artifact: $file"
    done
    [[ ! -e "$release" ]] || fail 'release already exists'
    
    for image in api web fiscal fiscal-mcp; do
      docker load --input "$staging/$image-image.tar.gz" >/dev/null
      docker image inspect "erp-next-$image:sha-$source_sha" >/dev/null || fail "image not loaded: $image"
    done
    
    mkdir -m 700 "$release"
    
    compose_overlay_args=()
    if [[ -f "$previous_release/compose.json" ]]; then
      # Current production still uses a generated, self-contained Compose JSON.
      # Keep its private runtime configuration on the server and replace only the
      # three immutable image references.
      cp -p "$previous_release/compose.json" "$release/compose.json"
      python3 - "$release/compose.json" "$source_sha" <<'PY'
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import sys
    
    target = Path(sys.argv[1])
    config = json.loads(target.read_text())
    config["services"]["fiscal-engine"]["healthcheck"]["test"] = ["CMD", "node", "scripts/healthcheck.mjs"]
    
    def environment(service):
        value = service.get("environment", {})
        if isinstance(value, list):
            value = dict(entry.split("=", 1) for entry in value if "=" in entry)
        service["environment"] = value
        return value
    
    api = environment(config["services"]["api"])
    fiscal = environment(config["services"]["fiscal-engine"])
    token = api.get("ERP_FISCAL_ENGINE_TOKEN") or fiscal.get("ERP_FISCAL_ENGINE_TOKEN")
    if not token or len(token) < 24:
        raise SystemExit("Private fiscal token missing")
    api.update({"ERP_CNPJ_WS_ENABLED": "true", "DANFE_MCP_URL": "http://127.0.0.1:8093/mcp", "DANFE_MCP_TOKEN": token,
                "DANFE_MCP_TOOL_PREFIX": "bare", "DANFE_CA_BUNDLE_FILE": "/etc/ssl/certs/erp-icp-brasil-roots.pem"})
    config["services"]["fiscal-mcp"] = {
        "image": "erp-next-fiscal-mcp:sha-" + sys.argv[2], "restart": "unless-stopped",
        "network_mode": "service:api", "depends_on": {"api": {"condition": "service_healthy"}},
        "read_only": True, "tmpfs": ["/tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m,mode=1777"],
        "environment": {"XDG_CACHE_HOME": "/tmp/cache"},
        "security_opt": ["no-new-privileges:true"], "cap_drop": ["ALL"],
        "mem_limit": "512m", "pids_limit": 128,
    }
    target.write_text(json.dumps(config, indent=2))
    PY
      # The generated JSON carries the public release marker in the web
      # environment; update it together with the immutable image references.
      sed -i "s|\"ERP_RELEASE_SHA\": \"[0-9a-f]*\"|\"ERP_RELEASE_SHA\": \"$source_sha\"|g" "$release/compose.json"
      previous_api=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Config.Image}}' erp-next-api-1)
      previous_web=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Config.Image}}' erp-next-web-1)
      previous_fiscal=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Config.Image}}' erp-next-fiscal-engine-1)
      for pair in \
        "$previous_api|erp-next-api:sha-$source_sha" \
        "$previous_web|erp-next-web:sha-$source_sha" \
        "$previous_fiscal|erp-next-fiscal:sha-$source_sha"; do
        old=${pair%%|*}
        new=${pair#*|}
        escaped_old=$(printf '%s' "$old" | sed 's/[.[\*^$()+?{|\\]/\\&/g')
        sed -i "s|$escaped_old|$new|g" "$release/compose.json"
      done
      grep -q "erp-next-api:sha-$source_sha" "$release/compose.json" || fail 'API image was not pinned'
      grep -q "erp-next-web:sha-$source_sha" "$release/compose.json" || fail 'web image was not pinned'
      grep -q "erp-next-fiscal:sha-$source_sha" "$release/compose.json" || fail 'fiscal image was not pinned'
      grep -q "erp-next-fiscal-mcp:sha-$source_sha" "$release/compose.json" || fail 'MCP image was not pinned'
      grep -q "\\\"ERP_RELEASE_SHA\\\": \\\"$source_sha\\\"" "$release/compose.json" || fail 'release SHA was not pinned'
      compose_file=compose.json
      compose_env_args=()
    else
      [[ -f "$previous_release/compose.yaml" && -f "$previous_release/api.env" && -f "$previous_release/web.env" && -f "$previous_release/.env" ]] || fail 'active release has an unknown layout'
      cp -p "$staging/compose.yaml" "$staging/fiscal-compose.yaml" "$release/"
      cp -p "$previous_release/api.env" "$previous_release/web.env" "$previous_release/.env" "$release/"
      chmod 600 "$release/api.env" "$release/web.env" "$release/.env"
      sed -i \
        -e "s|^ERP_API_IMAGE=.*|ERP_API_IMAGE=erp-next-api:sha-$source_sha|" \
        -e "s|^ERP_WEB_IMAGE=.*|ERP_WEB_IMAGE=erp-next-web:sha-$source_sha|" \
        -e "s|^ERP_FISCAL_ENGINE_IMAGE=.*|ERP_FISCAL_ENGINE_IMAGE=erp-next-fiscal:sha-$source_sha|" \
        -e "s|^ERP_RELEASE_SHA=.*|ERP_RELEASE_SHA=$source_sha|" \
        "$release/.env"
      sed -i '/^ERP_FISCAL_MCP_IMAGE=/d' "$release/.env"
      printf '\nERP_FISCAL_MCP_IMAGE=erp-next-fiscal-mcp:sha-%s\n' "$source_sha" >> "$release/.env"
      grep -q "^ERP_API_IMAGE=erp-next-api:sha-$source_sha$" "$release/.env" || fail 'API image was not pinned'
      grep -q "^ERP_WEB_IMAGE=erp-next-web:sha-$source_sha$" "$release/.env" || fail 'web image was not pinned'
      grep -q "^ERP_RELEASE_SHA=$source_sha$" "$release/.env" || fail 'release SHA was not pinned'
      compose_file=compose.yaml
      compose_overlay_args=(--file "$release/fiscal-compose.yaml")
      compose_env_args=(--env-file "$release/.env")
    fi
    
    compose() {
      docker compose --project-name "$APPLICATION" --project-directory "$1" \
        "${compose_env_args[@]}" --file "$1/$compose_file" "${compose_overlay_args[@]}" "${@:2}"
    }
    
    rollback() {
      local status=$?
      trap - EXIT
      printf '%s\n' 'ERP deploy failed; restoring previous release' >&2
      if [[ -f "$previous_release/compose.json" ]]; then
        docker compose --project-name "$APPLICATION" --project-directory "$previous_release" \
          --file "$previous_release/compose.json" up --detach --no-build --remove-orphans --wait --wait-timeout 120 || true
      else
        docker compose --project-name "$APPLICATION" --project-directory "$previous_release" \
          --env-file "$previous_release/.env" --file "$previous_release/compose.yaml" \
          --file "$previous_release/fiscal-compose.yaml" up --detach --no-build --remove-orphans --wait --wait-timeout 120 || true
      fi
      exit "$status"
    }
    
    trap rollback ERR
    compose "$release" config --quiet
    compose "$release" up --detach --no-build --wait --wait-timeout 120

    for path in ("/entrar", "/erp-preview.webp"):

    import importlib.util
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import subprocess
    import tempfile
    import unittest
    
    MODULE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "deploy" / "migrate-release.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("release_migration", MODULE)
    migration = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(migration)
    SHA = "a" * 40
    
    
    class FakeRuntime:
        def __init__(self, fail=None, database="erp_next"):
            self.calls = []
            self.fail = fail
            self.database = database
    
        def __call__(self, args, **kwargs):
            self.calls.append((args, kwargs))
            if args[:2] == ["docker", "inspect"]:
                output = json.dumps([f"DATABASE_URL=postgresql://runtime:SENSITIVE@host.docker.internal/{self.database}"])
            elif args[:3] == ["docker", "image", "inspect"]:
                output = "sha256:" + "b" * 64
            elif args[:2] == ["id", "-u"]:
                output = "111"
            elif "pg_dump" in args:
                output = "-- Backup\nCREATE TABLE fixture ();\n" if "--schema-only" in args else "INSERT INTO _sqlx_migrations VALUES (1);\n"
            elif "psql" in args:
                output = json.dumps([{"version": 1, "success": True, "checksum": "c" * 96}])
            else:
                output = "migrations applied"
            failed = self.fail == "backup" and "pg_dump" in args or self.fail == "migrate" and args[:2] == ["docker", "run"]
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(args, int(failed), output, "SENSITIVE private diagnostic" if failed else "")
    
    
    class ReleaseMigrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
        def setUp(self):
            self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
            self.addCleanup(self.directory.cleanup)
            self.root = Path(self.directory.name)
            self.release = self.root / "releases" / SHA
            self.release.mkdir(parents=True)
            self.runtime = FakeRuntime()
    
        def migrate(self):
            return migration.migrate_release(SHA, self.release, root=self.root, run=self.runtime)
    
        def test_backup_and_ledger_precede_exact_image_migration_without_building_or_activating_services(self):
            proof = self.migrate()
            commands = [args for args, _ in self.runtime.calls]
            apply_index = next(i for i, args in enumerate(commands) if args[:2] == ["docker", "run"])
            self.assertEqual(sum("pg_dump" in args for args in commands[:apply_index]), 2)
            self.assertIn("erp-next-api:sha-" + SHA, commands[apply_index])
            self.assertEqual(commands[apply_index][-1], "migrate")
            self.assertIn("none", commands[apply_index])
            self.assertIn("--read-only", commands[apply_index])
            self.assertNotIn("SENSITIVE", json.dumps(commands))
            self.assertFalse(any("build" in args or "up" in args for args in commands))
            self.assertTrue(proof["applied"])
            self.assertTrue((self.root / "private" / ("migration-" + SHA) / "verification.json").exists())
    
        def test_backup_failure_stops_before_any_migration(self):
            self.runtime.fail = "backup"
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "backup"):
                self.migrate()
            self.assertFalse(any(args[:2] == ["docker", "run"] for args, _ in self.runtime.calls))
    
        def test_failed_migration_keeps_private_diagnostic_and_never_claims_success(self):
            self.runtime.fail = "migrate"
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "migration") as error:
                self.migrate()
            self.assertNotIn("SENSITIVE", str(error.exception))
            private = self.root / "private" / ("migration-" + SHA)
            self.assertIn("SENSITIVE", (private / "migration.log").read_text())
            self.assertFalse((private / "verification.json").exists())
    
        def test_existing_backup_is_never_overwritten(self):
            self.migrate()
            before = len(self.runtime.calls)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "exists"):
                self.migrate()
            self.assertEqual(len(self.runtime.calls), before)
    
        def test_foreign_database_is_rejected_before_backup_or_apply(self):
            self.runtime.database = "another_product"
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "database"):
                self.migrate()
            self.assertFalse(any("pg_dump" in args or args[:2] == ["docker", "run"] for args, _ in self.runtime.calls))
    
        def test_invalid_sha_and_paths_are_rejected_before_running_commands(self):
            for sha, release in [("../bad", self.release), (SHA, self.root / "elsewhere")]:
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    migration.migrate_release(sha, release, root=self.root, run=self.runtime)
            self.assertEqual(self.runtime.calls, [])
    
        def test_dispatcher_migrates_before_installing_activation_rollback_or_starting_services(self):
            source = (MODULE.parent / "production-deploy.sh").read_text()
            migration_index = source.index('python3 "$release/migrate-release.py"')
            self.assertLess(migration_index, source.index("trap rollback ERR"))
            self.assertLess(migration_index, source.index('compose "$release" up'))
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        unittest.main()

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """Apply the candidate image's SQLx migrations before replacing running services."""
    import hashlib
    import json
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    import re
    import subprocess
    import sys
    from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
    
    ROOT = Path("/mnt/HC_Volume_106542212/erp-next")
    STATE_SQL = "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('version',version,'success',success,'checksum',encode(checksum,'hex')) ORDER BY version),'[]'::json) FROM _sqlx_migrations;"
    
    
    def private_file(path, content):
        with os.fdopen(os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600), "w") as output:
            output.write(content)
    
    
    def migrate_release(sha, release, *, root=ROOT, run=subprocess.run):
        root = Path(root).resolve()
        release = Path(release)
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", sha) or release.resolve() != root / "releases" / sha or not release.is_dir():
            raise ValueError("Invalid release revision or directory")
        private_root = root / "private"
        if private_root.resolve() != private_root:
            raise ValueError("Invalid private backup directory")
        private_root.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
        private = private_root / ("migration-" + sha)
        if private.exists():
            raise RuntimeError("Migration backup already exists; inspect the previous attempt before retrying")
        private.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    
        def execute(args, stage, **kwargs):
            result = run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False, **kwargs)
            if result.returncode:
                private_file(private / (stage + ".log"), result.stdout + "\n" + result.stderr)
                raise RuntimeError(f"Release {stage} failed; private diagnostic saved")
            return result.stdout.strip()
    
        image = "erp-next-api:sha-" + sha
        image_id = execute(["docker", "image", "inspect", "--format", "{{.Id}}", image], "image-check")
        if not re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", image_id):
            raise RuntimeError("Invalid candidate image identity")
        active = json.loads(execute(["docker", "inspect", "--format", "{{json .Config.Env}}", "erp-next-api-1"], "database-check"))
        active_env = dict(entry.split("=", 1) for entry in active if "=" in entry)
        database = urlsplit(active_env.get("DATABASE_URL", ""))
        if unquote(database.path).lstrip("/") != "erp_next" or database.hostname not in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "host.docker.internal"}:
            raise RuntimeError("Active database is not the expected local ERP database")
    
        psql = ["sudo", "-n", "-u", "postgres", "psql", "-X", "-qAt", "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1", "-d", "erp_next"]
    
        def state(stage):
            rows = json.loads(execute(psql, stage, input=STATE_SQL))
            if not isinstance(rows, list) or any(not isinstance(row, dict) or row.get("success") is not True or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{96}", str(row.get("checksum", ""))) for row in rows):
                raise RuntimeError("Migration ledger contains an invalid or unsuccessful entry")
            return rows
    
        before = state("ledger-before")
        private_file(private / "ledger-before.json", json.dumps(before, indent=2) + "\n")
        dump = ["sudo", "-n", "-u", "postgres", "pg_dump", "--no-owner", "--no-privileges"]
        schema = execute(dump + ["--schema-only", "erp_next"], "schema-backup")
        if not schema:
            raise RuntimeError("Empty schema backup; migration was not started")
        private_file(private / "schema-before.sql", schema + "\n")
        ledger = execute(dump + ["--data-only", "--table=public._sqlx_migrations", "--column-inserts", "erp_next"], "ledger-backup")
        if not ledger:
            raise RuntimeError("Empty ledger backup; migration was not started")
        private_file(private / "ledger-before.sql", ledger + "\n")
        pg_uid = execute(["id", "-u", "postgres"], "postgres-user")
        if not pg_uid.isdigit():
            raise RuntimeError("Invalid PostgreSQL operating-system identity")
        command = ["docker", "run", "--rm", "--name", "erp-next-migration-" + sha, "--network", "none", "--read-only",
                   "--security-opt", "no-new-privileges:true", "--cap-drop", "ALL", "--pids-limit", "64", "--memory", "256m",
                   "--user", pg_uid, "--volume", "/var/run/postgresql:/var/run/postgresql:ro", "--env", "DATABASE_URL", image, "migrate"]
        environment = {**os.environ, "DATABASE_URL": "postgresql://postgres@localhost/erp_next?host=/var/run/postgresql"}
        output = execute(command, "migration", env=environment)
        private_file(private / "migration.log", output + "\n")
        after = state("ledger-after")
        if any(row not in after for row in before):
            raise RuntimeError("Existing migration checksums changed; services must not be activated")
        private_file(private / "ledger-after.json", json.dumps(after, indent=2) + "\n")
        proof = {"sha": sha, "imageId": image_id, "applied": True, "beforeCount": len(before), "afterCount": len(after),
                 "schemaBackupSha256": hashlib.sha256((schema + "\n").encode()).hexdigest(), "binaryBuiltOnServer": False}
        private_file(private / "verification.json", json.dumps(proof, indent=2) + "\n")
        return proof
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        os.umask(0o077)
        try:
            if len(sys.argv) != 3:
                raise ValueError("Expected revision and release directory")
            print(json.dumps(migrate_release(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])))
        except Exception:
            print("ERP migration preflight failed; services were not activated. Inspect the private release diagnostic.", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)

    Update { move_path: None }: C:\Users\nicol\.codex\worktrees\a9e9\erp-next-main\deploy\README.md
    @@ -40,2 +40,24 @@
     
    +O dispatcher versionado em `deploy/production-deploy.sh` recebe também
    +`migrate-release.py` no pacote da mesma revisão. Após validar o Compose, ele
    +executa o helper antes de instalar o rollback de ativação ou iniciar serviços.
    +O helper guarda schema, ledger SQLx e diagnóstico em
    +`private/migration-<sha>/`, com diretório privado e arquivos de acesso restrito.
    +Confere o banco local esperado e aplica o comando `migrate` da imagem candidata
    +por socket PostgreSQL, com a identidade local do postgres. Nenhuma senha é
    +incluída na linha de comando. Não compila código no servidor.
    +
    +Falha de backup, checksum ou migração impede ativar os novos serviços. O helper
    +não restaura dados nem inicia containers da aplicação; os serviços anteriores
    +continuam ativos. Se a tentativa falhar, inspecione o diagnóstico privado e as
    +migrações já aplicadas antes de tentar novamente. Backups existentes não são
    +sobrescritos. As migrações devem conservar compatibilidade com a aplicação
    +anterior; o rollback da ativação troca imagens, sem desfazer DDL automaticamente.
    +
    +Antes da primeira publicação com esse protocolo, instale o dispatcher revisado
    +em `/usr/local/sbin/erp-next-deploy`, preservando uma cópia do anterior e esperando
    +terminar qualquer publicação em andamento. O helper é enviado pelo workflow;
    +não se instala uma cópia de revisão diferente fora do pacote. Validação local:
    +`python -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/deploy -p 'test_*.py'`.
    +
     Crie um diretório de release separado, copie a configuração privada da versão

    # Acabamentos dos catálogos: implementação
    
    > Execução inline por superpowers:executing-plans, com um único revisor final independente. Não delegar implementação.
    
    Goal: separar estrutura, braços e estofado de ponta a ponta e apresentar opções/amostras reais dos catálogos, preservando dados e histórico.
    Architecture: migração aditiva; contrato opcional no produto e itens; componentes existentes de acabamento com paleta explícita e rasters originais. Migração da imagem validada precede ativação da aplicação.
    Tech stack: Rust/SQLx/PostgreSQL, Next16/React19/TypeScript, testes Rust/Node/Playwright e Python para deploy.
    Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-12-catalog-finishes-source-parity.md
    Base: e065b0d5191abd8f176ef4c1310b3e1ffc9c4c3a; branch feat/catalog-finishes-source-parity-20261112; worktree a9e9.
    
    ## Global constraints
    Não preencher nacionais/Core ou inserir dez modelos excluídos. Não sobrescrever fotos, preços, status, impostos, estoque ou histórico. Não reutilizar aliases armColors/armColor. Não gerar aproximações das imagens. Não compilar no servidor nem enviar e-mail/NF-e real nos testes. Publicação e preenchimento Premium já autorizados. Preservar processos e checkout do usuário.
    
    ## Task1 — contrato e persistência dos componentes
    Files: migrations/202611120003_catalog_finishes.sql; apps/api/src/domains/catalog.rs; sales.rs; sales/proposals.rs; sales/negotiation_model.rs; sales/negotiation.rs; sales/pricing_orders.rs; caminhos de snapshots/conversões/contratos encontrados na leitura; testes HTTP de produtos/propostas/negociação e OpenAPI.
    Interfaces: ProductInput.swing_arm_colors:Option<Vec<String>>,finishing_palette:Option<String>; itens swing_arm_color:Option<String>. upholstery permanece estofado; aliases legados permanecem anilheiro. Novas colunas em products e linhas existentes, sem reescrever dados antigos.
    - [ ] Escrever testes RED de roundtrip/omissão, validação e legado independente.
    - [ ] Implementar leitura/gravação/validação e propagar o campo nas conversões e snapshots.
    - [ ] Testar edição de quantidade com seleção histórica inalterada após mudança de paleta; opções novas inválidas continuam recusadas.
    - [ ] Rustfmt/clippy/contrato e testes apropriados; exportar OpenAPI real para a web.
    
    ## Task2 — paletas originais e seleção compacta
    Files: apps/web/src/features/catalog/catalog-color-photo-model.ts,catalog-color-photos.tsx,catalog-workspace.tsx; public/catalog rasters/provenance; apps/web/src/features/sales/orders.tsx,proposals.tsx,commercial-simulator.tsx,negotiation-types.ts,documentos/detalhes; modelos e navegador.
    Interfaces: palette explícita do produto + componente semântico; swingArmColors/swingArmColor novos; nomes atuais de estofado corretos. Desconhecido não recebe swatch aproximado.
    - [ ] RED: cores e componentes independentes, nenhuma equivalência Amarelo→Apple Green, estofado não configurável não esconde braços.
    - [ ] Reutilizar rasters originais e implementar as três seções/rótulos/seleções; atualizar os fluxos de proposta, pedido, simulador e documentos.

    function key(value: string, part: CatalogFinishPart) {
      const normalized = value.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/[\s-]+/g, "")
      return part !== "upholstery" && normalized === "mattegraphiteblack" ? "graphiteblack" : normalized
    }
    
    export type CatalogPalette = CatalogFinishPalette
    
    export function catalogPaletteFor(reference: unknown): CatalogPalette | undefined {
      return typeof reference === "string" && getCatalogFinishPalette(reference) ? reference as CatalogPalette : undefined
    }
    
    export function catalogColorPhoto(value: string, reference?: CatalogPalette, part: CatalogFinishPart = "structure") {
      const palette = getCatalogFinishPalette(reference)
      if (!palette) return undefined
      const normalized = key(value, part)
      if (![...palette[part].standard, ...palette[part].special].some(name => key(name, part) === normalized)) return undefined
      const photos = reference === "dhz-sforce" ? sforcePhotos : proPhotos
      const photo = photos.find(photo => key(photo.name, part) === normalized)
      return photo ? { ...photo, asset: palette.source.asset, sourceWidth: 1245, sourceHeight: 1759 } : undefined
    }

    "use client"
    
    import { catalogColorPhoto, type CatalogPalette } from "./catalog-color-photo-model"
    import { catalogFinishGroups, getCatalogFinishPalette, type CatalogFinishPart } from "./catalog-finish-palettes"
    
    type CatalogColorPhotosProps = {
      label: string
      options?: readonly string[]
      value?: string
      onChange?: (value: string) => void
      disabled?: boolean
      palette?: CatalogPalette
      part: CatalogFinishPart
      readOnly?: boolean
      showSource?: boolean
    }
    
    export function CatalogPaletteReference({ palette }: { palette?: CatalogPalette }) {
      const source = getCatalogFinishPalette(palette)?.source
      return source ? <a className="text-xs text-muted-foreground underline underline-offset-2" href={source.asset} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Ver paleta original e combinações · {source.title}, {source.printedPage ? `pág. ${source.printedPage}` : `PDF pág. ${source.pdfPage}`}</a> : null
    }
    
    export function CatalogColorPhotos({ label, options, value, onChange, disabled, palette, part, readOnly = false, showSource = true }: CatalogColorPhotosProps) {
      const names = [...new Set(options ?? [])]
      if (!names.length) return null
      const groups = catalogFinishGroups(palette, part, names)
      const hasPhotos = names.some(name => catalogColorPhoto(name, palette, part))
      return <div className="min-w-0 space-y-2" role="group" aria-label={`${label}: ${hasPhotos ? "fotos do catálogo DHZ" : "opções de acabamento"}`}>
        {([["standard", "Padrão"], ["special", "Especiais do catálogo"], ["other", "Outras opções cadastradas"]] as const).map(([group, title]) => groups[group].length > 0 && <div key={group} className="min-w-0 space-y-1.5">
          {(group === "special" || group === "other" && hasPhotos || group === "standard" && groups.special.length > 0) && <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{title}</p>}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {groups[group].map(option => {
            const photo = catalogColorPhoto(option, palette, part)
            const scale = photo ? 46 / photo.width : 1
            const content = <>
              {photo && <span aria-hidden="true" className="flex h-9 items-center"><span className="block shrink-0 rounded-sm" style={{
                width: 46,
                height: photo.height * scale,
                backgroundImage: `url("${photo.asset}")`,
                backgroundRepeat: "no-repeat",
                backgroundSize: `${photo.sourceWidth * scale}px ${photo.sourceHeight * scale}px`,
                backgroundPosition: `${-photo.x * scale}px ${-photo.y * scale}px`,
              }} /></span>}
              <span className="w-full break-words [overflow-wrap:anywhere]">{option}</span>
            </>
            const cardClass = `${photo ? "w-14 sm:w-16" : "min-h-11 min-w-14 max-w-36 px-2"} flex shrink-0 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-md border p-1 text-center text-[11px] leading-tight`
            return readOnly ? <div key={option} className={cardClass}>{content}</div> : <button key={option} type="button" disabled={disabled || !onChange} aria-pressed={value === option} onClick={() => onChange?.(option)} title={option}
              className={`${cardClass} focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${value === option ? "border-primary ring-1 ring-primary" : "border-border hover:border-primary"}`}>{content}</button>
          })}
          </div>
        </div>)}
        {showSource && hasPhotos && <CatalogPaletteReference palette={palette} />}
      </div>
    }

    # Produtos
    
    [Todas as telas](../../../README.md) · [Cadastros](../README.md)
    
    Consultar, cadastrar e editar os produtos da empresa ativa.
    
    **Onde acessar:** `/cadastros/produtos`.
    
    ## O que aparece na tela
    
    - Nome, SKU e unidade
    - Categoria e situação
    - Preço base, NCM e CEST
    - Foto e acabamentos disponíveis
    
    ## O que você pode fazer
    
    - Buscar por nome ou SKU e filtrar por categoria ou situação
    - Abrir um produto, criar ou editar
    - Arquivar ou reativar pelo campo Situação
    
    ## Regras e limites
    
    Preço base, custo de compra e preço da tabela publicada são informações diferentes. Editar um produto não altera os documentos comerciais anteriores.
    
    ## O que ainda precisa de atenção
    
    Separar braços e estofado nos dados e apresentar as paletas originais de cada catálogo. Essa correção ainda não deve ser tratada como concluída. Não existe escolha comercial de cor de anilheiro; o tipo é escolhido na proposta ou no pedido.
    
    ## Referências para manutenção
    
    Guia conferido no código de 12/11/2026. As ações dependem das permissões e da configuração da empresa. Relatos técnicos antigos descrevem a etapa em que foram escritos.
    
    - [product-media](referencias/product-media.md)
    - [CORES-EQUIPAMENTOS](referencias/CORES-EQUIPAMENTOS.md)
    - [LUDUS-CATALOGO-PUBLICACAO](referencias/LUDUS-CATALOGO-PUBLICACAO.md)
    - [catalog-workspace](../../../../apps/web/src/features/catalog/catalog-workspace.tsx)
    # Propostas comerciais
    
    [Todas as telas](../../../README.md) · [Vendas](../README.md)
    
    Preparar um orçamento, acompanhar sua decisão e preservar as versões negociadas.
    
    **Onde acessar:** `/vendas/propostas`.
    
    ## O que aparece na tela
    
    - Cliente e produtos
    - Quantidade, preço e acabamentos por item
    - Validade
    - Pagamento, entrega e observações
    - Histórico de versões e situação
    
    ## O que você pode fazer
    
    - Pesquisar e criar uma proposta
    - Salvar e editar o rascunho
    - Imprimir ou salvar PDF
    - Enviar por e-mail quando disponível e autorizado
    - Registrar envio, aceite, rejeição ou cancelamento
    - Revisar uma versão ou converter uma proposta aceita em pedido
    
    ## Regras e limites
    
    Para enviar, abra **Enviar por e-mail**, confira destinatário, assunto e mensagem e confirme o envio com anexo. O servidor precisa estar configurado para e-mail. O anexo atual é um documento HTML da proposta; o PDF pode ser salvo pela impressão do navegador.
    
    Marcar como enviada registra uma situação interna; isso não envia um e-mail. Se o envio ficar sem confirmação, não faça um novo envio: consulte o histórico e o resultado da mesma solicitação e confira a situação com o provedor de e-mail. Um envio pendente bloqueia novas mensagens para evitar duplicação. Uma proposta não movimenta estoque nem contas a receber. A conversão cria um pedido que ainda segue suas etapas de confirmação.
    
    ## O que ainda precisa de atenção
    
    A escolha do tipo de anilheiro deve ficar no item: Standard, Olímpico ou Não se aplica. A separação definitiva das paletas de braços e estofado está em desenvolvimento.
    
    ## Referências para manutenção
    
    Guia conferido no código de 12/11/2026. As ações dependem das permissões e da configuração da empresa. Relatos técnicos antigos descrevem a etapa em que foram escritos.
    
    - [sales-proposals](referencias/sales-proposals.md)
    - [proposals](../../../../apps/web/src/features/sales/proposals.tsx)

    file changes: Completed · 1 changes
    Add: C:\Users\nicol\.codex\worktrees\a9e9\erp-next-main\artifacts\catalog-finishes-pr-body.md
    Braços e estofado compartilhavam dados e rótulos em parte do fluxo comercial, e as amostras podiam ser inferidas sem uma referência confirmada do catálogo. Agora estrutura, braços e estofado têm campos independentes, seleções próprias e imagens originais da paleta explicitamente vinculada ao produto. As opções padrão e especiais ficam separadas; cores genéricas preservam seu texto. Os nomes permanecem legíveis no celular.
    
    A seleção dos braços acompanha propostas, pedidos, simuladores, conversões, documentos, contratos e dados fiscais. A omissão por clientes antigos e as escolhas históricas, inclusive ausência de seleção, são preservadas. Os aliases antigos de cores de anilheiro continuam independentes; a interface oferece somente o tipo de anilheiro. Estofado fixo na empresa não oculta os braços.
    
    A migração aditiva 202611120003 exige atualizar o schema antes de ativar as imagens. O pacote inclui um helper da mesma revisão que guarda schema/ledger privados e executa SQLx na imagem candidata por socket PostgreSQL. Backup ou migração falhos interrompem a ativação. O dispatcher deve ser instalado com backup e lock antes da primeira publicação desse protocolo. Não há compilação no servidor.
    
    Validação: suíte API com 467 testes aprovados e um ignorado, mais regressão atualizada do simulador aprovada; Clippy sem avisos; 156 modelos Node; 59 casos distintos de navegador, incluindo paletas em 320/393/1280px, proposta em 320/390px, teclado e preservação de escolhas. Build padrão, tipos e lint do trecho aprovados. Helper Python 7/7, planejador CI 13/13, contrato Node do dispatcher e sintaxe Bash aprovados. Revisão independente única sem achados críticos/importantes; documentação por tela atualizada.
    
    Este PR implementa a capacidade. A associação dos cadastros Premium às fontes e a atualização da planilha serão conferidas e aplicadas depois da publicação. Os produtos Core permanecem em aberto e os dez modelos excluídos não serão inseridos.

    # Google Sheets
    
    Use this skill to keep spreadsheet work grounded in the exact spreadsheet, sheet, range, headers, and formulas that matter.
    
    ## Purpose Of This File
    
    This file covers:
    
    1. routing to the right spreadsheet workflow
    2. stateful operation and mandatory routing to reference files
    3. live-read/search safety for direct connector calls
    4. final-response citations and delivery
    
    Detailed editing, formula, chart, upload, live-read/search, and batch-update rules live in `references/`.
    Latency is not a constraint for this skill, so always read the relevant reference files before performing the task.
    If the user has not provided explicit style direction, read `references/style-profiles.md` and apply the appropriate Google Sheets destination default before authoring workbook formatting.
    
    ## Default Routing
    
    1. New Google Sheet from a native Google Sheets reference or template URL: copy the entire source workbook with the Drive file-copy action, then trim or repair the copy. Treat a deep-linked `gid` as the initial view, not copy scope. Duplicate one source sheet only when the user explicitly requests a single-sheet extraction. Do not rebuild through `.xlsx` when chips, validation, formulas, rich links, or formatting matter.
    2. Other new Google Sheets creation: Inspect the available skills and plugins for the registered `Spreadsheets` capability. It may be exposed as the `$Spreadsheets` skill, the `@Spreadsheets` plugin, or the plugin URI `plugin://spreadsheets@openai-primary-runtime`. If found, load and follow its instructions.
       - If a system spreadsheet plugin or skill is installed, YOU MUST use it to create a local `.xlsx`. Then import the `.xlsx` into Drive as a native Google Sheets spreadsheet. For table-like option/list/dropdown columns, seed a valid row and add native table `DROPDOWN` columns post-import.
       - If neither skill is installed, create the spreadsheet directly with Google Sheets MCP.
    3. Existing Google Sheets edits: use Google Sheets MCP directly.
    
    Deliver the verified native Google Sheet. Never include the local `.xlsx` unless explicitly asked for by the user.
    
    ## File Safety
    
    Treat a provided Google Sheet as read-only unless the user explicitly asks to edit that file. When a task uses the Sheet as a reference, template, similar structure, or data source, copy it or create a separate Sheet, then verify the output spreadsheet ID differs before writing.
    
    ## Canonical Workflow Bias
    
    Prefer one simple proven workflow over a large tree of recovery branches.
    When a task matches a known successful pattern, follow that pattern directly instead of re-evaluating every possible fallback path.
    Do not let accumulated edge-case guardrails turn a straightforward Sheets task into a long blocker-analysis exercise.
    
    For sheet creation and editing tasks, prefer this sequence when viable:
    
    1. Gather the required source material.
    2. Pick the correct default routing.
    3. Establish the sheet checklist or sheet plan.
    4. Build or edit the sheet.
    5. Verify the sheet is clean, complete, native, and scannable per `references/reference-visual-quality.md`.
    6. Stop once the verified workflow has succeeded.
    
    If a simple verified workflow is viable, use it. Do not drift into speculative alternate paths.
    
    ## Required Read Order (No Skips)
    
    For every route that creates, imports, or edits a Google Sheet, read `references/reference-visual-quality.md` before final verification.
    
    If Default Routing uses native Google Sheets reference-follow creation:
    1. Read `references/reference-edit-workflow.md`
    2. Read `references/reference-live-read-search-safety.md`
    3. Read `references/reference-native-cell-structure.md`
    4. Read `references/reference-batch-update-recipes.md`
    
    If Default Routing uses the system spreadsheet plugin or skill like `[@spreadsheets](plugin://spreadsheets@openai-primary-runtime)` or `$Spreadsheets`:
    1. Read the plugin/skill, e.g. `[@spreadsheets](plugin://spreadsheets@openai-primary-runtime)`
    2. Read `references/reference-import-spreadsheet-to-native-sheets.md`
    3. If the new Sheet has explicit or reference-derived option/list/dropdown columns, read `references/reference-batch-update-recipes.md` before the post-import table batch update.
    
    If Default Routing uses connector edit workflow:
    
    1. Read `references/reference-edit-workflow.md`.
    2. Before any direct live range read, cell read, or `search_spreadsheet_rows`, read `references/reference-live-read-search-safety.md`.
    3. Read every task-specific file from the matrix below.
    4. If the task spans multiple categories, read all matching files.
    5. If uncertain, read every file in `references/`.
    
    ## Final Answer Requirement
    
    Unless Default Routing selected native Google Sheets reference-follow creation, if the registered `Spreadsheets` capability like the `[@spreadsheets](plugin://spreadsheets@openai-primary-runtime)` plugin is available, you MUST use one of them to create a local `.xlsx` and import it to Google Drive with `upload_mode: "native_google_sheets"`.
    
    ### Final Response Citations
    
    - **Create/edit:** for created or edited spreadsheets, cite each final deliverable exactly once with `purpose="output"`, in its own paragraph. Briefly describe the result without repeating its filename, path, or link. Never put output directives inside prose or list items.
    - **Q&A and summaries:** Every file whose contents you summarize or use to support an answer MUST receive a `:codex-file-citation{...}` with `purpose="source"` in the final response. Use the source citation in place of the filename, wherever the filename would appear. Do not write the filename separately and append its citation at the end. Files merely inspected but not used in the answer need no citation. Do not emit output citations for unchanged files or read-only answers.
    
    - Emit `:codex-file-citation{...}` directly, without backticks, code fences, or a Markdown-link wrapper. Use verified targets only. No need to cite or reference intermediate work.
    
    Deliver a native Google Sheets file even when another authoring workflow was used to build it, unless the user explicitly requests preservation of the source file type or no conversion. Set `path` to its verified native URL returned by the connector and omit `mode`. Citation directives are exempt from “Return web URLs as Markdown links.”
    
    Some illustrative examples, real responses use verified targets outside code fences.
    
    ```text
    :codex-file-citation{path="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<verified-file-id>" purpose="output"}
    ```
    
    ```text
    The review of :codex-file-citation{path="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<verified-file-id>" purpose="source"} is due Friday.
    ```
    
    ### Spreadsheets location
    
    Use/create `ChatGPT` at My Drive root. Place new spreadsheets created from scratch or from a template there.
    Edit existing spreadsheets in place.
    
    Respect user-specified locations.

    6. Before each edit pass, identify the exact sheet, range, headers, formulas, and validation constraints being edited through connector reads.
    7. Re-read target cells before writing when live values, formulas, formatting, or validation could affect the write.

    # Edit Workflow
    
    When to read: before existing Google Sheets inspection that may lead to an edit, and before any existing spreadsheet content write or edit operation.
    
    ## Workflow
    
    Read `./reference-live-read-search-safety.md` before connector reads or row search, and `./reference-native-cell-structure.md` before extending populated rows or columns.
    
    1. If the spreadsheet or tab is not already grounded, identify it first and read metadata before deeper reads or writes.
    2. Prefer narrow reads and row search over dumping large tabs into context.
    3. Ground the task in exact sheet, range, header, and formula context before proposing changes.
    4. When a read could influence a write, default to `get_cells`. Treat `get_range` as the exception and use it only when plain displayed values are truly sufficient.
    5. If the task involves filling in, editing, or normalizing existing cells, do not rely on `get_range` alone. Inspect the target cells with `get_cells` first so value choices come from the live cell metadata.
    6. When validation-backed cells may matter, prefer a `get_cells` read that includes the live constraint data you need, for example `dataValidation,formattedValue,effectiveValue,userEnteredValue`.
    7. When preparing to write into existing cells, check whether the target range is constrained by dropdowns or other data validation before choosing values.
    8. Do not infer allowed values from plain neighboring text alone when validation may exist.
    9. If validation is present, restate the allowed values or rule before drafting or applying the write.
    10. Before the first write-heavy `batch_update`, read `./reference-batch-update-recipes.md` for request-shape recall.
    11. Cluster logically related edits into one `batch_update` so the batch is coherent and atomic.
    12. Avoid both mega-batches and one-request micro-batches.
    13. If the user asks to clean, normalize, or restructure data, summarize the intended table shape before writing.
    14. For exact-row, fixed-count, or report-style tasks, keep the findings narrowly scoped to the requested conclusions only.
    15. Do not add extra metrics, adjacent commentary, or bonus rows unless the user asked for them.
    16. After writing, run `./reference-visual-quality.md` before the final answer.
    
    Preserve existing values, formulas, validation, chips, and formatting outside the requested change. For content-only edits, retain the target cell's formatting unless the user asks to change it.
    
    ## Output Conventions
    
    - Always reference the spreadsheet, sheet name, and range when describing findings or planned edits.
    - For `batch_update` work, use a compact table or list with the request type, target range or sheet, proposed change, and reason.
    # Live Read And Search Safety
    
    When to read: before direct connector range reads, cell reads, or `search_spreadsheet_rows` calls against an existing Google Sheet.
    
    ## Rules
    
    - Read spreadsheet metadata before direct live reads or searches. Record visible sheet titles, `sheetId` values, grid row/column counts, frozen/header rows if exposed, and any relevant named ranges.
    - Use exact visible sheet titles from metadata. Do not assume `Sheet1`, `Sheet2`, localized default names, or title-derived tab names.
    - If a spreadsheet has exactly one visible sheet, you may infer that sheet for read-only inspection after metadata confirms it. For writes, still name the resolved sheet explicitly.
    - Keep `sheet_name` and cell-only `range` separate when the connector has separate arguments. Use a full A1 string with quoted sheet names only for tools that require a single A1 range argument.
    - Quote sheet names in full A1 notation when they contain spaces, punctuation, apostrophes, or non-ASCII characters.
    - Bound `search_spreadsheet_rows` calls to the smallest plausible rectangle. Avoid whole-grid or whole-column searches unless the computed scan is safely below the tool cap.
    - Keep row-search scans under 50,000 cells. Compute `(end_row - start_row + 1) * scanned_column_count` before the call, and chunk by rows or columns when the first useful range would exceed the cap.
    - Do not call row search with an empty query, a query that only repeats a sheet title, or `return_columns` outside the searched rectangle.
    - If a range or tab read fails, do not retry the same guessed range. Re-read metadata, list exact tab names in your working notes, then retry with a metadata-derived sheet and a smaller range.
    - Prefer targeted sentinel reads such as header rows, known id columns, or bounded data rectangles before escalating to broader scans.
    
    ## Recovery Patterns
    
    - Tab not found: re-read metadata, compare against exact visible titles, then use the single visible sheet only if metadata proves there is one.
    - Range parse error: separate `sheet_name` from cell-only `range` when possible, or quote the sheet name in full A1 notation.
    - Range too large: shrink to header plus likely data columns, then page through bounded chunks. Do not repeat the oversized call.
    - No rows found: confirm the query value exists in a small displayed-value read before broadening the search.
    # Spreadsheet Visual Quality
    
    When to read: before finalizing any Google Sheet created, imported, or edited.
    
    ## Scope
    
    - Edit: changed cells/objects plus visible neighbors or dependents.
    - New, imported, or reference/template-based Sheet: every populated visible sheet and important output/chart; compare equivalent reference views.
    
    For a new Sheet, size/style the authored area as a whole, never the unused grid.
    
    ## Final Check
    
    1. Verify values/formulas and native structure, then inspect the Google-rendered Sheet at normal zoom.
    2. Fix clipping, awkward wrapping, overlap, unreadable controls, or damaged layout with the smallest change. For an inserted or substantially changed populated column, use Resize a Column in `./reference-batch-update-recipes.md`.
    3. Validate formatting is applied properly and consistently (e.g. when styling a table, prefer rules based conditional formatting over manual per-row formatting).
    4. Re-read and re-render. Confirm the fix and no unrelated data, structure, dimension, or layout changes.
    
    Never sheet-wide autofit or restyle an edit, import, reference, or template without authorization. Preserve intentional fixed dimensions and report unavoidable clipping.
    
    ## Google Sheets Evidence - Visual Verification
    
    If CUA is authenticated and enabled, use it for visual verification of each sheet. If CUA is unavilable, export the Google Sheet to `.xlsx` and import, render and inspect via artifact_tool_v2. Note that Gsheet specific structures may not fully port to local .xlsx and there are known compatability differences between Gsheet and Excel. Do not verify via exported PDF as it may look very different. If none of these available, do a best effort visual validation pass by reading the formatting and style details directly from GoogleSheet API.

    "use client"
    
    import { erpFetch } from "@/lib/api/client"
    import type { Schema } from "@/lib/api/types"
    import { AutomaticCnpj, fillCompanyFields } from "@/features/records/automatic-cnpj"
    
    import Link from "next/link"
    import { accessHref, safeReturnTo } from "@/lib/return-to"
    import { AccessLink } from "@/components/feedback/session-recovery"
    import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation"
    import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore, type FormEvent } from "react"
    import { CompanySelectionError, selectCompany } from "./company-selection"
    
    const uuidPattern = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i
    
    function isCompanyDirectory(value: unknown): value is { data: (Schema<"CompanySummary"> & { status?: string })[]; platformAdministrator: boolean } {
      if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return false
      const body = value as { data?: unknown; platformAdministrator?: unknown }
      if (typeof body.platformAdministrator !== "boolean" || !Array.isArray(body.data)) return false
      const valid = body.data.every(item => {
          if (!item || typeof item !== "object") return false
          const company = item as Partial<Schema<"CompanySummary">> & { status?: unknown }
          return typeof company.id === "string"
            && uuidPattern.test(company.id)
            && typeof company.legalName === "string"
            && (company.tradeName === undefined || company.tradeName === null || typeof company.tradeName === "string")
            && typeof company.status === "string"
        })
      return valid && new Set(body.data.map(item => (item as { id: string }).id)).size === body.data.length
    }
